### [1] [NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40000v1)
*Zhuoran Li,Chen Gu,Zhuohang Bian,Haochen Yu,Yibo Zhao,Xuxiao Yang,Zhaori Cong,Jinshan Yue,Qing Luo,Di Geng,Ling Li,Youwei Zhuo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: NORmal 是首个面向 3D 铁电 NOR 闪存（FeNOR）的主存架构，通过将 BEOL 共集成的 3-bit MLC 与亚 7.5 ns SLC 阵列经 DRAM 仿真桥接入未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，作为普通 rank 提供字节可寻址的确定性访存，并按"可变性与生命周期"而非热度为智能体状态分层，使手机端可原地服务 200B 级模型与长上下文规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机端智能体团队（大规划器 + 并行 worker、长会话）需要 200B 级模型和远超手机 DRAM 容量的上下文。现有分层方案把闪存当存储：UFS 带宽不足，无法支撑逐 token 权重流式加载；移动 HBF 需重新设计 SoC，且无法承接持续的 KV 写入。作者指出，只要访问延迟落在 DRAM 时序窗口内，非易失存储器就能作为普通 rank 挂上未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，而现有 NAND 层级均不满足该条件——这构成了本文的核心设计机会。

Method: 硬件层面：流片并实验表征 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列，同一阵列共集成高密度 3-bit MLC 与高耐久、可原地写入的 SLC，感测时间低于 7.5 ns。系统层面：通过三个机制把该阵列变为 LPDDR6 上字节可寻址、时序确定的 load/store rank——(1) 阵列下方 DRAM 仿真桥，(2) 交错 bank 读取与零周期权重 swizzling，(3) posted SLC 写。数据放置策略：跨越该 rank 与 DRAM，按可变性和生命周期（而非访问热度）划分智能体状态，权重与持久规划器上下文原地驻留，并按智能体阶段动态划分子通道。

Result: 基于生产级智能体 trace 的服务级仿真显示：相较 UFS offloading 快 8.9×–28.0×；与无限 DRAM 理想方案差距在 0.4% 以内；在超过 256K token 的会话上比 HBF 快 2.8×–6.3×；每 token 内存能耗降低 8.1×–17.8×。

Conclusion: 满足 DRAM 时序窗口的非易失存储可无缝并入现有移动主存总线，3D FeNOR 依此成为可行的"第二主存"。以可变性/生命周期为准则的状态放置与子通道动态划分，可将现有移动端内存层级从"容量受限"推进到接近无限 DRAM 的服务水平，同时显著降低能耗，无需改动 SoC 或 LPDDR6 接口。

Abstract: Smartphone agents increasingly work as teams, in which a large planner directs parallel workers across long sessions. Running such a team on the device requires 200B-class models and contexts that exceed phone DRAM many times over, yet existing tiers treat flash as storage: UFS starves per-token weight streaming, and mobile High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) needs a redesigned SoC and cannot absorb continuous KV writes. We show that a non-volatile memory can join an unmodified LPDDR6 bus as a plain rank only if its access latency fits the DRAM timing window, a condition no NAND tier meets. We present NORmal, to our knowledge the first main-memory architecture for 3D ferroelectric NOR flash. We have fabricated and experimentally characterized back-end-of-line (BEOL) 3D FeNOR arrays that co-integrate dense 3-bit MLC and fast, high-endurance in-place-writable SLC with sub-7.5 ns sensing. NORmal turns these co-fabricated arrays into a byte-addressable, deterministic-timing load/store rank on an unmodified LPDDR6 interface through an under-array DRAM-emulation bridge, staggered bank reads with zero-cycle weight swizzling, and posted SLC writes. Across this rank and DRAM, NORmal places agent state by mutability and lifetime rather than by hotness, serving 200B-class models and persistent planner contexts in place while dynamically partitioning subchannels across agent phases. In serving-level simulation on production agent traces, NORmal is 8.9$\times$--28.0$\times$ faster than UFS offloading, within 0.4% of an unlimited-DRAM ideal, and 2.8$\times$--6.3$\times$ faster than HBF on sessions beyond 256K tokens, with 8.1$\times$--17.8$\times$ less memory energy per token.

</details>


### [2] [LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39882v1)
*Zecheng Xu,Guanhua Chen,Yumao Wu,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出以LLM充当"版图工程师"的模拟电路布局(placement)框架，将约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能轻量评估封装为可组合放置组件；LLM依据初始与演化中设计的多模态检查点选择并组合组件，构建与修订自有布局流程，并通过"打开模块/划分并重组器件"自适应调整布局层级，辅以可复用的经验技能引导决策。在SMIC 180nm的两个电路上降低了布局面积并改善多数测得的后版图性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟版图需要在面积、匹配、可布线性与电性能之间做电路相关的权衡；仅靠预定义目标函数与固定布局流程难以平衡这些权衡。作者希望让布局流程本身能够按电路特点被动态构建与修订，从而更灵活地处理冲突目标与全局/局部设计需求。

Method: 1) 将布局能力解耦为可组合组件：约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能的轻量评估；2) 以LLM作为决策主体，输入初始与迭代演化设计的多模态检查点(版图/检查信息)，由其选择与组合组件，构建并修正专属布局流程；3) 支持层级自适应：重开(重新打开)已放置模块，或将器件划分重组，使局部布局响应全局需求；4) 引入经验技能库作为可复用设计知识，指导组件选择与层级调整决策。

Result: 在SMIC 180nm工艺的两个电路上进行评测，结果表明该框架减小了布局面积，并在大多数所测后版图性能指标上取得改善；同时验证了LLM驱动的组件组合与层级自适应机制能够形成电路相关的布局流程。

Conclusion: LLM结合可组合布局组件与经验技能，可作为模拟版图流程的构建者与修订者，实现面向电路特性的权衡调节与层级自适应，在面积与后版图性能上获得收益。该方法把"流程设计"本身纳入优化回路，为模拟布局提供了区别于固定流程与纯数值优化的新范式；其局限在于评测规模有限(两电路、180nm)，可布线与电性能评估为轻量近似。

Abstract: Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

</details>


### [3] [Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39797v1)
*Jacky Wong,Jacob Alexandrou,Yinting Huang,Luke Panayi,Lev Mukhanov,Sam Ainsworth,Paul Kelly*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Caerus 是一种在多个互不重叠的全局偏移上做 PC 局部过滤的偏移预取器，在 SPECspeed 2017 上取得 8.3% 几何平均加速，比 SOTA 的 Berti 高 2.0%，且硬件与 DRAM 流量开销低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算与访存之间的性能鸿沟使数据预取至关重要。偏移预取中，BOP 选取单一全局偏移、均匀发放，但缺乏上下文敏感的精度跟踪，导致 DRAM 流量显著增加、性能有时不佳；Berti 虽精度与性能出色，但其 PC 局部提取偏移的方式限制了捕捉全局访存模式的能力，在不少场景下反而不如 BOP 这类简单全局偏移预取器。二者各自的局限催生了对兼顾全局模式覆盖与高精度的偏移预取方法的需求。

Method: Caerus 从全局访存轨迹中提取多个非重叠偏移，并仅用尚未被先前已学偏移覆盖的访问来训练后续偏移，以最大化这些偏移的联合覆盖率；对每个提取出的偏移，按 PC 逐一跟踪其精度，判断其能否覆盖任意 PC 的未来访问，从而在应对复杂 delta 模式的同时保持高精度。

Result: 在 SPECspeed 2017 上，Caerus 取得 8.3% 的几何平均加速，比 Berti 高出 2.0%，同时硬件开销与 DRAM 流量开销均较低。

Conclusion: Caerus 将全局偏移提取与 PC 局部精度过滤相结合，弥补了 BOP 精度跟踪不足与 Berti 全局模式覆盖不足的短板，在低开销下实现了优于现有最优偏移预取器的性能。

Abstract: Modern processors rely heavily on data prefetching to bridge the growing performance gap between computation and memory accesses. In offset prefetching, prefetches are issued at an address delta relative to the most recently observed access, selecting deltas that have exhibited high coverage in the recent access-stream history. The Best-Offset Prefetcher (BOP) exemplifies this approach by selecting a single uniformly-issued global offset that delivers timely prefetches. However, its lack of context-sensitive accuracy tracking results in significantly increased DRAM traffic and sometimes disappointing performance. Conversely, Berti, the state-of-the-art offset prefetcher, achieves impressive prefetching performance and accuracy. However, its Program-Counter (PC)-local approach to extracting offsets limits its ability to capture global memory patterns, meaning there are many scenarios where simpler global offset prefetchers, such as BOP, outperform it.
  Observing the limitations of contemporary offset prefetchers, we present Caerus: an offset prefetcher that employs PC-local filtering on multiple non-overlapping globally derived offsets. Caerus extracts multiple offsets from the global memory trace and maximizes their combined coverage by training each offset only on accesses not already covered by previously learned offsets. The accuracy of each extracted offset is tracked per-PC based on whether it can cover future accesses for any PC. This allows Caerus to address complex delta patterns while maintaining high accuracy. In SPECspeed 2017, Caerus gains a geomean speedup of 8.3%, outperforming Berti by 2.0% while achieving low hardware and DRAM-traffic overhead.

</details>


### [4] [MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39638v1)
*Samaneh Rahimi,Ali Azarpeyvand*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出首个高基数广义最大冗余无符号数字（MRUD）数制，将UDR从radix-2推广到radix-2^h并保持无进位加法，配套完整算法与硬件架构；在45nm下相比MRSD最多降低30%延迟、26%面积、87%功耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRSD等有符号冗余数制虽可无进位加法，但因同时存在正负位元导致乘法开销大；UDR在radix-2已有优势但向高基数的推广尚属空白，且冗余数制普遍只支持有符号运算，缺乏类似常规二进制的统一有符号/无符号支持。

Method: 构建广义MRUD数制框架：给出数字编码、数字扩展、加/减/乘运算、符号取反、正/反向转换算法、上溢/下溢检测，以及有符号与无符号MRUD的硬件架构；在FreePDK 45nm库下评估RRR、BBR、BBB三种乘法器模式及MAC单元。

Result: 相比MRSD，MRUD最多降低30%延迟、26%面积、87%功耗；BBR模式下32×32操作数较最优常规架构延迟降低达43%；MAC单元仅在末尾做一次反向转换，吞吐率较DesignWare高64%、较Wallace高150%以上。

Conclusion: MRUD使高基数冗余算术在乘法器与MAC中性能显著提升，可作为有符号数字冗余数制的高效替代方案。

Abstract: Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well as Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, using the FreePDK 45nm library, demonstrate that MRUD achieves up to 30\% lower delay, 26\% smaller area, and 87\% lower power than MRSD. In BBR mode, MRUD achieves up to 43\% delay reduction over the best conventional architecture for 32$\times$32 operands, while in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, performing reverse conversion only once at the end yields up to 64\% higher throughput than DesignWare and over 150\% higher than Wallace. These results demonstrate that MRUD enables high-radix redundant arithmetic with significantly improved multiplier and MAC performance, making it an efficient alternative to conventional signed digit redundant number systems.

</details>


### [5] [LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39570v1)
*Leo Itoh,Junichiro Kadomoto*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于FPGA的在环开发环境，让LLM智能体实现CPU候选设计并用板载性能测量指导设计决策，成功将单周期RV32I核演进为三发射乱序RV32IM核，在Artix-7上达130 MHz、5.61 CoreMark/MHz；同候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代时，含实现在内的FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL仿真评估CPU候选设计的成本很高：长时间仿真需数小时，而短诊断运行可能漏掉执行后期才出现的性能退化，从而延误LLM智能体驱动的CPU开发中的设计决策。

Method: 构建由LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选并以板载性能测量来指导设计决策的开发环境；在人工监督下，以该流程将单周期RV32I核迭代为三发射乱序RV32IM核，并与单线程RTL仿真进行同候选对比评估。

Result: 最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上于130 MHz达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz；运行8000次CoreMark迭代时，FPGA评估（含实现）比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍；板级测量发现某候选在短诊断中表现更优、但在长时运行中出现性能退化，该结果指导了候选选择并促成基于RTL的根因分析与修复。

Conclusion: FPGA在环测量能提供比短诊断运行更可靠、且远快于长时RTL仿真的评估信号，可有效支撑LLM智能体参与的CPU迭代设计，并暴露长时运行中才显现的性能退化问题。

Abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.

</details>


### [6] [APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39515v1)
*Bingyang Liu,Xiaohan Gao,Souradip Poddar,David Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: APPlace：在全局布局阶段同时优化器件位置与接入点(AP)选择的路由感知模拟布局框架，并配合保持该结构的合法化阶段，在四个真实基准上取得更优的后布局性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟/混合信号布局中寄生与失配强烈影响电路性能，placement 又决定布线解空间与可达的后布局性能；而已有解析式布局方法仅基于中心点线长代理优化器件坐标、把 AP 选择留给布线。模拟电路中布线引脚是一段延伸的终端金属而非固定点，最优 AP 取决于其他相连器件的位置，因此"仅坐标"布局优化的是布线器实际不会使用的连接点。

Method: 提出 APPlace 路由感知框架：在全局布局中联合优化器件位置与 AP 选择（AP 与放置协同优化），随后设置合法化阶段，保持全局布局建立的结构不被破坏。

Result: 在四个真实模拟基准上，在面积相当情况下，APPlace 的后布局整体性能优于代表性基线；消融实验显示，移除 AP 协同优化导致 OTA 基准 CMRR 最多下降 13 dB，比较器延迟增加 23%。

Conclusion: 模拟布局中 AP 选择必须与器件位置联合优化，坐标-only 的布局代理不足；AP 协同优化对关键模拟指标（CMRR、延迟）有显著贡献。

Abstract: Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Ablation studies further show that removing AP co-optimization causes up to a 13 dB CMRR loss among the OTA benchmarks and a 23% increase in comparator delay.

Abstract: Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level prediction accuracy and robustness remain to be evaluated.

Abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.

</details>


### [9] [Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39380v1)
*Yi Ding,Li Shang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Formulaic 流程：由语言模型智能体编写数学形式化（formulation），求解器在其内优化，验证与测量核查假设与结果，从而跨越 AI 基础设施中"芯片与软件需协同改动"的层次边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 基础设施（芯片与软件）按层次设计，层次虽使系统可管理，却固定了优化器可考虑的选择空间；需要芯片与软件协同改动的收益在优化开始前就已被排除在形式化之外。语言模型智能体使得重新审视这些边界成为可能，但智能体给出的提案本身无法证明设计正确或最优。

Method: 将工作拆分：智能体负责写形式化，数学求解器在形式化内寻优，验证与测量检查其假设与结果。智能体从计算图逐级细化至芯片，每一步是一个模板（一族程序及其正确性条件）；wall relaxation 通过为约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片设计空间。本文为阶段性工作，以独立研究而非端到端流程呈现。

Result: NVIDIA GB10 上，智能体编写的模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075×；模拟 Ventus GPU 研究中，联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最差场景周期降至参考的 0.428，而仅软件优化为 0.934；五步 GEMM 细化链上复用证明使检查提速 2.51×。

Conclusion: 智能体 + 求解器 + 验证/测量的分工可在保持正确性可检验的前提下部分突破层次抽象的限制，联合软硬件设计收益显著优于单独软件优化，但尚需整合为端到端流程。

Abstract: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

</details>


### [10] [Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39268v1)
*Sana Fatima,Ab Al-Hadi Ab Rahman,Ibrahim Yousef Alshareef,Farhad Khodadadi,Nuzhat Khan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端余弦域卷积神经网络（CD-CNN）架构，基于HLS在FPGA上实现高能效推理，在MNIST与94类ASCII数据集上相比全谱傅里叶域CNN（FD-CNN）显著降低资源占用、提升吞吐与能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CNN计算开销大，难以部署于低功耗边缘AI设备；且全谱（复数）傅里叶域CNN存在复数运算与频谱层间逆变换的额外代价。

Method: 采用实值DCT域表示完成中间特征提取，避免复数算术与频谱层之间的中间逆变换，构建端到端CD-CNN架构，并用高层次综合（HLS）在Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA上实现；在相同网络与实现约束下与全谱FD-CNN对比，数据集为MNIST与94类ASCII。

Conclusion: 实值DCT域频谱处理在能效上优于全谱复数域方案，验证了其在能效边缘AI部署中的潜力。

Abstract: The computational cost of conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) limits their deployment in low-power devices for high-speed edge AI applications. This paper presents an end-to-end cosine-domain CNN (CD-CNN) architecture for energy-efficient FPGA inference using high-level synthesis (HLS). The proposed architecture performs intermediate feature extraction using real-valued DCT-domain representations, avoiding complex-valued arithmetic and intermediate inverse transforms between spectral layers. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA and evaluated against a fully spectral Fourier-domain CNN (FD-CNN) under consistent network and implementation constraints. Experiments on the MNIST and 94-class ASCII datasets show that the CD-CNN reduces normalized resource utilization and improves inference throughput on both datasets. Its energy efficiency reaches 112.91 frames/J for MNIST and 101.27 frames/J for ASCII, corresponding to improvements of $1.51\times$ and $2.76\times$, respectively, over the fully spectral FD-CNN architecture. Furthermore, compared to the previous GPU-based fully spectral CD-CNN implementation, the proposed end-to-end FPGA implementation improves energy efficiency by $12.96\times$. These results demonstrate the potential of real-valued spectral processing in the DCT domain for energy-efficient edge AI deployment.

</details>


### [11] [IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39040v1)
*Konstantinos Stavrakakis,Ilgaz Er,Theofilos Spyrou,Dimitrios Stavrakakis,Stephan Wong,Georgi Gaydadjiev,Said Hamdioui*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: IMPACT 是一种在完整映射空间上搜索的 DNN 加速器映射器，通过遗传算法结合约束感知修复算子，将不可行映射转化为可行映射而非丢弃，在灵活架构与强约束的存算一体加速器上均优于现有映射器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量算子在硬件上的映射（分块、排序、并行化）构成组合爆炸的搜索空间；多数映射违反硬件约束，其余多数又利用率低。现有映射器要么为可解只搜索部分空间，遗漏最优映射；要么全空间随机采样，评估的映射大多不可行。

Method: 提出 IMPACT 映射器，在完整空间搜索：将遗传算法与约束感知的修复算子（constraint-aware repair operator）结合，把每个不可行映射修复为可行映射，而不是直接丢弃。

Result: 在灵活加速器上，IMPACT 在全部 DeepBench 工作负载的 EDP、延迟和能耗三项指标上均优于 SOTA 映射器；在可行映射极少的 CIM 加速器上，相对最强基线在五个网络上 EDP 降低 66%、延迟降低 47%、能耗降低 18%，并可媲美手工专家映射。

Conclusion: IMPACT 能在灵活与高度受限的加速器上自动找到高效映射，并将开源发布。

Abstract: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

</details>

*Kachkachi Nor Eddine*

TL;DR: 本文比较Vivado的多种时序指令与实现策略，在NQR谱仪SoC-FPGA与高能物理探测器数字读出ASIC原型两个测试设计上分别评估时序、面积与运行时表现，以筛选最高效的流程配置。

Abstract: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

</details>


### [13] [GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38489v1)
*Ziyue Zheng,Zhi Qu,Yangdi Lyu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GI-RTL-Fuzz用BNF文法覆盖率引导LLM生成RTL测试用例，并以差分测试方式在主流的Verilog仿真器中发现大量未知的lint与仿真结果不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL仿真器是现代IC设计流程的基础工具，但与其他复杂软件一样，其中存在可能影响仿真正确性的关键缺陷。为系统性地对这些工具进行压力测试，需要高质量的RTL测试用例来充分覆盖复杂的语言特性。

Method: 提出GI-RTL-Fuzz，一种语法引导（grammar-informed）的模糊测试框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）生成高质量RTL测试用例。其核心创新在于使用巴科斯-诺尔范式（BNF）文法覆盖率信息来引导LLM的生成过程，从而探索复杂且鲜少被测试的语言特性；并通过差分测试（differential testing）比较不同RTL仿真器的行为。

Result: 在主流的Verilog仿真器间进行差分测试，在lint流程与仿真结果两方面均发现了大量此前未知的不一致（inconsistencies）。

Conclusion: 将BNF文法覆盖率信息引入LLM驱动的测试用例生成，是一种可行的RTL仿真器压力测试手段，能够有效暴露主流Verilog仿真器中隐藏的缺陷与行为不一致。

Abstract: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

</details>


### [14] [The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38426v1)
*Minxing Chu,Anhang Li,Martins Atilla,Ruichen Qi,Mehdi Saligane*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 在SKY130上对gLayout的受控实验表明，直接用LLM绘制版图的主要瓶颈是时间与token成本，而基于生成器框架的核心优势是可复用性：已验证的原语使每次模型编辑足够小、可检查，参数化使单次编辑可在一族版图上评估。因此最有效的方式是让模型针对设计意图所属族群的生成器源码进行开发，并在最可能失败的族成员上测试每次编辑；族测试结果还可作为监督信号训练本地模型，以更低推理成本习得跨族有效的编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟版图设计仍以手工为主、难以自动化。gLayout等生成器框架将版图表达为程序，可从参数化、设计规则感知的生成器产生版图，但编写生成器仍需专家投入。前沿大语言模型已能编写生成器代码，甚至能依据设计意图直接绘制版图几何。由此引出实际问题：若模型能自行绘制版图，生成器框架还有何贡献？将模型用于生成器框架是否优于从零直接绘制版图？论文旨在通过受控实验回答这一问题。

Method: 在SKY130工艺下对gLayout开展受控实验，对比“模型直接绘制版图”与“模型在生成器框架上开发”两条路径。并据此提出工作流：让模型基于设计意图所属族群的生成器源码进行迭代开发；每次编辑时选择最可能失败的族成员进行测试；将族测试结果作为监督数据，用于微调/蒸馏本地模型，使其以更低的推理成本学习跨族通用的编辑。

Result: 直接绘制版图的主要障碍是时间与token开销；生成器框架带来的主要优势是可复用性——已验证原语保证每次编辑规模小、便于检查，参数化使一次编辑可在整个版图族上评估。采用“按族开发、对最易失败成员测试”的策略时，一次经验证的改动即可改进该生成器产出的所有版图；族测试结果作为监督训练本地模型后，本地模型能以推理成本的一小部分学到在整族上成立的编辑。

Conclusion: 生成器框架的价值不在于替代模型的绘图能力，而在于提供可复用的验证与参数化抽象，使LLM编辑更可控、可泛化。模型与生成器框架结合优于从零绘制版图；合理的族级开发与测试流程，加上用族测试结果监督本地小模型，可显著提升效率并降低推理成本。

Abstract: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Physical non-idealities in integrated circuit (IC) design and fabrication are concealed by conventional hardware abstractions, yet they can limit kernel performance and obscure optimization opportunities. Using distributed shared memory (DSMEM) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs as a case study, we show how floorsweeping restricts hardware resources available for clustered execution, potentially offsetting the benefits of reduced data movement enabled by DSMEM. Guided by these insights, we develop a wave-aware clustering strategy that accounts for these resource constraints to improve kernel performance. Evaluations using a global-load-and-broadcast microbenchmark, GEMM, and the Hopper version of FlashAttention 4 demonstrate the performance implications of these constraints, with wave-aware clustering improving FlashAttention 4 throughput by up to 5.30% over its baseline. We further show that, under thermal design power (TDP) limits, reduced data movement enables higher Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) frequencies through Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), explaining otherwise unexpected throughput improvements. Extending this analysis beyond GPUs, we show that power constraints also limit throughput scaling on Tenstorrent's Wormhole accelerator, highlighting the broader importance of accounting for physical non-idealities when analyzing and optimizing kernel performance.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: AnalogScout 由 LLM 智能体驱动，融合三项机制：(1) 精英设计复用；(2) 基于 gm/Id 的解析局部尺寸设计；(3) 全局精修，并在完整 PVT 角点下进行验证。

Conclusion: 将可复用已验证设计与解析 gm/Id 局部尺寸交由 LLM 智能体，可显著减少所需多角点仿真次数，在有限预算下实现更优的 PVT 感知尺寸设计。

Abstract: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.

</details>

*Arooba Farhan,Afsah Syed,Muhammad Fahd Ibrahim Bhatti,Muhammad Areeb Khalid Kidwai,Muhammad Ahsan Salar Khan,Vincenzo Romano,Muhammad Ali Siddiqi*

TL;DR: 提出两种与目标硬件匹配的紧凑脉冲神经网络（ConvSNN与StreamSNN），用于在头戴式前端上实时区分浦肯野细胞简单锋电位与复杂锋电位，实现无线记录的数据压缩。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Distinguishing Purkinje cell (PC) simple spikes (SSs) from complex spikes (CSs) is key to studying cerebellar function. PC recordings commonly rely on wired headstages, whose tethers restrict natural movement in freely behaving animals. Untethered headstages remove this constraint, but cannot continuously transmit raw recordings within their power budgets, making on-headstage spike classification an attractive form of compression, provided it runs accurately in real time on constrained hardware. This work presents two compact spiking neural networks (SNNs) matched to their target hardware: ConvSNN, which maps to the Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of an EFM32PG28 microcontroller, and StreamSNN, which processes one waveform value per timestep using learned time constants and fixed synaptic delays for a dedicated SKY130 circuit. Evaluated on cells unseen during training, ConvSNN achieves a CS F1 of 0.873 with 1,018 parameters and StreamSNN 0.837 with 527 parameters, both with eight-bit weights. On the microcontroller, MVP acceleration reduces ConvSNN latency by 62.3\% and extends estimated battery life to 33.73~hours on a 50~mAh battery. In SKY130, StreamSNN occupies 0.173~mm$^2$ and consumes 0.46~$μ$J per event, with 0.2~ms of computation within an 8.3~ms end-to-end latency.

### [19] [p-DCIM: A 28nm Probabilistic SRAM DCIM based Ising Machine for Near-Memory Context Selection in LLM-RAG Pipeline](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37033v1)
*Madhav Vadlamani,Rahul Singh,Yuyao Kong,Haomei Liu,Zheng Zhang,Shimeng Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We present a fabricated SRAM DCIM Ising machine that performs set-level context selection for large language model (LLM) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). In RAG, the evidence-selection stage is increasingly delegated to repeated language-model reranking, which adds substantial energy to the inference pipeline. We reformulate evidence selection as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem and solve it on a dual-mode digital compute-in-memory (DCIM) macro: the same multiply-and-accumulate datapath computes the embedding-similarity scores that populate the QUBO coefficients and evaluates the per-spin Hamiltonian differences that drive the anneal. The annealing temperature is set by a digital plane-count control along with the SRAM pseudo-read random bit flips, giving graded cooling entirely from on-chip digital configuration. The macro is taped-out in a 28 nm process [0.16 mm2, 0.41 mW] and is proposed to be integrated as part of the logic base-die in hybrid high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and high-bandwidth flash (HBF) stacks in a GPU package, where only the selected passage identifiers return to the host. Replacing the language-model selection pass with the near-memory Ising solver yields a macro normalized selection-energy estimate more than six orders of magnitude lower than the LLM-based baseline and reduces the evaluated total energy per query by 67%, while maintaining comparable token-level F1 on the evaluated examples.

### [20] [Comparative Analysis of Large Load Interconnection Requirements Across U.S. Transmission Entities](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36645v1)
*Rafi Zahedi,Rahul Anilkumar,Amin Zamani*

TL;DR: 该文对北美11家电力实体（AEP、CAISO、ERCOT、PJM等）的大负荷并网技术要求进行七维度比较分析，揭示各实体在要求范围与细化程度上差异显著，并指出数据中心申请者可被视为潜在电网资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的数据中心等大负荷快速增长，已占西部互联区大负荷并网申请的近80%，但大负荷并网技术要求尚未成熟、存在多处空白，缺乏系统性的横向比较基线。

Method: 选取11个美国电力实体，按七个技术类别（大负荷定义、负荷数据与建模、故障穿越、负荷削减与甩负荷、可调度性、电能质量、无功功率控制）对其并网要求进行对比分析。

Conclusion: 研究提供了结构化基线，可供公用事业公司、监管机构、ISO/RTO与开发商识别差距、对标同行，并加快并网标准制定。

Abstract: The rapid growth of large loads, especially data centers driven by artificial intelligence, is creating unprecedented demands on the North American electric grid. Data centers now account for nearly 80% of large load interconnection requests in the Western Interconnection, and U.S. electricity consumption from data centers is projected to reach 325-580 TWh by 2028. Despite this urgency, technical interconnection requirements for large loads have not yet matured and still contain several gaps. This paper presents a comparative analysis of large load interconnection requirements across eleven U.S. entities, including AEP, Ameren, CAISO, Dominion, Duke Energy, ERCOT, LIPA, MISO, PJM, Southern Company, and SPP, under seven technical categories: large load definition, load data and modeling, fault ride-through, load curtailment and shedding, dispatchability, power quality, and reactive power control. The analysis reveals significant variation in both the scope and specificity of requirements. LIPA addresses all seven technical categories at least partially, while Dominion and Duke Energy provide detailed coverage across nearly all categories. The analysis also finds that data center applicants can be viewed as potential grid resources, rather than only as consumers. The findings provide a structured baseline from which utilities, regulators, ISOs/RTOs, and developers can identify gaps, benchmark against peers, and accelerate the development of interconnection standards.

</details>


### [21] [A State Augmented Approach to Paralle Modeling in High-Level Synthesis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36481v1)
*Nicholas Kovacs,Hao Zheng*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于同步时序进程的显式架构建模方法，将持久状态、通信与反馈控制用C++表达，由HLS负责调度与绑定；以五级RV32I处理器验证，CPI优化配置达1.221 CPI@220 MHz，优于算法式HLS基线（4.000）和Ibex（1.575@242 MHz）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HLS只能调度输入描述中已被合法化的并发；对于反馈耦合设计，顺序行为模型会掩盖架构状态边界与冒险消解，导致难以获得高效的重叠执行。作者希望将"架构设计"与"工具调度"分离，由设计者掌控架构结构。

Method: 采用同步时序进程（synchronous sequential processes）的显式架构建模方法：各进程以锁步方式启动，并在重复前同步完成。持久状态、通信与反馈控制均以C++显式表达，HLS仅在既定结构内进行调度与绑定。以五级RV32I处理器为例，讨论三个关键建模决策：消费者读取哪个版本的值、何时消费该值、架构存储操作如何映射到端口操作。

Result: 在Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA上：CPI优化配置达1.221 CPI、220 MHz；算法式HLS基线为4.000 CPI；Ibex参考实现为1.575 CPI、242 MHz。面积优化配置LUT减少65%、寄存器减少47%，基准周期增加9.7%，时钟达250 MHz。

Conclusion: 结果验证了"设计者控制架构、工具控制调度"这一分离范式的有效性：显式架构建模使反馈耦合设计获得接近甚至超越手写RTL参考的性能，同时保留HLS的可编程性与面积/性能权衡空间。

Abstract: High-level synthesis (HLS) can schedule only the concurrency made legal by its input description. For feedback-coupled designs, a sequential behavioral model can obscure the architectural state boundaries and hazard resolution needed for efficient overlap. We develop an explicit architectural modeling methodology based on synchronous sequential processes that start in lockstep and synchronize completion before repeating. Persistent state, communication, and feedback control are represented in C++, while HLS schedules and binds operations within that structure. A five-stage RV32I processor illustrates three consequential modeling decisions: which version of a value a consumer reads, when it consumes that value, and how architectural memory actions map to port operations. On a Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA, the CPI-optimized configuration achieves 1.221 cycles per instruction at 220 MHz, compared with 4.000 for an algorithmic HLS baseline and 1.575 at 242 MHz for an Ibex reference. An area-optimized configuration reduces LUTs by 65\% and registers by 47\%, with 9.7\% more benchmark cycles and a 250 MHz achieved clock. These results demonstrate a separation between designer-controlled architecture and tool-controlled scheduling.

</details>


### [22] [zkDuel: Characterizing SumCheck Prover Kernels across GPU Programming Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37710v1)
*Samarth Narang,Alhad Daftardar,Brandon Reagen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 论文提出 zkDuel 基准，在 32/64/128/256 位素域上比较 Triton 与 CUDA 编写的 SumCheck 内核，发现 CUDA 相对优势随域宽增大从 3.5x 收敛至 1.4x，并通过改用 tl.reduce 与专用点插值使 Triton 内核中位时间逼近 CUDA 8% 以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SumCheck 是零知识证明的核心证明原语，其表并行结构天然适合 GPU，但随着有限域位宽增大，算术（多 limb Montgomery 运算）强度显著上升，这一变化可能改变 Triton（Python 嵌入式 DSL）与 CUDA 之间的性价比权衡，而此前缺乏系统的量化对比。

Method: 构建基准 zkDuel：提供 25 个源自 zkPHIRE 的约束的 CUDA/Triton 匹配实现，并辅以诊断性多项式；覆盖 32/64/128/256 位素域；采用独立的 CPU 参考实现校验，并以跨后端校验和门控保证正确性。在 NVIDIA H100 与 A100 上运行 800 组配置，通过 profiling 定位性能差异来源，并尝试两项优化：用 tl.reduce 替换原块归约、采用专用点插值。

Conclusion: 在密码学常用域宽下，Python 嵌入式 DSL（Triton）可以接近 CUDA 性能，差距主要源于可修复的归约实现与启动开销而非语言本身；但最大规模的全展开约束仍暴露出编译器可扩展性瓶颈。

Of 800 configurations attempted on an NVIDIA H100, 758 complete with matching checksums. Replacing that reduction with tl.reduce brings Triton's median kernel time within 8% of CUDA on both GPUs, while specialized point interpolation improves 256-bit evaluation kernels by 1.55-1.75x. </details>

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. Abstract: Routing the bus between a processor and its DRAM remains largely manual in printed circuit board (PCB) design, and published algorithms optimize proxies such as crossing or layer counts. Its core is an exact constraint-programming model that chooses, for all lanes at once, where each necessary crossing occurs, in what order -- by a rule over every triple of lanes -- and where each lane changes layer, with via room; for the ends it is given, it proves its plan optimal within the model. The model reads naturally as physics: worldlines, frustrated Ising spins and contact forces. A linear program places the lanes in millimeters; the constraints it must violate return to the model as cuts, and audit findings as negotiated congestion prices, until the plan passes an audit against the production router's rules or lays clean. The escapes are chosen by an estimate of the same objective, and differential pairs carry their polarity, with an automatic via crossover where the ends disagree. On an Allwinner H3 and a Zynq-7020, each to a DDR3 device, the router completes every rung of two ladders, of up to 51 nets on the H3 (its whole bus) and 43 on the Zynq, connected and DRC-clean, never with more vias than the human designer (80 against 88 and 62 against 100 at the top rungs) and always with less copper, where the toolkit's production router leaves nets open on four of the ten rungs and Freerouting completes none. Abstract: Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. Compared with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, SPARTA achieves 3.9x higher generation throughput and 8.3x higher end-to-end energy efficiency on average; versus AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, the gains are 5.0x and 81.7x. It also delivers 1.6-12.0x higher throughput, 2.0-4.2x higher energy efficiency, and 1.3-51.4x higher area efficiency than FIGLUT, TeLLMe, and MCBP.

*Huaizhi Zhang,Jiacheng Zhu,Xuqi Zhu,Junkyu Lee,Klaus McDonald-Maier,Xiaojun Zhai*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MCF 是一个面向长上下文 LLM 推理的内存与通信感知框架，通过阶段自适应 KV-cache 布局转换（MARS 动态复制/调度）与查询中心解码执行模型，并结合 FPGA compute-NIC 软硬件协同，提升 TTFT、吞吐与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV-cache 体量随上下文长度快速增长，带来显存压力与跨设备 KV 传播通信开销；prefill 与 decode 两阶段对内存与通信的需求不同，且边界处布局转换代价高，现有分布式系统难以兼顾。

Method: 核心为 MARS（Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling）：在 chunked prefill 早期利用显存余量选择性复制高复用 KV 块，提升局部性并将 KV 传播延迟隐藏在注意力计算之后；随 prefill 推进与显存压力上升，逐步释放冗余副本，将 KV cache 收敛为分片、可直接解码的布局，避免 prefill–decode 边界的昂贵转换。解码阶段采用查询中心执行模型，KV 分片保持驻留，仅路由轻量 query 张量，使通信量由依赖 KV-cache 转为依赖 query，从而随上下文长度增长的通信开销更小。此外构建基于 FPGA compute-NIC 数据通路的软硬件协同执行层，在网络路径内实现元数据驱动的 KV 路由与集合通信。

Conclusion: 通过内存感知的 KV 复制/调度、阶段自适应布局收敛、查询中心解码通信范式以及 FPGA compute-NIC 网络内计算，MCF 有效缓解长上下文推理的显存与通信瓶颈，并具备良好的规模可扩展性。

Abstract: This paper presents Memory- and Communication-Aware Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference (MCF) that optimizes long-context inference through communication-aware and stage-adaptive KV-cache layout transitions. At the core of MCF is {Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling} (MARS), a dynamic orchestration mechanism for chunked prefill. MARS exploits early-stage memory headroom by selectively replicating highly reused KV blocks, improving locality and hiding KV propagation latency behind attention computation. As prefill progresses and memory pressure increases, MARS progressively drains redundant replicas and converges the KV cache into a sharded decode-ready layout, avoiding expensive layout conversion at the prefill--decode boundary. For decoding, MCF adopts a query-centric execution model in which KV shards remain stationary while lightweight query tensors are routed across workers. This changes communication from KV-cache-dependent transfer to query-dependent transfer, reducing communication growth with context length. MCF further integrates a hardware-software co-designed execution layer based on an FPGA compute-NIC datapath, enabling metadata-driven KV routing and collective operations directly in the network path. Experiments show that MCF improves TTFT, throughput, and scalability over state-of-the-art distributed inference systems, with larger benefits as context length and cluster size increase.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间敏感的神经形态架构需要可预测的互连以保住精确事件时序。已有静态调度 TDM 电路交换 NoC 虽具确定性延迟，但配置存储随调度深度线性增长；同时联合优化任务放置、路由与调度构成难解的组合搜索空间。此外现有部署框架忽略算法层面的轴突延迟，强制立即注入脉冲，加剧网络拥塞。

Method: 软硬件协同设计。硬件侧 ChroNoC 是表式（tableless）TDM NoC，将预计算的全网格广播树嵌入组合逻辑，形成固定路由基底；软件侧 DARSA（Delay-Aware Reservations and Spatial Annealing）在该固定基底上把部署转化为空间搜索，并将轴突延迟转化为周期性调度松弛，以错开网络注入、降低通信开销。

Result: 130nm CMOS 工艺下，ChroNoC 相比所评估的电路交换与分组交换基线，单跳能耗降低逾 75%。在 UCI-HAR 与 N-MNIST 负载上，DARSA 相比立即传输分别将每时间步通信周期数减少约 60% 与 45%，同时降低所需配置的通信存储。

Conclusion: 将轻量 TDM 交换设计与延迟感知部署相结合，可在保持神经事件时序的前提下同时提升硬件效率与系统级通信性能。

Abstract: Time-sensitive neuromorphic architectures require predictable interconnects to preserve precise event timing. Statically scheduled time-division-multiplexed (TDM) circuit-switched networks-on-chip (NoCs) provide deterministic latency at the cost of linear configuration-memory scaling with schedule depth. Furthermore, jointly optimizing task placement, routing, and scheduling creates an intractable combinatorial search space. Existing deployment frameworks also ignore algorithmic axonal delays by forcing immediate spike injections that increase network contention. This paper proposes a hardware-software co-design to address these challenges. ChroNoC is a tableless TDM NoC that embeds precomputed full-grid broadcast trees into combinational logic as a fixed routing substrate. This fixed substrate reduces deployment to a spatial search via Delay-Aware Reservations and Spatial Annealing (DARSA). DARSA converts axonal delays into periodic scheduling slack to stagger network injections and reduce communication overhead. In a 130nm CMOS process, ChroNoC reduces per-hop energy consumption by more than 75% relative to the evaluated circuit- and packet-switched baselines. On UCI-HAR and N-MNIST workloads, DARSA reduces per-timestep communication cycles by approximately 60% and 45%, respectively, compared with immediate transmission, while also reducing provisioned communication memory. These results demonstrate how combining lightweight TDM switch design with delay-aware deployment improves both hardware efficiency and system-level communication performance while preserving neural event timing.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代SoC布局面临高度耦合的复杂设计约束；现有方法将约束松弛为目标函数做多目标优化，导致解不可行或质量下降。

Conclusion: 以约束优化框架替代多目标松弛，结合SDP初始化、ALM全局布局与SOCP合法化，可在保证可行性的同时显著提升SoC布局质量与效率。

Abstract: Modern system-on-chip (SoC) floorplanning is increasingly challenged by highly coupled complex design constraints. Existing methods often relax constraints into objectives via multi-objective optimization, leading to infeasible solutions or degraded quality. To address this, we formulate the problem as a constrained optimization task and propose a novel three-stage analytical framework integrating semidefinite programming (SDP), augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), and second-order cone programming (SOCP), which enforces constraints more rigorously and achieves higher-quality solutions. First, we adopt a two-step SDP formulation to obtain a robust initialization in the non-convex search space. Next, we incorporate differentiable objectives and constraints into an incremental ALM to jointly handle coupled design constraints during global floorplanning. Finally, an SOCP-based legalization strictly enforces feasibility while further reducing area. Experiments on the FloorSet benchmark show that our method satisfies all constraints with the fastest runtime. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, it reduces wirelength and area by 90\% and 16\% on average, and achieves near-optimal results, with wirelength and area being merely 2\% and 1\% larger than the ground-truth references, respectively.

*Yunchu Zhang,Ray Song,Junhan Jiao,Liyiming Ke,Yuchen Yang,Ruihan Gao,Emma Romig,Siddhartha Srinivasa,Yiyue Luo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SwapBot——一种模块化、以工具为中心的末端执行器系统，通过低成本适配器将家用工具快速转换为机器人末端执行器，并集成触觉传感、自主快换与遥操作示教，实现接触丰富任务的模仿学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常操作任务（如煎豆腐）需在不同工具间切换并施加不同力度的接触，单一通用夹爪难以胜任；同时，工具侧硬件成本高、缺乏触觉反馈、示教效率低，限制了以工具为中心的操作研究。

Result: 用户研究表明，遥操作中SwapBot缩短了任务完成时间并降低操作者负荷；基于采集示教训练的模仿学习策略成功完成煎豆腐、拌沙拉、翻肉等任务；消融实验表明，触觉增强示教在接触丰富技能上比仅RGB策略提升15–25个百分点的成功率。

Abstract: Robot manipulation in everyday environments inherently involves substantial tool usage. Seemingly simple household tasks, such as cooking pan-fried tofu, require forceful cutting, delicate brushing, and precise placement using different tools under contact-rich interaction. Thus, the ability to autonomously swap and use task-appropriate tools is important for tool-centric manipulation. We introduce SwapBot, a modular, tool-centric end effector system featuring low-cost adapters that quickly convert common household tools into robot end effectors. Rather than pursuing a single universal gripper, SwapBot adopts a unified design principle that combines a fixed robot-side coupling interface with low-cost, tool-side adapters, enabling compatibility with diverse tools, including articulated ones, and multiple robot platforms. Each adapter integrates compact tactile sensors, supports fast autonomous swapping, and interfaces with an intuitive teleoperation system for efficient demonstration collection. User studies show that, during teleoperation, SwapBot reduces task completion time and operator workload. Using collected demonstrations on the robot, we train imitation learning policies to successfully perform tool-centric tasks like cooking tofu, stirring salad, flipping meat. Our ablation study shows that using tactile-augmented demonstrations improves policy performance across contact-rich skills, increasing success rates by 15 to 25 percentage points over RGB-only policies. These results highlight modular, tactile-equipped tools as a practical and extensible pathway toward robust and capable robot manipulation. Project website https://personalrobotics.github.io/SwapBot.

*Fnu Aryan,Yaqi Xie,Joseph Campbell,Woojun Kim,Kwonjoon Lee,Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub,Ehsan Moradi-Pari,Katia Sycara,Simon Stepputtis*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人等智能系统需从短暂观测中预判长序列未来动作；纯神经模型依赖大量观测、难以解释与调整，而符号先验提供结构化替代方案。

Method: 给定短视频，在场景图与知识图上进行联合搜索，构建符号上下文，统一推理空间关系、物体属性、可供性与关联动作；该符号上下文作为先验，用于迭代精化过程，逐步生成并改进未来动作序列。方法参数高效，并允许用户直接编辑底层知识以调整预测而无需再训练。

Conclusion: 神经-符号结合方式可在短观测下实现长程动作预测，兼顾可解释性与可调节性，为长时程动作预判提供参数高效且可交互的新范式。

Abstract: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.

</details>

Abstract: This work proposes a novel conveyor belt mechanism enabling continuous, active repositioning of functional elements along the body of a tendon-driven continuum robot. Up to three conveyor belt mechanisms are integrated within a 9 mm diameter continuum robot. We demonstrate equivalent or reduced conveyor belt actuation forces compared to robot tendon actuation forces. As a case study, we mount permanent magnets along two conveyor belts, and demonstrate actively reconfigurable inter-robot coupling. Coupling point location and quantity can be adjusted during robot operation to actively tune the effective stiffness of the coupled multi-robot system. We show that effective stiffness follows a predictable inverse-cubic relationship with coupling location, and increases with the number of coupling points. These findings demonstrate that the conveyor belt mechanism enables active functional element repositioning for changing tasks requirements, with magnetic inter-robot coupling as one proof-of-concept.

*Pranjal Aggarwal,Sean Welleck*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Gym-Anything for Robotics 框架，将机器人仿真环境的构建重新定义为编码智能体任务，自动生成 25 个仿真场景与 200 个 RL 环境（RoboWorld），并以多种新范式提升前沿模型表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实感的机器人仿真可支撑具身智能模型的大规模训练并迁移到现实，但现有仿真仅覆盖极窄的任务与物理现象。核心瓶颈在于：构建更好的仿真依赖大量专家工作，无法规模化。

Method: 核心洞察是"仿真创建即代码智能体任务"，从而让编码智能体的进步直接转化为更丰富、更逼真的仿真。具体做法：依据美国 GDP 数据挑选仿真主题以覆盖具有经济价值的物理工作；明确定义"好的仿真"与"好的任务"的标准；设计对抗式"创建—审计"循环，对每个仿真与任务按标准进行校验。由此构建 RoboWorld：25 个仿真、25 个测试环境与 175 个训练环境，难度各异。

Conclusion: 仿真创建可被有效建模为编码智能体任务，从而自动化、可扩展地生成多样化机器人仿真与基准，并暴露当前前沿模型在具身操控上的巨大差距。作者开源了流水线、RL 环境与基准，以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $π_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics

</details>

Abstract: In robotics, shape control (or shape servoing) refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object to achieve a desired shape. It involves a feedback loop that exploits the relation between robot motion and changes in the measured shape. This relation, known as the interaction Jacobian or, in this context, the deformation Jacobian, depends on the object's mechanical properties, geometry, and boundary conditions (e.g., where the object is grasped). Because these factors are often difficult to model accurately, the deformation Jacobian can be estimated locally from observed shape changes produced by commanded robot motions, without requiring a fine-tuned mechanical model. This article is the first of a two-part tutorial on data-driven Jacobian-based shape control of deformable objects. It introduces the central elements of the approach: the formulation of the shape-control problem, shape representation, estimation and online update of the deformation Jacobian, and a standard control law from the literature. It then assembles these elements into a complete shape-servoing loop, derives a local stability condition for this loop, and illustrates why some target shapes cannot be reached. Part II covers more advanced topics. Throughout both parts, a simulated planar example in which two robot arms manipulate an elastic rod observed by a camera illustrates the concepts.

</details>


### [36] [PhysVLMM: Interaction-Conditioned Physical Belief Maps for Articulated Objects in Robot Scene Maps](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40539v1)
*Dibyendu Ghosh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 PhysVLMM，为视觉-语言-运动地图中每个关节部件维护物理信念，用闭式更新的地图更新算法与查询算法回答规划器提问，在真实家居门/抽屉上实现高精度、低误差且四数量级更快的拉动响应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人需拉门、拉抽屉，但现有场景地图只记录物体身份与是否移动，不记录其对"拉动"的动力学响应；且仅观察部件运动无法辨识其动力学，单次测量的拉动只能识别被拉部件至多一个方向的信息。

Method: PhysVLMM 包含地图更新与查询两个算法：(i) 将不可辨识的方向保留为后验分布而非点估计；(ii) 以闭式形式将每次拉动的证据传递给地图中未被触及的"相似部件"；(iii) 在给定风险水平下回答动作是否会成功，或选择弃答。

Result: 在18个家庭真实门与抽屉上：留出拉动的关节类型识别率86%（学习的单视图方法48%）；拉动响应预测误差比可微仿真低41%（CRPS 0.323 vs 0.544），且快四个数量级（13 ms vs 230 s/例）；后验将末位置误差从0.460降至0.270；证据共享将未触及部件的力误差从56%降至42%；在0.02–0.30的各风险水平下，误报"安全"的比例均控制在给定风险内。

Conclusion: 将动力学方向建模为后验并跨相似部件闭式共享证据，是可解释、可风险控制且高效的关节物体物理信念表示；此外，汇集同一家庭内全部已测部件与相似部件分组效果相当，而更简单的变体在预测被拉部件停止位置方面至少同样好。

Abstract: Mobile robots must open doors and drawers, yet their scene maps record what each object is and whether it has moved, not how it will respond to a pull. This paper proposes PhysVLMM, a method that maintains a physical belief for every articulated part of a Vision-Language-Motion Map and answers a planner's queries about it, with two algorithms: a map update and a query. Watching a part move provably cannot identify its dynamics, and a measured pull identifies only the pulled part, up to one direction. PhysVLMM therefore (i) keeps that direction as a posterior instead of a point estimate, (ii) passes the evidence of each pull in closed form to the untouched look-alike parts of the map, and (iii) answers whether an action will succeed at a stated risk, or abstains. On real doors and drawers in 18 homes, it identifies the joint type in 86% of held-out pulls (48% for a learned single-view method) and predicts the response to a pull with 41% lower error than differentiable simulation (CRPS 0.323 vs. 0.544), four orders of magnitude faster (13 ms vs. 230 s per case). The posterior lowers the final-position error from 0.460 to 0.270, sharing lowers the force error of untouched parts from 56% to 42%, and at every stated risk from 0.02 to 0.30 the false-safe answers stay within it. Abstract: We present DAWN (Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network), a hierarchical robotic framework designed to perform real-world, unfastening tasks through multi-modal sensory integration. Experimental validation on a Franka Emika robot demonstrates that DAWN achieves alignment & insertion success rates comparable to trained human operators, robustly transitions between stages, and attains an impressive success rate in unfastening across various unseen scenarios. Ablation studies further elucidate critical input modalities and effective training strategies, highlighting DAWN's scalability, robustness, and data efficiency.

Abstract: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly. In BURGER, an agent starts from the same blank canvas and controls a robot arm to draw the object or spatial composition specified by language, while each instruction allows an open-ended variety of valid drawings and stroke orders. Using 28,200 simulated demonstrations spanning 282 drawing tasks, we evaluate five representative VLA models across data scales, language grounding, and multimodal behavior. BURGER supports fine-grained analysis of language grounding, spatial composition, and action generation, revealing distinct failure patterns across VLA models. Our experiments suggest that some VLA models can benefit from greater task diversity and demonstration scale, capture multimodal drawing behaviors, and generalize to unseen compositions of familiar objects. Finally, we deploy a trained policy on a Franka Panda arm, demonstrating the ability to draw reactively under human intervention. The optimization results show that a configuration in which all four rotors spin clockwise can generate a larger tangential force than the conventional alternating-spin configuration. Abstract: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors. The sensor motion is restricted to a precomputed set of feasible paths that satisfy mobility constraints, limited available energy by requiring return to charging stations, and avoidance of known obstacles. We cast the resulting active path selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm that adaptively assigns paths using confidence bounds computed from the collected data. We also propose a graph-based method to construct low-cardinality path covers under the team's constraints. We establish finite-time and anytime probabilistic correctness guarantees for the proposed algorithm, derive non-asymptotic upper bounds on the times required to detect all regions of interest and to label all nodes, and show that these bounds match algorithm-independent lower bounds up to constant factors for a broad class of problem instances. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate the behavior of the proposed approach and the effect of path redundancy and team size on search performance.

Abstract: Fine-grained manipulation requires a robot policy to follow instructions, remain robust to visual variations, and translate predicted actions into precise robot control. DEED generates demonstrations for different instructions from the same initial scene and renders each physical trajectory under different camera positions and lighting conditions while preserving its original states and action targets. A hierarchical sampling strategy balances instructions, trajectories, and visual conditions during supervised adaptation. At deployment, DEED converts predicted action chunks into robot commands using inverse kinematics, gripper mappings selected for each task, and closed-loop replanning. DEED achieves an official Overall score of 85.55%. Fixed-policy evaluations show that performance varies with execution horizon, denoising budget, and gripper mapping.

</details>

Abstract: This paper studies UAV path planning in areas where GPS signals are not present. Because these drones can easily get lost when they don't have GPS, they must rely on dead reckoning and occasionally pass near cellular towers, which act as landmarks to reset and fix their position. The goal is to find the shortest path from a start to a goal location while keeping the estimation uncertainty within a given bound. To solve this problem, we propose a localization-constrained A* planner that treats uncertainty as a hard constraint during search. The robot state and covariance are propagated using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), and only paths that satisfy the covariance limit are considered. We also show that the proposed method does not affect heuristic used in A* and remains admissible and consistent, ensuring optimality among all feasible paths. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and PyBullet quadrotor test show that the proposed method finds shorter and more reliable paths compared to RRT* and PRM, while always satisfying the uncertainty constraint.

</details>

Abstract: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

</details>

Conclusion: 机器人学并非广义人工智能投资战略的下游受益者，而是拥有自身供应链与自身失效节点的独立体系，因此值得获得专属的、持续的联邦投入承诺。

Abstract: This paper sets out what a sustained federal research and investment agenda would need to include to close that gap--not within a single budget cycle, but over the decade such an undertaking will realistically require. It identifies where the gap is most pronounced today: in the methods needed to verify and certify components of uncertain origin, in the foundational hardware research that has long been underfunded relative to software, in the physical infrastructure researchers need to test systems at scale, and in the workforce required to build and sustain all of it. Robotics should not be treated merely as a downstream beneficiary of a broader artificial intelligence investment strategy. It constitutes its own supply chain, with its own points of failure, and merits its own sustained federal commitment.

</details>

Motivation: 现有个人健康 LLM 智能体读取可穿戴数据并给出建议，但不以可审计或可证伪的方式"学习"个体，缺乏科学问责性。

Method: 1) 证据门控假设登记册：每条关于运动员的论断须在事件发生前给出概率预测，其信念仅通过日志化统计拟合计算出的证据更新；2) 机制数字孪生：由心率、GPS 与气压高度推得，含滞后心率响应模型、带可学习时间常数的体能-疲劳模型、以及在发现的山道段上测量的隐式技术下坡技能状态；3) 智能体以约束实验方式开具下一周训练，在负荷与安全约束下最大化信息增益，围绕约两次"仪器化骑行"进行；4) 用 18 个月数据做滚动原点回放基准测试与实时前瞻阶段评估。

Result: 回放基准显示孪生在心率预测上优于标准预测器，但在分段用时上不占优；智能体闭环与静态模型持平。实时前瞻阶段前三周：登记册封存 20 条预测、计分 14 条；下坡预测经一次修正后校准良好，爬坡预测因运动员进步而偏悲观；安全官两次否决智能体建议。

Conclusion: 所有修正均保留在登记册中，为数字健康中的可审计、可证伪个性化提供模板；作者公开登记册、基准与协议。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for personal health read wearable data and recommend, but do not learn about the individual in a way that can be audited or falsified. We present EpiCoach, an agentic system that treats one athlete, a cross-country mountain biker, as the subject of accountable N-of-1 science. Claims about the athlete live in an evidence-gated hypothesis registry: each must issue a probabilistic prediction about a future session before it occurs, and its belief moves only through computed evidence from a logged statistical fit. Predictions come from a mechanistic digital twin inferred from heart rate, GPS and barometric altitude: a lagged heart-rate response model, a fitness-fatigue model with learned time constants, and a latent technical-descending skill state, measured on discovered trail segments. The agent prescribes the next training week as a constrained experiment maximizing information gain subject to load and safety constraints, around two instrument rides. We evaluate the system two ways over eighteen months of data. A rolling-origin replay benchmark shows the twin beats standard forecasters on heart rate but not segment time, and the agentic loop matches a static model. A live prospective phase runs the weekly cycle: in its first three weeks the ledger sealed 20 predictions, scored 14, the descent forecast calibrated after one correction, the climb forecast pessimistic as the athlete improved, and the safety officer vetoed the agent twice. Every correction is preserved in the registry, a template for auditable, falsifiable personalization in digital health. We release the registry, benchmark and protocol.

</details>

Abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) adapts robot policies through test-time demonstrations, but long multimodal trajectories constrain how many examples fit in context. Abstract: Human demonstrations offer an efficient and scalable source of data for dexterous robot manipulation, but differences in sensing and hand morphology complicate the transfer of contact-rich interactions. We present TouchBridge, a hardware--software co-designed framework for human-to-robot data transformation. A wearable human demonstration interface and a corresponding robot interface establish cross-embodiment correspondence in visual and fingertip tactile sensing. We introduce Tac-Retarget, a tactile-conditioned retargeting method that uses measured contact to align fingertip contact patches and preserve their spatial relations within and across hands. Unlike object-aware or simulation-based transfer pipelines, Tac-Retarget requires no object mesh, object-pose estimate, or physics simulation for retargeting, enabling direct and scalable conversion of human demonstrations into robot-domain training data. Combined with visual synthesis and camera-anchored action conversion, TouchBridge produces robot-domain demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, policies fine-tuned solely on TouchBridge-converted human demonstrations achieve a 72.5% average success rate, compared with 77.5% using an equal number of teleoperated robot demonstrations, while human demonstration collection is 7.0x faster. Under the same policy and training setup, Tac-Retarget outperforms DexPilot and UniDex by 25.0 and 42.5 percentage points, respectively.

</details>

Abstract: Musculoskeletal robots combine compliant actuators with articulated skeletons, but exploring alternative configurations often requires repeated fabrication. We present MUSBRIC, a modular hardware platform and accompanying MuJoCo-based simulator for reconfigurable musculoskeletal robots. LEGO-compatible endcaps turn fiber-reinforced extensile pneumatic artificial muscles into reusable, plug-and-play muscle bricks that connect directly to standard LEGO components. Experimentally identified actuator behavior supports corresponding musculoskeletal simulations. An elbow-joint prototype validates load-dependent flexion and extension, showing that pulley-guided routing enables reversible motion and a mechanical stop stabilizes the straight posture. A robotic hand demonstrates compliant grasping and multi-joint construction. Matched hardware and simulation sweeps across 15 leg configurations demonstrate systematic exploration of attachment geometry, while a quadruped assembled from four legs demonstrates walking. Together, these demonstrations span mechanism analysis, configuration exploration, and functional robot construction within a single reconfigurable system. The hardware designs and simulation code will be released as open source soon to facilitate reproduction and further development.

### [49] [Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40271v1)
*Youssef Saied,Ziyad Sheebaelhamd,Claire Vernade,François Fleuret*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出高斯动作读出（GAR）：用高斯读出层替换流策略最终层，仅用0.02%状态微调，即可一次网络前传采样，并在约两倍推理速度下达到接近教师策略的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流策略（flow policies）是强力的机器人控制器，擅长建模多模态动作分布，但其采样需要多步数值积分、推理代价高，且难以给出似然。作者观察到所研究的流策略的连续动作分布可被高斯良好近似，因此希望以极低代价获得高效、可解析的采样与似然。

Method: 分析发现流策略的连续动作分布近似为高斯；据此提出GAR：将流策略的最终层替换为高斯读出层，仅用0.02%的可用状态训练该读出（其余网络保持冻结）；采样时只需一次动作网络前传，并提供闭式似然。

Result: GAR在仅训练极小比例状态、冻结主干网络的情况下，实现单次前传采样并获得闭式似然，任务成功率接近教师流策略，推理速度最高提升至约2倍。

Conclusion: 高频控制场景下，流策略的复杂多步采样可能并非必要；高斯读出是轻量、高效的替代方案，兼顾速度、似然可得性与接近原策略的性能。

Abstract: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. Our analysis shows that the continuous-action distributions of the studied flow policies are well approximated by Gaussians. We propose the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on just 0.02% of eligible states, while keeping the rest of the network frozen. It samples with one action-network pass, gives closed-form likelihoods, and achieves near-teacher task success at up to twice the inference speed.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人导航通常假设存在无碰撞路径，但在杂乱、含可移动障碍物的环境中，到达目标往往需要物理交互。传统方法依赖几何规则与任务专用逻辑；学习方法则常将决策空间限制在低维运动指令或预定义动作集，难以泛化到需要组合交互行为的场景。

Result: 规划器在交互式导航任务上优于经典规划器与提示式前沿模型；与从零训练模型对比表明：结构化表示下技能组合不依赖预训练，但预训练能带来更可靠的几何目标。底层端到端全身推动策略仿真成功率93.3%（分层基线83.5%），完成时间缩短60%以上。硬件上分层系统在44/45次试验中给出正确技能组合，端到端成功率34/45。

Abstract: Robotic navigation typically assumes a collision-free route to the goal exists; in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, however, reaching the goal may require physical interaction. Classical solutions encode these behaviors through geometric rules and task-specific logic, while learning-based approaches often constrain the decision space to low-dimensional motion commands or predefined action sets. We instead consider a broader decision space, jointly selecting the skill, relevant object, and geometric target. Our language-conditioned task planner, fine-tuned with LoRA on synthetic data, maps natural-language tasks and a structured scene representation to variable-length sequences of parameterized actions, executed by low-level reinforcement-learning policies. The planner learns the geometric relations underlying interactive navigation and outperforms a classical planner and a prompted frontier model on interactive navigation tasks. Comparisons with models trained from scratch indicate that composition does not require pretraining when the representation is structured, whereas pretraining yields more reliable geometric targets. At the low level, we introduce an end-to-end whole-body planar pushing policy that achieves a 93.3% success rate in simulation, versus 83.5% for a hierarchical baseline, while reducing completion time by more than 60%. On hardware, the hierarchy yields the correct skill composition in 44/45 trials and end-to-end success in 34/45. Project website: https://anonymousprojects-dev.github.io/LLM-guided-LocoManipulation-Quadrupeds/

</details>

TL;DR: 该文提出AcrossDEX 1.0系统，将人类运动预训练、仿真专家学习、机器人示教采集与视觉闭环执行串联，实现两种手型（Inspire六通道、Allegro十六关节）的双臂灵巧操作，并在开盖/复位与闭盖物体重定向任务上取得40.6%–100%的成功率。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of wrist motion, finger contact, and object motion. Human videos provide rich manipulation experience. Using this experience for robot control requires aligning human poses with robot commands and accounting for embodiment-specific kinematics and contact dynamics. We present AcrossDEX 1.0, a learning system that connects human motion pretraining, simulation-based expert learning, robot demonstration collection, and visual closed-loop execution. Pretraining on HOT3D Aria predicts one second of bimanual motion from five images and thirty annotated hand states over the preceding second. Robot adaptation preserves the visual encoder, temporal backbone, and wrist parameters. Shared wrist representations, separate finger fields, and validity masks support both six-channel Inspire hands and sixteen-joint Allegro hands. The robot policy predicts sixty control targets from frontal images, command history, and task conditions. It executes a prefix and replans from updated observations. We compare direct regression, diffusion, and flow matching on lid opening and return and closed-lid object reorientation. Direct regression achieves success rates of 40.6\% for opening and return, 100.0\% for Inspire reorientation, and 93.3\% for Allegro reorientation. Flow matching achieves 90.0\% on Allegro reorientation. Paired comparisons further show that constraining replanning with the previous plan improves the continuous execution of generative policies. These results demonstrate a common adaptation pipeline for two hand embodiments and highlight the roles of contact coordination and action-chunk continuity.

</details>

*Xueyuan Wei,Xuanxu Wang,Xudong Li,Yuping He,Wanshui Gan,Jiaqi Peng,Wenqi Guo,Jianjun Zhou,Junting Dong,Chunhua Shen,Haoyu Guo,Mulin Yu,Tao Lu*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度动作标注可支撑技能复用与组合泛化，但现有机器人数据集多为任务级指令，少数带子任务标签的数据在格式与规范上不一致，阻碍跨源联合训练。
