Abstract: Fine-grained action annotations can support skill reuse and compositional generalization in robot policies. However, robot datasets typically provide task-level instructions without subtask annotations. Although some include subtask labels, inconsistent formats and conventions hinder cross-source joint training. We propose RoboAtom-Data, which adds unified, time-aligned atomic-action annotations to existing data from multiple sources, covering 1.45 million trajectories, 6.88 million skill-labeled segments, and 16,882.1 hours. Our pipeline combines a unified protocol, large-scale manual annotation, propagation across repeated executions with the same ordered skill sequence, and multi-stage quality control. We evaluate the dataset through automatic atomic-action annotation and robot control. We construct RoboAtom-Bench to standardize evaluation of skill recognition and temporal boundary localization. Trained on the annotated data, RoboAtom-Anno achieves better automatic annotation performance than all evaluated open- and closed-source models on both RoboAtom-Bench and the external WGO-Bench. For robot control, atomic-action supervision paired with hierarchical execution improves task success over task-level baselines on LIBERO-Long, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin. We will release the data, benchmark, model, and construction pipeline to support further research on skill-level robot learning.

</details>


### [53] [Decision-Level Error Attribution and Depth-Aware Safety Evaluation of Monocular RGB Human Tracking for Autonomous Robot Navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40199v1)
*Abdulahi Taiwo,Chijioke Cyriacus Ekechi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将单体RGB行人跟踪中的机器人停/行决策误差分解为"安全规则"与"感知"两部分，提出基于Shapley的两因子归因方法，并在ETH/UCY数据上表明：横向距离规则在精确位置上不漏检但停精确率极低(5.6–31.9%)，而实际感知中检测漏检是漏险的首要来源，采用地平面定位加两倍标准差安全裕度可匹配或优于横向规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在人附近作业时依赖单目RGB跟踪做二元停止/前进决策，但几何精度指标（如定位误差）不能反映感知误差如何影响决策结果；因此需要量化决策误差中来自安全规则与来自感知各自的比例。

Method: 证明仅横向距离是平面距离的下界（位置精确时不漏检但会产生不必要停止）；提出两因子Shapley归因以分离规则贡献与感知贡献，并进一步区分漏检与定位误差；在ETH与UCY行人视频上使用模拟静止机器人，校准与评估行人互斥，采用时间分块bootstrap置信区间；对比地平面定位、几何基线与标定后的Depth Anything V2。

Result: 三个场景共898名行人：横向规则在标注位置上零漏险，但停精确率仅5.6–31.9%；两个含RGB感知场景中，地平面定位平面RMSE为0.59 m与0.51 m，优于几何基线(1.72 m/1.39 m)与Depth Anything V2(0.81 m/0.68 m)；检测召回率仅0.43与0.26，使漏检成为漏险的首要来源；两倍标准差安全裕度加地平面定位在全部8个场景-阈值设置中漏险率匹配或优于横向规则，并在7个设置中减少不必要停止。

Conclusion: 决策层面的归因揭示了横向规则保守但停精确率低、感知漏检主导风险的结构；地平面定位配合统计安全裕度可在不增加漏险的前提下提升决策效率。所有交互均为模拟，结果为离线决策分类，不构成避碰演示。

Abstract: Monocular RGB tracking is useful for robots operating near people, but perception errors affect binary stop/proceed decisions in ways that geometric accuracy metrics do not capture. We examine how much decision error arises from the safety rule versus perception. We prove that lateral-only distance is a lower bound on planar distance: with accurate positions, it cannot miss dangers identified by the planar rule, but it produces unnecessary stops. We introduce a two-factor Shapley attribution separating rule and perception contributions, and further distinguish missed detections from localization errors. Experiments use ETH and UCY pedestrian videos with simulated stationary robots, disjoint calibration and evaluation pedestrians, and time-block bootstrap intervals. Across 898 pedestrians in three scenes, the lateral rule missed no dangers on annotated positions but achieved only 5.6-31.9% stop precision. In two scenes with RGB perception, calibrated ground-plane localization achieved 0.59 m and 0.51 m planar RMSE, compared with 1.72 m and 1.39 m for a geometric baseline and 0.81 m and 0.68 m for calibrated Depth Anything V2. Detection recall of 0.43 and 0.26 made missed detections the leading source of missed danger. A two-standard-deviation safety margin with ground-plane localization matched or improved on the lateral rule's missed-danger rate in all eight scene-threshold settings and reduced unnecessary stops in seven. All robot interactions are simulated, and outcomes are offline decision classifications, not demonstrations of collision avoidance.

</details>


### [54] [Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40075v1)
*Jianming Ma,Rongjun Jin,Yizhi Chen,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对黑盒可行性预言机（仅返回二值可行/不可行）条件下的流匹配机械臂策略，提出一种“预言机引导的可微安全护罩”，在前向传播中修正不安全更新，在反向传播中利用局部边界信息构造约束感知梯度，训练与推理共用同一护罩，实现前后向对齐的安全策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配类机器人基础模型生成的动作不保证满足关节限位、避碰等物理约束；当可行集无解析形式、仅能通过黑盒可行性预言机查询时，现有可微约束建模方法失效，需要一种仅依赖二值查询的安全机制。

Method: 1）在前向过程中，用二值可行性查询检测并纠正不安全的动作更新；2）在反向过程中，从预言机查询中提取局部边界信息（可行域边界近似），为策略学习提供约束感知的学习信号；3）结合离散时间流匹配，使训练与推理复用同一护罩，无需显式或可微约束模型即可实现前向—反向对齐的策略学习。

Result: 在障碍物感知的机器人操作实验中，约束满足率达到100%，同时保持任务性能。

Conclusion: 仅依赖黑盒可行性查询即可为流匹配机器人策略提供端到端可训练的安全保障，兼顾零约束违反与任务成功率，为缺乏解析约束模型的真实操作场景提供可行方案。

Abstract: Robot foundation models increasingly rely on flow-based action generation for general-purpose manipulation, yet the generated actions are not guaranteed to satisfy physical constraints such as joint limits and collision avoidance. This problem is especially challenging when the feasible set cannot be described analytically and is accessible only through black-box feasibility oracles. We study this practical oracle-only setting and propose an oracle-guided differentiable safeguard for safe flow-matching robot policies. The safeguard uses binary feasibility queries to correct unsafe updates in the forward pass, while extracting local boundary information to provide constraint-aware learning signals in the backward pass. Combined with discrete-time flow matching, the same safeguard is used during training and inference, enabling forward--backward aligned policy learning without explicit or differentiable constraint models. Experiments on obstacle-aware robotic manipulation demonstrate 100% constraint satisfaction while preserving task performance.

</details>


### [55] [Don't Risk It!: Trajectory-Conditioned Distributional Risk for LiDAR-Only Crowd Navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40050v1)
*Mathai Mathew Pulicken,Laksh Nanwani,Basant Sharma,Phani Teja Singamaneni,Arun Kumar Singh,K. Madhava Krishna*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DRIP：仅用LiDAR的端到端人群导航规划框架，耦合占据栅格预测与以轨迹为条件的间隙/不确定性估计，以风险评估候选控制序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效人群导航需要预判动态无碰撞空间，而依赖目标跟踪的方案易失效（跟踪脆弱）。因此希望仅凭LiDAR感知直接进行预测与规划。

Method: 输入LiDAR占据栅格历史；预测候选控制序列对应的最小机器人与障碍物间隙分布，并给出不确定性；用直接以实际碰撞结果为监督的风险代价训练模型（而非仅几何回归）。

Result: 在最多45名行人的闭环实验中，相比SOTA基线成功率更高、碰撞更少，且"冻结"（停滞）行为减少。

Conclusion: 以碰撞结果为锚的风险/不确定性学习可替代脆弱跟踪，实现更安全、更流畅的LiDAR-only人群导航。

Abstract: Efficient crowd navigation requires anticipating dynamic collision-free space without relying on fragile object tracking. We propose the Don't Risk It Planner (DRIP), an end-to-end LiDAR-only planning framework that couples occupancy forecasting with trajectory-conditioned clearance and uncertainty estimation. Operating directly on LiDAR-derived occupancy grid histories, DRIP predicts a distribution over minimum robot-obstacle clearance for candidate control sequences to evaluate collision risk. The model is trained using a risk cost that grounds predictive uncertainty directly in empirical collision outcomes rather than geometric regression alone. In closed-loop experiments with up to 45 pedestrians, DRIP achieves higher success rates with fewer collisions and reduced freezing behavior compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [56] [RoboSeed: Multidimensional Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models: Capability, Resource Affordability, and Research Evidence](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40026v1)
*Xin Ma,Furong Chen,Xinlong Man,Bo Zhang,Yalong Guo,Haolan Lei,Chaochen Cui,Hongyuan Zhang,Mulin Chen,Yi Wang,Lap-pui Chau,Chuang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RoboSeed 多维评估框架，用能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地验证科研价值与可复现证据五个维度，将实测与审计准则映射为 0-100 画像，用于 VLA/WAM 模型选型，并明确指出证据不全时不给出总体数值排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人动作模型选型需综合任务能力、适应成本、部署需求与结论可靠性，而单一成功率指标对不同算力预算与目标的研究者指导有限。

Method: 定义能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地验证研究价值、复现证据五维框架；以固定归一化锚点将实测与审计标准映射为 0-100 画像，设平衡、训练受限、部署受限三种偏好配置；通过接口与协议检查判定比较适用性；缺失测量显式标注、不完整聚合分不予输出，并以加权输入覆盖率识别证据缺口。应用于代表性 VLA 与 WAM 模型，依据本地训练、开源权重评测、任务级审计与评估系统研究。

Result: 揭示随预算变化的主干网络选择差异、对适配配方（adaptation recipe）的敏感性，以及语言接口与视觉任务接口之间的表现差异；提供可复现代码与机器可读证据，支持扩展到更多模型。

Conclusion: 该研究给出维度级评估与后续测量优先级，但因服务追踪不完整、协议异质，暂不作总体数值排名，框架定位为持续开放发布并附可验证证据的评估计划。

Abstract: Choosing a robot action model requires evidence about task capability, adaptation cost, deployment requirements, and the reliability of reported conclusions. Success rates alone offer limited guidance to researchers with different computing budgets and goals. We propose RoboSeed, a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM), within a continuing program to train, evaluate, and openly release robot models with verifiable evidence for model selection.
  The framework defines five dimensions: capability, downstream training affordability, deployment affordability, locally verified research value, and reproduction evidence. It maps empirical measurements and audit criteria to 0-100 profiles using fixed normalization anchors, with balanced, training-constrained, and deployment-constrained preference settings. Interface and protocol checks establish when comparisons are appropriate. Missing measurements remain explicit, incomplete aggregate scores are withheld, and weighted input coverage identifies evidence gaps.
  We apply the framework to representative VLA and WAM models, drawing on local training, released-weight evaluation, task-level audits, and an evaluation-system study. The results reveal budget-dependent backbone choices, sensitivity to adaptation recipes, and differences between language and visual task interfaces. Reproducible scoring code and machine-readable evidence support extension to additional models. The study provides dimension-level assessments and priorities for further measurement, while incomplete serving traces and heterogeneous protocols preclude overall numerical rankings.

</details>


### [57] [LOGIV: Graph-Verified Execution with Causal Local Repair for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40016v1)
*Enqiao Lu,Yuxiang Xie,Xingrui Yu,Yuyang Wang,Yipeng Gu,Zhenglin Wan,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao,Yang You,Yuxiang Gao,Ivor Tsang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LOGIV是一个图工程框架，将验证过的计划编译为条件支撑边与资源序关系边，在执行中持续做物理有效性检查，并借依赖追踪在失败后确定需恢复的内容，从而在高层目标与底层策略之间提供显式、持续校验的任务依赖接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体机器人需要把高层目标转为动作并保持后续步骤所需物理条件有效。单个动作"完成"并不保证其效果持续：后续扰动可能破坏剩余计划仍假设成立的支撑条件，因此需要显式的、可实时校验的任务依赖表示。

Method: LOGIV以显式任务图连接符号规划、基于观测的验证与具身执行：把已验证计划编译为条件支撑边和资源排序边；执行期检查这些边的物理有效性；失败后用依赖追踪确定需恢复的范围；修复受"保留的未完成动作"约束，合成的续接方案在执行恢复前先经符号验证。框架叠加在现有VLA与WAM策略之上，无需可训练组件。

Result: 在RoboTwin V2与BiCoord的20项双臂任务、三种执行骨干上，无注入扰动时平均任务成功率分别提升10.67与15.33个百分点；在预定义扰动下，两个基准上每个骨干的任务完成率与条件恢复均优于三个适配的恢复基线；三项真实机器人任务成功次数由12/30提升至17/30。

Conclusion: 结果支持将显式、持续校验的任务依赖作为可靠智能体机器人执行的实用接口。

Abstract: Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin~V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

</details>


### [58] [Humanoid Dodgeball: Learning Fast Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Motions for Humanoids](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40003v1)
*Aoqian Zhang,Chunzheng Wang,Haoran Chen,Annan Tang,Cheng Xiang,Fan Shi,Shuzhi Sam Ge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Humanoid Dodgeball——一个用于人形机器人敏捷动态避障的强化学习框架，通过威胁感知奖励塑形与多方向对抗性运动先验，实现全身动态闪避并保持稳定、类人的运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人需在动态场景中安全作业，须在保持稳定性与全身运动可行性的前提下快速躲避高速运动障碍物。难点在于系统高维动力学，以及需同时平衡反应式避障、运动自然性与控制鲁棒性三者。

Method: 基于强化学习（RL）的框架：1）威胁感知奖励塑形（threat-aware reward shaping），驱动对来袭抛射物的高动态全身闪避；2）多个方向特定的对抗性运动先验（direction-specific adversarial motion priors），将学习行为正则化至稳定且多样的类人动作。

Result: 大量仿真与真机实验表明，该框架在多种障碍物速度与发射距离下显著提升动态避障性能，同时保持鲁棒且物理可行的人形运动。

Conclusion: 威胁感知奖励塑形结合方向特定对抗性运动先验，可有效解决人形机器人高动态避障中敏捷性、自然性与鲁棒性的联合优化问题，并在真实硬件上验证可行。

Abstract: Humanoids have become increasingly agile and capable in real-world environments. To operate safely in dynamic scenarios, they must rapidly evade fast-moving obstacles while maintaining stability and physically feasible whole-body motion. Learning such behaviors remains challenging due to the high-dimensional dynamics of humanoid systems and the need to jointly balance reactive obstacle avoidance, motion naturalness, and control robustness. In this work, we present Humanoid Dodgeball, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for agile dynamic obstacle avoidance in humanoids. Our method enables highly dynamic whole-body evasive maneuvers against incoming projectiles through threat-aware reward shaping, while multiple direction-specific adversarial motion priors regularize the learned behaviors toward stable and diverse human-like motions. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially improves dynamic obstacle avoidance performance across diverse obstacle speeds and launch distances, while preserving robust and physically plausible humanoid motions.

</details>


### [59] [How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40002v1)
*Dabin Seo,Eunhyek Joa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoC-CFG：在每个Euler步上对含推理片段与不含推理片段的上下文做classifier-free guidance，并将每步引导权重视为可测量的MDP，用小型critic拟合动作值实现Q自适应引导，在驾驶仿真与Waymo端到端基准上优于固定权重、SAC/GRPO及多种自适应引导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型VLA策略先写推理轨迹再解码动作，错误轨迹导致错误动作，看似正确的轨迹也可能误导规划。现有方法关注"推理是否正确"，本文转而研究"推理应以多大强度引导动作"，即引导强度的自适应控制问题。

Method: CoC-CFG在策略上下文与去掉推理片段的同一上下文之间施加classifier-free guidance，每个Euler步一个权重，w=1退化为原策略。将该权重的选择建模为MDP：专家冻结、噪声固定时，单步施加权重后由当前控制器完成规划可精确返回该权重的价值，故动作值可测量而非自举估计；再用小型critics拟合这些值，并保守地改进控制器。

Result: Alpasim闭环300场景通过262（原策略252），开环优于所有固定权重与SAC、GRPO；Waymo端到端驾驶留出帧上前三阶段优于所有固定权重、四种自适应引导方法、SAC与GRPO；隐藏测试集上冻结Alpamayo 1.5配规则化相机/车辆转换取得8.135159评分反馈分，超过最佳公开方法8.079。

Conclusion: 推理引导的关键不在于判定推理对错，而在于按步自适应调节其引导强度；以可测量动作值驱动的Q自适应引导无需自举即可保守改进控制器，并在仿真与真实基准上刷新最优结果。

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

</details>


### [60] [Gaze-Assisted Supervisory Control for Lunar Robotic Arm Teleoperation Under Concurrent Monitoring](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39998v1)
*Jiayu He,Yifan Li,Oliver R. Runswick,Ernest N. Kamavuako,Yunjie Jia,Peter D. Hodkinson,Yang Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出注视辅助的监督控制框架：注视提名目标、显式确认授权、机器人执行受限自主抓取-放置；16人VR实验显示任务时间由47.65 s降至18.43 s、NASA-TLX由32.54降至18.26，但精度放置阶段手动控制更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月面样品操作中，巡视器机械臂可扩展人的作业范围，但连续摇杆遥操作需反复进行视觉-运动对齐，且操作者还需兼顾系统状态监控，认知负担重。作者希望将任务级意图指定与自主执行结合，降低操作负荷并保留人在关键环节的控制权。

Method: 采用被试内2×2×3设计（控制模式×放置难度×并行监控负荷），16名被试在任务模拟VR环境中完成岩石抓取-放置；对比注视辅助监督控制与手动摇杆遥操作，测量任务完成时间及其阶段分解、监控任务的反应准确率与速度、核心兴趣区间注视切换率、raw NASA-TLX负荷，以及放置误差与成功率。

Result: 平均单块岩石任务完成时间由47.65 s降至18.43 s，其中72.5%的差异来自抓取阶段；在测试的听觉监控条件下，注视辅助模式的监控任务平均比例减速更小，两种模式在监控反应准确率与速度上无显著差异；核心兴趣区间注视切换率由49.98降至27.73次/min，raw NASA-TLX由32.54降至18.26。收益具有任务依赖性：精度放置中手动控制的平均放置误差更低、成功率更高。

Conclusion: 结果支持混合主动式控制权分配：注视用于快速的任务级意图指定与自主执行，精度关键阶段仍保留手动微调；即注视辅助监督控制适合提升效率与降低负荷，而非在所有阶段全面替代手动遥操作。

Abstract: Rover-mounted robotic arms can extend human reach during lunar sample handling, but continuous joystick teleoperation requires repeated visual-motor alignment while operators may also need to monitor system states. This paper presents a gaze-assisted supervisory control framework in which gaze nominates a rock or placement target, explicit confirmation authorizes the action, and the robot performs bounded autonomous grasp-and-place execution. The framework was evaluated against manual joystick teleoperation in a mission-analog virtual reality study with 16 participants. The study used a 2 x 2 x 3 within-subject design varying control mode, placement difficulty, and concurrent monitoring load. Mean recorded task completion time decreased from 47.65 to 18.43 s per rock, with 72.5% of this difference arising during grasping. Under the tested auditory monitoring conditions, gaze-assisted supervisory control showed less average proportional slowing, with no detected control-mode difference in monitoring-response accuracy or speed. The rate of gaze shifts between core areas of interest decreased from 49.98 to 27.73 shifts/min, while the raw NASA Task Load Index score decreased from 32.54 to 18.26. However, the benefit was task dependent. In precision placement, manual control yielded lower mean placement error and a higher placement success rate. These findings support a mixed-initiative allocation in which gaze enables rapid task-level intention specification and autonomous execution, while precision-critical stages retain manual refinement.

</details>


### [61] [Compressed Orientation Reachability Maps for Sub-Second Robotic Needle Entry Point Planning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39879v1)
*Prabhu Nithin Gollapudi,Andreas Maier,Franziska Mathis-Ullrich,Water Zhao,Jia Wang,Siming Bayer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于方向的ORIENTATION-BASED可达性地图ORM，预计算6自由度机械臂在188,873个工作空间位姿的运动学可行性并压缩为83MB索引地图，配合JIT运行时管线将近实时数组查表替代在线优化，将经皮肝穿刺入口点规划延迟从13.5-26.9秒降至0.289-0.349秒，几何保真度保持较高（凸包体积重叠比0.933，α-shape体积比0.976）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人经皮肝介入的多阶段轨迹规划中，确定运动学可行的入口点是关键计算瓶颈；现有方法依赖穷举逆运动学或随机搜索，每个靶点耗时13-27秒，难以支持术中实时自适应调整。

Method: 构建基于方向的可达性地图（ORM）：离线预计算6自由度串联机械臂在188,873个工作空间位置的可行性与方向可达信息，编码为紧凑的带索引83MB地图；运行时采用JIT编译管线，以数组查表替代在线优化计算。

Result: 每个靶点的规划延迟由13.5-26.9秒降至0.289-0.349秒，同时保持高几何保真度：相对基线可达点云的平均凸包体积重叠比为0.933，平均α-shape体积比为0.976。

Conclusion: ORM框架实现了亚秒级入口点规划，为经皮肝消融中的机器人针插入提供了高效计算框架。

Abstract: In the context of multi-stage trajectory planning for robotic percutaneous liver interventions, identifying a kinematically feasible entry point remains a critical computational bottleneck. Existing methods rely on exhaustive inverse kinematics or randomized searches, incurring delays of 13 to 27 seconds per target and limiting real-time intraoperative adaptation. This paper introduces an Orientation-Based Reachability Map (ORM) that precomputes the kinematic feasibility of a 6 Degrees of Freedom (DoF) serial manipulator across 188,873 workspace positions and encodes orientation feasibility into a compact, indexed 83 MB map. A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiled runtime pipeline replaces live optimization with near-instantaneous array lookups. Experimental evaluation demonstrates a reduction in planning latency from 13.5-26.9 s to 0.289-0.349 s per target while maintaining high geometric fidelity, achieving a mean convex hull volume overlap ratio of 0.933 and a mean alpha-shape volume ratio of 0.976 relative to the baseline reachable point cloud. The proposed ORM framework enables sub-second entry point planning and provides an efficient computational framework for robotic needle insertion in percutaneous liver ablation.

</details>


### [62] [PASA-KV: Attacking Action-Facing Visual Routes in World Action Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39816v1)
*Zhongbo Wu,Jiakai Huang,Zheng Zhang,Siyu Xu,Kaixiang Chen,Xiaohong Liu,Shan You,Chang Xu,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究世界动作模型（WAMs）中"世界表示→动作"通路对扰动的脆弱性，指出表示扰动幅度与闭环控制失效之间存在明显不匹配，并提出以"面向动作的读出"为核心的脆弱性视角，配合 Tail-AV 探针与 PASA-KV 攻击方法进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAMs 日益将视觉/世界表示与动作生成耦合，但其 world-to-action 通路是理解鲁棒性的关键却研究不足。此前的直觉认为表示扰动越大、控制失败越强，作者希望厘清内部表示扰动何时才真正转化为行为后果。

Method: 1）系统性地对视觉 K/V 路径施加扰动，分析表示可扰动性与闭环脆弱性之间的关系；2）将不匹配归因于动作条件读出机制——key 决定动作查询"读哪里"，value 决定"读什么内容"；3）提出 Tail-AV 短探针信号用于识别脆弱路径；4）据此实现 PASA-KV：先选择"面向动作"的 K/V 目标，再训练一个新的任务共享攻击。

Result: 攻击有效性在不同视觉 K/V 路径间差异显著，而更大的表示位移并不能可靠地带来更强的控制失效；基于读出信息的目标选择在多个 WAM 系统及一台实体机器人上得到验证，实现了强闭环攻击，并揭示系统间在抗攻击能力上存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 脆弱性应由扰动如何被路由进动作生成来衡量，而非仅看表示空间幅度；"面向动作的读出"视角为 WAM 鲁棒性分析与攻击目标选择提供了有效且可操作的框架。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) increasingly couple internal visual or world representations with action generation, making their world-to-action pathways a critical yet poorly understood source of robustness. We investigate when perturbations to these internal representations actually become behaviorally consequential, and uncover a pronounced mismatch between representation perturbability and closed-loop vulnerability: attack effectiveness varies sharply across visual K/V routes, while larger representation displacement does not reliably imply stronger control failure. Our analysis attributes this mismatch to the action-conditioned readout, where keys determine where action queries read and values determine what content they receive. This motivates an action-facing view of vulnerability, in which the effect of a perturbation depends on how it is routed into action generation rather than on representation-space magnitude alone. We instantiate this view with Tail-AV, a short-probe signal for identifying vulnerable routes, and operationalize it in PASA-KV, which selects action-facing K/V targets before training a fresh task-shared attack. Experiments across multiple WAM systems and a physical robot validate readout-informed target selection, demonstrate strong closed-loop attacks, and reveal substantial system-level differences in resistance.

</details>


### [63] [Surrogate Uncertainty for Black-box Visual Grounding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39798v1)
*Hanbo Zhang,Tianrun Hu,Cedar Site Bai,Anxing Xiao,David Hsu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文针对黑盒VLM视觉定位的置信度不可靠问题，提出以VLM预测为观测的贝叶斯定义，用外部代理贝叶斯模型在标定集局部邻域上估计逐查询不确定性（分解为偶然与认知），并通过分层检索实现紧凑联合空间邻域，可结合共形预测或模型规划进行主动定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在视觉观测下理解自然语言指令需要可靠的视觉定位，而现有方法直接从黑盒VLM自身输出（如生成的不确定性）导出置信度，这些输出与预测来自相同的参数和结构，会继承其偏差，导致不确定性估计不可靠。

Method: 给出形式化贝叶斯定义，将VLM预测视为观测；使用外部代理贝叶斯模型在留出标定集的局部邻域上量化逐查询不确定性，并分解为偶然（aleatoric）与认知（epistemic）两部分；通过跨输入模态的分层检索构建紧凑的联合空间邻域以缓解维度灾难；该估计器可进一步与共形预测或基于模型的规划结合，实现机器人以言语或物理动作进行的主动视觉定位。

Result: 在多个定位基准与先进VLM上，该方法一致地提升了校准质量与任务表现；在真实Fetch机器人上执行开放世界指令时，实现了"自信行动"与"信息收集"之间的原则性权衡，显著提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 不应依赖黑盒VLM自报的不确定性，而应以外部代理贝叶斯估计器给出可分解、可校准的逐查询不确定性，并借分层检索与共形/规划模块自然扩展至主动视觉定位，在真实机器人上验证了有效性。

Abstract: Visual grounding is crucial for robots to understand language instructions with visual observations. This paper addresses the problem of visual grounding uncertainties, where a robot uses a black-box vision-language model (VLM) to ground free-form natural-language instructions to target objects. Prevailing methods derive uncertainty from the VLM itself. Yet, outputs of the VLM, e.g., generated uncertainties, are from the same parameters and structures producing the predictions, and inherit the bias. We give a formal Bayesian definition of the problem that treats the VLM prediction as an observation. An external surrogate Bayesian model then quantifies per-query uncertainty over a local neighborhood of a held-out calibration set, decomposed into aleatoric and epistemic components. A hierarchical retrieval across input modalities realizes a compact joint-space neighborhood, mitigating the curse of dimensionality. The estimator further integrates with conformal prediction or model-based planning for active visual grounding, where robots are allowed to take verbal or physical actions to ground targets. Across grounding benchmarks and state-of-the-art VLMs, it consistently improves both calibration and task performance. On a real Fetch robot under open-world instructions, it enables principled trade-offs between confident action and information gathering, substantially improving robustness.

</details>


### [64] [Data-Driven or Model-Constrained? Comparing Airflow Estimation Methods under Sparse Sensing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39789v1)
*Dominik Aigner,Thomas Wiedemann,Javier Monroy,Achim J. Lilienthal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文在三种二维稳态仿真场景、不同采样密度下定量比较四种气流估计器（高斯过程回归、图结构高斯马尔可夫随机场、两种基于Navier–Stokes的方法，含一种新的强形式残差最小化变体），发现物理先验在低采样密度下收益最大，基于模型的方法在各场景中保持精度优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气流平流是实际场景中气体与气溶胶扩散的主要机制，准确的气流估计对通风监测、气体源定位与污染物扩散分析至关重要；但高分辨率空间感知获取流场图通常不可行，必须借助统计或物理先验从稀疏测量中估计流场。现有方法主要在流体约束引入方式与环境几何利用方式上不同，却缺乏系统性比较，导致物理先验在稀疏感知下的潜在收益未被充分探索。

Method: 在稳态条件下、三种模拟二维场景中，以不同采样密度对四类气流估计器进行定量评估：高斯过程回归（GPR）、基于图的高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF），以及两种基于Navier–Stokes方程的方法——其中包括一种新颖的强形式残差最小化（strong-form residual minimization）变体。

Result: 物理先验在低采样密度下收益最大，可补偿缺失的空间信息；随着传感器覆盖度提高，数据驱动的高斯过程回归竞争力逐渐增强；但基于模型的估计器在所评估的各场景中始终保有精度优势。

Conclusion: 物理/流体力学先验对稀疏感知下的气流估计具有实质价值，尤其在低采样密度时最为显著；尽管数据驱动方法在密集采样下表现改善，模型驱动方法仍具稳定的精度优势，这为稀疏传感条件下估计器的选择提供了系统性的定量依据。

Abstract: Airflow-driven advection is the primary mechanism for gas and aerosol dispersion in real-world scenarios, making accurate airflow estimation essential for ventilation monitoring, gas source localization, and contaminant spread analysis. Since obtaining airflow maps via high-resolution spatial sensing is usually infeasible in practice, flow field estimation methods must cope with sparse measurements by introducing statistical or physical priors to compensate for limited data. Existing approaches mainly differ in how they incorporate fluid-flow constraints and environmental geometry. However, due to the lack of systematic comparisons across this spectrum of methods, the potential benefits of physics-based priors for airflow estimation under sparse sensing remain underexplored. To address this question, we quantitatively evaluate four airflow estimators across three simulated 2D scenarios under steady-state conditions and varying sampling densities. The methods range from Gaussian Process Regression and graph-based Gaussian Markov Random Fields to two Navier-Stokes-based approaches, including a novel strong-form residual minimization variant. Our results show that physical priors provide the greatest benefit at low sampling densities by compensating for missing spatial information. Although data-driven Gaussian Process Regression becomes increasingly competitive as sensor coverage increases, model-based estimators retain an accuracy advantage across the evaluated scenarios.

</details>


### [65] [Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39775v1)
*Kristian Ceder,Kilian Freitag,Knut Åkesson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将大语言模型（LLM）监督器在线蒸馏为决策树，用于移动机器人在MPC冻结时的监督决策，测试时零LLM查询且性能匹配LLM与专家规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局规划器+局部MPC的架构在非凸避障与有限预测时域下会导致机器人冻结于复杂布局；是否重规划、等待或求助属于监督决策。此前每遇异常即查询LLM监督器，速度慢、成本高；而手写规则无法覆盖物理机器人将遇到的长尾情形。

Method: 在线将LLM监督器蒸馏为决策树。每个训练回合后，通过反事实回放将恢复动作标注为"必要/不必要/有害"，用这些标签淘汰无用规则；决策树处理熟悉场景，新场景才查询LLM，并把经验证的恢复动作转化为新规则。

Result: 在20个MPC单独会冻结的未见布局仿真中，所有随机种子下决策树至少正确处理18个，或到达目标或在无可行路径时求助；性能与始终查询LLM的监督器及专家设计规则相当，而测试时LLM查询次数为零。

Conclusion: 在线蒸馏是应对长尾场景的有效手段：决策树覆盖熟悉情况，LLM仅用于新情况，其验证后的恢复动作沉淀为新规则；LLM也可作为监督器的设计者而非仅是运行时监督者。

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots commonly pair a global planner with a local model predictive controller (MPC), but nonconvex obstacle avoidance and a limited horizon can make the robot freeze in complex layouts. Deciding whether to replan, wait, or call for help is a supervisory decision. Recent work queries a large language model (LLM) supervisor on every anomaly, which is slow and costly. We instead distill the LLM online into a decision tree. After each training episode, counterfactual replay labels recoveries as needed, unnecessary, or harmful. These labels retire unhelpful rules. In simulation, on 20 unseen layouts where the MPC alone freezes, the tree handles at least 18 correctly across all seeds, either by reaching the goal or by calling for help when no feasible path exists. The tree matches both an always-query LLM supervisor and expert-designed rules, while issuing no LLM queries at test time. Handwritten rules cannot anticipate the long tail of situations a physical robot will encounter. Online distillation is a promising remedy: the tree handles familiar cases, and the LLM is consulted only for new ones, whose validated recoveries become new rules. Language models can thus also serve as designers of supervisors rather than only as runtime supervisors.

</details>


### [66] [AFast Robot Localization Method Based on Monte Carlo Sampling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39708v1)
*He Zhaoqing,Hang Li,Xian Pu,Li Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种仅依赖车身前后左右四个测距传感器、无需航向信息的在线蒙特卡洛粒子滤波定位方法，并在地图局部高度相似的迷宫环境中验证其可行性与较高定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实受限环境中机器人往往无法依赖外部定位系统（如GPS、外部基站等），且现有方案常需航向信息或多传感器配置，成本与条件受限，故需一种低成本、快速、有效的自主定位方案。

Method: 基于蒙特卡洛采样的在线粒子滤波定位方法：以四个方向测距传感器的距离观测更新粒子权重，不使用航向信息，在迷宫地图环境中对移动机器人进行在线状态估计。

Result: 仿真实验表明，即使迷宫局部区域高度相似（易产生观测歧义、粒子退化与多峰分布），车辆仍能实现相对准确的定位。

Conclusion: 该方法为复杂受限环境下的机器人定位提供了一种快速、有效且硬件需求低的解决途径；论文为仿真验证，未给出量化误差指标与实车实验。

Abstract: Localization is an essential capability of intelligent robots. However, in real-world constrained environments, robots often cannot rely on external localization systems. Therefore, this paper proposes an online particle-filter localization method based on Monte Carlo sampling. The method is applied to the localization of a mobile robot in a maze environment and requires only four range sensors mounted on the front, rear, left, and right sides of the vehicle, without the need for any heading information. Simulation experiments demonstrate that even in a maze where local regions are highly similar, the vehicle can still achieve relatively accurate localization, thereby providing a fast and effective approach for robot localization in complex environments.

</details>


### [67] [AI for Science in Space: Orbital Laboratories, Planetary Fieldwork, and Embodied Autonomy](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39689v1)
*Zizhe Wang,Jia Deng,Xin Lu,Zehao Jia,Yi Huang,Yao Zhu,Jianing Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 综述AI4S从数据解释走向实验设计与执行在空间场景中的机遇与限制，提出连接样本历史、科学决策、物理执行与主张效度的框架，并以在轨设计与行星扩展及匹配评测分离感知、决策与执行的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI4S正从解释已有数据扩展到设计并执行实验；空间提供地面难以复现的现象（微重力、地外环境），但样本有限、资源受限、干预机会稀缺，另有通信时延使人类及时支持不可得，因此需评估自主科学在轨与行星原位研究的可行性与价值边界。

Method: 批判性综述：覆盖生物学、材料、流体与热物理及自适应探索的轨道实验室与行星原位科学；区分四类能力（从空间数据学习、选择科学行动、执行行动、保持实验效度）；以地面自驱动实验室提供优化、专用自动化、机器人操作与无人值守支撑的旁证；构建连接样本历史—科学决策—物理执行—主张特定效度的框架，并给出一个在轨设计实例、一个行星扩展实例与匹配的评测方案，用于消融式分离感知、决策策略与物理动作的贡献。

Result: 归纳出已由受限AI系统展示的科学收益，并识别三类缺口：观测、可执行动作、有效证据的连续性；指出空间机器人仅在必要干预超出已验证仪器能力且无法获得及时人工支持时才有价值扩张意义，其价值须与专用机构、冗余设计及人机协同操作对照确立。

Conclusion: 提出以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本与证据完整性（贯穿完整任务周期）来度量自主性的议程；强调自主性评价应基于科学效度而非自动化程度。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence for science (AI4S) is extending from interpretation of existing data to the design and execution of experiments. Space offers distinctive scientific opportunities while restricting physical support. Microgravity and extraterrestrial environments expose phenomena that terrestrial experiments cannot fully reproduce; finite samples, constrained resources, and limited opportunities for intervention complicate sustained investigation. This critical review examines orbital laboratories and planetary in situ science across biology, materials, fluid and thermal physics, and adaptive exploration. We distinguish learning from space-derived data, selecting scientific actions, executing them, and preserving experimental validity. Terrestrial self-driving laboratories provide complementary evidence on optimization, dedicated automation, robotic manipulation, and the support needed for unattended operation. The synthesis connects scientific gains already demonstrated by bounded AI systems to gaps in observation, executable actions, and continuity of valid evidence. Space robots can expand the attainable scope of autonomous science when necessary interventions exceed validated instrument capabilities and timely human support is unavailable. Their value must be established against dedicated mechanisms, redundancy, and human-supported operation. We develop a framework connecting sample history, scientific decisions, physical execution, and claim-specific validity. A worked orbital design, a planetary extension, and matched evaluation schemes separate the contributions of sensing, decision policies, and physical actions. The resulting agenda measures autonomy through valid scientific return, task coverage, intervention costs, and evidence integrity across complete campaigns.

</details>


### [68] [Kinematic-Tactile Aligned Dexterous Retargeting with Contact Wrench Space Alignment](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39582v1)
*Xinyuan He,Ziheng Xu,Yueyuan Chen,Yufan Ye,Yuanshuo Tan,Huiming Pan,Jianjun Meng,Shuo Jiang,Peter B. Shull*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出三级分层框架，实现人手到机器人手的"运动学—触觉"对齐重定向，以物体为中心接触力旋量空间作为触觉对齐的物理表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示是可扩展的灵巧操作数据源，但现有重定向方法主要迁移运动学，物理交互中的触觉信息在不同本体间几乎未被保留。

Method: 三阶段框架：先对齐手部运动学与接触几何；再由触觉力与接触几何构建人类力旋量支撑（wrench support）剖面；随后优化机器人指尖力目标以覆盖该支撑集，并转换为关节位置修正，得到可直接回放的机器人手部轨迹；以物体为中心的接触力旋量空间作为跨本体物理表征。

Result: 在仿真与真机三类倾倒（pouring）任务上评估；真机实验实现96.7%回放成功率，力旋量迁移保真度优于代表性重定向基线。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了运动学与触觉信息从人类演示到机器人手的物理落地迁移，为可扩展地学习接触密集型灵巧操作提供了路径。

Abstract: Human demonstrations provide a natural and scalable source of data for learning dexterous manipulation policies. However, existing retargeting methods primarily transfer human kinematics, while the tactile information underlying physical interaction is rarely preserved across embodiments. To address this limitation, we present a hierarchical three-stage framework for kinematic-tactile aligned dexterous retargeting. We use object-centric contact wrench space as a physical representation for tactile alignment between human and robot hands. The framework first aligns hand kinematics and contact geometry, and then constructs a human wrench support profile from tactile forces and contact geometry. Robot fingertip force targets are subsequently optimized to cover the human wrench support and converted into joint position corrections, yielding directly replayable robot hand trajectories. We evaluate the framework in simulation and real robot experiments across three pouring conditions. In the real robot experiments, our method achieves a 96.7\% replay success rate and higher wrench transfer fidelity than representative retargeting baselines. The framework enables physically grounded transfer of kinematic and tactile information from human demonstrations to robot hands, providing a path toward scalable learning of contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

</details>


### [69] [SimTO-Robust: Automated Design of Soft Grippers Robust to Grasp Pose and Object Geometry](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39560v1)
*Kurt Enkera,Joshua Pinskier,Marcus Gallagher,David Howard*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SimTO-Robust：在仿真驱动的拓扑优化中同时模拟多物体、多抓取位姿的接触力并聚合，以优化软夹爪形态，从而无需复杂控制即可获得对形状、位姿误差与扰动鲁棒的抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化环境中，软夹爪希望靠机械设计而非复杂感知与控制获得鲁棒性；但现有计算设计框架没有显式针对"跨物体几何与抓取位姿"的鲁棒性优化软夹爪形态。

Method: 将SimTO推广为SimTO-Robust：对不同对象与抓取位姿批量仿真抓取，聚合接触力作为优化目标指导形态拓扑优化；生成6,646个设计，物理测试其中24个，并与10个专用SimTO设计、2个刚性基线夹爪、1个用传统拓扑优化生成的通用软夹爪基线对比；共37个夹爪在涉及5个特征丰富物体、6种抓取位姿的拾放任务中测试，并施加逐步增大的外部扰动。

Result: SimTO-Robust设计的平均拾放完成可靠性高于专用SimTO设计与刚性基线；最佳SimTO-Robust设计承受的扰动幅度超过所有其他被测夹爪。

Conclusion: 把多样化抓取条件纳入仿真驱动拓扑优化是提升真实世界软夹爪鲁棒性的简单有效途径，也表明鲁棒抓取可主要通过智能机械设计而非复杂感知与控制实现。

Abstract: Robotic grippers operating in unstructured environments must robustly grasp objects of different shapes and sizes despite perception and positioning errors. Soft grippers that can achieve this robustness through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated control software offer a promising solution. However, no existing computational design framework explicitly optimises soft gripper morphology for robustness across object geometries and grasp poses. We introduce SimTO-Robust, a generalisation of simulation-driven topology optimisation (SimTO) that simulates grasps across multiple objects and poses and aggregates their contact forces to guide gripper morphology optimisation. We generate 6,646 designs and physically evaluate 24 of them alongside 10 specialised SimTO designs, two rigid baseline grippers, and a baseline generalist soft gripper produced using conventional topology optimisation. All 37 grippers are tested in a pick-and-place task involving five feature-rich objects and six grasp poses, with external disturbances of increasing magnitude applied during the task. On average, SimTO-Robust designs complete pick-and-place more reliably than specialised SimTO designs and the rigid baselines. The best SimTO-Robust designs also withstood more of the applied disturbances than any other tested gripper. These results show that incorporating diverse grasp conditions into simulation-driven topology optimisation is a simple and effective approach to improving real-world soft gripper robustness. More broadly, they show that robust robotic grasping can be achieved through intelligent mechanical design rather than sophisticated sensing and control.

</details>


### [70] [Assuring Learning-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems with Foundation Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agenda for Testing, Verification, and Runtime Assurance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39547v1)
*Xi Zheng,Ivan Ruchkin,Hong Jin Kang,Tevfik Bultan,Vijay Ganesh,Taylor T. Johnson,Ziyang Li,Lei Ma,Aloysius K. Mok,Daniel Neider,Ruzica Piskac,Nalini Venkatasubramanian,Simon Thompson,Sanjoy Baruah*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 面向含基础模型的学习型信息物理系统，提出"基础模型保障栈"，以神经-符号架构、语义落地的一致性测试、组合式验证与运行时保障三条路线，将模型中心评估转向系统级保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型CPS（自动驾驶、无人机等）越来越多地嵌入基础模型，但现有保障实践高度碎片化，无法支撑系统级保证；随机神经网络、符号与物理边界之间缺乏工程控制手段。

Method: 提出Foundation Model Assurance Stack，含三个相互衔接的方向：(i) 神经-符号架构，用显式符号世界模型、推理层与接口约束基础模型；(ii) 语义落地的一致性测试，结合形式规约与符号世界模型，并借助基础模型辅助的规约挖掘、场景生成与测试合成；(iii) 组合式验证与运行时保障，针对可形式化处理的分量与接口，采用模块化合约、等价性检查、经验证的综合、不确定性推理及运行时监控与强制执行。符号抽象作为随机学习与形式推理之间的保障边界。

Result: 给出一个覆盖系统全生命周期的保障框架，将测试、验证与运行时证据通过符号抽象联结；明确基础模型仅作为受约束的辅助者，其输出在可形式化规定正确性之处均被独立校验；并归纳出规约工程、抽象保真度、证据组合、生命周期认证四类研究挑战。

Conclusion: 呼吁从模型中心评估转向系统级保障，并提出面向可信、可部署、可认证学习型CPS的分阶段研究议程。

Abstract: Learning-enabled cyber-physical systems (CPS), including autonomous vehicles and UAVs, increasingly incorporate foundation models, yet fragmented assurance practices provide insufficient support for system-level guarantees. We argue that restoring engineering control across stochastic neural, symbolic, and physical boundaries requires a shift from model-centric evaluation to system-level assurance. We introduce the Foundation Model Assurance Stack, connecting three directions: (i) neuro-symbolic architectures that constrain foundation models through explicit symbolic world models, reasoning layers, and interfaces; (ii) semantically grounded, conformance-based testing that combines formal specifications and symbolic world models with foundation-model-assisted specification mining, scenario generation, and test synthesis; and (iii) compositional verification and runtime assurance that target formally tractable components and interfaces through modular contracts, equivalence checking, verified synthesis, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and runtime monitoring and enforcement. Symbolic abstractions establish assurance boundaries between stochastic learning and formal reasoning, connecting testing, verification, and runtime evidence across the system lifecycle. Foundation models serve as constrained assistants whose outputs are independently checked wherever correctness can be formally specified. We identify research challenges in specification engineering, abstraction fidelity, evidence composition, and lifecycle certification, and outline a staged agenda toward trustworthy, deployable, and certifiable learning-enabled CPS.

</details>


### [71] [From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39543v1)
*Yixue Zhang,Wenke Xia,Kun Wu,Wenbo Yu,Pei Ren,Junnan Nie,Di Hu,Zhengping Che,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CoRAct 提出"后果接地"的推理-动作对齐框架，将 ECoT 中的运动与路点作为可验证信号，通过在动作噪声空间用奖励引导的 group-relative 优化，使生成动作显式对齐推理意图与预期后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的具身思维链（ECoT）仅以条件方式（conditioning）隐式引导动作生成，动作并未被显式优化以与推理保持一致，导致推理与执行脱节。

Method: 将两类物理接地 ECoT 组件形式化为可验证信号：movement（意图运动）与 waypoints（预期空间后果）。用统一的 Mixture-of-Transformers 联合建模 ECoT 推理、动作生成与动作条件下的未来预测。对由采样噪声生成的候选动作计算对齐奖励（movement 一致性 + 预测结果与 waypoints 的一致性），并以奖励驱动 group-relative 优化更新初始噪声分布，从而将动作生成推向与意图和预期后果一致。

Result: 在 RoboCasa、VLABench 及真实世界操作任务上，相较强 ECoT-based VLA 基线，在任务成功率、泛化性与推理-执行对齐度上均有提升；并可将外部提供的 ECoT 落地为可执行行为，借助强 VLM 的知识实现对新场景的零样本适应。

Conclusion: 将推理作为可验证的奖励信号、在噪声空间显式对齐动作，是比隐式条件更强的 ECoT 利用方式；该框架兼具性能提升与外部推理迁移能力。

Abstract: Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them.
  We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences.
  Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models.
  Project page and dataset: https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/

</details>


### [72] [PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39528v1)
*Huabin Peng,Fagang Jin,Yancong Wei,Tengfei Ma,Chuhang Liu,Chao Yu,Liqing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PRIME W0：一种分层条件流匹配VLA框架，通过逐层KV注入、动力学感知条件（异步世界模型子目标图像预测+DINOv2历史帧语义桥）与协方差结构化噪声的Action Dynamic Manifold流匹配，弥补前馈VLA丢失长时程时序上下文与VLM层级结构的缺陷，在LIBERO与真机基准上取得SOTA，并通过消融验证各组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型多为前馈式：动作仅以当前观测为条件，丢弃了长时程时序上下文，也未利用VLM表征的层级结构，限制了指令跟随之外的复杂长程操作能力。

Method: 三项协同设计：(1)将预训练VLM的逐层KV注入自适应MoE动作专家；(2)动力学感知条件化——异步世界模型子目标图像预测，配合DINOv2历史帧语义桥；(3)Action Dynamic Manifold(ADM)流匹配，采用协方差结构化噪声以尊重机器人运动学耦合。训练分四阶段：VLM预训练、DAT/NTP视动预训练、带世界模型注入的DiT流匹配解码器组装、端到端SFT。

Result: 在LIBERO与真实机器人基准上达到SOTA性能；系统性消融实验验证了每个架构组件的有效性。

Conclusion: 分层条件流匹配结合VLM层级特征注入、世界模型子目标条件与运动学结构化噪声，可有效恢复长时程时序上下文，是提升VLA长程操作性能的可行范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at instruction following, yet most remain feed-forward: they condition actions only on the current observation and discard both long-horizon temporal context and the hierarchical structure of VLM representations. We present PRIME W0, a hierarchical conditional flow-matching framework that closes this gap through three synergistic designs: (1)per-layer KV injection from a pretrained VLM into an Adaptive MoE action expert; (2)dynamics-aware conditioning via asynchronous world-model subgoal-image prediction and a DINOv2 historical-frame semantic bridge; and (3)Action Dynamic Manifold (ADM) flow matching with covariance-structured noise that respects robot kinematic coupling. PRIME W0 is trained in four stages---VLM pre-training, DAT/NTP visuomotor pre-training, DiT flow-matching decoder assembly with WM injection, and end-to-end SFT---and achieves state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and real-robot benchmarks, with systematic ablations validating each architectural component.

</details>


### [73] [Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39446v1)
*Kai Sheng,Liuyi Wang,Jinlong Li,Haojie Dai,Chengju Liu,Qijun Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EvoLife：一个统一导航框架，让多模态具身智能体自主选择移动方式、主动求助并将经验持久化到空间记忆中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 要让具身智能体在物理世界中"活起来"，需同时具备自主行动、主动交互与记忆积累能力，使每次经历既能服务于当前决策，又能沉淀为未来任务的经验；现有工作往往将这三者割裂。

Method: 提出 EvoLife 统一导航框架：混合动作空间支持航点导航、局部离散调整、像素级导航与目标导向导航；主动交互机制允许智能体在遇到歧义或困难时寻求澄清或帮助；持久化空间记忆将观测与对话绑定到地点，保留有用经验以指导后续重访。

Result: 在四类任务族的八个基准上评测（VLN、物体导航、交互式实例导航、连续多任务导航）。平均每回合仅 1.87 次主动交互，在覆盖 VLN 与物体导航的四个 100 回合测试集上首次访问成功率（SR）达 100%；完整序列 SR 在 LHPR-VLN 50 条序列上达 98%、GOAT-Bench 50 条序列上达 94%；R2R 重访设置中，借助保留经验 SPL 从 82.23% 提升至 93.31%；多日真实物理导航实验展示了探索、主动求助与重访记忆地点的能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，自主行动、主动交互与经验积累复用相结合可有效提升具身导航的性能与泛化性，向"有生命感"的具身智能体迈进一步。

Abstract: Giving embodied agents the freedom to act autonomously, initiate interactions, and understand their surroundings through experience is a step toward bringing them to life in the physical world. Realizing this vision requires action, interaction, and memory to work together, so that each encounter can inform current decisions and contribute experience for future tasks. We present EvoLife, a unified navigation harness that enables a multimodal embodied agent to choose how to move, when to ask, and what experience to carry forward. Its hybrid action space supports waypoint navigation, local discrete adjustments, pixel-based navigation, and object-directed navigation. Active interaction allows the agent to seek clarification or assistance when it encounters ambiguity or difficulty, while persistent spatial memory binds observations and dialogue to places, retaining useful experience to guide subsequent visits. We evaluate eight benchmarks across four task families: vision-language navigation, object navigation, interactive instance navigation, and continuous multi-task navigation. With an average of only 1.87 active interactions per episode, our method achieves a first-visit success rate (SR) of 100% across four 100-episode sets spanning vision-language navigation and object navigation. Complete-sequence SR reaches 98% on 50 LHPR-VLN sequences and 94% on 50 GOAT-Bench sequences. In the R2R revisit setting, success weighted by path length (SPL) increases from 82.23% to 93.31% with retained experience. Multi-day physical navigation further demonstrates exploration, proactive help-seeking, and revisiting remembered places. Together, these results advance the vision of bringing embodied agents to life through autonomous action, proactive interaction, and the accumulation and reuse of experience.

</details>


### [74] [ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39429v1)
*Neel Jawale,Stephan Pleines,Soha Pouya,Yuke Zhu,Ajay Mandlekar,Caelan Garrett*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ScheduleGen，一个将规划与调度结合的集成算法，用于自动生成满足多臂约束的多臂机器人演示数据，在仿真与真机上均显著优于现有数据生成基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂（双臂、人形）平台相比单臂系统具有更短的任务周期，但因多臂约束的存在而更难以安全控制。训练通用多臂策略需要大规模数据集，而多臂演示数据的获取是瓶颈；现有的从少量源演示自动合成新演示的算法忽略了多臂约束，常导致不安全或失败的行为。

Method: ScheduleGen 是一个面向多臂演示生成的集成规划与调度（planning & scheduling）算法，在演示合成过程中显式建模并满足多臂约束，从而生成安全、可执行的演示轨迹。

Result: 在 28 个仿真任务变体上评估，包括 7 个外部作者编写的 RoboDojo 任务以及先前系统无法处理的设置：平均数据生成成功率为 79.6%，所训练策略平均成功率 65.5%；优于基于 SOTA 数据生成基线训练的策略；在 8 个真实世界变体上通过零样本 sim-to-real 及 real-to-sim-to-real 迁移，达到 50–80% 的成功率。

Conclusion: 显式引入多臂约束的规划与调度式演示生成，是突破多臂数据瓶颈、获得可迁移且高性能通用多臂策略的有效途径。

Abstract: Multi-arm robot platforms, including bimanual and humanoid robots, have the capability to complete tasks with lower cycle times than single-arm systems, but they are more difficult to safely control due to the presence of multi-arm constraints. The paradigm of training generalist robot policies from massive datasets is a promising approach to address general-purpose multi-arm manipulation, but the acquisition of large multi-arm manipulation datasets remains a bottleneck. Automated demonstration generation can alleviate this burden by synthesizing new demonstrations from a handful of source demonstrations, but existing algorithms ignore multi-arm constraints and as a result often induce unsafe and unsuccessful behaviors. We address this limitation by introducing ScheduleGen, an integrated planning & scheduling algorithm for multi-arm demonstration generation. We evaluate ScheduleGen on 28 simulation task variants, including seven externally authored RoboDojo tasks and settings inaccessible to prior systems; it achieves 79.6% mean data-generation success and trains policies with 65.5% mean success. ScheduleGen policies outperform those trained on a state-of-the-art data generation baseline, and achieve 50-80% success across eight real-world variants through zero-shot sim-to-real and real-to-sim-to-real transfer. Videos and more at: https://schedulegen.github.io/

</details>


### [75] [Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39416v1)
*Akila Ayanthi,Darshana Priyasad,Tharindu Fernando,Dimity Miller,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes,Peyman Moghadam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文指出VLM把抓取与运动预测当作语言生成任务存在结构性缺陷，并提出在冻结骨干的中间隐藏层上挂接几何兼容的轻量回归头，直接以连续值预测可供性框与轨迹路点，从而在精度与效率上取得更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测"在哪里抓"和"如何移动"本质上是几何问题，但现有视觉-语言模型将其视为文本生成：把空间坐标tokenize成文本并自回归解码。该机制忽视空间结构、截断连续精度，且坐标token间误差会累积。作者据此考察瓶颈究竟在自回归解码，还是另有因素。

Method: 先诊断：验证0.5–2B小型现成VLM的中间隐藏状态已蕴含丰富空间信息。再提出方法：在冻结骨干的中间隐藏层接一个轻量、几何兼容的预测头；该头以任务指令条件化一个可学习query，并通过视觉token上的cross-attention细化，直接回归可供性框与轨迹路点（连续值），不修改骨干参数。

Result: 在ShareRobot-Bench与AGD20K上评测：2B变体相比自回归基线，轨迹误差降低60%以上，ShareRobot-Bench可供性mAP提升85%；轨迹预测接近RoboBrain（DFD 0.251 vs 0.191），吞吐量高3.8倍。消融显示自回归解码是轨迹预测的主导瓶颈，而可供性预测还依赖特征深度与解码器结构。

Conclusion: 对指令条件的2D几何预测而言，绕过自回归文本解码、直接以连续几何形式读出VLM潜在空间信息，可获得更优的精度-效率权衡，且无需改动或重训骨干网络。

Abstract: Predicting where to grasp and how to move is fundamentally a geometry problem. Vision-language models treat it as language generation instead. They tokenize spatial coordinates into text and decode them autoregressively. This mechanism ignores spatial structure and truncates continuous precision. Errors compound across coordinate tokens during decoding. In this paper, we show that compact off-the-shelf VLMs with 0.5-2B parameters already encode rich spatial information in their intermediate hidden states. Autoregressive decoding is the dominant bottleneck for trajectory prediction, while affordance prediction depends additionally on feature depth and decoder architecture. We expose the latent spatial information with a lightweight, geometry-compatible prediction head that attaches to a frozen backbone. It reads features from an intermediate hidden layer, conditions a learned query on the task instruction and refines it via cross-attention over the visual tokens to regress affordance boxes and trajectory waypoints directly as continuous values, without modifying the backbone. We evaluate on ShareRobot-Bench and AGD20K. Our 2B variant reduces trajectory error by over 60% and improves ShareRobot-Bench affordance mAP by 85% relative to the autoregressive baseline. It approaches RoboBrain on trajectory prediction (0.251 vs 0.191 DFD) at 3.8x higher throughput. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for instruction-conditioned 2D geometric prediction.

</details>


### [76] [UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39385v1)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 UMI 类设备虽使人类专家无需遥操作实体机器人即可采集示教，但实际用于训练仍依赖一致的硬件配置、标定与数据处理流程，部署门槛高；同时缺乏双臂、带外感知且开箱即用的整套方案。

Method: 设计 UMI-Live 自研硬件，集成相机与 LiDAR-惯性传感、板载计算与供电，采集时无需外部跟踪设备与环境内标定；提供简洁的录制界面，后台以异步流水线并行执行 SLAM 重建并发布训练就绪数据集；同时开源支持双 YAM 遥操作及 VLA 策略训练与推理的软件栈。

Conclusion: UMI-Live 以"硬件—采集—重建—训练"一体化开源方案降低了野数据采集门槛，双臂高质量示教数据可有效支撑 VLA 策略微调，并具备良好可复现性。

Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) devices allow human experts to demonstrate tasks for robot learning without teleoperating physical robots. Using these demonstrations as training data still requires a consistent hardware setup, calibration, and data processing. We present UMI-Live, a full-stack open-source bimanual UMI system for in-the-wild data collection. We design our custom UMI-Live hardware to integrate camera and LiDAR--inertial sensing, onboard compute, and power, without external tracking equipment or calibration within the collection environment. We implement a simple user interface for recording data while an asynchronous pipeline performs parallel SLAM reconstruction and publishes training-ready datasets. We also release software that supports dual-YAM teleoperation and VLA policy training and inference. We validate UMI-Live data quality by fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ and MolmoAct2, achieving success rates of 10/10 and 8/10, respectively on a bimanual pick-and-place task. Furthermore, we release 40 hours of UMI-Live data across three tasks, and complete hardware designs, software, and reproduction guides at our $\href{https://umi-live.github.io/}{\text{project website}}$.

</details>


### [77] [Information-Driven Collaborative Autonomy for Heterogeneous UAV/UGV Teams](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39379v1)
*Joshua Yuriv Pilipovsky*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究无人机(UAV)与无人地面车(UGV)异构车队的协同规划：UAV利用机载光学相机对潜在危险目标进行空中搜索，UGV沿地面路线行进；通过遍历式最优控制、贝叶斯PMB后验与SCvx*-C-ADMM嵌套分布式优化实现闭环协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境中存在数量未知的潜在危险目标，需要空中传感与地面机动协同：UAV需根据地面路线与目标信息自适调整轨迹，UGV需规避风险；同时要求分散式求解以应对非线性、不可分离目标及连续时间分离约束。

Method: 1) 用遍历式控制(ergodic control)建模空中搜索，按空间信息密度分配感知努力，兼顾探索与定位；纳入动态相机视场脚印与位姿相关概率检测模型。2) 仅角度量测经贝叶斯推断，并对数据关联假设边缘化，得到Poisson multi-Bernoulli(PMB)近似目标后验(含已检测与未检测目标)，以其引导空中感知。3) 地面规划将机会约束避障(经置信集实现)与空洞概率(void-probability)目标结合。4) 采用嵌套SCvx*--C-ADMM方案全分散求解：外层序列凸规划迭代，内层分布式共识优化。5) 闭环方案随信息更新两车队轨迹，当剩余路线风险低于阈值时允许地面运动。

Result: 数值案例研究考察了感知几何与目标不确定性，比较了分散式与集中式求解器，并展示了多UAV与多UGV之间的完整闭环协同。

Conclusion: 所提出的遍历式空中搜索+PMB信念引导+机会约束地面规划+嵌套SCvx*-C-ADMM分散式闭环框架，可实现异构UAV-UGV车队在未知危险目标环境中的有效协同，分散式求解性能与集中式可对比。

Abstract: This paper considers coordinating a heterogeneous team of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) traversing a domain containing an unknown number of potentially hazardous targets. The UAVs provide aerial sensing using onboard optical cameras, adapting their trajectories to ground routes and target information. We formulate the aerial search problem using ergodic control, which distributes sensing effort according to a spatial information density to balance exploration and target localization. The formulation incorporates dynamic camera field-of-view footprints and pose-dependent probabilistic detection models. Angles-only measurements are processed through Bayesian inference and marginalization over data-association hypotheses to obtain a Poisson multi-Bernoulli (PMB) approximation of the target posterior, representing both detected and undetected targets. This belief directs aerial sensing toward unexplored regions along the ground routes and viewpoints that improve target localization. Ground planning combines chance-constrained target avoidance, enforced through confidence sets, with a void-probability objective that favors routes unlikely to contain threats. We solve each team's optimization problem in a fully decentralized manner using a nested SCvx*--C-ADMM scheme, with outer sequential convex programming iterations and inner distributed consensus optimization, accounting for nonlinearities, nonseparable objectives, and continuous-time inter-agent separation constraints. A closed-loop scheme updates both fleets' trajectories as information becomes available and permits ground motion when the remaining route risk falls below a prescribed threshold. Numerical case studies examine sensing geometry and target uncertainty, compare decentralized and centralized solvers, and demonstrate full closed-loop collaboration between multiple UAVs and UGVs.

</details>


### [78] [Utility-WAM: Correcting Future-Induced Action Changes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39367v1)
*Feihong Zhang,Xi Lin,Yulong Shi,Zuxing Lu,Yanghong Mei,Zhaopeng Gu,Tingyu Yuan,Zihao Liang,Yinuo Wang,Zhaowen Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Utility-WAM，通过残差适配器与预生成门控对 World Action Model 的未来条件控制进行原位校正，消除"未来诱导负迁移"并剔除冗余视频计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM 依赖生成视觉未来为动作提供条件，但该额外上下文既带来推理开销又并非普遍有益：聚合指标掩盖了特定任务（尤其精度类任务）上的严重退化，需要厘清"预测未来究竟改变了什么"并加以修正。

Method: 以同一 WAM 检查点下未来条件路径与无未来路径的动作差 Δa 为分析对象；提出 Utility-WAM：(1) 冻结共享 WAM 主干，训练残差适配器修复未来诱导的速度偏差，将其对齐真实动态指导并对超出无未来基线部分的额外误差施加惩罚；(2) 轻量预生成门控复用反事实动作结果，选择性跳过视频生成。

Result: 聚合层面 Δa 仅带来 +0.8（LIBERO）与 −0.8（RoboTwin 2.0）点变化，而延迟增加 1.7–1.9×；长程任务提升 +2.4 点，但 Press Stapler 与 Place Can Basket 分别下降 54.0/34.0 点，并跨独立训练变体复现。Utility-WAM 将上述损失降至 6.0/14.0 点，保留长程前瞻；门控在 75.5% 的 RoboTwin 查询上跳过视频生成，延迟降低 38%，平均成功率升至 RoboTwin 2.0 的 93.3% 与 LIBERO 的 98.9%；真实双臂三任务 60 次试验成功 53 次（FAST-WAM 为 43）。

Conclusion: 未来条件的收益高度集中于长程任务，代价主要体现为精度任务上的负迁移与推理延迟；通过原位残差校正与条件化视频生成门控，可在保留前瞻收益的同时消除退化并显著降低计算成本，真机实验亦验证其有效性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) can condition robot actions on generated visual futures, but this additional context is neither cost-free nor uniformly beneficial. We examine what a predicted future actually changes: the action delta $Δa$ between the future-conditioned and future-free execution paths of the same model. Under a shared WAM checkpoint, this delta barely shifts average benchmark success ($+0.8$ points on LIBERO, $-0.8$ on RoboTwin~2.0), while generating visual futures increases inference latency by 1.7--1.9$\times$. These aggregate metrics conceal a concentrated failure mode that we term \emph{future-induced negative transfer}: while predictive deltas benefit long-horizon tasks ($+2.4$ points on LIBERO-Long) and remain negligible on most routine manipulations, they induce severe degradation on precision tasks---with \emph{Press Stapler} and \emph{Place Can Basket} losing 54.0 and 34.0 points, recurring as top failure modes across independently trained WAM variants. We introduce \textbf{Utility-WAM} for in-place correction of future-conditioned control. Its primary learning component is a residual adapter that repairs future-induced velocity deltas under a frozen shared WAM by aligning them with ground-truth dynamic guidance and penalizing excess error beyond the future-free baseline. The adapter selectively eliminates the majority of severe task drops (reducing losses to 6.0 and 14.0 points) while preserving long-horizon foresight. To eliminate superfluous video computation, a lightweight pre-generation gate reuses counterfactual action outcomes to selectively bypass video generation on 75.5\% of RoboTwin queries, cutting latency by 38\% while improving average success to 93.3\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and 98.9\% on LIBERO. On physical bimanual manipulation across three real-world tasks, Utility-WAM succeeds in 53 of 60 trials, compared to 43 for FAST-WAM.

</details>


### [79] [SONIC-K1: Porting a Universal Humanoid Motion Tracker to a Small Humanoid on a Single GPU](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39327v1)
*Kyrylo Kolesnichenko,Jong-Hoon Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SONIC-K1——首个面向Booster K1人形机器人的开源权重全身运动跟踪器，由SONIC框架适配到该更小型机器人，单GPU从头训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SONIC框架面向较大机器人且算力开销高；缺少针对小型人形机器人（Booster K1）的低算力全身运动跟踪方案与公开权重。

Method: 将SONIC框架适配至Booster K1，策略在单块共享GPU上从头训练，算力仅为SONIC的一小部分；在MuJoCo中用SONIC成功判据评估留出运动片段与外部基准，并在真实K1上测试，另做动作延迟敏感性分析。

Result: MuJoCo中几乎跟踪全部留出运动片段并在外部基准表现良好；真实K1上可跟踪上半身与慢速运动，踏步与转向可靠性较低；仿真显示对动作延迟敏感。

Abstract: We present SONIC-K1, to our knowledge the first open-weights whole-body motion tracker for the Booster K1 humanoid, obtained by adapting the SONIC framework to this smaller robot. The policy is trained from scratch on a single shared GPU with a small fraction of the compute reported for SONIC. In MuJoCo simulation, it tracks nearly all held-out motion clips and performs well on external benchmarks under SONIC's success criterion. On the real K1, it tracks upper-body and slow motions, while stepping and turning remain less reliable, and simulation experiments show a sensitivity to action latency. These results show broad motion-tracking capability on a modest training budget and point to quantitative hardware evaluation as the main next step. Code, policy weights and evaluation tools are publicly available.

</details>


### [80] [ProLoop: Progress-Aware Closed-Loop Framework via Structured State Relations for Long-Horizon Robotic Task Planning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39319v1)
*Runxin Zou,Qingmiao Liang,Jiatao Zhang,Xinyan Lv,Liangyu Qie,Meiyi Bu,Wei Song,Shiqiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ProLoop 框架，通过对期望状态与执行状态的结构化关系进行学习式监测，显式推断子目标进度（进行中/偏离/完成），并据此闭环指导执行，提升长时程机器人任务的成功率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程机器人任务常分解为语义子目标以简化规划，但基于 LLM 的规划中子目标进度通常只能从交互历史隐式推断；估计不准确会误导执行，导致局部错误累积传播。

Method: ProLoop 是进度感知的闭环框架：从期望状态与执行状态之间的结构化关系中显式导出子目标进度。采用可学习的 State-Relation Monitor 评估这些关系，再将关系聚合为 ongoing、deviated、completed 三类的子目标进度，并用该进度驱动执行适配，实现进度感知的闭环控制。

Result: 在 AgentBoard ALFWorld 与真实机器人平台上实验：整体成功率提升 12.94%，Hard 任务提升 15.46%，同时环境交互次数减少 32.3%。

Conclusion: 显式建模并闭环利用子目标进度，可有效抑制局部误差传播，在仿真基准与真实平台上同时提升成功率并显著降低交互开销，说明进度感知控制对长时程机器人任务规划具有实用价值。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic tasks are commonly decomposed into semantic subgoals to simplify planning. However, subgoal progress in LLM-based planning is typically inferred implicitly from interaction histories. Inaccurate estimates can misguide execution and allow local errors to propagate. To address this, we propose ProLoop, a Progress-Aware Closed-Loop framework that derives explicit subgoal progress from structured relations between desired and execution states. A learned State-Relation Monitor assesses these relations, which are then aggregated into subgoal progress as ongoing, deviated, or completed. The resulting progress guides execution adaptation, enabling reliable progress-aware control throughout execution. Experiments on AgentBoard ALFWorld and a real-world robotic platform show that ProLoop improves success rate by 12.94% overall and by 15.46% on Hard tasks, while reducing environment interactions by 32.3%.

</details>


### [81] [Language-Grounded Force/Torque Pretraining for Extrinsic Contact Perception](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39314v1)
*Kazuki Takahashi,Hiroaki Murakami,Ryota Sakuma,Mitsuhiro Kamezaki,Matthew Ishige,Yoshihiro Kawahara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出将双臂六维力/力矩时序信号通过与冻结语言空间对齐，预训练成具有语义结构的物理表征；该表征支持对机器人动作、物体重量、抓取交互的直接读出，并可通过无标签校准与低秩适配迁移到真实世界的接触/支撑状态识别与连接器插入等新事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精细操作要求机器人识别抓取物体何时与环境发生或改变接触，但这类"外在接触"难以从视觉或局部接触几何直接观测。力/力矩信号虽携带此类信息，却随物体重量、抓取构型与机器人运动而变化，因此其能否构成可复用的物理状态表征尚不明确。

Method: 以仿真拾放交互生成的监督信号，将双臂六维力/力矩历史与冻结的语言空间对齐，预训练出语义结构化的物理表征；在读出阶段采用文本原型分类；在真实放置任务中用无标签校准实现接触与支撑状态识别（编码器不更新）；在连接器插入任务中用低秩适配（LoRA）进行数据高效微调。

Result: 在仿真未见过物体上，该表征支持对机器人动作、物体重量和抓取交互的文本原型读出；在真实放置中，无标签校准下的接触与支撑状态识别优于"垂直力符号反转"规则基线；在未参与预训练的连接器插入事件上，低秩适配相比从头训练显著提升数据效率。

Conclusion: 力/力矩历史既可用于已知物理状态的直接读出，也可高效适配到新的外在接触事件，说明其可作为可复用的物理状态表征。

Abstract: Fine manipulation requires robots to recognize when a grasped object makes or changes contact with its environment, yet such extrinsic contact is not always directly observable from vision or local contact geometry. Force and torque signals carry this information, but also vary with object weight, grasp configuration, and robot motion, leaving it unclear whether they can provide a reusable representation of physical state. Here we show that bilateral six-axis force/torque histories can be pretrained as a semantically structured physical representation by aligning them with a frozen language space using supervision generated from simulated pick-and-place interactions. On unseen objects in simulation, the learned representation supports text-prototype readout of robot action, object weight, and grasp interaction. In real-world placement, unlabeled calibration enables contact and support-state recognition without updating the encoder, outperforming a vertical-force sign-reversal rule baseline. For connector insertion, an event absent from pretraining, low-rank adaptation improves data-efficient learning over training from scratch. These results show that force/torque histories can support both direct readout of known physical states and efficient adaptation to new extrinsic-contact events.

</details>


### [82] [OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39287v1)
*Junli Liu,Zhongrui You,Chenhui Li,Zhen Li,Yuyang Tian,Qizhen Chen,Delin Qu,Haoming Song,Dong Wang,Xuelong Li,Zhigang Wang,Bin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 OpenFlyV2，一种统一机载的视觉-语言-动作架构，以共享视觉-语言表示在单一模型中同时支持语义理解、语言接地感知、空间推理与连续飞行控制，可在 Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 机载闭环生成动作块，并实现仿真到真机的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中机器人系统多为单能力专用、依赖机外计算，或在资源受限平台上难以维持闭环运行；而人类认知能够基于共享感知基础灵活统一地完成理解、注意、空间推理与行动，因此需要为飞行机器人赋予类似的功能组织。

Method: 构建统一的机载 VLA 架构：以共享视觉-语言表示驱动语义理解、语言接地感知、空间推理与连续空中控制；用紧凑的动作专家将共享多模态上下文转换为短时域航点；引入运动感知时序记忆与动作先验以降低闭环执行计算开销；并构建约 7 万条导航轨迹、6 万条视觉-语言指令-响应对的仿真数据集。

Result: 在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上完全机载、以 10 Hz 生成每块 12 个航点的动作块；无真实空中训练数据条件下由仿真零样本迁移至实体四旋翼，在四类真实环境中取得 48% 导航成功率。

Conclusion: 广泛的视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞行可在资源受限的空中平台上的单一模型中并存，表明共享表示的统一 VLA 设计对机载空中机器人是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.

</details>


### [83] [Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39280v1)
*Jonathan Yang,Chelsea Finn,Dorsa Sadigh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种跨本体、跨控制器的机器人数据迁移框架，通过"行为交互上下文"（指令动作+实际运动）让单一策略在上下文中自适应控制器差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人策略通常假设每个机器人只有单一控制器，但不同控制器对同一动作赋予不同物理含义、完成任务所需策略也不同，直接混合数据会因动作解释冲突而损害学习，限制了跨控制器数据迁移。

Method: 覆盖6种控制器类型及控制器增益、柔顺性变化；用"指令动作—实际机器人运动"的示例对来编码某控制器下的行为交互；用Transformer上下文编码器对这些交互进行总结，使单一策略能够上下文内自适应（in-context adaptation），从而在混合数据上训练而不受冲突动作解释干扰。

Result: 真实实验中，相较朴素数据混合平均成功率提升33个百分点；在未见过的控制器模式上达50%成功率，未见控制器增益下52%；在控制器专属数据有限的任务上也能迁移。在USB插入、表面擦拭等接触丰富任务中，行为交互上下文使策略不仅调整动作、还能调整策略。

Conclusion: 行为交互上下文为通用机器人策略利用跨不同动作解释的数据提供了可行路径，使单一策略可泛化到未见控制器模式与参数。

Abstract: Generalist robot policies increasingly learn from data collected across diverse tasks and embodiments, yet typically assume a single controller for each robot. This assumption limits transfer because different controllers can assign different physical meanings to the same action and may require different strategies to complete a task. We study how to transfer robot data across both embodiments and controllers without allowing conflicting action interpretations to interfere with learning. Our setting spans six controller types as well as variations in controller gains and compliance. We propose a framework that encodes behavioral interaction under a controller through examples of commanded actions and the resulting robot motions. A transformer context encoder summarizes these interactions, allowing a single policy to adapt in context. Across real-world experiments, our method improves average success by 33 percentage points over naive data pooling, achieves 50\% success on unseen controller modes and 52\% on unseen controller gains, and transfers to tasks with limited controller-specific data. On contact-rich tasks such as USB insertion and surface wiping, behavioral interaction context enables the policy to adapt not only its actions but also its strategy. Our results provide a path toward generalist robot policies that can leverage data collected across diverse action interpretations. For more information, visit \href{https://controller-transfer.github.io}{https://controller-transfer.github.io}.

</details>


### [84] [CuBot-STT: Simultaneously Transport and Tighten for Lattice-type Modular Reconfiguration Robot](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39279v1)
*Chongxi Meng,Da Zhao,Yanmin Zhou,Runjie Shen,Zhipeng Wang,Bin He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CuBot-STT：一种集模块运输、接口锁紧与释放于一体的外部机器人，用于晶格型模块化自重构机器人的自主重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专用运输机器人通过取消模块级重构执行器来降低模块重量与成本，但现有系统存在连接容量低、或需要占用功能部件空间的内部紧固机器人等问题。

Method: 立方模块提供结构支撑与24V配电；每个面上齿轮传动将单一外部输入转换为四个螺旋锁点的运动，从而保留内部空间。机器人采用交替足支撑、用于搬运模块的夹爪以及用于接口驱动的拧紧头；控制器通过连续约束转移协调双足支撑与模块锁紧。规划器将重定位代价分解为解析下界与经专家引导、目标条件Q学习得到的残差；接触面A*搜索将重定位序列扩展为满足连通性、非对称操作与足部站立约束的机器人基元。

Result: 实验显示法向与切向接口容量分别为300 N与490 N，跨六个模块实现电气连通，并完成11模块晶格的自主重构。规划基准显示其搜索效率优于解析引导与双向启发式搜索，且无需微调即可泛化到超出训练规模的晶格。

Conclusion: 一体化的外部机器人设计可在不占用模块内部空间的前提下实现高容量连接与自主重构，结合解析与学习的规划方法具备良好的效率与规模泛化能力。

Abstract: Lattice-type modular reconfigurable robots rearrange standardized modules across tasks. Dedicated transport robots reduce module weight and cost by eliminating module level reconfiguration actuators. But existing systems use low capacity connections or internal fastening robots that occupy space for functional components. This paper presents CuBot-STT, which integrates module transport, interface locking, and release in one external robot. Cubic modules provide structural support and $24\,\mathrm{V}$ power distribution. On each face, a gear transmission converts one external input into motion of four helical locking points, preserving internal space. The robot uses alternating foot support, a gripper for module handling, and a tightening head for interface actuation. The controller coordinates two-foot support and module locking through continuous constraint transfers. The planner decomposes relocation costs into an analytical lower bound and a residual learned through expert-guided, goal conditioned Q-learning. Contact face $A^*$ search expands relocation sequences into robot primitives satisfying connectivity, asymmetric manipulation, and foot stance constraints. Experiments demonstrate normal and tangential interface capacities of $300\,\mathrm{N}$ and $490\,\mathrm{N}$, electrical continuity across six modules, and autonomous reconfiguration of an 11-module lattice. Planning benchmarks show superior search efficiency over analytical guidance and bidirectional heuristic search, with generalization beyond training lattice sizes without fine-tuning.

</details>


### [85] [RAIBO-Wagon: Real-Time Navigation System for a Legged Robot Towing a Wagon](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39267v1)
*Insung Yang,Eunchae Kim,Jungwoo Hur,Seunghun Jeon,Donghyuk Choi,Jemin Hwangbo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出将条件流匹配（CFM）与基于学习前向动力学模型（FDM）的 MPPI 相结合的导航框架，用于四足机器人牵引拖车的受限空间自主导航，并在真机全机载条件下取得 85% 成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腿足机器人自身控制已较成熟，但与外部欠驱动物体耦合后（如牵引拖车）整体动力学更复杂，可靠导航困难；在受限空间中需在严格实时约束下寻找狭窄可行路径，难度进一步放大。现有方法难以兼顾实时性与对耦合动力学的建模能力。

Method: 构建 CFM + MPPI over learned FDM 的分层式框架：CFM 生成初始轨迹分布，缓解 MPPI 的初始化难题并加速收敛；MPPI 借助学习的前向动力学模型进行迭代优化，突破 CFM 训练分布限制以恢复可行解。框架集成到 RAIBO-Wagon（四足机器人 + 定制拖车）的全栈导航系统中，感知与计算全部机载完成。

Result: 在真实户外 15 m 长的受限空间赛道开展实验，40 次试验成功率 85%，最大牵引总负载 40 kg，接近 RAIBO 自重的 100%，全部感知与计算机载运行。

Conclusion: CFM 提供先验、MPPI+FDM 负责精化的组合范式可有效应对欠驱动耦合系统的受限空间导航；真机验证表明该框架在重载、受限场景下具备实用性与实时性，为腿足机器人带载作业提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Legged robots have demonstrated advanced capabilities across a wide range of real-world tasks, yet much of this progress concerns the robot controlling only itself. Once the robot is coupled to an external object -- particularly an underactuated one -- the dynamics of the combined assembly become more complex. Towing a wagon is a common practical scenario, where coupled dynamics make reliable navigation challenging. This difficulty is amplified in confined spaces, where collision-free navigation requires finding a narrow set of feasible paths under strict real-time constraints. To address this, we propose a navigation framework that combines Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control over a learned Forward Dynamics Model (FDM). The CFM model mitigates the initialization problem of MPPI and accelerates its convergence, while MPPI with the FDM recovers feasible solutions beyond the CFM model's training distribution by iterative refinement. We integrate the framework into a full-stack navigation system for RAIBO-Wagon, a quadruped towing a custom wagon, and validate it in real-world outdoor experiments on 15 m-long courses through confined spaces, with all sensing and computation performed fully onboard. The system achieves an 85% success rate across 40 trials, towing a total load of up to 40 kg -- nearly 100% of RAIBO's body weight.

</details>


### [86] [Event2Reward: Learning Robotic Rewards from Progress Relations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39212v1)
*Junnan Nie,Zitian Fan,Jiachen Zhang,Junyi Lao,Likui Zhang,Chenghao Liu,Xiaoyang Lu,Yunbo Wang,Yixue Zhang,Linbo Zhai,Jiayi Li,Mengzhe Wang,Xichang Wu,Bin Wang,Chang Liu,Tianle Zhang,Songfang Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Event2Reward，利用轨迹内局部相对进度关系约束进度预测，并与归一化时间标签的绝对进度监督结合，为机器人强化学习构造稠密奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法以归一化演示时间作为进度标签，隐含假设任务进度单调递增；但策略探索中进度会停滞甚至回退，模型可能把回退误判为进度，对导致进度损失的动作给予正向塑形奖励。而次优与失败执行虽含纠错经验，却难以标注绝对进度。

Method: 关键观察：停滞、回退与恢复在没有绝对进度时仍可建立局部相对进度关系。Event2Reward 用归一化时间标签锚定进度尺度，用轨迹内相对关系约束局部变化，联合绝对与相对进度监督；其进度预测作为势函数用于奖励塑形。并构建了约10万条真实机器人执行记录的事件标注数据集，涵盖成功、次优与失败执行，无需逐帧绝对进度标签。

Result: 相同训练预算下，LIBERO四个套件40个任务上策略平均成功率比仅用稀疏任务奖励的基线提升18.16个百分点。真实机器人30分钟训练后，三个精密插入任务平均成功率60.0%，三个物体操作任务90.0%，分别比同预算稀疏奖励基线高36.7与23.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 消融表明绝对进度监督与相对进度关系互补，联合监督带来更好的下游策略学习效果。

Abstract: Learning task progress from robot demonstrations provides a practical way to construct dense shaping rewards for robotic reinforcement learning. A common approach uses normalized demonstration time as progress labels, implicitly assuming monotonically increasing task progress. During policy exploration, however, actual task progress can stall or even regress. Such models may mistake regressions for progress, assigning positive shaping rewards to actions that cause progress loss. Real suboptimal and failed executions offer corrective experience, but assigning absolute progress values to their states is difficult. Our key observation is that stalls, regressions, and recoveries establish local relative progress relations even when absolute progress is unknown. We introduce Event2Reward, which uses normalized temporal labels to anchor the progress scale and these within-trajectory relations to constrain local changes, combining absolute and relative progress supervision. Its progress predictions serve as potentials for reward shaping. We curate an event-annotated dataset from approximately 100K raw real-robot execution records, covering successful, suboptimal, and failed executions, without requiring framewise absolute progress labels. Under the same training budgets, Event2Reward improves average policy success by 18.16 percentage points over a baseline using only sparse task rewards across 40 tasks in four LIBERO suites. On real robots, average success after 30 minutes of wall-clock training reaches 60.0% on three precise insertion tasks and 90.0% on three object manipulation tasks, exceeding the sparse-reward baseline under the same budget by 36.7 and 23.3 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further show that absolute progress supervision and relative progress relations are complementary, with joint supervision yielding better downstream policy learning.

</details>


### [87] [EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39180v1)
*Zhifeng Gu,Ying Chen,Rui Jiang,Lei Yi,Bing Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 EmbodiExp 框架，通过"结果锚定的子目标经验"实现跨任务经验迁移与在线组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验可帮助具身智能体把高层计划转化为落地动作，但跨任务迁移困难：过去的有效策略可能不适用于当前状态，或无法产生预期结果。
