Abstract: Robot imitation learning uses demonstrations from operators of varying skill, but selecting training data remains challenging. Existing methods score demonstrations using smoothness, diversity, or estimated influence on policy performance, but differences in selection and evaluation protocols make it difficult to determine whether they outperform simple baselines. We introduce \textbf{CuraEval}, a framework combining mathematical analysis of demonstration scores with controlled comparisons against fixed size-matched random subsets and full-data training on mixed-skill robomimic data using Diffusion Policy and BC-RNN. We show that the evaluated PSD score depends only on episode length and squared position magnitudes, and produces nearly the same ranking as episode length on \textit{square} ($ρ=0.999$). With Diffusion Policy, selecting the shortest 50\% of demonstrations improves \textit{square} success from 70.7\% under random selection to 76.5\%. Compared with random selection, our adapted geometric-entropy LOO selector reduces success at 25\% retention from 94.7\% to 74.0\% on \textit{can} and achieves 41.7\% on \textit{square}, below the mean success rates of all three independently sampled random subsets (59.8--62.5\%). On the same 3 \textit{square} Diffusion Policy training seeds, length-based selection at 75\% retention improves success over full-data training from 76.7\% to 86.7\% under the original protocol, but lowers it from 80.5\% to 79.5\% after checkpoint reporting, rollout count, and evaluation seed change jointly. No evaluated curated condition significantly outperforms full-data training after Holm correction, although confidence intervals still permit useful gains. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CuraEval.

</details>


### [122] [Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38199v1)
*Greta Perez-Haiek,Luca Macesanu,Kevin Angers,Mohammed Imam,Timothy Gambin,Christopher Clark*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文构建水下操作数据集并训练14种配置的通用VLA模型，在泳池硬件测试中多数优于基线（最高93.3%成功率），并在真实沉船现场对比ACT与SmolVLA，发现单任务ACT显著优于通用VLA，同时开源BLUEMBODIED KIT工具链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆在地面机器人操作中泛化良好，但海洋视觉畸变与动态水流造成严重域偏移，是通用架构应用于水下现场操作的关键瓶颈。

Method: 在平静与湍流水域采集1616条水下操作数据，训练14个本体感知观测配置不同的通用VLA模型（DynamicVLA）；泳池中执行3项任务共1260次可评分硬件rollout。另开展案例研究：在ROV上用单任务ACT与SmolVLA在真实海洋考古与保护场景（抓取、系泊）执行任务，共748条episode、508次可评分rollout。

Result: 泳池实验中10个模型超过基线，最佳模型总体成功率93.3%（含部分成功）；真实场景中ACT显著优于SmolVLA（合并成功率47.9% vs 7.9%），最成功任务达66.7%。

Conclusion: 通用VLA在水下经适配后可超越基线，但现场任务中专用ACT仍明显优于通用VLA；作者开源BLUEMBODIED KIT以推动海洋现场机器人具身智能研究。

Abstract: Behavior Cloning has demonstrated promising generalization capabilities for robotic manipulation in terrestrial environments. However, marine visual distortions and dynamic currents create a severe domain shift that remains a key bottleneck in adapting generalist architectures to underwater field manipulation. To address this, 1616 episodes of underwater manipulation data were collected in calm and turbulent waters and were used to train 14 generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models (DynamicVLA) with varying proprioception observation configurations. Across three tasks on 1260 gradable on-hardware rollouts in a pool, 10 models outperformed the baseline, with the highest-performing model achieving a 93.3% overall success rate, including partial successes. Results are also introduced from a case study evaluating the performance of a single-task Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) and a generalist VLA (SmolVLA) policy for two tasks in marine archaeology and conservation: grasping and mooring. Experiments are performed on an ROV on and around the WWII wreck Coralita X127 and at Manoel Island Marina, Malta. Across 748 collected episodes and 508 gradable on-hardware rollouts, the ACT policy substantially outperformed SmolVLA (47.9% vs. 7.9% pooled success rate), earning a 66.7% success rate on the most successful task at the marine archaeological site. To enable further contributions to embodied intelligence in marine field robotics, the BLUEMBODIED KIT used to collect data, train models, and deploy policies on the ROV has been open sourced.

</details>


### [123] [Minimum Sufficient Communication for Independent Behaviour Tree Robot Teams](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38176v1)
*Sherry Jiang,Oliver Obst*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个实验框架，用于在具有私有黑板、运行固定独立行为树（BT）的机器人团队中判定"充分通信量"。通过单侧同时置信界，将候选轻量策略与全状态通信参照进行配对比较，输出精确最小值、正区间、充分上界或未定边界四类结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人团队通常采用无共享内存的独立行为树与私有黑板，通信是主要开销来源，但"成功完成任务所需的最小通信量"缺乏可判定、可统计推断的实验方法。

Method: 在声明的策略族内改变消息内容与准入频率，以"每机器人决策的接收者加权比特数"度量流量；先做密集扫描筛选候选策略，再在新生成的配对场景上重测候选与全状态参照，用单侧同时置信界检验成功率是否保持在参照的5个百分点以内，同时判定更便宜策略是否可被判为不充分。

Result: 在四种仓库条件下测试8种内容策略：低争用条件下零通信为精确最小值；在放大条件下，无释放（no-release）策略在门限 q=0.992222 处被确认为充分，成功率96.33%，估计速率738.55比特/每机器人决策，仅为全状态流量的0.544%；正的最小值仍未确定。

Conclusion: 该框架可在明确限定的策略族、采样门限与工况范围内给出统计意义上的充分通信判定；结论不外推到策略族外或未采样工况，正最小值问题留待后续研究。

Abstract: We present an experimental framework for determining sufficient communication in robot teams running fixed, independent Behaviour Trees with private blackboards. Within a declared policy family, we vary message content and admission frequency and measure traffic in recipient-weighted bits per robot decision. A dense sweep identifies candidate policies for comparison with full-state communication. We retest selected candidates and the reference on fresh, paired scenarios, using one-sided simultaneous confidence bounds to assess whether success remains within five percentage points of the full-state reference. The bounds also assess whether tested cheaper policies can be ruled out as insufficient. Depending on the evidence, the framework reports an exact minimum, a positive bracket, a sufficient upper bound, or an unresolved boundary. Experiments with eight content policies across four warehouse conditions identify zero communication as the exact minimum under low contention. In the scaled condition, the no-release policy at gate $q=0.992222$ is confirmed sufficient, achieving 96.33% success at an estimated rate of 738.55 bits per robot decision, or 0.544% of full-state traffic. The positive minimum remains unresolved. These claims apply only to the declared policy family, sampled gate values and operating conditions.

</details>


### [124] [SKiD-SLAM: Resource-Aware Distributed Multi-Robot LiDAR SLAM for Planetary Missions with Field Deployments at Analog Sites](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38141v1)
*Hogyun Kim,Juwon Kim,Dongjin Cho,Jiwon Choi,Geonmo Yang,Seokhwan Jeong,Jiyun Lee,Miryeong Park,Hyungtae Lim,Younggun Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SKiD-SLAM——面向通信受限、无中心设施的行星探测环境的分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM系统，并在韩国熔岩管洞穴与行星类似地形的两次野外部署中验证其在250 kbps通信预算下可靠运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来行星探测任务需要机器人团队在严重通信受限、机载算力受限且无中心基础设施的条件下协同建图，现有SLAM系统难以满足真实行星任务的通信与计算预算。

Method: 先调研真实行星任务的通信与计算预算，据此选取可满足预算的模块，构建分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM系统，包含机器人间位置识别、相对位姿估计与分布式轨迹融合；在部署前于类行星环境的公开数据集和基于NASA JPL开源漫游车搭建的仿真器中验证，随后开展野外部署：济州岛万丈熔岩管洞穴中用轮式漫游车团队，涟川KICT行星模拟地形上用四足机器人开展陨石坑与岩石科学场景。

Result: 两次野外部署中，SKiD-SLAM在250 kbps的机器人间通信预算内可靠完成分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM，验证了其在严苛野外条件下的可行性；代码与野外数据已开源。

Conclusion: SKiD-SLAM证明了在真实行星任务级别的通信与计算约束下，分布式多机器人LiDAR SLAM具备可行性，为未来行星探测的协同建图提供了可部署方案。

Abstract: Future planetary exploration missions require teams of robots to collaboratively map unknown environments under severe communication limits, constrained onboard computation, and no central infrastructure. In this field report, we present SKiD-SLAM, a distributed multi-robot LiDAR simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system for such environments, and report its deployment across two mission concepts: cave exploration and scientific surface exploration. We survey the communication and computation budgets of actual planetary missions and select modules that fit these budgets for inter-robot place recognition, relative pose estimation, and distributed trajectory fusion. Before field deployment, we verify the assembled system on public datasets resembling planetary environments and in a simulator built on NASA JPL's Open Source Rover. We then validate SKiD-SLAM through field deployments in South Korea: a team of wheeled rovers explores the Majang lava-tube cave on Jeju Island, and quadruped robots carry out a crater-and-rock science scenario on a planetary analog terrain at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) in Yeoncheon. Across both deployments, SKiD-SLAM reliably performed distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM within a 250 kbps inter-robot communication budget, demonstrating its feasibility under challenging field conditions. Supplementary materials, including code and field data, are available at https://sparolab.github.io/research/skid_slam/.

</details>


### [125] [Minimum-Time Escape from the Conic Field of View of a Reeds--Shepp Pursuer: the Faster Evader](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38125v1)
*Ubaldo Ruiz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究全向逃逸者从Reeds–Shepp追捕者前向锥形视野中最小时间逃逸的问题，对快于追捕者的所有速比ν>1与半角0<α<π/2完整求解该博弈，给出逃逸时间的显式刻画及其作为博弈值（非预期策略下）的证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作只处理了较慢逃逸者的情形，速度比ν>1（逃逸者更快）且一般半角α下的追逃博弈尚未被完全求解；同时需要严格的博弈值证明与显式可计算的逃逸时间公式。

Method: 采用微分博弈与最优控制方法：通过由特征线刻画逃逸时间，将其表示为标量方程根的选取问题；分析可用部分边界出发的特征线（半径为ν的圆渐开线，终止于尖点），并引入两个显式阈值以判断特征线是否在尖点前到达前轴、以及逃逸时间的跳变是否在尖点前结束；比较水平集（level-set）与半拉格朗日（semi-Lagrangian）数值格式与解析值。

Result: 得到了对每个ν>1、0<α<π/2的显式逃逸时间刻画，并证明其为非预期策略下的博弈值；刻画了逃逸线端点E上方逃逸者沿"支流"汇入的通用直线追击倒行的追捕者；边界特征线为圆渐开线并在尖点终止，两阈值决定其几何与跳变行为；当跳变延伸至尖点时，初级特征线在屏障附近发生折叠（fold back）；追捕者的最优策略为较慢情形的继电器策略。

Conclusion: 该博弈在全部ν>1、0<α<π/2范围内被完整且显式地求解，逃逸时间可由标量方程根的选取直接计算，且与水平集、半拉格朗日数值结果一致，验证了解析刻画与博弈值的正确性。

Abstract: We continue the study of minimum-time escape of an omnidirectional evader from the forward conic field of view of a Reeds--Shepp pursuer, now for a faster evader, and solve the game for every speed ratio $ν>1$ and every half-angle $0<α<π/2$: the escape time is characterized by explicit characteristics and the selection of roots of a scalar equation, and it is the value of the game in nonanticipative strategies at every state. Above the end $E$ of the evader's dispersal line on the front axis, the evader chases the reversing pursuer along a universal line fed by tributaries. The characteristic from the boundary of the usable part is an involute of a circle of radius $ν$ ending at a cusp, and two explicit thresholds decide whether it reaches the axis before the cusp and whether the jump of the escape time across it ends before the cusp or runs to it; in the latter case primaries fold back next to the barrier. The pursuer's optimal strategy is the relay of the slower case. The evader follows the tributaries and switches once to a primary, or commits in advance to a heading certified by the scalar equation of the primaries. Level-set and semi-Lagrangian computations are compared with the value.

</details>


### [126] [Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38104v1)
*Arshia Sangwan,Zhongyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出"位置动作 vs 速度动作"的标签不能确定机器人实际执行的内容，在执行链路（滤波、物理缩放、参考构造、反馈、时序、力矩上限）层面重新考察位置/速度接口的归因，发现仅改物理缩放即可使成功率变化0.645–1.000，即使精确匹配局部原始力矩增益仍残留差距，故接口比较必须报告执行通路与所匹配的物理量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习文献常把位置动作与速度动作当作两个互斥的"实验处理"，但动作标签本身并不决定机器人真正执行的运动。有界策略输出在影响运动前还要经过滤波、物理缩放、参考构造、反馈、时序与力矩限制等环节，这些被忽略的属性会混淆位置-速度接口的归因结论。作者希望在共享学习器与训练预算下厘清这些隐藏因素对结果差异的贡献。

Method: 在三个接触丰富的 Factory 任务（PegInsert、GearMesh、NutThread）上，每种条件独立训练10个策略，比较5种关节空间接口。第一步在同一种位置反馈律内仅改变执行接口，单独替换物理动作缩放，并测试移除指数滑动平均（EMA）的影响；第二步进行跨反馈律比较，选取使速度接口与位置接口局部原始力矩指令增益精确相等的速度缩放进行校准。

Result: 同反馈律内，仅改物理动作缩放即可使样本中位数评估成功率变化0.645–1.000（随任务不同）；移除EMA带来任务相关的变化。跨律校准后，GearMesh与NutThread的样本中位数提升，PegInsert无中位数变化；但PegInsert与GearMesh仍存在明显的样本中位数残差差距，NutThread的置信区间包含零。

Conclusion: 仅匹配局部原始力矩增益仍无法使反馈动态与保持动作动态对齐，因此不能据此宣称位置与速度接口的训练结果等价。动作接口比较应明确报告执行通路，并说明所匹配的物理量，否则归因不可靠。

Abstract: Robot-learning studies often compare position and velocity actions as though each label identified a single experimental treatment, yet the label alone does not determine what the robot executes. Before affecting robot motion, bounded policy output passes through filtering, physical scaling, reference construction, feedback, timing, and effort limits. We study how these omitted properties affect attribution under one shared learner and training budget. Across three contact-rich Factory tasks (PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread), we compare five joint-space interfaces, with ten independently trained policies per condition. We first remain within the same position-feedback law and vary the executed interface: substituting only the physical action scale as the directly modified component changes sample-median evaluation success by 0.645-1.000 across tasks, while removing an exponential moving average produces task-dependent changes. We then move to a cross-law comparison and choose a velocity scale that exactly matches the position interface's local raw-torque command gain. This calibration raises the sample median on GearMesh and NutThread, with no median change on PegInsert. Yet clear residual sample-median gaps remain on PegInsert and GearMesh, while the NutThread interval includes zero. Thus, even this explicit equality leaves feedback and held-action dynamics unmatched and does not establish position-velocity trained-outcome equivalence. Action-interface comparisons should therefore report the executed pathway and state the physical quantity they match.

</details>


### [127] [Efficacy of Monocular Depth Estimation in Lunar Environments](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38080v1)
*Michael W. Lanighan,Kenji Brameld,Seth Gee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究评估了多种先进单目深度估计方法在分布外月球环境中的泛化能力，基于NASA Ames POLAR立体数据集与Apollo 17表面影像构建模拟-现场验证流程，发现部分方法可成功泛化，生成高质量月表相对三维重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计虽在分布内地面场景中已实现高精度三维重建，但其在分布外（out-of-distribution）月球等非结构化环境中的有效性尚不明确，需要系统验证其泛化性能。

Method: 采用NASA Ames极地光学月球模拟重建（POLAR）立体数据集与Apollo 17表面影像，对多种主流单目深度估计方法进行评测；构建"模拟-现场"（analog-to-field）验证流程，利用真实物理模拟基准做定量评估，并借助历史现场数据做定性评估。

Result: 定量结果表明部分最先进技术能够泛化至分布外月球地形，产出高保真的相对三维重建；定性结果与历史现场影像一致，验证了重建的合理性。

Conclusion: 单目深度估计在分布外月球环境下具备可行的泛化潜力，所提模拟-现场验证流程可用于此类极端环境的系统性评测，但当前方法主要局限于相对深度重建，绝对尺度恢复仍待解决。

Abstract: Recent advances in monocular depth estimation have demonstrated highly accurate 3D reconstructions within in-distribution terrestrial domains. This study investigates the efficacy of several state-of-the-art approaches to reconstruct out-of-distribution lunar environments using the NASA Ames Polar Optical Lunar Analog Reconstruction (POLAR) stereo dataset and Apollo 17 surface imagery. By leveraging these datasets, we establish a robust analog-to-field validation pipeline that evaluates quantitative performance against ground-truth physical analogs and qualitative performance against historical field data. Our results indicate that select state-of-the-art techniques can successfully generalize to produce high-fidelity relative 3D reconstructions of the unstructured lunar surface.

</details>


### [128] [EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38040v1)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 EARS-Info：在事件驱动的蚁群重分配搜索（EARS）基础上引入信息感知扩展，用于 OpenStreetMap 栅格地图上的多机器人探索；在 30 种实现、8 个城市、168,000 个回合的对比中，平均运行得分最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人探索需要在通信不稳定、能量受限的条件下平衡感知收益、可行重定位与返航安全，现有 EARS 变体缺乏统一的信息价值度量与资源保留机制。

Method: EARS-Info 融合五项机制：边际感知增益、可行重定位、返航感知路由、感知预留（sensing reservations）与最短路径缓存；在 OSM 派生栅格上与 EARS-Safe 等实现进行大规模对照实验（168,000 回合、30 种实现、8 个城市）。

Result: 8 机器人、3% 通信丢包下，得分较 EARS-Safe 提升 5.43%，加权发现率由 88.88% 升至 98.46%，平均能耗降低 2.62%；8 城市得分差均为正（p=0.0078125，城市自助法 95% 区间 [0.0159, 0.0694]）；5,600 个 EARS-Info 回合无模拟事故。

Conclusion: 结果支持整体控制器的有效性，但各单项组件的独立贡献仍不确定；泛化性受限于地理复用、单一训练重复、粗糙地图及改编后的对比方法。

Abstract: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. These results support the complete controller; individual component advantages remain uncertain. Generalization is limited by reused geography, one training replicate, coarse maps, and adapted comparison methods.

</details>


### [129] [METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38027v1)
*Chen Tessler,Yifeng Jiang,Alec Otto,Yi Shi,Umar Iqbal,Gal Chechik,Xue Bin Peng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Metatron 是一个"可提示"的全身执行层：冻结的生成式基础策略接收由定时身体部位目标、速度指令和风格线索组合而成的 prompt，输出多样化全身运动；任务意图由普通代码编写的有状态 skill 在每个控制步下发给该策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人控制器通常需要针对每个任务单独训练，尽管这些任务共享平衡与全身协调这一核心能力；作者希望把"运动能力"与"任务逻辑"解耦，避免每个新任务都重训策略。

Method: 1) 基础策略：输入"部分目标"即 prompt（可组合定时的身体部位目标、速度指令、风格线索），输出与目标一致的多样化全身运动；训练数据混合动捕、合成恢复轨迹、重定向后的场景交互运动；训练完成后策略冻结。2) 技能层：用普通有状态程序（skill）在每个控制步以 prompt 表达任务意图，相当于绘制粗略几何草图，由策略转化为协调运动。3) 技能由编码智能体基于运动数据分析拟合并固化紧凑规则来精炼，无需任务特定策略训练。

Result: 在实体 Unitree G1 上，单一冻结 checkpoint 支持行走、恢复、遥操作物体抓取、坐家具；对比评估中在到达成功率与抗推扰鲁棒性上优于测试的参考轨迹跟踪流水线；同一套方法在仿真角色上还产出了攀爬与杂技动作。

Conclusion: 将运动能力沉淀为一个冻结的可提示基础策略、把任务意图下放到代码层，可使编码智能体在不做额外策略训练的情况下，把已学到的运动能力转化为新技能，为通用人形全身控制提供可编程的执行层。

Abstract: Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, one frozen checkpoint supports walking, recovery, teleoperated object pickup, and sitting on furniture. Comparative evaluations show higher reaching success and push robustness than the tested reference-tracking pipelines. The same recipe produces climbing and acrobatics on a simulated character. Metatron enables coding agents to turn learned motor capabilities into new skills through code, without further policy training.

</details>


### [130] [Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38000v1)
*Kaiwen Hong,Shaoting Peng,Xiangyu Zeng,Pengcheng Wang,Boyuan Tian,Haonan Chen,Yifan Zhu,Yixiao Wang,Katherine Driggs-Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT)，利用在源任务上训练并冻结的偏好识别器为目标任务无标注示范自动打偏好标签，从而在无额外人工偏好的情况下把执行偏好控制迁移到新任务，并保持任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略可通过带偏好标注的示范学习执行偏好（如抓取位置、绕障方式），但为每个新任务提供偏好标注成本高昂。作者希望探究：在目标任务的示范包含所需行为、却缺乏偏好标注时，已学到的偏好控制能否迁移到新任务。实验发现：带偏好标注训练的策略在新任务上能遵循偏好但成功率有限；而在无标注目标示范上微调虽提升成功率，却削弱偏好控制。

Method: SPT采用共享视觉-语言主干，在带标注的源示范上联合训练两个目标：偏好条件动作预测与偏好识别。随后冻结偏好识别器以保留其跨任务偏好识别能力，并用它为目标示范自标注偏好，再用于策略微调。同时扩展到多偏好场景。

Result: 仿真中五类执行偏好下识别器准确率达96.4%；SPT取得84.8%偏好遵循率与89.2%任务成功率，而朴素微调为59.4%与88.0%。多偏好设置下SPT偏好遵循率93.8%，基线为42.5%。真实世界两个任务迁移中，SPT相对朴素微调将偏好遵循率由52.5%提升至92.5%。

Conclusion: SPT能在无需额外人工偏好标注的前提下，实现跨任务、跨物体的偏好适配，并在维持任务成功率的同时显著提升偏好遵循能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can learn to follow execution preferences, such as where to grasp an object or how to move around an obstacle, from demonstrations annotated with preference labels. Providing these annotations for every new task, however, is costly. We study whether learned preference control can transfer to new tasks whose demonstrations contain the desired behaviors but lack preference annotations. We find that a policy trained with preference annotations can follow preferences on a new task before adaptation but achieves limited task success. Fine-tuning on target demonstrations without these annotations improves task success while weakening preference control. Motivated by this finding, we introduce Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT). SPT jointly trains a shared vision-language backbone for preference-conditioned action prediction and preference recognition on annotated source demonstrations. It then freezes the recognizer to preserve its cross-task preference recognition capability and uses it to self-label target demonstrations for policy fine-tuning. Across five types of execution preferences in simulation, the recognizer achieves 96.4% accuracy, and SPT reaches 84.8% preference following and 89.2% task success, compared with 59.4% and 88.0% for naive finetuning. We further extend to multiple preferences, achieving 93.8% preference following compared with 42.5% of baselines. In real-world experiments, SPT increases preference following from 52.5% to 92.5% relative to naive finetuning across two task transfers. These results show that SPT can support preference adaptation across tasks and objects while maintaining success, without additional manual preference annotations.

</details>


### [131] [Active Constraints for Simultaneous Guidance and Safety in Handheld Micromanipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37981v1)
*Roger Ho,Robert A. MacLachlan,Cameron N. Riviere*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向手持式微操作机器人的优化型主动约束框架，可同时实现任务引导与安全约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手持机器人在显微手术等关键应用中可突破人手精度极限，但现有主动约束形式无法同时提供引导与安全保障；而基于优化的实现方案仅针对独立式机器人设计，忽略了手持机器人相对操作者手部驱动、工作空间受限的特性。

Method: 构建基于优化的主动约束框架，将任务相关需求与安全要求统一为约束优化问题，适配手持机器人相对手部驱动、工作空间有限的运动特性，并在手持机器人平台上实现，通过一项医学相关的人工任务进行验证。

Result: 相比基线方法，所提框架将安全违规率降低两个数量级以上，同时弥补了仅施加安全约束所导致的三倍精度损失。

Conclusion: 优化型主动约束可同时兼顾引导与安全，适用于手持式微操作，验证结果表明其在安全性与操作精度上均显著优于现有方案。

Abstract: In micromanipulation, erroneous hand motion limits unaided manipulation accuracy, which can affect task performance and safety in critical applications like microsurgery. Handheld robots (micromanipulators) enable motion accuracy beyond human limits by providing robotic assistance in a low-cost, compact, intuitive form factor. Particularly, active constraints are an effective form of robotic assistance, which aids the operator by restricting the robot's permissible motion based on task-specific requirements or objectives, thereby providing task guidance and enforcing safety. However, existing formulations of active constraints for handheld systems are limited, most notably because of the inability to provide guidance and enforce safety simultaneously. Implementing active constraints with optimization-based methods can address these limitations, but existing implementations are designed for free-standing robots, and neglect that handheld robots actuate relative to the operator's hand with a limited workspace. In this work, we propose an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulation that enables simultaneous guidance and safety enforcement. The formulation was implemented in a handheld robot and demonstrated on a medically relevant artificial task. Results show that the proposed formulation reduced safety violation rate by more than two orders of magnitude relative to baselines, while recovering the threefold accuracy loss from enforcing safety alone.

</details>


### [132] [FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37974v1)
*Adrian B. Ghansah,Yujin An,Jeeseop Kim,Soon-Jo Chung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段学习框架，将在线降阶模型（ROM）参考生成与全身跟踪控制相结合，实现多功能、敏捷的人形机器人运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人需在宽广指令空间内实现多种运动策略（如高速行走、侧移、旋转、单腿跳跃与连续切换），而直接在全身动力学上学习难以兼顾运动学与动力学一致性及泛化性，因此需要借助简化降阶模型空间来生成一致的参考轨迹。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用单刚体动力学结合完整人形运动学，训练指令条件化的全身参考生成器；第二阶段冻结该ROM策略并在线展开，为全阶动力学模型上的全身跟踪策略生成参考。ROM空间中学习动力学一致的参考生成器，使单一统一框架可覆盖广泛指令空间与多种运动策略。

Result: 在Unitree G1人形机器人上验证：纵向速度-2.0至2.8 m/s、横向速度可达±1.0 m/s、角速度可达±3.0 rad/s，并实现单腿跳跃及指令间的连续平滑切换，且仅用单一参考策略与单一全身跟踪策略。

Conclusion: 将运动学一致的参考生成置于降阶模型空间、再以全身跟踪策略落地全阶动力学，可统一实现宽广指令范围内的多样敏捷运动，验证了ROM参考生成与全身跟踪解耦耦合训练的有效性。

Abstract: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.

</details>


### [133] [3D Occupancy-Language Fields from mmWave Radar](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37929v1)
*Haowen Lai,Zhiwei Zheng,Mingmin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TextRadar 从全景雷达观测构建场景级 3D 占据-语言场，实现仅用雷达即可对新场景进行开放式自然语言查询与免提示语义可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雷达系统虽能恢复场景几何并识别预定义类别，但其输出缺乏持久化的空间表示，无法支撑开放式语言查询；而此类查询需要把不同视角的观测关联到同一物理位置。

Method: 构建结合占据信息与表面位置处尺度相关语言特征的场景级 3D 占据-语言场；训练单帧雷达蒸馏模型从每次雷达观测预测对齐的距离与语言特征；利用雷达估计位姿配准这些预测，从而仅依靠雷达在新场景中重建该场。

Result: 在七栋建筑约 2 万次同步观测上进行实验，实现了场景级自然语言查询与免提示语义可视化；相机到雷达的概念可迁移性分析显示，结构、材质与人体姿态的一致性高于颜色和印刷文字。

Conclusion: 雷达观测可独立支撑持久化的开放词汇 3D 语义场重建，但其语义迁移在颜色与文字类概念上仍存在明显局限。

Abstract: Radar systems can recover scene geometry and recognize predefined categories, but these outputs do not provide a persistent spatial representation for open-ended language queries. Such queries require linking observations from different viewpoints to the same physical locations. We present TextRadar, a framework that constructs a scene-level 3D occupancy-language field from panoramic radar observations. The field combines occupancy with scale-dependent language features at surface locations, allowing the reconstructed scene to be queried with new descriptions. A single-frame radar distillation model predicts aligned ranges and language features from each radar observation. Using radar-estimated poses, we register these predictions to reconstruct the field from radar alone in a new scene. Experiments on approximately 20k synchronized observations across seven buildings demonstrate scene-level natural-language querying and prompt-free semantic visualization. Analysis of camera-to-radar concept transferability shows stronger agreement for structures, materials, and human poses than for colors and printed text.

</details>


### [134] [What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37917v1)
*Ruben Hammele,Samira Huber,Mohammad Nazeri,Amirreza Payandeh,Alexandyr T. Card,Aaron Nguyen,Anuj Pokhrel,Daeun Song,Xuesu Xiao,Sören Pirk*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文在BEHAVIOR基准全部100个任务上，对已有的推理策略与数据采集策略进行了系统性的配对评估，发现这些策略并不能统一地迁移到新环境与新任务中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型被视为通用家庭机器人的有前景范式，但此前在较小规模场景中部署的推理与数据采集策略，未必能泛化到大规模、多样化的任务套件，因此需要系统检验其可迁移性。

Method: 采用配对（paired）实验设计，在全部100个任务上评估既有的推理策略与数据采集策略；评测模型为基于2025年BEHAVIOR Challenge冠军方案微调的π_{0.5}模型，其在公开测试集上取得0.39的Q-score。

Result: 所提出的各类策略在新环境与新任务上表现不一致，无法统一迁移；π_{0.5}微调模型在公开测试集上Q-score为0.39。

Conclusion: 小规模设定下的推理与数据采集经验不能直接外推至大规模多样化任务套件，需针对新环境与任务重新审视或调整策略；作者公开了项目主页、视频与详细分析。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026

</details>


### [135] [When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37891v1)
*Josef Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: A fixed 1,505-parameter action updater is evaluated against three planner baselines on PushT; it solves 8/16 scenes (worse than released LePlanner's 16) and fails the pre-registered task-cost criterion, while extra test-time updates reduce success without rescuing failures.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The paper compares a lightweight, trained action updater against planning-based baselines on the PushT manipulation benchmark, aiming to test whether a small learned updater can match planners under matched compute and pre-registered criteria.

Method: Evaluate a fixed action updater with 1,505 parameters on 16 scenes held out from configuration selection; baselines are a selected Adam, an adapted iCEM, and a released LePlanner. Report tasks solved and total planning + encoding time. A second matched experiment replays only the first ten commands per context and then grants 4, 8, or 12 updates to the subsequent solve (later solves always get 8).

Result: Updater solves 8/16 scenes in 59.079s; Selected Adam 7/16 in 218.440s; adapted iCEM 2/16 in 49.309s; released LePlanner 16/16 in 5.652s. The updater does not satisfy the pre-fixed task-cost criterion. With 4/8/12 update budgets (over 16 contexts, 8 scene clusters) successes are 9/8/7; extra updates rescue no failing task, all success/failure changes concentrate in one scene cluster where extra updates lower latent world-model trajectory costs yet turn prior successes into failures.

Conclusion: The parameter-efficient updater is competitive with selected Adam in success count but is far less effective and slower than the released LePlanner, and it violates the pre-registered cost criterion. More test-time updates are not monotone: lower planning cost does not imply task success, so the updater must be assessed honestly against pre-registered criteria. Code, weights, evaluators, traces, and cost accounting are released.

Abstract: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. The code, weights, evaluators, execution traces and cost accounting accompany the paper.

</details>


### [136] [Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37865v1)
*Gagan Khandate*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出单阶段离线策略（off-policy）视觉强化学习框架 Echo，通过"逆蒸馏"让基于状态的辅助策略模仿演化中的视觉策略并采集无需渲染的廉价经验，借助共享特权评论家直接改进视觉策略，从而在不按比例增加视觉计算的前提下扩展经验收集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU 加速仿真中的视觉强化学习因渲染与视觉策略推理代价高昂而计算昂贵；常用两阶段教师—学生蒸馏虽能训练视觉策略，但引入模仿间隙（imitation gap）。作者希望在扩展经验采集规模的同时避免视觉计算线性增长，并消除两阶段蒸馏带来的间隙。

Method: 提出 Echo：单阶段 off-policy 框架。核心机制为逆蒸馏——用一个基于状态的辅助策略模仿不断演化的视觉策略，并采集无渲染开销的经验；Echo 利用这些经验进行 off-policy 价值学习，通过共享的特权评论家（privileged critic）直接改进视觉策略。实例化版本基于 FastTD3，在 Genesis 仿真器上的三个视觉控制任务与两个灵巧手操作任务上评估，对照 SDPG 方法。

Result: 在评估配置下，相较于 SDPG：三个运动任务达到参考回报所需时间平均减少 60%，两个手部任务减少 56%；峰值平均回报分别提升 62% 与 12%；两个手部任务在相同模拟器交互步数预算下也取得更高的平均回报。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明，扩展 off-policy 经验规模是高效直接视觉强化学习的一条有前景的路径。该工作为初步研究（preliminary study），主要验证单阶段框架相对两阶段蒸馏的加速与回报优势。

Abstract: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated configurations, Echo reduces time to reference returns by an average of \textbf{60\% across the three locomotion tasks} and \textbf{56\% across both hand tasks}, while improving peak mean returns by \textbf{62\% and 12\%}, respectively. Both hand tasks also achieve higher mean returns at matched simulator-transition budgets. These initial results suggest that scaling off-policy experience is a promising approach to efficient direct visual RL.

</details>


### [137] [TACOS: Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision for Visual Footstep Planning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37806v1)
*Jean-Michel Fortin,William Larrivée-Hardy,Gabriel Jeanson,Olivier Gamache,Daniele De Martini,François Pomerleau,Philippe Giguère*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TACOS，基于腿部状态估计中因子图残差构造足步失稳评分，投影到前序图像上自监督训练稠密视觉预测器，在失稳检测、严重度排序及户外视觉预测精度上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 足式机器人需要类似人类视觉系统的前瞻能力，在落步前预判地面响应。自监督学习具备这一潜力，但监督信号多凭直觉选取，其对模型所学内容的影响鲜有系统检验。

Method: 提出TACOS（Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision）：以腿部状态估计中因子图残差的残差量构造具有一致意义的足步失稳评分，并将该连续评分投影到前序图像上，用于监督稠密视觉预测器。给出两个变体：利用事后信息的硬评分，以及可即时获取的因果软评分。

Result: 在两套无数据与标签重叠的独立评测中，与最先进替代方案比较：在1716个手工标注接触上，两变体在失稳检测与严重度排序上均优于所有对照，合并严重度排序指标提升28%；在三次户外测试中训练出最准确的视觉预测器，秩相关提升58%，加入机载上下文后进一步提升25%。

Conclusion: 在50 m森林轨迹的真实实验中，训练所得的预测器能够处理泥泞、植被等非几何地形属性，同时绕开倒木等几何障碍。监督信号的设计对学习效果具有实质影响，代码已开源。

Abstract: Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Self-supervised learning could provide legged robots the same ability, but the supervisory signal is typically chosen on intuition, and its effect on what the model learns is rarely examined. We present Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision (TACOS), which proposes a meaningful and consistent footstep instability score, based on the residual of a factor graph in legged state estimation. It projects the continuous score into preceding images to supervise a dense visual predictor. We propose two variants, a hard score that exploits hindsight and a causal soft score available immediately. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. In a real-world experiment over a 50 m forest trajectory, the trained predictor handles non-geometric terrain properties such as mud and vegetation, while stepping around geometric obstacles like fallen branches. Code is available for reproducibility at https://github.com/norlab-ulaval/TACOS.

</details>


### [138] [An Empirical Study of Wrist-Target Construction and Joint-Angle Limits in Humanoid Arm Retargeting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37801v1)
*MinJun Chang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究比较两种期望腕部位置构建方式（重构目标 vs. 可达域归一化目标）对Unitree H1-2机械臂关节角度触限的影响，发现目标构建与姿态匹配应视为独立的retargeting决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动重定向把人类演示动作映射到机器人关节运动，但期望腕部位置的构建方式可能隐式决定关节是否触及限位，而现有研究常将目标构建与姿态匹配偏好混为一谈。

Method: 基于演示臂方向与机器人连杆长度构建"重构目标"，其肩—腕距离随演示中两段夹角变化；另构建"可达域归一化目标"，保持方向不变而重新缩放距离。两者使用相同处理后的演示数据与相同关节角求解方法，并在前伸扫掠、单被试25段记录、第二被试搬砖与提举对比以及硬件回放实验中进行比较，同时考察跨体伸展与臂间间隙。

Result: 前伸扫掠中，重构目标20次重复有10次使某关节角触及限位，归一化目标为0次；25段记录中，够取臂触限次数为8 vs 6，支撑臂为14 vs 5。硬件回放中，方向匹配记录16条有12条命令关节至限位，归一化记录16条为0；且合格记录内，触限帧的跟踪误差与执行扭矩均高于同次运行其他帧。

Conclusion: 目标构建方式本身会显著影响关节限位可达性，应将其与姿态匹配作为相互独立的retargeting决策分别处理，并与操作所需的腕部位置和臂间间隙一同评估；径向调整存在局限，跨体伸展与臂间间隙可揭示其边界。

Abstract: Motion retargeting maps a demonstrated human movement onto a robot to compute its joint motion. This study examines how the construction of the desired wrist position affects whether computed arm joint angles reach their permitted limits on a Unitree H1-2. A reconstructed target is formed from demonstrated arm directions and robot segment lengths, so its shoulder-to-wrist distance depends on the demonstrated angle between the segments even when no posture-matching preference is applied. A reach-normalized target retains that direction while rescaling the distance, using the same processed demonstrations and the same joint-angle method. Across a forward-reach sweep the reconstructed target places a joint angle at a bound in 10 of 20 repetitions and the reach-normalized target in none. Across 25 recordings from one participant the corresponding counts are 8 and 6 on the reaching arm and 14 and 5 on the supporting arm, and a second participant repeats the bricklaying and lifting comparison. In hardware replay a joint is commanded to a bound in 12 of 16 direction-matching arm-records and in none of the 16 normalized records, and within the eligible records both tracking error and executed torque at those frames exceed their values elsewhere in the same run. Cross-body reach and arm-to-arm clearance identify limits of radial adjustment. The findings support treating target construction and posture matching as separate retargeting decisions, and evaluating both alongside the wrist positions and clearance that manipulation requires.

</details>


### [139] [DexSuite: An All-in-One Framework for Dexterous Manipulation Across Arms, Hands, and Tasks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37799v1)
*Anas Houssaini,Hugo He,Junming Shi,Amin Abyaneh,Ricardo Chahine,Shuo Wen,Mohamad H. Danesh,Charles-Étienne Fréchette,Mariana Sosa Guzman,Mathias Desrochers,Rayan Houssaini,Adam Landa,Theophile Soulie,Charlotte Morissette,Annie Tims,Martino Russi,Jonathan Lussier,Gregory Dudek,Doina Precup,Julen Urain,Hsiu-Chin Lin,David Meger*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexSuite 是一个基于 Genesis 仿真器的全流程灵巧操作仿真框架，提供30个任务、100+单臂机器人、上千种双臂组合、标准化环境 API、遥操作与触觉仿真，并发布16个任务-本体对基准和4,700条成功演示数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人领域的人类级灵巧性仍是核心开放问题，而现有仿真框架很少覆盖灵巧操作的完整流程（从机器人配置、示教数据采集到策略评估）。

Method: 基于 Genesis 仿真器构建一体化框架：组合10种机械臂与12种末端执行器（从平行夹爪到灵巧手），形成100+单臂机器人与数千种双臂配对；提供标准化环境 API、集成遥操作与仿真触觉传感；定义覆盖不同接触复杂度与时域的16个任务-本体对基准；并通过人类遥操作、脚本化专家和学得策略采集4,700条成功仿真演示。

Result: 发布包含30个任务的框架、16个任务-本体对基准，以及4,700条成功episode的演示数据集，代码开源，视频与数据集公开于项目主页。

Conclusion: DexSuite 作为开源全流程仿真工具，为灵巧操作的机器人搭建、数据采集与策略评测提供统一平台，期望推动后续研究与社区共建。

Abstract: Human-level dexterity remains a central open problem in robotics, yet few simulation frameworks cover the full workflow of dexterous manipulation, from setting up a robot to collecting dexterous demonstrations and evaluating policies. We present DexSuite, an all-in-one simulation framework for dexterous manipulation built on the Genesis simulator. DexSuite provides 30 tasks and assembles its 10 arms and 12 end-effectors, from parallel-jaw grippers to dexterous hands, into more than 100 single-arm robots and thousands of bimanual pairs. It also ships a standardized environment API, integrated teleoperation, and simulated tactile sensing. Moreover, we define a benchmark of 16 task-embodiment pairs spanning diverse contact complexities and horizons, and release a dataset of 4,700 successful episodes in simulation from human teleoperation, scripted experts, and learned policies. We release DexSuite as open source and hope others will build on it. Videos and datasets are available at https://dexsuiteorg.github.io

</details>


### [140] [ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37666v1)
*Chaehyun Kim,Chi-Pin Huang,Jisoo Kim,Min-Hung Chen,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Seungryong Kim,Fu-En Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ThinkWorld proposes a VLA framework that represents actions as "Chain-of-Dynamics" (CoD) motion tokens grounded in world dynamics, and uses reinforcement learning with world imagination to learn from unlabeled human videos.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA models generalize poorly due to limited diversity/coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations; human videos are broader but lack explicit action grounding, creating a trade-off between scalable data and action supervision.

Method: Represent each action thought as a CoD, a discrete motion-token sequence capturing intermediate dynamics from current to future state and serving as a cross-embodiment action representation. Initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, predict the future induced by each CoD, and reinforce CoDs whose predictions better match observed outcomes (RL with world imagination), enabling unlabeled videos to supervise via state transitions.

Result: Simulation and real-robot experiments show effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

Conclusion: Grounding action reasoning in world dynamics plus prediction-consistency reinforcement unifies human and robot experience in a shared reasoning space, improving transfer and generalization.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

</details>


### [141] [Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37652v1)
*Ian Chuang,Hiya Shah,Vamsi Chilamkur,Iman Soltani,Claire Tomlin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一套无需人类数据的仿真训练配方，实现LEAP多指灵巧手的手内物体位姿到达策略，并零样本迁移到真实手；叠加可调保守度的残差安全滤波器，在13.3小时评测中达到95.2%目标精度、掉物率降低75%，可用于拧灯泡等便携技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多指灵巧手是机器人学的前沿，但已学到的技能多限于简单抓取或重复旋转；随着手内操作难度上升，安全性（如不掉落物体）变得关键却很少被度量。因此需要一个同时考察高难度手内位姿到达、性能与安全性的研究平台。

Method: 任务定义为手内物体位姿到达：在任意腕部朝向下将物体移动至手指可达范围内的几乎任意位置与姿态，并完成长序列连续目标。训练配方包含：无需人类数据的仿真训练、基于生成式抓取数据集的多样化初始状态与目标、自适应摩擦课程、精细系统辨识以实现零样本真机迁移（使用动捕或单一腕部深度相机）；在任务策略之上叠加带可调保守度的学习式残差安全滤波器。

Result: 在4个物体、多样腕部朝向、4800个未见目标、13.3小时真机评测中，基于状态的策略95.2%的目标在2 cm与0.4 rad以内；安全滤波器将其掉物率降低75%，同时仍达成91.5%目标。策略还能以任意姿态旋转灯泡、泛化到分布外目标、承受快速手臂运动与扰动，仅凭腕部相机即可完成拧灯泡等便携技能。

Conclusion: 工作给出了面向高维灵巧系统研究性能、可靠性与安全性的完整开源训练配方与平台，展示了无需人类数据即可获得可迁移、鲁棒且可调安全性的手内操作策略。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.

</details>


### [142] [RESPLE2: Inertial-Informed Recursive Non-Uniform Spline Estimation for Multi-Sensor Odometry with Global Refinement](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37602v1)
*Ziyu Cao,William Talbot,Song Li,Pakpong Chirarattananon,Fredrik Gustafsson,Marco Hutter,Kailai Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RESPLE2：基于非均匀B样条与迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波的递归多传感器状态估计框架，并配套轻量全局优化模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续时间多传感器里程计在处理高动态、极端加速度机动时精度与鲁棒性不足，且难以在原生时间戳上融合异构传感器、并保持实时性。

Method: 用非均匀B样条表示6-DoF运动；利用节点钳制边界性质，由惯性运动学推导控制点的精确预测机制，节点布置随运动与量测可用性自适应；在迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波中，用部分惯性量测执行该预测，并通过重置步骤在节点扩展时保持轨迹一致性；更新步以连续时间观测模型在原生时间戳融合LiDAR、相机、IMU与腿部运动学；另设轻量全局优化模块，直接优化非均匀B样条控制点并引入LiDAR-视觉回环约束。

Result: 在手持、履带、足式及空地混合平台的公开与自采数据集上（含高动态极端加速度场景）评估，在对应传感器配置下精度与鲁棒性达到或优于SOTA多传感器里程计，强机动下优势尤为明显，并保持实时运行；代码与数据集已开源。

Conclusion: 将非均匀B样条连续时间表示、惯性驱动的控制点预测与紧耦合滤波相结合，可有效提升多传感配置下的高动态状态估计性能，并支持灵活扩展与回环优化。

Abstract: We present RESPLE2, a recursive multi-sensor state estimation framework using non-uniform B-splines for 6-DoF motion representation. By exploiting the knot-clamping boundary property, we propose a theoretically grounded mechanism for exact control-point prediction directly informed by inertial kinematics along the trajectory, with knot placement adapted to motion and measurement availability. Within an iterated extended Kalman filter, we perform this prediction using a subset of inertial measurements. A subsequent reset step preserves trajectory consistency as the knots extend. The update step further incorporates heterogeneous sensor measurements at their native timestamps through continuous-time observation models, supporting flexible combinations of LiDARs, cameras, inertial measurement units, and leg kinematics. We further develop a lightweight global optimization module that directly refines non-uniform B-spline control points by incorporating loop-closure constraints derived from LiDAR-visual cues. We conduct extensive evaluations on public and experimental datasets across handheld, tracked, legged, and hybrid aerial-legged platforms, covering highly dynamic maneuvers with extreme accelerations. Compared with state-of-the-art multi-sensor odometry systems, RESPLE2 achieves competitive or superior estimation accuracy and robustness in the corresponding sensor configurations, particularly under aggressive motion, while maintaining real-time operation. We publicly release our code and experimental datasets at https://github.com/ASIG-X/RESPLE2.

</details>


### [143] [EgoThumb: A Vision-Driven Supernumerary Robotic Thumb for Autonomous Grasp and Holding Assistance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37582v1)
*Jianyu Hou,Jiawei Fu,Weikang Wan,Minghui Jiang,Jiajun Li,Hao Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出开源、视觉驱动的超数机器人拇指EgoThumb，用前臂驱动双腱驱动灵巧指+掌心相机视觉模仿学习策略，实现自主"持握-操作"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超数机器人手指硬件笨重、仅能操作大物体，且依赖显式手部动作触发、缺乏环境上下文信息。

Method: 紧凑双腱驱动手指，将驱动移至前臂以减轻末端重量并实现关节主动精确控制；采用掌心朝向相机采集第一视角图像，训练视觉模仿学习策略，将自我中心图像直接映射为连续关节位置，隐式解码包含手部与目标物体视觉线索的人体意图。

Result: 实现稳健的自主操作能力，并在不同用户与环境间表现出强泛化性；硬件设计与软件实现全部开源。

Conclusion: EgoThumb以轻量化硬件与视觉端到端策略替代显式触发，证明超数机器人手指可自主、跨用户跨环境地完成协同操作，并推动开源复现。

Abstract: Supernumerary robotic fingers augment human dexterity by enabling a single hand to perform complex "hold-and-manipulate" tasks that typically require bimanual coordination. However, existing devices are often hindered by bulky hardware that limits interaction to large objects and rely on explicit hand motion triggers that lack environmental context. To address these challenges, we present EgoThumb, a fully open-source, vision-driven supernumerary robotic thumb. EgoThumb features a compact, dual tendon-driven finger whose actuation is relocated to the forearm, reducing distal weight while enabling precise active joint control. The system utilizes a visual imitation learning policy that maps egocentric images from a palm-facing camera directly to continuous joint positions. By implicitly decoding human intent from visual cues capturing both the hand and the object of interest, EgoThumb achieves robust autonomous manipulation and strong generalization across diverse users and environments. All hardware designs and software implementations are fully open-sourced at https://ego-thumb.github.io.

</details>


### [144] [Learning Visuomotor Quadrotor Flight Through Dynamic Narrow Gaps via Differentiable Simulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37557v1)
*Riccardo Bianco,Yunfan Ren,Jiaxu Xing,Davide Scaramuzza*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微的"移动窄缝"建模方法，将穿越窄缝这一稀疏事件转化为稠密路径目标，配合单阶段、无教师/规划器/蒸馏的视觉-惯性到指令策略训练，实现四旋翼直接穿越移动窄缝：仿真几分钟训练即达99.3%成功率，实机10次试验成功率80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 穿越移动窄缝是敏捷飞行的严苛测试，需要厘米级空间对齐与精确时间执行，成功解位于极薄可行流形上，时序、位置、姿态或视觉可观性上的小误差即导致碰撞。已有规划与学习方法依赖特权状态、教师、规划器或蒸馏，直接从零学习动态窄缝穿越仍是开放问题。

Method: 引入可微的移动窄缝形式化：以到随时间变化的缝隙平面的有符号距离对居中项、对齐项与平滑碰撞项进行门控，把稀疏穿越事件转化为稠密路径目标；将该目标集成到视觉特征到指令（集体推力与机体角速度）的策略中，单阶段从随机初始化训练，无需教师、规划器或蒸馏，直接使用机载视觉与惯性测量。

Result: 在受控基准中，路径梯度显著优于得分函数梯度（precision-critical任务），单GPU仅数分钟训练即在仿真中达到99.3%成功率；策略可直接迁移到真实四旋翼，在多样化初始条件下仅凭机载传感与惯性测量穿越动态窄缝，10次物理试验成功率80%。

Conclusion: 表明通过可微门控将稀疏穿越事件稠密化，可在无特权信息、无教师与规划器的条件下直接学习高精度动态窄缝穿越策略，并实现从仿真到实机的直接迁移。

Abstract: Threading a quadrotor through a moving narrow gap is a demanding test of agile flight, requiring centimeter-level spatial alignment and precise temporal execution. We address this challenge using a control policy that operates directly on onboard visual and inertial measurements to output collective thrust and body-rate commands. The task is difficult because success lies on a thin feasible manifold: small errors in timing, position, attitude, or visual observability cause collision. Prior planning and learning methods rely on privileged state, teachers, planners, or distillation; learning dynamic narrow-gap traversal directly, from scratch, remains open. We introduce a differentiable moving-gap formulation that gates centering, alignment, and smooth collision terms by signed distance to a time-varying gap plane, turning a sparse traversal event into a dense pathwise objective. We integrate this formulation into a visual-feature-to-command policy trained in one stage from random initialization, without a teacher, planner, or distillation. We validate our approach in both synthetic and real-world experiments. In controlled benchmarks, we demonstrate that pathwise gradients significantly outperform score-function gradients for precision-critical tasks, yielding a 99.3% success rate in simulation after only a few minutes of training on a single GPU. Furthermore, the policy transfers directly to a real quadrotor, successfully crossing a dynamic narrow gap from varied initial conditions using onboard sensing and inertial measurements, achieving an 80% success rate over 10 physical trials.

</details>


### [145] [Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37550v1)
*Baptiste Bonin,Caro Strickland,Audrey Durand*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS)，将指令末端执行器旋量投影到物体关节轴上，把沿关节方向的有效进展与违反约束的无效消耗分离，用于细粒度评估操作策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有操作策略评估主要依赖二值任务成功率，无法判断指令手势是否是物体运动学所允许的那一个，也无法解释失败源于何处。

Method: CRS 需要关节模型及由该模型导出的关节跟随脚本控制器，无需演示数据或学习型判别器；通过将指令 twist 投影到关节轴，得到"沿关节进展"与"偏离约束浪费"两条通道。

Result: 在 74 个仿真铰接物体上，成功率仅以较低速率记录三种迁移失败而不能归因，两条 CRS 通道则给出各自独立的失败特征；门训练的行为克隆策略在 110 个抽屉回合中成功 59 次，其通过回合的离轴旋转约为抽屉训练策略的 40 倍（1.27 vs. 0.032 rad/s）。相对同一轴评分的脚本控制器，CRS 判定在关节轴误差 30° 内不变，绝对阈值约可容忍 8°。

Conclusion: CRS 提供了可归因、对关节轴误差鲁棒的策略评估方式，弥补成功率指标的不足。

Abstract: Manipulation policies are evaluated predominantly by binary task success, which cannot tell whether the commanded gesture is the one the object's kinematics admit. We introduce Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects the commanded end-effector twist onto the object's joint axis, separating progress along the joint from off-constraint waste. CRS requires a joint model and a joint-following scripted controller derived from it, but no recorded demonstration or learned judge. On 74 simulated articulated objects, success registers three transfer failures as lower rates but attributes none, while the two CRS channels give each a distinct signature. A door-trained behavior-cloning policy opens drawers in 59 of 110 episodes, and in these passes it commands about $40\times$ the off-axis rotation of a drawer-trained policy's passes ($1.27$ vs.\ $0.032$~rad/s). Relative to a scripted controller scored with the same axis, CRS verdicts are unchanged under joint-axis errors up to $30^\circ$; absolute thresholds tolerate about $8^\circ$.

</details>


### [146] [When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37547v1)
*Anukriti Singh,Maxime Caniot,Pratap Tokekar,Firas Abi-Farraj*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出自适应残差修正（ARC）模块：在冻结策略之上用RL学习残差修正，并以稀疏人类修正界定"何时生效"与"在残差空间何处探索"，在真实机器人三个精密操作任务上将成功率从33.3%提升至75.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿策略能完成大部分轨迹，但在需要"最后一公里"精度的局部区域容易失败。全量更新策略或在所有位置探索残差动作，会把局部失败当成全局学习问题，代价高、效率低。

Method: ARC是轻量后训练模块：底层策略冻结，用强化学习学习残差修正；人类修正不作为模仿目标，而是用干预前状态决定残差控制"何时"激活，用修正几何结构决定在残差动作空间"何处"进行自主精细探索，最终由任务奖励决定"执行何种"残差。由此人类修正定义了七关节残差空间中任务相关的2–3维子空间（保留96.0–97.7%的修正平方幅值）。

Result: 真实机器人上三个精密操作任务平均成功率由33.3%升至75.0%；稀疏修正所确定的低维子空间保留了绝大部分修正量级。

Conclusion: 稀疏人类修正可用于定位并约束自主后训练，而无需把修正本身当作最终动作目标，从而实现高效、局部的残差式策略改进。

Abstract: Imitation policies that reliably execute most of a manipulation trajectory can still fail in localized regions requiring last-mile precision. Updating the full policy or exploring residual actions everywhere treats this local failure as a global learning problem. We introduce Adaptive Residual Correction (ARC), a lightweight post-training module that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn a residual correction on top of a frozen policy while using sparse human corrections to structure autonomous exploration. Rather than treating human corrections as imitation targets, ARC uses pre-intervention states to determine 'when' residual control should become active and correction geometry to determine 'where' in residual action space autonomous refinement should explore; task reward determines 'what' residual is ultimately executed. Across three precision-manipulation tasks on a real robot, ARC improves average task success from 33.3% to 75.0%. The human corrections define task-dependent 2-3 dimensional subspaces of the seven-joint residual space that retain 96.0-97.7% of squared correction magnitude. Together, these results show that sparse human corrections can localize and constrain autonomous post-training without requiring the observed correction itself to serve as the final action target.

</details>


### [147] [Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37543v1)
*Dequan Ou,Austin Lopez,Quentin Missinne,Christophe De Wagter,Guido C. H. E. de Croon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种无需图像渲染的解析式事件相机仿真器，直接从场景几何与自运动合成事件流，速度提升400倍以上，使端到端强化学习30分钟内收敛，并将量化策略全机载部署于56克微型无人机实现真实避障82%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具备低延迟、高动态范围与毫瓦级功耗，适合微型无人机在杂乱环境中敏捷导航。但现有仿真器需先渲染高保真图像再转换为事件，导致大规模强化学习训练极其缓慢，难以进行端到端学习。

Method: 利用事件相机本质测量"运动对比边缘"的特性，跳过视觉渲染，直接从场景几何与自运动解析生成事件流。单GPU上生成64x64事件观测仅需17微秒。基于该仿真器进行目标导向避障的端到端强化学习训练。策略经int8量化至1.2MB，部署于搭载Prophesee GenX320事件相机和OpenMV N6微控制器的56克Crazyflie上，全机载运行，无微调、无外部处理、无定位。

Result: 仿真速度比SOTA渲染流水线快400倍以上；训练收敛速度快三个数量级（30分钟内）。策略零样本迁移至光线追踪Isaac Sim。在未见过的杂乱赛道中成功率83%（中等难度，可通行概率约0.57），平均目标速度2.4 m/s；纹理密集室内大厅保持70%。真机在三条递增难度赛道上平均成功率82%（5/5、5/6、4/6）。

Conclusion: 通过解析式事件仿真绕开视觉渲染瓶颈，可大幅加速事件相机强化学习训练，并且学到的策略具备强零样本迁移能力，可完全机载部署于资源受限的微型无人机实现敏捷避障。

Abstract: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav

</details>


### [148] [Predict the Swing, Match the Speed: Robotic Pipe Stabbing With Learned Stereo Vision and Residual Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37535v1)
*Mohamed Ashraf Mostafa,Taher El-Fakharany,Samir Khaled*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StabBot 是一个机器人对扣（stabbing）系统：用摆锤卡尔曼滤波跟踪管柱摆动、六轴机械臂配开口V形滚轮头以匹配速度接近并接触确认，结合 ResNet-18 关键点网络与残差强化学习策略完成三维定位与捕获；在 200 组随机作业中全部对扣成功，接触速度与峰值接触力显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统固定式对扣导向器（stabbing guide）要求管柱以任意摆动速度撞击静止装置，导致高冲击速度与大接触力，易损伤螺纹并降低作业成功率（论文中基线仅 74% 成功）。因此需要一种能预测管柱摆动、主动以匹配速度迎接近管柱的机器人对扣方案。

Method: 1) 用由管柱计数（pipe tally）调参的摆锤卡尔曼滤波，在立体图像中跟踪管柱；2) 六轴机械臂配开口 V 形滚轮头，以匹配速度接近，最后几毫米靠触觉确认，在吊卡偏心时把公扣对准母扣，并以侧向柔顺跟随大钩下行；3) ResNet-18 关键点网络在三维中定位管柱、公扣端面与母扣口；4) 残差强化学习策略精细修正捕获。评估基于 1:4 Froude 缩比 MuJoCo 模型，200 组配对随机作业，涵盖 2-3/8 in. 油管至 20 in. 套管共 9 种规格，结果折算到全尺寸。

Result: StabBot 在全部 200 组作业中成功对扣，且管柱仅与滚轮接触；传统固定导向器成功率为 74%。中位接触速度由 18.4 降至 2.3 cm/s，中位峰值头-管接触力由 11.3 降至 1.4 kN，且 200 组作业中力均更低（Wilcoxon p < 10^-30）。关键点网络每对立体图像定位中位误差 0.4 mm，耗时 2.3 ms。网络闭环下，在 20 mm 附加噪声、300 ms 延迟、85% 丢帧、20 mm 标定偏移、20 cm 吊卡偏移和 40 cm 摆动条件下成功率保持 100%。

Conclusion: 以匹配速度主动迎接管柱的机器人对扣方案可显著降低接触冲击与接触力，并在视觉噪声、延迟、丢帧、标定误差与大幅摆动等扰动下保持高鲁棒性，具备替代传统固定式导向器的潜力。需注意全部结论来自 1:4 Froude 缩比 MuJoCo 仿真并按全尺寸折算，尚待实物验证。

Abstract: A joint of pipe run into the hole swings from the elevator over the well and strikes a fixed stabbing guide at whatever speed the swing has. StabBot, a robotic stabbing system, predicts the swing and meets the pipe at its own speed. A pendulum Kalman filter tuned from the pipe tally tracks the joint in stereo images. A six-axis arm with an open V-shaped roller head closes in at matched velocity, confirms the last millimetres by touch, aims the pin over the box when the elevator hangs off centre, and follows the block down with lateral compliance. A ResNet-18 keypoint network locates the pipe, pin nose and box mouth in 3-D, and a residual reinforcement-learning policy refines the capture. On 200 paired random jobs with nine sizes from 2-3/8-in. tubing to 20-in. casing, StabBot seated every joint with the pipe touching only rollers, against 74% for a conventional fixed guide. Median contact speed fell from 18.4 to 2.3 cm/s and median peak head-pipe force from 11.3 to 1.4 kN, and the force was lower in all 200 jobs (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-30}$). The network locates the pipe with 0.4-mm median error in 2.3 ms per stereo pair. With the network in the loop, success stayed at 100% under 20 mm of added noise, 300-ms delay, 85% frame loss, 20-mm calibration offset, 20-cm elevator offset and 40-cm swings. All results come from a 1:4 Froude-scaled MuJoCo model and are reported at full scale.

</details>


### [149] [Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37533v1)
*Baptiste Bonin,Caro Strickland,Audrey Durand*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文在模拟双臂工具使用任务上系统测量各传感通道可识别的失败原因，揭示部分失败原因的可辨识性边界，并指出VLM诊断器内部状态与输出之间的错位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作失败诊断器多以VLM为主，且训练评测集中于单臂、由成功演示扰动生成的失败。双臂工具使用引入了新的失败类型（工具滑脱、双手时序错、多重原因并发），这些失败的可辨识性与诊断能力尚未被刻画。

Method: 构建可记录失败原因的双臂工具使用仿真任务，从记录轨迹中读取真实失败原因；逐一评测不同传感通道（工具手、双臂、单侧手）对各类原因的可辨识性；并分析VLM内部状态所编码的信息与其答案输出之间的关系。

Result: 工具滑脱可由工具手读出；哪只手臂延迟需双臂感知，单侧手只能读出自身延迟及部分对侧延迟；当工具手延迟时，被动传感无法辨识该延迟尝试是否同时推力不足。在两次尝试内，一个在原因不可辨识时升级的修复策略可达到与已知真实原因同等水平的修复成功率。VLM内部状态几乎完美地编码了延迟手信息，但其方向与答案读取方向的距离与随机方向无异；答案是否报告该信息取决于提问措辞。

Conclusion: 双臂工具使用失败诊断受传感配置的可辨识性约束，不可辨识原因需通过主动升级策略补偿；VLM内部表征与输出决策存在解耦，诊断可靠性依赖提问方式。

Abstract: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.

</details>


### [150] [Leveraging Distributed Sensing and Hyperdimensional Computing for Non-Line-of-Sight Passive Object Sensing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37519v1)
*Placido Mursia,Marco Rossanese,Francesco Devoti,Adrian Lendinez Ibanez,Lanfranco Zanzi,Xi Li,Xavier Costa-Perez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种仅依赖分布式通信信道测量的ISAC框架，利用超维计算（HDC）实现机器人视距外（FoV外）被动实体的风险感知分类，在严重遮挡下达到89%准确率并提升路径规划安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能工厂中人、可移动障碍等被动实体可能与自主机器人发生冲突，构成安全风险；而LiDAR、雷达、相机等常规被动目标检测依赖直视线（LoS），受遮挡限制，无法感知机器人视距外的实体。

Method: 利用ISAC，通过分布式无线设备协作，仅基于通信基础设施的分布式信道测量进行视距外被动实体感知；将信道测量经超维计算（HDC）嵌入高维表示，无需显式信道重建即可实现鲁棒、可扩展的学习与风险感知分类。

Result: 基于商用射线追踪器的数值仿真与ROS在真实智能工厂场景中的验证表明：在严重遮挡下分类准确率最高达89%，提升了安全性并改善路径规划，同时保持较低计算复杂度。

Conclusion: 通信基础设施结合HDC可有效实现机器人视距外的被动实体感知与风险评估，为遮挡环境下的安全导航提供低复杂度、可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: In smart factory environments, passive entities such as humans and movable obstacles may interfere with autonomous robot operations, posing significant safety risks. Detecting potential conflicts between robots and entities outside their field-of-view (FoV) is therefore of paramount importance. However, conventional passive object detection systems rely on sensors such as LiDAR, radar, or cameras, which operate under direct line-of-sight (LoS) and are limited by obstacles and occlusions. To overcome these limitations, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception via the communication infrastructure thanks to cooperation among distributed wireless devices. In this paper, we propose a framework for passive entity sensing beyond the robot's FoV that relies solely on distributed channel measurements from the communication infrastructure to perform risk-aware classification. These measurements are embedded into high-dimensional representations using hyperdimensional computing (HDC), enabling robust and scalable learning without explicit channel reconstruction. Numerical simulations based on a commercial ray tracer and ROS-based validation in realistic smart factory scenarios demonstrate improved safety and enhanced path planning with up to 89% accuracy under severe occlusions, while maintaining low computational complexity.

</details>


### [151] [World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37518v1)
*Guoning Wu,Zijian Cai,Yuhang Zhang,Ying Liu,Yongbin Zheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: World Dreamer v5-lite 是一个面向多机器人协同的世界-动作模型，通过共享世界状态实现机器人特定的动作预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人控制需要融合分布式相机视角并预测各自独立的动作序列。现有视觉-语言-动作模型与世界-动作模型大多针对单机器人；而简单拼接多路视角并不能建立视角间的空间对应关系。

Method: 以共享世界状态为核心：用预训练视频编码器输出的标定特征，按工作空间坐标填充该状态，其空间尺寸不随视角增加而改变；视觉语言模型提供场景上下文并为每个机器人提供一个 query，各 query 读取共享状态并交换姿态感知信息，但动作流保持独立；采用掩码视角协同训练，在两条视觉分支中屏蔽部分相机视角而保留全部动作标签，以促使模型利用其他机器人共享的观测。预训练数据超过 10,000 小时，涵盖 20 种仿真机器人、RoboFactory 及真实机器人。

Result: 在 RoboFactory 上平均成功率为 74.0%，比最强评测基线高 23.7 个百分点；在四项真实机器人任务上平均成功率 78.8%，领先 13.8 个百分点；在 RoboCasa365 上总体达到 58.08%。

Conclusion: 共享世界状态与掩码视角协同训练能有效建立跨视角空间对应并促进机器人间信息共享，在多仿真与真实机器人任务上显著优于基线。

Abstract: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

</details>


### [152] [Ego-CEVR: Learning Cross-Embodiment Visual Representations from Human Egocentric Videos](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37509v2)
*Keru Zhou,Zhirui Fang,Xinrun Xu,Yaopeng Lou,Zeyuan He,Zihao Zhu,Xinze Niu,Chen Wang,Tianfu Li,Samith Va,Xiyue Zhang,Bin Qian,Junwei Li,Wenjia Ding,Yicheng Xu,Bowen Jiang,Wenhao Wang,Ziwei Wang,Chang Zhou,Li Liu,Xiu Li,Maoqing Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Ego-CEVR是一个数据原生的分层视觉表征学习框架，将全局表征与交互表征赋予不同的学习目标，从而把大规模第一视角视频转化为机器人操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一视角视频成本低、可扩展，富含高层任务理解语境；而带腕部观测与动作标注的真机示教则提供细粒度动作对齐监督。关键问题是如何将二者结合以学习机器人操作能力。

Method: 采用分层表征学习：全局模块通过在第一视角视频上的未来预测学习物体关系、任务状态与时间进度；交互模块在全局语境下解读腕部观测，借助机器人动作监督学习局部对齐与接触线索；两条独立的残差路径将两种表征同时输入动作策略。全局视频模块可在大规模人类第一视角视频及多种机器人本体视频上独立预训练，无需动作标签或配对腕部观测。

Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果；框架层面证明全局模块可脱离动作标签与腕部观测进行独立预训练，并支持跨人类与多本体机器人视频的规模化预训练。

Conclusion: 通过解耦全局语境与局部交互的学习目标并保留双路径接入策略，Ego-CEVR实现了数据原生的分层视觉表征学习，兼顾高层任务理解与细粒度执行信息，提升第一视角数据的可利用性。

Abstract: As egocentric video becomes increasingly available for embodied learning, an important research question is how to turn this low-cost, scalable source of data into robot manipulation capabilities. Egocentric videos naturally provide rich context for high-level task understanding, while real-robot demonstrations with wrist observations and action annotations provide supervision for fine-grained action alignment. We present Ego-CEVR, a data-native framework for hierarchical visual representation learning that assigns distinct learning objectives to global and interaction representations. The global module learns object relations, task state, and temporal progress through future prediction on egocentric video. The Interaction module interprets wrist observations in global context and learns local alignment and contact cues through robot action supervision. Separate residual paths expose both representations to the action policy, preserving direct access to task context alongside fine-grained execution information. Ego-CEVR supports independent pretraining of its global video module on large-scale human egocentric videos and videos from diverse robot embodiments, without requiring robot action labels or paired wrist observations.

</details>


### [153] [Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37470v1)
*Daan van Hamersveld,Ewoud Smeur,Iurii Kriachko*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种由神经网络直接控制的固定翼拦截无人机，将滤波后的单目视觉观测直接映射为执行器指令，在仿真与真实飞行中均实现对目标的有效拦截。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中空长航时无人机（如Shahed型）难以拦截：传统防空成本过高，四旋翼拦截器续航极短、仅能应对近距离低空目标；固定翼拦截器虽有航程优势，但依赖人工操控。因此需要一种能在固定翼平台上实现自主拦截的自动化控制方法。

Method: 在自定义Python环境中使用强化学习与近端策略优化（PPO）训练策略网络，输入为滤波后的单目视觉观测，输出直接为执行器指令；随后将策略部署到固定翼平台进行真实拦截测试；并开发两种经典制导控制器作为仿真基线进行对比。

Result: 策略在仿真和真实飞行中均能成功拦截目标；仿真中在多数条件下优于两种经典制导控制器；真实飞行中成功拦截了具有机动能力的固定翼目标。

Conclusion: 该新型系统验证了人工智能用于固定翼拦截无人机自主控制的可行性，展示了学习型视觉伺服策略在实际拦截任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Medium altitude, long endurance unmanned aerial systems such as Shahed-type strike drones are an unanswered threat in modern conflicts. Conventional air defense systems are too expensive to provide a feasible large-scale solution. Quadcopter interceptors are a cheap, battle-proven alternative, but their extremely limited flight time restricts them to low altitude targets at short range, whereas fixed-wing platforms have the endurance to reach higher altitude targets from longer distances. However, such interceptors are still operated manually. Recent developments in learning-based controllers show potential for automation. In this work, a fixed-wing interceptor is presented that is controlled by a neural network that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands. The policy was trained in a custom Python environment using reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization. The policy was then deployed on a fixed-wing platform and tested in real interception scenarios. As a baseline, two classical guidance controllers were also developed and tested in simulation. The policy is able to intercept targets both in simulation and in real flight. In simulation, the policy outperforms the classical controllers under most conditions. The interceptor was ultimately successfully validated in real flight by intercepting maneuvering fixed-wing targets. This novel system shows the potential of artificial intelligence for autonomous control of fixed-wing interceptor drones.

</details>


### [154] [Electric-Field Induction Motor with Discrete Circuit Elements and Improved Rotor Dynamics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37452v1)
*Alex S. Miller,Jeffrey H. Lang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种转子表面由离散电路元件构成、可模拟"深槽"效应的电场感应电机，在宽转速范围内提升转矩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电场致动器在纳米尺度与生物系统中占主导，并在极轻质量、真空或高温等宏观场景有潜力。既有电场感应电机转子表面为单一连续材料，其电阻率、介电常数与电路特性受限，设计自由度不足。

Method: 以有限数目导电叶片之间的离散电路元件构造转子，突破单一连续材料限制；借鉴磁励感应电机"深槽"转子利用集肤效应随频率降低转子时间常数的机理，在转子表面布置电路以模拟该效应。

Result: 完成宏观尺度电场感应电机的提出、分析、设计与实验演示，验证其可在宽转速范围内提供更优转矩。

Conclusion: 转子离散电路化为电场电机带来更大设计自由度，"电学深槽"方案可有效改善宽速域转矩特性。

Abstract: Electric-field-based actuators and machines lead the design space at the nanoscale and in biological systems, while having the potential to be used in favorable macroscale applications which prioritize minimal mass, performance in a vacuum, or performance in high temperatures. Electric-field induction motors consist of a set of stator electrodes which induce opposite charges onto a movable rotor surface. In earlier work, rotor surfaces for electric-field induction motors have been made of single continuum materials, which are limited in possible resistivity, permittivity and circuitry characteristics. To enhance design freedom, we develop a rotor for electric-field-based machines which may be constructed out of discrete circuit components between a finite number of conductive vanes. Magnetic-field induction motors, which are common in machinery, often utilize ``deep bar'' rotors, consisting of conducting bars which decrease the rotor time constant with increasing frequency using the skin depth effect. We propose, analyze, design and demonstrate a macro-scale electric-field induction motor which uses circuitry on the rotor surface to emulate the ``deep bar'' design, providing improved torque over a wide range of speeds.

</details>


### [155] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Co-Adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control (MARL-Exo) for Metabolic Energy Reduction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37441v1)
*Yifei Yuan,Jakob Wolf,Ghaith Androwis,Xianlian Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出MARL-Exo多智能体强化学习框架，在仿真中让全身肌肉骨骼人体模型与双侧髋关节外骨骼策略协同训练，学习到以肌肉代谢功率为奖励的单一群体级控制器，无需逐用户调参即可在新用户身上显著降低行走代谢成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人机回路优化（human-in-the-loop）需为每位用户单独调参，成本高且难以推广；同时，辅助策略的设计目标（如是否显式塑造机械功率）对最终代谢收益的影响缺乏仿真层面的系统筛选手段。作者希望验证：在仿真中与肌肉骨骼模型共适应、以代谢能量为奖励训练出的外骨骼策略，能否直接迁移到未见过的真实用户。

Method: 开发MARL-Exo多智能体强化学习框架：1）全身人体模型含304个肌肉驱动器，并随机化解剖结构、步态与速度；2）人体模型与外骨骼策略分两阶段并发训练；3）外骨骼仅观测延迟的髋关节运动学及自身历史指令；4）奖励由基于生理学能量学模型的肌肉代谢功率构成，分两种设置——仅代谢（Metabolic）与代谢+机械功率塑形（Metabolic+Power）；5）将Metabolic策略不作再训练直接部署于8名健康成人，以1.25 m/s行走，用间接测热法测量代谢。

Result: 仿真中，Metabolic策略使建模肌肉代谢功率较无设备行走降低13.8%，而Metabolic+Power仅降低8.8%。硬件实验中，MARL-Exo相对Passive（被动）状态使净代谢率降低18.3±6.6%，8名参与者全部有效；相对No-Exo（无外骨骼），平均降低7.4±10.0%，其中6人补偿超过13.1%的佩戴代价，最高降至其No-Exo成本的24.2%以下。

Conclusion: 在仿真中代谢信息驱动共适应得到的策略可无需逐用户调参直接迁移至真实用户，并稳定降低佩戴设备的行走代谢成本；显式机械功率塑形反而削弱了仿真中的收益。相较逐用户人机回路优化，该方法产出单一群体级控制器，并支持在人体测试前于仿真中筛选辅助目标。

Abstract: Objective: This study aims to determine whether a hip-exoskeleton policy trained in simulation, by co-adapting with a musculoskeletal human model under a metabolic-energy reward, reduces the metabolic cost of walking in new users without per-user tuning, and how mechanical-power shaping affects the learned assistance. Methods: We developed MARL-Exo, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a full-body human model (304 muscle actuators; randomized anatomy, gait, and speed) and a bilateral hip-exoskeleton policy are trained concurrently in two stages. The exoskeleton observes only delayed hip kinematics and its past commands; its reward includes muscle metabolic power from a physiologically based energetics model, alone (Metabolic) or with mechanical-power shaping (Metabolic + Power). The Metabolic policy was deployed and tested without retraining in eight healthy adults walking at 1.25 m/s, using indirect calorimetry. Results: In simulation, the Metabolic policy reduced modeled muscle metabolic power by 13.8% relative to no-device walking, versus 8.8% for Metabolic + Power. On hardware, MARL-Exo reduced net metabolic rate by 18.3 $\pm$ 6.6% relative to Passive in all eight participants. Relative to No-Exo, the mean reduction was 7.4 $\pm$ 10.0%; six participants more than offset the 13.1% device-wearing penalty, walking up to 24.2% below their No-Exo cost. Conclusion: A metabolically informed policy co-adapted in simulation transferred to users without per-user tuning and consistently reduced the metabolic cost of walking with the device, while explicit power shaping reduced the simulated benefit. Significance: Unlike per-user human-in-the-loop optimization, this approach yields a single population-level controller and allows assistance objectives to be screened in simulation before human testing.

</details>


### [156] [AuRaSim: A Ray-Tracing Based Automotive FMCW Radar Simulator for Dynamic Scenarios](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37403v1)
*Zhaoze Wang,Changxu Zhang,Tai Fei,Christopher Grimm,Yi Jin,Claas Tebruegge,Markus Gardill*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AuRaSim：基于Blender与Sionna RT的射线追踪FMCW车载雷达仿真框架，支持动态场景、路径级复系数传播、运动感知多普勒与相干多通道ADC数据立方体合成，与实测距离-多普勒图对比RMSE为0.147、PSNR为16.93 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
