Motivation: 相机与LiDAR仿真已能生成带精确标注的合成数据，但车载雷达仿真仍不成熟：既需3D引擎建模动态目标，又需电磁材料属性、天线配置、波传播机制与相干信号合成。现有框架或为闭源专有，或过度简化，难以规模化生成雷达原始测量数据。

Method: 不从头实现全部组件，而以Blender进行高效动态场景构建、以Sionna RT进行GPU加速电磁射线追踪；在此基础上增加雷达专用适配：带复系数的路径分辨传播、运动感知的多普勒建模，并依据波形配置进行相干多通道ADC数据立方体合成。

Result: 在数字孪生场景中，仿真与实测距离-多普勒图定量对比达到RMSE 0.147、PSNR 16.93 dB，表明合成信号具有较高精度与逼真度。

Conclusion: AuRaSim为可复现的车载雷达仿真与研究提供了完整且可扩展的平台，并公开项目主页。

Abstract: Modern simulators can generate synthetic camera and LiDAR data with accurate annotations for downstream tasks. In contrast, automotive radar simulation remains less mature because it requires not only a 3D engine to model dynamic objects in the scenes but also electromagnetic material properties, antenna configurations, wave propagation mechanisms, and coherent signal synthesis. Existing frameworks are either proprietary or overly simplified, limiting the scalability of radar raw measurements. This paper presents AuRaSim, a ray-tracing-based automotive frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar simulation framework for dynamic scenarios. Rather than implementing all components from scratch, AuRaSim builds on Blender for efficient dynamic-scene construction and Sionna RT for graphics processing unit (GPU) accelerated electromagnetic ray tracing, while introducing radar-specific adaptations for path-resolved propagation with complex coefficients, motion-aware Doppler modeling, and subsequently coherent multi-channel analog-to-digital converter (ADC) cube synthesis based on waveform configurations. Quantitative comparison between simulated and measured range-Doppler maps in digital-twin scenarios achieves a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 0.147 and a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 16.93 dB, demonstrating the accuracy and fidelity of the synthetic signal. AuRaSim therefore provides a complete and extensible platform for reproducible automotive radar simulation and research. Project homepage: https://wangzhaoze.github.io/aurasim.

</details>


### [157] [Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37393v1)
*Sinjae Kang,Dong Kyu Shin,Jaehong Kim,Kamin Lee,Hyoeun Kim,Kaixin Wang,Li Zhao,Seonghyeon Ye,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出质量可控策略QCP，可在推理时控制机器人策略的单项与组合质量属性，并结合迭代式事后重标注扩展可控质量范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略评估多依赖二值成功信号，而实际部署还要求可控的执行速度、运动平滑度等质量属性，需随任务需求动态调节。

Method: QCP以质量标签为条件实现推理时对单项及组合质量属性的控制；为进一步突破示教数据质量上限，设计迭代式事后重标注闭环：按目标质量标签在线采集轨迹，将成功轨迹加入数据集，依据实测质量对累积轨迹做事后重标注，并微调策略。

Result: 在Robomimic与RoboEval上，QCP随迭代持续提升任务执行质量与成功率，生成的轨迹质量超越初始示教；真实操作任务中，控制速度提升传送带作业吞吐，控制搬运稳定性提升端酒杯成功率。

Conclusion: 质量可控策略在物理部署中带来实际收益，表明将质量属性纳入策略学习与评估具有实用价值。

Abstract: Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. In real-world deployment, however, desired execution behaviors are also defined by quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, which need to be dynamically controlled according to task requirements. To address this, we introduce Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over both individual quality attributes and their combinations. To extend the controllable quality range beyond initial demonstrations, we further propose an iterative hindsight relabeling loop: QCP collects online rollouts under target quality labels, adds successful trajectories to the dataset, relabels the accumulated trajectories in hindsight according to their measured quality, and fine-tunes the policy. Experiments on Robomimic and RoboEval demonstrate that QCP consistently improves both task execution quality and success rates across iterations, producing successful rollouts that exceed the quality of the initial demonstrations. Finally, we validate QCP on real-world manipulation tasks, where controlling speed increases throughput in conveyor operations and controlling transport stability improves success when carrying wine glasses, demonstrating that quality-controllable policies yield practical gains in physical deployment.

</details>


### [158] [PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37381v1)
*Hanqing Wang,Zhaotian Cai,Ruichuan An,Bohan Zeng,Tao Zhang,Yilin Chen,Xu Jiang,Kaiquan Chen,Chongyang Wu,Haoran Li,Fan Yang,Mingan Lin,Wentao Zhang,Zenan Zhou,Youzheng Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PDRVLA 通过轻量物理动力学模块从视觉-语言特征中提取物理 token 来条件化动作生成，无需在线生成视频即可获得世界模型式的动力学先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型虽能从视觉观测和语言指令生成动作，但对物理动力学的理解有限；视频世界模型能捕捉场景动态，却因需生成未来视频而给控制环路引入高延迟。

Method: 设计轻量物理动力学模块，从视觉-语言特征提取物理 token 并用于条件化动作生成；该模块以直接预测未来 RGB、深度与光流特征为目标学习，并借助冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督；训练仅用公开数据，并通过人-机数据合成、子任务标注与具身思维链（ECoT）标注进行扩充。消融实验中还考察了子任务条件化、未来物体位姿监督与 ECoT 训练对动作成功率的影响。

Result: 四个仿真基准上的成功率为：LIBERO 99.3%、LIBERO-Plus 89.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 93.6%、SimplerEnv 81.5%；消融显示世界模型监督可提升未来预测，并量化了子任务条件化、未来物体位姿监督与 ECoT 训练对任务成功率的作用。

Conclusion: 以“学习式动力学表征+辅助世界模型监督”替代在线视频生成，可在保持低控制延迟的同时显著增强 VLA 的物理动力学理解与操作成功率，且可完全基于公开数据训练。

Abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

</details>


### [159] [VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37378v1)
*Bojun Zou,Wenhao Yu,Jiaohao Li,Jiaxuan Lin,Guanting Ye,Haohan Geng,Weihao Yu,Yanyong Zhang,Jianmin Ji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 VLA-Stem，一种免微调、基于强化学习的轻量级安全机制，将 VLA 输出的动作块转为轨迹参考，在推理时由 Stem 策略自适应修正执行，从而在保持原任务意图的同时应对空间约束与动态障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型多针对无约束静态操作，忽视空间约束和动态障碍；直接采集避障数据微调成本高（尤其动态场景），且可能损害原有任务能力。

Method: 将底层 VLA 策略产生的动作块转换为运动参考，以轨迹级引导保留其空间意图并允许灵活的运动与时序调整；Stem 策略以该参考、机器人本体感知和局部障碍信息为条件，在推理时自适应修改执行动作；训练上结合教师-学生蒸馏与课程学习，提升鲁棒性和样本效率。

Result: 在参考跟随、静态空间约束和动态避障任务上评估，六个受限仿真设置中平均无碰撞任务成功率为 52.8%，最强安全基线为 23.7%；在无障碍设置下保持基策略性能；真实世界实验显示静态与动态障碍下碰撞率一致下降。

Conclusion: VLA-Stem 将 VLA 的高层任务意图与对即时物理风险的快速反射式响应相结合，提供了一种类脑干机制的机器人稳健执行方案，且无需微调底层 VLA。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

</details>


### [160] [Generalizable Target-Less Joint Intrinsic-Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Pixel-Point Correspondences](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37350v1)
*Simon Bultmann,Daniele Cattaneo,Abhinav Valada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种全自动、无靶标的联合标定框架，可从原始图像和LiDAR点云中同时估计相机内参、径向-切向畸变以及相机-LiDAR外参，并将基于学习的像素-点对应标定从校正图像推广到原始相机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习像素-点对应的无靶标方法虽然精度高、泛化好，但依赖已校正图像和已知内参，只能用于已单独标定过的相机，适用性受限。

Method: 通过内参与畸变感知的对应学习（借助合成数据增强），将深度对应标定推广到原始相机；标定时迭代耦合对应预测与非线性优化，联合精化相机参数与传感器间相对变换。

Result: 在KITTI中未见过的相机-LiDAR配置以及三个真实机器人平台上进行零样本评估，联合标定的外参精度优于使用预标定相机的对应类方法，同时还能恢复准确的内参。

Conclusion: 联合标定可同时获得更优外参与可靠内参，消除了对相机预标定的依赖，提升了无靶标标定的实用性。

Abstract: Accurate camera-LiDAR calibration is an essential prerequisite for robust multi-modal perception in robotics. Recent target-less methods based on learned pixel-point correspondences achieve high extrinsic calibration accuracy and generalize across environments. However, they operate on rectified images with known camera intrinsics, restricting their applicability to systems whose cameras have already been individually calibrated. We present a fully automatic, target-less framework that jointly estimates camera intrinsics, radial-tangential distortion, and camera-LiDAR extrinsics from raw images and LiDAR scans. Our method generalizes deep correspondence-based calibration from rectified images to raw cameras through intrinsic- and distortion-aware correspondence learning via synthetic augmentations. During calibration, we iteratively couple correspondence prediction and nonlinear optimization to jointly refine the camera parameters and relative sensor transformation. We evaluate our approach on an unseen camera-LiDAR configuration from the KITTI dataset and on three real robotic platforms in a zero-shot manner. The results demonstrate that joint calibration with our generalized pixel-point correspondence network improves extrinsic accuracy over correspondence-based methods using pre-calibrated cameras, while additionally recovering accurate intrinsics.

</details>


### [161] [Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37330v1)
*Hanwen Ren,Meng Zheng,Wenzhe Cui,Benjamin Planche,Zhongpai Gao,Anwesa Choudhuri,Terrence Chen,Ziyan Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AFIL框架，将失败轨迹作为自适应负向引导，联合训练成功/失败双动作生成器，提升扩散与流式VLA策略的成功率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖仅基于成功样本的行为克隆，缺乏纠错训练信号，细微执行误差会迅速累积为不可恢复的分布外失败。

Method: AFIL为端到端框架：用预训练VLA在线生成失败rollout，免去人工设计失败模式或人在回路恢复；在共享视觉-语言主干上联合训练双动作生成器（DAGs），分别建模成功与失败行为，参数开销有限；采样时由失败生成器依据每步扩散中成功与失败分布之间的距离自适应确定引导强度，将动作生成推离失败易发区域。

Result: 在域内与域外机器人操作任务（含短程与长程设定）上，AFIL相较现有VLA基线持续提升任务成功率与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 失败轨迹可作为有效的自适应负向引导信号，AFIL在效果、效率与通用性上均得到验证。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

</details>


### [162] [Spiking Neuromorphic Control for Periodic Orbits Stabilization in Underactuated Robots: A Greedy Lyapunov-Based Approach](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37310v1)
*Maksim Surov,Oleg Sumenkov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将事件驱动的脉冲神经元控制器（以脉冲神经网络实现）用于欠驱动机器人的轨迹跟踪，通过横截线性化把周期轨道镇定问题化为周期LTV系统零点镇定，并把原本针对LTI的Lyapunov贪心设计推广到周期LTV横截动力学以构造反馈控制器，在butterfly机器人上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欠驱动机器人的周期轨道镇定需要连续、计算量较大的反馈控制；希望利用事件驱动、稀疏发放的脉冲神经网络控制器实现低能耗的轨道镇定，而现有面向LTI系统的Lyapunov贪心脉冲控制器设计尚不能直接用于周期轨道镇定场景。

Method: 对周期轨迹邻域内的机器人动力学做横截线性化，得到周期系数的线性时变（LTV）系统，将轨道镇定转化为该LTV系统平凡解的镇定；把原为LTI系统提出的Lyapunov贪心设计推广到周期LTV横截动力学，从而构造基于脉冲神经网络的事件驱动反馈控制器。

Result: 所提方法可构造出实现轨道镇定的反馈控制器；在butterfly机器人的轨迹镇定任务上演示了方法的有效性（摘要未给出定量指标）。

Conclusion: Lyapunov贪心脉冲控制器设计可由LTI推广至周期LTV横截动力学，表明事件驱动脉冲神经网络控制器可用于欠驱动机器人的周期轨道镇定，并在butterfly机器人上得到验证。

Abstract: This work investigates the use of event-based spiking controllers, implemented as spiking neural networks, for trajectory tracking in underactuated robots. Specifically, we address the problem of stabilizing a prescribed periodic orbit. It is well known that, by applying the method of transverse linearization to the robot dynamics in a neighborhood of a periodic trajectory, the dynamics can be approximately described by a linear time-varying system with periodic coefficients (a periodic LTV system). The problem of orbital stabilization can therefore be reduced to stabilizing the trivial solution of this LTV system. We show that a previously proposed Lyapunov-based greedy design, originally developed for LTI systems, can also be extended to the corresponding linearized transverse dynamics, which take the form of a periodic LTV system. This enables the construction of a feedback controller for orbital stabilization of the robot. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on the trajectory stabilization problem for the butterfly robot.

</details>


### [163] [KEPT: Conformal Keepouts Kept in Planning for Enclosed-Space Navigation in Degraded Sensing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37217v1)
*Eric Minwoo Kim,Jong-Kook Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出对共形（conformal）安全裕度按无标签的退化严重度估计进行条件化，使其在感知退化变化时保持覆盖率接近目标；同时由规划控制层在规划时与每条指令上强制单一制动距离条件，仅在跟踪残差上留裕度、不改动keepout本身。地面机器人烟雾数据验证keepout，雾中隧道四旋翼仿真闭环相较标准部署显著减少进入校准keepout的次数、到达目标数更多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隧道、矿井等封闭空间中烟雾、粉尘与雾使距离图（range map）不准确，依赖其建图的自动驾驶存在风险。共形预测可在已测绘墙面周围生成按选定概率覆盖真实不安全集的keepout，但常规做法是把keepout当作膨胀障碍：感知退化时keepout会移动，却没有任何机制保证车辆能在其之前停下；窄通道中该裕度叠加规划器缓冲会封死通路，现有补救办法是放松覆盖水平（牺牲安全性）来恢复可达性。

Method: 1）将共形裕度条件化于一个无标签的退化严重度估计（label-free severity estimate），从而在退化程度变化时使覆盖率保持在目标附近；2）规划与控制层在规划时刻及每次指令下发时对keepout强制单一制动距离条件，以实测跟踪残差作为唯一裕度，且从不修改keepout；3）在真实地面机器人烟雾录制数据上验证keepout，并在雾中隧道的四旋翼仿真中与标准部署方案进行闭环对比。

Result: 闭环仿真中，所提系统在两种校准机制下均大幅减少进入校准keepout的事件，并比标准部署到达更多目标；混合统计的增益为3.2个百分点，但其分机制的置信区间包含零。逐类别的keepout在留出录制数据上覆盖率接近目标。

Conclusion: 以退化严重度为条件的共形裕度配合显式制动距离约束的规划控制层，可在不放松覆盖目标、不膨胀keepout的前提下同时改善安全性与可达性；不过闭环性能增益的统计显著性尚不稳健（置信区间含零），与标准部署的对比仍需更多验证。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles in enclosed spaces such as tunnels and mines rely on range maps that smoke, dust and fog make inaccurate. Conformal prediction calibrates a keepout around the mapped walls that covers the true unsafe set at a chosen probability. Typically an unmodified planner treats the keepout as an inflated obstacle, and nothing ensures that the vehicle can stop before the keepout as it moves when sensing degrades. In narrow passages this margin and the planner's buffer close the route, and existing remedies recover reach by relaxing the coverage level. This paper conditions the conformal margin on a label-free severity estimate to hold coverage near its target as degradation varies. A planning and control layer enforces one braking-distance condition on the keepout at plan time and at every command, takes the measured tracking residual as its only margin and never alters the keepout. The keepout is validated on ground-robot smoke recordings and the closed loop in simulated quadrotor flights in a foggy tunnel against the standard deployment. In closed-loop simulation the proposed system substantially reduces entries into the calibrated keepout and reaches numerically more goals than the deployment pattern in both calibration regimes, an observed gain of 3.2 percentage points pooled whose per-regime confidence intervals include zero. The per-class keepout holds its coverage near the target on held-out recordings.

</details>


### [164] [Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37215v1)
*Pham Tri Quang,Bao-Ngoc Dao,Minh Duc Nguyen,Duc-Duy Nguyen,Hung T. Ho,Linh Dang Le,Trong-Bao Ho,Thien-Loc Ha,Tan Q. Nguyen,Tuan Dam,Vu N. Duong,Daniel Sonntag,Ngan Le,Khoa D. Doan,Jan Peters,An Thai Le,Duy M. H. Nguyen,Vien Anh Ngo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: R2A将VLA策略的OOD鲁棒性问题重构为几何运动基元检索问题：离线构建成功演示的时空运动基元图，推理时用查询相关的GNN定位当前执行并检索结构兼容的未来运动基元，再通过逐维门控与冻结VLA的预测动作融合，无需微调即可显著提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略语义泛化强但对执行中的OOD视觉偏移高度脆弱；已有测试时方法着力抑制虚假视觉线索，却忽视了策略自身训练经验中丰富且未被破坏的运动学先验。

Method: 提出测试时扩展框架R2A：(1)将成功训练演示结构化为离线时空运动基元图，绕过脆弱的视觉特征；(2)推理时用查询相关的图神经网络在执行过程中动态定位并检索结构兼容的未来运动基元；(3)通过可学习的逐维门控机制将检索到的几何先验与冻结VLA的预测动作协调融合，自适应修正错误空间轨迹并保留局部反应性。全程不微调基座策略。

Result: 在GR00T N1.7、π0.5、StableVLA三种先进VLA架构上验证，R2A对多种上下文扰动均持续显著提升鲁棒性：仿真基准LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0-Plus绝对成功率最高提升+12%，真实部署最高提升+40%，且无需任何微调。

Conclusion: 将OOD鲁棒性归结为几何运动基元检索是有效且模型无关的测试时方案，可即插即用地增强现有VLA策略，提示训练经验中的运动学先验是被忽视的高价值资源。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $π_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

</details>


### [165] [Remember Where You Walk: Learning Spatial Memory for End-to-End Legged Robot Exploration](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37203v1)
*Leon Magnus,Nico Bohlinger,Jan Peters,Oleg Arenz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于Hadamard记忆的Local Spatial Matrix Memory (LSMM)网络结构，用于足式机器人在长视野下按位置存储与检索任务相关信息，在自主迷宫探索中达到与强基线相当的覆盖率，且是唯一能记住迷宫布局的结构（重构误差降低三倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂环境中的足式/人形机器人需要记住已离开视野、却很久之后才用到的信息；端到端训练的LSTM等记忆网络在长视野上常常无法保留足够信息。

Method: 将Hadamard记忆引入网络架构，设计LSMM：在由位置索引的特定记忆单元上写入通用任务相关信息，实现灵活且具空间落地性的记忆；与RL策略结合，在自主迷宫探索任务上评估，与强循环网络和有限历史基线对比。

Result: LSMM的迷宫覆盖率与强循环和有限历史基线相当；同时是唯一能记住迷宫布局的架构，布局重构误差降至三分之一。

Conclusion: 位置索引的Hadamard型外部记忆为机器人导航中长视野信息保持提供了有效方案，兼顾探索性能与空间布局记忆能力。

Abstract: Humanoids and other legged robots operating in complex environments must remember information that leaves their field of view and only becomes relevant much later. Reinforcement learning policies address this using memory networks such as LSTMs that are trained end-to-end with the policy to memorize such task-relevant aspects. Yet, such architectures often fail to preserve sufficient information over long horizons. In this work, we propose a network architecture based on Hadamard memory that specifically targets robot navigation. Our Local Spatial Matrix Memory (LSMM) enables RL agents to store generic task-relevant information at specific, position-based memory cells, enabling flexible and spatially grounded memorization. We evaluate LSMM on the task of autonomous maze exploration, where it matches the maze coverage of strong recurrent and finite-history baselines while being the only architecture that remembers the maze layout, reducing the reconstruction error threefold.

</details>


### [166] [A Bi-level Co-design Framework for Lunar Monoped with 2D Jump and Landing Control](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37199v1)
*Sanjay Ramkumar,Suraj Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文针对月球低重力环境下平面单腿机器人，构建双层协同设计框架，联合优化连杆长度与控制器（QP-TSC或直接配点轨迹优化），并扩展到二维跳跃与触地稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月球低重力下接触力小、腾空相长，使腿形态与控制器选择相互耦合，需要协同设计而非分别独立设计。

Method: 双层协同设计：外层用差分进化搜索连杆长度；内层对每个候选在垂直跳跃任务上分别用基于二次规划的任务空间控制器（QP-TSC）与基于直接配点的轨迹优化进行评估；再扩展至二维跳跃，采用质心角动量调节的轨迹优化实现原地与前进跳跃，并用LQR吸收触地冲击。基线形态两连杆各0.3 m。

Result: 两种控制器给出不同的最优连杆长度；轨迹优化在设计空间多数区域优于QP-TSC，在各自最优处COT低17%；二维情形实现稳定原地与前向跳跃，LQR可吸收冲击并在触地后稳定机器人。

Conclusion: 低重力腿式机器人设计中形态与控制强耦合，轨迹优化类控制器配合协同优化可在更低能耗与更强跳跃能力上获益，且触地稳定需专门控制器保障。

Abstract: Legged robots for lunar exploration must be designed for low gravity, where reduced contact forces and long flight phases make leg morphology and controller choice interdependent. We study this for a planar monoped in lunar gravity ($1.625$ m/s$^2$) using a bi-level co-design framework: a differential evolution outer loop searches over link lengths, and each candidate is evaluated on a vertical jump by either a quadratic program based task-space controller (QP-TSC) or a direct-collocation based trajectory optimization. The two controllers yield different optimal link lengths, and trajectory optimization outperforms the QP-TSC across most of the design space, with 17% lower Cost of Transport (COT) at their respective optima. We then extend to a 2D jump, where trajectory optimization with centroidal angular momentum regulation produces stable in-place and forward jumps, and an LQR controller absorbs impact and stabilizes the robot after touchdown. This is demonstrated on a baseline morphology with both links 0.3 m long.

</details>


### [167] [How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37196v1)
*Haojia Gao,Yue Cao,Yumin Liu,Haohua Que,Mingkai Liu,Guanqiu Guo,Zhuo Zou,Bokui Chen,Xueqian Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出"去噪反事实协议"（基于逐位可复现分支、重复续接、留出oracle与共同随机数）来测量世界动作模型（WAM）中测试时选择器的真实可选提升空间（selectable headroom），并据此构建失败门控选择器，在闭环任务上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时选择是提升固定策略的自然手段：想象候选动作的未来并执行最优者。但选择收益受"可选提升空间"限制，而标准估计方法（每个候选只执行一次并取最好结果）把候选质量与后续随机性混为一谈，导致高估。

Method: 提出去噪反事实协议：逐位可复现的分支、对每个候选进行重复续接、留出（held-out）oracle、共同随机数（common random numbers），以分离候选质量与随机噪声；基于该测量构建失败门控选择器（仅当WAM读出预测失败时才偏离策略块）。实验覆盖4个WAM、2个基准、超10万次分支 rollout，并采用预注册检验。

Result: (i) 标准估计高估原生样本的可选提升空间：每个候选17次续接给出，三个WAM的可选份额介于24%–66%；(ii) 结构化动作扰动可带来最多16个百分点的可选提升空间；(iii) 在动作条件想象的两个WAM中，想象未来携带的候选结果信息与真实未来无可检测损失，而Cosmos Policy的价值头未利用该信息。闭环：训练任务留出集成功率76.9%→81.6%，未见任务62.6%→69.8%。

Conclusion: 选择器收益主要来自失败门控与结构化扰动而非朴素单次采样；WAM的想象未来是可靠的结果信息源，可用于提升闭环任务成功率，且在策略最易失败处增益最大。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [168] [Acoustic Signature Optimisation for Bioinspired Flapping-Wing Micro Aerial Vehicles](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37190v1)
*Yi Lun Duh,Krispin C. V. Broers,Sophie F. Armanini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文针对扑翼膜翼拍动反转时"膜松弛突跳"产生的脉冲式"咔哒"噪声，提出两种被动几何降噪方法：基于分析模型的翅脉布局优化，以及仿蜂鸟羽毛的增材后缘缨。实验证实反转突跳噪声最高降低8 dB，后缘缨在不损失升力情况下再降低3–4 dB宽带"嗖"声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扑翼微型飞行器以安静飞行为卖点，但现有实测表明工程翼比其所模仿的生物翼噪声高15–30 dB，声学特征仍远逊于自然。作者聚焦扑翼的主要声源之一——拍动反转时松弛膜在两曲率间突跳辐射的脉冲"咔哒"声，探索被动几何手段降低噪声而不牺牲气动性能。

Method: 将反转"咔哒"声建模为膜的动态突跳（snap-through）过程，据此建立分析模型以优化翅脉（venation）布局；制造优化布局翼并在实验中测量突跳噪声，同时考察翅脉取向与厚度的影响；另设计受蜂鸟羽毛启发的增材后缘缨（trailing-edge fringe），与切除锯齿翼对比其宽带"嗖"声与升力表现。

Result: 优化翅脉布局使反转突跳噪声在实验中最高降低约8 dB；测试发现翅脉性能对取向敏感，而对厚度不敏感。仿生后缘缨在无升力代价下进一步降低宽带"嗖"声3–4 dB，效果与切除锯齿翼相当，但无需牺牲升力面积。

Conclusion: 两种被动几何策略可有效削减扑翼膜翼的声学特征：翅脉优化针对脉冲式突跳噪声，后缘缨针对宽带噪声且零升力代价，为低噪声扑翼微型飞行器设计提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Flapping-wing micro air vehicles are prized for quiet flight, yet the few existing measurements show engineered wings to be 15-30 dB louder than the animals they imitate. This paper investigates two passive geometric approaches to reduce the acoustic signature of a flapping membrane wing, and applies these to an exemplary wing. A significant sound source in flapping wings is the impulsive click radiated at stroke reversal, when a slack membrane snaps between two curvatures. Our first noise-reduction approach optimises the wing's venation layout, based on an analytical model of the reversal click as a dynamic snap-through of the membrane. The optimised venation pattern was manufactured and resulted in a reduction of up to 8 dB during the reversal snap in experiments. During testing, the venation was found to be sensitive to orientation rather than thickness. Secondly, an additive trailing-edge fringe inspired by hummingbird feathers was shown to further reduce the broadband swoosh by 3-4 dB at no lift cost, matching a cut serration wing without removing lifting area.

</details>


### [169] [From 12 to 200 Demonstrations: How ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$ Scale on a Low-Cost Arm](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37170v1)
*Simon Cowling*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在一个含干扰物的抓取放置任务上，以12→200条示教数据的嵌套子集训练ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA和π0.5，在真实SO-101机械臂上完成1340个评分回合的评测，比较不同策略的数据效率、失败模式与测量噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习策略比较多在仿真或不同训练配方下进行，缺少固定配方、统一任务、真实机械臂上的可控数据量扫描与失败模式细粒度分析，尤其缺乏对"数据量少时哪种策略更好"以及评测本身可靠性的实证回答。

Method: 采用12/25/50/100/200条遥操作示教的嵌套数据子集，每个策略固定一套训练配方；在物理SO-101机械臂上按固定物体摆放进行126个区块、1340个评分回合的评测；利用关节与相机记录将每回合映射到"起步—到达—抓取—交付"四阶段阶梯；用十回合区块重复测试估计测量噪声，并分离种子间方差，同时对人工评分进行审计；训练时长固定，因此数据量与训练步数存在混淆。

Result: ACT从12条示教的1/40提升至100条的37/40；π0.5用动作专家微调时在低数据下最优（12条16/40，25条28/40），之后稳定在约70%，100条后ACT领先但差距未被完全解释；SmolVLA与Diffusion Policy峰值约50%，且存在"起步失败"：SmolVLA有47%的回合机械臂完全未动，Diffusion Policy在剔除示教中的空转前导段前几乎无法起步；π0.5的微调方式比数据量更关键（LoRA为4/110，动作专家微调为130/200）。同一检查点重复测试平均相差2/10。

Conclusion: 数据量增加使ACT的失败由"到达"转移到"抓取"再至无失败，而π0.5残余失败集中在抓取；十回合区块作为测量单位噪声较大，需与种子方差区分；训练长度固定带来的混杂限制了部分结论的适用范围，作者明确列出哪些结论稳健、哪些不稳健。

Abstract: We trained four widely used imitation-learning policies, ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$, on nested subsets of 12, 25, 50, 100 and 200 teleoperated demonstrations of one pick-and-place task with distractor objects, using one fixed training recipe per policy. Every trained model was then run on a physical SO-101 arm on a fixed set of object placements: 1,340 scored episodes in 126 blocks.
  ACT, trained from scratch, rose from 1 success in 40 episodes at 12 demonstrations to 37 in 40 at 100. $π_{0.5}$ with its action expert fine-tuned was the best policy when data was scarce (16 of 40 at 12 demonstrations, 28 of 40 at 25) and then stayed near 70%; from 100 demonstrations ACT was ahead, by a margin this study does not fully resolve. SmolVLA and Diffusion Policy peaked near 50%, and both were affected by a failure to start: SmolVLA's arm never started moving in 47% of episodes, and Diffusion Policy hardly ever started until an idle lead-in was trimmed from the demonstrations. For $π_{0.5}$ the fine-tuning recipe mattered more than the amount of data: low-rank adaptation succeeded in 4 of 110 episodes, against 130 of 200 for action-expert fine-tuning.
  From the joint and camera recordings we place every episode on a four-stage ladder (started, reached the ball, carried it, delivered it) and show that for ACT more data moves failures from reaching, to grasping, to none, while the failures $π_{0.5}$ retains are in grasping. We also measure how weak a ten-episode block is as a measurement (the same checkpoint tested twice differs by 2 successes in 10 on average), separate seed-to-seed variation from that noise, and audit the human scoring against the recordings. Training length was fixed within each recipe, so the amount of data and the number of times it was seen change together; we state which conclusions survive that confound and which do not.

</details>


### [170] [RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37111v1)
*Xinyi Chen,Yichen Zhang,Chenxing Jiang,Shaojie Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RAVEN——一个面向四旋翼的统一定义主动视觉 SLAM 框架，通过前沿与主动回环候选生成全局路径候选，并用分别量化探索效率与定位精度的效用向量进行评价，以 [0,1] 优先级参数选择最终路径，最后由基于在线 Fisher 信息场的感知感知规划器生成平滑轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动 SLAM 存在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环之间的权衡；现有工作多针对地面机器人，而四旋翼敏捷性高、传感器受限，定位漂移更严重，需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划；同时缺乏能依据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略。

Method: 1) 识别前沿（frontiers）与主动回环候选；2) 由候选生成全局巡游（tour）方案；3) 用分别量化探索效率与定位精度的效用向量评价候选，并按 [0,1] 的优先级参数选出最终巡游；4) 感知感知导航规划器基于实时在线 Fisher 信息场（提供视觉定位信息）生成最小化视觉状态估计误差的平滑执行轨迹。

Result: 基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于现有最先进主动 SLAM 方法，并在不同优先级设置下呈现连续的性能谱；使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼的全机载实地实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实用性。

Conclusion: RAVEN 为四旋翼提供了一套统一、可调优先级的主动视觉探索 SLAM 框架，兼顾探索效率与定位精度，兼具基准性能优势与实机可行性；源代码将开源以惠及社区。

Abstract: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.

</details>


### [171] [GAWM: A Compact Latent World-Action Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37091v1)
*Yang Liu,Xiaoli Liu,Liuzhao Li,Yuduo Song,Muyuan Liu,Xiang Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GAWM 是一个紧凑的多任务世界动作模型，在冻结 DINOv3 编码器的潜空间中预测未来观测，参数量不足 100M，却在 RoboTwin 2.0 上超越十亿参数 WAM，在 LIBERO 上与十亿参数 VLA 相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）多依赖十亿参数级的视觉语言或视频生成骨干，训练成本高、推理延迟大，难以实际部署。作者希望在显著降低规模与开销的前提下，保留"预测未来观测"带来的策略学习收益。

Method: 以冻结的 DINOv3 编码器为特征源，将其在各相机视角下的特征压缩为少量 token；使用一个以任务而非动作为条件的轻量预测器，在两个未来时间尺度上预测这些 token；预测结果由未来帧的稠密 patch 特征监督，从而迫使模型编码未来场景的空间布局；再由动作解码器基于当前与预测 token 直接回归一段动作序列（action chunk）。全程无机器人或视频预训练。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上优于十亿参数 WAM；在 LIBERO 上与十亿参数 VLA 性能相当；在真实双臂机器人上，对留出示范的动作预测误差低于微调后的十亿参数 VLA，且推理延迟显著更低。消融实验显示，在训练数据或训练时间受限时，潜空间世界模型的收益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 世界模型的预测能力不必依赖超大生成式骨干：在冻结自监督特征的潜空间中做紧凑预测，即可用小模型获得强策略性能与低延迟，并在数据/算力受限条件下更具优势。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) incorporate the prediction of future observations into robot policy learning. However, most WAMs build on billion-parameter vision-language or video-generation backbones, which incur high training cost and inference latency. In this letter, we present GAWM (Geometry-Aware World Model), a compact multi-task WAM that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. GAWM compresses the features of each camera view into a small set of tokens. A lightweight predictor, conditioned on the task rather than on actions, forecasts these tokens at two future horizons. The forecast is supervised with the dense patch features of future frames, which requires it to encode the spatial layout of the future scene. An action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current and predicted tokens. With fewer than 100M parameters and no robot or video pretraining, GAWM outperforms billion-parameter WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 and performs comparably to billion-parameter VLAs on LIBERO. On a dual-arm robot, it achieves lower action-prediction error on held-out demonstrations than a fine-tuned billion-parameter VLA, with substantially lower inference latency. Ablation studies show that the latent world model substantially improves performance when training data or training time is limited. Code is available at https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm.

</details>


### [172] [State estimation for a hybrid rigid-continuum space manipulator system](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37043v1)
*Lorenzo Ticozzi,Patricio A. Vela,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向"刚性-软体"混合空间机械臂（末端为腱驱动连续体机器人）的状态重构流程，将配置估计建模为MAP推断并转录为因子图，结合GVS最小阶参数化，在仿真中验证了精度与计算性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间机械臂可支撑在轨装配、维修、升级与加注等长期在轨操作；将连续体/软体机构引入空间机械臂设计可减小收拢体积与质量，并借助固有机械柔顺性提升操作安全性。但此类混合软刚系统的状态估计（融合关节编码器与视觉等异构、离散、含噪测量）及与刚-软运动学模型的耦合仍是挑战，且需为后续基于模型的反馈控制提供紧凑配置描述。

Method: 1) 研究对象：混合软-刚空间机械臂，末端连杆为腱驱动连续体机器人。2) 将配置估计表述为以关节编码器与视觉感知流程的离散含噪测量为条件的最大后验（MAP）推断问题。3) 将所得软约束优化问题转录为因子图，紧凑表示异构测量与刚-软运动学模型的融合。4) 采用几何变应变（GVS）方法获得配置的最小阶参数化。5) 仿真验证：闭环轨迹，连续体连杆位置测量由基于合成逼真图像的模拟视觉流程获取。

Result: 在闭环轨迹仿真中，状态重构精度与计算性能均验证了所提框架的潜力，表明其适用于在轨混合软-刚机器人应用；GVS的最小阶参数化预期有助于未来基于模型的反馈控制设计。

Conclusion: 所提MAP-因子图状态重构框架可有效融合关节编码器与视觉测量及刚-软运动学模型，在混合软-刚空间机械臂上展现出良好的精度与计算性能；GVS参数化为后续反馈控制奠定基础。当前验证限于仿真，后续需进一步实证。

Abstract: Spacecraft-mounted robotic manipulators can support long-term operability of orbiting assets by conducting tasks such as on-orbit assembly, repair, upgrade, and refueling. In this context, the integration of continuum/soft robotic mechanisms into space manipulator designs promises to reduce stowage volume and mass, as well as to improve operational safety through the inherent mechanical compliance of soft structures. This work presents a novel state reconstruction pipeline for a hybrid soft-rigid space manipulator, in which the distal link is a tendon-driven continuum robot. The estimation problem is formulated as a maximum a posteriori (MAP) inference problem over the hybrid manipulator's configuration, conditioned on discrete, noisy measurements from joint encoders and a vision-based sensing pipeline. The resulting soft-constrained optimization problem is transcribed as a factor graph, providing a compact representation for fusing heterogeneous measurements with the rigid-soft kinematic model. Furthermore, the adoption of the Geometric Variable Strain (GVS) approach yields a minimum-order parameterization of the configuration, a property expected to facilitate model-based feedback control design in future work. The proposed implementation is validated in simulation on a closed-loop trajectory where, for better realism, position measurements for the continuum link are obtained by means of a simulated visual pipeline leveraging synthetic photorealistic images. The state reconstruction accuracy and computational performance confirm the potential of the proposed framework for hybrid soft-rigid robotic applications in orbit.

</details>


### [173] [Structure-Actuation Co-Design of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36996v1)
*Mohammad Bahari,Amir Hossein Barjini,Jouni Mattila*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种混合离散-连续多目标双层优化框架，用于全电重载机械臂的结构-驱动协同设计，实现质量自洽的固定点收敛并给出多个可行非支配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重载全电机械臂的几何结构与驱动（电机、减速器、丝杠）选型高度耦合，序列式单次选型忽略了质量反馈与多目标权衡，易导致硬件质量、成本与能耗评估失真。

Method: 构建双层优化：上层优化机械臂几何与驱动拓扑；下层针对各关节搜索离散电机、减速器与丝杠配置并构造可行档案；系统级协调器按硬件质量、协同设计成本与含损耗供电能量选择执行器组合；执行器质量回馈至机器人模型，迭代直至质量一致固定点。采用SE(3)全位姿基准（100 kg工具负载、12个位姿）评估，并进行固定设计消融与负载筛选。

Result: 得到8个满足全部12个位姿的可行非支配设计；所有设计执行器质量耦合均在3次迭代内收敛；固定设计消融显示单次序贯选型使硬件质量变化达2.13%、成本变化10.20%、供电能量变化9.40%；负载筛选表明随载荷增加，质量-成本-能量需求上升且竞争机制拓扑发生改变。

Conclusion: 质量反馈耦合与双层多目标协同设计对重载机械臂的驱动选型评价不可忽略，所提框架能一致地给出帕累托设计集并揭示负载对最优机构拓扑的影响。

Abstract: This paper presents a mixed discrete-continuous multiobjective bilevel framework for the structure-actuation co-design of all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators. The upper level optimizes manipulator geometry and actuation topology, while joint-specific lower-level searches construct feasible archives of discrete motor, gearbox, and screw configurations. A system-level coordinator selects actuator packages according to hardware mass, co-design cost, and loss-aware supply energy, and the resulting actuator masses are fed back to the robot model until a mass-consistent fixed point is obtained. Evaluation on a full-pose SE(3) benchmark with a 100-kg tool payload yields eight feasible nondominated designs, all satisfying the 12 prescribed poses. Actuator-mass coupling converges in three iterations for every reported design. A fixed-design ablation shows that one-pass sequential sizing changes hardware mass by up to 2.13%, co-design cost by 10.20%, and supply energy by 9.40% in magnitude. Payload screening further reveals increasing mass-cost-energy demand and changes in competitive mechanism topology with carried load.

</details>


### [174] [Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36968v1)
*Zichen Yan,Rui Huang,Shenao Wang,Yucong Wang,Nuthasith Gerdpratoom,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Omni-IGN，一个全机载的无人机图像目标导航系统，融合四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习策略与碰撞感知安全层，在 Habitat 基准上取得连续动作基线最优表现，并在 IsaacSim 与真实世界实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视角观测，需额外旋转与探索来搜索视野外与目标相关的线索，且需在有限机载算力下同时完成探索、目标导向导航与避障。

Method: 系统由三部分组成：(1) 四鱼眼 RGB 感知，无需专用深度传感器即可同时支持 ImageNav 与避障；(2) 基于注意力的强化学习策略，自适应融合多视角中与目标相关的特征，输出连续导航方向引导；(3) 碰撞感知安全层，结合学习式深度估计进行动作过滤。整体全机载运行。

Result: 在 Habitat 基准上，于连续动作基线中取得最佳性能；IsaacSim 飞行测试验证了学习式深度估计与动作安全层结合对避障的有效性；真实世界实验实现无需微调、无需外部定位的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。

Conclusion: 多视角全景感知与注意力融合策略可有效替代单视角搜索，配合安全层可在机载条件下兼顾导航与避障，并具备良好的仿真到现实泛化能力。代码与模型权重将在论文录用后开源。

Abstract: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [175] [Keeping Contact: Task-Adaptive Friction Margins for Bimanual Non-Prehensile Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36961v1)
*Qian Ying Lee,Lin Yang,Domenico Campolo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以带符号摩擦距离度量力空间中的摩擦裕度，并从双臂倾斜中平衡枢轴力矩偏差所需的力修正导出任务自适应裕度，将其嵌入SOCP序列求得全局最优接触力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非抓取操作的接触维持仅靠名义摩擦锥可行性不足：刚在锥内的力与深入锥内的力同样可行，但对滑移和接触丢失的裕度不同，因此需要显式、可量化的摩擦裕度，且裕度应随任务需求自适应而非固定。

Method: 1) 用带符号摩擦距离（signed friction distance）在力空间量化摩擦裕度；2) 由双臂倾斜任务中平衡枢轴力矩偏差所需的力修正量，解析推导任务自适应裕度；3) 将所得接触裕度嵌入一系列二阶锥规划（SOCP），在每个倾角下求解全局最优接触力，使物体绕环境枢轴平衡，并使机器人与枢轴接触力远离名义摩擦边界。

Result: 优化器层面呈现可解释的力重分配，并能适应物体属性变化；实机实验在物体属性变化与模型失配下成功执行；与固定裕度、无裕度基线对比，说明按任务需求自适应调整裕度的重要性。

Conclusion: 带符号摩擦距离裕度可作为双臂非抓取操作中维持接触的力规划机制。

Abstract: Maintaining contact in non-prehensile manipulation requires more than nominal friction cone feasibility: a force barely inside the cone and one well inside it are both feasible, but they provide different margins against slip and contact loss. This paper uses signed friction distance to measure friction margin in force space and derives a task-adaptive margin from the force correction needed to balance pivot moment deviations in bimanual tilting. The resulting contact margins are embedded in a sequence of second-order cone programs (SOCPs), each giving a globally optimal contact force solution at a tilt angle. The optimizer balances the object about an environmental pivot while keeping robot and pivot contact forces away from the nominal friction boundary. Optimizer-level results show interpretable force redistribution and adaptation to object property changes. Real-world experiments demonstrate successful execution under object property variations and model mismatch, while fixed margin and no-margin comparisons illustrate the importance of adapting the margin to task demand. These results support signed friction distance margins as a force planning mechanism for maintaining contact in bimanual non-prehensile manipulation. Project page: https://keeping-contact.github.io/

</details>


### [176] [ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36859v1)
*Ri-Zhao Qiu,Bowen Wen,Yifeng Jiang,Chen Tessler,Eric Heiden,Xue Bin Peng,Xiaolong Wang,Stan Birchfield,Erwin Coumans*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ActiveAlign 框架，利用主动感知（挥手运动+触觉）对齐 Real2Sim2Real 差距，实现毫米级物体对齐与精细操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Real2Sim2Real 方法依赖被动感知，因观测不完美而产生 real2sim 差距；受人类通过动作主动感知的启发，希望用交互来弥补该差距。

Method: 包含两个互补模块：(i) ActiveAlign-Waving：利用主动手部运动结合可微渲染进行手眼标定；(ii) ActiveAlign-Touching：借助触觉反馈精化物体对齐，达到毫米级精度。

Result: ActiveAlign-Waving 可用于为开源未标定的机器人操作数据集构建仿真环境；在真实 Unitree G1 机器人上验证 ActiveAlign 支持按下按钮、移动滑块等毫米级精细操作。

Conclusion: 主动感知能有效弥合 Real2Sim2Real 差距，两模块协同实现强对齐，并具备数据集仿真化与真实精细操作的应用价值。

Abstract: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.

</details>


### [177] [When Black-Box Robot Policies Fail: Online Sensor Diagnosis and Repair with a Transparent Surrogate](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36852v1)
*Marc Ziegler,Batu Özen,Sami Mentes,Thomas Waschulzik,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文研究在策略冻结且不可访问内部的情况下，能否用外部监控器诊断并修复损坏的传感器输入。作者用一个把周期性步态与依赖传感器的修正项分离的结构化替代模型，引导冻结运动策略的输入修复。仿真 Go2 上离线诊断把行走成功率从 259/640 提升到 429/640，在线修复达到 382/640，并且在 64 个无故障留出回合中零误触发；匹配的 boosted-tree 替代模型虽能同样准确预测干净动作，却不带来可检测的修复增益。Go1 与 ANYmal C 上的独立拟合同样改善行走，但相位感知梯度效果更好。证据仍限于单一策略与部分筛选的仿真故障集，硬件验证待完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人基础模型具备跨任务、跨本体泛化能力，但其动作仍依赖可能失效的传感器。当策略被冻结或不可访问时，缺少一种无需访问内部即可从外部诊断并修复损坏输入的手段，这构成了本文的核心问题动机。

Method: 构建一个结构化替代模型（structured surrogate），将周期性步态与传感器依赖的修正项分离，并以此在冻结的运动策略外围引导输入修复；对比采用匹配的 boosted-tree 替代模型作为基线；在仿真 Go2 上评估离线诊断与在线修复，并在 Go1、ANYmal C 上以独立拟合进行跨本体检验，同时比较相位感知梯度等不同信号。

Result: 仿真 Go2 上离线诊断将行走成功回合数从 259/640 提升至 429/640，在线修复达到 382/640，且在 64 个留出的无故障回合中没有触发。匹配的 boosted-tree 替代模型在预测干净动作上表现相当，但相对不修复未检测到修复收益。独立拟合在 Go1 与 ANYmal C 上同样改善行走，相位感知梯度表现更优。

Conclusion: 结构化（步态相分离）的替代模型可作为冻结策略的外部输入修复引导，优于仅追求动作预测精度的黑箱替代模型；但结论目前仅基于单一策略和部分筛选的仿真故障集，向机器人基础模型与真实硬件的推广仍需验证。

Abstract: Robot foundation models may generalize across tasks and embodiments, but their actions still depend on sensors that can fail. When the policy is frozen or inaccessible, can an external monitor diagnose and repair corrupted inputs without access to its internals? We test a structured surrogate that separates periodic gait from sensor-dependent corrections to guide input repair around a frozen locomotion policy. On simulated Go2, offline diagnosis raises walking success from 259/640 to 429/640 episodes; online repair reaches 382/640, with no triggers in 64 held-out fault-free episodes. A matched boosted-tree surrogate predicts clean actions similarly well but yields no detected repair improvement over no repair. Separate fits improve walking on Go1 and ANYmal C, although phase-aware gradients perform better. Evidence remains limited to one policy and a partly screened simulated fault suite; robot foundation model and hardware validation remain open.

</details>


### [178] [Trace-WAM: Learning to Act via 3D Motion Prediction for World Action Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36840v1)
*Xu Hu,Changjie Wu,Linzhe Shi,Hang Zhang,Chen Yang,Lingjun Zhang,Guowen Zhang,Mu Xu,Junran Peng,Qing Li,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Trace-WAM 在视频-动作联合学习中引入未来 3D 运动预测作为辅助目标，用三支路 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构统一学习视频预测、运动预测与动作生成，在不改变推理路径的前提下提升分布内性能与分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: World Action Models 通过耦合未来视觉预测与动作生成来学习机器人控制表征。但成功操作主要取决于机器人与任务相关物体的演化，而未来视频预测还必须重建整个场景的外观与背景，存在监督信号与任务需求不匹配的问题。

Method: 提出 Trace-WAM，将未来 3D 运动预测作为辅助目标加入视频-动作学习，监督时序点对应关系以及图像平面位移和深度变化，直接刻画操作中的交互动力学与空间变化。架构上采用三支路 Mixture-of-Transformer（Tri-MoT），联合学习视频预测、运动预测与动作生成；运动专家由当前视觉特征预测未来轨迹，使运动监督塑形动作生成所用表征。

Result: 在 RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 上实验表明，方法具备较强的分布内性能与分布外泛化能力；在示教数据有限和分布偏移条件下，相较 Fast-WAM 增益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 以 3D 运动预测作为辅助监督可有效提炼与操作相关的表征，且因动作专家不消费预测轨迹，推理仍保持单次视觉前向与动作去噪的当前观测策略路径，兼顾性能与推理效率。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) learn representations for robot control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. Successful manipulation depends primarily on how the robot and task-relevant objects evolve, whereas future-video prediction must also reconstruct the appearance and background of the entire scene. We therefore propose Trace-WAM, which augments video-action learning with future 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective. This objective supervises temporal point correspondence together with image-plane displacement and depth change, directly describing the interaction dynamics and spatial changes involved in manipulation. To this end, we adopt a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer (Tri-MoT) architecture to jointly learn video prediction, motion prediction, and action generation. The motion expert predicts future trajectories from current visual features, allowing motion supervision to shape the representations used for action generation. Because the action expert does not consume predicted trajectories, inference retains the current-observation policy path: a single visual forward pass followed by action denoising. Experiments on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate strong in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, with particularly clear gains over Fast-WAM under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts.

</details>


### [179] [ExecDiffuser: Closing the Sample-to-Execution Gap in Diffusion Planning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36837v1)
*Shuo Pei,Bosun Liang,Saihui Zha,Chen Sun,Huachun Tan,Yong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出生成式规划器存在"采样—执行鸿沟"（sample-to-execution gap）：评价看生成轨迹质量，而闭环驾驶只取决于被提交执行的那一条。为此提出 ExecDiffuser，通过共享执行语义的循环式 proposal-to-execution 框架将候选生成、轨迹选择与后续重规划耦合起来，在 nuPlan、InterPlan、NAVSIM 上取得领先闭环性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式规划器多以可生成轨迹的多样性/质量作为评价指标，但闭环驾驶的实际表现只由最终提交给控制器的单条轨迹决定。二者之间存在不一致，即"sample-to-execution gap"。作者进一步指出：仅提升候选轨迹（proposal）质量，反而可能恶化实际执行的决策，说明问题不在于采样能力，而在于从候选到执行决策的转化链条。

Method: 提出 ExecDiffuser，一个循环的 proposal-to-execution 框架，以共享的执行语义贯通三个阶段：(1) Intent-Guided Diffusion Proposal（IGD）：为各假设分配责任（hypothesis responsibility），并以执行条件化监督（execution-conditioned supervision）塑造轨迹；(2) Execution-Grounded Selection（EGS）：学习候选条件化的发布效用（publication utility），据此选定并提交一条轨迹给控制；(3) 被提交的轨迹作为上下文返回下一规划周期，实现重规划闭环。

Result: 在 nuPlan、InterPlan、NAVSIM 三套基准上优于强 SOTA 基线。统一五随机种子协议下平均得分 85.62，分别较 Diffusion Planner 与 FlowDrive 提升 4.02 和 1.31 分；NAVSIM 上按官方评测流程取得 92.6 PDMS。匹配的反事实分析（counterfactual analysis）表明 ExecDiffuser 更能把优质候选转化为已提交决策；前缀干预（prefix intervention）实验确认该优势在物理执行与后续重规划之后依然保持。

Conclusion: 闭环驾驶性能的关键瓶颈是从候选集合到单一执行决策的转化效率，而非单纯生成质量。将生成、选择与重规划通过执行语义统一联合优化的 ExecDiffuser 验证了该观点的有效性，且优势在跨基准与长程执行中稳健。研究提示生成式规划器的评测与设计应以执行终态为中心。

Abstract: Generative planners are often evaluated by the trajectories they can generate, although closed-loop driving ultimately depends on the single candidate committed to control. We identify this mismatch as the sample-to-execution gap and show that improving proposal quality alone can worsen the executed decision. Here, we introduce ExecDiffuser, a recurrent proposal-to-execution framework that couples candidate generation, trajectory selection, and subsequent replanning through shared execution semantics. Intent-Guided Diffusion Proposal (IGD) assigns hypothesis responsibility and shapes trajectories with execution-conditioned supervision. Execution-Grounded Selection (EGS) learns a candidate-conditioned publication utility, commits one trajectory to control, and returns it as context for the next planning cycle. Across nuPlan, InterPlan, and NAVSIM, ExecDiffuser achieves leading closed-loop performance against strong state-of-the-art baselines. Under a unified five-seed protocol, it obtains an average score of 85.62, improving over Diffusion Planner and FlowDrive by 4.02 and 1.31 points, respectively. On NAVSIM, it achieves 92.6 PDMS under the official evaluation pipeline. Matched counterfactual analysis further shows that ExecDiffuser more reliably converts strong candidates into committed decisions, while prefix interventions confirm that this advantage persists after physical execution and subsequent replanning.

</details>


### [180] [HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36825v1)
*Wenhao Xu,Yanheng Mai,Yifei Fu,Nan Zheng,Yanbo Zhou,Zirui Huang,Mingsheng Ling,Xinjue Wang,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可部署的感知式人形机器人跑酷框架 HC2Robot，通过预测未来落脚事件来弥合非对称 actor-critic 中的信息差，仿真平均穿越成功率 97.60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人跑酷需在高不连续地形上推理未来落脚点与全身运动。非对称 actor-critic 中 critic 训练时可用特权仿真信号，而可部署 actor 只有机载感知，存在明显信息差；作者认为关键不是把特权信息直接暴露给 actor，而是学习其可部署近似。

Method: HC2Robot 由预测前瞻模块（PFM）与超连接（HC）Transformer 组成。PFM 从可部署观测预测策略条件下每只脚下一次触地事件的时机、位置与支撑质量，将特权监督转成可部署的隐表示，使 actor 无需特权运行时传感即可获得预测触地信息；HC Transformer 用可学习多流路由增强时序推理，并设未来运动预测头提供短期运动先验作正则。

Result: 在台阶、沟壑、高台与斜坡地形上，仿真平均穿越成功率 97.60%，安全落脚率持续优于强感知式运动基线。

Conclusion: 在仅有可部署感知的条件下，预测式落脚前瞻可有效缩小训练—部署信息差，同时提升穿越性能与落脚几何支撑质量。

Abstract: Humanoid parkour requires robots to reason about future footholds and whole-body motions over highly discontinuous terrain. We revisit the information asymmetry in asymmetric actor-critic learning for perceptive humanoid locomotion: the critic exploits privileged simulator signals during training, whereas the deployable actor operates solely from onboard perception. We argue that the key is not exposing privileged information to the actor, but learning a deployable approximation of it to narrow the information gap between training and deployment. We present HC2Robot, a deployable perceptive humanoid parkour framework consisting of a Predicted Foresight Module (PFM) and a Hyper-Connection (HC) Transformer. PFM predicts from deployable observations the policy-conditioned timing, location, and support quality of each foot's next touchdown event, converting privileged supervision into a deployable latent representation that provides the actor with predicted touchdown information without privileged runtime sensing. The HC Transformer further enhances temporal reasoning through learnable multi-stream routing, while a future motion prediction head provides short-horizon motion priors for regularization. Across stairs, gaps, high platforms, and slopes, HC2Robot achieves a mean simulated traversal success rate of 97.60% and consistently higher safe foothold rates than strong perceptive locomotion baselines, supporting improved traversal performance and geometric foothold support under deployable sensing.

</details>


### [181] [TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36823v1)
*Jeremy A. Collins,Seungjae Lee,Rachanon Wachakorn,Krishnan Srinivasan,Animesh Garg,Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini,Paarth Shah*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TAPESTRY 将机器人动作视为视频模型潜空间中的单 patch token，把预训练视频扩散 Transformer 复用为世界动作模型，推理时无需生成视频，单步 DDIM 即可输出动作块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视频生成模型蕴含丰富的物理交互先验，但现有利用方式存在缺陷：要么测试时进行昂贵的视频生成，要么从零训练动作头而未能充分利用预训练主干。

Method: 用轻量线性投影将每个动作时间步映射到预训练 VAE 的 patch 维度，生成的动作 token 与视频 token 共享同一 patchify 层与 Transformer 主干；共享主干按 minibatch 元素采样三种扩散目标优化：(1) 视频扩散，利用机器人与人类视频 VAE 潜变量建立动力学先验；(2) 视频+动作联合扩散，采用耦合扩散时间步与非对称注意力掩码；(3) 仅动作扩散，以干净图像潜变量为条件去噪动作。

Result: 测试时从纯噪声出发，以单次 DDIM 步生成紧凑动作 token 序列，在消费级硬件上每动作块耗时 84 ms，无需完整视频生成；在仿真基准与真机实验中取得强性能，推理成本显著低于可比的视频—动作联合策略。

Conclusion: 将动作 token 化并嵌入预训练视频扩散主干，可高效继承视频模型的物理动力学先验，在保持动作生成质量的同时大幅降低推理开销，为复用视频基础模型做机器人控制提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. More information can be found at https://tapestry-wam.github.io.

</details>


### [182] [Integrated Design and Reproducible Feasibility Analysis of a Four-Wheel Rover with Packet-Commanded Imaging, LiDAR Ranging, and Learning-Assisted Target Recognition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36816v1)
*Sabik Bin Sultan,Shafi Bin Sultan,Safwan Sadad,Aranya Abeer Khan Prapya,Maria Sultan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究为一款用于2027年NASA人类探索月球车挑战赛高中遥控组的四轮教学漫游车建立了集成化、可复现的设计评估：融合商用差速驱动、独立悬挂轮架、双电池与Raspberry Pi任务子系统，通过CAD与BOM对账推导机动性与电气约束，并给出8.105 km/h理论速度、20°爬坡每轮≥1.255 N·m、相机成像/指向误差敏感度等量化结论；软件部分在2400张合成板图像上比较颜色-几何规则与两种线性SVM，并用模拟硬件校验参考指令执行器，但未开展实车试验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向学生竞赛的四轮漫游车设计通常缺乏可追溯的工程论证：组件选型、失效机理与定量设计限值之间缺少联系，电机标称参数难以直接证明满足赛规（如8 km/h限速），视觉与测距执行也缺乏可复现的验证手段。因此需要一套集成、可复现的设计评估方法，在学生可达的资源条件下把选型决策与可检验的指标对应起来。

Method: (1) 架构整合：商用差速驱动控制、独立弹性悬挂轮架、驱动/任务电池分离、基于Raspberry Pi的命令执行子系统（成像与测距）；(2) 将组件清单与带尺寸的CAD视图对账，推导机动性与电气约束，并把传感器几何映射到命令执行误差；(3) 解析计算：以10.919 kg估计质量、215 mm车轮、200 RPM推算理论滚速；以滚阻系数0.10、等扭矩分配计算20°稳态爬坡所需每轮扭矩；以50 ft处12 in特征、Camera Module 3 Standard全分辨率图像与1°指向误差量化成像分辨率与测距射线偏移；(4) 软件验证：在2400张生成的合成板裁片上，采用场景不相交评估，对比颜色-几何规则与两种线性支持向量机；并用模拟硬件（mock）检验独立参考指令执行器。

Result: 质量10.919 kg、215 mm车轮以200 RPM旋转时理论滚速为8.105 km/h，说明电机标称值不足以证明满足8 km/h设计上限；在滚阻系数0.10、等扭矩共享假设下，20°稳态爬坡每轮至少需1.255 N·m；50 ft处理想12 in特征在Camera Module 3 Standard全分辨率图像中约占71像素，1°指向误差使测距射线偏移约266 mm；合成基准中给出颜色-几何规则与两种线性SVM的场景不相交对比结果，参考指令执行器通过模拟硬件校验。研究未报告实车试验结果。

Conclusion: 主要贡献在于建立组件选型、失效机理、定量设计限值与可复现验证任务之间可追溯的联系，软件结果与解析敏感度共同支撑一份可检验的开发计划；实车试验留待后续工作。

Abstract: This study develops an integrated, reproducible design assessment for a four-wheel educational rover intended for the high-school remote-control division of the 2027 NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge. The architecture combines commercial differential drive control, independently sprung wheel carriers, separate drive and task batteries, and a Raspberry Pi-based subsystem that executes received imaging and ranging commands. The analysis reconciles component lists with dimensioned computer-aided design views, derives mobility and electrical constraints, and connects sensor geometry to command execution. At the estimated mass of 10.919 kg, a 215 mm wheel rotating at 200 RPM produces a theoretical rolling speed of 8.105 km/h; consequently, the nominal motor label does not establish compliance with an 8 km/h design ceiling. A steady 20-degree climb requires at least 1.255 newton-meters per wheel under an assumed rolling-resistance coefficient of 0.10 and equal torque sharing. At 50 ft, an ideal 12-inch feature spans approximately 71 pixels across a full-resolution Camera Module 3 Standard image, while a 1-degree pointing error displaces the ranging ray by approximately 266 mm. An executed synthetic benchmark compares color-geometry rules and two linear support-vector classifiers on 2,400 generated board crops with scene-disjoint evaluation. A separate reference command executor is checked using mocked hardware. These software results and analytical sensitivities support a testable development plan; the study does not report physical rover trials. The principal contribution is a traceable connection between component choices, failure mechanisms, quantitative design limits, and reproducible verification tasks.

</details>


### [183] [Gradient flow of magnetic inclination and intensity as a GPS-free guidance mechanism](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36812v1)
*Zayed Herma,Philippe Cardin,Andréa Vassilev*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文将生物启发磁导航（BIMN）建模为梯度流控制与制导问题，证明在预定区域内仅利用磁倾角与磁强度即可实现无GPS的精确导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海龟等动物能感知地磁场并用于长距离导航，启发了以地磁场（"自然GPS"）为天然导航基础设施的BIMN，可作为脆弱的卫星导航系统的替代方案；但磁坐标与地理位置并非一一映射，不同地点可能具有相似磁特征，导致导航歧义，这是BIMN的根本挑战。

Method: 将BIMN形式化为梯度流控制与制导问题：以磁倾角和磁强度构造势场，把梯度流视为"水流"，通过控制该流引导系统经过若干中间航点（waypoints）到达目标点。

Result: 表明在预定义区域内，磁倾角与强度提供足够信息以导航至任意目的地；受控梯度流可承载系统并按设定航线经中间航点收敛至目标。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了无GPS导航机制：工程上可构建地磁导航基础设施以定义并跟踪指定航线，生物学上可用于分析依赖磁感受的动物迁徙路线。

Abstract: It is well established that some animals, such as sea turtles, sense the Earth's magnetic field and use it as a primary cue for long-distance navigation across the vast and featureless ocean. This remarkable ability has inspired the development of bio-inspired magnetic navigation (BIMN), which seeks to mimic these animals to develop robust and frugal navigation methods. BIMN exploits the Earth's magnetic field, sometimes described as ''Nature's GPS'', as a natural navigation infrastructure, providing a potential alternative to vulnerable satellite navigation systems. However, unlike geographic coordinates, magnetic coordinates extracted from the Earth's magnetic field do not provide a one-to-one mapping to geographic locations. Different locations can exhibit similar magnetic signatures, creating ambiguity and making BIMN inherently more challenging. Despite this fundamental challenge, we demonstrate that, within predefined regions of the Earth, magnetic inclination and intensity provide sufficient information to navigate to any destination. By formulating BIMN as a gradient flow control and guidance problem, we show that the resulting gradient flow act as current that carries the system and can be controlled to guide it through intermediate waypoints toward the desired destination. The resulting framework provides a GPS-free navigation mechanism with potential applications in both engineering and biology. In engineering, it can be used to establish a geomagnetic navigation infrastructure through which prescribed routes can be defined and followed, while in biology, it can be used to analyse the migration routes of animals known to rely on magnetoreception.

</details>


### [184] [RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36791v1)
*Haoyu Zhao,Yinzhou Tang,Zixuan Wang,Minghao Zhu,Dongchi Huang,Xingyue Zhao,Qin Zhao,Kehan Li,Siteng Huang,Xin Li,Zhenyu Zeng,Mingxiu Chen,Deli Zhao,Zhongyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出跨具身视频世界模型RynnWorld-Latent，以3D锚定的潜在动作为共享条件接口，统一人类视频、机器人演示与仿真数据联合预训练，并支持数字遥操作与潜在动作合成两条数据生成路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构交互视频学习可控世界动态存在两大障碍：不同机器人具身动作空间互不兼容，人类视频缺乏原生控制标签，难以在统一动作空间下联合预训练。

Method: 采用RynnLAM的3D锚定潜在动作作为跨具身共享条件接口；在预训练视频Transformer基础上，将全局动作token与身份初始化的局部分支结合，使动作与未来视频潜变量对齐；在23个数据集约5.535亿帧上预训练，并针对目标机器人后训练；设计数字遥操作与潜在动作合成两条数据生成路径。

Result: 在公开基准和两个真实机器人平台上视频预测指标提升；相同初始观测下不同动作序列展现定性动作跟随；合成中间训练提升LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus策略成功率；两条生成路线在实验设置下均优于仅用真实演示训练的真实策略成功率。

Conclusion: 结果表明通用潜在动作可作为跨异构具身学习可控视觉动态的可扩展接口。

Abstract: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.

</details>


### [185] [A fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand with human-level joint structure enabled by linkage-based actuation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36789v1)
*Jihao Li,Jianguo Wang,Haotian Guo,Yanzhe Wang,Guodong Lu,Huixu Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Torch-Hand，一种全关节、21 自由度的仿人灵巧手：采用五自由度差异化拇指与其余四指各四自由度，并以纯连杆-丝杠传动与掌内串联式驱动实现高抓取力、大负载与可控性之间的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿人灵巧手在「仿生运动学复杂度、机械鲁棒性、负载能力、控制简易性」之间存在难以调和的权衡，制约了非结构化环境下的灵巧操作。

Method: 复现人手的关节结构与运动层级，设计 21 自由度构型（拇指 5 自由度、含多轴 CMC 运动；其余四指各 4 自由度）；摒弃腱驱动与混合驱动，采用纯连杆传动架构，融合丝杠-连杆驱动以兼顾紧凑仿生外形与高抓取力、高负载；所有执行器集成于手掌内，按类串联机器人方式布局，使电机运动与关节运动学一一对应；在机械层面解耦功能自由度以抑制关节间非意图运动传递，同时在复杂操作中可将可独立驱动的自由度主动协调为耦合多关节运动模式。

Result: 实验系统评估了可达工作空间、协调指尖轨迹、拇指对掌能力、33 种抓取分类覆盖率、抓取力、负载能力及任务级操作表现。

Conclusion: Torch-Hand 在仿生构型、鲁棒性与控制可解性之间取得平衡，可作为灵巧具身操作可靠的硬件基础。

Abstract: Humanoid dexterous hands are a core component of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to translate high-level intent into rich and adaptive physical interaction. However, existing designs remain constrained by a persistent trade-off among anthropomorphic kinematic complexity, mechanical robustness, load capacity and control simplicity, limiting dexterous manipulation in unstructured environments. Here we present Torch-Hand, a fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand that replicates the joint structure and motion hierarchy of the human hand with 21 degrees of freedom (DOF), comprising a highly articulated five-DOF thumb and four DOF in each of the remaining fingers. The differentiated thumb integrates multi-axis CMC motion to provide broad opposition and flexible contact orientation relative to the four fingers. Unlike tendon-driven or hybrid actuation approaches, Torch-Hand adopts an entirely linkage-based transmission architecture. By integrating screw-linkage actuation, the hand achieves high grasping force and substantial payload capacity while maintaining a compact anthropomorphic form. Its actuation architecture is optimized for control tractability, with all actuators integrated within the palm and arranged in a serial-robot-like configuration that establishes a direct correspondence between motor motion and joint kinematics. This architecture mechanically decouples functional DOF to reduce unintended inter-joint motion propagation, while allowing independently addressable DOF to be actively coordinated into coupled multi-joint motion patterns during complex manipulation. Comprehensive experiments assess reachable workspace, coordinated fingertip trajectories, thumb opposition, 33-grasp taxonomy coverage, grasping force, payload capacity and task-level manipulation. These results establish Torch-Hand as a robust hardware foundation for dexterous embodied manipulation.

</details>


### [186] [Making Self-Driving Laboratories Auditable:A Unified Framework for Hybrid Actions,Measurements, and Safe Execution](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36761v1)
*Zihan Zhang,Zeyu Wu,Xin Zhang,Mingyu Luo,Haohui Que,Tong Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一个可追溯的自主实验室（SDL）框架，由LAM、OpenSDL、Safe-SDL与L3-Bench四部分组成，覆盖混合动作生成、受监控的设备执行、测量反馈与实验评估的端到端设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主实验室需将实验规划、自动化执行与测量反馈闭环耦合，但柔性机器人控制与仪器暴露的类型化API、连续测量之间缺乏统一执行接口，且存在协调与可追溯性难题。

Method: LAM：以测量为条件的策略架构，将视觉-语言-动作范式扩展为同时生成连续机器人轨迹与类型化仪器API调用；OpenSDL：执行基座，将角色级操作映射到异构设备、协调执行并记录带时间戳的因果事件；Safe-SDL：运行时门控，结合派发前的模式与资源检查及执行期（含长等待）的信号时序逻辑监控；L3-Bench：三级实验室基准，定义涵盖物理结果、时序、可复现性、安全违规与故障恢复的回合级评估协议。

Result: 摘要为设计性/框架性描述，未给出具体实验数据或量化结果；其“结果”为四组件协同构成的端到端设计方案，可支撑混合动作生成、受监控执行、测量反馈与评估的贯通，并回应SDL工作流的协调与可追溯性挑战。

Conclusion: 该工作以可追溯性为核心，提出从策略生成到设备执行、安全监控与基准评估的一体化SDL设计，为后续实现与实证验证提供体系化蓝图。

Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are laboratory systems that couple experimental planning, automated execution, and measurement feedback in a closed loop. Integrating flexible robot control with the typed application programming interfaces (APIs) and continuous measurements exposed by laboratory instruments remains an execution-interface challenge. To address this challenge, we propose a traceable framework comprising four components: LAM (Lab Action Model), OpenSDL, Safe-SDL, and L3-Bench. LAM is a proposed measurement-conditioned policy architecture that extends vision-language-action paradigms to generate both continuous robot trajectories and typed instrument API calls. OpenSDL is an execution substrate with an initial control implementation, designed to map role-level operations to heterogeneous devices, coordinate execution, and record timestamped causal events. The proposed Safe-SDL runtime gate combines pre-dispatch schema and resource checks with signal temporal logic monitoring during execution, including extended waiting periods. L3-Bench (Level-3 Laboratory Benchmark) specifies an episode-level evaluation protocol covering physical outcomes, timing, reproducibility, safety violations, and fault recovery. Together, these components provide an end-to-end design for linking hybrid action generation, monitored device execution, measurement feedback, and experimental evaluation, addressing coordination and traceability challenges in SDL workflows.

</details>


### [187] [Learning Side-by-Side Navigation for Personal Mobility Vehicles from Human Drivers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36726v1)
*Luis Yoichi Morales,Florent Ferreri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种双人代步车(PMV)并排自主行驶的协同规划方法：两车各自运行采样型模型预测规划器，仅交换彼此可观测的里程计信息，通过一对效用矩阵与统一规则实现联合决策；行为参数由人类驾驶数据经逆强化学习拟合，并配有不可被代价覆盖的安全层。仿真24+24次运行无一碰撞，对话队形保持率显著高于人类驾驶员。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使两台载人代步车能够并排行驶以维持可交谈的"社交队形"，同时保证骑行安全与平稳；并希望以去中心化、低通信依赖的方式贴近人类驾驶员的行为特征。

Method: 各车独立运行基于采样的模型预测规划器；规划器间不共享额外信息，仅交换对彼此的里程计观测；联合决策表示为候选轨迹对的效用矩阵，由统一规则解算。行为参数通过逆强化学习从10组人员、共409分钟室内人类驾驶数据中拟合；可通行车道由走廊几何离线推导而非手工设定。另设成本函数无法覆盖的安全层——仅当整车可安全刹停时才执行动作；受阻车辆沿自身路径倒车后继续。

Result: 在驾驶员记录条件与四种生成障碍布局下各24次闭环仿真，均未发生墙体或锥桶碰撞。在障碍环境中对话队形保持率为60.5%和68.9%（逆/顺时针），空旷通道为81.2%和91.5%，人类驾驶员对应为34.0%/36.0%与52.9%/56.0%，且速度与人类相当。系统保持单一侧向队形，而人类在近距斜列与宽阔并排间切换，系统方差明显更小。结果基于ROS 2上的差速驱动运动学仿真。

Conclusion: 所提去中心化协同规划框架能在无人碰撞前提下，以低通信量实现并排社交队形的稳定保持，行为与人类驾驶风格可比且一致性更强；但结论基于仿真与差速驱动平台，尚未在真实硬件上验证。

Abstract: This paper presents an approach to achieve side-by-side autonomous motion with a pair of personal mobility vehicles (PMVs). Given a global path, two PMVs plan cooperatively so as to hold a social formation that lets the passengers hold a conversation, while keeping the ride safe and smooth. Each vehicle runs its own sampling-based model-predictive planner; the planners exchange nothing but the odometry each vehicle could observe of the other, and the joint decision is expressed as a pair of utility matrices over pairs of candidate trajectories, resolved by a common rule. The behavioural parameters are fitted by inverse reinforcement learning from 409 minutes of driving by ten pairs of people in human-driven PMVs in an indoor environment, and the lanes the pair can use are derived offline from the corridor itself rather than fixed by hand. A safety layer the cost cannot override executes a move only if the vehicle can still brake clear, measured from its whole body, and a vehicle that is stuck reverses along its own path and continues. In closed-loop simulation over 24 runs in the conditions the drivers were recorded in and 24 in four generated obstacle layouts, no vehicle entered a wall or a cone. The pair holds conversational formation for 60.5 and 68.9 percent of the time among obstacles (anticlockwise and clockwise) and 81.2 and 91.5 percent in a clear aisle, against the drivers' 34.0 and 36.0 percent, and 52.9 and 56.0 percent, and it matches their speed. It keeps one lateral formation where the drivers alternated between a close diagonal and a wide abreast one, and it varies far less. Experimental results are based on a differential drive kinematic simulator running on ROS 2.

</details>


### [188] [On Shaky Ground: Characterising Non-Rigid Base Effects in Mobile Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36725v1)
*Zongyuan Zhang,Christopher Lehnert,Will N. Browne,Jonathan M. Roberts*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文以砂带/打磨作业为案例，结合仿真与两台轻量无驱动轮式平台的实验，研究非刚性基座效应对移动机械臂持续接触任务的影响。结果显示低基座-地面阻力下100 N指令仅实现54–70%，工具中心点误差达100 mm；接触中提高基座-地面阻力可改善力实现并抑制工具位移，而基座振动与力跟踪误差无一致关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机械臂可将接触作业能力拓展到固定机器人工作空间之外，但其基座还需承受作业产生的反力。在轻量平台上，基座运动与支撑柔顺性会改变实际作用于工件的力与运动，而这类非刚性基座效应在持续接触过程中的表现尚缺乏充分刻画。

Method: 采用打磨（sanding）案例研究，将探索性仿真与两台轻量、无驱动轮式试验平台的实验相结合，同步测量接触力、工具运动与基座振动，并考察改变基座-地面阻力对力实现与工具位移的作用。

Result: 持续接触与显著的任务误差并存：低基座-地面阻力条件下，100 N指令力仅实现54–70%，工具中心点误差达100 mm；在接触过程中提高基座-地面阻力可改善力实现并阻止工具进一步位移；在所测条件下，基座振动未随力跟踪误差呈现一致变化。

Conclusion: 非刚性基座行为会实质影响接触任务的执行质量，表征轻量移动操作时应将力、运动与振动三者联合考察，而非仅依赖单一力跟踪指标。

Abstract: Mobile robot manipulators extend contact-task capability beyond the workspace of fixed robot installations, but their bases must also sustain the forces generated by the task. On lightweight platforms, base motion and support compliance can change the force and motion realised at the workpiece. How these non-rigid base effects manifest during sustained contact remains insufficiently characterised. This paper investigates non-rigid base effects in mobile robot manipulators through a sanding case study combining exploratory simulation with experiments on two lightweight, unactuated wheeled testbeds. Joint measurements of contact force, tool motion, and base vibration show that sustained contact coexisted with substantial task error: under low base-ground resistance, only 54-70% of a 100 N command was realised, with tool-centre-point errors reaching 100 mm. Increasing base-ground resistance during contact improved force realisation and arrested further tool displacement, while base vibration did not vary consistently with force-tracking error in the tested conditions. These observations illustrate how non-rigid base behaviour can affect contact-task execution and highlight the value of examining force, motion, and vibration together when characterising lightweight mobile manipulation.

</details>


### [189] [TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36694v1)
*Tuo An,Chuhao Zhou,Jiahua Dong,Jingliang Li,Jiaqi Bai,Jindou Jia,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TOPS 通过为每个任务定制流匹配的源先验与插值调度（不改网络结构），提升语言条件多任务操作策略的性能与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流的语言条件多任务策略对所有任务共享单一高斯源先验和统一的线性传输路径，难以可靠满足各任务差异化的运动需求。

Method: 1) 由专家动作序列反向映射构造多模态任务源，使语言指令可选择生成起点；2) 依据源-目标协方差失配，在去噪早期放慢向专家动作的过渡、后期沿需扩张方向加速；3) 在高斯端点模型下理论分析该调度可降低速度预测风险上界；4) 无需修改网络架构，可迁移至大规模策略。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN 上，分布内、扰动与跨环境设置均提升性能，并具更好数据效率；单步积分下 LIBERO-10 成功率由十步标准 FM 的 53.44% 升至 69.67%，推理时间约降至基线 1/6；迁移至 π0.5 在四个设置上均有稳定增益；真机上手抽屉开启任务成功率由 20% 升至 80%。

Conclusion: 任务导向的源先验与调度是无需架构改动的有效增强手段，兼顾成功率与推理效率，并可跨策略与真实场景泛化。

Abstract: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline.
