TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.

</details>


### [190] [RoboSTD: Zero-Shot Single-to-Dual Transfer via Sagittal Mirroring for Bimanual Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36685v1)
*Hongyu Wu,Chong Liu,Shaoxuan Xie,Shaqi Luo,Hanyu Feng,Shihan Wu,Guocai Yao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboSTD是一种零样本"单臂到双臂"数据构建方法，通过矢状面镜像生成对侧伪示范，并借助LLM生成时空协调约束来重构伪双臂监督，从而在无需额外双臂示范的情况下提升双臂策略学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂机器人操作在真实场景中很重要，但双臂示范采集成本高，限制了双臂策略学习的规模化发展；而现有单臂数据由于动作空间、协调需求与手臂空间偏好上存在"Single-to-Dual gap"，难以直接迁移到双臂系统。

Method: RoboSTD先对观测、本体感知与动作施加矢状面镜像，构建可执行的对侧伪示范；随后利用LLM生成结构化时空协调约束，指导在不同工作空间区域与任务阶段上重构伪双臂监督信号。在AgileX ALOHA平台的RoboTwin仿真与真实环境中评测。

Result: 实验表明RoboSTD对双臂策略学习有效：在无额外双臂示范的情况下，杯子收集任务中平均收集杯子数量达到单臂基线的2.11倍。

Conclusion: 通过镜像变换与LLM驱动的时空约束重构，可将单臂数据零样本转化为双臂可用监督，缓解双臂数据稀缺问题，是一种可扩展的双臂策略学习数据构建方案。

Abstract: Bimanual robot manipulation plays an important role in real-world robotic applications, but the high cost of collecting bimanual demonstrations limits the scalable development of bimanual policy learning. Meanwhile, existing single-arm manipulation data are difficult to directly transfer to bimanual systems due to the Single-to-Dual gap in action spaces, coordination requirements, and arm-side spatial preference. To address this issue, we propose RoboSTD, a zero-shot Single-to-Dual data construction method for bimanual robot learning. RoboSTD first applies sagittal-plane mirroring to observations, proprioception, and actions to construct executable contralateral pseudo-demonstrations. It then uses an LLM to generate structured spatio-temporal coordination constraints that guide the reconstruction of pseudo-bimanual supervision across workspace regions and task stages. We evaluate RoboSTD on the AgileX ALOHA platform in both RoboTwin simulation and real-world settings. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RoboSTD for bimanual policy learning. Without requiring additional bimanual demonstrations, RoboSTD increases the average number of collected cups to 2.11x that of the single-arm baseline in the cup collection task. Project page: https://huahungy.github.io/RoboSTD/

</details>


### [191] [From Biological Curves to Soft Modular Robots: Learning-Based Inverse Design with Uncertainty-Guided Refinement](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36681v2)
*Dixiang Wang,Minghao Zha,Arifur Rahman,Yinhong Qin,Yitao Jiang,Shiyang Lu,Zebing Mao,Muhao Chen,Luyang Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出学习驱动的 real-to-sim-to-real 框架，通过代理辅助逆向设计与不确定性引导精修，将生物曲线高效转化为电缆驱动模块化软体机器人构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物具有丰富的形变行为（如鳗鱼摆动、尺蠖拱身），用模块化软体机器人复现这些形状有望获得多功能的仿生系统；但现有电缆驱动模块化软体机器人的逆向设计依赖耗时的物理建模与组合搜索，难以高效复现多样目标形状。

Method: 构建学习式 real-to-sim-to-real 框架：将学习到的逆向预测与定向候选探索相结合，用快速前向代理模型评估并筛选候选设计，并以不确定性引导进行精修；在仿真中训练、迁移到真实机器人。

Result: 前向代理将形变预测时间从 1.53×10^5 ms 降至 0.0008 ms（约 1.9×10^8 倍加速）；逆向设计时间从 1.99×10^6 ms 降至 4.18 ms；在 5000 个未见穿线模式的测试样本上，代理评估下的形状重建成功率达 93%；四个仿生机器人的物理演示验证了生物曲线到可实现机器人形状的转化。

Conclusion: 代理辅助的逆向设计可显著提升模块化软体机器人形状复现的效率与成功率，为生物形态到机器人构型的自动转化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Animals exhibit diverse shape-changing behaviors, from the undulatory swimming of eels to the arching movements of inchworms. Reproducing these biological shapes with modular soft robots offers a promising approach to developing versatile bioinspired robotic systems. However, translating a desired shape into a feasible robotic configuration remains challenging. Existing cable-driven modular soft robots rely on computationally expensive physics-based modeling and combinatorial search for inverse design, making it difficult to efficiently reproduce diverse target shapes. To address this challenge, we present a learning-based real-to-sim-to-real framework that translates biological curves into robotic configurations through surrogate-assisted inverse design and uncertainty-guided refinement. The proposed method combines learned inverse prediction with targeted candidate exploration, using a fast forward surrogate to evaluate and select suitable designs. The learned forward surrogate reduces deformation prediction time from $1.53 \times 10^5$ ms to 0.0008 ms, achieving approximately a $1.9 \times 10^8$-fold speedup. At the same time, the proposed inverse design method reduces design time from $1.99 \times 10^6$ ms to 4.18 ms. On 5,000 test samples generated from previously unseen threading patterns, the method achieves a 93% shape reconstruction success rate under surrogate-based evaluation. Physical demonstrations with four bioinspired robots further illustrate the translation of biological curves into realizable robotic shapes.

</details>


### [192] [SWIM: Learning What Matters from Behaviors for JEPA World Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36662v1)
*Jiaming Hu,Shi Bo,Yan Zheng,Tian Wang,Florian Dubost,Alejandro Mottini,Junze Liu,Arvind Srinivasan,Kai Zhong,Kun Qian,Sharon Gao,Vianne Gao,Houyu Zhang,Qingjun Cui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SWIM方法，利用逆动力学模型从离线轨迹中学习状态特征权重，构建加权状态度量用于状态监督的世界模型训练，在五个仿真机器人操作任务上提升规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA类世界模型的视觉预测目标未显式包含任务相关状态信息，导致决定任务进展的物理状态未必被可靠编码。用仿真器状态做监督可提升规划信息量，但需确定哪些状态特征重要；现有做法为手工选择或均匀加权，而均匀加权会让冗余坐标重复计入同一变化、无关特征掩盖任务相关差异。

Method: SWIM（State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model）：以当前状态和观测到的未来位移为输入，预测记录的动作，从离线轨迹中学习各状态特征的权重；该权重刻画每个特征对动作预测的贡献，并据此定义加权状态度量，用于状态监督训练（文中以对齐潜空间距离与状态距离的方式实现）。逆动力学模型仅用于训练阶段。

Result: 在五个仿真机器人操作任务上，SWIM相对均匀状态加权一致地提升了规划成功率；由于逆动力学模型仅训练时使用，所得世界模型在规划阶段仅依赖图像，无额外计算开销。

Conclusion: 从逆动力学可预测性中自动导出状态特征权重，是一种无需手工设计、可替代均匀加权的状态监督方案，能有效改善JEPA世界模型的规划性能，且不增加推理成本。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) enable world models to plan from images by predicting future embeddings. However, their visual prediction objectives do not explicitly incorporate task-relevant state information, so the physical state that determines task progress may not be reliably captured in the latent space. Supervising world models with simulator state can make planning more informative, but it requires deciding which state features matter. Features are typically selected by hand or weighted uniformly, and a uniform weighting gives every standardized state feature equal influence, so redundant coordinates can overcount the same variation, while irrelevant ones can obscure task-relevant differences. To address this limitation, we propose SWIM (State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model), which learns state weights from offline trajectories by predicting recorded actions from current states and observed future displacements. The learned weights quantify each feature's contribution to action prediction and define a weighted state metric for state-supervised training, which we demonstrate by aligning latent and state distances. The inverse-dynamics model is used only during training, so the resulting world model plans from images with no additional planning-time computation. Across five simulated robotic manipulation tasks, SWIM consistently improves planning success over uniform state weighting.

</details>


### [193] [HumiMimic: Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36615v2)
*Nghia Le,Khang Nguyen,Ba Long Tran,Thi Quynh Nhu Pham,Binh Nguyen,Tuong Do,Erman Tjiputra,Hoan Nguyen,Tung D. Ta,Baoru Huang,Hai-Nguyen Nguyen,Anh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 HumiTransfer，一个仿体映射（mimetic embodiment transfer）框架，将野外人类-人类交互视频转换为物理可行的人-人形机器人交互动作，并据此构建 HumiMimic 数据集（约50万帧），支持交互动作生成与真机部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人与人自然交互不仅需保留个体动作，还需保留交互中的空间、语义与接触关系（拥抱、跳舞、握手等）；同时方案需跨不同形态与运动学约束的人形本体泛化。

Method: HumiTransfer 首先重建具有一致足-地接触的3D人体运动；随后通过交互建模将其中一方迁移至目标人形本体，采用加权关节相对方向（weighted joint-relative directions）与解剖偏移（anatomical offsets）以优先保证交互关键的体间关系；最后通过重定向后优化（post-retargeting optimization）施加平衡、接触与避碰约束。

Result: 将 HumiTransfer 应用于1200段野外视频，为26自由度 Unitree R1 Edu 与23自由度 HighTorque Mini-hi 生成约50万帧多样交互数据，构成 HumiMimic 数据集；在两种机器人上均取得更优的运动保真度、体间关系保持与接触精度；HumiMimic 可支撑跟随人类伙伴的交互动作生成方法；真机部署验证了迁移动作的物理可执行性。

Conclusion: HumiTransfer 可实现从野外交互视频到多本体人形机器人交互动作的可扩展迁移，兼顾交互关系保持与物理可行性，并通过数据集与真机实验验证其对数据生成、动作合成及实际部署的价值。

Abstract: Enabling a humanoid to interact naturally with human partners requires preserving not only individual motions but also the spatial, semantic, and contact relationships underlying the interaction (i.e., hugging, dancing, hand-shaking, etc.). Furthermore, a practical solution should generalize across various humanoid embodiments with distinct morphologies and kinematic constraints. To tackle this challenge, we propose HumiTransfer, a mimetic embodiment transfer framework that converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions. HumiTransfer first reconstructs 3D human motion with consistent foot-ground contact, then transfers one participant to a target humanoid embodiment via interaction modeling, using weighted joint-relative directions and anatomical offsets to prioritize interaction-critical inter-body relationships, while post-retargeting optimization enforces balance, contact, and collision avoidance. Subsequently, we apply HumiTransfer to 1,200 in-the-wild videos, producing approximately 500,000 frames of diverse interactions for the 26-DoF Unitree R1 Edu and the 23-DoF HighTorque Mini-hi humanoid robot, resulting in our HumiMimic dataset. Across both robots, HumiTransfer achieves superior motion fidelity, preserves inter-body relationships, and maintains contact accuracy compared with existing baselines. Moreover, we demonstrate that HumiMimic supports motion generation methods for synthesizing interactive humanoid motions following a human partner. Finally, our real robot deployments confirm the physical executability of the transferred motions in real-world settings. Our project is available at https://aioznetwork.github.io/HumiMimic/

</details>


### [194] [Camera-to-Quadruped Robot Pose Estimation from Sequential Images](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36599v1)
*Seobin Hwang,Ji-Seong Beom,Yeong-Jun Cho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出QuadPose，从单目视频序列估计四足机器人全身18自由度姿态（6-DoF基座位姿+12-DoF关节角），并构建首个相机到四足机器人姿态基准QuadSyn；在QuadSyn上达到92.18% PCK@2.5px与约33 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人越来越多地被部署于灾害响应、设施巡检等危险环境，外部相机监控对安全运行至关重要。但四足机器人是带时变腿部关节、腿部对称性和频繁自遮挡的铰接系统，导致关键点对应关系存在歧义；同时缺乏公开基准，难以进行定量比较。

Method: 提出QuadPose，以单目视频序列为输入，回归四足机器人全身18自由度姿态，包括6自由度基座位姿与12自由度关节角；同时构建首个相机到四足机器人的姿态基准QuadSyn，用于定量评测。

Result: 在QuadSyn上，QuadPose取得92.18% PCK@2.5px、95.54% PCK-AUC、85.94% ADD@20cm、66.98% ADD-AUC，平均关节角误差3.65度，运行速度约33 FPS。

Conclusion: 该方法在无需外部标记的单目视频设置下实现了较高精度的全身姿态估计并保持实时性，同时通过QuadSyn填补了该任务公开基准的空缺，为后续定量比较提供平台。

Abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly deployed in hazardous environments such as disaster response and facility inspection, where external-camera monitoring is essential for safe operation. This setting is challenging because quadrupeds are articulated systems with time-varying leg joints, leg symmetry, and frequent self-occlusions, which make keypoint correspondence ambiguous. Moreover, no public benchmark exists, making quantitative comparison difficult. To address these challenges, we propose QuadPose, which estimates the full-body 18-DoF pose (6-DoF base pose + 12-DoF joint angles) from monocular video sequences, and introduce QuadSyn, the first camera-to-quadruped robot pose benchmark. On QuadSyn, QuadPose achieves 92.18% PCK@2.5px, 95.54% PCK-AUC, 85.94% ADD@20cm, 66.98% ADD-AUC, and 3.65 degree mean joint-angle error at approximately 33 FPS.

</details>


### [195] [OpenJaws: An Open Hardware UMI Framework with Stereo Localization for Generalist Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36598v1)
*Adithyavairavan Murali,Yash Oza,Karanbir Chahal,Neel Jawale,Silas De Vries,Hesam Rabeti,Erwin Coumans,Balakumar Sundaralingam,Stan Birchfield*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenJaws：一套完全开源（硬件+软件）的带传感 UMI 手持示教采集框架，以低成本双目相机替代单目视觉惯性里程计来恢复米制相机轨迹，并发布 UMI-Loc-Bench-v1 定位精度基准，证明双目定位显著优于单目方案，且所采数据训练的策略可迁移至真实机器人执行多类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMI 类手持采集接口可在无机器人参与的条件下于野外收集操作示教，但动作标签质量受制于视觉定位精度。现有方案要么依赖单目视觉惯性里程计（存在尺度歧义与漂移），要么依赖闭源跟踪模块与外部基础设施（带来成本与部署负担）。因此需要一个开源、低成本、高定位精度且易于跨平台部署的方案。

Method: 1) 模块化 3D 打印夹爪，带标准化 ISO 适配器，便于对接不同机械臂；2) 低成本双目相机恢复米制尺度相机轨迹，替代单目 VIO；3) 提出 UMI-Loc-Bench-v1 基准，用于量化手持采集设备在真实场景中的定位精度；4) 用 OpenJaws 采集数据训练策略并在真实机器人上部署验证。

Result: UMI-Loc-Bench-v1 实验显示双目定位精度显著优于单目方案；基于 OpenJaws 数据训练的策略可在真实机器人上完成多类操作任务部署。硬件、软件与数据以商业友好许可开源。

Conclusion: OpenJaws 通过开源硬件加双目传感的组合，缓解了手持示教中的尺度歧义与漂移问题，降低了跨机器人平台的部署成本，并提供可复现的定位评测基准，为 UMI 范式的开放化与实用化奠定基础。

Abstract: Handheld data-collection interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) allow manipulation demonstrations to be gathered in the wild without a robot in the loop, but the quality of the resulting action labels is bounded by the accuracy of vision-based localization. Existing systems recover end-effector pose from monocular visual-inertial odometry, which is subject to scale ambiguity and drift, or delegate tracking to closed-source modules and external infrastructure that reintroduce cost and setup burden. We present OpenJaws, a fully open hardware and software framework for sensorized UMI that improves localization and simplifies deployment across robot platforms. OpenJaws pairs a modular, 3D-printed gripper exposing a standardized ISO adapter with a low-cost stereo camera to recover metric camera trajectories. We further introduce UMI-Loc-Bench-v1, a benchmark quantifying real-world localization accuracy for handheld data-collection devices, and show that stereo localization substantially outperforms monocular alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected with OpenJaws can be deployed on a real robot across multiple tasks. Hardware, software, and data are released under a commercially permissive license. Code, data, and videos are available at https://open-jaws.github.io/

</details>


### [196] [REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36546v1)
*Shengzhang Xu,Yuning Guo,Weiyi Hu,Yifeng Xu,Zhongyu Li,He Kong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REACH 是一个基于强化学习的分层框架，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人通过变高度双足行走与爬行穿越高度受限环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 狭小受限空间中的仿人运动需要跨多种运动模式的连续高度适应，而现有方法大多只限于高度可调的双足行走，蹲行仍受离地间隙限制。

Method: 分层 RL 框架：双足行走（1.27–0.50 m）与爬行（0.50–0.20 m）两个互补高度指令区间的策略；面向富接触爬行动力学采用历史条件化的潜表示，从本体感知观测中提取地形与交互上下文；双向过渡策略连接蹲姿双足行走与爬行，处理大幅运动学与接触不连续；并与 LiDAR 规划器集成，将点云转成无碰撞三维路径与含主动高度目标的运动指令。

Result: 真机实验验证了高度与速度跟踪精度、地形穿越鲁棒性、模式切换可靠性，以及整体流程下的受限空间穿越能力。

Conclusion: 变高度双足行走与爬行的统一学习可实现超出蹲行离地间隙极限的连续高度适应运动，且能与感知规划闭环集成完成受限空间穿越。

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27--0.50m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50--0.20m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiDAR-based planner that converts point clouds into collision-free three-dimensional paths and locomotion commands, including proactive height targets. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate height and velocity tracking, robust terrain traversal, reliable mode transitions and confined-space traversal with the proposed pipeline. Code and videos are available at https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/.

</details>


### [197] [CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36539v1)
*Cunxi Dai,Botao He,Francois R Hogan,Wei Pan,Rao Fu,Wen-Han Hsieh,Ruoshi Liu,Jitendra Malik,Guanya Shi,Akash Sharma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CARD：以“接触力目标”为锚点的无物体模型重定向框架，将视频/动捕/触觉手套统一为手-接触表示，显式保留接触并在真机上用触觉跟踪控制器闭环复现力，显著优于纯运动学与物体感知重定向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据采集（遥操作、动觉示教、可穿戴外骨骼）迫使人通过机器人本体行动，限制了人的灵巧性；重定向可规避该瓶颈，但现有重定向方法只迁移运动学、忽略决定任务成败的真实接触动力学。

Method: 提出CARD：(1) 通过共享的“手–接触”表示统一视频、动捕、触觉手套等人类数据源；(2) 在运动学之外生成显式接触力目标；(3) 设计触觉跟踪控制器，在硬件开环回放下维持接触目标；(4) 针对无触觉源的视频，提出视频到接触模型Vid-HACO（达到新的SOTA）。属仿真器+无物体(object-free)框架。

Result: 在视频、手套、动捕数据及GRAB数据集上，CARD在43%–78%的接触帧上维持接触；纯运动学重定向<10%，物体感知重定向22.5%。将该表述接入基于物理的重定向后，GRAB上严格任务成功率由12%提升至32%。触觉跟踪控制器对硬件回放中复现演示力至关重要。

Conclusion: 通过CARD保留接触，是一种可扩展的、将人类灵巧性迁移到机器人的接口。

Abstract: Humans are dexterous, but traditional data collection paradigms such as teleoperation, kinesthetic teaching, and wearable exoskeletons force humans to act through the robot embodiment, bottlenecking their dexterity. Retargeting can avoid this. However, existing methods purely translate kinematics and ignore the real-world contact dynamics essential for task success. We present CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation, a simulator and object-free framework that retargets human demonstrations to robot actions by explicitly preserving contact force targets. CARD unifies human data sources including video, motion capture, and tactile gloves via a shared hand--contact representation and generates explicit contact force targets in addition to kinematics. To maintain these contact targets during hardware open-loop replay, CARD also introduces a tactile tracking controller. For video which does not contain an explicit tactile source, we present Vid-HACO, our video-to-contact model that sets a new state of the art. Across our video, glove, motion-capture data and the GRAB dataset, CARD maintains contact on $43$--$78\%$ of contact frames, while kinematic and object-aware retargeting methods maintain contact on $<10\%$ and $22.5\%$ of the frames respectively. Further, integrating our formulation into physics-based retargeting improves strict task success from 12\% to 32\% on GRAB dataset. Finally, we show that our tactile tracker is critical to reproduce demonstrated forces during hardware replay. These results establish that contact preservation via CARD is a scalable interface for transferring human dexterity to robots.

</details>


### [198] [A Trainable CPG Framework for Quadruped Locomotion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36537v1)
*Xiyan Liu,Yide Liu,Guoyong Mao,Shaoxing Qu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CPG-ENN框架，将基于对称性的八神经元CPG与预训练腿部共享执行网络结合，单个反馈策略调制六个可解释轨迹变量，实现五种步态及任意步态间切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人多步态控制通常依赖步态专用的学习控制器和切换专用奖励，步态间切换与速度调节难以统一且缺乏可解释性。

Method: 对称性八神经元CPG产生步态节律；预训练的腿部共享执行网络（ENN）将节律信号与轨迹参数映射为关节角参考，无需在线逆运动学；单一反馈策略调制六个物理可解释的轨迹变量以跟踪平面速度与偏航角速度指令。

Result: 仿真中20组有向步态对及{0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0} m/s全部源-目标速度组合的切换成功率达99.39%；消融显示未训练切换时跨步态切换仍具高可行性，切换样本主要改善步态获取与速度瞬态；与AllGaits、Walk These Ways对比显示更准确的步态-速度调节；Unitree Go2实机验证五种步态及其切换。

Conclusion: 显式神经协调与学习式运动实现相结合，可在无步态专用控制器和切换奖励的条件下统一实现多步态运动与高成功率切换，并在实机上得到验证。

Abstract: We present CPG-ENN, a trainable quadruped locomotion framework that combines explicit neural coordination with learned motion realization. A symmetry-based eight-neuron central pattern generator (CPG) supplies gait rhythms, while a pretrained, leg-shared execution neural network (ENN) maps rhythmic signals and trajectory parameters to joint-angle references without online inverse kinematics. A single feedback policy modulates six physically interpretable trajectory variables. The controller tracks planar velocity and yaw-rate commands across walk, trot, pace, bound, and pronk without gait-specific learned controllers or transitionspecific rewards. Simulation yields 99.39% transition success across all 20 directed gait pairs and all source-target speed combinations from {0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0} m/s. Ablations show high cross-gait transition feasibility without transition exposure; exposure mainly refines gait acquisition and velocity transients. Comparisons with AllGaits and Walk These Ways demonstrate accurate gait-speed regulation, and Unitree Go2 experiments validate five gaits and their transitions.

</details>


### [199] [A generalist policy for muscle-driven control across individual musculoskeletal models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36535v1)
*Bozhao Wang,Yinglei Zhu,Zhengqing Li,Zhiyuan Zhang,Weiming Kang,Yiheng He,XinJun Liu,Senhao Hou,Huichan Zhao,Xiaoqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MyoAcross 是一个结合个体肌骨模型构建、形态条件化策略学习与虚拟模型增广的框架，实现无需个体微调的肌肉驱动参考运动跟踪，并在31个留出个体模型上达到99.24%完成率、跟踪误差降低22.60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体间肌骨形态差异使策略难以跨模型复用，缺乏统一的控制框架用于跨个体的运动比较仿真。

Method: 构建个体化肌骨模型；学习以形态为条件的策略（morphology-conditioned policy learning）；采用虚拟模型增广（含不对称增广，覆盖单侧下肢短缩模型）；仅依赖单张图像形状估计、实测身高与体重构建模型。

Result: 31个留出个体模型上完成率99.24%，跟踪误差较无条件MLP降低22.60%；策略可迁移至22名个体的单图估计模型及单侧下肢短缩模型；与额外120名个体实测数据相比，垂直地面反作用力波形一致，肌肉激活与肌电的一致性依通道而异。

Conclusion: 结果为跨个体肌骨模型的运动比较仿真建立了通用控制框架。

Abstract: Differences in musculoskeletal morphology challenge policy reuse across individual models. Here we present MyoAcross, a framework that combines individual musculoskeletal model construction, morphology-conditioned policy learning and virtual model augmentation to enable muscle-driven reference-motion tracking without individual fine-tuning. Across 31 held-out individual models, MyoAcross achieves 99.24% completion and reduces tracking error by 22.60% relative to an unconditioned multilayer perceptron. Policy reuse extends to models of 22 held-out individuals constructed from single-image shape estimates, measured height and body mass, and, with asymmetry augmentation, to models with unilateral lower-limb shortening. Comparisons with measurements from 120 additional individuals show agreement in vertical ground reaction force waveforms and channel-dependent agreement between simulated muscle activations and electromyography. These results establish a common control framework for comparative simulations of movement across individual musculoskeletal models.

</details>


### [200] [RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36533v1)
*Buzhao Liu,Jianing Ye,Xiu Yuan,Yangtong Feng,Chengsong Huang,Tyler Dinh,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Ning Zhang,Chongjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoboAuto框架，通过层级知识库、场景接地与多阶段实验规划，把对象级/场景级/交互级物理理解显式组织进LLM智能体的机器人程序搜索流程，在多个基准和真机长程任务上显著超越ASPIRE与π_0.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Code-as-Policy类方法主要依赖执行反馈来迭代改进程序，缺乏对"物体如何被操作、场景几何如何约束动作、交互为何成功或失败"的物理理解，导致程序搜索效率与成功率受限。

Method: 三组件构成：(1) 层级知识库，将可执行技能与以物体为中心的知识（可供性、空间关系、动作效果）结合，并从具身数据和在线任务求解中学习；(2) 场景接地，把知识关联到当前环境，识别相关物体并解析对动作关键的物理量；(3) 多阶段规划与自主设计实验，检查每阶段是否产生预期物理效果，并主动检验竞争性假设以消解物理不确定性。

Result: 在五个基准族上均取得更优表现：LIBERO-PRO短程任务成功率89.1%；在LIBERO-PRO Long与LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率超过ASPIRE的两倍；在三项需要精细操作的长程真机任务上优于ASPIRE和π_0.5。此外，知识库可跨仿真器与跨具身迁移，且程序搜索性能随知识库规模增长而提升。

Conclusion: 显式组织多层级物理理解是提升LLM智能体机器人程序搜索的有效途径，且其知识具备可迁移性与可扩展性；但方法仍依赖知识库构建质量与人工设计的实验机制。

Abstract: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

</details>


### [201] [GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36507v1)
*Liang Li,Guoyao Zhang,Xingyu Chen,Sikai Wu,Qianyang Wu,Yuhang Lin,Renjing Xu,Mingliang Zhou,Diyun Xiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GRAFT：一种面向冻结行为基础模型（BFM）的几何感知残差适配框架，仅用轻量适配器对下半身执行目标施加地形条件修正，将地形学习简化为执行层适配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BFM主要基于平地运动训练，缺乏显式机制来调整落足点、摆动高度与接触时序以适应局部地形；而地形感知方法通常需联合感知重训或微调跟踪器，数据与算力开销大，且将普通跟踪与感知通路耦合。

Method: 保持BFM参数与运动参考接口冻结；轻量适配器仅对下半身执行目标添加地形条件残差修正；用任务奖励与足部几何奖励训练，并加正则项抑制平地上的多余修正；通过特权地形观测蒸馏至机载深度输入。在四个冻结跟踪器上实例化。

Result: 仿真中评估楼梯、沟槽与平台地形；在Unitree G1实机部署，适配后的SONIC跟踪器仅凭机载深度与未修改的运动参考即可跨越地形。

Conclusion: 冻结BFM已提供全身参考跟踪与名义运动能力，因此地形适应可被有效缩减为聚焦的执行层适配问题；残差适配在低成本下赋予跟踪器地形感知能力并保持参考接口不变。

Abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) provide reusable whole-body motion priors: given a kinematic reference, they generate coordinated joint commands for motion replay, teleoperation, and VLA control. However, trained primarily on flat-ground motion, BFMs lack an explicit mechanism to adapt foot placement, swing clearance, and contact timing to local terrain. Many terrain-aware BFM approaches address this limitation by retraining or fine-tuning the tracker together with perception, incurring substantial data and computation costs while coupling ordinary tracking to the perception pathway. To bridge this gap, we propose GRAFT, a geometry-aware residual adaptation framework for frozen behavior trackers. GRAFT preserves the BFM parameters and motion-reference interface, while a lightweight adapter adds terrain-conditioned corrections only to lower-body execution targets. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized to suppress unnecessary corrections on flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth. Because the frozen BFM already provides whole-body reference tracking and nominal locomotion, GRAFT reduces terrain learning to a focused execution-adaptation problem. We instantiate the framework on four frozen trackers and evaluate stairs, gaps, and platforms in simulation. We further validate it through real-world deployment on a Unitree G1, where the adapted SONIC tracker traverses terrain with onboard depth and unmodified references.

</details>


### [202] [SVIn+: Multi-Modal Framework for Robust Underwater State Estimation using 3D Sonar, Visual-Inertial, Water-Pressure, and DVL](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36454v1)
*Chinmay Burgul,Xiaoming Zhao,Yewei Huang,Michalis Chatzispyrou,Marios Xanthidis,Ioannis Rekleitis,Alberto Quattrini Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SVIn+ 是一个用于 AUV 鲁棒状态估计的多传感器紧耦合框架，在开源视觉惯性 SLAM 系统 SVIn 基础上融合水压与 DVL 测量，并通过 KISS-ICP 声呐前端的分层因子图设计提升精度与全局一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下作业规模扩大，AUV 自主性需求提升；状态估计是控制、导航与建图的基础难题，在低能见度条件下尤为困难，单一模态难以可靠工作。

Method: 在 SVIn（视觉惯性 SLAM）基础上，将水压传感器与 DVL 速度测量以紧耦合方式并入非线性优化（因子图）公式；对紧凑型 3D 声呐采用分层架构，用解耦前端 KISS-ICP 提供相对位姿因子并作为约束加入因子图，以利用声学结构信息同时保持计算效率。

Result: 在沉船与珊瑚礁现场部署测试中验证，相比基线实现漂移抑制，并获得全局一致的地图/轨迹估计。

Conclusion: 将 IMU、相机、水压、DVL 与 3D 声呐进行紧耦合多模态融合，并配合解耦声呐前端的分层设计，可有效提升低能见度水下 AUV 状态估计的鲁棒性与一致性；代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: As expansion and scalability in underwater oper- ations becomes more important and challenging, autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) become more relevant and the necessity for reliable autonomy more critical. A fundamental challenge in any autonomous underwater operation, from control to safe navigation and mapping, is state estimation; a notorious hard problem to address, especially in low visibility conditions. In this paper, we tackle this problem, by presenting SVIn+, a multi-sensor framework for robust state estimation of AUVs equipped with an IMU, cameras, a water-pressure sensor, a Doppler Velocity Log (DVL), and a compact 3D sonar. This framework extends an established open-source state-of-the-art visual-inertial SLAM, SVIn, by integrating water-pressure and DVL measurements into a tightly-coupled nonlinear optimiza- tion formulation resulting in improved estimates. To leverage the structural information of recently available 3D acoustic sonars while maintaining computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical architecture that incorporates estimates from a decoupled front-end via KISS-ICP, treated as relative pose factors within the factor graph. The proposed framework is validated through field deployments in a shipwreck and coral reef, demonstrating drift mitigation and global consistency. To support further research in underwater multi-modal fusion, the code and the datasets can be found on project website https://cmburgul.github.io/projects/svin+/ https://dartmouthrobotics.github.io/svin-plus

</details>


### [203] [Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36452v1)
*Michael Drolet,Oleg Arenz,Jan Peters*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种由高层控制器生成的简洁运动表示（离散运动token），可直接作为全身运动跟踪策略的参考接口，实现人形机器人基于行为标签或文本指令的舞蹈、格斗、行走等运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 速度指令型RL策略对人形机器人复杂全身运动而言接口过于受限；现有全身运动跟踪策略缺乏对未来期望运动的信息，难以进行受控偏离以实现长期任务成功，尤其在行为切换准备阶段。

Method: 采用简洁运动表示（可由高层控制器依据行为标签或文本命令生成），直接输入跟踪策略以提供详细运动参考；使用随机运动tokenizer（对比FSQ与VQ-VAE）构建离散接口，条件化全身跟踪策略。

Result: 在同等容量下，随机运动tokenizer对Unitree G1运动的重建效果优于FSQ与VQ-VAE等SOTA方法；在实体Unitree G1上执行了每段16.8 s的舞蹈、格斗、行走运动及35 s的格斗到舞蹈序列切换。

Conclusion: 离散运动token接口可有效条件化全身跟踪策略，支持灵活、长时序的真人形机器人全身运动与行为转换。

Abstract: While velocity-commanded RL policies are effective for controlling quadrupeds, they are a limited interface for humanoids that need to perform complex whole-body motions. Furthermore, RL tracking policies for whole-body motions typically have limited information about the desired future motion, preventing them from performing controlled deviations to achieve long-term task success; such information is particularly relevant when a controller must prepare for transitions between behaviors. We address these challenges using concise motion representations that can be generated by a high-level controller, given a behavior label or text command. These representations can be fed directly into a tracking policy to provide a detailed motion reference. Our method exhibits a high degree of flexibility in performing real-world robot motions such as dancing, fighting, or walking based on conditional information. At matched capacity, our adopted stochastic motion tokenizer reconstructs motions from the Unitree G1 at a level that exceeds state-of-the-art approaches such as finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and the vector-quantized autoencoder (VQ-VAE). The resulting discrete interface conditions whole-body tracking policies that execute generated dance, fight, and walk motions lasting 16.8 s each and a 35 s fight-to-dance sequence on a physical Unitree G1.

</details>


### [204] [Ground Sample Distance Constrained k-Coverage Viewpoint Planning via Set Multi-Cover Formulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36450v1)
*Waleed Bin Khalid,Chul Min Yeum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对体素化结构，在GSD约束下求解k覆盖视点选择问题：候选视点沿外表面方向生成并经距离、视角、视场、遮挡筛选，选择建模为带逐体素覆盖需求的集合多重覆盖，提出动态加权贪心启发式，与顺序重叠剪枝及ILP对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机3D重建与检测需要满足图像质量约束、且对每个表面区域多次观测的视点，而基于重叠的规划启发式无法保证这一点。

Method: 候选视点沿外表面方向生成，经距离、视角、视场与遮挡测试筛选，并对可见性不足的体素进行增补；选择问题建模为带逐体素覆盖需求的集合多重覆盖；提出优先考虑剩余覆盖缺口与稀缺观测替代方案的动态加权贪心启发式；在相同候选池上与顺序重叠剪枝和ILP公式对比。

Result: 在两种结构、四种体素分辨率、三种覆盖要求下，所提方法以紧凑视点集实现完整或接近完整的k覆盖，视点数仅比ILP多3.00–16.39%。

Conclusion: 动态加权贪心在接近ILP质量的同时，提供了基于覆盖缺口与视点可用性的可解释选择过程。

Abstract: Drone-based 3D reconstruction and inspection require viewpoints that satisfy image-quality constraints while observing each surface region multiple times, which overlap-based planning heuristics do not guarantee. We study ground sample distance (GSD)-constrained $k$-coverage viewpoint selection for structures represented by surface voxels. Candidate viewpoints are generated along outward surface directions, screened with distance, viewing-angle, field-of-view, and occlusion tests, and augmented for voxels with insufficient visibility. Selection is then posed as set multi-cover with per-voxel coverage demands. We propose a dynamically weighted greedy heuristic that prioritizes remaining coverage deficits and scarce viewing alternatives, and compare it with sequential overlap-based pruning and an integer linear programming (ILP) formulation on the same candidate pools. Across two structures, four voxel resolutions, and three coverage requirements, the proposed approach achieves full or near-full $k$-coverage with compact viewpoint sets, using only 3.00--16.39\% more viewpoints than ILP while offering an interpretable selection process based on coverage deficits and viewpoint availability.

</details>


### [205] [A Singularity Avoiding Track Model for Race Car Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36430v1)
*Adwait Verulkar,Behzad Danaei,Srikanth Sivaramakrishnan,Ryan Trinter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一条赛道拟合流程：将实测赛道点云转换为闭合、\(C^4\) 可微的三维曲面模型，用于高保真 Modelica 赛车优化；曲面采用以最小曲率线（MCL）为基准的 Monge 片参数化，并以周期分段五次 \(C^4\) B 样条导出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 若以几何中心线作为参数化基准，在急弯处相邻法线会在可行驶区域内相交，导致参数化非单射（同一三维点对应多个弧长坐标），从而产生无效道路几何。因此需要选择更合适的参考线以保证全赛道宽度内法线映射单射。

Method: 1) 构造 Monge 片曲面：以沿 MCL 的曲线弧长坐标与带符号横向偏移为参数，横截面高程用可选阶次的多项式描述；2) MCL 由二次规划求解，目标为最小化积分曲率，约束包括赛道边界、周期性及加加速度（jerk）正则化；3) 曲面与赛道宽度导出为周期分段五次 \(C^4\) B 样条，作为非线性规划求解。

Result: 在总曲率降低且不越出赛道边界的前提下，MCL 使参数化失效区域在所有研究赛道上均落在可行驶带之外，法线映射在全赛道宽度内保持单射；同时得到更线性的"时间—弧长"变换，有利于最小单圈时间问题。

Conclusion: 以 MCL 为参考线的 Monge 片参数化可生成闭合、\(C^4\) 可微、单射有效的三维赛道曲面，适用于高保真赛车优化。

Abstract: A track fitting pipeline is presented that converts a measured racetrack point cloud into a closed, $C^4$ differentiable, three-dimensional surface model suitable for high-fidelity Modelica race-car optimization. The surface is a Monge patch, parametrised by a curvilinear arc-length coordinate measured along the minimum-curvature line (MCL) and a signed lateral offset, with a height polynomial of user-selectable degree capturing the cross-sectional elevation profile. The choice of MCL as the reference line is deliberate since anchoring the same surface on the geometric centre-line can cause adjacent normals to cross inside the drivable region on tight corners. The resulting non-injective parametrisation assigns multiple curvilinear addresses to the same three-dimensional point and returns invalid road geometry. The MCL is obtained from a quadratic program that minimises integrated curvature subject to track-boundary, periodicity, and jerk-regularisation constraints. By reducing total curvature while remaining within the track bounds, the MCL moves the region of parametrisation breakdown outside the drivable strip on all circuits studied, keeps the normal map injective across the full track width, and yields a more linear time-to-arc-length transformation for minimum lap-time problems. The fitted surface and the associated track widths are exported as periodic piecewise-quintic $C^4$ B-splines, solved as a nonlinear program.

</details>


### [206] [A 2-DOF MultiBody Track Joint for Race Car Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36407v1)
*Srikanth Sivaramakrishnan,Behzad Danaei,Adwait Verulkar,Ryan Trinter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 TrackJoint：一个 Modelica MultiBody 组件，将三维道路曲面表示为二自由度关节（沿参考线的弧长 + 横向偏移），用于赛车最小圈速优化与仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 赛车最小圈速优化通常需要对道路约束建模，传统方法依赖拉格朗日乘子或对模型做大幅修改；作者希望用单一模型同时支持时域仿真与优化，且无需在两者之间改动模型。

Method: 将道路几何以少量周期分段五次样条输入关节；两个关节坐标映射为单个 frame_b 连接器的位置、姿态与角速度；用达朗贝尔原理闭合道路约束，将对应两个广义力置零从而避免拉格朗日乘子。关节与多体赛车模型在 Dymola 中连接并导出为 FMI 3.0 FMU，同一 FMU 用于时域仿真与 CasADi/IPOPT 最小圈速优化；因关节保留弧长为真实状态并发布其时间导数，问题可改写为以距离为自变量。

Result: 在新加坡 Formula 1 赛道上给出了最小圈速仿真结果，验证了同一 FMU 在仿真与优化中复用的一致性。

Conclusion: 以二自由度关节封装道路几何并基于达朗贝尔原理闭合约束，可获得无乘子、可复用的 FMI 组件，实现仿真与优化的统一模型流程。

Abstract: TrackJoint is a Modelica MultiBody component that turns a three-dimensional road surface into a joint with two degrees of freedom. The two joint coordinates are the distance travelled along a reference line and the sideways offset from that line. Together they give the position, orientation and angular velocity of a single frame_b connector. All road geometry reaches the joint as a small set of periodic piecewise-quintic splines, so one component can represent any circuit whose splines have been fitted beforehand. The road constraint is closed with d'Alembert's principle. The two generalized forces that belong to the joint coordinates are set to zero, so no Lagrange multipliers are needed. The joint is connected to a multibody race car in Dymola and the pair is exported as one FMI~3.0 FMU. The same FMU is then used for time-domain simulation and for CasADi/IPOPT minimum lap-time optimization, with no change to the model in between. This works because the joint keeps the arc-length coordinate as a real state and publishes its time derivative, which is the quantity that lets the problem be rewritten with distance We report results for minimum lap time simulations on the Singapore Formula~1 circuit.

</details>


### [207] [HIDRA: Hierarchical Dual-Routing Attention for Replay-Free Lifelong Imitation Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36374v1)
*Fanqi Yu,Matteo Tiezzi,Cigdem Beyan,Tommaso Apicella,Vittorio Murino*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HIDRA 是一个用于无回放、单遍终身模仿学习的结构化路由框架，通过分层双注意力与键级几何正则缓解专家路由干扰，在 LIBERO 系列基准上优于无回放与有回放基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中的机器人智能体需要从多模态演示流中持续学习，且常无法存储或重访历史数据（无回放、单遍）。在这种终身模仿学习设定下，顺序更新会逐渐扭曲表示空间，使基于专家的方法对路由干扰尤为敏感，专家选择能力随时间退化。

Method: 提出 HIDRA 结构化路由框架：(1) 分层双注意力机制，将指令级专家检索与上下文相关的细化解耦；(2) 键级几何正则化，在表示漂移下同时约束任务内对齐与任务间分离；(3) 支持可扩展的专家集合以持续适应。

Result: 在多个 LIBERO 基准套件（含异构任务序列与改写语言指令的更难变体）上，HIDRA 一致优于无回放与有回放基线，提升 AUC 与前向迁移，同时保持较低遗忘率；在高干扰与语言变化条件下增益更明显。

Conclusion: 分层双注意力解耦加键级几何正则能有效稳定表示漂移下的专家路由，实现可靠的专家选择与可扩展的持续适应，为无回放终身模仿学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Robotic agents operating in real-world environments must adapt continuously from a stream of multimodal demonstrations, often under constraints that preclude storing or revisiting past data. In this replay-free, single-pass lifelong imitation learning setting, sequential updates can progressively distort the representation space, making expert-based approaches particularly sensitive to routing interference, causing expert selection to degrade over time. We propose HIDRA, a structured routing framework that mitigates this issue through a hierarchical dual-attention mechanism, which decouples instruction-level expert retrieval from context-dependent refinement. To further stabilize routing under representation drift, HIDRA introduces a key-level geometric regularization that enforces both alignment within tasks and separation across tasks. The resulting approach enables reliable expert selection while supporting an expandable set of experts for continual adaptation. We evaluate HIDRA on several LIBERO benchmark suites, including more challenging variants with heterogeneous task sequences and paraphrased language instructions. Our approach consistently outperforms both replay-free and replay-based baselines, improving AUC and forward transfer while maintaining low forgetting, with stronger gains under high interference and language variation. The code is available at: https://github.com/yfqi/HIDRA.

</details>


### [208] [SG^2SLAM: Spatial Geometry-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Monocular Outdoor Navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36312v1)
*Ziang Guo,Didar Seyidov,Yixiao Zhou,Xuefeng Zhang,Ali Alridha Abdulkarim,Chen Min,Zufeng Zhang,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SG^2SLAM用"流式空间几何"（chunk级度量先验统一监督跟踪与建图）与"光线条件化3DGS核"（为每个基元增加视向子空间以感知单目视角）联合优化空间几何与位姿，在KITTI与Waymo上优于逐帧2D-3D关联基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目室外导航需要稳健的相机运动估计与稠密可导航地图，3DGS SLAM通过显式可微参数化与闭式投影适配该任务。但现有系统通常以2D像素与3D点的关联恢复几何，模块化SLAM会把跟踪误差吸收进地图，导致级联式退化。

Method: 提出SG^2SLAM：1）流式空间几何（streaming spatial geometry），以chunk级度量先验替代逐帧跨维对应，从同一来源监督跟踪与建图；2）光线条件化核（ray-conditioned 3DGS kernel），为每个基元扩展一个视向子空间以感知单目相机视角；3）对空间几何与位姿进行联合优化。

Result: 在KITTI与Waymo Open数据集上的单目室外导航实验中，SG^2SLAM超过基于逐帧关联的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过统一几何来源的先验与视向条件化表示，联合优化可获得全局一致的地图与轨迹，缓解模块化SLAM的误差级联问题；代码将在录用后公开。

Abstract: Monocular outdoor navigation requires robust camera motion estimation and a dense, navigable map, where 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM serves this task through an explicit differentiable parameterization and closed-form projection. However, typically, the geometry is recovered by associating 2D pixels with 3D points, so a modular SLAM system absorbs tracking error into the map, leading to cascading degradation. To address these gaps, we present SG^2SLAM, which couples streaming spatial geometry with a ray-conditioned 3DGS kernel. Streaming spatial geometry replaces the per- frame cross-dimensional correspondence with a chunk-level metric prior that supervises tracking and mapping from one source. A ray-conditioned kernel extends each primitive with a viewing-direction subspace that senses the monocular camera viewpoints. The joint optimization over spatial geometry and poses ensures a globally consistent map and trajectory outcome. Experiments on the KITTI and Waymo Open datasets show that our SG^2SLAM surpasses the per-frame association baselines in the monocular outdoor navigation task. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [209] [ASPEN: Adaptive Semantic Reasoning via Command Persistence Prediction for Efficient Navigation VLAs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36285v1)
*Vieri N. Akustia,Bin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ASPEN——基于"命令持续性预测"的事件触发调度器，在冻结的导航VLA策略上按需复用上一命令，减少昂贵的语义推理调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 导航VLA策略在每个控制步都重复进行昂贵的语义推理，即使下一条命令与上一条相同；直接复用命令虽能省算力，但会错过与指令相关的转向或停止，导致行为错误。

Method: 训练一个轻量多模态预测器，输入包含时序观测、语言指令、执行历史与缓存的VLA置信度，预测冻结基础策略是否会重新输出上一命令（命令持续性）。在可复用的命令边界处，若预测持续性足够高则复用命令；否则触发VLA进行新的语义推理。基础策略NaVILA保持冻结，仅做调度级加速。

Result: 在RxR-CE val-unseen跨数据集设定下，VLA调用减少9.5%，估计推理时间（含调度开销）降低8.1%；导航性能与基线相当，92.1%的episode保持与基线完全相同的动作序列。

Conclusion: 以命令持续性预测为触发条件的选择性复用，可在不重新训练基础策略的前提下实现即插即用的推理加速，且大部分场景行为无损；但整体节省幅度约10%，复用收益受命令变更频率限制。

Abstract: Navigation vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke costly semantic reasoning even when the next command remains unchanged. Command reuse can reduce computation but risks missing instruction-dependent turns or stops. We introduce ASPEN, an event-triggered scheduler based on command persistence prediction: estimating whether the frozen base policy would reissue its previous command. A lightweight multimodal predictor combines temporal observations, language instructions, execution history, and cached VLA confidence. At eligible command boundaries, sufficient predicted persistence permits command reuse. Otherwise, ASPEN triggers fresh semantic reasoning from the VLA. Evaluated with frozen NaVILA on cross-dataset RxR-CE val-unseen, ASPEN reduces VLA calls by 9.5% and estimated inference time by 8.1%, including scheduling overhead. It maintains comparable navigation performance and preserves identical baseline action sequences on 92.1% of episodes.

</details>


### [210] [Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36270v1)
*Simone Manni,Annika Wollschläger,Dario Bellicoso,Abel Gawel,Marco Hutter,Simon Le Cleac'h,Jan Brüdigam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出对PPO进行扩展（相位条件critic、相位门控奖励、多相位重置课程），并采用解耦分层控制架构，实现跨异构硬件（Unitree G1、Boston Dynamics Spot+机械臂）的复杂长时程移动操作单一策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂全身移动操作需在单一长时程任务中完成蹲伏、抓取、行走等多种动作；现有方法依赖人类运动数据与对应人形平台，限制平台独立性并带来大量数据处理开销。

Method: 将PPO扩展用于多相位任务：引入相位条件critic、相位门控奖励函数与多相位重置课程以引导探索；并采用解耦分层控制架构，将底层平衡动力学与高层相位执行分离，从而适配不同机器人硬件。

Result: 在Unitree G1 与搭载机械臂的Boston Dynamics Spot 实机上展示了多阶段移动操作技能，并通过消融实验验证了各项设计选择的有效性。

Conclusion: 仅通过环境交互即可习得复杂移动操作行为，并能将高层任务结构直接融入策略学习，实现跨硬件平台的通用性。

Abstract: Complex whole-body loco-manipulation requires executing diverse maneuvers, such as crouching, grasping, and locomotion, within a single long-horizon task. While performing simple pick-and-place behaviors is well-established, scaling to complex, long-horizon tasks remains difficult. Currently, this challenge is addressed by relying on human motion data and correspondingly humanoid platforms, which limits platform independence and introduces substantial data processing overhead. Instead, we extend proximal policy optimization (PPO) to train a single policy for multi-phase tasks across diverse robotic hardware, leveraging prior task structure to shape behavior. Our method adapts PPO using a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated reward functions, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to guide exploration. To support varied hardware, we employ a decoupled hierarchical control architecture that separates lower-level balancing dynamics from high-level phase execution. We demonstrate multi-stage loco-manipulation skills on hardware on both the Unitree G1 and a Boston Dynamics Spot equipped with a manipulator arm, and validate our design choices through ablations. Our approach enables the acquisition of complex loco-manipulation behaviors purely through environment interaction while directly incorporating high-level task structure into policy learning.

</details>


### [211] [cuArms: GPU-Accelerated Conflict-Based Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36250v1)
*Philip Huang,Fabio Ramos,Jiaoyang Li,Caelan Garrett,Lars Johannsmeier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 cuArms：一种与 GPU 并行协同设计的冲突基（conflict-based）多臂规划器，结合高层调度器联合优化任务分配、调度、运动与操作技能，实现实时初始解与随时改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂操作可显著提升吞吐量、效率与灵巧性，但现有方法（任务分配与调度的并行化、联合多臂运动规划、直接学习多臂策略）或过慢、或依赖领域特定假设、或随机器人与任务时域数量增加而扩展性差。

Method: cuArms 采用冲突基搜索框架，与 GPU 并行计算协同设计：利用可复用的多模态路线图（multi-modal roadmaps）高效分解单机器人搜索空间，并通过惰性搜索（lazy search）解决冲突与死锁。上层集成一个调度器，提出候选骨架（skeletons），交由 cuArms 落地为协调的多臂操作计划，从而联合优化任务分配、调度、运动与操作技能。

Result: 实验中达到新的 state of the art：可实时给出初始解，并在运动质量与调度两方面支持 anytime 改进，且无需学习类方法所需的数天领域特定训练；在仿真与真实工业任务上均有验证（视频见项目主页）。

Conclusion: 将冲突基多机器人规划与 GPU 并行、以及高层任务调度器结合，为多臂共享工作单元中的联合任务—运动优化提供了快速、可扩展且免训练的实用方案。

Abstract: Multi-arm manipulation has the potential to dramatically improve the throughput, efficiency, and dexterity of many manipulation tasks. Recent work coordinates multiple robot arms in a shared workcell by allocating and scheduling tasks for greater parallelism, jointly planning multi-arm motions, or directly learning multi-arm policies. So far, these approaches are either too slow, rely on domain-specific assumptions, or scale poorly with the number of robots and task horizon. Thus, we introduce cuArms, a conflict-based planner co-designed with GPU parallelism that efficiently decomposes the search space using reusable multi-modal roadmaps for individual robots and resolves conflicts and deadlocks through a lazy search. To jointly optimize task assignment, schedules, motions, and manipulation skills, we integrate a high-level scheduler that proposes candidate skeletons for cuArms to ground into coordinated manipulation plans. Experimental results show that our method establishes a new state of the art, with real-time initial solutions and anytime improvements in both motion quality and scheduling, without days of domain-specific training required by learning approaches. Videos of both simulated and real-world industrial tasks are available on https://cuarms.github.io/.

</details>


### [212] [Program-Level Adversarial Co-Adaptive Self-Play for Robotic Security](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36143v1)
*Leo Benaharon,Chi Zhang,Wei Zheng,Weifan Zhang,Yifan Wei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出编程层面的对抗性协同自适应自博弈框架：编码智能体在无需模型微调的情况下，基于对手可执行代码与任务反馈生成攻防程序，并在自动驾驶与人形机器人运动控制两个场景做八代案例研究。防御方产出局部任务恢复机制（直接驱动恢复、入站状态校验修正），但未形成持续鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体可通过修改可执行程序来适配机器人软件，但面对不断演化的对手，一次性成功的响应未必持续有效；需要一个能让攻防双方在程序层面持续协同演化、并显式暴露其能力与局限的评估框架。

Method: 构建程序级对抗性协同自适应自博弈框架：不进行模型微调，攻防均由编码智能体编写；以对手已测试代码和任务反馈作为输入生成新版本程序。提供环境特定接口——自动驾驶通过外部程序接入，人形运动通过 SDK 级防御接入。开展两组各八代的案例研究。

Result: 观察到具体软件响应：驾驶防御方引入直接驱动（direct-actuation）恢复机制；人形防御方修改入站状态校验逻辑。这些响应实现局部任务恢复，但未建立持续鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该框架使协同自适应过程及其局限性可通过可执行产物与任务级证据被观测；程序级自博弈可用于研究机器人软件攻防演化，但当前防御仅达局部恢复，持续鲁棒性仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Coding agents can adapt robotic software by revising executable programs, but successful responses to an evolving opponent may not remain effective. We present a framework for program-level adversarial co-adaptive self-play in which coding agents generate attacks and defenses from tested opponent code and mission feedback, without model fine-tuning. Environment-specific interfaces support external programs for autonomous driving and SDK-level defenses for humanoid locomotion. Two eight-generation case studies reveal concrete software responses: a driving defender introduces direct-actuation recovery, while a humanoid defender revises incoming-state validation. These responses provide local task recovery but do not establish sustained robustness. The framework makes such adaptation and limitations observable through executable artifacts and task-level evidence.

</details>


### [213] [Closed-Loop Aware Planning via Imitation-Free Speed Scoring for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36079v1)
*Emad Aghajanzadeh,Thomas Schwarzfischer,Marc Kaufeld,Moritz Thoma,Ryan Pégoud,Manoj Rohit Vemparala,Pierpaolo Mori,Nael Fasfous,Johannes Betz,Daniel Mueller-Gritschneder,Ulf Schlichtmann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CLAP-AD：路径用模仿学习、速度用基于物理安全约束监督的评分函数在候选速度中选择的规划范式，首次在无速度条件训练下实现对端到端驾驶模型测试时速度的显式控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶主要依赖开环模仿学习，存在两点局限：(1) 专家示范每个场景仅一种行为，模型无法学习其他有效行为，也无法在测试时适配用户指定偏好；(2) 示范中的噪声或歧义导致监督不一致、不可靠。驾驶本质是多模态的，同一场景存在多种有效行为，且这种多样性主要来自速度而非路径。

Method: 将规划解耦为路径与速度两部分：路径通过模仿学习获得；速度则对一组候选速度用学习到的评分函数按多准则打分，该评分函数由具有物理依据的安全约束监督。实现为CLAP-AD——可插拔规划头，可与现有端到端驾驶模型集成，且无需速度条件训练即可实现测试时速度选择的显式控制。

Result: 在Bench2Drive-Speed上取得82.53的速度遵循分数（Speed-Adherence Score），比该指标最强基线TFv6高12.9分，同时保持较强的闭环驾驶性能；在Bench2Drive上相较UniAD与VAD分别提升驾驶分数+28.5与+32.7；在基于真实驾驶数据的NAVSIM v2上，相较其骨干网络EPDMS提升+6.1。

Conclusion: 将多模态性归因于速度、并以安全约束监督的速度评分替代纯模仿，是一种有效且通用的端到端规划改进方案；CLAP-AD作为即插即用规划头可跨模型、跨数据集带来一致提升，并支持测试时的速度偏好控制。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has predominantly relied on open-loop imitation learning for training, which presents two limitations. First, expert demonstrations show only one behavior per scenario, so the model cannot learn alternative valid behaviors and, in turn, cannot adapt to user-specified preferences at test time. Second, noise or ambiguity in these demonstrations can produce inconsistent, unreliable supervision for the end-to-end models. Driving is inherently multi-modal: multiple different behaviors can be valid responses to the same scene, and this diversity arises largely from speed rather than path. We introduce a planning paradigm that learns the path through imitation while scoring a set of candidate speeds across multiple criteria with a learned function supervised by physically grounded safety constraints. We realize this paradigm as Closed-Loop Aware Planning for Autonomous Driving (CLAP-AD), a plug-in planning head that integrates with existing end-to-end driving models and, to our knowledge, is the first to enable explicit test-time control over their speed selection without speed-conditioned training. On Bench2Drive-Speed, CLAP-AD sets a new state of the art Speed-Adherence Score of 82.53, topping TFv6, the strongest baseline on this metric, by 12.9 points while retaining strong closed-loop driving performance. On Bench2Drive, it improves driving score by +28.5 and +32.7 over UniAD and VAD, and on NAVSIM v2, built on real-world driving data, EPDMS by +6.1 over its backbone. Project page: https://clap-ad.github.io

</details>


### [214] [Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36068v1)
*Jiayi Luo,Yang Zhang,Liliang Chen,Nan Wang,Chen Gao,Boxiang Qiu,Zhuoxuan Li,Baorui Peng,Chuankang Li,Yuxiang Yan,Si Liu,Qingyun Sun,Shuicheng Yan,Maoqing Yao,Jianxin Li,Guanghui Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Rollback 将动作条件世界模型从"前向模拟器"改造为"反事实引擎"：回滚到关键决策点、分叉试不同动作并对比结果，从而在动作级别蒸馏细粒度监督，无需单独价值模型；配合分布式世界模型搜索与异步真机执行的闭环，在三个真机任务上显著超越最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的方法仅把世界模型当作物理环境的前向代理（forward-only surrogate），浪费了真实环境无法提供的独特能力——回滚到过去的决策点并探索反事实未来。同时，真实交互代价高昂，需要更高效地把想象算力集中在关键决策上。

Method: 1) 回滚-分叉-对比：定位关键决策点，回滚并分叉出替代动作，通过对比结果将成功归因到具体单步决策，实现"把想象集中在最要紧处"；2) 将反事实结果蒸馏为动作级细粒度监督，避免额外学习价值模型；3) 可扩展训练系统：分布式世界模型搜索 + 异步真机执行，构成自增强循环；4) test-time physics grounding：用被训练策略产生的真实转移，通过轻量 LoRA 管线校正世界模型动力学。

Result: 在方块抽取、抛球、桌面冰壶三个真实任务上，成功率相对最强基线绝对提升 10.67%、11.11%、11.85%，且训练过程提升更稳定；尽管由远低于人类水平的遥操作示教初始化，在抛球与桌面冰壶上 8 小时内即超过人类玩家平均成功率。

Conclusion: 世界模型的价值不止于前向仿真，更在于其可回滚、可分支的反事实能力；将反事实归因与真机闭环校正结合，可在细粒度监督、无价值模型的前提下实现稳定且高效的策略改进。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

</details>


### [215] [Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35862v1)
*Sihang Li,Xiaofeng Guo,Jinkun Cao,Charlie Cheng,Ruihan Yang,Chen Feng,Guanya Shi,Haozhi Qi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FLORE框架，用双手力感知UMI式手持夹爪与可穿戴动捕采集无机器人示范，训练力反应扩散策略，结合混合柔顺全身控制器执行双手力指令并保持平衡，实现人形机器人接触力与运动协调控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常任务不仅需要控制运动，还需控制接触力；在人形机器人上力需在双手与全身间协调，仅靠运动学轨迹无法指定，因此需要力反应式的全身移动操作学习框架。

Method: 用两个带力感知的UMI式手持夹爪采集手部运动与接触力旋量，配可穿戴跟踪器采集身体运动，获得无机器人示范；训练以视觉、本体感知和测得力旋量为输入、输出动作与单手力指令的力反应扩散策略；设计带力跟踪的混合柔顺全身控制器，通过真实F/T传感器测得力误差的积分项，使手沿指令方向精确跟踪力、其他方向保持柔顺，同时维持平衡。

Result: 仿真中控制器能跟踪不同幅值与方向的单手力指令，全身运动精度损失很小；机器人上三个富接触任务中，力反应策略成功率达80%，而同一示范、同一控制器下纯位置策略仅26.7%。

Conclusion: 在统一框架下可同时实现力反应策略学习与精确双手力跟踪，显著优于仅位置控制的基线。

Abstract: Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller. For more details, please visit our website: https://louis-leee.github.io/FLoRe/.

</details>


### [216] [Differentiable Contact Dynamics for Legged Locomotion: Policy Learning and Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35852v1)
*Gijeong Kim,Seungbin Oh,Dongyun Kang,Hae-Won Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出摩擦接触的平滑解析梯度（仅在反向传播替换精确灵敏度，前向保持硬接触），通过de Saxcé修正二阶锥互补问题的中心路径松弛实现接触模式切换时灵敏度连续；用于足式机器人策略学习与接触隐式轨迹优化，策略可零微调迁移到硬件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确接触灵敏度在闭式下可得，但只描述当前接触模式内的变化，无法为相邻接触模式提供一阶信息，导致基于梯度的策略学习与接触隐式轨迹优化在接触模式切换处梯度不连续、难以优化。

Method: 对库仑摩擦的de Saxcé修正二阶锥互补问题做中心路径松弛，平滑分离、粘滞（clamping）与滑动三种模式的定义条件；仅在后向传播中用松弛灵敏度替代精确灵敏度，前向仍求解硬接触，保证 rollout 可行；松弛灵敏度在由硬接触解初始化、经牛顿迭代得到的中心路径点上求值，随松弛消失收敛到精确灵敏度。

Result: 策略学习使用10万样本、桌面PC上训练不足2分钟即获得可零微调迁移到硬件的策略；硬件上trot步态策略可抵御推扰并穿越碎石与湿滑地面。轨迹优化中，该梯度能找到精确梯度与Signorini松弛梯度遗漏的接触丰富解。

Conclusion: 以后向专用的中心路径松弛灵敏度，在保持前向硬接触可行性的同时获得跨接触模式的连续梯度，兼顾可微接触的物理一致性与优化可用性，在足式机器人学习与轨迹优化中均验证有效。

Abstract: This paper proposes a smooth analytic gradient for frictional contact and applies it to policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged locomotion. The exact contact sensitivity is available in closed form but describes changes within the current contact mode, providing no first-order information toward neighboring contact modes. The proposed gradient replaces this sensitivity only in the backward pass, leaving the hard-contact forward solve unchanged and the realized rollout feasible. A central-path relaxation of the de Saxcé-corrected second-order-cone complementarity problem for Coulomb friction smooths the conditions defining the separating, clamping, and sliding modes. The relaxed sensitivity is evaluated at a point on the central path obtained by a Newton iteration initialized from the hard-contact solution. The sensitivity remains continuous through contact-mode transitions and converges to the exact sensitivity as the relaxation vanishes. Using 100,000 samples and less than 2 min of training on a desktop PC, policy learning with the proposed gradient produces a policy that transfers to hardware without fine-tuning. On hardware, the robot under a trotting policy withstands pushes and traverses debris and slippery ground. In trajectory optimization, the proposed gradient reaches contact-rich solutions missed by exact and Signorini-relaxed gradients. Project page: https://diffcontact.github.io

</details>


### [217] [Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35832v1)
*Yifei Yao,Yude Zou,Guanbo Jiao,Xing Gao,Ning Gao,Yukai Wang,Jiantong Chen,Zihou Zhu,Xinyu Li,Ningyu Yan,Shuai Wang,Jianming Ma,Haoyu Guo,Weinan Zhang,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该技术报告在EBench上评测前沿MLLM（GPT-6-Astra）作为机器人智能体的表现，比较其与后训练VLA/WAM策略的能力边界与互补性，并提出"agent harness+策略调用"的融合范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿多模态大模型已能零机器人专属训练地控制机器人，但其与后训练VLA、世界动作模型（WAM）策略在不同操作需求下的能力对比与交互方式尚缺乏系统评测，需明确MLLM智能体的能力边界及改进方向。

Method: 在EBench上以GPT-6-Astra为核心构建智能体，通过agent harness控制机器人，并与后训练策略采用相同的视觉与本体质感知观测协议。设置两种配置：(1) 直接控制，智能体直接生成路点指令；(2) harness+策略，额外可调用后训练VLA或WAM策略执行动作。

Result: 直接控制下整体性能与后训练策略具竞争力：短时域任务领先，跨泛化维度性能波动最小；但在长时域任务、桌面操作和高精度接触丰富任务上劣于后训练策略。harness+策略配置可整合双方互补优势，将整体成功率提升至最强后训练基线水平并显著降低token开销；但受策略调用次优、固定指令执行无子目标、智能体接管时抓取扰动影响，仍低于各组件单任务性能上界。

Conclusion: 研究刻画了前沿MLLM智能体的能力边界，揭示MLLM高层语义泛化与后训练策略低层执行精度的互补性，并为未来agent harness设计（策略调用决策、子目标分解、控制权交接平滑性）指明改进方向。

Abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

</details>


### [218] [Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35817v2)
*Benjamin Pikus,Daniel Saunders,Mircea Mironenco,Salman Mohammadi,Mathew Mathew,Sirou Zhu,Divya Makkar,Xuhua Huang,Qinbo Li,Supreeth Narasimhaswamy,Siyuan Cen,Dejia Xu,Shyamal Buch,Thomas Neff*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ZAP：将小型现成视觉语言模型（VLM）训练为机器人策略，通过简单工具接口控制机器人，无需真实机器人数据训练即在真实任务上达到96.7%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人策略需同时具备两项能力：理解场景中任务要求（世界理解与推理），以及知道如何驱动机器人完成该任务（动作生成）。作者希望通过复用现成VLM，避免依赖大规模真实机器人数据与昂贵的大模型推理。

Method: 分阶段训练一个小型（27B）预训练VLM：先用其作为引导模型获得世界理解与推理能力，再在简单仿真任务上进行监督微调与GRPO强化学习，教其通过简洁的“工具接口”输出机器人控制指令；训练中不使用真实机器人数据。

Result: 真实任务成功率96.7%，与GPT-6 Astra持平，显著优于MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%）；相比GPT-6 Astra运行快3倍、成本低17倍。可泛化到未见过的本体形态及训练中未出现的新物体、新目标和新策略。单臂Franka上RoboLab-120达55.9%，领先最佳VLA/WAM基线4.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 小型现成VLM经仿真微调+强化学习并配合工具接口，可成为高效、低成本且具强泛化性的机器人策略，具备替代大模型与专用VLA的潜力。

Abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without observing real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Furthermore, ZAP also generalizes to an unseen embodiment as well as new objects, goals and strategies never seen during training. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

</details>


### [219] [E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36011v1)
*X-Era AI Lab Team,:,Jianhao Lai,Zhihao Zhan,Zhiquan Liao,Qichang Li,Shubin Chen,Zhiyuan Liu,Hongsen Lei,Jianman Lin,Xiaoxin Lin,Ke Gong,Baiyue Gu,Shiming Chen,Junlin He,Longqi Yang,Junrong Xiao,Haolin Luo,Xiaojuan Su,Jianfeng Li,Yu Luo,Xu Sun,Likui Zhang,Jusheng Zhang,Qinhan Lyu,Tianshui Chen,Liang Lin,Guangrun Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: E0.5 是一个以 3D 基础模型为主干、以几何为原生表示的世界-动作模型（WAM），同时显式预测未来 3D 状态与动作，在 RoboTwin 2.0 与真实机器人操作任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型多基于视频基础模型或视觉-语言模型，3D 几何（如 VGGT 提取的特征）仅作为辅助输入或预测目标，未成为世界建模的原生基础，限制了几何动态的表达能力。

Method: 以 3D 基础模型作为主骨干，使 3D 几何成为世界建模与动作预测的原生表示；在统一框架内联合预测未来 3D 状态与机器人动作；并在 AgiBotWorld-Beta 的 16 万+ 条机器人轨迹上进行具身预训练，联合学习动作与未来几何。

Result: RoboTwin 2.0 上无具身数据预训练即达到 89.90%（干净）与 50.09%（随机化）成功率；经具身预训练后，在 AgileX Piper 与 Zerith H1 上真实操作平均成功率分别提升约 15 与 7 个百分点。

Conclusion: 几何原生基础模型能够习得机器人交互知识并迁移到真实物理操作，E0.5 作为 VWA 系列世界-动作模型的成员，验证了这一范式的潜力。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models. Even when geometric features extracted by 3D models such as VGGT are incorporated, they are typically passed into a video model or VLM that serves as the primary backbone, leaving 3D geometry as an auxiliary input or prediction target rather than the native foundation for world modeling. We present E0.5, a geometry-native world-action model built directly on 3D foundation models. E0.5 introduces two key innovations. First, it adopts a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone, making 3D geometry the native representation for both world modeling and action prediction. Second, it explicitly predicts future 3D states together with actions, enabling the model to capture geometric world dynamics beyond action-only modeling or future video prediction. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 first demonstrate the effectiveness of E0.5 without embodied-data pretraining, achieving success rates of 89.90\% and 50.09\% under clean and randomized settings, respectively. Building on these results, we further pretrain E0.5 on more than 160k robot trajectories from AgiBotWorld-Beta, jointly learning robot actions and future geometry within the pretrained 3D foundation. This embodied pretraining improves mean real-world manipulation success rates by approximately 15 and 7 percentage points on AgileX Piper and Zerith H1, respectively. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of geometry-native foundations to acquire robot interaction knowledge and transfer it to physical manipulation. E0.5 embodies this geometry-native approach as a member of the VWA family of world-action models.

</details>


### [220] [SPECOLA: A Tool for Specification Driven Robot Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35730v1)
*Immanuel Ampomah Mensah,Hadas Kress-Gazit*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Specola 是一个在仿真中依据 STL（信号时序逻辑）规格评估机器人行为的工具，提供规格编写接口、监控器自动生成与管理、Python API/CLI，以及 9 个仿真环境适配器，用于超越单一成功率的细粒度评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真基准通常仅以成功率衡量性能，无法反映成功裕度、对目标参数变化的敏感度、可能违反的要求以及成功是否持续等细节。

Method: 采用 STL 作为形式化规格语言定义需求并度量行为与规格的接近程度；通过接口在仿真信号上编写规格，在策略执行期间自动创建和管理监控器；提供 Python API 与命令行界面接入既有策略执行循环，并提供适配器接口连接新仿真器（已实现 LIBERO、RoboCasa、Isaac Lab、RoboDojo 等 9 个环境与基准）。

Result: 工具可直接嵌入现有仿真执行流程，支持多环境监控，并通过案例研究展示了其所能实现的细粒度、多层次评估能力；代码与适配器已开源。

Conclusion: 将 STL 监控引入仿真基准，可提供比成功率更丰富、更严格的机器人行为评估方式，且具备良好的可扩展性与工程可用性。

Abstract: Simulation benchmarks are a useful way to measure progress in robotics; typically they provide success rate as the dominant measure of performance. However, success rate reports only whether a rollout completed the task, hiding by what margin it succeeded, how sensitive the success is to goal parameter changes, requirements it may have violated, and whether success persisted. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) provides a formal language for capturing specifications; it can be used to define requirements, and measure how close a robot behavior is to satisfying or violating them. Using STL monitors in a simulator, however, requires exposing simulator state and mapping it to specification-relevant signals. We present Specola, a tool for evaluating robot behaviors in simulation with respect to STL specifications. Specola provides an interface for writing specifications over simulator signals, and creates and manages the relevant monitors while a policy executes. We provide a Python API and command-line interface for integrating monitoring into existing policy execution loops. We provide an adapter interface for connecting new simulators, and provide adapters for nine simulation environments and benchmarks, including LIBERO, RoboCasa, Isaac Lab, and RoboDojo. We provide case studies that illustrate the nuanced evaluation that Specola enables. Code and adapters are available at https://github.com/specola-eval/specola.

</details>


### [221] [TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35687v1)
*Elias Hofele,Thomas Trapp,David Timmermann,Tristan Schnell,Georg Heppner,Arne Roennau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TrySee——一个模块化闭环机器人任务规划流水线，将通用VLM推理与领域专用感知和成熟机器人组件结合，无需VLM微调或端到端示教，在5个差异显著的领域（含真实拆解任务）上验证了实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在高层推理与任务规划上表现亮眼，但在专业/垂直领域（specialized domains）的图像解读与视觉接地（grounding）能力不足；而领域专用训练数据稀缺，难以对VLM进行微调或采集端到端示教。

Method: 构建TrySee模块化闭环流水线：包含本质反应式的循环式（cyclic）规划流程，并叠加领域专用的模块化视觉预处理以提供在线接地；引入动态预处理选择机制以提升可扩展性。系统通过可替换的感知模块与运动规划器实现适配，无需VLM微调，也无需端到端示教。

Result: 在5个差异较大的领域任务上评估规划性能，并在棕地（brownfield）环境中进行真实机器人拆解任务的现场测试，结果显示该方案在领域专用训练数据有限的条件下仍具备实用性。

Conclusion: 通用VLM推理可通过“通用推理+领域专用感知模块+成熟机器人组件”的模块化闭环保留其规划优势并弥补接地短板，为在数据受限的专业机器人系统中集成VLM规划提供了一条可扩展、可替换的实用路径。

Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.

</details>


### [222] [FISRF: Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework for Robotics Task Planning with Large Language Model](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35686v2)
*Qingmiao Liang,Jiatao Zhang,Runxin Zou,Yufan Song,Wei Song,Yuhua Zheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FISRF框架，用"agent-导师"架构估计机器人在任务规划中的最近发展区（ZPD），自适应选择反思策略与导师指导，促进有效纠错经验的积累。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的规划反思纠错主要依赖自主探索，在新环境早期交互中易积累错误经验，导致纠错效率低。

Method: FISRF：一种agent–mentor双角色架构，在线估计机器人任务规划的ZPD，并据此自适应地选取反思策略与导师引导强度，从而形成有效的纠错经验积累。

Result: 在ALFWorld与真实机器人平台上，平均纠错轮次减少37%，冗余推理减少25.1%，整体任务成功率提升8%。

Conclusion: 将教育学ZPD与教学脚手架思想引入LLM任务规划反思，可缓解早期错误经验累积问题，提升纠错效率、推理经济性与任务成功率。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely adopted for reflective error correction in task planning; however, existing approaches primarily rely on autonomous exploration, rendering them prone to accumulating erroneous experiences during early interactions with new environments. To address this limitation, we propose the Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework (FISRF), an agent--mentor architecture that estimates the robot's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) in task planning and adaptively selects reflection strategies and mentor guidance, thereby facilitating the accumulation of effective error-correction experience. Experiments in ALFWorld and on real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that FISRF reduces the average number of error-correction rounds by 37% and redundant reasoning by 25.1%, while improving the overall task success rate by 8%. Project webpage : https://fisrfplanning.github.io/

</details>


### [223] [Continuous-Time Safe Planning and Control for Agile Quadrupeds](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35670v1)
*Gage MacLin,Mason Peterson,Camilla Tabasso,Venanzio Cichella,Joshua Migdal,Tye Brady,Taskin Padir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种保留四足机器人完全驱动 SE(2) 模型（含各向异性、航向耦合速度约束）的实时运动规划框架，用复合 Bernstein 多项式参数化轨迹，借助凸包性质对整段规划区间（而非离散点）证书化避碰与输入约束，并以在线重规划速率闭环输出机体速度指令。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中四足导航需要既动态可行又可证明无碰撞的轨迹。现有实时规划器多通过凸化简化（如降阶运动学模型）换取可解性，从而丢弃机器人实际可执行的运动，并且只在离散采样点上认证安全，无法排除与移动障碍物的采样间碰撞。

Method: 以复合 Bernstein 多项式参数化轨迹；保留完全驱动 SE(2) 模型及其各向异性、航向耦合的速度边界，直接接受由此产生的非凸性；利用 Bernstein 多项式的凸包性质，对整个规划时域连续地认证避碰与输入约束；优化以在线重规划频率求解并构成闭环，将机体系速度下发给运动控制器。

Result: 在仿真中与消融变体和外部基线方法进行对比验证；并在四足机器人硬件实验中，于未知移动障碍物间导航，复现了简化模型所排除的横向运动与航向耦合运动。

Conclusion: 无需依赖简化运动学或仅离散点安全认证，即可在实时速率下生成连续时间安全、动态可行的四足轨迹；保留完整 SE(2) 动力学模型带来的额外机动能力在硬件上得到实证。

Abstract: Agile quadruped navigation in dynamic environments demands trajectories that are both dynamically feasible and provably collision-free. Most real-time planners achieve tractability through a convex reduction that requires simplified kinematic models, discarding motion that the robot can readily execute, and certify safety only at discretization points, leaving open possible inter-sample collisions with moving obstacles. We present a real-time motion planning framework that retains the fully-actuated $SE(2)$ model of a quadruped, with its anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, and accepts the resulting nonconvexity. By parameterizing trajectories as composite Bernstein polynomials, we exploit the convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and the input bounds over the entirety of each planning horizon. Solved at online replanning rates, the optimization runs in closed loop, commanding body velocities to the locomotion controller. We validate the approach in simulation against ablations and external baselines, and in hardware experiments on a quadruped navigating among unknown moving obstacles, recovering both lateral and heading-coupled motion that simplified models exclude.

</details>


### [224] [Environment Edits as a Corrective Signal for Reward Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35659v1)
*Isaac Ngui,Courtney McBeth,Nancy M. Amato*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出环境编辑（environment edits）作为一种补充反馈形式，并提出FERRET方法，从机器人纠正与场景编辑两类轨迹中学习人类偏好。由于机器人运动保持不变，场景中被移动的物体成为编辑的唯一解释，从而使环境编辑能够消歧特征，学到仅靠机器人纠正无法学到的偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人纠正虽可让用户调整机器人行为，但单次纠正会同时改变多个特征，存在特征纠缠与歧义；同时，关于物体属性以及物体间关系的偏好无法通过移动机器人来表达。

Method: 提出环境编辑作为互补反馈形式：在人编辑场景时保持机器人运动不变，使被移动物体成为编辑的唯一解释；进而提出FERRET（Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces），同时从机器人纠正轨迹与环境编辑轨迹中学习偏好。

Result: 实验表明，环境编辑能够对特征进行消歧，并能学习到仅依靠机器人纠正无法学到的偏好。

Conclusion: 环境编辑是机器人纠正的有效补充反馈，二者结合（FERRET）可提升偏好学习的表达力与可辨识性。

Abstract: Robot corrections allow people to adjust a robot's behavior, but a single correction changes many features. Also, preferences about object attributes and relationships between objects cannot be expressed by moving the robot. We propose environment edits as a complementary form of feedback. The robot's motion is held constant as the human edits the scene, so the only explanation for the edit is the moved object. We introduce Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces (FERRET), which learns preferences from both robot and environment corrections. We show that environment edits are able to disambiguate features and learn preferences that robot corrections alone cannot.

</details>


### [225] [VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35642v1)
*Richard Fechner,Peer Neubert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 VPR-Space 基准，用于评估视觉位置识别（VPR）在类月球/火星等外星表面特征稀疏环境中的能力，并引入基于相对位姿估计器集成性能的“任务相关”真值标注新范式，评测了九种 SOTA VPR 方法，指出仍有较大改进空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VPR 与 SLAM 方法在城市及特征丰富的自然环境中表现优异，但在地外表面（如月球、火星）这类广阔且特征稀少的环境中面临严重挑战；同时传统 VPR 基准以固定位置与视角阈值判定“同一地点”，未考虑匹配对下游 SLAM 任务的实际价值，存在病态性问题。

Method: (1) 基于空间模拟域（SAD，即类月/类火的地球环境）的既有数据，构建 16 个 VPR 数据库-查询数据集，涵盖环境、视角变化与光照条件等多类挑战；(2) 提出新的真值生成方法：不再用固定的相机位姿阈值定义同一地点，而是以匹配是否对下游 SLAM 有价值为判据，通过集成多种 SOTA 相对位姿估计器（RPE）的性能生成 VPR 真值矩阵，避免在 SLAM 系统中闭环评估的开销与限制；(3) 在该真值下评测九种 SOTA VPR 方法。

Result: 在 VPR-Space 基准上对九种 SOTA VPR 方法的评测显示，现有方法在外星表面场景中性能存在明显不足，仍有相当大的提升空间，并为未来研究指明了方向。

Conclusion: VPR-Space 为地外表面 VPR 提供了首个系统性评测基准，其任务驱动的真值定义方式更贴合 SLAM 实际需求；实验表明现有 SOTA 方法难以应对特征稀疏环境，数据集已以预发布形式在 GitHub 公开。

Abstract: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE).
