Motivation: 现有 3D-LLM 将海量 3D 物体 token 与文本 token 拼接送入 LLM，存在两大缺陷：(i) 引入大量任务无关物体数据，形成噪声，降低推理准确率并加剧幻觉；(ii) 仅依赖点云，缺乏 2D 模态中的颜色、材质、纹理及高层上下文关系等丰富语义。

Method: 提出 3D-SceneQ，统一"自适应 token 剪枝"与"多模态语义增强"。其一为 Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP)：利用可学习潜在查询，依据用户指令意图自适应选择任务相关物体，保留关键信息并抑制无关噪声。其二为 Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE)：将预训练 2D 模型的特征嵌入融合进 3D 表示，增强物体级语义信息。

Result: 在多个基准上超越当前 SOTA，例如 Scan2Cap 上 CIDEr +5.7，SQA3D 上 EM@1 +17.0，在多种 3D 语言推理任务中表现优异。

Conclusion: 通过指令驱动的 token 剪枝与 2D-3D 多模态特征融合，可同时缓解噪声与语义不足问题，显著提升 3D 场景理解、推理与定位能力。

Abstract: Current 3D scene understanding pipelines typically concatenate vast numbers of 3D object tokens with text tokens and feed the resulting sequence to a Large Language Model (LLM). However, existing 3D-LLMs for scene understanding encounter two major limitations: (i) excessive inclusion of task-irrelevant object data, introducing noise that reduces reasoning accuracy and increases hallucinations; and (ii) reliance solely on point cloud data, which inherently lacks the rich semantic information available in complementary 2D modalities, such as color, material properties, texture, and high-level contextual relationships. To address these challenges, we introduce 3D-SceneQ, a 3D LLM that unifies adaptive token pruning with multimodal semantic enrichment, markedly advancing scene understanding, reasoning, and grounding. Specifically, we propose a Query-Guided Adaptive Pruning (QGAP) module that adaptively selects task-relevant objects based on the intended meaning of user instructions, leveraging a learnable latent query to retain critical information while effectively suppressing irrelevant noise. In addition, we introduce a Multi-modal Object-level Feature Enhancement (MOFE) module, which integrates 2D feature embeddings from pre-trained models into 3D representation to enrich object-level semantic information. Evaluations show that 3D-SceneQ outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks (e.g., +5.7 CIDEr on Scan2Cap and +17.0 EM@1 on SQA3D), demonstrating its remarkable capabilities in various 3D language reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [533] [VGIQA: Fine-Grained Image Quality Assessment with Visual Grounding Rewards](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37186v1)
*Weichang Wang,Liyu Chen,Shuyue Guan,Jie Hu,Fei Gao,Wei Li,Nannan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VGIQA，一个兼具局部与全局质量评估能力的多模态大模型 IQA 模型，采用冷启动+强化学习两阶段训练，并构建局部质量评估数据集 VGSR-2K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的 IQA 方法多局限于整体图像级评估，缺乏细粒度、局部化评估能力，限制了实际应用性。

Method: 两阶段训练范式：冷启动阶段 + 强化学习阶段；设计专门的局部质量评估奖励函数驱动 RL 优化；并构建面向局部质量评估的新数据集 VGSR-2K。

Result: 在 VGSR-2K 上展现优异的图像质量理解能力，显著优于 Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 等开源 MLLM；且局部质量评估任务能有效提升模型在退化感知任务上的表现。

Conclusion: 同时具备局部与全局质量评估能力的 VGIQA 弥补了 MLLM-based IQA 在细粒度评估上的空白，并表明局部质量评估可作为提升退化感知等下游任务的有效训练信号。

Abstract: Image quality assessment (IQA) aims to evaluate the perceptual visual quality of images. Recently, the rapid development of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has significantly advanced the IQA field. By integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reinforcement learning (RL), these models can generate more accurate and interpretable results while relying on less training data. However, existing MLLM-based methods are predominantly constrained to holistic, image-level evaluations and lack the capability to produce fine-grained, localized assessments, which substantially limits their practical applicability. To address this limitation, we propose VGIQA, a novel IQA model endowed with both local and global quality assessment capabilities. VGIQA is trained via a two-stage paradigm comprising a cold-start phase followed by reinforcement learning. Driven by carefully designed local quality assessment reward functions, our model exhibits exceptional image quality understanding on VGSR-2K, a new dataset we propose specifically for local quality evaluation, significantly outperforming existing open-source MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Furthermore, the local quality evaluation task can effectively enhance the model's performance on the degradation perception task.

</details>


### [534] [INTR++: INterpretable TRansformer with better Accuracy, Interpretability, and Adaptability](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37178v1)
*Dipanjyoti Paul,Arpita Chowdhury,Maneet Chatterjee,Daichi Kitaguchi,Tanya Berger-Wolf,Tetsuya Sakurai,Wei-Lun Chao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出INTR++，通过在Prompt-CAM中加入轻量级Prompt Adapter Module (PAM)，使可学习提示具备域自适应性，从而在动物、植物、医学影像、显微成像、遥感影像等多种域上保持一致的Transformer可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释Transformer（如INTR、Prompt-CAM）多在特定领域表现良好，但跨域泛化能力不足。Prompt-CAM用可学习提示提升适应性，但提示是固定的，难以适配输入图像特征差异较大的领域（如医学、显微、遥感影像），导致可解释性下降。目标是兼顾ViT式的广泛适用性与跨域一致的可解释性。

Method: INTR++ 继承 Prompt-CAM 框架，新增轻量级 Prompt Adapter Module (PAM)。PAM 将域相关知识注入提示，使提示由静态变为可自适应；模型保留可解释Transformer的标准架构与端到端学习范式，仅相比 Prompt-CAM 增加少量参数。

Result: 在动物、植物、医学影像、显微成像、遥感影像及以物体为中心的数据等多个域上，INTR++ 在各项指标上均取得一致提升，并实现跨域稳定的可解释性。

Conclusion: 以极小的参数开销将提示自适应化，是提升可解释Transformer跨域一致性的有效途径，INTR++ 在保持架构简洁与端到端训练的同时实现了广泛的域适用性。

Abstract: Interpretable Transformers often perform well in domain specific settings but lose effectiveness beyond that. Achieving ViT-like broad applicability requires models with consistent performance across domains. Recent works on Interpretable Transformers, INTR and Prompt-CAM, were developed keeping domain adaptability in mind. Prompt-CAM leverages learnable prompts to promote adaptability. However, these prompts are fixed in nature and therefore struggle to adapt to domains with substantial variation in input image characteristics, resulting in reduced interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose INTR++, which extends Prompt-CAM by incorporating a lightweight Prompt Adapter Module (PAM). PAM enables prompts to be adaptive by enriching them with domain-specific knowledge, thereby ensuring consistent interpretability across diverse domains including those with varying image characteristics such as medical imaging, micro-scopic imaging, and remote sensing imagery. INTR++ retains the standard architecture and end-to-end learning of Interpretable Transformer based models, while adding only a small number of additional parameters compared to Prompt-CAM. We demonstrate that INTR++ delivers consistent improvements in all aspects across domains like animals, plants, medical imaging, microscopic imaging, remote sensing imagery and object-centric data.

</details>


### [535] [FastBEVFusion: Simple Multi-Modal Fusion for 3D Object Detection at 50 FPS](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37153v1)
*Tom Sanitz,Emre Gülsoylu,Simone Frintrop,Christian Wilms*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FastBEVFusion——一种简洁、快速、鲁棒的激光雷达-相机BEV融合3D检测系统，无需深度估计，在nuScenes上超过实时SOTA并以>50 FPS运行，且对标定误差鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠实时的3D目标检测对自动驾驶安全至关重要，需在极低延迟下准确感知环境。现有SOTA系统虽检测质量高，但难以满足实时约束；且多模态融合常依赖计算昂贵、易出错的深度估计。

Method: 将各模态特定特征投影到"半对齐"的模态特定BEV空间，规避深度估计；在此基础上设计轻量级、软性、动态的交叉注意力融合模块，依据场景上下文自适应地跨整个BEV空间进行特征融合。

Result: 在复杂nuScenes数据集上优于实时SOTA系统，未使用部署库即达到>50 FPS；对相机-激光雷达标定误差表现出强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FastBEVFusion在精度、速度与鲁棒性之间取得良好折衷，是适合真实场景部署的强有力3D目标检测系统。

Abstract: Reliable real-time 3D object detection based on LiDAR and camera data is critical for safety in autonomous driving, where systems must accurately perceive their surroundings with minimal latency. Many state-of-the-art systems achieve high-quality detection results but fail to meet real-time constraints, limiting their practical use. To address this challenge, we propose FastBEVFusion, a simple, fast, and robust fusion system for 3D object detection. Based on modality-specific features, FastBEVFusion projects these features into semi-aligned modality-specific BEV spaces, without relying on a computationally intensive and potentially error-prone depth estimation. Given these BEV spaces, we propose a light-weight, soft, and dynamic fusion module based on cross-attention, which adapts dynamically to the scene context and enables feature fusion across the entire BEV spaces. Experiments on the complex nuScenes dataset show that FastBEVFusion outperforms state-of-the-art real-time systems, and achieves over 50 FPS without deployment libraries. Additionally, our system shows strong robustness to calibration errors, making FastBEVFusion a powerful 3D object detection system for real-world applications.

</details>


### [536] [GCSR-OCC: Geometry Calibration and Semantic Routing for Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37149v1)
*Bohua Wang,Congyang Zhao,Tianxiong Lv,Chenxu Zhao,He Zheng,Hangqi Fan,Leigang Luo,Zhihao Liao,Yihong Guo,Yang Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GCSR-OCC 通过几何校准与多模式查询条件语义路由，从单张 RGB 图像实现开放词汇室内占据预测，无需 3D 语义标注即在 Occ-ScanNet 上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 3D 高斯重建再转体素占据的方法存在两类问题：高斯尺度膨胀与过度重叠会扭曲体素占据预测；跨越多个类别的高斯以及 3D–2D 语义特征对齐过程会产生语义混叠。

Method: 提出 EC-G2O 算子，通过核质量归一化、p 范数聚合与可学习增益抑制尺度膨胀和局部证据过度累积，校准占据响应；提出 MM-QGSR，为每个高斯匹配多个语义模式到文本查询，并经可学习文本条件路由器将查询相关证据聚合到体素；辅以细粒度子类查询与平滑语义聚合优化体素级预测。

Result: 在无 3D 语义标注条件下，于 Occ-ScanNet 上取得开放词汇占据预测 SOTA：几何 IoU 63.31%，语义 mIoU 27.44%；几何聚合延迟由 19.76 ms 降至 12.88 ms。

Conclusion: 几何校准与查询优先的多模式语义路由能有效缓解高斯到体素转换中的尺度与语义失真，在保证效率的同时提升开放词汇室内占据预测性能。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction represents scene geometry and semantics in a unified voxel grid, enabling recognition beyond predefined categories. One approach reconstructs scenes with 3D Gaussians and converts them into voxel occupancy. However, Gaussian scale inflation and excessive overlap can distort voxel occupancy predictions, while semantic mixing can arise within Gaussians spanning multiple categories and during 3D--2D semantic feature alignment. We propose GCSR-OCC, which combines geometry calibration and multi-mode query-conditioned semantic routing for indoor occupancy prediction from a single RGB image. The Evidence-Conserving Gaussian-to-Occupancy operator (EC-G2O) uses kernel mass normalization, $p$-norm aggregation, and a learnable gain to suppress scale inflation and excessive local evidence accumulation while calibrating occupancy responses. Multi-mode Query-First Gaussian Semantic Routing (MM-QGSR) matches multiple semantic modes per Gaussian to text queries and aggregates query-specific evidence into voxels through a learnable text-conditioned router. Fine-grained subclass queries and smoothed semantic aggregation further refine voxel-level predictions. Without 3D semantic annotations, GCSR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary occupancy prediction on Occ-ScanNet, with 63.31% geometric IoU and 27.44% semantic mIoU. It also reduces geometric aggregation latency from 19.76 ms to 12.88 ms. Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [537] [MixSIS: Mixed-supervised instance segmentation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37138v1)
*Christian Wilms,Emre Gülsoylu,Sven Schreiber,Simone Frintrop*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出混合监督实例分割任务MixSIS，允许在数据集内灵活混合图像、点、框和掩码四种标注级别，并提出AnnsMixer基线，从各级别标注（甚至单图内混合）生成伪掩码，在WSIS和MixSIS上大幅优于SOTA，案例研究显示标注时间减少90%或效果提升34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督实例分割（WSIS）方法大多只关注单一标注级别，忽略了不同目标难易程度不同：简单目标用点标注即可，困难目标需框乃至掩码标注。作者希望优化标注流程，对困难实例详细标注、对简单实例节省标注成本。

Method: 提出MixSIS任务，支持图像级、点级、框级、掩码级标注在数据集内灵活混合，甚至单张图像内混合。提出AnnsMixer基线系统，从所有标注级别生成伪掩码标注，实现真正的混合监督实例分割。

Result: 在WSIS与MixSIS任务上评估AnnsMixer，大幅超越SOTA方法；三个案例研究显示，借助简单标注规则或异构数据，可减少90%标注时间或提升34%分割效果。

Conclusion: MixSIS具有高度实用价值，AnnsMixer作为有效基线验证了混合监督实例分割的可行性，显著提升标注效率与分割性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) based on either box-, point-, or image-level annotations has been proposed to overcome the labor-intensive annotation process in fully-supervised instance segmentation. Despite decent results, most WSIS methods only focus on a single annotation level, ignoring that some objects are easy to spot from point annotations, while others require box or even mask annotations. Therefore, we propose the Mixed-Supervised Instance Segmentation (MixSIS) task, which allows a flexible mix of annotation levels (image, point, box, and mask) within a dataset. MixSIS has a high practical relevance, as it allows optimizing the annotation process by annotating challenging objects in more detail, while saving time on simpler instances with less detailed annotations. To address MixSIS, we propose AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer is a truly mixed-supervised instance segmentation system, which generates pseudo mask annotations from all annotation levels, even mixed within a single image. We evaluate AnnsMixer on both WSIS and MixSIS tasks, largely outperforming state-of-the-art methods. In three case studies, we also demonstrate how the unique features of MixSIS and AnnsMixer can substantially reduce the annotation time (-90%) or improve the results (+34%) in instance segmentation with a simple annotation rule or leveraging heterogeneous data. Our code is available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS

</details>


### [538] [Physics Guided Diffusion Model Based Exposure Interpolation for High Dynamic Range Imaging](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37135v2)
*Zhengguo Li,Chaobing Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种物理引导的扩散模型曝光插值算法，用于单次拍摄双大口径比（LER）SDR图像融合中的亮度顺序反转（BOR）伪影问题，通过物理驱动分量插值初始图像、扩散模型分量生成残差高频细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多帧HDR存在鬼影伪影；单次拍摄双LER SDR图像可避免鬼影，但直接融合会产生亮度顺序反转（BOR）伪影。关键是在两幅LER图像曝光时间之间插值出一幅中间曝光图像。

Method: 提出物理引导的扩散模型曝光插值算法：物理驱动分量生成初始插值图像，新扩散模型分量生成残差高频细节。该扩散模型基于生成模型的相关性分析，采用新的预测目标以降低含噪数据与目标间Pearson相关性波动以及拟合误差放大因子。

Result: 相比现有基于卷积神经网络的神经增强曝光插值算法，所提方法在生成更多高频信息方面具有固有优势；实验结果验证了所提曝光插值算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 物理引导扩散模型曝光插值可有效缓解BOR伪影，并在高频细节生成上优于CNN类曝光插值方法。

Abstract: Ghosting artifacts are an open problem for popular multi-shot based high dynamic range (HDR) imaging. An effective solution is to capture two large-exposure-ratio (LER) standard dynamic range (SDR) images simultaneously via a single-shot. Brightness order reversal (BOR) artifacts are generated when the two LER images are directly fused together. It is crucial to interpolate an image with an exposure time in between the exposure times of two LER images. In this paper, a novel physics-guided diffusion model based exposure interpolation algorithm is proposed to address the BOR artifacts. An initial image is interpolated by a physics-driven component, and the residual high-frequency details are generated by a new diffusion model based component. The new diffusion model is based on the correlation analysis of generative models and includes a new predicted target to reduce the variation of the Pearson correlation between the noisy data and the target, as well as the amplification factor of the fitting error. Compared with existing neural augmented exposure interpolation algorithms on top of convolution neural networks, the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm has an inherent advantage to generate more high frequency information. Experiment results validate the proposed exposure interpolation algorithm.

</details>


### [539] [MRI-to-CT Translation of Spinal Images via Anatomy-Guided Pseudo-Pairing and Adversarial Diffusion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37134v1)
*Eduardo Nieto,Ibai Genua,Davide Scorza,Karen López-Linares*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段脊柱MRI到CT合成框架：解剖引导的椎体匹配构造伪配对数据、对抗扩散模型做图像翻译、3D体数据处理提升层间一致性，3D椎体Dice由0.666提升至0.739。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRI是脊柱疾病常规诊断手段，但手术规划常需CT以更清晰显示椎体骨性解剖；由MRI合成CT可避免额外辐射暴露并简化术前评估流程。核心难点在于配对MRI-CT数据难以获取。

Method: 三阶段框架：1）解剖引导的椎体匹配系统，利用脊柱分割识别相似的矢状位MRI与CT切片，经刚性配准对齐，从未配对扫描构造伪配对数据；2）用这些配对训练对抗扩散模型完成MRI-to-CT翻译；3）将合成切片组装为3D体数据，并由网络精修以改善层间连续性与结构一致性。评估结合分布度量与椎体分割指标。

Result: 在超过10,000对未配对矢状位MRI与CT切片上训练，在83个MRI体数据共1,911张切片（覆盖全部脊柱区域）上评估。相较单纯扩散方法，二值3D椎体Dice从0.666提升至0.739；体数据处理减少堆叠切片间可见的不连续，并改善轴位与冠状位下的椎体一致性。

Conclusion: 解剖引导伪配对、对抗扩散与3D精修相结合可提升脊柱MRI-to-CT合成效果：椎体匹配主要增强解剖对齐与保真度，体数据精修改善3D一致性。结果支持进一步发展用于术前规划的MRI派生类CT可视化，尤须在保持体数据一致性的同时保留细粒度强度细节。

Abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is routinely used to diagnose spinal disorders, but surgical planning often requires Computed Tomography (CT) for better visualization of vertebral bone anatomy. Synthesizing CT from MRI could avoid additional radiation exposure and streamline preoperative assessment.
  We propose a three-stage framework for spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. First, an anatomy-guided vertebral matching system identifies similar sagittal MRI and CT slices using spine segmentations and aligns them through rigid registration, creating pseudo-paired data from unpaired scans. Second, these pairs train an adversarial diffusion model for MRI-to-CT translation. Third, synthesized slices are assembled into 3D volumes and refined by a network that improves inter-slice continuity and structural coherence.
  The framework was trained on over 10,000 unpaired sagittal MRI and CT slices and evaluated on 1,911 slices from 83 MRI volumes spanning all spinal regions. Assessment combined distribution-based measures with vertebral segmentation metrics. Compared with diffusion alone, the proposed approach increased binary 3D vertebral Dice from 0.666 to 0.739. Volumetric post-processing reduced visible discontinuities between stacked slices and improved vertebral coherence in axial and coronal views.
  Combining anatomy-guided pseudo-pairing, adversarial diffusion and 3D refinement improves spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. Vertebral matching primarily enhanced anatomical alignment and fidelity, while volumetric refinement improved 3D consistency. These findings support further development of MRI-derived CT-like visualization for preoperative planning, particularly to preserve fine intensity details while maintaining volumetric coherence.

</details>


### [540] [MCP-Net: Real-Time Coronary Perception Network and Topological Analysis for Robotic Guidewire Navigation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37127v1)
*Sahar Nasirihaghighi,Tianyuan Wang,Kenan Niu,Stefano Stramigioli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出仿真驱动的多任务冠脉感知框架MCP-Net，从单帧透视图像联合分割血管、定位导丝尖端与狭窄，并生成结构化血管图与导航路径图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经皮冠状动脉介入中的导丝导航需在二维X线透视下持续判读血管解剖、导丝位置与目标狭窄。现有方法多将血管分割与器械定位作为独立任务处理，缺乏面向机器人导航的结构化冠脉场景感知。

Method: 以三维冠脉CTA为起点生成仿真透视图像，包含血管结构、仿真导丝、不同严重程度的狭窄病变及多样血管几何形态，并给出仿真真值。MCP-Net在单帧透视图上联合执行血管分割、导丝尖端定位与狭窄定位；随后将预测结果转换为含中心线、分叉点、端点、分支方向与分支角的结构化血管图，并将预测狭窄与该图关联，自动选取图根节点并生成至目标病变的路径图（roadmap）。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架可联合恢复多个冠脉感知目标，并将其转化为可解释的血管表示，适用于下游机器人导航。

Conclusion: 该工作以仿真数据驱动、多任务联合感知加结构化图表示的方式，为机器人辅助导丝导航提供了统一的冠脉场景理解框架。

Abstract: Coronary guidewire navigation during percutaneous coronary intervention requires continuous interpretation of vessel anatomy, guidewire position, and target stenosis under two-dimensional X-ray fluoroscopy. While existing approaches commonly address vessel segmentation or device localization as separate tasks, a robotic system requires a more structured perception of the coronary scene to support downstream navigation. In this work, we present a simulation-driven framework centered on a Multi-Task Coronary Perception Network (MCP-Net) for robotic guidewire navigation, integrating coronary vessel segmentation, vascular topology extraction, and roadmap generation. Starting from three-dimensional coronary CT angiography, we generate simulated fluoroscopy images containing vascular structures, simulated guidewires, stenotic lesions with varying severity, and diverse vascular geometries, together with simulation-derived ground truth. MCP-Net jointly performs coronary vessel segmentation, guidewire-tip localization, and stenosis localization from a single fluoroscopic frame. These predictions are subsequently converted into a structured vascular graph containing centerlines, bifurcations, endpoints, branch directions, and branch angles. By associating the predicted stenosis with this graph, the framework generates a roadmap from the automatically selected graph root toward the target lesion. The results demonstrate that the proposed framework can jointly recover coronary perception targets and transform them into an interpretable vascular representation suitable for downstream robotic navigation.

</details>


### [541] [Multibranch Ensemble Head in Vision Foundation Models for Efficient Cucumber Phenological Stage Classification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37118v1)
*Kostiantyn Khabarlak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种多分支集成正则化头（低/高容量分支随机采样训练、推理时概率空间平均），配合DINOv2 ViT-S用于小样本域偏移的黄瓜物候期分类，以12.2 GFlops、22.3M参数达到Macro F1 0.978、Kappa 0.971。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督预训练的视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）特征迁移性强，但在小规模、域偏移数据集上适配仍困难；同时精准农业中黄瓜生长阶段分类面临叶片遮挡、阶段差异仅表现为细微叶形态变化等挑战，且需部署于边缘设备。

Method: 设计多分支集成头：将低容量与高容量分支配对，训练时每步随机采样单个分支，推理时在概率空间对两分支取平均；参数量增量极小、相对单一重头几乎无额外推理开销。在NALEF食品安全数据集（五类黄瓜生长阶段、真实多变条件）上系统评测DINOv2/DINOv3的ViT与ConvNeXt变体，并与强监督模型（ResNet、EfficientNet、ViT）对比。

Result: DINOv2 ViT-S搭配多分支头取得Macro F1 0.978与Cohen's Kappa 0.971，性能匹敌参数量和GFlops均超其十倍的模型，而自身仅需12.2 GFlops与22.3M参数。

Conclusion: 该方案在数据稀缺条件下改善精度—效率权衡，所提模型可部署于智能手机与边缘设备进行物候期分类，为VFM在小样本域偏移场景的轻量化适配提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained with self-supervised learning, such as DINOv2, provide highly transferable features, yet adapting them to small, domain-shifted datasets is still challenging. We propose a regularizing multibranch ensemble head: a training and inference scheme that pairs low- and high-capacity branches, samples a single branch stochastically at each training step, and averages both branches in probability space at inference. The design adds negligible parameters and essentially no inference overhead over a single heavy head, while improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under data-scarce conditions. Accurate classification of plant growth stages is critical for precision agriculture, enabling timely decisions on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting. Therefore, as a challenging practical case we use cucumber phenological stage classification, in which flowers and fruits are frequently occluded by foliage, and stage transitions manifest primarily as subtle changes in leaf morphology. The NALEF Food Safety dataset contains images of five cucumber growth stages captured under diverse real-world conditions. On it we evaluate a broad range of backbones, including DINOv2 and DINOv3 ViT and ConvNeXt variants, against strongly supervised counterparts (ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT). The proposed DINOv2 ViT-S with multibranch head achieves a Macro F1 of 0.978 and Cohen's Kappa of 0.971, matching the performance of models more than ten times larger in parameters and GFlops, while requiring only 12.2 GFlops and 22.3M parameters, making it deployable on smartphones and edge devices for phenological stage classification.

</details>


### [542] [A First-Step Bias Restores Lost Diversity in Diffusion Model Distillation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37110v1)
*Wenwu Tang,Dong Wang,Yun Cheng,Olga Saukh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReSeed：仅在蒸馏学生模型的第一个（高噪声）去噪步添加种子响应偏置适配器，对齐教师的区间割线速度，即可在几乎零参数、无需真值图像/感知/对抗损失的前提下大幅恢复生成多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布匹配蒸馏可实现少步高质量生成，但蒸馏后的学生模型在同一提示下会把不同初始噪声映射到相似输出，多样性显著下降。作者希望定位多样性在采样轨迹的哪一段丢失，从而以最小代价恢复。

Method: 沿采样轨迹对比教师与学生模型对不同初始噪声的响应差异，发现最大衰减出现在第一个高噪声步；用教师首步轨迹替换后多样性大幅回归（"首步是关键"）。基于此提出 ReSeed 后蒸馏方法：只在第一步学生上加入 seed-response bias adapter，将其速度对齐教师的 first-interval secant velocity（割线速度），学生全部原始权重与后续去噪步全部冻结不变，无需目标图像、感知损失和对抗损失。

Result: 在 SD3-Medium、SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev 三个文生图模型及 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 文生视频模型上验证。以 4 步蒸馏 FLUX.1-dev 为例，额外可训练参数仅占基座模型的 0.00196%，用 8,000 个 prompt–noise 对训练；DINO 多样性提升 48.3%，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。

Conclusion: 多样性损失主要集中在首个高噪声去噪步；仅对该步做轻量、数据高效的后蒸馏调优即可恢复大量多样性，无需微调整个学生模型。

Abstract: Distribution-matching distillation enables high-quality image generation in only a few denoising steps. However, distilled student models often map different initial noise samples to similar outputs under the same prompt. To locate where diversity is lost, we compare the teacher and student along the sampling trajectory. The largest measured reduction in the response to different initial noises occurs during the first, high-noise step. When we replace the first step with the teacher's corresponding trajectory and leave the final three student steps unchanged, most of the output diversity returns. This suggests that the first step is a key point for restoring diversity. Motivated by this finding, we introduce \emph{ReSeed}, a post-distillation method that adds a seed-response bias adapter only to the first student step and aligns its velocity with the teacher's first-interval secant velocity. All student weights and later denoising steps remain unchanged. We evaluate ReSeed on three text-to-image models (SD3-Medium, SD3.5-Medium, and FLUX.1-dev) and one text-to-video model (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B). For a distilled 4-step FLUX.1-dev model, \emph{ReSeed} requires only $0.00196\%$ additional trainable parameters relative to the base model and is trained on 8,000 prompt--noise pairs, while keeping the distilled student fully frozen and requiring no target images, perceptual losses, or adversarial losses. It improves DINO diversity by $48.3\%$ while maintaining competitive visual quality. These results show that substantial diversity can be recovered through a lightweight, data-efficient tuning of only the first denoising step, without finetuning the full student model.

</details>


### [543] [SplatScout: Query-Driven Part-Level Referring Segmentation in Gaussian Scenes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37098v1)
*Yihan Zang,Da Li,Shinkyu Park,Ivan Viola,Dominik Engel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SplatScout：一种查询驱动、闭环的VLM控制感知框架，用于高斯场景中的指代分割（含部件级），并构建PartRef-ScanNet++基准，取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯场景指代分割方法主要针对整体对象，依赖分割器生成候选、再由VLM从中选择。这类预定的固定候选可能遗漏作为目标或识别线索所需的细粒度部件。

Method: SplatScout将感知置于VLM控制下：模型主动选择视角、指导分割、检查渲染的三维结果以迭代精炼预测，形成查询驱动的闭环流程。同时构建PartRef-ScanNet++部件级评测基准，包含12个ScanNet++场景、261条人工校验查询，标注由网格导出。

Result: 在PartRef-ScanNet++上达到0.538 mIoU，大幅优于现有方法；消融实验验证迭代精炼的收益，跨VLM骨干的对比显示有效利用工具反馈的重要性；在四个现有指代基准上亦取得更高分数。

Conclusion: 将视角选择、分割指导与三维结果校验交由VLM闭环控制，可克服固定候选的局限并提升部件级指代分割性能，代码与基准已开源。

Abstract: Existing referring segmentation methods on Gaussian scenes primarily target whole objects, relying on segmenter-generated candidates from which a vision-language model (VLM) selects. Such predetermined fixed candidates may omit fine-grained parts needed as targets or cues for identifying objects. We introduce SplatScout, a query-driven, closed-loop approach that places perception under VLM control. The model actively selects views, directs segmentation, and inspects rendered 3D results to refine its predictions. For part-level evaluation, we introduce PartRef-ScanNet++, comprising 261 manually verified queries across 12 ScanNet++ scenes with mesh-derived ground truth. On PartRef-ScanNet++, SplatScout achieves 0.538 mIoU, substantially outperforming existing methods. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of iterative refinement, while comparisons across VLM backbones highlight the importance of effective tool-feedback utilization. SplatScout also achieves higher scores on four existing referring benchmarks. Code and the PartRef-ScanNet++ benchmark are available at https://github.com/kaust-violab/SplatScout.

</details>


### [544] [TriDifNet: A Unified Three-Task Diffusion Network for End-to-End RGB-T Perception](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37097v1)
*Qianchao He,Jing Liu,Yunhao Li,Xiaoqing Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一的扩散网络TriDifNet，将配准、融合、检测三任务联合建模，首个面向失配RGB-T行人感知的扩散式三任务联合优化网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外-可见光多模态感知在恶劣光照下鲁棒，但受平台运动、视角变化和模态相关畸变影响，红外与可见光图像常失配，配准误差会传播至融合与检测阶段，因此需要在失配条件下端到端地联合解决配准、融合与检测。

Method: TriDifNet由三个基于扩散的模块组成：配准扩散模块RegDM通过估计稠密变形场将失配红外图像对齐到光学参考图像；融合扩散模块FusDM采用残差条件扩散生成面向检测的融合表示，兼顾光学结构线索与红外显著性互补信息；检测扩散模块DetDM将行人检测建模为边界框空间中的迭代去噪过程。三任务通过闭环优化机制耦合：检测语义引导融合与配准，融合结果进一步正则化几何对齐。训练上采用分阶段渐进训练策略，并在后期引入轻量级Nash-MTL多任务精调以平衡三任务优化。

Result: 在KAIST多光谱行人基准上的大量实验表明，TriDifNet在失配RGB-T设置下取得更优的下游检测性能；相比强系统级对比方法，达到65.44%召回率、57.55% mAP₅₀和26.83% mAP₅₀:₉₅。

Conclusion: 面向失配RGB-T行人感知，将配准、融合、检测统一为扩散式三任务框架并以闭环优化耦合，是提升端到端多模态感知的有效途径；分阶段训练与Nash-MTL后期精调有助于多任务平衡。

Abstract: Infrared--visible (IR--VIS) multi-modal perception supports robust scene understanding under challenging illumination. Infrared and visible images are often misaligned due to platform motion, viewpoint changes, and modality-dependent distortions, causing registration errors to propagate into subsequent fusion and detection stages. We propose TriDifNet, a unified three-task diffusion network for end-to-end RGB-T perception. To the best of our knowledge, TriDifNet is the first diffusion-based network that jointly optimizes registration, fusion, and detection for misaligned RGB-T pedestrian perception. TriDifNet consists of three diffusion-based modules, i.e., the Registration Diffusion Module (RegDM), the Fusion Diffusion Module (FusDM), and the Detection Diffusion Module (DetDM). RegDM aligns the unaligned infrared image to the optical reference by estimating a dense deformation field. FusDM performs residual conditional diffusion to generate a detection-oriented fused representation with optical structural cues and complementary infrared saliency. DetDM formulates pedestrian detection as an iterative denoising process in bounding-box space. To couple the three tasks, TriDifNet introduces a closed-loop optimization mechanism, where detection semantics guide fusion and registration, and the fusion result further regularizes geometric alignment. A stage-wise progressive training strategy and a lightweight Nash multi-task learning (Nash-MTL)-based late-stage refinement are further adopted to balance registration, fusion, and detection optimization. Extensive experiments on the KAIST multispectral pedestrian benchmark show that TriDifNet achieves superior downstream detection performance under misaligned RGB-T settings. Against strong system-level competitors, TriDifNet achieves 65.44\% Recall, 57.55\% mAP$_{50}$, and 26.83\% mAP$_{50:95}$.

</details>


### [545] [Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37093v1)
*Ruilin Yao,Xinyu Qiu,Tianyu Zou,Yi Rong,Shengwu Xiong,Shuheng Shen,Changhua Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LBS（Look Beyond Screens），以 GUI grounding 作为可扩展的空间监督来源，通过 SFT（教师生成的 grounding 轨迹）加 RL（多轮 crop-and-inspect 决策）训练视觉语言模型，学习可迁移到 GUI 以外的主动观察行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉感知正从被动识别转向主动、任务导向的观察，但缺乏可扩展的空间监督信号。作者探究 GUI grounding 能否作为此类监督来源，训练出可迁移出界面领域的观察行为。

Method: 两阶段训练：(1) 在教师模型生成的 GUI grounding 轨迹上做监督微调初始化，建立视觉检查原语；(2) 用强化学习优化多轮 crop-and-inspect（裁剪-观察）决策。基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 两个骨干构建模型，并在固定推理设置下对比。

Result: 两骨干在固定推理设置下均稳定优于对应基线；SFT 之外的增益可迁移至 PerceptionBench（两骨干）、HR-Bench 与 ChartQAPro（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）。分析显示 SFT 负责建立视觉检查原语，RL 提升其下游有效性。

Conclusion: GUI grounding 是一种实用的监督范式，可获得可迁移的主动视觉感知能力并助力更广泛的多模态推理；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.

</details>


### [546] [Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37074v1)
*Nuria Balbás-Esteban,Albert Belenguer-Llorens,Elaheh Moradi,Jussi Tohka,Vanessa Gómez-Verdejo,Carlos Sevilla-Salcedo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SYMBA，一个面向结构性脑 MRI 的自监督预训练框架，整合解剖约束掩码、MS-SSIM 重建目标与从局部到全局的渐进式课程，在冻结线性探测下实现优越的跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构 T1 加权 MRI 的神经退行性疾病早期识别依赖深度学习，但标注稀缺与扫描仪导致的分布漂移使监督模型泛化性差；现有自监督方法多移植自自然图像范式（对比学习或体素级掩码重建），难以刻画神经退行性变相关的分布式形态学模式。

Method: SYMBA 由三部分构成：（1）解剖约束掩码；（2）多尺度结构相似性（MS-SSIM）重建损失替代体素级损失；（3）从局部解剖细节到全局脑形态的渐进式课程。在 9 个异质队列共 6,953 例 T1 扫描上预训练，并在两个独立未见数据集上以冻结线性探测评估分布外泛化。

Result: 在多项临床任务上稳定优于近期神经影像基础模型：阿尔茨海默病分类 AUROC 0.930，轻度认知障碍转化预测 0.772，淀粉样蛋白状态预测表现良好；低标注场景下样本效率高，仅用 6 名有标注受试者即达约 0.90 AUROC（AD/CN）。

Conclusion: 将神经解剖结构显式嵌入自监督目标（而非依赖通用图像先验）可显著提升结构脑 MRI 表征的分布外泛化与标注效率，SYMBA 为神经影像基础模型提供了领域特化的预训练范式。

Abstract: Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration.
  We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors.
  Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

</details>


### [547] [Learning to Code the World: Harness Evolution for Compositional 3D Reconstruction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37046v1)
*Haoyu Yao,Chenguo Lin,Ruize Du,Yadong Mu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SceneEvolve将3D场景表示为可执行代码，通过围绕小型开源智能体"演化脚手架"来提升重建效果：结合组合式语义动作接口SceneAct与由教师智能体驱动的SceneHarness-RSI，在固定模型参数、动作语义与执行后端的前提下，得到可复用的重建流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单张真实图像重建可编辑、可组合的3D场景，需要联合推理几何、物体结构与空间关系，对小型开源模型而言难度较高；同时希望在不更新参数、不依赖大型专有模型推理的前提下获得高质量重建。

Method: 提出SceneEvolve框架，把3D场景建模为可执行代码。其一是SceneAct——基于参数化基元、层次化组合与语义空间关系的组合式语义动作接口；其二是SceneHarness-RSI——利用更强的教师智能体，依据开发集重建反馈迭代演化harness。演化过程中模型参数、动作语义与执行后端均保持不变，最终得到可由小模型直接复用的重建流程。

Result: 在两个域内数据集与一个域外数据集上，Qwen3.8-27B版SceneEvolve使四项重建指标全部提升，平均推理时间较基座模型降低47.0%；相比大型专有模型GPT-5.6-Sol，重建质量高32.3%，平均等效部署成本低59.8%；演化所得harness迁移到Kimi-K3后，重建性能与GPT-6-Astra相当。

Conclusion: 通过演化智能体外部脚手架而非修改模型权重，可在紧凑开源模型上实现高效、低成本且可迁移的高质量可编辑3D场景重建，说明harness层面的程序化设计是可复用的有效增益来源。

Abstract: Reconstructing editable and compositional 3D scenes from a real image requires jointly reasoning about geometry, object structure, and spatial relationships. We introduce SceneEvolve, a framework that represents 3D scenes as executable code and improves reconstruction by evolving the harness around a small open-source agent. SceneEvolve combines SceneAct, a compositional semantic action interface built on parameterized primitives, hierarchical composition, and semantic spatial relations, with SceneHarness-RSI, which leverages a stronger teacher agent to iteratively evolve the harness using feedback from development-set reconstructions. Throughout harness evolution, the model parameters, action semantics, and execution backend remain fixed. The resulting harness provides a reusable reconstruction procedure that enables the small open-source model to reconstruct unseen scenes without parameter updates or teacher assistance. Across two in-domain datasets and one out-of-domain dataset, SceneEvolve with the comparatively compact Qwen3.8-27B model improves all four evaluated reconstruction metrics while reducing mean inference time by 47.0% relative to the base model. More notably, despite relying on a substantially smaller model, SceneEvolve achieves 32.3% higher reconstruction quality than the large proprietary GPT-5.6-Sol model, while reducing mean equivalent deployment cost by 59.8%. Furthermore, the harness evolved using Qwen3.8-27B also generalizes to Kimi-K3, achieving comparable reconstruction performance to GPT-6-Astra. The project page is https://haoyu-agent.github.io/SceneEvolve.

</details>


### [548] [Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37037v1)
*Lai Wei,Yatai Li,Liangbo He,Jun Lan,Renjie Gu,Linhan Cao,Junkai Lin,Huijia Zhu,Weiqiang Wang,Linghe Kong,Yue Wang,Zhuosheng Zhang,Weiran Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EvidenceConnect 数据合成框架：利用单图内相关区域的放大视图生成需比较/聚合/链式推理视觉证据的问题，并以多VLM一致性校验与区域消融过滤保证质量；再用 RLVR 训练得到 ZwZ2，在细粒度与空间感知及具身推理、长上下文、智能体任务和通用视觉推理上均获提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是具身智能与多模态智能体的两大基础任务，但为其合成定向高质量训练数据困难且昂贵。作者洞察到二者共享同一底层能力——"连接证据"（定位相关视觉事实、绑定到正确实体、恢复关系并组合成答案），而针对该能力合成数据远比针对任务本身容易。

Method: 提出 EvidenceConnect：易于实现的数据合成框架，使用单张图像中相关区域的放大视图（zoomed views）构造需要比较、聚合或链式视觉证据的问题。质量控制采用双重机制：参考答案仅在多个独立 VLM 一致同意时保留；通过区域消融测试（移除选定区域后答案仍不变则丢弃该问题）。随后在合成数据上用 RLVR 训练基座 VLM，得到 Zooming without Zooming v2（ZwZ2）。

Result: 尽管合成数据并非针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2 在细粒度与空间感知上改善，并进一步在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态智能体任务及通用视觉推理上取得增益。

Conclusion: EvidenceConnect 是监督"证据连接"能力的有效框架；强化这一共享底层能力可带来更具泛化性的多模态感知性能。

Abstract: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

</details>


### [549] [GraftRay: Physically Based Mesh Insertion into Gaussian Splatting Scenes via Path Tracing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37036v1)
*Jinxin Ai,Matthias Niessner*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GraftRay 提出统一的物理一致物体插入方法，可将网格物体插入以 2D/3D 高斯泼溅表示的室内场景，显式建模空间延展光源并联合路径追踪，实现视角一致的光照与软阴影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 2DGS/3DGS 重建场景中插入虚拟物体需同时满足物体被场景真实照亮、并向场景投射物理合理阴影。现有方法或在图像空间做外观协调（牺牲多视角一致性），或用插入点处环境贴图近似光照，无法表示室内主导的近场区域光源（窗户、灯具）。

Method: 1）借助扩散先验恢复场景材质与表面法线；2）显式建模空间延展发光体，并以闭式解求其辐射亮度；3）设计混合渲染器，对场景高斯与插入网格联合进行路径追踪，产生视角一致的着色、互反射与软阴影；方法同时兼容 2DGS 与 3DGS 表示。

Result: 在 FIPT 基准上取得新的 SOTA，在渲染保真度与阴影精度上优于 ComGS、EAG-PT 等近期基线，同时保持很有竞争力的渲染效率。

Conclusion: 显式近场区域光源建模加混合路径追踪是提升高斯场景中物体插入物理一致性的有效途径，可在保真度、阴影准确性与效率之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Inserting virtual objects into scenes reconstructed via 2D or 3D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS/3DGS) is a key capability for content creation, AR, and synthetic data generation. However, realistic insertion requires the object to be seamlessly lit by the scene and, conversely, to cast physically plausible shadows onto it. Existing approaches either harmonize appearance in image space, sacrificing multi-view consistency, or approximate scene illumination with an environment map at the insertion point, which cannot represent near-field area lights such as windows and lamps that dominate indoor lighting. To address this, we present GraftRay, a unified method for physically consistent insertion of mesh objects into indoor scenes represented by either 2D or 3D Gaussians. We recover scene materials and surface normals with diffusion-based priors, and explicitly model spatially-extended emitters, solving their radiance in closed form. A hybrid renderer then jointly path-traces the scene Gaussians and inserted meshes, producing view-consistent shading, interreflections, and soft shadows. On FIPT, GraftRay sets a new state of the art, outperforming recent baselines such as ComGS and EAG-PT in rendering fidelity and shadow accuracy, while maintaining highly competitive rendering efficiency.

</details>


### [550] [Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Medical Imaging](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37026v1)
*Sami Alnawali,Muhammad Atif Saeed,Abdul Hadi,Azka Atiq,Akhtar Jamil,Ahmad Din*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在BreakHis组织病理数据集上（患者级划分）基准测试十种ImageNet预训练模型进行乳腺良恶性分类，并用四种可解释性方法解释预测；DenseNet121最优（99.4%准确率，AUC 0.999），Transformer类模型落后于CNN，解释结果一致聚焦于核丰富与腺体区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中具有潜力，但可解释性不足限制其临床落地，因此需要系统比较模型性能并验证解释方法的可靠性。

Method: 采用BreakHis组织病理数据集并进行患者级（patient-level）划分；基准测试十种ImageNet预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT、Swin Transformer），完成良恶性二分类；并用Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients与LRP四种归因方法对预测进行解释，进行模型间显著性检验（p<0.001）。

Result: DenseNet121表现最佳，测试准确率99.4%，AUC-ROC 0.999，且显著优于其他所有模型（p<0.001）；Transformer类模型整体不及CNN；四种解释方法一致地突出具有诊断意义的核密集区与腺体结构区域。

Conclusion: 迁移学习与可解释AI结合可构建准确且可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具；DenseNet121在该任务上性能与解释一致性兼具，CNN在此类组织病理任务中仍具优势。

Abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.

</details>


### [551] [Ground-to-Satellite Knowledge Distillation for Crop Classification under Temporal and Geographic Shift](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37021v1)
*Miro Miranda,Rocco Sedona,Valerio Marsocci,Gabriele Cavallaro,Claudia Paris*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究能否将地面实地照片作为"特权监督"用于基于预训练卫星嵌入的作物类型分类：以冻结CLIP特征构建照片教师，指导AlphaEarth与TESSERA表示上的分类器训练，照片仅在训练阶段使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续、实时的作物类型制图对农业监测至关重要，但受限于参考数据不足。地面照片与卫星时间序列从不同视角刻画同一地块，具有互补性；然而推理时并非每个卫星像元都有对应实地照片，限制了其可扩展性。因此需要探索"训练时可用、推理时不需要"的特权信息利用方式。

Method: 构建配对的地面照片—卫星影像数据集（17个作物类别）。以基于冻结CLIP特征的照片教师模型，通过知识蒸馏监督建立在预训练卫星嵌入（AlphaEarth、TESSERA）之上的学生分类器；照片仅在训练阶段参与，推理阶段不改变输入需求。

Result: 知识蒸馏相比仅用卫星数据的分类结果稳定提升。对冻结嵌入，在时间偏移条件下优势扩大，宏平均F1最高提升+5.5；在地理外推（holdout）场景下提升（+3.7）也大于分布内（+3.0）。

Conclusion: 地面视角监督可有效补充卫星嵌入表征，并在不增加推理负担的前提下提升其鲁棒性，为缺乏参考数据的可扩展作物制图提供了新途径。

Abstract: Continuous and up-to-date crop type mapping is essential for agricultural monitoring but is often hampered by limited reference data. The growing availability of ground-level field photographs offers a promising way to address this challenge. When combined with satellite time series, these images provide complementary perspectives on the same parcel, capturing crop characteristics from distinctly different perspectives. However, field photographs are not always available for each satellite pixel at inference time, limiting their potential in scalable crop type mapping. We investigate whether ground photographs can provide privileged supervision for crop classification built on pretrained satellite embeddings. A photo teacher based on frozen CLIP features supervises classifiers trained on AlphaEarth and TESSERA representations; photographs are used only during training. On a paired field photo and satellite imagery dataset with 17 crop classes, knowledge distillation consistently improves over satellite-only classification; for frozen embeddings the margin grows under temporal shift, reaching up to +5.5 macro-F1 points, and widens in geographic holdouts (+3.7 vs +3.0 in-distribution). These results show that ground-view supervision can complement satellite embeddings and improve their robustness without changing inference requirements.

</details>


### [552] [RePAIR: Inverting Backdoor Attacks in Semantic Segmentation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37015v1)
*Arnold Brosch,Kira Maag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RePAIR——一种无需重训练、无需标签、不依赖攻击假设的后处理式语义分割后门防御方法，利用"后门偏移更多体现在分类头而非内部表征"的观察，推断受害者-目标类关系并定位可疑像素，进而做特征与输出校正，在多种架构与攻击设置下大幅降低攻击成功率并保持干净性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义分割模型对后门攻击依然脆弱：触发器存在时把指定受害类的像素重定向到攻击者指定的目标类，同时保持干净预测不变。现有防御多源自图像分类，专门面向分割的防御稀少，且通常需要重训练或修改模型结构，部署成本高。

Method: 核心观察：后门引起的语义偏移在分类头处强于内部表征，因此受害类语义在特征空间中仍可恢复。RePAIR流程为：(1) 从无标签、可能受污染的图像池中推断受害类-目标类关系；(2) 构建经安全性约束的语义参考；(3) 通过比较分类头预测与内部语义证据定位可疑像素；(4) 向推断出的受害语义做特征空间与输出层校正，并以保守定位与输出约束限制对良性预测的改动。理论上将攻击建模为对抗性概率传输、修复视为其近似逆，推导了定位、残余攻击成功率、干净侧变化、防御诱发目标预测及攻击无关配对识别的界与充分条件。

Result: 在多种分割架构与攻击设置下的实验表明，RePAIR显著降低攻击成功率，同时基本保持干净图像的预测性能。

Conclusion: RePAIR证明了在无需重训练、无需标签、不假设攻击类型的前提下进行分割后门修复的可行性，为后处理式分割防御提供了理论刻画与实证支持。

Abstract: Despite significant advances in computer vision, semantic segmentation models remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks, posing a security risk. These attacks redirect pixels of a chosen victim class to an attacker-specified target class when a trigger is present, while preserving clean predictions. Existing defenses are largely derived from image classification, while dedicated segmentation defenses remain scarce and typically require retraining or model modification. We introduce RePAIR, a post-hoc, label-free, attack-unaware defense based on the observation that backdoor-induced shifts can be stronger in the classifier head than in internal representations, leaving recoverable victim-class semantics. RePAIR infers the victim-target relation from an unlabeled, potentially contaminated image pool, constructs a safety-approved semantic reference, and localizes suspicious pixels by comparing head predictions with internal semantic evidence. It then applies feature-space and output corrections toward the inferred victim semantics, while conservative localization and output constraints limit changes to benign predictions. We model the attack as adversarial probability transport and repair as its approximate reversal, deriving bounds and sufficient conditions for localization, residual attack success, clean-side changes, defense-induced target predictions, and attack-unaware pair identification. Experiments across segmentation architectures and attack settings show that RePAIR substantially reduces attack success while largely preserving clean performance.

</details>


### [553] [GPA-VGGT: Geometry-Preserving Acceleration of VGGT](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37000v2)
*Muyeol Sung,Jangwon Kim,Jongwoo Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GPA-VGGT：一种免训练加速方法，通过用帧内注意力+共享跨帧K/V替代早期块的全局注意力，并在后续块中仅合并K/V并保留全部query、恢复注意力质量、随机投影匹配度量到128维，实现与已有方法相当的速度提升，同时保留超过99%的VGGT位姿精度（AUC@3）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VGGT等前馈几何模型虽能从单次前向中恢复相机参数、深度图与点图，但其全局注意力对帧数呈二次复杂度，在长序列上主导端到端运行时间。已有的免训练加速方法（如token merging）虽提速但精度下降明显，难以真正替代VGGT。因此需要一种既加速又不损失几何精度的免训练方案。

Method: 1) 在早期块中，用帧内注意力（frame attention）并辅以共享的跨帧K/V集合来替代全局注意力；2) 在其余块中，仅合并key和value而保留全部query；3) 恢复每个被合并key所代表token的注意力质量（attention mass）；4) 将匹配度量随机投影到128维以降低匹配开销。整个方法无需训练。

Result: 在多种多视角几何任务上，GPA-VGGT取得了与已有工作相当的速度提升，同时保留了精确几何估计所需的信息；在AUC@3指标下保持超过99%的VGGT位姿精度。

Conclusion: 通过有针对性的注意力近似设计（早期块帧内+共享跨帧K/V、后期块仅合并K/V并保留query、注意力质量恢复与降维匹配），GPA-VGGT在免训练条件下实现了高效且高保真的多视角几何感知，可有效替代VGGT而不牺牲精度。

Abstract: Feed-forward geometry models such as VGGT recover camera parameters, depth maps, and point maps from one to hundreds of views in a single forward pass, making them powerful backbones for multi-view 3D perception. However, VGGT's global attention is quadratic in the number of frames and dominates end-to-end runtime on long sequences, which has motivated a range of training-free efficiency methods such as token merging. These methods, however, come with a drop in accuracy that makes them hard to use in place of VGGT. We propose GPA-VGGT, a training-free acceleration method that replaces global attention in early blocks with frame attention augmented by a shared cross-frame K/V set. In the remaining blocks, we merge only keys and values while preserving all queries, restore the attention mass of the tokens each merged key represents, and randomly project the matching metric to 128 dimensions to reduce matching cost. Across diverse multi-view geometry tasks, GPA-VGGT provides training-free acceleration at speedups comparable to prior work while preserving the information required for precise geometric estimation, retaining over 99% of VGGT's pose accuracy under AUC@3.

</details>


### [554] [LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36986v1)
*Rinyoichi Takezoe,Yaqian Li,Weiren Wang,Zihao Bo,Huihong Shi,Anzhou Hou,Mo Guang,Jiale Yan,Kaiwen Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LearnPrunerV2，将原两阶段启发式剪枝框架升级为完全可学习架构：在每层插入轻量可学习模块，融合视觉内在显著性与（通过 shadow token 捕获的）查询相关性来估计 token 重要性，并基于发现的"阶梯式冗余规律"设计预算确定的硬件友好剪枝调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）因海量视觉 token 带来极高计算开销；现有 token 剪枝方法存在两大缺陷：(1) 剪枝准则不可靠，受注意力偏置或与查询无关的设计影响，难以准确定位任务相关区域；(2) 剪枝策略僵化、非自适应，忽视冗余度随模型深度的动态变化。

Method: LearnPrunerV2：在 VLM 主干每一层集成轻量可学习模块，通过融合内在视觉显著性与借助 shadow token 捕获的外在查询相关性来估计 token 重要性；据此观察跨层一致的阶梯式（staircase）冗余模式，提出 Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP)，以固定的逐层预算构建硬件友好调度。整体由原先两阶段启发式升级为端到端可学习架构。

Result: 在多基准、多 VLM 上一致优于先前 SOTA；在 LLaVA-v1.5 上剪除 77.8% 视觉 token 仍保留原性能的 99.8%，取得更优的精度-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 可学习的、查询感知的 token 重要性估计结合按层固定预算的自适应调度，能有效释放 VLM 视觉 token 冗余，实现近乎无损的高比例剪枝，兼具精度与硬件部署友好性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [555] [Explicit Regional Representations For Video Quality Assessment](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36978v1)
*Fuyi Yang,Lei Yang,Andrew Liu,Chenyu Wei,Xiaoyi Guo,Ming Kai Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文为端到端视频质量评价（VQA）引入显式的像素级区域表示——质量-相关性热图（QRH），在视觉语言模型引导下融合局部退化证据与感知先验，无需像素级标注，并通过两种确定性片段采样策略接入现有VQA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端VQA方法的预测依据（区域证据）基本是隐式的，缺乏可解释、可复用的区域表示接口。

Method: 构建像素级QRH，结合局部退化证据与感知先验、由VLM引导且无需像素级标注；将其应用于已有VQA模型时采用两种确定性片段采样：(1) 分布保持采样，在不重训练的情况下近似原采样器的QRH分数分布；(2) 质量感知采样，优先选取高QRH分数区域并配合微调。

Result: 以DOVER在多个基准上的实验显示：分布保持采样可紧密逼近随机采样平均后的预测；质量感知采样在多数主流VQA基准上提升了大多数评价指标。

Conclusion: 显式区域表示可作为下游VQA的有效接口，兼具可解释性与性能收益。

Abstract: End-to-end video quality assessment (VQA) methods leave the regional evidence underlying their predictions largely implicit. We introduce an explicit pixel-level regional representation for VQA, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH) that combines localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors under vision-language model guidance, without requiring pixel-level annotations. We apply QRH to existing VQA models through two deterministic fragment-sampling strategies: distribution-preserving sampling approximates the original sampler's QRH-score distribution without retraining, while quality-aware sampling prioritizes regions with high QRH scores and is paired with fine-tuning. Experiments with DOVER on multiple benchmarks show that the former closely approximates predictions averaged over random samples, while the latter improves most evaluated metrics across popular VQA benchmarks. These results support explicit regional representations as a useful interface for downstream VQA.

</details>


### [556] [Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36956v1)
*Tamas Kovacs,Daniel Luger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将19世纪Pressutti的regesta与部分版本作为"遗留层"，与教宗Honorius III登记册（Reg. Vat. 9）第1–2年的现代专家转录并置审计，实证其无法替代现代转录，但能在正字法、词汇、拓扑三个层级上引导、校验与切分手写文本识别（HTR）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Honorius III登记册的HTR依赖现代专家转录，而这类金标仅覆盖Reg. Vat. 9的第1–2年；余下登记册仅有Pressutti regesta与零散旧版本。作者要回答：在两层文本共存的fol. 1–203上，这一"遗留层"究竟能为HTR贡献什么、以何种方式贡献。

Method: 先在fol. 1–203上以现代转录审计遗留文本，再分三层实验：(1) 正字法层——比较原始旧版本、经"重放"（replay）与投影到教廷拼写后的零标签适配效果，测WER与oracle差距，并分析拼写/书写者/字迹变化的年代拐点；(2) 词汇层——用全语料遗留词表估计对未编辑条目OOV词的覆盖率，评估其检错精度，并将预训练中世纪NER模型蒸馏进识别器的NER头；(3) 拓扑层——用regest收束数据条款与转换为教廷罗马数字形式的日期定位行流中的条目起点，并以版本一致性估计CER。

Result: 正字法层：原始版本至多中性、不重放则有害；投影到教廷拼写并重放现代源行后成为零标签适配目标，134个第2年页合并WER下降1.50点（95% CI −1.84至−1.15），弥合与oracle差距的33%；拼写变化发生在年度分界处（源于书写者或转录者），而字迹仅在fol. 191r明显改变。词汇层：遗留词表覆盖未编辑条目OOV词的82.2%，检错精度66.7%；蒸馏NER达F1 82.1%，与识别后最佳标注器持平。拓扑层：可定位73.9%条目起点；版本一致性估计fol. 203之后CER为7.80%。

Conclusion: 古文献学成果不能取代现代转录，但可在未转录登记册上对HTR起引导、校验与切分作用；其价值取决于分层使用方式，且在正字法层须经拼写投影与重放才能转化为有效监督。

Abstract: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.

</details>


### [557] [Dense Representation Learning and Differentiable Shape Modeling for Spine Landmark Detection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36951v1)
*Augustin Daridon,Sofiane Sifaoui,Ayman Assi,Mohamad Karam,Wafa Skalli,Elsa Angelini,Loic Le Folgoc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文将脊柱X光解剖关键点检测重构为像素级对比表征学习问题，用密集像素嵌入与关键点原型匹配，并结合全局形状先验以消除关键点歧义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脊柱X光关键点检测是评估脊柱形变严重程度、构建生物力学模型和术前规划的关键步骤；传统热图回归范式难以区分不同椎体上的椎角关键点。

Method: 把关键点检测表述为像素级对比学习：将密集像素嵌入与关键点原型进行匹配生成热图；即使采用通用U-Net主干，该表述也产生更具判别力的热图；随后将热图与可学习的全局脊柱关键点构型形状先验结合，解决关键点位置歧义。

Result: 在公开AASCE数据集及两个私有脊柱X光数据集上，方法在关键点精度与临床参数估计方面与最先进方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 像素级对比表征学习可替代传统热图回归以获得更可分的脊柱关键点热图，配合全局形状先验形成简单实用的脊柱关键点检测方案；代码与预训练权重已开源（BioMedTP/Pix2Point）。

Abstract: Spine landmark detection from spinal X-ray is a key step for estimating spine deformation severity, for building biomechanical models, and for pre-operative planning. We reframe anatomical landmark detection as a pixel-level contrastive representation learning problem, matching dense pixel embeddings with landmark prototypes. Surprisingly, even with a generic U-Net backbone, this formulation results in more discriminative heatmaps compared to the traditional heatmap regression paradigm, leading to improved discrimination between vertebral corners on distinct vertebra. Furthermore, we combine the resulting heatmaps with learnable shape priors over the global configuration of spinal landmarks to resolve ambiguities in landmark locations, yielding a simple and practical approach to spinal landmark detection. Our approach is competitive, in terms of landmark accuracy and clinical parameter estimation, with the state-of-the-art on the public AASCE dataset and on two private spinal X-ray datasets. Our code and pre-trained weights are available at https://github.com/BioMedTP/Pix2Point.

</details>


### [558] [PREEN: Exemplar-Based Color Style Transfer with Smartphone Editor Presets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36896v1)
*Beomjin Ahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PREEN 将色彩风格迁移转化为对确定性图像编辑器 29 个参数的回归，直接预测可解释、可被编辑器直接使用的预设向量，而非生成栅格图，并在 PST50 基准上取得优于基线的保真度与亚秒级设备端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有风格迁移方法通常输出栅格图像，结果难以编辑、不可解释，也难以融入真实修图工作流。作者希望让迁移结果以“预设/滑块参数”的形式呈现，从而具备可解释性与可直接消费性。核心难点在于监督信号缺失：任意真实参考图并不存在对应的预设真值。

Method: 将色彩风格迁移建模为对确定性图像编辑器 29 个参数的回归。用风格迁移教师模型生成目标外观，并将其反演到编辑器参数空间得到伪预设作为监督；先预训练一个以 CLIP 为条件的回归器，再在图像级 CIELAB 损失下用 LoRA 微调。

Result: 在人工构建的 PST50 基准上，PREEN 在应用参考色彩的同时保持结构保真，在像素级与感知保真度指标上领先基线；预设表示紧凑，设备端推理延迟低于一秒。

Conclusion: 低维参数子空间天然提供一个单一位于推理期的强度调节旋钮，可在一次前向传播中给出从默认到浓艳的连续轨迹，且每个中间状态都是合法编辑器预设。双轴人类研究显示：评分者认为浓艳端更贴合参考、但默认端作为独立照片更佳，该权衡可由旋钮在无需重训练的情况下覆盖。

Abstract: We present PREEN (Preset Regression via an Exemplar-based Editor Network), which casts color style transfer as regression onto the 29 parameters of a deterministic image editor. Given a content image and a style reference, PREEN predicts a preset, a vector of editor slider values that is interpretable and editor-consumable, not a raster image. The key obstacle is supervision, since an arbitrary real reference lacks a preset ground truth. We therefore supervise with a style-transfer teacher, whose target looks we invert into the editor's parameter space as pseudo-presets, then pretrain a CLIP-conditioned regressor and refine it with LoRA under an image-level CIELAB loss. On the human-curated PST50 benchmark, PREEN applies the reference's color while preserving structural fidelity, leading the baselines on pixel- and perceptual-fidelity metrics. The preset is compact and predicted at sub-second on-device latency. The low-dimensional subspace also exposes a single inference-time strength knob that traces a continuous default-to-vivid trajectory in one forward pass, with every intermediate state a valid editor preset. A two-axis human study shows that raters prefer the vivid end for matching the reference but the default as a standalone photo, a trade-off the knob spans without retraining.

</details>


### [559] [HoloRecon: Incremental Reconstruction of Long-Range Panoramas with Global Consistency](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36876v1)
*Zhuoxiao Li,Xinyi Liu,Hongye Hou,Jing OU,Kang Du,Shuai Zhang,Dongli Wu,Taoyu Wu,Siyuan Feng,Xiaohui Zhu,Wufan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出耦合ORB稀疏全景SLAM前端与微调前馈模型的全景重建框架，利用预测局部几何对跨远距离重访的特征匹配做3D验证以建立长程约束，并发布PanoRecon基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列全景重建需要细节丰富的场景几何与跨远距离重访全局一致的相机位姿。全景SLAM与增量式SfM依赖特征对应，但重复/相似结构与小重叠使可靠长程连接难建立，漂移无法消除；前馈模型局部几何精细但算力受限、推理窗口小，需额外全局约束。

Method: ORB稀疏全景建图前端＋微调前馈模型的紧耦合框架；用稀疏路标标定预测深度，以预测局部几何对远距离重访的特征匹配进行3D验证，生成跨区域长程相机约束；用验证连接优化全局位姿图，并以校正后位姿更新稠密几何；同时构建含七个场景、重复建筑、大小回环及参考位姿与LiDAR几何的PanoRecon基准。

Result: 在评估方法中取得最低平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）与较高F-1 Score。

Conclusion: 特征跟踪的连续性与前馈模型的局部几何质量互补：以预测几何验证匹配可将局部重建转化为长程全局约束，实现长序列全景下的精确定位与全局一致稠密建图。

Abstract: Long-sequence panoramic reconstruction requires detailed scene geometry and globally consistent camera poses across distant revisits. Panoramic SLAM and incremental SfM rely on feature correspondences, but repeated, similar structures and small partial overlap make reliable long-range connections difficult to establish, leaving accumulated drift unresolved. Feed-forward models offer detailed local geometry, but their high computational costs limit inference window size, necessitating additional constraints for global consistency. This motivates combining continuous feature-based tracking and sparse mapping with rapid, high-quality local reconstruction from feed-forward models to achieve accurate localization and globally consistent dense mapping over long sequences. We therefore propose a panoramic reconstruction framework that couples an ORB-based sparse panoramic mapping frontend with a fine-tuned feed-forward model. Our key insight is that predicted local geometry enables 3D verification of feature matches across distant revisits, yielding long-range camera constraints even between regions. We calibrate predicted depths with sparse landmarks and use verified connections to optimize the global pose graph, updating dense geometry with the corrected camera poses. We also introduce PanoRecon, a seven-scene benchmark with repetitive architecture, large and small loops, and reference camera poses and LiDAR geometry for evaluating global consistency. Our method achieves the lowest mean absolute trajectory error and high F-1 Score among the evaluated methods. Project Page:https://zhuoxiaoli.github.io/HoloRecon_page/

</details>


### [560] [AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36874v1)
*Bingchao Wang,Yongcheng Jing,Chengyu Wang,Jun Huang,Jie Yang,Wei Liu,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaGround 是一个免训练的 GUI grounding 框架，通过自适应缩放、验证器闭环与结构化组合接地，在 OSWorld-G 与 ScreenSpot-Pro 上较骨干模型提升 7.4–20.6 个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率屏幕上的 GUI grounding 主要在小目标上失败，而放大（zoom-in）是常见的免训练补救手段；但现有 zooming 流程存在问题：未根据目标尺寸匹配放大倍数、无条件接受放大后的答案、且从不回溯错误答案。

Method: 提出三个组件：(1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming，依据模型对目标尺寸的自身估计来设定每个样本的放大倍数、视野与缩放深度；(2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement，用一个带标记点击的 Yes/No 验证器决定保留或拒绝每次缩放、在缩放链之间选择、触发重新接地，并通过存在性查询决定何时弃答；(3) Compositional Structure Grounding，由表头组合电子表格单元格。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL 模型上，AdaGround 超过最先进的免训练 zooming 方法与许多已训练的 GUI 模型；在 OSWorld-G 和 ScreenSpot-Pro 上较骨干模型提升 7.4 至 20.6 个点，且增益可迁移到留出的 UI-Vision。

Conclusion: AdaGround 以自适应缩放、验证器闭环与组合式结构接地，显著提升高分辨率屏幕小目标的 GUI grounding 精度，且无需额外训练，具备良好的泛化性。

Abstract: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround

</details>


### [561] [RangeRectQuant: Compressing Scientific Fields for Every Future Rectangular Sum](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36873v1)
*Jiahao Zhang,Xinling Wen,Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RangeRectQuant 提出一种"协同扰动"的栅格量化方法：在保持像素取值范围与指定精确样本的前提下，精确控制前缀和误差，使任意轴对齐矩形求和均满足统一的绝对误差预算，实现线性时间、单行工作空间的高效编码与显著存储节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学栅格常在"待测区域未知"时就被存储。若采用逐像素独立误差界，则为了让所有未来可能矩形都恰好可重建整数结果，只能做精确整数重建（无压缩收益）。作者希望放宽为"允许像素协同变化"，从而在保证任意矩形和准确的同时获得压缩空间。

Method: 利用前缀和性质：从左上角累积的前缀和中，四个前缀和即可确定任意矩形总和。RangeRectQuant 保持像素值域与指定精确样本，并控制前缀和误差。对每个行位置，精确刻画出可使"剩余像素"满足约束的误差集合——该集合为单个整数区间（即使存在多种补全方式）；反向遍历求区间端点，正向遍历据此选择量化像素。

Result: 生成的栅格场对每个轴对齐矩形均满足给定误差预算；算法线性工作量，工作空间仅为一行规模。在地理留出的建成地表与水体出现频次地图上实验，相比满足相同要求的替代方法取得显著存储节省。

Conclusion: 数据生产方一次编码，后续用户在无源数据、无需重编码、无需查询相关校正的情况下即可测量任意矩形，兼顾误差保证、效率与压缩率。

Abstract: Scientific rasters are often stored before the regions to be measured are known. Independent pixel-error bounds can force exact integer reconstruction when one absolute error budget covers every future rectangle. Coordinated changes allow every pixel to change while every rectangular sum remains accurate. A prefix sum accumulates values from the top-left corner. Four such sums determine any rectangular total. RangeRectQuant preserves the pixel range and designated exact samples while controlling errors in prefix sums. At each row position, we characterize exactly which errors let the remaining pixels meet these constraints. These errors form a single integer interval, even when many completions exist. A backward pass finds its endpoints; a forward pass uses them to choose quantized pixels. The resulting field meets the prescribed error budget for every axis-aligned rectangle, with linear work and workspace proportional to one row. Experiments on geographically held-out built-surface and water-occurrence maps show substantial storage savings over alternatives meeting the same requirements. Data producers encode once; later users measure arbitrary rectangles without the source, re-encoding, or query-specific correction.

</details>


### [562] [Forget the Data, Keep the Capability: Switchable Unlearning for Retrieval](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36858v1)
*Jingong Chen,Kyle Gao,Guangyuan Li,Chulwoo Pack,Sijia Liu,Kwanghee Won*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MoME，一种可切换框架：将预训练骨干拆分为保存检索能力的核心参数与承载全量知识的寄生参数，在梯度隔离下训练，关闭分支得 Core（已遗忘），开启得 Full（保留知识），实现"翻开关而非重训"的机器遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私合规要求重识别模型能选择性遗忘特定个体（删除其训练数据）同时保留对他人识别能力。常规做法需重训练，代价高；文章希望单模型可在"标准推理"与"已遗忘推理"间切换，且使遗忘删除请求变为一次开关切换而非再训练。

Method: 1) 把骨干分为核心参数（保证检索）与零初始化的寄生参数（承载全量数据知识）；2) 训练时梯度隔离，核心不接收遗忘集梯度；3) 关闭寄生分支得 Core（满足删除请求），开启得 Full（保留遗忘数据带来的知识）；4) 理论上证明 Core 在经审计的耦合通道集合上独立于遗忘集，并提出基于秩的 Forgetting-Rank 统计量用于在训练后模型中审计该独立性。

Result: 在 Market-1501、VeRi-776、RegDB 上，Core 在三种成员推断攻击下的隐私泄露水平与重训参考模型相当（即达到遗忘效果），且检索性能高于该参考；检索优势可迁移到 ResNet 与 CLIP 骨干。代码与权重已开源。

Conclusion: MoME 以参数拆分+梯度隔离实现可切换的机器遗忘，在隐私合规（抗成员推断）与检索效用间取得优于重训基线的平衡，并给出可审计的独立性证明工具（Forgetting-Rank），具备跨骨干通用性。

Abstract: Privacy compliance requires re-identification models to selectively forget individuals while preserving their ability to recognize others. For this, we present MoME, a switchable framework that can adapt pre-trained backbones for privacy compliance, allowing the same model to switch between Full mode for standard inference and Core mode for unlearned inference. MoME splits one backbone into core parameters that preserve retrieval and zero-initialized parasitic parameters that carry the full-data knowledge, and training them under gradient isolation so the core never receives a forget-set gradient. Disabling the branch yields Core, which satisfies a request to delete a person's training data, and enabling it yields Full, which retains what the deleted data taught, so honoring the request is a flag flip rather than a retraining run. We prove Core independent of the forget set up to an audited set of coupling channels and introduce the rank-based Forgetting-Rank statistic to audit that independence in a trained model. On Market-1501, VeRi-776 and RegDB, Core reads at a retrained reference under three membership attacks while retrieving above it, and the retrieval advantage carries to ResNet and CLIP backbones. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Jingong-Chen/MoME.

</details>


### [563] [Evaluating AlphaEarth Embeddings for Crop Classification: Separability, Temporal Dynamics, and Cross-Regional Transferability](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36857v2)
*Priyanka Goyal,Maitreyee Sar,Adway Mitra,Manjira Sinha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出一个与表示形式无关的评估框架，系统比较64维AlphaEarth嵌入与Sentinel-2反射率、NDVI物候及谐波特征在作物分类中的表现，揭示"表征丰富性"与"跨区域可迁移性"之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于遥感（EO）的农业监测正从像元级光谱分析转向表征驱动建模，但针对学习到的表征尚缺乏系统评估。地理空间基础模型（FM）产生的高维嵌入虽编码了复杂的地表时空属性，其在农业应用中的效用与可解释性仍不清楚。

Method: 采用表示无关（representation-agnostic）的评估框架，在美国本土（CONUS，2017–2023）与印度北部（2021）的田块尺度数据上，从四个维度比较特征：几何可分性（Fisher比、Bhattacharyya距离、Mahalanobis距离）、时序动态（轮作可分辨性）、空间稳健性（残差空间自相关Moran's I）、跨区域泛化（美国→印度迁移的Macro F1）。

Result: 传统特征线性可分性强（Fisher比高）；嵌入在分布感知可分性上显著更优，光谱相似类别（玉米/大豆）的Bhattacharyya与Mahalanobis距离高出一个数量级（3.9 vs. 0.10）。嵌入能独特捕捉多年轮作动态，可分性比达1.784，而所有工程特征最高仅1.003。空间显式验证下嵌入的残差空间自相关更低（平均Moran's I≈0.17），对地理邻近性的依赖更弱。但谐波特征跨大陆迁移性更强（US→India Macro F1：0.493 vs. 嵌入0.326），NDVI亦具相似优势；组合特征空间性能最均衡。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了表征丰富性与跨区域可迁移性之间的权衡，为大规模作物分类中的特征选择提供了系统框架；实践中组合特征空间可获得更均衡的表现。

Abstract: Earth Observation (EO)-based agricultural monitoring is shifting from pixel-level spectral analysis toward representation-driven modeling, yet systematic evaluation of learned representations remains limited. Geospatial foundation models (FMs) generate high-dimensional embeddings encoding complex spatio-temporal land-surface properties, but their utility and interpretability for agricultural applications remain insufficiently understood. This study presents a representation-agnostic framework evaluating a 64-dimensional AlphaEarth embedding space against Sentinel-2 reflectance, NDVI phenology, and harmonic features across geometric separability, temporal dynamics, spatial robustness, and cross-regional generalisation using field-scale data from the Conterminous United States (CONUS; 2017-2023) and Northern India (2021).
  Traditional features achieve strong linear separability (Fisher ratio), while embeddings provide superior distribution-aware separation - Bhattacharyya and Mahalanobis distances up to an order of magnitude higher for spectrally similar pairs (e.g. Corn/Soybeans: 3.9 vs. 0.10). Embeddings uniquely capture multi-year crop rotation dynamics, yielding a separability ratio of 1.784, versus a maximum of 1.003 for all engineered features. Under spatially explicit validation, embeddings exhibit lower residual spatial autocorrelation of errors (mean Moran's $I \approx 0.17$), reducing reliance on geographic proximity. However, harmonic features show stronger cross-continental transferability (US $\to$ India Macro F1: 0.493 vs. 0.326 for embeddings), with NDVI showing a similar advantage. The combined feature space yields balanced performance. These findings reveal a trade-off between representational richness and cross-region transferability, providing a framework for feature selection in large-scale crop classification.

</details>


### [564] [LingGS: Decoupling Feed-Forward Geometry Prediction from Camera Tracking for High-Fidelity Gaussian SLAM](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36853v1)
*Da Li,Yihan Zang,Ivan Viola,Zeyu Wang,Dominik Engel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在线单目 RGB 高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统，将冻结的流式 3D 基础模型作为虚拟 RGB-D 传感器提供深度先验，并结合基于特征重投影的显式几何求解器进行相机跟踪，在有限优化预算下同时获得高质量重建与实时跟踪，单张 RTX 4090 上约 7 FPS，吞吐量为对比系统的 2–3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目 RGB 高斯泼溅 SLAM 在有限优化预算下难以同时兼顾高质量重建与响应式相机跟踪；且学习式相机预测在跟踪精度上存在瓶颈，需要一种更可靠的跟踪方式来支撑在线建图。

Method: 以冻结的流式 3D 基础模型作为虚拟 RGB-D 传感器，从单目视频估计深度；再用显式几何求解器通过特征重投影估计相机位姿；最后由流式高斯映射器将观测增量式融合为稠密场景表示。

Result: 在室内外数据集上的大量实验表明，方法在重建质量上显著优于现有方法；单张 RTX 4090 上约 7 FPS，吞吐量约为所评估的先前 SLAM 系统的 2–3 倍；在多种代表性流式几何骨干上，几何跟踪均提升了相机位姿精度，说明方法的广泛适用性。

Conclusion: 将学习式几何先验与显式几何相机跟踪相结合的在线框架，在有限优化预算下可同时实现高质量重建与高精度、高吞吐的跟踪，且几何跟踪对多种流式几何骨干具有普适增益。

Abstract: Achieving high-quality reconstruction and responsive camera tracking remains challenging for monocular RGB Gaussian splatting SLAM under a limited optimization budget. We present an online system that addresses this challenge by combining learned geometric priors with explicit geometric camera tracking, which can substantially outperform learned camera prediction in terms of tracking accuracy. A frozen streaming 3D foundation model serves as a virtual RGB-D sensor, providing depth estimation from monocular video. An explicit geometric solver then estimates camera motion through feature reprojection, and a streaming Gaussian mapper integrates the resulting observations into a dense scene representation. We further show that geometric tracking improves camera pose accuracy across representative streaming geometry backbones, demonstrating the broader applicability of our approach. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets show that our method significantly improves reconstruction quality over existing approaches, achieving about 7 FPS on a single RTX 4090 and delivering 2-3 times the throughput of the evaluated prior SLAM systems.

</details>


### [565] [uTHCD-C: A Corruption-Robustness Benchmark for Tamil Handwritten Character Recognition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36850v1)
*Preethi S,Meeradevi T,Arun Prakash A*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出泰米尔语手写字符识别鲁棒性基准uTHCD-C，含10种腐蚀、5级严重度，评测9种CNN/Transformer架构，ConvNeXt与Swin鲁棒性最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有泰米尔语手写字符识别（HCR）评估多局限于干净测试图像，缺乏标准化、多腐蚀的鲁棒性基准；同时缺少对鲁棒性与计算开销权衡的系统刻画。

Method: 基于无约束泰米尔手写字符数据库（uTHCD）构建uTHCD-C基准：定义10种腐蚀类型（含手写专属的笔画细化腐蚀）、5个严重度等级；采用五折分层交叉验证与书写者无关测试，评估9种卷积与Transformer架构；以VGG16-BN为参考模型，用归一化平均腐蚀误差（mCE）量化鲁棒性，并比较参数量、计算复杂度与推理吞吐。

Result: ConvNeXt与Swin获得最低mCE（0.75、0.83），ShuffleNet与MnasNet较高（1.55、1.85）；效率测量刻画了腐蚀鲁棒性与计算需求之间的权衡差异。

Conclusion: uTHCD-C通过标准化腐蚀配置、评估协议与对比结果，为泰米尔HCR鲁棒性与计算效率研究提供可复现基线。

Abstract: Evaluation of Tamil handwritten character recognition (HCR) has largely focused on clean test images, and a standardized multi-corruption robustness benchmark for isolated Tamil HCR has not been established. We introduce uTHCD-C, a corruption-robustness benchmark based on the unconstrained Tamil Handwritten Character Database (uTHCD). The benchmark defines ten corruption types, including a handwriting-specific stroke-thinning corruption, at five severity levels. We evaluate nine convolutional and transformer-based architectures using five-fold stratified cross-validation and writer-independent testing. Robustness is quantified using mean Corruption Error (mCE), normalized against a VGG16-BN reference. We additionally compare parameter count, computational complexity, and inference throughput to characterize the computational requirements of the evaluated architectures. The results establish comparative robustness baselines for Tamil HCR, revealing substantial differences across architectures: ConvNeXt and Swin achieve the lowest mCE values (0.75 and 0.83, respectively), whereas ShuffleNet and MnasNet exhibit higher values (1.55 and 1.85, respectively). The accompanying efficiency measurements characterize the trade-offs between corruption robustness and computational requirements. By providing standardized corruption configurations, evaluation protocols, and comparative results, uTHCD-C establishes a reproducible basis for future research on robust and computationally efficient Tamil HCR.

</details>


### [566] [AxisQ: Depth-Adaptive Channel--Frequency Quantization for Camouflaged Object Detection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36844v1)
*Chi Ruan,Tianqi Li,Xin He,Xue Geng,Ming-Ming Cheng,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AxisQ，一种面向伪装目标检测(COD)的深度自适应比特分配量化框架：浅层在通道域、深层在局部频域分配精度，并结合边界感知 Hessian 近似做重建，在 W2A2 低比特下显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COD 依赖的弱纹理与边界线索在激进训练后量化(PTQ)下易被破坏；现有 PTQ 方法主要优化量化器或重建网络块，且在整个层级骨干中始终使用单一精度分配域，未考虑不同深度特征的可分配维度差异。

Method: 基于"有效分配轴随特征深度变化"的观察，提出 AxisQ：在固定的逐层平均激活比特预算下，浅层特征在通道域分配精度、深层特征在局部频域分配精度，并以 COD 感知敏感度指导分配以保留细微前景与模糊边界；同时引入边界加权梯度与误差统计，构造边界感知的 Hessian 近似用于重建。

Result: 在多个 COD 模型与多种基准上，低比特宽度下精度优于最强基线；W2A2 量化下 CAMO 数据集上，CFRN 的相对加权 F-measure 提升 12.7%，CamoFormer-P 提升 33.3%。

Conclusion: 将精度分配域与特征深度相匹配，可作为层级式 COD 模型的一种可迁移量化策略。

Abstract: Camouflaged object detection (COD) depends on weak texture and boundary cues that can be destroyed by aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ). Existing PTQ methods mainly optimize quantizers or reconstruct network blocks, while using a single precision-allocation domain throughout hierarchical backbones. Instead, we introduce AxisQ, a depth-adaptive bit-allocation framework motivated by the observation that the useful allocation axis changes with feature depth. Under a fixed per-layer average activation-bit budget, AxisQ allocates precision in the channel domain for shallow features and in the local-frequency domain for deep features, using COD-aware sensitivity to better preserve subtle foreground regions and ambiguous boundaries.
