At its core, GRNStyle builds on Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) and introduces a polar style-aware mask that embeds style identities as equal-norm directions within selected regions. Complementary representation--geometry conditioning combines encoded mask features with raw-mask spatial support, integrating spatiotemporal context with geometric control. To provide paired supervision, we develop an automated pipeline combining global stylization, video object removal, matting, and compositing, and construct the LociArt-100K Dataset with 100K local stylization pairs. We further establish the LociArt Benchmark, comprising 80 source videos and 84 target masks covering 168 foreground/background stylization cases, with a Style Prototype Similarity (SPS) evaluation scheme for regional style quality and complementary measures of non-target preservation and temporal consistency. Experiments show that GRNStyle outperforms existing methods in regional style quality and spatial control while maintaining strong temporal consistency. Qualitative examples further illustrate joint stylization of multiple regions with the same or different learned styles, despite training only on single-region, single-style pairs. Together, these components provide a unified foundation for learning and evaluating controllable local video stylization. Project page: https://higherhu.github.io/lociart/.

</details>


### [602] [FORESEE-MS: Toward Prospective Spatial Forecasting of Future Multiple Sclerosis Lesions from Baseline FLAIR MRI](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36428v1)
*Maryam Akhavan Aghdam,Sudip Mittal,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FORESEE-MS评估协议，以fold-specific人群先验图谱为基线，检验基线FLAIR能否预测未来MS病灶形成；在小样本MSSEG-2队列上，图谱在体素级AUROC/AUPRC上未被任何深度学习模型可靠超越，但3D U-Net与Attn+ResBlock+VAE在患者内定位指标上均值更高（差异不显著）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统MS影像分析多聚焦于回顾性病灶检测与分割，缺乏对未来病灶形成风险的预测性评估；且现有研究多以人群级空间分布模式为依据，需明确基线FLAIR是否携带超越人群先验的患者特异性预测信息。

Method: 提出FORESEE-MS评估协议：以fold-specific（折内特异性）人群先验图谱作为基线；采用体素级判别指标（AUROC、AUPRC）与患者内病灶定位指标（Recall@Top-K%）进行评价，并用患者级bootstrap估计置信区间；在MSSEG-2数据集39例受试者上以5折交叉验证评估5种深度学习模型（3D U-Net、Attn+ResBlock+VAE、ViT及两种SwinUNETR变体）。

Result: 人群先验图谱取得最高的池化体素级AUROC与AUPRC，无任一深度学习模型在这两项指标上可靠超越；但3D U-Net与Attn+ResBlock+VAE在所有评估阈值下的患者内Recall@Top-K%均值均高于图谱，不过多数配对置信区间包含零，差异未达统计显著。

Conclusion: 基线FLAIR可能包含患者特异性预测信息，但在该小规模队列中，该信息能否带来超越人群先验图谱的病灶预测增益仍不确定；结果凸显了强基线对比与不确定性量化的必要性，需在更大队列中验证。

Abstract: Traditional multiple sclerosis (MS) image analysis has primarily focused on retrospectively detecting and segmenting lesions. This study investigates whether baseline FLAIR MRI can identify regions at risk for future lesion formation beyond population-level spatial patterns. We introduce FORESEE-MS, an evaluation protocol that uses a fold-specific population-prior atlas as a baseline and assesses predictions using pooled voxel-level discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC) and within-patient lesion localization (Recall@Top-K%), with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluated five deep learning models (3D U-Net, Attn+ResBlock+VAE, ViT, and two SwinUNETR variants) using 5-fold cross-validation on 39 subjects from the MSSEG-2 dataset. The atlas achieved the highest pooled voxel-level AUROC and AUPRC, with no deep learning model reliably outperforming it on either metric. However, the 3D U-Net and Attn+ResBlock+VAE achieved higher mean voxel-level within-patient Recall@Top-K% than the atlas at all evaluated thresholds, although most paired confidence intervals for the differences included zero. These findings suggest that baseline FLAIR may contain patient-specific predictive information, but in this small cohort, it remains uncertain whether this information improves lesion forecasting beyond a population-prior atlas.

</details>


### [603] [SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36420v1)
*Truman Hickok*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 SO-101 Bench：基于真实 SO-101 机械臂的 Isaac Lab 数字孪生，构建语言条件空间操作仿真基准，含 4 个任务（计为 5 个评测族）、138 个物体（已见/未见实例/未见类别划分）、916 个评测回合与 3,629 条仿真示教；验证仿真孪生能复现真机策略排序（ρ=1.00），并揭示当前 VLA 在空间放置、未见类别与旋转适配规划上仍存明显短板，而"LLM 写代码 + 学习策略执行抓取"的框架可达 83.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本机械臂（如 SO-101）已成为机器人学习最常见的入门平台，但尚无开箱即用、可在其上执行"空间受约束 + 语言条件"任务的策略；现有 SO-101 基准仅在真机运行，任务简单、留出物体少，缺乏可复现、可细粒度归因的评测手段，难以判断策略失败来源（空间推理、未见物体泛化、遮挡记忆等）。

Method: 构建 SO-101 真机装置的 Isaac Lab 数字孪生仿真基准：设计 4 个任务、按 5 个评测族计分；构建 138 个物体并划分为已见、未见实例、未见类别三种划分；组织 916 个评测回合，包含留出外观、旋转适配（rotate-to-fit）规划与遮挡记忆子集；提供 3,629 条仿真示教，所有学习型策略在等算力预算下统一微调。验证方面，用真机在未见环境、未见物体上复跑同一权重，比较仿真与真机的策略排序一致性（Spearman ρ、MMRV）。对比范围覆盖 9 个 VLA、世界-动作模型及一个 LLM agent，并对 LLM agent 的 harness 与语言模型选择做消融。

Result: 孪生与真机排序高度一致：5 个未用真实数据训练的策略（4 个 VLA + 1 个 LLM agent）在真机上保持完全相同的排名（Spearman ρ = 1.00，MMRV = 0.000），但仿真会高估成功率。在 9 个 VLA 与世界-动作模型中，最佳学习型策略约 61%，空间放置、未见物体类别与旋转适配规划仍是开放难点。LLM agent（生成代码并将抓取交给学习型策略）达 83.2%；消融显示其领先来源于 harness 设计与语言模型的选择。

Conclusion: SO-101 Bench 提供了一个与真机策略排序可对齐、支持细粒度失效归因的低成本仿真评测平台，可替代部分真机评测成本；结论表明当前端到端 VLA 在语言条件空间操作上仍不足，而"代码生成 + 专用抓取策略"的分层 harness 是更有效的路径，且性能对 harness 与基座模型选择敏感。

Abstract: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.

</details>


### [604] [SpeeDiff: Scalable Pixel-Anchored End-to-End Latent Diffusion Model](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36419v1)
*Bingliang Zhang,Wenda Chu,Yizhuo Li,Linjie Yang,Yisong Yue,Katherine L. Bouman,Yang Song,Qiushan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpeeDiff，一种从零开始联合训练 VAE 与扩散模型的潜扩散方法，通过 Tweedie 像素重建（TPR）损失缓解端到端训练中的潜空间塌缩问题，实现显著更快的收敛速度与高质量生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统两阶段方法（预训练冻结 VAE + 扩散模型）中，扩散损失无法直接指导 VAE 编码器，难以形成"利于生成"的潜空间。理论上联合训练可让扩散损失梯度直接优化编码器以加速收敛，但朴素端到端实现会因扩散损失无约束反向传播导致潜空间塌缩，性能严重退化。

Method: 提出简单有效的 Tweedie 像素重建（TPR）损失：利用 Tweedie 公式从中间噪声状态解码出预测的干净潜变量，从而提供额外的像素级反馈以缓解塌缩。在此基础上，方法支持全 Transformer 架构的联合规模化，并增强端到端框架内的表征对齐。

Result: SpeeDiff-XL 相比 Vanilla SiT 与 REPA 分别实现超过 140 倍与 61 倍的训练加速；在 ImageNet 256×256 无引导生成上达到 FID 1.50；在使用更高效的 32 倍压缩 VAE 时，ImageNet 512×512 无引导生成达到 FID 1.53。

Conclusion: TPR 损失有效解决了端到端联合训练的潜空间塌缩问题，使联合训练在收敛速度与生成质量上均优于两阶段范式，并可与全 Transformer 架构规模化及表征对齐协同，展现出高效、可扩展的统一训练潜力。

Abstract: We present Scalable Pixel-anchored End-to-end Diffusion (SpeeDiff), a latent diffusion method that jointly trains the VAE and the diffusion model from scratch. In principle, joint training allows the diffusion loss gradient to directly guide the VAE encoder, encouraging the formation of a generation-friendly latent space and potentially yielding faster convergence than the conventional two-stage approach with a pretrained frozen VAE. However, a naive end-to-end implementation severely degrades performance, as unrestricted backpropagation of the diffusion loss leads to latent space collapse. Our main technical contribution is a simple yet effective Tweedie Pixel Reconstruction (TPR) loss, which provides additional pixel-level feedback by decoding a predicted clean latent from an intermediate noisy state using Tweedie's formula, thereby alleviating collapse. Furthermore, our method enables jointly scaling a fully transformer-based architecture and enhances representation alignment within the end-to-end framework. Our SpeeDiff-XL model achieves over 140x and 61x faster training compared to Vanilla SiT and REPA, respectively, while attaining an FID of 1.50 without guidance on ImageNet 256x256 generation. With a more efficient 32x compressed VAE, our model further reaches an FID of 1.53 without guidance on ImageNet 512x512 generation.

</details>


### [605] [ORBITAL: Optimization of Robust Brain--Computer Inference Through Architecture-Aware Low-Precision Compression](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36411v1)
*Saim Rehman,Muhammad Shafique*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ORBITAL 框架，在压缩 EEG 解码器的同时约束其对抗鲁棒性，并在边缘设备上做原生验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑 EEG 解码器支持嵌入式脑机接口，但压缩可能在硬件收益不成比例的情况下损害对抗鲁棒性，需联合考虑鲁棒性与硬件效率。

Method: ORBITAL 结合硬件可实现的结构化压缩、恢复感知的工作点选择、多攻击评估与原生边缘验证；在 BCI Competition IV-2a 上以 9 名被试、3 个随机种子评测，用匹配对照实验定位鲁棒性恢复来源，并在 Jetson Orin Nano 上测量能耗与延迟。

Result: S25-TRADES 在压缩 EEGNet 中取得最高平均 true-union 鲁棒性（23.06% vs 标准 Full 的 21.27%），参数量减少 26.27%、MACs 减少 25.10%；匹配对照显示 TRADES 是鲁棒性恢复的主因（S25 union 准确率较 clean recovery 提升 6.74 个百分点，p=0.0039），逐样本分析显示为边界重分布而非统一边界扩张。Jetson Orin Nano 上 FP16 压缩最高降低板载能耗 16.20%、延迟 8.00%；原生 INT8 Q/DQ 虽预测一致率 99.3%，但延迟与能耗约为 FP16 的两倍。

Conclusion: 压缩 EEG 解码器需同时进行鲁棒性与硬件感知优化；量化格式的硬件实测表现可能与预测一致率脱节，FP16 在当前边缘平台优于原生 INT8 Q/DQ。

Abstract: Compact electroencephalography (EEG) decoders enable embedded brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but compression can alter adversarial robustness without proportional hardware savings. We present ORBITAL, a robustness-constrained framework combining hardware-realizable structured compression, recovery-aware operating-point selection, multi-attack evaluation, and native edge validation. Across nine subjects and three seeds on BCI Competition IV-2a, S25-TRADES achieves the highest observed mean true-union robustness among compressed EEGNet models (23.06% vs 21.27% for standard Full), with 26.27% fewer parameters and 25.10% fewer MACs. Matched controls identify TRADES as the main source of robustness recovery, improving S25 union accuracy by 6.74 percentage points over clean recovery (p=0.0039), while per-example analysis reveals boundary redistribution rather than uniform margin expansion. On Jetson Orin Nano, FP16 compression reduces board energy by up to 16.20% and latency by 8.00%. Despite 99.3% prediction agreement, native INT8 Q/DQ incurs about twice the FP16 latency and energy, demonstrating the need for joint robustness and hardware-aware optimization.

</details>


### [606] [SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36384v1)
*Matea Tashkovska,Naël Ouerghemi,Haozhe Qi,Alexander Mathis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SOMA 基准，用于评估多模态大模型从第一人称视频理解细粒度人体动作的能力，发现 37 个主流模型最佳零样本准确率仅 50.0%，明显低于人类的 68.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型评测多聚焦物体、场景与粗粒度动作，缺乏对人体自身运动推理能力的评估；第一人称视角下身体仅部分可见、运动线索被遮挡且分布在时间上，该任务尤为困难，此前缺乏系统评测。

Method: 构建 SOMA 基准，含 1,632 个人工校验问题，覆盖身体构型、运动动力学、时间推理三个能力维度；评测 37 个闭源、开源及第一人称专用 MLLM 并进行大规模人工评估与错误分析；另提出对齐视频—身体运动—语言监督的训练数据集，以及联合学习多模态的多模态基线模型。

Result: 人类仅凭视频准确率为 68.5%，而最强模型 Qwen3.6-27B 零样本仅 50.0%；错误分析显示模型常误读佩戴者自身身体、时间事件判断错误，并存在偏好右手、重复次数少计等偏差。

Conclusion: SOMA 揭示了当前 MLLM 在身体运动理解上的常见失效模式与能力缺口，并通过训练数据与多模态基线为缩小与人类差距提供支持，期望推动身体运动理解与多模态推理的后续研究。

Abstract: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma

</details>


### [607] [Evaluating Federated Vision-Language and Vision-Only Models for Privacy-Aware Breast Cancer Imaging](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36379v1)
*Malithi Mithsara Wanniarachchi Kankanamge,Ning Yang,Sree Bash Debnath,Md Zobaer Islam,Abdur R. Shahid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出并评估一个结合预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）与客户端级差分隐私的隐私感知联邦学习框架，用于乳腺影像；结果表明模型虽在"正常 vs 患病"任务上ROC-AUC达0.940–0.990，但存在采集年份混杂的严重隐患，良恶性判别接近随机，且差分隐私实现方式导致性能大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺影像AI受限于标注数据稀缺、机构间数据孤岛与隐私法规，难以集中式训练；同时VLM与联邦学习、差分隐私结合的实际有效性与可靠性尚缺乏系统评估。

Method: 在联邦学习下对比五类模型：通用CLIP、生物医学BiomedCLIP、ImageNet预训练ViT-B/16基线，以及去除文本通路的CLIP ViT-B/16消融模型；在两个公开乳腺影像数据集上分别在有/无差分隐私条件下评测。评价指标包括患者级ROC-AUC及bootstrap 95%置信区间、基线比较、阈值敏感性、模型间一致性与通信开销；并设置"仅用采集年份"作为混杂对照基线。

Result: 五模型在联邦学习下"正常 vs 患病"判别AUC为0.940–0.990，但仅用采集年份即达0.974，提示可能源于混杂而非真实病理识别；"良性 vs 恶性"判别AUC仅0.504–0.637，所有置信区间均包含0.50，判别能力不确定。去除文本通路可保持分类精度并将通信成本减半。差分隐私使AUC下降0.375，原因在于对全部模型状态（而非仅可训练参数）加噪。

Conclusion: 面向乳腺影像的联邦AI系统开发中，必须系统评估数据混杂、预测可靠性、隐私机制的正确实现与部署效率；高AUC可能具有误导性，文本通路与差分隐私的作用范围均需审慎设计。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) shows promise for breast imaging, but limited labeled data, institutional data fragmentation, and privacy concerns hinder centralized training. We investigate a privacy-aware federated learning framework combining pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with client-level differential privacy. We compare general-purpose CLIP models, biomedical BiomedCLIP, and an ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 baseline on two public breast imaging datasets, with and without differential privacy. We also evaluate a CLIP ViT-B/16 ablation that removes the text pathway. Evaluation includes patient-level ROC-AUC with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, baseline comparisons, threshold sensitivity, inter-model agreement, and communication cost. Under federated learning, all five models achieve high normal-versus-sick discrimination (ROC-AUC: 0.940-0.990). However, acquisition year alone achieves 0.974 on the same test partition, raising concerns about confounding rather than genuine pathology recognition. Benign-versus-malignant discrimination remains uncertain (ROC-AUC: 0.504-0.637), with all confidence intervals including 0.50. Removing the text pathway preserves classification accuracy while halving communication cost. Differential privacy reduces ROC-AUC by 0.375, attributable to perturbing the full model state rather than only trainable parameters. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating confounding, predictive reliability, privacy implementation, and deployment efficiency when developing federated AI systems for breast imaging.

</details>


### [608] [BoxWorld: Let World Engines Control and Video Generators Render](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36371v1)
*Zike Wu,Ahmed Hatem,Chintan Trivedi,Wallace Michel Pinto Lira,Xuebin Qin,Lele Wang,Renjie Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BoxWorld 将"交互推理"与"生成式渲染"解耦：由编码智能体根据用户规则生成 Box World Engine，输出布局框、持久物体属性与动态状态变量组成的状态流，再交由 Box-State Generative Renderer 自回归渲染成视频，实现实时可交互、规则可自定义的视频世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端视频世界模型把交互动力学隐含在生成器内部，难以显式指定物体级交互规则、难以对规则后果进行推理与验证。作者希望支持用户在物体层面定义行为规则，并实时、在线地控制物体运动、状态切换与条件事件。

Method: 核心是"推理-渲染"分离架构：(1) 编码智能体依据用户规则编写 Box World Engine，计算交互结果，通过轻量接口（layout boxes、持久属性、动态状态变量）暴露物体状态；(2) Box-State Generative Renderer 将该状态流自回归渲染为视频，外观与物理效果交由生成器负责；(3) 三阶段训练：先从开放域视频学习物体 grounding，再从游戏视频学习状态转移（两者均自动标注），最后在自生成历史上做 rollout 蒸馏；(4) 提出 PairedStateBench 成对基准，用于细粒度交互控制评测。

Result: BoxWorld 显著优于端到端世界模型，并在多个公开基准上保持有竞争力；PairedStateBench 支撑细粒度交互控制的成对评测；渲染器可实时响应物体级状态更新，且与已生成历史保持时序一致。

Conclusion: 将交互推理外化为可编程引擎、把渲染留给生成模型，是一种可行且有效的实时交互视频世界构建范式，兼顾规则可指定性与渲染逼真度；配套基准与三阶段训练（含 rollout 蒸馏）是保证状态一致性的关键。

Abstract: We tackle the challenge of building real-time interactive video worlds with user-defined behaviors. Such worlds must track object states, apply interaction rules, and render the resulting consequences as users act. Yet existing end-to-end video world models typically learn interaction dynamics within the generator, making it difficult to specify object-level rules and reason about their consequences. In this work, we introduce BoxWorld, which separates interaction reasoning from generative rendering. Given user-specified rules, a coding agent creates a Box World Engine that determines interaction outcomes and exposes the resulting object states through a lightweight interface of layout boxes, persistent object attributes, and dynamic status variables, leaving appearance and physical effects to generative rendering. A Box-State Generative Renderer then renders this evolving state stream into video autoregressively, enabling online control over object motion, state switches, and conditional events. Rendering this state stream is non-trivial: the renderer must respond to object-level state updates in real time while remaining coherent with the generated history. To this end, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that learns object grounding from open-domain videos and state transitions from gameplay videos, both annotated automatically, and finally performs rollout distillation on self-generated histories. We further propose PairedStateBench, a paired benchmark for fine-grained interaction control. BoxWorld substantially outperforms end-to-end world models and remains competitive across multiple public benchmarks. Project page: https://boxworld-web.github.io.

</details>


### [609] [CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36340v2)
*S Mahmudul Hasan,Lu Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CrowdCC基准，联合评估边缘部署中图像退化与量化精度对人群计数模型的影响，覆盖6类23种腐蚀、4个数据集、26个模型，在A100与Jetson Orin NX上测试FP32/FP16/INT8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的人群计数模型同时面临两类问题：采集与传输链路导致输入退化，以及为满足资源约束而进行的模型量化。然而现有研究通常将"腐蚀鲁棒性"与"部署量化"分开评估，缺乏二者联合视角的系统性基准。

Method: 构建受控基准CrowdCC：设计23种面向部署场景的腐蚀（分属6大族，含三个严重等级），几何或可见性变化时同步调整头部标注；覆盖4个人群计数数据集与26个模型；在A100上用TensorRT引擎评估FP32、FP16、训练后INT8三种精度，并在对应Jetson Orin NX配置上测量吞吐与能耗。

Result: 采集链腐蚀在各模型上造成的性能下降最大；人群密度对绝对误差与相对误差影响不同；干净图像精度无法可靠预测腐蚀图像表现；INT8对腐蚀鲁棒性的改变大于FP16且方向不一致，也未稳定提升延迟或能效；INT8推理效率与编译引擎中的重格式化开销强相关，INT8覆盖不足时甚至出现减速；精度会改变腐蚀误差排序及鲁棒性—成本前沿。

Conclusion: 腐蚀鲁棒性与部署成本必须联合考量：模型与精度选择不应仅依赖干净数据精度或单一量化收益假设，而应结合目标腐蚀条件、INT8覆盖度与编译开销共同决策，以实现鲁棒性—成本权衡。

Abstract: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two challenges: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are often quantized to satisfy resource constraints of the edge. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects across 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models. We evaluate TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision on an A100 GPU, alongside throughput and energy measurements on corresponding Jetson Orin~NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our results show that capture-chain corruptions consistently cause the largest degradation across evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative errors differently. Accuracy on clean images does not reliably predict performance on the corresponding corrupted images. INT8 changes corruption robustness more than FP16, without a consistent direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy efficiency. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, with slowdowns also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness--cost frontiers, highlighting the need to consider corruption robustness and deployment cost jointly when selecting models and precision. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

</details>


### [610] [CRLoMTL: Conflict-Resolution through Low-rank matrices for Multi-Task Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36337v1)
*Ahmed Agiza,Tasneem Shaffee,Rahil Badkul,Sherief Reda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CRLoMTL，在低秩参数更新空间（LoRA）中缓解多任务学习的负迁移，通过SVD提取共享正交子空间并融合任务更新，可折叠进骨干网络，实现参数高效的精度-参数权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务学习通过共享表示提升效率，但任务更新相互干扰导致负迁移。现有冲突缓解方法多作用于梯度空间，需显式操作任务梯度并引入额外优化步骤，代价较高。

Method: CRLoMTL框架：每个任务通过独立前向更新各自的LoRA低秩矩阵，再经基于SVD的共享子空间解析器（SVD resolver）提取跨任务适配器的公共低维正交基，将各任务更新投影至共享空间后融合为单一部署更新；融合结果可折叠入骨干，推理无额外分支。

Result: 在Swin Transformer骨干上于PASCAL-Context、NYUD-v2、CelebA实验：相比单任务基线分别最高提升2.77%、5.03%、3.50%，且仅训练单任务模型参数的一小部分，取得良好的精度-参数权衡。

Conclusion: 在低秩参数空间而非梯度空间解决任务冲突是可行且高效的；SVD共享子空间融合可实现无推理开销的多任务部署，优于单任务基线并显著降低可训练参数量。

Abstract: Multi-task learning (MTL) improves model efficiency by sharing representations across related vision tasks, but it often suffers from negative transfer when task updates interfere with one another. Existing conflict-mitigation methods typically operate in gradient space, requiring explicit task-gradient manipulation and additional optimization steps. We propose Conflict-Resolution through Low-Rank Matrices for Multi-Task Learning (CRLoMTL), a parameter-efficient framework that mitigates task interference in the low-rank parameter-update space. CRLoMTL learns task-specific LoRA updates through task-specific passes, where each task updates its own low-rank matrices, and integrates these updates through global shared-subspace fusion. Specifically, we introduce a shared-subspace resolver based on singular value decomposition (SVD), referred to as the SVD resolver, which extracts a common low-dimensional orthonormal basis across task adapters and projects task updates into this shared space before merging them into a single deployment-time update. The resulting update can be folded into the backbone, preserving the inference structure of the original model without additional runtime branches. Experiments with Swin Transformer backbones on PASCAL-Context, NYUD-v2, and CelebA show that CRLoMTL achieves a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off, improving over single-task baselines by up to 2.77% on PASCAL-Context, 5.03% on NYUD-v2, and 3.50% on CelebA, while training only a small fraction of the parameters used by single-task models.

</details>


### [611] [Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36327v1)
*Yuqi Li,Chuanyue Yan,Neil Rodrigues,Xianglong Wang,Xiaoqin Feng,Junming Liu,Xi Xiao,Zhongwei Cheng,Wei Li,Lin Chen,Yingli Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）的免训练推理加速方法，按推理流水线中的干预阶段（输入、视觉编码、投影器、预填充、解码）组织现有工作，并将训练后量化（PTQ）作为跨阶段扩展单独讨论，结合定量实验分析精度-时延权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频大模型理解与推理能力强，但处理长视觉序列带来巨大的计算、时延与显存开销，亟需在保持任务相关时空证据的前提下降低推理成本；现有局部效率优化未必能转化为端到端加速，缺乏统一视角的系统梳理。

Method: 综述性研究，聚焦免训练（training-free）推理加速范式。按干预阶段分类：输入阶段、视觉编码阶段、投影器阶段、预填充（prefill）阶段、解码阶段；训练后量化（PTQ）作为跨阶段扩展单独讨论。分析干预位置对证据保留与计算节省的影响，并辅以既有研究的定量证据及作者在统一评测设定下的对比实验。

Result: 给出各阶段方法的分类框架，阐明干预位置与证据保留、计算节省之间的关系；指出局部效率提升难以直接转化为端到端加速的原因；通过统一设定下的实验量化准确率-时延权衡。

Conclusion: 免训练推理加速需以"任务相关时空证据保留"为核心约束统筹各阶段干预；评估应关注端到端时延而非单模块效率，未来方向在于跨阶段协同设计与统一基准。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.

</details>


### [612] [Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36269v1)
*Donghao Zeng,Nishant Subramani,Tamar Rott Shaham,Benno Krojer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过"跨模态引导（cross-modal steering）"这一因果性手段，检验统一多模态模型（UMMs）中概念与机制是否跨模态共享：在一种模态上找到的引导向量可零样本迁移到另一模态，并伴随几何特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI模型中的概念与机制是跨模态统一，还是各模态分别实现，尚无定论。以往研究多依赖表征相似性等相关性证据，无法说明因果作用，因此作者希望用因果性的引导实验来回答这一"模态统一性"问题。

Method: 1) 在统一多模态模型（语言与图像生成共享参数）中，针对某模态token寻找能成功操控生成结果的引导向量；2) 将其零样本加入另一模态token，观察是否同样产生引导效果；3) 覆盖情绪、物体大小及高度模态特有的概念（如正式vs口语化表达），并分析引导向量的几何关系（方向相似性与模态间隙）。

Result: 引导向量在文本→图像与图像→文本两个方向均可零样本迁移；即便对高度模态特有的概念，也能在另一模态诱发一致且可解释的效果（如正式服装与设计）；尽管文本与图像表征间存在明显模态间隙，跨模态迁移性强的引导向量在同一概念下方向趋于一致，形成几何签名。

Conclusion: 统一多模态模型内部存在跨模态共享的概念与机制，引导向量具有可迁移性和几何一致性。这为理解视觉与语言在UMM内部的交互提供线索，并指向更通用、模态无关的行为控制方法。

Abstract: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.

</details>


### [613] [Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36249v1)
*Wang Tang,Fethiye Irmak Dogan,Linbo Qing,Ce Zhu,Hatice Gunes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HiRe-DRR 分层多模态交互推理框架，从特征层级、交互类型、关系层级三个视角组织关系证据，用 MoI-Former 稀疏路由与 HC-Loss 由粗到细监督，三元组基准上超越代表性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有二元关系识别方法把异构线索投影到共享表示并优化扁平分类目标，忽视了不同关系依赖不同交互模式：远距离关系多由直接行为对应推断，亲密关系更依赖协同的情感、行为与多模态响应。

Method: 将面部、身体、声学、文本线索分解为低层与高层表示，构建同质与异质的跨参与者交互；提出 Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer（MoI-Former），把多样化交互视为专家并采用关系感知稀疏路由筛选关系相关证据、保留上下文交互信息；设计 Hierarchical Conditional Loss（HC-Loss），利用社会关系的层级性进行由粗到细监督。

Result: 在三个二元关系基准上优于近期代表性的图像、视频与多模态方法；路由分析显示远距离关系倾向依赖低层同质交互，亲密关系则聚焦高层异质交互。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 分层建模特征层级与交互类型、并结合关系层级监督，是提升二元关系识别的有效路径，路由分析亦验证了不同亲疏关系对应不同交互证据结构。

Abstract: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tw-repository/HiRe-DRR.

</details>


### [614] [Diagnosing and Correcting Bias in MLLM for Long Video Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36210v1)
*Xusheng Liang,Jianqiao Sun,Hao Zhang,Yulei Niu,Hengshuang Zhao,Jiawei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出基准S-MME以诊断MLLM长视频问答中的捷径偏差，并提出免训练框架CLEAR，通过反事实视角估计并干预偏差，提升预测准确性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答的答案往往依赖稀疏分布的关键时刻，而内存限制迫使MLLM以极低帧率采样，易遗漏关键证据；作者进一步指出，单纯扩大上下文无法突破瓶颈，根本限制在于由虚假语言相关性和显著但无关的视觉观察引起的偏差（捷径偏差）。

Method: 1) 构建S-MME基准，系统诊断MLLM的捷径偏差行为；2) 提出免训练框架CLEAR：将完整视频-问题对视为完整视角，通过仅保留问题或仅保留局部显著视频片段构造增强视角，估计偏差效应；3) 在推理时干预隐状态以缓解该偏差差异，使正确答案被高置信度预测。

Result: 在五个基准上的实验表明该方法具有泛化性，可集成于不同MLLM，并在预测性能与鲁棒性上取得一致提升。

Conclusion: CLEAR为长视频理解的测试时扩展提供了互补方向，说明缓解捷径偏差比单纯扩大上下文更为有效。

Abstract: Long-video question answering is challenging since the answer often hinges on a few decisive moments scattered throughout the video, while memory constraints force Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to sample frames at extremely low rates, resulting in sparsity that risks omitting key evidence. Though aggressively enlarging the context size is intuitive, we argue that performance remains fundamentally constrained by the bias, \emph{i.e.}, the misleading cues caused by spurious \textit{linguistic} correlations and salient yet irrelevant \textit{visual} observations. In this paper, we first introduce {S-MME}, a benchmark designed to systematically diagnose shortcut-biased behavior in MLLMs. To mitigate this failure, we further propose a training-free framework, Counterfactual Long-video Evidence-Aware Reasoning (CLEAR). By treating the full video-question pair as a complete view, CLEAR estimates bias effects via augmented views by only keeping the question or locally salient visual clips. Then, we intervene hidden states to mitigate the discrepancy at inference such that the correct answer can be predicted confidently. With experimental studies across five benchmarks, we show that our method is generalizable and can be integrated in different MLLMs, yielding consistent gains in prediction and robustness. We hope CLEAR can offer a complementary direction in test-time scaling for long-video understanding.

</details>


### [615] [UT-HMR: Uncertainty-Guided Temporal Modeling for Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36203v1)
*Zhibo Wang,Sirisha Rambhatla,Yuhao Chen,Maria Koshkina,David Clausi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UT-HMR是首个建模关节间相关姿态不确定性的单阶段人体网格恢复框架，用低秩加对角高斯协方差预测全体SMPL姿态分布，并通过时序早期融合补充证据，在冰球与足球数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目3D人体网格恢复在远距离、遮挡、运动模糊等弱观测下高度病态，不同3D姿态可能产生相似2D投影；单阶段方法（无人体裁剪框、无外部2D线索）歧义尤为严重，且现有方法未建模关节间相关的姿态不确定性。

Method: 提出UT-HMR：每个person query预测整个SMPL姿态上的高斯分布，协方差采用紧凑的低秩加对角形式，以建模关节间相关性；将该分布转换为关节级精度权重，用于异方差监督，同时保持推理确定性；另引入时序早期融合，在姿态解码前注入相邻帧证据以消解歧义。骨干网络为轻量ViT-B。

Result: 在VIP-HockeyPose-v2（冰球）与WorldPose（足球）上取得SOTA，MPJPE、PA-MPJPE、PVE分别最多降低4.7%、3.8%、5.6%；在3DPW上与使用更大骨干和更高输入分辨率的方法相比仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 关节相关的姿态不确定性建模与时序早期融合相结合，可有效缓解弱观测下的单阶段HMR歧义；轻量骨干即可在挑战性运动场景取得领先性能，说明不确定性引导与时序证据补充是提升鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: Monocular 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) remains unreliable under weak observations caused by long camera-to-person distances, occlusion, and motion blur. In challenging scenarios such as sports, these factors make the problem highly ambiguous, as different 3D poses may yield similar 2D projections. This ambiguity is especially severe for one-stage HMR, which recovers all meshes directly from the full image without person crops or external 2D cues. To handle this ambiguity, we present UT-HMR ( Uncertainty-guided Temporal HMR), to our knowledge the first one-stage HMR framework to capture correlated pose uncertainty across joints. Each person query predicts a Gaussian distribution over the full SMPL pose with a compact low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance, which is converted into joint-wise precision weights for heteroscedastic supervision while keeping inference deterministic. Temporal early fusion further injects neighboring-frame evidence before pose decoding, supplying the visual evidence needed to resolve the ambiguity that the uncertainty captures. With a lightweight ViT-B backbone, UT-HMR achieves state-of-the-art results on VIP-HockeyPose-v2 (ice hockey) and WorldPose (soccer), reducing MPJPE, PA-MPJPE, and PVE by up to 4.7%, 3.8%, and 5.6%, and remains competitive on 3DPW against methods with larger backbones and higher input resolutions.

</details>


### [616] [Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36195v2)
*Kartik Jangra,Atharva Gawane,Siddharth Pulipaka,Hemachandran Karah,Raj Dabre*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BrailleBench（259张真实一级/二级盲文图像基准），揭示通用视觉语言模型直接转写盲文的严重能力缺口，并证明针对性合成数据监督可显著提升真实场景盲文转写性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉理解与文档转写进展迅速，但现代视觉语言模型（VLM）在"从图像读取盲文"这一基本无障碍任务上表现薄弱；现有评测缺乏真实盲文图像基准，且合成数据训练与真实照片表现之间的关系尚不清楚。

Method: 1）构建手工筛选的BrailleBench基准，含259张真实一级与二级盲文图像；2）系统评测闭源、开放权重、OCR专用及工具辅助的多模态系统；3）设计含多样版面与图像扰动的合成盲文生成流水线；4）用合成数据训练2B规模VLM；5）对比合成验证集与真实图像上的准确率差距。

Result: 独立通用模型直接转写盲文图像表现差，工具辅助系统明显更好；2B VLM在合成数据训练后于BrailleBench上达到一级87%、二级61%的完全匹配率，超过独立VLM，并在所评测系统中取得最高二级完全匹配分数；同时发现合成验证集高精度（最高96%）无法迁移到真实照片（一级最高仅3.26%）。

Conclusion: 研究识别出多模态系统在无障碍相关能力上的缺口，表明合成验证集精度不能作为真实性能的代理指标，而针对性的合成监督可有效改善真实世界盲文转写。

Abstract: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.

</details>


### [617] [Beyond the Estimate: Wiener-Informed Decoding for Easier Training of Pixel-Space Flow Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36192v1)
*Ziqiao Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WiD（Wiener-informed Decoding），利用粗二阶图像统计知识同时用于直接预测与组织解码器计算，在像素空间速度场学习中加速训练并提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接在像素空间学习速度场困难且缓慢，作者发现冻结的Wiener估计可改善速度学习，且收益超出其显式提供的线性预测，冻结基与像素解码也有类似互补收益。

Method: WiD由可训练的Wiener预测路径与系数接口组成：系数接口将特征注入原生解码器并返回其预测的系数修正，无需修改原生模块；组件用数据统计初始化，谱变换与坐标变换等所有新增参数在原始像素空间速度目标下联合训练。

Result: 跨模型规模与解码器架构，WiD加速训练并提升生成质量，参数开销小；梯度轨迹更平滑，与表示对齐兼容；在ImageNet 256×256上PixelDiT-XL加WiD在500轮达FID 1.53，相当于节省37.5%训练轮次；类条件与文生图生成在不同分辨率上均提升。

Conclusion: 统计去噪器的作用不止于估计本身，其计算结构也能缓解像素空间训练难题。

Abstract: Learning velocity fields directly in pixel space is difficult and slow. We show that coarse second-order image statistics can ease this task: frozen Wiener estimates improve velocity learning, with gains extending beyond the linear predictions they explicitly provide. Moreover, we observe similar but complementary gains from frozen bases and pixel decoding. These observations motivate Wiener-informed Decoding (WiD), which uses statistical knowledge both for direct prediction and to organize decoder computation without modifying native blocks. WiD combines a trainable Wiener prediction path with coefficient interfaces that inject features into the native decoder and return its predicted coefficient corrections, with these components initialized with data statistics. All introduced parameters, including the spectrum and coordinate transforms, are trained jointly under the original pixel-space velocity objective. Across model scales and decoder architectures, WiD accelerates training and improves generation quality with modest parameter overhead. It also yields smoother gradient trajectories and remains effective with representation alignment. WiD improves class-conditional and text-to-image generation across different resolutions. On ImageNet 256 x 256, PixelDiT-XL with WiD reaches FID 1.53 after 500 epochs, achieving comparable quality to PixelDiT with 37.5% fewer training epochs. Statistical denoisers contribute beyond the estimate: their computational structure can also ease pixel-space training.

</details>


### [618] [PrinGS: Privacy Preservation in Gaussian Splatting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36168v2)
*Gaurav Behera,Abhinav Raundhal,Archisha Panda,Saumya Balina,Gargi Shroff,Ponnurangam Kumaraguru*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的表示级匿名化框架：给定训练好的splat和用户标注敏感内容的参考视图，方法在底层3D表示中定位对应区域并直接匿名化，使敏感信息不再出现在任何新视角渲染结果中，同时保持场景几何与视觉保真度；此外还提出隐私优先（privacy-by-design）训练策略。后训练匿名化耗时不足1秒，FSM仅9.79%（FDR 39.47%），敏感文本OCR字符错误率达1.00即完全不可读。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS已成为高保真新视角合成与三维重建的主流表示，但训练得到的splat隐式编码了人脸、车牌、证件、屏幕等人脸与文本等敏感视觉信息，在共享或部署训练好的splat时带来显著隐私风险。而Gaussian Splatting中的隐私保护问题此前研究不足，作者希望填补这一空白并推动隐私感知三维表示的研究。

Method: 1）表示级后训练匿名化：输入一个训练好的splat与一张由用户提供的、标出敏感内容的参考视图，方法将敏感内容定位到对应的3D高斯区域，并直接在该表示层面对其进行匿名化处理，因此匿名化效果对所有后续新视角渲染均一致生效，同时保持整体场景几何与视觉保真；2）隐私优先训练策略：作为框架扩展，在优化过程中阻止敏感内容被嵌入到表示中，从而可由训练图像直接生成隐私保护型splat；3）后训练匿名化在1秒内完成，具备实用性。

Result: 后训练匿名化可在1秒内完成；人脸方面，在保留人脸检测率（FDR）39.47%的情况下取得极低的人脸相似度度量（FSM）9.79%；文本方面，敏感文本完全不可读，OCR字符错误率（CER）为1.00。

Conclusion: 面向3DGS的表示级匿名化是可行且高效的，既能消除敏感视觉内容在所有渲染视角中的泄露，又能保持场景几何与视觉质量，并可拓展为训练期即防泄露的隐私优先方案。作者期望该工作成为隐私感知三维表示领域的基础性一步，并激发后续研究。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has rapidly become the preferred representation for high-fidelity novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. However, the learned representation encodes sensitive visual information including human faces, license plates, documents, and computer screens, raising significant privacy concerns when trained splats are shared or deployed. In this work, we address the underexplored problem of privacy preservation in Gaussian Splatting by proposing a representation-level anonymization framework that directly anonymizes a trained splat. Given a trained splat and a user-provided reference view identifying sensitive content, our method localizes the corresponding regions in the underlying 3D representation and directly anonymizes them, ensuring that the sensitive information is absent from all subsequently rendered novel views while preserving the overall scene geometry and visual fidelity. We achieve this post-training anonymization in less than 1 second. Furthermore, we extend our framework with a privacy-by-design training strategy that prevents sensitive content from being embedded into the representation during optimization, enabling the generation of privacy-preserving splats directly from training images. Our method achieves a remarkably low Face Similarity Measure (FSM) of 9.79% at a retained Face Detection Rate (FDR) of 39.47% and makes sensitive text completely unreadable with an OCR Character Error Rate of 1.00. Our work aims to serve as the primary stepping stone towards privacy-aware 3D representations and motivates further research along these directions.

</details>


### [619] [Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36150v1)
*Jingong Chen,Qingwen Zhang,Youming Deng,Chulwoo Pack,Olaf Wysocki,Boris Jutzi,Kwanghee Won,Kyle Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Any3R 是一个前馈几何基础模型，将位置编码与训练损失都条件化在稠密光线场上，从而无需为每种镜头重新训练即可处理任意中心相机（含混合相机类型的场景）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何基础模型虽能从多视图前馈恢复相机位姿与稠密几何，但隐含假设输入为针孔图像；该假设不仅存在于输入层，还内嵌于主干网络——位置编码与训练损失都将图像位置绑定到空间方向且依赖镜头参数（如畸变系数、视场限制）。作者希望去除这一限制，使模型能直接处理任意中心相机而非仅针孔相机。

Method: 以"稠密光线场"（每像素对应的单位方向）作为统一表示，该表示无需镜头类型、畸变系数或视场上界即可描述任意中心相机。具体地：(1) 采用角度坐标，用每个 patch 实测的光线角度逐视图驱动旋转位置编码（rotary encoding）；(2) 采用立体角加权，按每像素在球面上覆盖的面积对点损失进行缩放。由此编码与监督均不依赖镜头。

Result: 在覆盖三个数据集、十三种中心相机的基准上（各方法均使用自身预测的相机位姿进行重建），Any3R 是准确性最稳定的方法，并能稳健处理单场景内混合多种相机类型的情形，无需针对每种镜头重新训练。

Conclusion: Any3R 实现了对任意中心相机的前馈三维重建，支持来自异构众包与档案影像（多相机类型）的可扩展三维重建。

Abstract: Geometry foundation models recover camera poses and dense geometry from a set of images with a feed-forward network, but they expect pinhole images. That assumption is inside the backbone too: the positional encoding and the training loss both bind an image position to a direction in space, and both depend on the lens. We condition both on the dense ray field, the unit direction through every pixel, which describes any central camera without a lens type, distortion coefficients or a bound on field of view. Angular coordinates give the rotary encoding the measured ray angle of each patch, evaluated per view, and solid-angle weighting scales the point loss by the area each pixel covers on the sphere, so neither the encoding nor the supervision depends on the lens. Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method. Any3R enables scalable 3D reconstruction from heterogeneous crowdsourced and archival imagery collections sourced across diverse camera types. Project page: https://jingong-chen.github.io/Any3R/

</details>


### [620] [VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35864v2)
*Muxi Diao,Wenbin Xu,Lele Yang,Xuyang Ma,Yuzhe Chen,Jiankang Chen,Kaiyu Jiang,Changyi Liu,Haoyu Zhang,Hongyi Fu,Jianxiong Wang,Tianke Zhang,Haonan Fan,Yingxin Li,Bingyi Li,Xu Wang,Xuanyu Zheng,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Wentao Zhang,Weiran Xu,Kongming Liang,Zhanyu Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VibeVideoBench，首个评估"以代码驱动视频生成"多模态智能体的基准：239 个中英双语任务、12 类，要求智能体在无图像/视频生成模型的沙箱中一小时内交付带声 MP4；采用交付规范程序检查 + 约 1.3 万条任务专属 rubric 检查 + 三维度 VLM 评审团的分层证据化评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散视频模型虽能生成惊艳片段，但无法可靠呈现精确公式、正确图表、规则一致的游戏或与画面事件同步的旁白。因此需要转向"写代码渲染每一帧、合成每一段声音"的多模态智能体路线，而此前缺乏针对该能力的系统性评测基准。

Method: 构建 VibeVideoBench：239 个自包含任务（中英双语），覆盖数据故事、音乐驱动视频、课堂讲解、论文解读等 12 类；智能体在原生 harness 与沙箱中运行，禁止调用图像/视频生成模型，须在一小时内产出含声音的成品 MP4。评估为分层、证据化：①交付规范程序化检查；②约 13k 条任务专属 rubric 检查，并可追溯到所约束的原始需求；③五个质量维度按任务锚定，由三个 VLM 评审团打分。

Result: 共评测 9 个前沿智能体系统、2,151 条计分 rollout。GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 在评审与人工标注中分列第一、第二；最强系统在 76.3% 的任务上满足全部核心要求。交付构成第二评估轴：将缺失视频计零会使排名改变，且四分之三的丢失视频源于最终渲染启动过晚、运行过慢或从未启动——即智能体对"一小时"的规划失败。智能体会自建渲染管线并检视自身帧，但"看多少"并不预测质量。评审团的系统排名与盲测人类偏好高度一致。

Conclusion: 代码驱动视频生成是可行且具区分度的智能体能力方向，但当前最强系统仍有明显短板（核心要求全满足率 76.3%）；时间预算规划与交付鲁棒性是独立于内容质量的关键瓶颈；基于 VLM 评审团的分层 rubric 评估可近似人类偏好，具备作为该方向标准基准的潜力。

Abstract: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox with no image or video generation model, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, scored by three VLM judge panels. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 rank first and second with both the judges and human annotators, and the strongest system satisfies every core requirement on 76.3% of tasks. Delivery is a second axis: counting missing videos as zero changes the ranking, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders that started too late, ran too slowly or never started, a failure of how agents plan their hour. Agents build their own rendering pipelines and inspect their own frames, yet how much they look does not predict quality. The judges' ranking of the systems closely matches blind human preferences.

</details>


### [621] [Do vision models know that three is three?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35857v1)
*Ankit Sonthalia,Arnas Uselis,Seong Joon Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究46个视觉编码器在10类概念上是否编码跨"视觉域(regime)"共享的抽象概念方向，发现普遍存在局域线性但常缺全局线性，提出并量化"碎片化线性"现象，并表明局域线性越强越能逐步摆脱碎片化、实现跨域方向迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性表示假说(LRH)已在语言模型中验证：概念变化对应嵌入空间中的方向。但视觉中同一概念可出现在像素空间毫不相关的"域"中（如手写数字与手势、厨房与地毯），视觉模型是否编码了跨域共享的抽象概念方向尚不清楚，这关系到模型是否真正"理解"抽象概念。

Method: 在10个概念族（数量性、年龄、物体身份、MIT-States属性等）上，评测46个覆盖不同架构、训练目标与规模的视觉编码器；在每个域内估计概念方向并进行显著性检验，比较不同域间概念方向的一致性，提出"碎片化线性"（局域线性强而全局线性近乎缺失）的度量，并分析局域线性强度与局部-全局线性一致性(τ∈[0.38,0.89])的关系，以及全局线性出现时概念方向作为线性探针的跨域迁移能力。

Result: 各域内几乎普遍存在统计显著的概念方向；但两个不同域并不总共享同一概念方向，多个模型对同一概念转变学到多套线性结构，即"碎片化线性"；局域线性更强的模型会逐步逃脱碎片化（局域-全局线性相关性τ∈[0.38,0.89]，跨所有概念一致）；当全局线性出现时，概念方向可作为线性探针跨域迁移。

Conclusion: 视觉模型普遍具备域内线性概念编码，但抽象概念的全局统一线性表示并不自动形成，"碎片化线性"是普遍现象；提升局域线性强度有助于走向全局线性与跨域迁移，为评估视觉模型的抽象概念理解提供了新视角。

Abstract: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes. We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $τ\in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.

</details>


### [622] [FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35854v1)
*Eunbeen Hong,Hyeonseo Yu,Honggyu An,Jooho Son,Hyunah Ko,Soowon Son,Chaehyun Kim,Jahyeok Koo,Jisoo Kim,Junhwa Hur,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FL4N，首个前馈式隐式 4D 新视角合成模型，将 4D 场景先验编码到统一的时空隐表示中，实时渲染并达到 SOTA 质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目前馈式 4D NVS 方法多依赖显式 4D 高斯表示，易出现时间不一致与严重渲染伪影；同时动态训练数据稀缺，直接学习 4D 表示困难。

Method: 以预训练静态隐式先验为基础，将时间动态学习为残差；引入轻量动态编码器，利用静态场景特征将物体运动与相机视差解耦；仅用图像合成目标端到端训练。

Result: 在 4D NVS 质量上达到 SOTA，并实现实时渲染；学到的隐表示可泛化到真实视频，且能解耦视角与时间。

Conclusion: 隐式 4D 表示 + 静态先验残差建模是替代显式 4D 基元的有效范式，在有限动态数据下实现高质量、实时的 4D 新视角合成。

Abstract: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.

</details>


### [623] [OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35850v1)
*Guowen Zhang,Liyi Chen,Xu Hu,Pengfei Wang,Jingfan Chen,Chenhang He,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OSWAM 通过用"想象 token"初始化扩散过程并引入特权信息蒸馏，将世界动作模型的动作生成压缩到单步去噪，在自动驾驶与具身控制上以约 3 倍加速达到相当或更优性能，实时推理延迟低至 40ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Direct-policy 世界动作模型（WAM）虽将动作生成与显式未来视觉预测解耦以提升效率，但仍需数十步去噪才能获得有竞争力的动作质量，导致高延迟、难以实时部署；而简单减少去噪步数会使非线性多步轨迹退化为粗粒度更新，显著损害动作质量。

Method: 作者认为瓶颈在于随机噪声初始化缺乏结构化动作先验，使模型只能依赖迭代去噪恢复连贯动作序列。为此构建"imagination tokens"初始化扩散过程，提供物理先验与动作条件表示；并引入带未来条件（future conditioning）的特权信息蒸馏，增强未来感知的动作生成，从而实现单步扩散生成高质量动作。

Result: 在自动驾驶和具身控制任务上，OSWAM 的结果与需要数十步的 direct-policy WAM 及 Joint-WAM 相当甚至更优；相比 direct-policy WAM 基线约 3 倍加速，并在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU 上支持实时编译推理，延迟低至 40ms。

Conclusion: 结构化动作先验初始化（imagination tokens）与特权信息蒸馏可有效消除对多步去噪的依赖，使世界动作模型在保持动作质量的同时实现单步实时生成，为实时部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/

</details>


### [624] [Seeing Through Distractions: Context-Stable Attribution via the Least Core](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35827v1)
*Sai Ganesh Nagarajan,Toshinori Yamauchi,Hiroshi Kera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"上下文干扰特征"(contextual distractors)概念：在视觉模型中存在一类特征，其加入完整真实图像后会降低目标类得分，即便预测标签不变。作者在半值和最小核心框架下刻画其归因，给出半值与最小核心差距的定量界及充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley 值等半值方法广泛用于特征归因，但其公理体系（如效率性、虚拟性）隐含的加性/单调直觉在计算机视觉中可能失效：某些特征在完整图像语境下反而降低目标类分数。这类"上下文干扰特征"的归因是否稳定、半值与最小核心结果是否一致，缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 形式化定义 contextual distractor；在弱平均边际单调性假设下，基于"采样到更小上下文的概率"推导半值与最小核心差距的定量上界及充分条件；进一步分析将半值权重向更大上下文偏移对带符号差距的影响；并在受控图像分类实验与 Salient ImageNet 上进行验证。

Result: 理论得到：在弱平均边际单调性下存在半值—最小核心差距的定量界与可检验的充分条件；将半值权重移向更大上下文会减小带符号差距。受控分类实验与 Salient ImageNet 评测对上述结论提供有力的实证支持。

Conclusion: 视觉语境中的上下文干扰特征会使归因对合作博弈解概念敏感；半值归因与最小核心解之间的偏差可由上下文采样概率刻画与调节，权重设计（偏向更大上下文）可缓解该偏差。这为视觉特征归因的解概念选择与权重配置提供了理论依据与实证参考。

Abstract: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [625] [Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36022v1)
*Rui Yang,Yanwei Li,Sili Chen,Jingjia Huang,Yi Lin,Hengshuang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出统一几何理解与生成模型GeoUG，从训练时几何监督与推理时显式几何证据两个角度利用生成能力提升空间理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像/视频生成器已能产生空间一致的视觉内容，但如何借此提升空间理解仍缺乏探索；现有理解模型缺少显式几何证据。

Method: (1) 多尺度深度编解码器，借助预训练视觉自编码器实现度量深度生成，并与空间理解联合训练；(2) 构建3DCueBench控制几何难度、平衡2D线索；(3) 自适应交错推理：先草拟答案，再由强化学习训练的决策模块判断是否生成深度证据以确认或修正，权衡精度收益与生成开销。

Result: 生成深度对需细粒度几何辨别的题目带来更大推理增益；GeoUG在CV-Bench-3D、3DCueBench、DA-2K上循环精度达97.9%、90.8%、94.2%，且生成调用次数少于"总是生成"策略。

Conclusion: 联合训练带来任务相关的空间理解增益；按需生成几何证据的推理范式可在更低生成成本下取得更优空间理解性能。

Abstract: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference. To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding. First, we design a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation using a pretrained visual autoencoder, and show that joint training yields task-dependent gains in spatial understanding. Second, we introduce 3DCueBench to control geometric difficulty while balancing selected 2D cues, and find that generated depth provides larger reasoning gains on questions requiring fine-grained geometric discrimination. Building on this finding, we develop adaptive interleaved reasoning, in which GeoUG first drafts an answer and then decides whether to generate geometric evidence to confirm or revise it. We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost. GeoUG achieves circular accuracies of 97.9%, 90.8%, and 94.2% on CV-Bench-3D, 3DCueBench, and DA-2K with fewer generation calls than always generating.

</details>


### [626] [Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35823v1)
*Minh Pham-Dinh,Md Farhan Ishmam,Hernan Yupanqui,Reaz Hassan Joarder,Kenneth Marino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MiniWeb 迷你真实网页环境与技能诊断基准，发现拖拽/手势类技能最弱；进而用 MiniWebGen 自动生成技能中心训练数据微调 Qwen3.5-4B，再配合规划器形成 MiniWebAgent，在未见网站与外部基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 浏览器智能体不缺练习量，而是缺乏"练对的东西"。现有基准多以整任务成功率作为唯一指标，难以诊断具体是哪类交互技能失败，也无法针对薄弱技能进行定向训练。

Method: 构建 MiniWeb：15 个领域、65 个互连网站、369 个人工标注任务的真实网页缩影，任务标注 37 个可复用交互原语、归为 7 个技能族。基准测试 10 个开放权重智能体进行细粒度技能诊断。针对最弱技能族，提出 MiniWebGen 框架，从 MiniWeb 自主生成经校验、以技能为中心的训练数据；用 3.1K 条校验轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-4B 作为执行器；再提出 MiniWebAgent，将训练后的执行器与规划器组合，规划器把完整任务分解为已学会的技能级子步骤。

Result: 拖拽与手势族一致最弱，无智能体解决率超过 24%。微调后在 13 个未见网站上单原语成功率提升 24.9pp，且各技能族均有增益。执行器+规划器组合在未见 MiniWeb 网站整任务成功率提升 19.4pp，并零轨迹训练迁移到外部基准：WebArena-Lite +9.3pp、Online-Mind2Web +16.1pp、WebVoyager +20.0pp。

Conclusion: 短程轨迹训练只能提升原语级交互，不能直接转化为整任务成功，需通过规划器将技能组合起来应对陌生任务。由此给出紧凑型浏览器智能体的简明配方：直接练习可复用技能，再组合技能解决新任务。

Abstract: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.

</details>


### [627] [Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35806v1)
*Adityan Thirumani Srinivasan,David Nordström*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VGGT等前馈3D重建模型在单次前向推理中直接回归相机位姿与几何，却不输出位姿不确定性。作者发现在冻结的VGGT特征上训练线性探针即可高精度预测相对位姿失败，说明模型"知道自己何时出错"，只是没有报告出来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3D重建模型（如VGGT）仅输出点图与相机位姿，不给出位姿置信度，导致错误位姿与正确位姿在输出上无法区分，下游系统无法据此可靠地设置阈值或弃权。作者因此追问：冻结模型内部特征是否已隐含了对自身位姿错误的判别信息。

Method: 构建HardMatch基准：1,000对刻意挑选的困难图像对，VGGT在其中35%上失败。在冻结的VGGT特征上训练线性探针预测位姿失败，并与VGGT自带的点图置信度、在VGGT全部输出上训练的分类器比较；进一步做跨数据集迁移测试（PhotoTourism、ScanNet-1500的旋转失败），并控制共视性因素；通过逐层分析定位该信息的计算位置，并在第二个模型π³上验证普适性。

Result: 线性探针在留出类别上的ROC-AUC为93.5%，显著优于VGGT点图置信度（79.7%）和基于全部输出的分类器（77.7%）。探针能识别VGGT自身高置信却错误的样本，可支持下游弃权决策；无需重训练即可迁移到PhotoTourism与ScanNet-1500的旋转失败检测，且增益超出共视性所能解释的范围。逐层分析显示该知识不存在于单图像编码器中，而是在融合两视图的中间层产生；π³上呈现同样规律。

Conclusion: VGGT对其自身失败的了解多于其对外报告的内容：位姿错误信号已在双视图融合的中间层特征中被隐式编码，可通过轻量探针提取并用于弃权与置信度校准，且该现象在π³上可复现，具有一定的跨模型与跨数据集普适性。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

</details>


### [628] [VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35756v1)
*Yanming Yang,Chenxi Song,Tong Zhao,Juntao Xu,Wenhao Rao,Yiwen Chen,Yiwei Wang,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 VidEdit3D，将文本引导的 3D 场景编辑重构为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务，借助视频扩散模型的时空先验实现跨视角一致的结构化编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）的文本引导 3D 编辑在"保持多视角一致性"与"允许结构修改"之间存在关键权衡；基于图像的编辑器在非常规视角下难以正确施加目标编辑。

Method: 将静态 3D 场景中的相机运动类比为视频时间动态，从而利用预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）的时空先验；提出三个组件：(1) Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR)，挑选信息量大的关键帧并构建符合 VDM 输入要求的平滑视频片段；(2) Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE)，免训练框架，包含 Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG)，在共享隐状态上对比源图像与编辑图像条件，并通过按计划放大源图像以增强对编辑参考的遵循同时保留原场景上下文；(3) Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS)，将几何与外观更新严格限制在目标基元上以减少背景属性泄漏。

Result: 实验表明，相比基线方法，该方法具有更强的指令对齐能力和更好的多视角一致性。

Conclusion: 通过轨迹化视频编辑范式结合免训练的编辑一致性引导与区域选择性 3DGS 精修，可在保持多视角一致性的同时实现结构化 3D 场景编辑。

Abstract: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

</details>


### [629] [MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35724v1)
*Shuyun Wang,Shangchen Zhou,Peiqing Yang,Yuekun Dai,Xin Yu,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MatAnyone-E 通过"低分辨率传播定位不确定区域+选择性高分辨率匹配+轻量解码器"降低高分辨率视频抠像的匹配与解码开销，在保持 MatAnyone 2 质量的同时实现约 7.4 倍推理加速，4K 下峰值显存降至 7.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于记忆（memory-based）的视频抠像方法依靠当前帧特征与历史帧存储信息的匹配来保证跨帧一致性，但随分辨率提升，匹配的计算与显存开销急剧增长，成为高分辨率（如 4K）实时应用的主要瓶颈。

Method: 1) 先做低分辨率传播，识别需要精细检查的不确定区域以及与之最相关的记忆候选；2) 仅对这些区域用筛选后的记忆执行高分辨率匹配，其余位置复用低分辨率匹配结果，从而同时减少需精细匹配的位置数和记忆搜索量；3) 针对实测运行时瓶颈设计轻量解码器，并通过训练使其复现原解码器的表示，降低高分辨率 alpha 生成成本。

Result: 抠像质量与 MatAnyone 2 相当；估计推理加速约 7.4×；4K 下峰值 GPU 显存降至 MatAnyone 2 的 7.6%；单张 NVIDIA H200、启用编译的推理下达到 1080p 73.07 FPS、4K 28.62 FPS。

Conclusion: 将计算资源按不确定性自适应分配（粗到细的匹配 + 记忆筛选 + 轻量解码）是提升记忆式高分辨率视频抠像效率的有效途径，可在几乎不损失质量的前提下显著改善速度与显存占用。

Abstract: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.

</details>


### [630] [OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35684v1)
*Junyeong Ahn,Geonwoo Kim,Kinam Kim,Gihwi Kim,Hoonjin Jung,Hyojin Jang,Jaegul Choo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniShowcase，用3D资产驱动的数据合成管线（Showcase-4K）与无需时间对齐的表面法线图转盘条件生成方法，将少视图 S2V 扩展到含360°环绕的多样相机轨迹，在保持视频质量与运动的同时取得主题一致性与3D一致性的SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本图像驱动的主题视频生成在相机暴露输入中未观测表面时非常困难。单参考图 S2V 需隐式推断未知外观与几何；多视图扩展虽提供更多视角信息，但未显式建模连接这些观测的3D结构，且现有训练数据不能保证视角变化背后是同一3D主题，导致身份与几何漂移。

Method: 1) 全自动数据合成管线：基于3D资产生成沿多样相机轨迹的视频，视角变化由底层主题几何驱动，可覆盖完整360°环绕，保证同一底层3D主体。2) 几何条件方法：从参考视图重建表面法线图，以“转盘”形式（turntable）作为条件输入视频模型，且无需与生成帧做时间对齐，避免严格时序对应的约束。3) 构建 Showcase-4K：涵盖12种相机运动、88种轨迹配置的4K级3D资产视频语料，附重建法线条件；ShowcaseBench 为留出评测集，含源网格与渲染相机参数。

Result: 实验表明在主题身份保持与3D一致性上达到SOTA，同时视频质量与运动表现保持竞争力；得益于显式几何条件与可控轨迹数据，模型可泛化到含大幅视角变化乃至360°环绕的生成任务。

Conclusion: 显式提供与生成帧解耦的三维几何先验（表面法线转盘），配合几何驱动的合成训练数据，是缓解少视图 S2V 中未知表面幻觉与3D不一致的有效途径；所提供的4K数据集与带网格、相机参数的评测基准为后续研究建立了可复现的评估基础。

Abstract: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase

</details>


### [631] [Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35682v1)
*Diogo J. Paulo,Hugo Proença,João C. Neves*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了SYN-MAD22的打印-扫描版本数据集（300/600 DPI、两台扫描仪），并用其评测8个仅在数字域训练的S-MAD模型，发现打印-扫描退化导致平均EER增大约3倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图人脸变形攻击检测（S-MAD）基准多在纯数字域评测，而部分国家真实护照签发流程要求申请人照片打印后再扫描入档，该过程引入半色调、重采样、色彩空间与传感器噪声，可能掩盖S-MAD依赖的高频伪影，导致数字域基准性能与真实部署鲁棒性之间存在被低估的差距。

Method: 对SYN-MAD22中全部真实与变形图像进行打印并在300 DPI与600 DPI下重新扫描，构建打印-扫描版本数据集；并使用第二台扫描仪重复采集以评估跨设备鲁棒性；随后在仅用数字数据训练的条件下评测8个SOTA S-MAD模型。

Result: 在数字域接近SOTA的检测器在打印-扫描数据上平均EER增加超过3倍，且在两台扫描设备上呈现一致的定性退化趋势。

Conclusion: 揭示了数字基准性能与对打印-扫描退化鲁棒性之间此前报道不足的关键差距，说明现有S-MAD评测范式不足以反映真实证件签发场景，需引入打印-扫描基准与相应鲁棒性改进。

Abstract: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.

</details>


### [632] [SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35637v1)
*Xunpeng Yi,Yibing Zhang,Qinglong Yan,Yifan Lu,Han Xu,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出生成式配准-融合框架 SeeRF，通过跨模态配准生成视场掩膜并与扩散生成模块紧耦合，突破多模态传感器视场不重叠的限制，实现完整场景级信息补全与自然融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法受限于各传感器成像视角差异与视场不匹配，难以在视场之外实现完整场景级信息整合；融合结果常残留模态特有区域与融合伪影，无法全面表征场景结构与语义信息。

Method: 1）基于微分同胚静态速度场的形变生成策略；2）视觉基础模型引导的特征提取与由粗到细的渐进式多模态配准模块，实现跨模态光流估计并生成有效视场掩膜；3）将配准模块与生成式扩散模块紧耦合，用于多模态补全与融合；4）引入跨模态控制编码模块与控制残差特征编解码机制提供有效引导，借助扩散模型先验建模能力完成非重叠视场区域的补全与自然融合。

Result: 在多个公开数据集与真实场景上的大量实验表明，该方法取得更优性能，验证了其有效性、优越性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将配准与生成式扩散融合统一建模，可有效克服共享视场假设的局限，为视场不匹配条件下的场景级多模态融合提供可行方案；代码即将开源。

Abstract: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

</details>


### [633] [Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35621v1)
*Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出合成可变形管状基准（LumenMorph生成），含5,580张RGB图像，带相机位姿、几何、深度、形变场、持久材质对应等标注，用于评估形变3D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估可变形3D重建需要同时关联相机运动、表面形变、材质对应与图像外观的真值，而现有资源难以在一个受控环境下统一提供这些信息。

Method: 开源工具包LumenMorph生成、标注并评估管状场景；基线设置三种表面运动条件×运动/静止相机×六个场景族，外观匹配变体覆盖四个场景族的运动相机有限元动作；公开读取与评估接口，含独立实现的几何与力学校验。

Result: SfM、光流与给定几何位移插值实验表明：该资源可区分配准覆盖率与几何精度，揭示相机与表面运动的影响，并检验力学先验的收益与失配。

Conclusion: 该基准提供受控合成参考，不宣称解剖或临床真实性；支持复用与扩展，数据完整性、固定环境可重复性与预测分数重放各有独立验证范围。

Abstract: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

</details>


### [634] [Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35594v1)
*Junyi Chen,Haiyu Zhang,Zhoujie Fu,Tengfei Wang,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Self Flow Forcing (SF²)，在 DMD 蒸馏框架中引入预测式表征损失，通过学生与 EMA 教师之间的噪声水平不对称，让学生从更受损输入预测教师内部表征，从而在极少步数下同时改善空间保真度与时序一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD 在少步视频扩散蒸馏中表现优异且无需对抗训练、适配多种学生架构，但其目标仅作用于输出空间，缺乏对内部表征的显式正则；当蒸馏步数极度压缩时，仅靠输出监督不足，学生模型的细粒度空间结构与连贯时序动态会明显退化。

Method: 在保持 DMD 原有输出目标不变的前提下加入预测式表征损失：对同一数据给学生与 EMA 教师施加异质噪声水平，构造信息不对称，迫使学生从更嘈杂的输入预测教师的内部表征，从而将自监督式表征对齐融入分布匹配。该方法与架构无关，无需外部特征提取器，额外计算开销极小。

Result: 大量实验表明 SF² 有效缓解时序闪烁，并持续提升空间保真度与运动质量；机制可无缝支持双向与因果两类模型。

Conclusion: 输出空间监督在极少步蒸馏下不足，引入基于信息不对称的表征预测损失可作为 DMD 的有效补充，且具备良好的通用性与低开销特性。

Abstract: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry.
