*Zhen Dong,Haiping Wang,Wei Tu,Yuan Liu,Bing Wang,Xuan Sun,Jinzhou Cao,Ronald Clark,Zhiheng Fu,Mohammed Bennamoun,Danfeng Hong,Yuanzheng Cui,Gemine Vivone,Pedram Ghamisi,Bisheng Yang,Qingquan Li,Deren Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，从"孪生—智能体"（twin-agent）视角系统梳理城市时空智能（Urban STI）系统的技术整合路径，并提出内层智能体闭环与外层系统闭环的双环蓝图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市需协调基础设施、出行、环境管理、应急响应与公共服务等多个领域，且条件不断变化；现有城市孪生与智能体AI技术各自分散，缺乏系统级视角说明如何将其一致地集成为统一的城市时空智能系统。

Method: 采用综述与综合（synthesis）方法：一方面回顾孪生如何重建并表征持续存在、信息丰富的城市环境；另一方面梳理智能体如何通过接口理解孪生、在其上进行推理、可靠行动并随城市持续演化；在此基础上归纳出双环蓝图——内层智能体闭环（grounding、reasoning、verification）与外层系统闭环（数据、孪生、智能体行动、反馈、更新）。

Result: 给出城市STI系统的系统级整合框架与双环蓝图，并据此组织STI研究议程，说明同一共享原型可支撑多样的城市场景与领域。

Conclusion: 城市时空智能可通过"城市孪生+智能体AI"的协同整合实现更及时、有效、透明的城市治理；双环蓝图可作为统一框架指导后续研究与原型复用。

Abstract: Cities must coordinate domains like infrastructure, mobility, environmental management, emergency response, and public services as conditions evolve. An urban Spatio-Temporal Intelligence (STI) system helps the city monitor citywide states, analyze problems, plan and execute interventions, and adapt through feedback, making urban governance more timely, effective, and transparent. Recent urban twinning and agentic AI techniques provide foundations for such systems. From a twin-agent perspective, this survey takes a system-level view of how these disparate techniques can be coherently integrated into an urban STI system. Specifically, we review how the twin reconstructs and represents a persistent, information-enriched urban environment, and how the agent understands the twin via interfaces, reasons over it, acts reliably, and continuously evolves with the city. Built upon this synthesis, we summarize a two-loop blueprint, where an inner agent loop for grounding, reasoning, and verification, and an outer system loop linking data, twin, agentic action, feedback, and update. We then use this to structure an STI research agenda and show how a shared prototype supports diverse urban domains.

</details>


### [702] [Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34785v1)
*Jiaming Zhang,Fuyao Zhang,Pengjun Xie,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出非鲁棒特征并非仅是被动的"捷径"，而可成为"自然干扰器"(Natural Jammers)主动误导标准模型，并提出"频谱-空间锁定"与"替换悖论"来解释其机制与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作多将非鲁棒特征视为帮助标准模型在干净数据上表现的"机会主义捷径"；作者希望揭示其更具破坏性的一面，即非鲁棒线索可能主动对抗、误导标准模型。

Method: 以标准模型与鲁棒模型之间的预测分歧为分析透镜，识别出鲁棒模型优于标准模型的"Jammed Set"；通过频谱滤波与微小几何变换进行干预，检验高频成分与特定空间结构的对齐关系，从而给出因果证据。

Result: 发现"频谱-空间锁定"：只有当高频分量与特定空间结构精确对齐时才产生干扰；破坏该锁定（频谱滤波或小几何位移）可恢复正确预测。同时发现"替换悖论"：单个干扰器对几何变换脆弱，但干扰的整体发生率近似稳定，只是被重新分配而非消除。

Conclusion: 将"自然非鲁棒性"重新表述为经验模型-数据几何上的一个"失效场"(failure field)，该场在微小变换下重新分布而非消失，为理解标准模型的自然脆弱性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.

</details>


### [703] [ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34782v1)
*Caiyi Sun,Yujing Sun,Siu-Ming Yiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ToDoPro，在主导噪阶段之前利用 DiT 自身对 2× 下采样参考图进行少量去噪步的"廉价探测"来估计参考 token 重要性，并据此做分层 token 缩减（丢弃低重要性、用下采样替换中重要性、保留高重要性），在无额外参数、兼容模型内加速技术的前提下显著提速并降低峰值显存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于参考图的生成模型将参考图与文本 token 拼接为联合序列送入单一 DiT，多参考导致 token 爆炸与 O(N²) 复杂度；现有 DiT 内部加速方法难以削减空间冗余、无法缓解峰值显存，而模型前置的 token 缩减方案又需引入外部模型。因此作者追问：能否在无额外参数、且与模型内技术兼容的条件下同时实现加速与省显存。

Method: 1) 廉价探测阶段：对参考图做 2× 空间下采样后执行少量去噪步，直接用 DiT 自身提取参考 token 重要性；2) 分层缩减：依据探测出的重要性，在主导噪前完全丢弃低重要性 token、将中重要性 token 替换为其下采样版本以低成本保留全局上下文、保留高重要性 token；3) 该缩减位于模型前置但无需外部模型参数，可与 DiT 内部加速方法叠加。

Result: 在三个基础模型与两个基准上，早期缩减显著加速推理并降低峰值 GPU 显存；同时通过安全滤除噪声性、无信息量的参考 token，使模型将有限注意力容量集中于真正有用的 token，从而提升生成质量。

Conclusion: ToDoPro 表明，借助 DiT 自身的下采样自探测可在模型前置阶段完成有效的参考 token 早期缩减，兼顾效率、显存与生成质量，且无需额外参数、与模型内加速技术兼容；代码将开源。

Abstract: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early Token reduction via Downsampled self-Probing (ToDoPro). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially $2\times$ downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at https://github.com/scy639/ToDoPro

</details>


### [704] [Factorized Gradients for Scalable Highly-expressive Parametric Diffeomorphisms](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34766v1)
*Amit Aflalo,Eran Treister,Chaim Baskin,Oren Freifeld*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FG-CPAB，将CPAB变换的轨迹积分与参数空间投影解耦（因子化梯度），把梯度计算复杂度从O(dTN)降至O(TN+dC)，实现最高约10^4倍加速（2D）与约500倍GPU显存节省，使细剖分CPAB首次在2D/3D中实用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPAB变换通过剖分上的连续分段仿射速度场参数化一族微分同胚，参数维度d取决于剖分精细度而非数据分辨率，参数紧凑且表达力可调。但长期瓶颈在于：轨迹积分与关于θ的梯度计算紧密耦合，导致梯度复杂度随d线性增长，细剖分时计算与显存开销不可接受，限制了其表达力发挥。

Method: FG-CPAB：一种因子化梯度（factorized-gradient）公式。核心是将速度场路径的数值积分与到参数空间的投影分离——先在与θ无关的量上完成积分（代价O(TN)），再通过剖分单元上的投影矩阵（代价O(dC)）映射回参数空间，从而避免对每个积分步、每个点都显式依赖完整d维参数向量。

Result: 梯度复杂度由O(dTN)降为O(TN+dC)；实测最高四个数量级加速（2D约10^4×），峰值GPU显存约降低500×（2D），同时表达力显著提升（可采用更细剖分）。

Conclusion: 解耦积分与参数投影是释放CPAB可扩展性的关键；该方法使细剖分CPAB在2D与3D中首次变得实用，从而提供高表达力的参数化微分同胚，适用于配准、变形建模等空间/时间变形任务。

Abstract: Diffeomorphisms provide a flexible, topology-preserving mathematical tool for modeling complex spatial or temporal deformations and are used in various scientific fields. However, making these deformations simultaneously highly expressive and computationally efficient remains challenging. Continuous Piecewise-Affine Based (CPAB) transformations (Freifeld et al., ICCV 2015; IEEE TPAMI 2017) offer an attractive solution by parameterizing a family of diffeomorphisms via continuous velocity fields that are piecewise affine with respect to a chosen tessellation of the domain. Importantly, $d=\dim(θ)$, the dimension of the parameter vector $θ$, depends on the fineness of the tessellation rather than on the data resolution. Despite this compact parameterization, CPAB optimization has long been hindered by the tight coupling between trajectory integration and gradient computation with respect to $θ$. We introduce FG-CPAB, a factorized-gradient formulation for scalable CPAB transformations. By separating integration from parameter-space projection, our method reduces gradient computation complexity from $\mathcal{O}(dTN)$ to $\mathcal{O}(TN+dC)$, where $T$ is the number of integration steps, $N$ is the number of transformed points, and $C$ is the number of tessellation cells. This reformulation yields speedups of up to four orders of magnitude (e.g., $\approx 10^4\times$ in 2D), substantial memory savings (e.g., $\approx 500\times$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage in 2D), and dramatically higher expressiveness. This makes fine-tessellation CPAB practical in 2D and 3D for the first time, enabling highly expressive parametric diffeomorphisms.

</details>


### [705] [Efficient Multi-modal Video Fusion Network with Dynamic Region-Guided Temporal Interaction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34765v1)
*Jingxue Huang,Xiaosong Li,Yi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种高效多模态视频融合网络，采用动态区域引导的时空交互，避免光流与特征扭曲，实现高质量、高时序一致性且边缘设备可部署的融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频融合方法依赖光流估计与特征扭曲做帧间对齐和跨帧聚合以保持时序一致性，带来较大计算开销，且融合性能易受光流估计误差影响。

Method: 1) 时空交互模块基于Test-Time Training范式以线性复杂度建模时序依赖；2) 将时序建模限制在关键动态区域，剔除低变化token以减少无效交互；3) 利用预训练MAE特征的全局结构建模能力，引入特征级时序一致性约束，通过对齐融合视频与源视频的帧间变化方向抑制局部闪烁；4) 提出基于MAE的时序指标，在动态区域内量化时序变化的方向距离。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，相比现有SOTA方法，融合质量与时序一致性更优，且在边缘设备部署设置下保持高计算效率。

Conclusion: 以动态区域引导的线性复杂度时序交互替代光流对齐，可在保证时序一致性的同时显著降低计算成本，适用于边缘端多模态视频融合。

Abstract: Multi-modal video fusion aims to generate temporally coherent videos with salient targets and rich structural details by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. However, existing video fusion methods commonly rely on optical flow estimation and feature warping for inter-frame alignment and cross-frame information aggregation to maintain temporal consistency, thereby introducing considerable computational overhead and making the fusion performance vulnerable to flow estimation errors. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an efficient multi-modal video fusion network with dynamic region-guided temporal interaction. Specifically, the proposed spatio-temporal interaction module leverages the Test-Time Training paradigm to model temporal dependencies with linear complexity. Building on this design, the module restricts temporal modeling to key dynamic regions in the video sequence, as static background regions provide limited temporal cues. By excluding low-variation tokens from unnecessary temporal interaction, this selective strategy contributes to improved fusion quality and temporal consistency. In addition, leveraging the strong ability of pretrained MAE features to capture global structural dependencies, we introduce a feature-level temporal consistency constraint to suppress local flickering by aligning the inter-frame variation directions of the fused and source videos. We further propose a new MAE-based temporal metric that quantifies directional distance between their temporal variations within dynamic regions. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with existing state-of-the-art methods, our method achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency on multiple benchmark datasets, while exhibiting high computational efficiency under edge-device deployment settings.

</details>


### [706] [From Sentinel-2 to 1-m Imagery: Real-World $\times 10$ Cross-Sensor Super-Resolution via Visual Autoregressive Modeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34742v1)
*Tailai Chen,Yuluxin Fu,Jie Deng,Shu Luo,Yanan Wu,Danfeng Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建了Sentinel-2 到 Jilin-1 的 ×10 真实跨传感器重建基准 YREB-SR（11,559 对场景），并提出 CrossVAR：以 Sentinel-2 为条件的九尺度视觉自回归模型预测 1-m 潜变量，再用无噪声注入的扩散精修器补偿量化残差，在 3,015 个测试场景上取得 27.60 dB PSNR、0.7725 SSIM、0.1451 LPIPS、7.15 FID 的最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的 Sentinel-2 → 1-m 重建存在双重困难：其一，输入与参考由不同卫星观测，在空间分辨率、光谱响应、辐射度量、成像时间和局部几何上均不一致，不存在可用的合成退化算子；其二，每个空间维度需放大十倍，远超遥感超分通常研究的 2–4 倍，现有方法难以直接适用。

Method: 构建 YREB-SR 基准：将 2022 年 Sentinel-2 RGB 合成影像与 2022 年 Jilin-1 RGB 参考影像（重采样至 1-m 网格）配对，覆盖长江经济带，共 11,559 对地理配准场景，按 6,409/2,135/3,015 划分训练/验证/测试。方法 CrossVAR 为视觉自回归模型，以 Sentinel-2 输入为条件，按九尺度层级预测 1-m 潜变量，并由扩散精修器在不注入噪声的条件下估计剩余量化残差。推理时以 Sentinel-2 像元网格为起点、按训练一致的尺度切分重叠窗口，在解码器训练尺寸上解码，再以高斯权重融合窗口，重建完整 1600×1600 场景。

Result: 在全部 3,015 个测试场景上，CrossVAR 取得 27.60 dB PSNR、0.7725 SSIM、0.1451 LPIPS 和 7.15 FID，四项指标均为对比方法中的最优值。

Conclusion: 该工作为大规模跨传感器重建建立了强自回归基线，并公开源代码与实现（https://github.com/SHANOAL/RSSR）以支持可复现研究。

Abstract: Reconstructing 1-m imagery from Sentinel-2 combines two difficulties. The input and the reference are observed by different satellites, which differ in spatial resolution, spectral response, radiometry, acquisition time, and local geometry, so no synthetic degradation operator links them. The required magnification of ten in each spatial dimension also far exceeds the factors of two to four at which remote sensing super-resolution is usually developed. We study this real-world $\times 10$ problem using YREB-SR, which pairs 2022 Sentinel-2 RGB composites with 2022 Jilin-1 RGB references resampled to a 1-m grid over the Yangtze River Economic Belt. The benchmark contains 11,559 geographically matched scene pairs, with 6,409, 2,135, and 3,015 assigned to training, validation, and testing, respectively. We develop CrossVAR, a visual autoregressive model that predicts the 1-m latent as a nine-scale hierarchy conditioned on the Sentinel-2 input and estimates the remaining quantization residual with a diffusion refiner run without injected noise. Complete 1600 $\times$ 1600 scenes are reconstructed in overlapping windows that start on the Sentinel-2 pixel grid, as every training patch does, and every window is decoded at the size on which the decoder was trained before the windows are blended with Gaussian weights. On all 3,015 test scenes, CrossVAR achieves 27.60 dB PSNR, 0.7725 SSIM, 0.1451 LPIPS, and 7.15 FID, the best value of each metric among the compared methods. These results establish a strong autoregressive baseline for large-scale cross-sensor reconstruction. To facilitate reproducibility, the source code and implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/SHANOAL/RSSR.

</details>


### [707] [FGD2HF: Frequency-guided Dual-domain Hypergraph Fusion for Semantic Segmentation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34734v1)
*Xiaofan Yang,Wei Pan,Yubin Liu,Junyu Wu,Junming Zhang,Jie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双域融合网络FGD2HF，用频域特征引导空间域的融合与增强，以低计算代价提升语义分割性能与边界精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频域信息对语义分割有益，但现有基于频域的方法存在频域利用不充分、融合效率低、计算复杂度高的问题。

Method: 包含三个核心组件：(1) NAHA混合注意力编码器，通过邻域注意力与超图注意力联合建模局部与全局关系；(2) WTE小波变换与增强模块，从前一阶段特征中提取并细化低/高频线索；(3) FGDF频域引导双域融合模块，用频率线索对当前阶段的空间分组与特征传播进行条件化，将全局与局部频域引导注入空间特征的调制、增强与融合。

Result: ADE20K上FGD2HF-B达48.7% mIoU（较SegMAN-B +0.3%，GFLOPs少18%）；Cityscapes上83.2% mIoU（与SegMAN-B相当，GFLOPs少21%）；SBD上较VWFormer-T高1.1% mIoU且GFLOPs少21%；边界分割精度亦显著提升。

Conclusion: 双域融合设计在低计算成本下实现了有竞争力的分割精度与更优的边界质量，验证了频域引导空间特征融合的有效性。

Abstract: Frequency-domain information is beneficial for semantic segmentation. However, existing frequency-based methods often suffer from insufficient frequency utilization, inefficient fusion, and high computational complexity. To address these issues, we propose FGD2HF, a dual-domain fusion network that leverages frequency features to guide spatial-domain fusion and enhancement. Specifically, we introduce a novel Hybrid-Attention Encoder (NAHA) that jointly models local and global relationships through neighborhood and hypergraph attention, enhancing the network's ability to extract effective features. We further introduce a Wavelet Transform and Enhancement (WTE) module to extract and refine low- and high-frequency cues from preceding-stage features, followed by Frequency-guided Dual-domain Fusion (FGDF) modules that use frequency cues to condition current-stage spatial grouping and feature propagation. This design incorporates both global and local frequency guidance into spatial feature modulation, enhancement and fusion with low computational cost. Extensive comparisons with numerous state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods demonstrate that our method is highly competitive. Our full FGD2HF-B model achieves 48.7% mIoU on ADE20K (+0.3% over SegMAN-B with 18% fewer GFLOPs), 83.2% mIoU on Cityscapes (comparable to SegMAN-B with 21% fewer GFLOPs), and 1.1% higher mIoU than VWFormer-T on SBD with 21% fewer GFLOPs, while also achieving significant improvements in boundary segmentation accuracy.

</details>


### [708] [RSKD: Grounding Semantic Consistency in Driving VLMs via Distillation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34689v1)
*Chuchu Xie,Yang Zhong,Kangan Qian,Hao Ye,Kun Jiang,Diange Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RSKD：一种语义一致性引导的蒸馏框架，按答案短语的任务重要性与教师预测的语义一致性来路由监督信号，实现大模型到自动驾驶紧凑模型的知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将大型多模态模型蒸馏到自动驾驶紧凑模型时，统一的token级匹配会稀释与规划相关的语义，并放大师生错误。

Method: 1) 在真值答案中定位任务关键语义短语；2) 计算短语级一致性得分，用以调节JSD蒸馏与真值监督之间的平衡；3) 仅在语义一致处强调教师信息，对不一致短语加强真值监督。

Result: 在DrivingVQA、LingoQA上优于对比的学生基线，在MapLMv2上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 基于任务重要性与一致性得分的短语级监督路由，可缓解均匀token匹配置的语义稀释与教师错误放大问题，是面向自动驾驶多模态蒸馏的有效方案。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation can transfer large multimodal models to compact models for autonomous driving, but uniform token-level matching can dilute planning-relevant semantics and amplify teacher errors. We propose RSKD, a semantic-consistency-guided distillation framework that routes supervision according to both the task importance of an answer phrase and its semantic consistency with the teacher prediction. Task-critical semantic phrases are localized in the ground-truth answer, and a phrase-level consistency score controls the balance between Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation and ground-truth supervision. Teacher information is emphasized only where it is semantically consistent, while semantically inconsistent phrases receive stronger ground-truth supervision. We evaluate RSKD on DrivingVQA, LingoQA, and MapLMv2. RSKD improves over the compared student-based baselines on DrivingVQA and LingoQA and remains competitive on MapLMv2.

</details>


### [709] [Good Rankings, Poor Choices? Rethinking Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34685v1)
*Hyuk Kwon,Jaebyeong Jeon,Hyeonseo Jang,Kibok Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文重新审视仅语言视觉语言模型选择（LOVM）的评测协议，指出排序指标不能直接反映所选模型性能，改用简单后悔（SR）并提出对异常值稳健的归一化后悔（ORNR）；在新协议下提出免训练方法 TC-ESR，在22个目标任务和43个VLM上取得最低平均SR与ORNR，并修正了先前评测协议中的两处目标性能泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LOVM评测使用top-5 recall、Kendall秩相关等排序指标，这些指标衡量的是排序质量而非被选中模型的实际性能；同时先前基于排序的评测协议存在目标性能泄漏问题，导致结论失真。

Method: ①将评测指标改为简单后悔SR（最优模型与所选模型的性能差），并引入Outlier-Robust Normalized Regret（ORNR），兼顾任务间性能范围差异并对异常值降敏；②提出Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret（TC-ESR）：免训练方法，依据目标任务条件，在源任务上按相似度加权的平均后悔最小者选择模型；③定位并修正旧协议中两处目标性能泄漏。

Result: 在22个目标任务、43个VLM的实验中，TC-ESR在所有对比方法中取得最低的平均SR与ORNR；修正后的协议消除了两处目标性能泄漏。

Conclusion: LOVM应直接以所选模型的性能损失（后悔）为评测目标而非排序相关性；TC-ESR作为一种简洁的免训练基线在新协议下表现最优，同时强调了协议泄漏修正对结论可靠性的重要性。

Abstract: Language-Only Vision-Language Model Selection (LOVM) aims to identify the Vision-Language Model (VLM) with the highest zero-shot accuracy on a target task using only textual information. We revisit the existing LOVM evaluation protocol and argue that ranking metrics, such as top-5 recall and Kendall's rank correlation, do not directly assess the performance of the selected model. We therefore adopt simple regret (SR), defined as the performance gap between the best and selected models, and introduce Outlier-Robust Normalized Regret (ORNR) to account for the varying performance ranges across tasks while reducing sensitivity to outliers. Building on this revised evaluation protocol, we propose Target-Conditioned Expected Source Regret (TC-ESR), a training-free method that selects the model with the lowest similarity-weighted mean regret across source tasks. Across 22 target tasks and 43 VLMs, TC-ESR achieves the lowest mean SR and ORNR among all compared methods. Separately, we identify two sources of target performance leakage in the prior ranking-based evaluation protocol and provide corrections that remove both.

</details>


### [710] [StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34662v2)
*Chengzhi Liu,Yuxiang Lai,Yuzhe Yang,Yanqing Liu,Jiheng Hou,Yue Cao,Haonan Wang,Ruixi Fan,Lan Wang,Sheng Liu,Songyou Peng,Yale Song,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Xin Eric Wang,Jui-Hsin Lai,Youbao Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 StreamVibe 系列工作（Bench、VL 模型、Harness），面向显式/隐式/动态用户意图的流式主动交互：新基准 4.1K 评测样本 + 85K 训练样本，模型相较基线在响应时机与答案质量上提升 10.7%，Harness 通过分层记忆将意图作为持久状态维护，再带来 12.3% 的主动交互增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型正从离线被动理解转向在线主动交互，但主流方法依赖显式请求，忽视隐式用户意图（如网页导航时的“下一步点哪里”），且无法随意图演化持续更新理解，难以支撑真实场景中的意图感知交互。

Method: 1) 构建 StreamVibe-Bench：涵盖显式、隐式、动态三类意图，4.1K 评测样本与 85K 训练样本；2) 训练 StreamVibe-VL 流式主动模型，从连续观测推断隐式意图并随意图演化作动态调整；3) 设计 StreamVibe-Harness，以分层记忆将用户意图维护为具有灵活生命周期的持久状态，跟踪最新意图与环境状态。

Result: (i) StreamVibe-VL 在保留强通用视频理解能力的同时，响应时机与答案质量较现有基线提升 10.7%；(ii) 现有主动模型在理解用户意图、判断何时响应方面仍受限，隐式与动态意图下尤为明显；(iii) StreamVibe-Harness 提升持续交互中的响应一致性与适应性，使主动交互性能再提升 12.3%。

Conclusion: 将“隐式/动态意图理解 + 何时响应”纳入统一基准与建模框架是可行且有效的；流式主动模型配合持久意图状态记忆，可显著改善真实场景下的主动交互表现，同时现有方法在该设定下仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while overlooking implicit user intents (e.g., "where should I click next?" when a user is navigating a website) and fail to continuously update their understanding as user intents evolve. These limitations make them less suitable for intent-aware interaction in real-world scenarios. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark that serves as a testbed for user intent understanding and interaction, comprising 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically adapts its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with flexible lifecycles through hierarchical memory, enabling it to track the latest user intents and environmental states. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding capabilities while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over existing baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intents and determining when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation during sustained interactions, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction performance.

</details>


### [711] [Regional prediction of hematoma expansion from non-contrast computed tomography in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage patients](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34645v1)
*Natasha Ironside,Hongyu Kan,Kristofor Pas,Mohammad Shifat-E-Rabbi,Benjamin Newman,Shinjini Kundu,Kareem El Naamani,Tanvir Rizvi,Andrea Becerril-Gaitan,Harrison Snyder,Aarathi Manchikalapudi,Sarah Ratcliffe,Stacie L. Demel,Carl D. Langefeld,Daniel Woo,Stephan Mayer,E. Sander Connolly,Gustavo Rohde,for the ERICH Investigators,the VISTA-ICH collaboration*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究基于发病时平扫CT，提出并验证了可解释的、分区域（脑叶、基底节、丘脑）的"传输基形态测量"（TBM）影像特征模型，用于预测脑出血血肿扩大，验证集AUROC达0.787，优于临床医师判断与常规机器学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血肿部位、扩大程度与最终体积共同影响神经功能结局，但既往血肿扩大预测模型多为整体性、缺乏可解释性，且未按出血部位分区建模。作者希望建立一个定量、可解释、按区域划分的平扫NCCT特征模型，以更准确地预测血肿扩大并揭示其区域影像学机制。

Method: 1) 数据：ERICH研究作推导队列，VISTA归档作验证队列；2) 图像处理：对发病时及24±6小时NCCT进行预处理、分割，并按脑叶、基底节、丘脑分区；3) 血肿扩大定义按区域及其对临床结局的影响确定；4) 特征提取：采用传输基形态测量（TBM）为每例血肿生成独特的传输基表示；5) 建模：在传输表示上应用线性分类器构建预测模型；6) 评价：以AUROC比较TBM区域模型与临床医师判断及其他机器学习方法。

Result: 推导队列574例（脑叶162、基底节257、丘脑155）；验证队列196例（脑叶31、基底节119、丘脑46）。联合区域模型在验证集中预测血肿扩大的AUROC为0.787。随部位变化的主要影像特征为血肿大小、异质性、离心率及血肿周边的密度分布。区域TBM模型性能优于临床医师判断及替代机器学习方法。

Conclusion: TBM能够从发病时NCCT中判别并可视化血肿扩大的区域特征，为血肿扩大的区域影像学特征提供了初步证据；该方法有望改善血肿扩大预测，并加深对其病理生理机制的理解。

Abstract: Background The combination of hematoma location, expansion and final volume influence neurological outcome. The aim of this study was to derive and validate a quantitative and interpretable region-based NCCT image feature model for predicting hematoma expansion. Methods The Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage(ERICH) study was used for derivation and the Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive(VISTA) was used for validation. NCCT images at presentation and 24+/-6hours were pre-processed, segmented and categorized into lobar, basal ganglia or thalamic regions. Hematoma expansion was defined by region and according to its effect on clinical outcome. Transport-based morphometry (TBM) produced a unique transport-based representation from each NCCT hematoma image. Linear classifiers applied to transport representations were used to derive a predictive model. The regional TBM model's performance was compared to alternate methods using AUROC analyses. Results The derivation dataset included 574 patients, comprising 162 lobar, 257 basal ganglia and 155 thalamic hematomas. The validation dataset included 196 patients, comprising 31 lobar, 119 basal ganglia and 46 thalamic hematomas. A combined regional model predicted hematoma expansion in the validation dataset with an AUROC of 0.787. The principal image features which varied by location were size, heterogeneity, eccentricity and density distribution towards the hematoma periphery. The regional TBM model outperformed alternative clinician based and machine-learning methods. Conclusions TBM discriminated and visualized regional features of hematoma expansion from presentation NCCT scans. This provides preliminary evidence for regional radiographic features of hematoma expansion. It has the potential to improve hematoma expansion prediction and understanding of hematoma expansion pathophysiology.

</details>


### [712] [RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34632v1)
*Kevin David Hayes,Alex Hanson,Allen Tu,Pranav Asthana,Matthias Zwicker,Tom Goldstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RIDE-Splat提出一种两阶段的反射去除3D重建流程，将从车载视频重建的透射场景建模为世界一致的3DGS，并将相机固定的挡风玻璃反射建模为一张共享的有符号RGB图像，无需干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车载视频透过挡风玻璃拍摄，破坏了3DGS假设的世界一致性：道路场景存在视差，而车舱反射随相机移动。标准3DGS因此会把反射内容错误地嵌入重建场景，导致重建结果含反射伪影。

Method: 将世界一致的透射部分交给3DGS场景，将主导的相机附着反射表示为一张共享的有符号RGB图像（同时建模叠加辐射与透射衰减）。分两遍构建：第一遍学习3D几何与有符号反射图像；第二遍用反射去除后的训练图像拟合干净的3DGS。推理时丢弃反射图像，保持标准3DGS渲染路径。此外发布RIDE-Splat Dataset——首个面向车载视频反射去除的3D重建基准，含真实驾驶场景、训练视图中的物理挡风玻璃反射及单独采集的无反射评估图像。

Result: 在RIDE-Splat Dataset、XLD和Wayve三个数据集上，RIDE-Splat在全部九项聚合指标上优于3DGS、DC-Gaussian和RobustSplat，PSNR最高提升3.59 dB，LPIPS最高降低0.0876；在42项逐场景比较中38项取得最优。它能去除基线中仍可见的挡风玻璃反射，同时保持透射场景。

Conclusion: 通过显式分离世界一致透射与相机附着反射，RIDE-Splat可在无监督（无需干净图像与掩码）条件下实现无反射的3D重建，且推理不引入额外开销，并提供了首个相关评测基准。

Abstract: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard 3DGS rendering path. We also introduce the RIDE-Splat Dataset, the first 3D reconstruction benchmark for reflection removal from driving video -- with real driving scenes, physical windshield reflections in training views, and separately captured non-reflective evaluation images. Across the RIDE-Splat Dataset, XLD, and Wayve, RIDE-Splat outperforms 3DGS, DC-Gaussian, and RobustSplat on all nine aggregate metrics, improving PSNR by up to 3.59 dB and reducing LPIPS by up to 0.0876. We achieve the highest metrics in 38 out of 42 per-scene comparisons and removes windshield reflections that remain visible in the baselines while preserving the transmitted scene.

</details>


### [713] [P2P-Former: Bridging the Supervision Gap Between Point and Proposal in Temporal Action Localization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34618v1)
*Yunchuan Ma,Laiyun Qing,Sai Xu,Guorong Li,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P2P-Former，一种点监督到时序提议的Transformer框架，通过点感知提议生成与点引导语义增强弥合点监督与全监督时序动作定位之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点监督时序动作定位标注成本低（每个动作实例仅需一帧）且检测性能有竞争力，但由于点标注比提议标注不完整，现有方法主要依赖多实例学习进行片段级分类，导致与全监督模型存在性能差距。核心难点在于：(1) 如何生成可靠提议作为伪真值；(2) 如何将点级线索有效融入全监督范式。

Method: 提出P2P-Former框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 点感知提议生成（PPG）策略，利用点感知重要性估计函数对基础定位器产出的提议置信度进行精化，再通过点标注与候选提议之间的最优匹配筛选可靠提议作为伪真值；(2) 点引导语义增强（PSE）模块，从点标注特征中聚合原型，并通过基于Transformer的交互将原型注入片段特征；(3) 点到提议约束损失（PPCL），强制每个预测提议包含所标注的点。

Result: 在THUMOS14和ActivityNet-1.3数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于多种现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过将点级监督与提议级学习有效衔接，P2P-Former在低标注成本下显著缩小了与全监督时序动作定位方法的性能差距，验证了点到提议建模范式的有效性。

Abstract: Recently, point-supervised temporal action localization has attracted increasing attention due to its low annotation cost (only one frame per action instance) and competitive detection performance. However, since point annotations are less complete than proposal annotations, existing methods mainly rely on multiple instance learning for snippet-level classification, which leads to a performance gap compared to fully supervised models. To bridge this gap, we propose P2P-Former, a novel point-to-proposal Transformer-based framework that effectively connects point-level supervision with proposal-level learning for temporal action localization. In this work, we identify two key challenges in transitioning from point-level supervision to full supervision: (1) how to generate reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth, and (2) how to effectively integrate point-level cues into the fully supervised paradigm. To address the first challenge, we propose a Point-aware Proposal Generation (PPG) strategy that refines the confidence of proposals produced by a base locator using a point-aware importance estimation function, and then performs optimal matching between point annotations and candidate proposals to select reliable proposals as pseudo ground-truth. To tackle the second challenge, we introduce a Point-guided Semantic Enhancement (PSE) module that aggregates prototypes from point-annotated features and injects them into snippet features through Transformer-based interactions. Moreover, we design a Point-to-Proposal Constraint Loss (PPCL) that enforces each predicted proposal to include the annotated point, thereby encouraging more accurate localization. Extensive experiments on the THUMOS14 and ActivityNet-1.3 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms several existing state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>


### [714] [Do Words Matter? What Text Contributes to Few and Full-Shot Vision-Language Anomaly Detection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34610v1)
*Arda Baris Basaran,Mesut Ceylan,Elgar Fleisch,Filipe Barata*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过理论证明与大规模实验表明：视觉-语言异常检测器从文本提示中读取的是"有效尺度"与"锚点几何排列"，而非语义内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言异常检测器通常被认为受益于文本描述的语义内容。但在few-shot/full-shot设置下，检测器插入了训练好的视觉适配器；而更换描述同时改变语义与几何（方向、尺度），使准确率比较无法区分二者贡献。因此作者希望隔离并量化"固定文本嵌入对（锚点）"到底贡献了什么：语义内容、有效尺度，还是联合锚点几何。

Method: 1) 理论分析：指出打分函数仅通过锚点之差访问锚点，训练后的适配器可旋转跟随任意替换方向，因此方向（即语言内容）不可辨识；并证明具有相同差分向量长度的替换锚点可产生完全相同的概率图与可达损失。2) 实验验证：在7个医学数据集、3种视觉骨干、两种监督范式、3类适配器家族上，比较尺度匹配的随机/正交锚点与正确提示；进一步用无文本的学习尺度替换MadCLIP学习提示，并在MVFA上复现；多类别共享适配器时考察类别轴的联合排列；在工业基准上验证"无意义旋转"提升性能；并在冻结零样本迁移下检验随机锚点框架的迁移性。

Result: 单锚点对情形下，尺度匹配的随机与正交锚点能追踪正确提示的表现；破坏尺度匹配会出现性能差距，而仅恢复尺度（不使用文本）即可闭合该差距。在MVFA中同样成立，MadCLIP的学习提示被无文本学习尺度替换后亦然。多类别共享适配器时，整体旋转所有类别轴无影响（与理论预测一致）；测试的CLIP提示中类别轴近乎共线，用无意义旋转将其分散可提升两个工业基准性能。冻结零样本迁移下，随机锚点框架与提示框架迁移效果相当——起作用的是坐标一致性而非语义。

Conclusion: 视觉-语言异常检测器从提示中读取的是尺度与排列（几何），而非语义内容。这一发现挑战了"语义增益"的主流归因，提示未来方法应关注锚点的尺度校准与几何构型设计，而非仅优化文本语义。

Abstract: Vision-language anomaly detectors describe normal and abnormal appearance with text, and their gains are commonly credited to the semantic content of these descriptions. This attribution is plausible in the zero-shot setting, but few- and full-shot detectors interpose a trained visual adapter, and in that setting it has not been isolated. Changing a description changes both its meaning and its geometry, so accuracy comparisons cannot separate the two. We ask what a fixed pair of text embeddings, or anchors, contributes to such a detector: semantic content, effective scale, or joint anchor geometry. For a single anchor pair, the answer is effective scale alone. The score reads the anchors only through their difference, and a trained adapter can rotate to follow any replacement direction, leaving that direction, and with it the linguistic content, unidentifiable. We prove that replacement anchors with the same difference-vector length permit exactly the same probability maps and attainable losses. Across seven medical datasets, three vision backbones, both supervision regimes, and three adapter families, scale-matched random and orthogonal anchors track correct prompts; breaking the scale match opens a gap that restoring it closes without text. The same pattern holds in MVFA and when MadCLIP's learned prompts are replaced by a text-free learned scale. When one adapter serves many categories, the answer expands to their joint arrangement. Rotating all category axes together changes nothing, as predicted. For the tested CLIP prompts, these axes are nearly collinear, and meaning-free rotations that spread them apart improve performance on both industrial benchmarks. Even under frozen zero-shot transfer, a random anchor frame transfers as well as the prompt frame: coordinate consistency, not meaning. What these detectors read from their prompts is scale and arrangement, not semantic content.

</details>


### [715] [FlexiMIND: Combined Pretrained Vision Features and Local Structure for Training-Free Deformable Medical Image Registration](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34600v1)
*Mojtaba Safari,Mingzhe Hu,Shansong Wang,Suyang Xi,Joshua Lorenz,Sean Pitroda,Aytekin Oto,Ralph R. Weichselbaum,Xiaofeng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练、免标注的两阶段配准框架 FlexiMIND：冻结的 FlexiCT-2D 编码器特征建立上下文对应，MIND-SSC 在 ConvexAdam 内细化形变；实验表明更紧耦合的特征融合并未优于顺序式、尺度分离的参考设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形图像配准中，对应解剖结构的灰度关系可能不一致；手工模态鲁棒描述子（MIND-SSC）与预训练视觉编码器特征各提供不同的对应表示，但二者如何组合尚不明确。作者旨在检验"更紧密集成"是否优于"顺序式、尺度分离"的设计。

Method: FlexiMIND 为两阶段、无训练无标签框架：以冻结的 FlexiCT-2D 编码器特征建立上下文对应，再由 MIND-SSC 在 ConvexAdam 优化器内细化形变。在 CT-CT（DIR-Lab 4DCT，10 例）、MR-MR（ACDC，50 例）、MR-CT（Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT，8 对）上评测，并对比五种替代特征耦合策略；指标为 TRE、Dice、SDlogJ 与局部折叠。

Result: DIR-Lab 4DCT 上 TRE 为 1.27 mm，ACDC 上 DSC 为 0.807，Abdomen MR-CT 上器官平均 DSC 为 0.825。15 组耦合策略-数据集对比中仅 4 组优于参考方法，Dice 最大绝对提升仅 0.0043，而退化可达 TRE 20.6%、Dice 37.9%。配准精度变化与形变场正则性变化密切相关，正则性保持更好的策略通常更接近参考性能。标记点级分析显示，预训练编码器阶段主要减少大对应误差，而非均匀提升局部精度。

Conclusion: 更紧密的特征耦合并未带来稳定收益，顺序式、尺度分离的两阶段设计在鲁棒性与精度间取得更优平衡；预训练编码器特征的价值在于抑制大位移/大对应误差，而局部精化仍宜交由手工描述子完成。

Abstract: Objective. Deformable image registration remains challenging because corresponding anatomy may exhibit different intensity relationships. Hand-crafted modality-robust descriptors such as Modality-Independent Neighborhood Descriptor with Self-Similarity Context (MIND-SSC) and features from pretrained vision encoders provide distinct representations for correspondence estimation, but how they should be combined remains unclear. We investigate whether tighter integration improves registration over a sequential, scale-separated design. Approach. We introduce FlexiMIND, a training-free and label-free two-stage framework in which frozen FlexiCT-2D encoder features establish contextual correspondence and MIND-SSC refines the deformation within ConvexAdam. Five alternative feature-coupling strategies were evaluated under a protocol across CT-CT (DIR-Lab 4DCT 4DCT, 10 cases), MR-MR (ACDC, 50 patients), and MR-CT (Learn2Reg Abdomen MR-CT, 8 pairs) registration. Performance was assessed using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (Dice), SDlogJ, and local folding. Main results. FlexiMIND achieved a TRE of 1.27 mm on DIR-Lab 4DCT, a DSC of 0.807 on ACDC, and an organ-averaged DSC of 0.825 on Abdomen MR-CT. Across 15 coupling-strategy dataset comparisons, only four outperformed the reference method, with a maximum absolute improvement of 0.0043 in Dice, whereas degradation reached 20.6 % in TRE and 37.9 % in Dice. Changes in registration accuracy were closely associated with changes in deformation-field regularity, and strategies that better preserved regularity generally remained closest to the reference performance. Landmark-level analysis showed that the pretrained encoder stage primarily reduced large correspondence errors rather than uniformly improving local precision. Code is available upon acceptance at https://github.com/mosaf/FlexiMIND.

</details>


### [716] [An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34599v1)
*Fatma Ahmed Mansour,Rahatara Ferdousi,Manar Fathy Elshenawy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出证据驱动的智能体AI框架，将肝脏与病灶分割、确定性量化及结构化报告生成串联，实现可追溯的临床可解释报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化肝脏病灶分割虽已进步，但从图像预测到临床可解释的放射学报告之间仍存在鸿沟；弥合该鸿沟需要可重复且可追溯的定量测量。

Method: 基于TotalSegmentator的nnU-Net模型分割肝脏、Couinaud分段与病灶；计算工具提取体积、尺寸、数量及解剖位置；大语言模型按预定义报告模板组织测量值，并对源测量做数值一致性校验。

Result: 在51例LiTS病例上，分割阶段肝脏Dice为0.947、病灶敏感度75.6%、阳性预测值68.9%；对25,494份MERLIN报告的探索性筛查识别出10,208份（40.0%）含肝脏相关异常。

Conclusion: 通过将定量影像证据与智能体报告生成相结合，本研究向以人为中心、强调可追溯性与临床相关性的医学AI迈进一步。

Abstract: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. Exploratory screening of 25,494 MERLIN reports identified 10,208 (40.0%) with liver-related abnormalities. By connecting quantitative imaging evidence with agentic report generation, this work takes a step toward human-centered medical AI that prioritizes traceability and clinical relevance.

</details>


### [717] [Finetuning Prompt-Based Image Editor for Geometry-Consistent Room Defurnishing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34597v1)
*Prakhar Kulshreshtha,Brian Pugh,Zachary Nussdorfer,Salma Jiddi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于FLUX.2的LoRA微调方案，实现单张房间图像去除家具、生成几何一致的空房间图，兼顾纹理真实感与3D结构保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将房间图像中家具擦除、生成对应空房间图，对 diminished reality、虚拟摆场等XR应用有价值。难点有二：一是以真实内容填补家具区域，二是不破坏房间3D几何结构。提示词驱动的图像编辑器（如FLUX.2）真实感强，但结构保真度不如显式布局条件的内绘方法。

Method: 在2,500对"有家具—空房间"配对数据上对FLUX.2微调LoRA适配器，通过训练配方提升几何一致性，同时保留原有纹理质量。

Result: 搭载该LoRA适配器的FLUX.2在几何一致性上显著提升，并保持了高纹理保真度。

Conclusion: 该单图内绘模块可作为depth-aware与3D一致性XR流水线的有效基础组件。

Abstract: Erasing all furniture from a single room image to generate its empty counterpart is valuable for XR applications such as diminished reality and virtual staging. The challenge is twofold: inpainting the furniture regions with realistic content, and doing so without distorting the room's 3D geometry. Prompt-driven image editors, such as FLUX.2, handle realism impressively, but their structural faithfulness is inferior to explicit layout conditioned inpainting. To improve geometric consistency, we propose a training recipe for finetuning a LoRA on 2,500 furnished-empty room pairs. FLUX.2 with our LoRA adaptor significantly improves geometric consistency while retaining the high texture fidelity. This single-photo inpainter can be an effective building block for depth-aware and 3D-consistent XR pipelines.

</details>


### [718] [FlockWorld: Toward Population-Scale Multi-Agent Video World Models through Artificial Life Simulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34564v1)
*Meryem Koksal,Yunzhe Wang,Volkan Ustun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FlockWorld（基于 Boids 的群体级多智能体视频世界模型环境）与 FlockDiT（联合生成多路同步第一视角视频的扩散 Transformer），为群体规模多智能体视频生成提供可控测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作条件视频世界模型多限于单玩家，已有多人模型仅支持规模小且固定的智能体组，缺乏可扩展到群体规模、且能独立控制智能体数量与群体密度的研究平台。

Method: 构建 FlockWorld：基于 Reynolds Boids 算法渲染同步第一视角裁剪画面，用不同颜色保持跨视角的相机—智能体身份一致性，将规则推导的加速度作为动作，并使相机智能体数量可独立于周围群体规模配置；再训练 FlockDiT——以 flow matching 训练的、动作条件的潜空间扩散 Transformer，联合生成多智能体同步第一视角视频。

Result: 在同密度设置下，联合生成有利于智能体检测；diffusion forcing 提升了 rollout 保真度。

Conclusion: FlockWorld 与 FlockDiT 共同构成面向多智能体视频生成的可控测试床。

Abstract: Most action-conditioned video world models remain limited to a single player, while existing multiplayer models support only small, fixed groups of agents. We introduce FlockWorld, an artificial-life environment built on Reynolds's Boids algorithm for studying population-scale multi-agent video world models. Specifically, FlockWorld renders synchronized egocentric crops, assigns distinct colors to preserve camera-agent identity across views, exposes rule-derived accelerations as actions, and lets the number of camera agents be configured independently of the size of the surrounding population. We further introduce FlockDiT, an action-conditioned latent diffusion transformer trained with flow matching on FlockWorld data to jointly generate synchronized egocentric videos for multiple agents. Our results suggest that joint generation benefits agent detection at density-matched settings and that diffusion forcing improves rollout fidelity. Together, FlockWorld and FlockDiT provide a controlled testbed for multi-agent video generation.

</details>


### [719] [Recursive CLIP: Vision-Language Distillation with Looped Transformer Blocks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34563v1)
*Szymon Mazurek,Alberto Presta,Michał Byra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究在对比视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）中递归复用Transformer块（N个块前向传播中重复M次，N·M固定为ViT-B深度）的可行性，提出视觉编码器递归的rCLIP与视觉+文本编码器均递归的r²CLIP，并在直接对比训练与DFN-2B教师蒸馏（CC3M/CC12M）下评估其零样本分类、跨模态检索、少样本学习、视觉定位与概念遗忘表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP类模型默认在深度方向使用独立参数化的Transformer块，参数占用大、适配成本高。作者希望探究在保持可迁移能力的前提下，能否通过递归复用块来压缩参数，并厘清递归对知识迁移与下游适配的影响。

Method: 构建N个块的递归骨架，每次前向重复M次，保持N·M等于标准ViT-B深度以维持计算深度、逐步提高参数共享；设置两种递归族rCLIP（仅视觉编码器递归）与r²CLIP（文本编码器也递归）；训练方式包括直接对比训练与从DFN-2B预训练的ViT-B/16教师蒸馏，使用CC3M与CC12M数据；评测涵盖零样本分类、跨模态检索、少样本学习、视觉定位与概念遗忘。

Result: CLIP能够容忍相当程度的递归块复用，但影响程度依赖于具体编码器与下游任务；递归在结构上天然带来参数效率，因为需要存储和适配的不同块更少。

Conclusion: 递归块复用构成视觉-语言模型一个实用的设计空间，对知识迁移、下游适配与参数效率具有明确意义，为参数高效的多模态架构设计提供依据。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP typically rely on independently parameterized transformer blocks across depth. We investigate the extent to which these blocks can instead be reused recurrently while preserving the transferable capabilities of CLIP. We study recursive transformer backbones in which a small set of $N$ transformer blocks is applied $M$ times per forward pass. By holding $N \cdot M$ fixed to the depth of a standard ViT-B, our models preserve computational depth while progressively increasing parameter sharing. We consider two recursive CLIP model families: rCLIP, where only the vision encoder is recursive, and r$^2$CLIP, where recurrence is also introduced in the text encoder. We study these models under both direct contrastive training and through knowledge distillation from a strong ViT-B/16 teacher pretrained on DFN-2B, using the substantially smaller CC3M and CC12M datasets. We evaluate the resulting models on zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval, and further study their adaptability through few-shot learning, visual grounding, and concept unlearning. Our results show that CLIP can tolerate substantial recurrent block reuse, although its effect depends on the encoder and downstream task. Recurrence also provides parameter efficiency by construction, since fewer distinct transformer blocks need to be stored and adapted. Our results establish recurrent block reuse as a practical design space for vision-language models and highlight its implications for knowledge transfer, downstream adaptation, and parameter efficiency.

</details>


### [720] [GRASP: Group-Adaptive Hybrid RL-SFT Post-Training for Medical VQA without Reasoning Annotations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34561v1)
*Wanqi Dong,Wanyue Dong,Jingze Ge,Mehul Motani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRASP 在每次参数更新中同时结合强化学习与监督微调，仅利用短答案即可提升医学视觉问答的域内与域外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学VQA标注数据稀缺且只有短答案、缺乏推理标注。纯SFT会过拟合标签并放大其偏差，损害域外（OOD）泛化；纯RL（如GRPO）虽泛化更好，却不直接利用金标准答案，且在组内全对或全错时无正确性信号。现有SFT-RL混合方法要么分阶段、要么按问题切换，要么依赖专家或强模型的推理轨迹，而医学VQA数据不具备这些条件。

Method: 提出GRASP：在每一次更新中联合RL与SFT，且仅使用短答案。RL让模型探索自身推理过程；SFT在推理之后教授金标准答案，以补足RL缺乏的直接监督；二者的平衡权重根据模型对每个问题的作答效果自适应调整。仅用LoRA微调约1%参数。

Result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3-8B与Gemma 3-4B上，GRASP在域内及OOD开放式问题上均优于所有对比训练目标。在覆盖八种成像模态的OOD基准上，GRASP训练的InternVL3-8B与Qwen3-VL-8B在开放式准确率上超过全部10个对比的通用与医学VLM，包括训练数据量多达2600倍、可训练参数多达250倍的模型。

Conclusion: GRASP以短答案即可实现高效的RL-SFT联合优化，参数高效且泛化强；同时发布MedTerse数据集（12.9K短答案问题）与代码。

Abstract: Adapting general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) to medical visual question answering (VQA) is valuable for helping clinicians read images and make diagnoses, but annotated data are scarce and provide only short answers, without reasoning annotations. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) fits these labels but overfits to them and amplifies their biases, eroding out-of-domain (OOD) generalization. Reinforcement learning (RL) better preserves generalization but never uses the gold answer as a training target: GRPO-style algorithms learn from the contrast between correct and incorrect answers within a group of sampled responses, so all-correct or all-wrong groups give no correctness signal. Existing SFT-RL hybrids either apply SFT and RL in separate stages or switch between them per question, or need reasoning traces from experts or stronger models, which medical VQA data lack. We propose GRASP, which combines RL and SFT in every update using only short answers: RL lets the model explore its own reasoning, SFT teaches the gold answer after that reasoning to supply the direct supervision RL lacks, and their balance adapts to how well the model answers each question. Tuning only about 1% of the parameters with LoRA, GRASP outperforms all compared training objectives both in domain and on OOD open-ended questions across Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B and Gemma 3-4B. On an OOD benchmark spanning eight imaging modalities, GRASP-trained InternVL3-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B beat all 10 compared general and medical VLMs in open-ended accuracy, including models trained on up to 2,600 times more data or with over 250 times more trainable parameters. We release MedTerse, a dataset of 12.9K short-answer questions, and our code at https://github.com/sea-comet/GRASP-MedVQA.

</details>


### [721] [VTC-AUDIT: An Interventional Reliability Audit for Visual-Token Compression under Paired Image Shifts](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34545v1)
*Isaac,Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VTC-AUDIT，在"全模型两张图都对、压缩模型干净图对"的条件配对子集上度量视觉 token 压缩引入的增量失效风险，并在 3 个 8-9B VLM、4 任务、8 个偏移上证实：在偏移图上重选保留位置会系统性提升失效率，且 clean 压缩模型不确定性比 support Jaccard 更适合作监控信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩评估依赖干净准确率与效率均值，这类平均值掩盖了压缩在图像偏移下引入的失效——即未压缩模型仍正确、而压缩模型出错的增量风险。作者希望把"条件可靠性"显式纳入评估，并检验何种信号可用于监控该风险。

Method: 设计四臂实验，交叉两个二元选择：由哪张图（干净图 vs 偏移图）决定保留 token 位置、由哪张图提供视觉特征；仅在"全模型两图均正确且压缩模型干净图正确"的配对上统计增量失效率。审计 3 个开源 8-9B VLM、4 个任务、8 个预注册偏移；比较两种免训练压缩器 DivPrune（硬剪枝）与 ApET（剪枝+合并），统一 25% 保留位置预算，共 708,000 条推理记录；另在独立重采样的第二份清单上复现，并做池化监控审计（AUROC 0.65 阈值）。

Result: 在全部 6 个"模型×压缩器"设置中，在偏移图上重选位置（而非沿用干净图位置）均提高失效率：DivPrune 提升 3.04–9.60 个百分点，ApET 提升 2.05–4.20 个百分点，所有 95% 区间均在零以上；第二份重采样清单完整复现全部 6 个提升。监控审计中，support Jaccard 不稳定性在 6 个设置中全部未达 AUROC 0.65 的实用阈值，而干净压缩模型不确定性全部达标。

Conclusion: 在所审计的基准混合下，support turnover 是较弱的排序信号，干净压缩模型不确定性信息量显著更强。作者建议未来视觉 token 压缩评估在干净准确率与效率之外，同时报告条件可靠性。

Abstract: Visual-token compression is usually evaluated by clean accuracy and efficiency, but these averages do not reveal failures that compression introduces under an image shift where the uncompressed model stays correct. We introduce VTC-AUDIT, which estimates this incremental risk only on pairs where the full model is correct on both images and the compressed model is correct on the clean image. The four arms then cross two binary choices: which image selects the retained token positions, and which image supplies the visual features. We audit three open 8-9B vision-language models on four tasks and eight pre-specified shifts. We evaluate two training-free compressors---hard-pruning DivPrune and prune-and-merge ApET---at a matched 25% retained-position budget, producing 708,000 inference records. Reselecting positions on the shifted image, rather than reusing the clean-image positions, raises the failure rate in all six model-compressor settings. The increase is 3.04-9.60 percentage points for DivPrune and 2.05-4.20 percentage points for ApET, with every 95% interval above zero. Repeating the audit on a separately resampled second manifest reproduces all six increases. In a pooled monitor audit across the four benchmarks, support Jaccard instability fails the practical AUROC criterion of 0.65 in all six settings, whereas clean compressed-model uncertainty clears it. Thus, support turnover is a weak ranking signal under the audited benchmark mixture, while clean compressed-model uncertainty is substantially more informative. These results suggest that future visual-token compression evaluations should report conditional reliability alongside clean accuracy and efficiency.

</details>


### [722] [Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34520v1)
*Federico Felizzi,Francesco Andrea Causio,Bianca Destro Castaniti,Olivia Riccomi,Michele Ferramola,Vittorio De Vita,Alessandro Tosi,Antonio Cristiano,Alessia Longo,Lorenzo De Mori,Chiara Battipaglia,Melissa Sawaya,Luigi De Angelis,Marcello Di Pumpo,Alessandra Piscitelli,Pietro Eric Risuleo,Giulia Vojvodic,Mariapia Vassalli,Nicolo Scarsi,Manuel Del Medico*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文检验视觉语言模型在医学问答中"无图像也给出诊断"时，其答案的**坚定程度**是否能作为"是否真正依赖图像"的可检测信号。结论：不能——凭空诊断与基于图像诊断的答案同样"稳固"，且所有可被用户观察到的置信类信号都无法区分二者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作发现视觉语言模型在医学问答中即使图像被空白占位符替换，仍能仅凭临床病例描述得出正确诊断（即"无缝绕行"图像）。作者追问：这种"无依据诊断"是否可从模型**持答案的坚定性**上被识别出来？换言之，一个基于空白图像得出的判断，是否会比基于真实图像的判断更容易在对抗压力下被推翻——若能，则答案稳定性可作为"grounding（证据接地）检测器"。

Method: 在 60 道意大利国家医师资格考试（State Examination）题目上，采用 2×2 析因设计：图像条件（真实医学图像 vs. 空白占位符）× 两种强度/性质的对抗压力（L1"无内容质疑"、L4"伪造共识"）。进行配对的项目层面分析，统计首次翻转率、首次翻转是否精确指向被施压选项、十轮对话中的判决变化次数、弃答率与图像缺失提示率，并对比两种压力下的"动态学"差异及其与题目内在歧义度的关系。

Result: 未发现无依据判断更脆弱的证据：L4 下真实图像翻转为 94.4%、空白图像 98.1%（Δ=+0.037；单侧 95% 上界 +0.105）；L1 下为 62.5% 与 51.8%（Δ=−0.107，95% CI [−0.209, −0.001]），点估计方向与"接地检测器"所需方向相反。两者动态截然不同：L4 下模型仅翻转一次且总指向被论证的选项（首轮翻转 110/110），随后冻结，十轮平均仅 1.9 次判决变化；L1 下则始终不收敛，平均 7.4 次变化。L1 下的不稳定性追踪的是题目内在歧义度而非证据可得性；翻转几乎全为破坏性的（合计 99/100）。模型并非"未察觉"证据缺失——基线时在 35/60 题上提示空白图像、4–6 题弃答——但这些弃答在压力下全部失守。

Conclusion: 答案坚定性不构成证据接地的信号。用户可能想到的所有"认识论信号"（是否提示缺图、是否弃答、答案是否易被动摇）都无法把有图像依据的诊断与凭空编造（confabulated）的诊断区分开。这提示医学视觉问答系统的可靠性评估与用户交互界面设计不能依赖这类表面信号。

Abstract: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($Δ= +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($Δ= -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. The two levels nonetheless produce opposite \emph{dynamics}: under L4 the model flips once, always to the exact option argued for (110/110 first-turn flips), and then freezes, averaging 1.9 verdict changes over ten turns; under L1 it never settles, averaging 7.4 changes. Instability under contentless doubt tracks intrinsic item ambiguity rather than evidence availability, and so does not serve as a grounding signal. Flips are almost entirely corrupting (99/100 across both levels). The model is not unaware of the missing evidence---it flags the blank image at baseline on 35 of 60 items and abstains on 4--6---yet those abstentions do not survive contact with pressure. None of the epistemic signals a user could plausibly consult distinguishes a grounded diagnosis from a confabulated one.

</details>


### [723] [PhysCreator: Creating Physically-Attributed 3D Assets at Will](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34473v1)
*Shiyan Zheng,Ming Li,Lei Han,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysCreator：从图像前馈生成可直接仿真的3D资产，在统一的体素对齐隐空间中联合建模几何、外观与空间变化的物理属性，并借助视觉-语言蒸馏获得无需稠密物理标注的体素级监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像到3D生成的表征本质是静态的，无法建模动态交互下的物理合理行为；已有物理属性预测方法要么将其作为事后简单预测，要么依赖昂贵的逐实例优化，且缺乏稠密物理真值标注，难以规模化学习。

Method: 提出统一框架PhysCreator：将图像观测提升为空间结构化的3D表征，构建体素对齐隐空间，以单次前馈方式联合推断几何、外观与物理属性；并利用视觉-语言模型的材质语义先验进行蒸馏，转化为空间落地的体素级监督，替代稠密物理标注。

Result: 实验表明，与已有方法相比，该方法在视觉质量、物理合理性和泛化能力上均取得更优表现。

Conclusion: 将物理属性估计重构进统一3D表征学习、配合VLM蒸馏的体素级监督，可有效实现无需逐实例优化、可直接用于仿真的3D资产生成。

Abstract: Significant advancements in 3D asset creation have enabled high-fidelity 3D generation from images. However, most existing representations remain inherently static, lacking the ability to model physically plausible behaviors under dynamic interactions. We present \textbf{PhysCreator}, a unified framework that directly generates simulation-ready 3D representations with spatially varying physical properties from images. Unlike prior approaches that treat physical attributes as simple post-hoc predictions or rely on expensive per-instance optimization, we reformulate physical property estimation within a unified 3D representation learning framework. We introduce a voxel-aligned latent space by lifting image observations into a spatially structured 3D representation, in which geometry, appearance, and physical properties are jointly modeled and inferred in a feed-forward manner. To enable scalable learning without densely annotated physical ground truth, we leverage vision-language distillation to transfer material-aware semantic priors from powerful vision-language models into spatially grounded voxel-level supervision. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior visual quality, physical plausibility, and generalization compared to prior approaches.

</details>


### [724] [Task Relevance-Driven Prompt Expansion for Federated Continual Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34461v1)
*Jiahua Dong,Wenqi Liang,Yang Cong,Yichen Li,Hongyuan Yu,Henghui Ding,Yulun Zhang,Salman Khan,Fahad Shahbaz Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出任务相关性驱动的提示扩展模型TRPE，解决联邦持续学习中新任务先验未知与任务间语义关系利用不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦持续学习(FCL)方法多假设全局服务器已知新任务的到达时间与类别数量，现实中不成立；同时忽视任务间正向语义关系、受旧任务无关关系干扰，加剧灾难性遗忘。

Method: 1) 本地客户端用分布外(OOD)检测器识别新任务到达；代理服务器用半径自适应DBSCAN推断新任务类别数，摆脱先验依赖。2) 计算新任务原始梯度与其在旧任务特征空间正交方向上梯度的亲和度，从全局视角评估新旧任务语义相关性；据此确定新任务的关键提示对(key-prompt pair)并识别高相关旧任务，拼接二者提示进行训练。3) 对本地key与prompt梯度施加软正交约束，平衡新任务学习与旧任务遗忘。

Result: 在多种数据集与骨干网络上开展实验，验证了TRPE模型的有效性。

Conclusion: TRPE通过无先验的任务到达/类别数推断与全局任务相关性驱动的提示扩展，有效利用正向跨任务关系并缓解灾难性遗忘。

Abstract: Federated continual learning (FCL) has attracted considerable interest by enabling local clients to continually acquire knowledge from new tasks. However, most FCL methods assume that the global server has prior knowledge of the arrival times and number of categories for new tasks, which is unrealistic in the real world. Furthermore, they neglect the importance of positive inter-task semantic relationships when learning new tasks and are significantly affected by irrelevant relationships from old tasks, thereby exacerbating catastrophic forgetting. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Task Relevance-driven Prompt Expansion (TRPE) model. Specifically, to eliminate the reliance on prior knowledge of new tasks, we propose an out-of-distribution detector to identify the arrival of new tasks within local clients, along with a radius-adaptive DBSCAN to infer the quantity of categories in new tasks on the proxy server. Moreover, to explore positive inter-task relationships, we calculate the affinity between the original gradient for learning new task and its gradient orthogonal to the feature space of old tasks to evaluate semantic relevance between old and new tasks from a global perspective. Then, we use this global task relevance to determine the key-prompt pair for new tasks and identify highly related old tasks. After concatenating their prompts for training, we can leverage such positive inter-task relations to improve the continual learning of newly arriving tasks. To balance the learning of new tasks and the forgetting of old ones, a soft orthogonality constraint is applied to the local key and prompt gradients. Experiments spanning diverse datasets and backbones confirm the efficacy of our TRPE model.

</details>


### [725] [On Detection Reliability for Small Object Segmentation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34432v1)
*Olivier Rukundo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文验证了“是否可直接用检测器预测框限定小目标分割范围”这一问题：以腺病毒颗粒为小目标，发现约11.27%的匹配分割质心落在所有预测框之外，因此仅在预测框内做分割会带来漏检风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测器预测框常被用于裁剪/限定分割区域以降低计算量，但对小目标而言，该方法是否会造成框外真目标被漏掉（假阴性）缺乏实证检验。作者希望验证预测框作为分割区域约束的可靠性。

Method: 以腺病毒颗粒为小目标；检测用YOLO26x，分割用YOLO26x-Sem，Mask R-CNN同时承担检测与分割作对照。将分割模型预测掩码以质心与真值掩码（优先采用真值掩码质心而非真值框质心）进行匹配，并判定匹配到的预测掩码质心是否落在至少一个检测预测框内；未匹配到预测的真值掩码记为“无匹配分割”。

Result: YOLO26系列：34个参考目标（47.89%）的匹配分割质心位于至少一个预测框内，8个（11.27%）落在所有预测框之外，29个（40.85%）无匹配分割。Mask R-CNN：对应为69（97.18%）、0（0.00%）、2（2.82%）。

Conclusion: 初步实验表明，将分割限制在检测器预测框内会排除框外的有效分割预测，可能引入假阴性；对小目标分割不宜简单以预测框作为区域约束，需结合分割分支的全图推理或扩大搜索区域。

Abstract: This study investigates whether predicted bounding boxes are reliable for determining where small-object segmentation should be performed without risking false negatives outside those boxes. The investigation leverages adenovirus particles as small objects, YOLO26x for detection, YO-LO26x-Sem for segmentation, and Mask R-CNN for both detection and segmentation. Segmenta-tion-model predictions were matched to ground-truth adenovirus masks or reference objects using their centroids, with ground-truth mask centroids preferred over ground-truth bounding-box centroids as references for matching. Matched predicted-mask centroids were considered as inside at least one detector-predicted bounding box or outside all such boxes, while ground-truth masks without matched predictions were recorded as having no matched segmentation. For the YOLO26 models, 34 reference objects (47.89%) had matched segmentation centroids inside at least one pre-dicted box, 8 (11.27%) had centroids outside all predicted boxes, and 29 (40.85%) had no matched predicted segmentation. For the Mask R-CNN model, the corresponding counts were 69 (97.18%), 0 (0.00%), and 2 (2.82%). These preliminary experiments demonstrated that restricting segmentation to detector-predicted bounding boxes risks excluding matched segmentation predictions outside those boxes, potentially introducing false negatives.

</details>


### [726] [No Cones, No Duals: A Fast and Scalable Solver for NRSfM](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34403v1)
*Suryansh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种快速、可扩展的非刚性结构从运动（NRSfM）求解器，用可微欧氏校正与展开谱近端求解器替代昂贵的SDP锥求解与ADMM交替优化，在保持竞争力的重建精度下实现显著加速（稠密序列7x-1000x）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高性能形状空间分解式NRSfM方法依赖两个昂贵环节：用于欧氏校正的半定规划（SDP）锥求解器，以及用于恢复低秩形状的ADMM求解器。二者在长序列与稠密点轨迹上扩展性差、耗时高。作者希望在不损失几何约束与精度的前提下消除这些瓶颈。

Method: 1) 旋转估计：提出可微欧氏校正，直接对每条序列优化小型因子，再用行极投影（row-polar projection）将每个相机块映射到最近的行正交矩阵；2) 形状估计：提出展开的谱近端求解器，在重排后的形状域中结合重投影梯度步与加权奇异值收缩，并引入FISTA式重启与延拓策略；将经典谱收缩算子嵌入固定可微求解器，同时保持NRSfM几何约束。方法类别无关、无需外部训练数据，且可映射到加速器友好的线性代数原语。

Result: 在稀疏、稠密、含噪、缺失数据及长序列基准上，该求解器取得显著加速且重建精度具竞争力；在包含28,887条跟踪点的稠密序列上运行时改进达7倍至1000倍。

Conclusion: 通过可微欧氏校正与展开谱近端求解替代SDP与ADMM，可在保持形状空间分解框架几何约束与精度的同时大幅提升NRSfM的可扩展性，为长序列、稠密轨迹场景提供实用方案。

Abstract: Non-rigid structure from motion (NRSfM) aims to recover camera motion and time-varying 3D shape from tracked 2D image measurements. Recent high-performing methods show that shape-space factorization remains highly effective for this task. These methods often use costly solvers for two key steps. First, a semidefinite programming (SDP) cone solver to perform Euclidean correction. Next, an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) solver to recover the low-rank shape. These steps often scale poorly to long sequences and dense point tracks. We propose a fast, scalable NRSfM solver that avoids these costly steps. For rotation estimation, we introduce a differentiable Euclidean correction that directly optimizes small factors for each sequence. A row-polar projection then maps each estimated camera block to the closest row-orthonormal matrix. For shape estimation, we introduce an unrolled spectral-proximal solver. It combines reprojection-gradient steps with weighted singular-value shrinkage in the reshuffled shape domain. This solver further uses FISTA-style restart and continuation. The spectral shrinkage operator itself is classical, but we embed it in a fixed differentiable solver, while preserving NRSfM's geometric constraints. The proposed approach is category-agnostic, requires no external training data, and maps naturally to modern accelerator-friendly linear algebra primitives. Across sparse, dense, noisy, missing-data, and long-sequence benchmarks, our solver achieves substantial speedups with competitive reconstruction accuracy, including 7x-1000x runtime improvements on dense sequences with 28,887 tracked points.

</details>


### [727] [A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34352v1)
*Shahid Rasheed,Muhammad Rashid,Seifedine Kadry,Salman A. AlQahtani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种非插值虚拟网格(NVHT)算子，用给定方形图像上的滤波核直接实现六边形像素表示下的特征提取，无需变换或插值，降低计算与存储开销并提高乳腺癌分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统医学图像特征分析方法在斜对角方向模式最优性、计算效率和特征缓冲区存储方面存在不足；经典算子（如图像卷积、梯度分析）复杂度高，需要高效硬件支撑，且六边形网格分析通常依赖从方形网格到六边形网格的变换与插值，代价较大。

Method: 设计非插值虚拟网格(NVHT)算子：在同一幅方形图像的同一方形区域上直接施加滤波核，不进行图像变换，也不插值到六边形网格，从而以六边形像素表示获得多方向响应。

Result: 该方法在降低计算成本与存储开销方面表现高效，特征提取效率与疾病分类准确率均有提升；相比传统方法，在保持各方向高灵敏度的同时所需存储更少。

Conclusion: NVHT算子可在不进行网格变换与插值的条件下获得六边形采样的多方向优势，兼顾计算/存储效率与分类性能，适用于乳腺癌等医学图像分类任务。

Abstract: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.

</details>


### [728] [Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoders via Localized Hebbian Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34346v1)
*Robin Koç,Hazal Moğultay Özcan,Fatoş T. Yarman Vural*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 S-LooM，一种空间感知的自组织图自编码器，用空间互相关与可学习空间核建立特征图间的动态连接，替代标量消息传递，并以最近邻上采样和软混合训练课程提升训练稳定性与潜拓扑质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期基于 Hebbian 可塑性的动态自组织自编码器依赖全局平均池化与标量连接，未能充分利用输入图像中的空间信息；且损失函数与训练动态的突变会引发表征冲击，导致特征学习不稳定。

Method: 1) 利用空间互相关与空间核在卷积特征图之间建立动态连接；2) 以可学习空间核替代自编码器中静态标量消息传递；3) 解码器采用最近邻上采样以消除高频反卷积伪影；4) 采用软混合（soft-blending）训练课程，使潜拓扑在训练中平滑对齐。

Result: 与当前先进的动态架构相比，S-LooM 得到更稳定的拓扑结构；涌现的图结构对特征纠缠与噪声更具鲁棒性，即使在高连接密度下也能形成负责光照、形状、纹理等视觉属性的功能社区。

Conclusion: 空间感知的动态连接设计与平滑的训练课程可有效缓解自组织自编码器的结构性瓶颈，获得更稳定、语义可解释的潜图拓扑。

Abstract: Traditional autoencoders rely on static network architectures to learn latent representations. Recently we suggested a dynamic architecture inspired by Hebbian plasticity, enabling topological self-organization among convolutional feature maps (R. Koç et al., Proceedings of the SIU, 2026). Early implementations of this paradigm infer relationships among feature maps using global average pooling and model their interactions through scalar-valued connections. This approach falls short to fully exploit the underlying spatial information, embedded in input images. Furthermore, abrupt transitions between different loss functions and training dynamics can introduce representation shocks, leading to unstable feature learning. In this paper, we introduce a Spatially-Aware Self-Organizing Graph Autoencoder (S-LooM) to address these structural bottlenecks. By using spatial cross-correlation, and spatial kernels, S-LooM establishes dynamic connections among feature maps. We replace static scalar message passing of autoencoders with learnable spatial kernels and eliminate high-frequency deconvolutional artifacts observed in decoders using nearest-neighbor upsampling. Via a soft-blending training curriculum, the latent topology aligns smoothly during training. Our experiments show that S-LooM yields a more stable topology, compared to the state of the art dynamic architectures. Meaning, the graph structure that emerge has more resistance to feature entanglement and noise. It forms functional communities responsible for visual attributes, such as illumination, shape and texture even under high connection densities.

</details>


### [729] [Birth-Death Structural Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34344v1)
*Quan Tran Hong,Long Nguyen-Chi,Binh T. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“一阶变分出生-死亡控制”（first-variation birth-death control），用重建损失关于辅助质量坐标的变分得分替代3DGS中基于代理信号的启发式密度控制，显著提升紧预算下的重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS的克隆/分裂/剪枝依赖位置梯度、不透明度、图像空间误差等代理信号，虽实践有效，但并未直接回答密度控制的结构性问题：新高斯应分配到何处才能降低多视角重建损失，哪些现有基元可在最小惩罚下被剪枝。

Method: 在每次结构更新时冻结当前高斯集合，为每个基元附加辅助“质量坐标”，对多视角损失关于该坐标求导，得到变分得分。作者证明该得分是Splat Regression Model一阶变分的坐标，从而构成出生-死亡操作的严格局部下降代理：高分高斯作为出生位置，低分且低不透明度高斯被移除。该得分被集成进3DGS-MCMC框架。

Result: 在标准3DGS基准上，集成该得分后达到state-of-the-art的重建质量，优于现有方法，且在紧高斯预算下增益最显著。

Conclusion: 基于梯度的变分度量可作为3DGS中代理启发式原则性替代方案，为密度控制提供有理论依据的结构决策准则。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a standard representation for real-time novel-view synthesis. Yet, its quality-efficiency trade-off still relies heavily on adaptive density control. Existing cloning, splitting, and pruning rules use proxy signals, such as position gradients, opacity, and image-space error. Although effective in practice, these signals do not directly answer the structural question behind density control: where should new Gaussians be allocated to reduce the multi-view reconstruction loss, and which existing primitives can be pruned with minimal penalty. To address this, we propose first-variation birth-death control for 3DGS, a principled approach that replaces heuristic structural decisions with a variational score derived from the reconstruction loss. At each structural update, we freeze the current Gaussian population, attach auxiliary mass coordinates to each primitive, and differentiate the multiview loss with respect to these coordinates. We demonstrate that this score is a coordinate of the first variation of the Splat Regression Model, giving a rigorous local descent surrogate for birth-death moves: high-score Gaussians are selected as birth sites, while low-score, low-opacity Gaussians are selected for removal. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, integrating this score into 3DGS-MCMC yields state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and outperforms existing methods, delivering the most significant gains under tight Gaussian budgets. Ultimately, our work provides compelling evidence that gradient-based variational metrics offer a principled alternative to proxy heuristics in 3DGS.

</details>


### [730] [CrossPair: Unlocking Generalist Visual Transformation Learning in Image Editors](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34333v1)
*Yibo Zhao,Lifan Jiang,Senlin cheng,Tianrun Wu,Bolei Xu,Xiaobo Li,Can Ye,Xiaofei He,Dehai Zhao,Boxi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CrossPair，将预训练多模态图像编辑模型改造为可从单个"前-后"示例对中迁移多样变换的统一框架；通过为示例前图、示例后图与查询图分配固定角色（VLM 提取操作语义、VAE 保留细节外观与结构），并引入仅训练期使用的 change-aware DINOv3 目标对齐跨场景的特征变化方向，实现无需推理期编码器的示例驱动图像变换迁移；同时构建 Transform-360K 数据集，在未见变换上取得优于现有系统的目标一致性与编辑方向相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型可由示例演示切换任务，而视觉领域仍依赖修复、编辑、风格化等彼此分离的系统。示例对之所以能作为共享指令，前提是可迁移的"变化"能与演示它的具体场景解耦。现有方法缺乏将变换语义从示例内容中剥离并迁移到新查询图像的机制，因此作者希望用单一模型统一实现基于示例对的多种变换迁移。

Method: 1）改造预训练多模态图像编辑器：示例前图、示例后图、查询图在原生 VLM 与 VAE 双通路中承担固定角色，VLM 负责抽取操作语义，VAE 负责保留精细外观与结构；2）设计仅训练期使用的 change-aware DINOv3 目标，跨内容不同的场景对齐特征变化方向，引导输出遵循示例所示关系，推理时无需额外编码器；3）构建 Transform-360K 数据集，按共享变换对来自条件生成表示、图像修复、图像编辑、虚拟试穿与风格化的过滤图像对进行分组。

Result: 在 Relation252K 派生的已见与留出变换上，CrossPair 的目标一致性与编辑方向相似度均优于已发布系统；消融实验表明语义路径与视觉示例路径互补，DINO 关系对齐可进一步增强迁移效果；使用 Transform-360K 训练还能提升留出操作的整体聚合得分。

Conclusion: 以示例对为统一指令、将语义抽取与外观保持解耦并在训练期施加关系级变化对齐，是可行且有效的示例驱动图像变换迁移范式；配套的大规模分组数据集进一步提升了模型对未见操作的泛化能力。

Abstract: Language models switch tasks from demonstrations, but vision still often relies on separate systems for restoration, editing, and stylization. A before--after example offers a shared instruction only if the transferable change can be separated from the scene that demonstrates it. We introduce CrossPair, which adapts a pretrained multimodal image editor to transfer diverse transformations from one exemplar pair. Exemplar-before, exemplar-after, and query images take fixed roles in its native VLM and VAE pathways: the VLM extracts operation semantics, while the VAE retains fine appearance and structure. A training-only, change-aware DINOv3 objective aligns feature-change directions across content-distinct scenes, guiding the output to follow the demonstrated relation without an inference-time encoder. We construct Transform-360K by grouping filtered pairs from conditional representations, restoration, editing, virtual try-on, and stylization under shared transformations. On Relation252K-derived seen and held-out transformations, \method improves target agreement and edit-direction similarity over released systems. Ablations show that the semantic and visual exemplar routes are complementary and that DINO relation alignment further strengthens transfer; Transform-360K training also improves aggregate held-out-operation scores.

</details>


### [731] [TopX: Text-to-Motion for Unseen Skeletons from the Skeleton File Alone](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34321v2)
*Tengjiao Sun,Pengcheng Fang,Xiaoyu Zhan,Dongjie Fu,Xiaohao Cai,Hansung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TopX：一个73M参数的流匹配Transformer，直接从骨架文件（运动学树、静止姿态、关节名）出发为训练中未见过的骨架生成文本到动作的关节旋转与根轨迹，无需角色片段、模板、重定向或微调；并构建SkelShift基准以隔离不同类型的骨架偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到动作模型只对训练时的骨架生成动作，而新角色通常只以一个骨架文件形式到来。作者研究在无角色动作片段、无模板、无重定向、无微调的条件下，对训练中未见骨架的文本到动作生成。

Method: 提出TopX：流匹配Transformer，输出关节旋转与根轨迹。用静止姿态与骨架尺寸归一化动作；静止姿态编码为与绑定时关节朝向无关的世界坐标描述子，训练时随机化静止约定。注意力在关节维与帧维上分解：关节维采用HK-RoPE（骨架图的热核旋转编码，对任意树定义，且与关节顺序和拉普拉斯特征基无关），帧维采用帧序旋转编码。同时构建SkelShift基准，将四个动作语料统一于同一编解码器下，留出整副骨架、树类别与物种，使各测试桶隔离一种骨架偏移（拓扑、关节数、体型、物种或绑定来源），并使用非学习型指标评估动作质量。

Result: 单一模型直接依据骨架文件驱动所有基准骨架（4–117个关节），可生成多达240帧。在留出的游戏物种上，其动作与真实片段的接近程度约等于真实片段两半之间的接近程度（核距离0.127 对 0.124）；文本到动作检索R@1达0.953，高于真实动作的0.929。

Conclusion: 结果表明，借助静止姿态归一化、世界坐标静止姿态描述子与基于骨架图的HK-RoPE，单一流匹配模型可实现跨骨架的零样本文本驱动动作生成，泛化到未见拓扑、关节数与物种，性能接近真实动作水平。

Abstract: Text-to-motion models generate motion only for the skeletons they were trained on, while a new character arrives as a skeleton file and nothing else. We study text-to-motion for skeletons unseen in training, without clips of the character, templates, retargeting or fine-tuning. We present TopX, a 73M-parameter flow-matching transformer that generates joint rotations and a root trajectory for any skeleton from its kinematic tree, rest pose and joint names. Motion is normalised by the rest pose and the size of the skeleton, and the rest pose is encoded as a world-frame descriptor that is independent of how the rig's author oriented each joint, while rest conventions are randomised during training. Attention is factorised over the joints and the frames of a motion. Across joints, queries and keys are rotated by HK-RoPE, a heat-kernel rotary encoding of the skeleton graph that is defined for every tree and does not change with the order of its joints or the eigenbasis of its Laplacian; across frames, they are rotated by a rotary encoding of frame order. To evaluate this generalisation, we build SkelShift, which unifies four motion corpora under one codec and holds out whole skeletons, tree classes and species, so that each test bucket isolates one kind of skeleton shift: topology, joint count, body plan, species or rig source. It scores motion quality without a learned evaluator. A single model animates every benchmark skeleton (4--117 joints) directly from its skeleton file and generates up to 240 frames. On held-out game species its motion is about as close to the real clips as two halves of the real clips are to each other (kernel distance 0.127 against 0.124), and text-to-motion retrieval reaches R@1 0.953, compared with 0.929 for real motion. Project page: https://chdtevior.github.io/TopX-page/.

</details>


### [732] [Learning Discriminative Prototypes via Boundary Repulsion MixUp for Object Re-Identification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34305v1)
*Athena Psalta,Vasileios Tsironis,Konstantinos Karantzalos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PBR-ReID原型框架，将类间几何（易混淆身份边界）作为显式学习目标，用原型相似度矩阵识别最易混淆身份对，并提出边界排斥MixUp（BRM）在可混淆对之间构造边界代理并将特征推离，配合原型预热+EMA联合微调的两阶段训练，在行人/车辆ReID基准上取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReID嵌入需对视角、光照、遮挡等类内变化鲁棒，同时保持视觉相似身份间的清晰分离。最难的错误恰好发生在易混淆身份交界处，而现有成对损失（pairwise losses）对该区域只是隐式塑造，缺乏显式监督。

Method: 1) 每个身份由可学习原型表示，与DiNOv3骨干联合优化；原型相似度矩阵在每步训练中揭示最易混淆身份对。2) 基于该信号构建边界排斥MixUp（BRM）：不在易混淆身份间插值样本（会模糊关键边界），而是在每个可混淆对上构造显式边界代理（boundary proxy），将双方特征推离该代理，把边界模糊性转化为判别信号。3) 两阶段训练：原型预热（prototype warmup）+ EMA稳定的联合微调。

Result: 在行人与车辆ReID基准上进行大量实验，表现强劲；消融实验证实各组件均有贡献。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将类间几何显式化（原型相似度驱动的边界排斥正则）是提升ReID判别性的有效途径，且可与DiNOv3骨干及EMA训练流程良好结合。

Abstract: Object re-identification requires embeddings that are robust to intra-class variation in viewpoint, illumination, and occlusion, yet preserve sharp separation between visually similar identities. The hardest errors arise precisely where confusable identities meet, a region that pairwise losses shape only implicitly. We present PBR-ReID, a prototype-based framework that makes this inter-class geometry an explicit learning target. Each identity is represented by a learnable prototype jointly optimized with a DiNOv3 backbone and the resulting prototype similarity matrix reveals, at every training step, which identities are most confusable. On this signal we build Boundary Repulsion MixUp (BRM), a geometry-aware regularizer that converts standard MixUp's weakness into a discriminative signal. Rather than interpolating samples across confusable identities, which blurs the boundaries that matter most, BRM constructs an explicit boundary proxy between each confusable pair and repels their features away from it, converting boundary ambiguity into a discriminative signal. We adopt a two-stage training protocol consisting of a prototype warmup phase followed by EMA-stabilized joint fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on person and vehicle ReID benchmarks demonstrate strong performance, with thorough ablations confirming each component's contribution. Code is available at https://github.com/psaltaath/pbr-reid.

</details>


### [733] [Real-Time Conveyor Belt Defect Detection via Edge TPU-Accelerated YOLOv11 on Raspberry Pi 5](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34304v1)
*Muhammad Nur Bijak Bestari,Mulki Indana Zulfa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出并在真实水泥厂现场验证了一套面向输送带缺陷检测的端到端低功耗边缘AI视觉系统：在Raspberry Pi 5 + Google Coral Edge TPU上部署经INT8全整数量化编译的YOLOv11n，实现30–40 FPS、端到端70–90 ms的实时检测，mAP@0.5达0.764。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输送带是水泥等重流程工业中连续物料输送的关键环节，纵向撕裂、孔洞、修补片退化、冲击穿孔等未检出的结构异常会导致断带、停机与安全事故。深度学习虽有高精度，但现有模型依赖高功耗工作站GPU，难以在偏远工业边缘点实际部署，因此需要低功耗、可现场落地的边缘AI方案。

Method: 采用优化的YOLOv11 nano架构，在超过3000张增强样本的多源工业数据（西爪哇某在运水泥厂数据、开源数据集、自动化采集图像）上训练，覆盖四类缺陷；随后进行训练后全整数量化（INT8）并编译为面向脉动阵列张量执行的格式；系统部署于Raspberry Pi 5并配Google Coral Edge TPU协处理器，封装于IP防护等级外壳内，通过RTSP PoE工业相机接入。

Result: 四类缺陷检测精确率0.742、召回率0.730、mAP@0.5为0.764；现场部署在320×320分辨率下达到30–40 FPS稳定吞吐，端到端延迟70–90 ms；在熟料粉尘恶劣环境下运行，主机CPU热平衡温度55±5 ℃、Edge TPU约65 ℃，丢帧为零。

Conclusion: 边缘AI可在低功耗、低成本硬件上弥合高精度计算机视觉与预测性维护之间的差距，为连续制造场景中的实用化预测性维护提供可行路径，验证了该系统在工业现场的鲁棒性与工程可部署性。

Abstract: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points.
