On DriveTransformer at a horizon of 2 seconds, ROC-AUC reaches 0.833 versus 0.715 for temporal consistency, with 2.67% readout runtime overhead. The trained probes also retain the ability to distinguish impending failures on new routes.

</details>


### [1003] [Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37284v1)
*Šimon Soldát,Václav Šmídl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述并统一了基于贝叶斯优化的模拟器贝叶斯推断方法，指出代理模型的响应变量选择是推断效率的主导因素，提出"代理变量"概念（对模拟器输出的信息保留型变换），显著提升仿真预算效率，并提供Julia软件包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对仿真器前向模型极其昂贵（仿真预算受限）的逆问题，现有文献碎片化、缺乏统一框架与系统性比较，且默认使用的标量对数似然响应变量可能损失关键信息、导致代理函数复杂度过高。

Method: 将现有基于贝叶斯优化的仿真器推断方法统一到一个通用框架中，识别主要设计选择并在仿真预算意义下进行系统性实证对比；进一步分析代理模型响应变量对建模函数复杂度的影响，提出将模拟器输出变换为信息更丰富、响应面更平滑的自定义代理变量。

Result: 实证表明推断效率通常由代理模型响应变量的选择主导；常用的标量对数似然是劣质响应变量，会丢弃关键信息；所提出的自定义代理变量在标准响应变量基础上大幅提升推断效率。

Conclusion: 响应变量设计应作为贝叶斯优化仿真器推断的核心设计维度；作者给出可操作的设计建议并提供数值稳健的Julia软件包，以促进该方法在仿真器逆问题中的实际应用。

Abstract: We present a survey of approaches to Bayesian inference with simulator forward models, focusing on settings with prohibitively expensive simulators. In this domain, Bayesian optimization-based methods have emerged as the most promising approach. We unify existing methods into a general framework, enabling consistent reasoning about shared algorithmic structure across the fragmented literature. Within this framework, we identify the primary design choices and perform a systematic empirical comparison of their effects on inference efficiency in terms of required simulation budget.
  A key result of our study is that inference efficiency is often dominated by the choice of surrogate-model response variable, as it directly governs the complexity of the modeled function. Specifically, we demonstrate that the prevalent scalar log-likelihood is a poor response variable, as it discards crucial information. Based on this insight, we introduce the concept of custom \emph{proxy variables}: transformations of simulator outputs engineered to retain more information and provide smoother response surfaces, substantially improving inference efficiency over standard response variables.
  We provide actionable guidance and a numerically robust Julia package to facilitate practical adoption of Bayesian optimization for simulator inverse problems.

</details>


### [1004] [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37276v1)
*Sichun Luo,Yi Huang,Mukai Li,Haochen Luo,Guanzhi Deng,Haibo Wang,Jian Xu,Zefa Hu,Junlan Feng,Qi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将评估预算拆分为"搜索期稀疏反馈 + 最终定向确认"，提出\method框架，在约半数评估单元下于多数设置中优于全量评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的智能体脚手架演化依赖迭代生成与评估，但评估同时承担"引导搜索"和"决定最终脚手架"两种角色；在每个候选上做全任务集评估的执行成本过高，因此需要研究如何在两种角色间分配评估预算。

Method: 实证分析发现稀疏反馈足以维持有效演化、额外定向评估可改善最终选择、共享信息性任务项与统一评分基准支撑近似候选间的比较。据此提出\method：先以一段全评估短预热建立共享信息性核心，并校准项目参数在搜索期固定的响应模型；搜索后用稀疏反馈引导演化；随后重拟合响应模型，并采用配对逐次减半（paired successive halving），复用已有观测、仅执行缺失评估。

Result: 在四个基准与两个演化框架上，\method在多数设置中平均性能高于全量评估，且评估单元用量约为其一半。

Conclusion: 评估预算可按角色差异化分配：搜索期稀疏、终选期定向，即可在显著降低评估成本的同时保持甚至提升脚手架演化效果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.

</details>


### [1005] [Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37255v2)
*Jian Mu,Ruibo Shen,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在KL正则化控制框架下，最优策略的对数几率会恢复出harness对每个动作的偏好，因此部署回报可分解为"harness天花板"减去"策略错配"。MiniWoB++实验显示反转观测字段顺序使成功率从85.0%降至19.2%；被固定模型比较拒绝但天花板更高的新harness在再训练后均超越原智能体，且天花板与错配可预测增益；Terminal-Bench Lite上"天花板减错配"复现准确率排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体通过harness（提示、工具与控制逻辑）进行后训练和部署，而harness的修订与评判通常依赖"已训练模型在该harness下的表现"，隐含假设模型在旧harness下学到的东西能迁移到新harness。作者质疑这一假设，希望厘清：策略究竟从其harness中学到了什么，harness改变后什么会保留下来。

Method: 从理论上，在KL正则化控制下证明最优策略的对数几率反映harness对各动作的偏好强度，将部署回报分解为"harness天花板（其能提供的最佳回报）"与"策略错配（自身次优决策导致的回报损失）"两项；训练只改变错配，更换harness则同时改变两项。实验上：在MiniWoB++中通过反转观测字段顺序构造最优决策不变的新harness；并在Terminal-Bench Lite的编码智能体harness上用更强模型估计最优值以计算天花板与错配。

Result: MiniWoB++中后训练使模型偏好特异于训练harness：仅在反转观测字段顺序（最优决策不变）的情况下，训练后模型的成功率从85.0%跌至19.2%。反之，所有被固定模型比较否决但天花板更高的新harness，在进一步训练后都优于原智能体；事先测得的天花板与错配能预测这些增益。Terminal-Bench Lite上，以更强模型近似最优所估计的"天花板减错配"能复现准确率排序，而单独任一项都不能。

Conclusion: harness比较不能只依赖固定模型的表现，因为这会混淆"harness提供了什么"与"模型利用得如何"。应以天花板与错配的分解来评估harness，并考虑在该harness下再训练后的潜在收益；该分解能预测改进并复现排序。代码已开源。

Abstract: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.

</details>


### [1006] [When Is a Relation Worth Trusting? Manipulation Costs, Exposure, and the Trust Trap in Multi-Relational Graph Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37239v1)
*Vincess Dongmo,Astride Melvin Fokam Ninyim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多关系图检测器中"何时使用某条关系反而比忽略它更糟"，基于攻击者对各关系的不同操纵代价，提出度门控（degree gating）严格优于对关系的任何选择或重加权，并证明该优势窗口是紧的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多关系图检测器从干净数据中学习对各关系的信任度，但忽略了攻击者操纵不同关系、不同动作的代价差异；缺乏理论刻画在何种条件下使用某关系会劣于弃用该关系，也缺乏指导平台"加固哪条关系"的可行准则。

Method: 以攻击代价为给定输入，证明度门控在"部分节点在该关系上被隔离且攻击者无力打开门控"时严格优于所有选择/重加权方案，且该窗口是紧的；提出逐节点暴露界（可推广至消息传递）与"单位代价暴露"指标来选择要加固的关系；并给出线性关系模型的精确最坏情形、R-GCN与树集成的认证上下界，以及对抗验证的有限样本保证。

Result: 真实图上，经校验的门控恰好在满足条件的那些关系上带来增益，其他关系上无增益；单位代价暴露指标在无攻击信息下选出的加固关系，在16例中有15例使精确陷阱阈值提升最大，而信息量、廉价性或等编辑代价分析至多7例；干净训练的图检测器在六张图、90个设定中有58个低于其无图对应版本；基于这些结果的选择协议从不显著劣于忽略图，关系数≤4时多为弃用（与仅用验证一致），其代价感知提议在关系较多时有效（目前仅在合成图上验证）。

Conclusion: 理论表明度门控的优势窗口存在且紧；单位代价暴露可作为无需攻击信息的加固优先级准则；在缺乏代价信息时，安全的选择是弃用图关系（abstain）。

Abstract: Multi-relational graph detectors learn from clean data how much to trust each relation, but an adversary pays a different price to manipulate each relation and each action; taking such costs as given, we ask when using a relation is worse than ignoring it. Our first main result proves that degree gating strictly beats every selection or reweighting of a relation when part of the population is isolated on it and the attacker cannot afford to open the gate, and that this window is sharp; on real graphs, validated gating gains exactly on the relations that meet these conditions and nowhere else. Our second shows that a per-node exposure bound, which extends to message passing, tells a platform which relation to harden: exposure per unit cost, computed without any attack, picks the relation whose hardening raises the exact trap threshold most in 15 of 16 cases, against at most 7 for informativeness, cheapness, or an analysis with equal edit costs. Supporting tools give exact worst cases for linear relational models, certified brackets for R-GCN and tree ensembles, and a finite-sample guarantee for adversarial validation, under which clean-trained graph detectors fall below their graph-free counterparts in 58 of 90 settings on six graphs. A selection protocol built on these results is never significantly worse than ignoring the graph; with at most four relations it mostly abstains, as validation alone would, and its cost-aware proposals help when relations are many, so far shown on synthetic graphs. Without cost information, the safe choice is to abstain.

</details>


### [1007] [Sharpness-Aware Muon: Matrix-Aware Optimization with Momentum-Guided Perturbations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37225v1)
*Zhiwei Zhai,Wenjing Yan,Ying-Jun Angela Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Muon仅塑造更新几何、未显式控制邻域最坏损失以偏向平坦区域，本文提出其锐度感知形式MuSAM，并进一步提出用归一化动量作扰动的MoMuSAM，在消除额外梯度计算的同时提升稳定性，实验验证锐度感知可稳定提升Muon。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon将动量与正交化结合，产生结构化更新方向且经验表现优异，但它只塑造更新本身几何，不显式控制邻域最坏情况损失、也不使训练偏向平坦区域，而这两者常与更强泛化相关。因此需要为Muon引入锐度感知机制。

Method: 先提出MuSAM：将SAM式扰动嵌入Muon的正交化更新，建立锐度感知训练与矩阵感知优化之间的原理性桥梁。进而指出该形式存在效率—稳定性张力：构造扰动需额外一次梯度评估，且扰动由单个minibatch梯度生成、噪声较大。为此提出MoMuSAM：将Muon的动量由更新变量转为锐度探测信号，以归一化动量作为扰动方向，从而省去额外的干净梯度计算，并用时间聚合的扰动替代单批次扰动代理。

Result: 理论上证明MuSAM与MoMuSAM达到相同的渐近一阶驻点阶数；进一步证明MoMuSAM相较MuSAM给出更稳定的随机线性化。标准基准实验表明，锐度感知一致地改进Muon。

Conclusion: 锐度感知的Muon形式化是可行且有效的：MuSAM提供了SAM与矩阵感知优化的理论连接，MoMuSAM通过动量复用兼顾效率与稳定性，并保持相同的收敛阶，实验上带来一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Muon is a matrix-aware optimizer that combines momentum with orthogonalization to produce structured update directions with strong empirical behavior. However, it only shapes the geometry of the update itself and does not explicitly control neighborhood worst-case loss or bias training toward flat regions, which are often linked to stronger generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce the sharpness-aware formulation of Muon. We first develop \textsc{MuSAM}, which incorporates Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)-style perturbation into Muon's orthogonalized update and establishes a principled bridge between sharpness-aware training and matrix-aware optimization. We then show that this formulation faces an efficiency--stability tension: constructing the perturbation requires an extra gradient evaluation, while the perturbation itself is generated from a single minibatch gradient and is therefore noisy. To resolve this issue, we propose \textsc{MoMuSAM}, which turns Muon's momentum from an update variable into a sharpness-probing signal. By using normalized momentum as the perturbation direction, \textsc{MoMuSAM} removes the extra clean-gradient computation and replaces the single-batch perturbation proxy with a temporally aggregated one. We prove that both \textsc{MuSAM} and \textsc{MoMuSAM} attain the same asymptotic first-order stationarity order, and further show that \textsc{MoMuSAM} yields a more stable stochastic linearization than \textsc{MuSAM}. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that sharpness awareness consistently improves Muon.

</details>


### [1008] [SimplexLoRA: Dynamic Rank Updating via Alternating Minimization with Simplex Projection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37206v1)
*Igor Shalygin,Grigorii Davydenko,Andrey Veprikov,Aleksey Antonov,Nikolay Bushkov,Stanislav Moiseev,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SimplexLoRA，通过在 n-单纯形上学习各适配器的重要性权重并在短预热后冻结，实现微调过程中自适应调整 LoRA 适配器秩，在不增加参数预算与推理成本的前提下提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 LoRA 在所有层使用固定秩，未考虑不同层/适配器的重要性差异，导致参数容量分配次优。

Method: 在短预热阶段于 n-缩放单纯形上优化每个适配器的重要性权重，随后冻结权重；据此动态调整各适配器秩（重分配容量），总参数预算与推理开销不变。

Result: 在 DeBERTaV3、BART-large、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3-8B 上覆盖 12 项语言理解、摘要与推理任务，SimplexLoRA 稳定持平或优于标准 LoRA 及近期自适应基线，低秩设置下增益最大。

Conclusion: 按学习到的重要性自适应分配适配器秩是一种低成本且有效的 LoRA 改进方向，尤其适用于低秩场景。

Abstract: The success of large language models in real-world applications relies on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which inserts compact, trainable adapters into selected layers. In this paper, we propose SimplexLoRA, a LoRA variant that adaptively adjusts adapter ranks during fine-tuning based on their learned importance. Unlike standard LoRA, which employs a fixed rank across all layers, SimplexLoRA optimizes per-adapter importance weights on the $n$-scaled simplex during a short warm-up and then freezes them, dynamically allocating capacity where it is most beneficial without increasing the overall parameter budget or inference cost. We evaluate SimplexLoRA across 12 language understanding, summarization, and reasoning tasks using DeBERTaV3, BART-large, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen3-8B. Our results show that SimplexLoRA consistently matches or outperforms standard LoRA and recent adaptive baselines, with the largest gains at low ranks. Our code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SimplexLoRA.

</details>


### [1009] [Action-Value Calibration via Continuation Sharing for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37195v1)
*Yingjian Chen,Lang Zhou,Zixin Zhao,Pingfan Li,Weishi Zheng,Zhilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ConCal是一种递归续段价值估计方法，利用rollout批次中已存在的续段证据对动作价值进行校准，降低长程强化学习中对单个采样续段的依赖，提升信用分配质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体强化学习依赖交互序列反馈，单个动作的信用分配困难。GiGPO等方法通过比较共享状态下的动作计算相对优势，但每个动作价值仅由单条采样续段估计，所得局部信用对后续决策敏感，易产生失真。

Method: 提出ConCal递归续段价值估计器：按入边状态-动作-状态转移匹配同一任务内的多次访问；将共享续段证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合；再把校准后的价值反向传播以修正早期动作价值估计，全程无需额外rollout。

Result: 留出回报诊断显示，组内价值差误差更小，与参考动作排序的一致性更高。在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，ALFWorld与WebShop成功率分别较GiGPO提升3.39与5.86个百分点。

Conclusion: 复用批次内续段证据进行递归价值校准，可在不增加采样成本的前提下缓解局部信用失真，改善长程智能体的策略学习效果。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on feedback from sequences of interactions, making credit assignment to individual actions difficult. Existing methods such as GiGPO compare actions at shared states to compute relative advantages, but estimate each action's value from a single sampled continuation. The resulting local credit remains sensitive to decisions made later in the trajectory. To address this problem, we propose ConCal (Continuation Calibration), a recursive continuation-value estimator that incorporates continuation evidence already present in a rollout batch. ConCal matches visits from the same task by their incoming state-action-state transitions, combines shared continuation evidence with each visit's own transition estimate, and propagates calibrated values backward to refine earlier action-value estimates. This reduces dependence on individual sampled continuations and mitigates local credit distortions without additional rollouts. Held-out return diagnostics show lower error in within-group value differences and higher agreement with reference action orderings than estimates based on individual continuations. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal.

</details>


### [1010] [Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37733v1)
*Yaxuan Wu,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在多井地下水异常预测中，源域预训练（固定迁移）平均提分但对相当比例异构井有害；CASL以校准训练的受限上下文混合融合"无迁移"与"固定迁移"两个冻结父模型，可部分或完全修复受损井，但该修复部分源于凸混合的结构性效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习整体平均精度提升掩盖了井间异质性：固定迁移（Fixed TL）在大量井上反而劣于无迁移（No TL）。作者希望构建一种上下文感知的选择性迁移机制，在保留迁移收益的同时抑制其对个别井的负迁移风险，并严格界定结论边界。

Method: 提出Context-Aware Selective Learning（CASL）：以冻结的无迁移模型与固定迁移模型为双父模型，用校准集训练受限的上下文权重进行混合；对照基线Global Convex Blend仅用单一种子级校准权重做全局凸组合。任务设定要求连续9个月观测输入、精确3个日历月目标、禁止插值；评估覆盖457口井、13,718个测试窗口、5个预定义种子，源池为四格maxsim0.60并仅按Always-TL验证RMSE冻结。

Result: Fixed TL损害18.38–51.86%的井。CASL相对No TL降低RMSE 0.424–1.084%，对受损井的修复率为97.53–99.50%（部分修复）、23.46–43.78%（完全修复）。Global Convex Blend在4个种子中保护更多井，CASL在4个种子中合并RMSE略低。

Conclusion: 凸混合可结构性地产生"部分修复"，因此不能据此断言上下文机制优越。两种方法互不支配，结果支持在固定划分上存在"精度—风险权衡"，而不构成滚动部署有效性的证据。

Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

</details>


### [1011] [MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37175v1)
*Brian Ko,Han Wang,Hejia Geng,Li Erran Li,Sherry Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MLE-World是一个从Qwen3.5-4B微调得到的“世界模型”，可在不执行代码的情况下预测程序终端输出（错误栈、训练日志、验证分数）并给出置信度，从而以极低代价支持AI研究智能体的测试时扩展（TTS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI研究智能体每评估一个候选程序都要真实训练与评估ML模型，成本高，严重限制了每步可探索的候选数量。预测一次只需一次推理调用而非一次训练，因此用世界模型替代真实执行可让TTS变得可行。

Method: 基于Qwen3.5-4B微调出MLE-World，输入为程序代码与数据描述，输出为预测的终端输出及置信度分数；在此基础上设计五种由世界模型引导的TTS策略：顺序修订、Best-of-N、成对评判、融合，以及加入置信度探索奖励的UCB式规则；仅当置信度低时才真实执行该候选。

Result: 在17个MLE-bench Lite任务上，MLE-World对留出程序的终端输出预测准确率达77.9%，而更大规模的提示模型仅为41.1%；世界模型引导的TTS使观测平均性能最高提升22.1%，且真实执行次数更少。

Conclusion: 小型微调世界模型能以低成本、较高保真度近似程序执行结果，配合置信度门控的真实校验，可在降低真实训练开销的同时显著提升智能体的搜索与优化效果。

Abstract: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program's terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction's correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of-N, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. Since predictions can be wrong, we run a candidate for real only when its confidence score is low. On 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks, MLE-World matches the real terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs, versus 41.1% for much larger prompted models. MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution. Project webpage: https://mle-world.github.io/.

</details>


### [1012] [Physics-Guided Flow Matching: A Generative AI Framework for Global Total Electron Content Forecasting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37159v1)
*Si-Tong Yang,Feng Ye,Xian Lu,Dong Lin,Benjamin C. Martinez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出融合偏微分方程物理约束的流匹配生成式AI框架，用于提前一天全球TEC预报，精度优于统计、深度学习与生成式基准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球总电子含量（TEC）的准确预报对空间天气监测及卫星通信、导航系统可靠运行至关重要，需提升现有预报方法的时空精度。

Method: 基于流匹配（flow matching）的物理引导生成式AI框架，将电离层动力学PDE嵌入由初始分布到目标分布的变换过程，用物理知识引导样本演化；同时结合数据中的统计模式，并逐位置自适应调整物理项与统计项的相对贡献权重。数据为一年的TIEGCM模拟全球TEC。

Result: 在所有预报时效和全部纬度上，时空精度均优于统计、深度学习和生成式AI代表基准；平均RMSE较ConvLSTM低39.2%，较去掉物理引导的同框架低23.8%；学习到的贡献权重随纬度与地理位置呈现系统性变化。

Conclusion: 显式物理引导可显著改善全球TEC的生成式预报，将物理动力学纳入生成式AI建模具有明确价值。

Abstract: Accurate forecasting of global total electron content (TEC) is important for space weather monitoring and the reliable operation of satellite communication and navigation systems. We propose a physics-guided generative artificial intelligence (AI) framework for day-ahead global TEC forecasting. The framework builds on flow matching, which learns to gradually transform samples from an initial distribution into new samples that share the statistical characteristics of the target data. The proposed model incorporates ionospheric dynamics described by a partial differential equation (PDE) into this transformation process, guiding the changes between initial and target samples using physical knowledge. The model further combines the physical dynamics with statistical patterns captured from data to learn this transformation, adaptively adjusting their relative contributions at each location. The model is trained and evaluated using one year of global TEC data generated by the Thermosphere Ionosphere Electrodynamics General Circulation Model (TIEGCM). The results demonstrate that our model improves both spatial and temporal forecasting accuracy over representative benchmarks, including statistical, deep learning, and generative AI methods at all lead times and across latitudes. The average root mean square error (RMSE) is 39.2% lower than that of ConvLSTM and 23.8% lower than that of the same framework without physical guidance. The learned contribution weights vary systematically with latitude and across geographic locations, showing how the physical contribution changes across the forecast domain. These findings demonstrate that explicit physical guidance improves generative forecasts of global TEC and highlight the value of incorporating physical dynamics into generative AI modeling.

</details>


### [1013] [Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37146v1)
*Ruoyu Wang,Xinyi Ye,Yunshuo Shi,Liangyu Yuan,Beier Zhu,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出变分控制框架，用共享的Jacobian回拉统一采样期引导与基于奖励的模型适配：由终端奖励最大化加路径KL惩罚出发，经Gibbs变分原理与Doob变换导出生成动力学的修正，得到状态空间中的VOG，并通过对端点蒸馏摊销为参数更新的DVOC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理期引导（sampling-time guidance）与基于奖励的模型适配（reward-based model adaptation）通常被当作两类独立技术，缺少统一的理论解释；作者希望用同一几何原理（Jacobian回拉）把二者联系起来。

Method: 从带路径空间KL惩罚的终端奖励最大化问题出发，用Gibbs变分原理和Doob变换给出生成动力学的修正项；再通过局部去噪近似显式给出把输出偏好传回受控变量的pullback。据此在状态空间构造VOG（通过去噪Jacobian作用），并通过把局部改进的端点蒸馏进模型参数，将VOG摊销为DVOC（参数回拉）。

Result: 理论上，在线性MMSE模型下VOG的精确修正位于数据子空间内；ImageNet上VOG把DiT-XL/2的FID从2.27降到2.04（250步），25步时从7.58降到4.44；Z-Image-Turbo上经20次更新，DVOC在HPSv3++及四个留出评测器得分上均优于未训练模型，并在所比较的训练方法中取得最高对应均值。

Conclusion: VOG与DVOC遵循同一局部变分规则，分别经由去噪Jacobian与端点蒸馏实现回拉，从而把推理期控制与奖励适配统一到一个共同的几何原理之下。

Abstract: We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback. Starting from terminal reward maximization with a path-space KL penalty, the Gibbs variational principle and Doob transform yield a correction to the generative dynamics. A local denoising approximation exposes the pullback that transports output preferences to the controlled variable. This construction gives Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG) in state space and extends to Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) by amortizing locally improved endpoints into model parameters. The resulting controls share a local variational rule: VOG acts through the denoising Jacobian, while DVOC realizes the parameter pullback by endpoint distillation. Under a linear MMSE model, VOG's exact correction lies in the data subspace. On ImageNet, VOG reduces DiT-XL/2 FID from 2.27 to 2.04 at 250 sampling steps and from 7.58 to 4.44 at 25 steps. After 20 updates on Z-Image-Turbo, DVOC improves HPSv3++ and four held-out evaluator scores over the untrained model, with the highest corresponding means among the trained methods compared. These results connect inference-time control and reward adaptation through a common geometric principle.

</details>


### [1014] [Beyond Parameter Protection: Fisher-Shaped EWC for Replay-Free Continual Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37145v1)
*Liying Wang,Simone Magistri,Joost van de Weijer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Fisher-Shaped EWC（FS-EWC），将 Fisher 信息矩阵的角色从"事后参数保护"扩展为"解的塑形"，通过最小化邻域内最坏情况下的经验 FIM 迹，并在任务结束时用基于轨迹的模型合并构造保留解，从而提升无回放持续学习的稳定—可塑性平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EWC 依赖在保留解处估计的 Fisher 信息矩阵来惩罚重要参数变化，但局部（单点）重要性估计无法刻画参数发生有限位移后的敏感性，因此需要控制解邻域内的 Fisher 敏感性。

Method: FS-EWC 在任务学习阶段将经验 FIM 迹在给定邻域上的最坏情况作为优化目标（min-max 形式），引导模型收敛到对有限未来位移不敏感的解；任务完成时，采用轨迹式模型合并（由多个优化中间状态而非单一终点迭代构造保留解），随后再估计 FIM 用于后续任务的巩固。

Result: 在多组基准实验上，FS-EWC 优于 EWC；受控实验表明其具有更有利的稳定性—可塑性权衡，且对参数漂移的容忍度更高。

Conclusion: 有效的知识保留既需要"在解的形成阶段就考虑未来保留"，也需要对已获得知识进行保护；二者结合才能提升持续学习中的抗遗忘能力。

Abstract: In replay-free continual learning, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) uses Fisher information matrix (FIM) to protect acquired knowledge by penalizing changes to historically important parameters. However, a local importance estimate at the retained solution does not in general characterize sensitivity after finite parameter displacement. This motivates controlling Fisher sensitivity over a neighborhood of potential future updates. We propose Fisher-Shaped EWC (FS-EWC), which extends the role of FIM from parameter protection to solution formation for future retention. During task learning, FS-EWC minimizes the worst-case empirical FIM trace within a prescribed neighborhood, explicitly favoring solutions that are less sensitive to bounded future displacement. At task completion, trajectory-based model merging constructs the retained solution from multiple optimization states rather than a single terminal iterate, after which FIM is estimated for subsequent consolidation. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that FS-EWC improves performance over EWC, while controlled studies indicate a more favorable stability--plasticity balance and greater tolerance to parameter drift. These results suggest that effective knowledge retention requires both forming solutions with future retention in mind and protecting acquired knowledge.

</details>


### [1015] [Generative Replay for Equilibrium Propagation: Toward Edge-Friendly Continual Learning in Hopfield Networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37139v1)
*Victor Cook,Gilles Sassatelli,Thierry Gil,Mohamed Watfa,Marina Reyboz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出能量驱动生成回放策略（EB-Gen），利用Hopfield网络内在的生成动力学实现无外部缓冲的持续学习，在类增量设置下缓解Equilibrium Propagation训练的灾难性遗忘，Split MNIST与Split CIFAR10上分别取得75%和64%的平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Equilibrium Propagation（EqProp）是训练Hopfield网络的一种生物合理、硬件友好的反向传播替代方案，但其在持续学习中的表现尚未被充分探索；而标准经验回放（ER）与生成回放（Gen-Replay）都需要外部数据缓冲或架构开销。

Method: 提出能量驱动的生成回放（EB-Gen）：利用Hopfield网络固有的生成动力学，使单一模型同时充当分类器与回放样本生成器；通过对网络的冻结副本进行弛豫（relaxation）产生携带旧任务知识的伪样本，从而仅依靠内部生成的伪数据完成排练，无需外部缓冲或额外架构。在类增量设置下，用Split MNIST与Split CIFAR10评测，并与FineTune、Experience Replay、Generative Replay、Sleep-Like Replay Consolidation（SRC）及Joint training对比。

Result: EB-Gen在保持可塑性的同时显著提升稳定性，在Split MNIST和Split CIFAR10上分别获得75%和64%的平均准确率。

Conclusion: Equilibrium Propagation可被改造以缓解灾难性遗忘，且不牺牲其原有的生物合理性与硬件对齐等优势。

Abstract: Equilibrium Propagation (EqProp) offers a biologically grounded and hardware-aligned alternative to backpropagation for training Hopfield Networks. However, its behavior in continual learning settings remains largely unexplored. This work confronts catastrophic forgetting in EqProp-trained Hopfield Networks from the inside out, eliminating the need for external data buffers or architectural overhead that standard Experience Replay \textbf{(ER)} and Generative Replay \textbf{(Gen-Replay)} inevitably require. We introduce an Energy-Based Generative Replay strategy \textbf{(EB-Gen)} which exploits the intrinsic generative dynamics of Hopfield Networks, allowing a single model to act as both classifier and replay samples generator. Samples capturing past task knowledge are generated by relaxing a frozen copy of the network, enabling rehearsal solely through internally generated pseudo-data. We evaluate the proposed method in the Class-Incremental setting, using the split versions of the MNIST and CIFAR10 benchmarks and compare it with FineTune, Experience Replay, Generative Replay, Sleep-Like Replay Consolidation (SRC) and Joint training. Our results show that EB-Gen significantly improves stability while preserving plasticity, achieving a 75\% and 64\% average accuracy on Split MNIST and Split CIFAR10 respectively. These findings show that Equilibrium Propagation can be adapted to alleviate catastrophic forgetting without forgoing the traits which made it compelling in the first place.

</details>


### [1016] [Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37126v1)
*Nabeelah Faumi,Deshan Sumanathilaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文用因子化剪枝实验证明准确率与困惑度等输出指标无法反映内部计算是否被破坏：GPT-2在幅度剪枝注意力头时电路归零，在神经元剪枝30%时电路符号反转，而困惑度反而误判为损伤更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 剪枝模型几乎只用准确率和困惑度评估，隐含假设"输出行为保持即内部计算保持"。作者要检验这一假设，并论证需要机制层面的补充评估手段。

Method: 在GPT-2上做因子化剪枝：重要性准则（幅度/随机）×组件类型（注意力头/MLP神经元）×稀疏度（3%/50%/70%）。以完整刻画的IOI（间接宾语识别）电路为真值，用激活补丁、路径补丁和直接logit归因测量电路完整性；并复现Greater-Than电路检验结论的可迁移性。

Result: 发现两种性质上不同的失效模式：(1) 幅度剪枝注意力头即令电路归零，面向输出的头被移除，准确率降至近随机；(2) 幅度剪枝神经元30%使电路"反转"——26个电路头全部完好，但Name Mover贡献符号翻转，模型系统性偏向错误名字（17.7%准确率），而困惑度（74.6 对 140.1）却判定其损伤小于随机剪头。Greater-Than电路复现表明关键组件类型取决于电路架构。

Conclusion: 输出指标与结构检查都可能漏检机制性损伤；应以电路级因果分析作为压缩语言模型评估的补充维度。

Abstract: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.

</details>


### [1017] [Self-Regularized Flow Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37115v1)
*Theodoros Kouzelis,Spyros Gidaris,Nikos Komodakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SERF自监督框架，利用去噪轨迹本身做噪声到干净的自蒸馏，提升连续扩散语言模型的训练效率与生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续流式/扩散语言模型的训练目标通常只依赖干净目标token的监督，去噪轨迹这一中间的丰富信号被浪费；且现有方法往往需外部预训练模型或改动推理流程。

Method: SERF采用噪声到干净的自蒸馏：EMA教师在同一插值路径上接收比学生更干净的输入，从而提供额外监督。两个变体：SERF-L对齐学生中间表示与更深层教师表示；SERF-P对齐输出token分布（在输出层或较早层）。仅作为标准目标的正则项，无需外部预训练模型，不改变推理。

Result: 在三种连续LM范式（one-hot FLM、潜空间ELF、超球面S-FLM）上均显著提升训练效率、生成质量与少步生成。OpenWebText上最高7.7倍墙钟训练加速；MAUVE提升24.3%；GSM8K准确率最高提升28.8%；采样步数最多减少64倍仍匹配基线。

Conclusion: 噪声到干净的自蒸馏是改进连续扩散语言模型的有效通用途径，可作为即插即用的自正则项兼容多种范式。

Abstract: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.

</details>


### [1018] [Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37727v1)
*Ioannis Konstantoulas,Iliana Loi,Kyriakos Sgarbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可微分的逻辑推理神经元模块——原生谓词神经元（Native Predicate Neuron），通过一阶逻辑量化将符号推理能力嵌入标准神经网络，并在多种架构与基准上实现更快收敛、更高精度与更低损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号推理方法多依赖静态架构，难以与深度神经网络及基于梯度的优化相融合，导致符号推理与神经网络之间存在集成鸿沟。

Method: 设计谓词神经元，用单一可训练参数学习在运算之间交替，从而建模关系型逻辑；采用"双重性质"的定制梯度机制：训练时执行硬逻辑运算，同时保持可反向传播的可微性；对输入与选择状态同时量化，使神经元能够逼近连续与非连续函数，从而缓解标准深度架构难以处理的函数不连续问题。模块可原生集成进全连接、卷积、循环与Transformer架构，并提供Keras与PyTorch实现。

Result: 在MNIST、Wikitext等基准上，于全连接、卷积、循环与Transformer四类架构中进行评测：加入谓词神经元普遍加快收敛、提升准确率并降低损失，在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务上改进尤为显著。

Conclusion: 谓词神经元能够原生集成到标准神经网络中，实现模糊逻辑运算，在保持梯度优化流程的同时赋予网络符号推理能力，并已开源为Keras与PyTorch模块。

Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

</details>


### [1019] [Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37726v1)
*Zeen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文针对神经偏微分方程发现中的中位数/样本标准差阈值选择，推导出精确的双信号保留边界与完整向量扰动界，并用有限诊断实验表明：即使系数回归到数值精度，阈值支持选择仍会丢失扩散项，真实支持重拟合与条件验证均无法自动纠正，需谨慎区分阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三类失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确回归不一定在支持选择后给出正确方程。作者希望量化“阈值式支持选择”在神经PDE发现中的失效机理，并区分其来源（阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤、评分拒绝），而非直接给出通用的自动纠正或恢复保证。

Method: 针对中位数/样本标准差阈值，理论推导精确的双信号保留边界与完整向量扰动界；构造平流-扩散精确库、40个稀疏状态的真支持重拟合、固定序贯阈值岭回归对照（60个理想对照）、条件验证与事后能量池化、4条未用解析轨迹上240次物理残差比较，以及固定系数/观测点/权重下精确替换学习库与目标的行序对比（60个状态），并测试Burgers扩散收益准则在各预算下加权损失的表现。

Result: 精确平流-扩散库虽系数恢复到数值精度仍丢失扩散；真支持重拟合降低扩散误差但未恢复全部导数精度；固定序贯阈值岭回归在60个理想对照中恢复精确支持，但在所有学习状态中选出多余项；全折正确支持候选被条件验证拒绝，事后能量池化在60个状态中均保留其更低的极小损失；供支持估计在240次物理残差比较中全部优于未改动的所选方程；精确替换学习库与目标使行序在59/60状态反转；加权两损失在每一测试预算下均未满足Burgers扩散收益准则。

Conclusion: 这些有限诊断可区分阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝，但不建立自动纠正，也不保证通用恢复或预测稳定性。

Abstract: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

</details>


### [1020] [On the Sparsity of Direct Preference Optimization: Weight Disentanglement in the NTK Regime](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37085v1)
*Kensuke Sasaki,Issei Sato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在NTK线性化框架下从理论上解释了DPO产生稀疏参数更新的现象，提出"双重稀疏性"概念：数据层面的稀疏性（由支持向量导致的稀疏线性组合）与参数层面的稀疏性（由于偏好/非偏好回答梯度相消导致的稀疏梯度特征），并证明了支持对数量的界、建立了双重稀疏性与权重解耦的联系，在GPT-2和多个7–9B模型上验证了结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期实证研究发现DPO会诱导出异常稀疏的参数更新，但此前缺乏对这一现象的理论解释。作者希望填补这一空白，并进一步探讨这种稀疏结构对模型合并等下游应用的潜在意义。

Method: 在神经正切核（NTK）线性化下分析DPO的优化动力学，指出DPO损失的logistic结构带来隐式最大间隔偏置；据此提出"双重稀疏性"概念，将更新方向分解为稀疏梯度特征向量的稀疏线性组合；在主要定理中形式化该结构，并用依赖间隔的谱量界定支持对数目；构建理论框架将双重稀疏性与权重解耦（weight disentanglement）相联系。实验在GPT-2 Small/Medium及Llama-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B上进行，使用Anthropic HH-RLHF与UltraFeedback数据集。

Result: 实验证实了数据层面和参数层面两种稀疏性来源的存在；GPT-2上的实验表明，相比监督微调（SFT），DPO可将跨任务干扰降低最多35倍。

Conclusion: DPO的稀疏更新源于隐式最大间隔偏置所导致的双重稀疏性，该结构可降低跨任务干扰并有利于权重解耦，为模型合并等应用提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has been widely adopted for aligning language models with human preferences. Recent empirical work has revealed that DPO induces remarkably sparse parameter updates, yet no theoretical explanation for this phenomenon has been offered. We analyze DPO's optimization dynamics under a neural tangent kernel linearization and show that the logistic structure of the DPO loss gives rise to an implicit maximum-margin bias. Building on this observation, we introduce the concept of dual sparsity: the DPO update direction is a sparse linear combination (data-level sparsity, driven by support vectors) of sparse gradient feature vectors (parameter-level sparsity, arising from gradient cancellation between preferred and dispreferred responses). We formalize this structure in our main theorem, bound the number of support pairs by a margin-dependent spectral quantity, and present a framework relating dual sparsity to weight disentanglement---a condition favorable for model merging. Experiments on GPT-2 Small and Medium and on 7--9B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B) with the Anthropic HH-RLHF and UltraFeedback datasets confirm both sources of sparsity, and experiments on GPT-2 show that DPO reduces cross-task interference by up to $35{\times}$ compared to supervised fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1021] [EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37062v1)
*Masato Fujitake*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出EnergyCal：一种轻量级规则，按路由专家有限步Newton-Schulz方向的归一化平方Frobenius范数来衰减专家更新，以抑制Muon族优化器训练稀疏MoE时的损失尖峰，在4B参数MoE模型上显著降低尖峰负担与困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE语言模型在使用Muon族优化器训练时会出现大幅损失尖峰（loss spikes），影响训练稳定性，需要一种不改变原有谱变换、不增加优化器持久状态的稳定化方法。

Method: 提出EnergyCal：依据路由专家更新方向的归一化平方Frobenius范数（即有限步Newton-Schulz方向的"能量"）对专家更新进行衰减。该规则保持谱变换不变，且不引入额外持久优化器状态，计算开销轻量。在4B参数MoE模型上，分别与开发集选出的低学习率MuonH配方以及等名义学习率与权重衰减下的plain Muon进行对比。

Result: 相较开发集选定的低学习率MuonH配方，EnergyCal-MuonH将平均阈值化损失尖峰负担降低99.51%，最终几何平均困惑度降低4.06%，仅有适度吞吐开销；在两种测试指数下，plain Muon（等名义学习率与权重衰减）的平均尖峰负担降低95.98%，并伴有小幅终点改进。

Conclusion: 在所评估的设定下，EnergyCal能同时在使用与不使用Hyperball（MuonH）的情形下有效稳定MoE训练，说明该稳定化策略对Muon族优化器具有较好的适用性与通用性。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [1022] [Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37058v1)
*Giuseppe Curci,Stefano Simonazzi,Andrea Molinari,Andrea Zugarini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从理论与实证两方面揭示：固定模型对做"delta-learning"式偏好数据会引入与生成器相关的系统性偏差，使该偏差独立于回复质量地预测偏好标签，从而导致DPO训练效果持续劣于多模型偏好数据，并可归因于对该偏差的reward hacking；增加生成器数量即可部分缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO通常依赖多模型池生成、外部LLM评判器打分的偏好对，成本较高。近期提出的delta-learning假设认为，用同一对模型（以较大模型的回复为偏好）即可获得可比监督。本文检验该假设的适用边界，明确单对模型偏好数据的局限。

Method: 在多个模型家族与规模上开展研究：(1) 理论分析固定模型对引入的生成器依赖偏差；(2) 实证验证该偏差独立于回复质量即可预测偏好标签；(3) 对比单对数据与多模型偏好数据训练的DPO表现；(4) 通过训练动态分析检验是否存在对这些偏差的reward hacking；(5) 仅增加生成器数量（不加外部评判器）做消融。

Result: 固定模型对带来系统性、依赖生成器的偏差，且该偏差可预测偏好标签而与回复质量无关；单对数据训练的DPO虽使用更高质量的大模型回复，仍一致地逊于多模型偏好数据；性能差距与训练动态中的reward hacking一致；增加生成器数量可在无外部评判器的情况下部分缓解该效应。

Conclusion: 生成器多样性是偏好数据构建的关键因素；单对delta-learning式监督存在原理性上限，不能完全替代多模型池+外部评判的偏好数据流程。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.

</details>


### [1023] [Crop Yield Prediction Using Regression Models: A Comparative Evaluation of Model Performance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37022v1)
*Saptak Das,Arijit Sarkar,Soumik Neogi,Suborno Naskar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在约100万条作物产量数据上比较了五种回归模型（线性回归、随机森林、决策树、岭回归、Lasso回归），发现线性类模型（LR、Ridge、Lasso）表现最优且几乎无差异，测试R²约0.913，RMSE约0.5008，可作为该数据集的竞品基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的作物产量预测有助于农业规划与资源分配，因此需要评估不同回归模型在该任务上的适用性与相对表现，明确可作为基线的模型。

Method: 数据初始含1,000,000条观测、10个变量，预处理中剔除231条目标值为负的样本；类别变量采用one-hot编码，布尔变量转为二值。比较五种回归模型：多元线性回归(LR)、随机森林(RF)、决策树(DT)、岭回归和Lasso回归。采用80:20与70:30两种训练-测试划分，以决定系数(R²)、均方误差(MSE)、均方根误差(RMSE)为评价指标。

Result: 80:20划分下，LR测试R²约0.9130、测试RMSE约0.5008；70:30划分下，Lasso取得最高测试R²（约0.9131）与最低测试RMSE（约0.5008），与LR、岭回归几乎一致。DT在70:30划分下测试表现有所提升，而RF的训练与测试性能之间存在明显差距（过拟合迹象）。

Conclusion: 线性回归类模型在该数据集上提供了有竞争力的基线性能，复杂非线性模型（尤其RF）未带来优势。后续需引入验证集（validation）等进一步实验，以确认模型的泛化性能与可预测性。

Abstract: Reliable crop-yield prediction can support agricultural planning and resource allocation. This study evaluates five regression models for predicting crop yield from environmental, crop-related, and agricultural management variables. The dataset initially contained 1,000,000 observations and ten variables, with 231 observations having negative target values removed during preprocessing. Categorical variables were represented using one-hot encoding, and Boolean variables were converted into binary values. The models considered were multiple linear regression (LR), random-forest regression (RF), decision-tree regression (DT), ridge regression, and lasso regression. Their performance was evaluated using 80:20 and 70:30 training-testing splits based on the coefficient of determination (R-squared), mean squared error (MSE), and root mean squared error (RMSE). Applying an 80:20 split, LR achieved a test R-squared of approximately 0.9130 and a test RMSE of 0.5008. Applying a 70:30 split, lasso regression yielded the highest test R-squared (approximately 0.9131) and the lowest test RMSE (approximately 0.5008), with performance almost identical to LR and ridge regression. DT also showed improved test performance under the 70:30 split, whereas RF exhibited a substantial gap between training and testing performance. These results indicate that the evaluated linear regression model provides competitive baselines for this dataset. Further experimentation, including validation testing, will help determine the models' performance and predictability.

</details>


### [1024] [V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37019v1)
*Miso Choi,Daekeun Kim,Eunji Kim,Jungbeom Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 V-LUMEN：为视觉语言模型设计的视觉查表记忆（visual lookup memory），用非参数化检索的离散视觉嵌入作为独立于深度/宽度的容量维度，在冻结的 Qwen3-VL-2B 上显著提升推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入级扩展通过查表式记忆扩展语言模型容量，而非增加深度、宽度或稠密计算。但将该思路迁移到 VLM 存在困难：视觉特征是连续的、具有空间结构且依赖查询，不同于天然支持 n-gram 查表的离散文本 token。

Method: 1）用冻结码本对视觉特征做离散化；2）通过基于空间聚合的哈希构建具备空间感知的记忆键；3）以文本条件化的相关性信号对记忆键进行调制；4）所有寻址均为非参数化，检索到的嵌入经门控残差通路融合进主干；查表开销与表大小无关，且仅在 prefill 阶段发生一次。

Result: 在五个推理密集型基准上，V-LUMEN 对冻结的 Qwen3-VL-2B 主干带来显著提升，并能零样本迁移到三个图像与训练数据不相交的基准。在匹配参数预算下，将部分 LoRA 或 MoE 适配器容量转移至 V-LUMEN，在两个主干上均保持精度。

Conclusion: 外部视觉记忆是一条独立的容量轴，而非更强的适配方法；其容量随存储增长而非随每 token 计算增长，为 VLM 提供了一种可扩展的新途径。

Abstract: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.

</details>


### [1025] [Compote: Collapse-Resistant Multiple Hypothesis Learning For Sequential Recommendation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37005v1)
*Louis Castres Saint Martin,Clement Calauzenes,Alain Rakotomamonjy,Patrick Gallinari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了COMPOTE——一种抗坍缩的多假设Transformer，用退火式目标（从均匀监督过渡到赢者通吃分配）训练多个假设分别专精不同目录区域，推理时采用归一化无关的最大相似度规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一项预测本质上是多义的：同一交互历史可对应多个合理的后续项目，分属不同商品目录区域。标准序列推荐器将这些备选压缩为单一预测，导致用户意图被混淆。

Method: 多假设Transformer；退火目标函数，从均匀监督逐步过渡到winner-takes-all分配，迫使各假设专精于不同目录区域；推理阶段使用高效、无需归一化器的最大相似度规则。理论上证明：在总体极限下，最优解按最大熵量化原则划分条件下一项分布，而汇总得分保持贝叶斯最优排序。

Result: 在三个Amazon Reviews 2023基准上，仅用物品ID即超越强ID基、生成式与多兴趣基线。等容量消融表明性能提升直接源于退火目标（避免常规多头架构中的"头坍缩"），而非增加容量、集成或路由机制。理论上给出随假设数对数增长的泛化界。

Conclusion: 多假设显式建模可有效缓解下一项预测的固有歧义；关键在于退火式WTA目标带来的假设专精化，而非模型容量或集成效应。

Abstract: Next-item prediction is inherently ambiguous: a single interaction history often admits multiple plausible continuations across distinct catalogue regions. Standard sequential recommenders compress these alternatives into a single prediction, conflating user intents. We introduce COllapse-resistant Multiple hyPOThesis lEarning (COMPOTE), a multi-hypothesis transformer trained with an annealed objective that transitions from uniform supervision to a winner-takes-all assignment. This mechanism forces hypotheses to specialize into distinct catalogue regions, while inference relies on an efficient, normalizer-free max-similarity rule. Theoretically, we show that in the population case, the optimal solutions partition the conditional next-item distribution according to a max-entropy quantization principle, while pooled scores preserve the Bayes-optimal ranking. We also prove a generalization bound scaling logarithmically with the number of hypotheses. Across three Amazon Reviews 2023 benchmarks, COMPOTE outperforms strong ID-based, generative, and multi-interest baselines using item IDs alone. Matched-capacity ablations confirm that performance gains stem directly from the annealed objective, preventing the head collapse observed in conventional multi-head architectures, rather than added capacity, ensembling, or routing.

</details>


### [1026] [Meta Models: Models that Model Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37001v1)
*Peihang Li,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出把元建模视为独立的数值模态而非LLM文本任务，发现现成表格上下文学习器TabPFN在多项设置下可媲美甚至超过需数十至数百GPU时微调的LLM元模型，且仅需数秒；叠加KAN可进一步提升精度，并对535B参数的Marin Hero Run做了预注册预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 每次神经网络训练不仅产出模型，也产出关于"模型如何学习"的证据。作者希望利用累积的训练实验，在真正执行训练之前预测并比较新的训练运行，并将最终性能预测、学习曲线预测、超参数选择统一视为同一"训练响应函数"的不同查询。

Method: 将真实语言模型训练记录视为原生数值数据；使用现成表格上下文学习器TabPFN作为元模型，并与在token化配置上微调的LLM元模型对比；进一步用Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks（KAN）增强TabPFN；最后对535B参数公开训练运行Marin Hero Run进行预注册预测。

Result: TabPFN在多个评估设置下达到或超过微调LLM元模型的精度，而后者需耗费数十至数百GPU时的微调成本，TabPFN仅需数秒的拟合与预测时间且无需任务特定权重更新；TabPFN+KAN在部分预测任务上进一步提升准确率。

Conclusion: 元建模更适合被当作独立的数值模态来处理，而非LLM的文本任务；作者以"谦逊的经验性第一步"给出初步证据，并通过预注册的Marin Hero Run预测，将元模型预测与当时尚未观测到的训练结果进行对照检验。

Abstract: Every neural-network training run produces not only a model, but also evidence about how models learn. Can these accumulated experiments enable us to predict and compare new training runs before executing them? We study meta-models: models that predict the learning behavior of other models. From this perspective, final-performance prediction, learning-curve prediction, and hyperparameter selection are different queries to the same training response function. We take a first, humble empirical step toward this goal: treating real language-model training records as native numeric data, we find that an off-the-shelf tabular in-context learner, TabPFN, can match or outperform a fine-tuned LLM meta-model in multiple evaluated settings. Whereas recent work fine-tunes LLMs on tokenized configurations at a cost of tens to hundreds of GPU-hours, TabPFN requires seconds of fit-and-predict time without task-specific weight updates. We argue that meta-modeling is better treated as its own numeric modality rather than as a text task for LLMs. Going one step further, augmenting TabPFN with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) further improves accuracy on selected prediction tasks. Finally, we pre-registered a forecast of the Marin Hero Run, a 535B-parameter public training run, whose ground truth is revealed point by point as training progresses, putting meta-model predictions to the test against training outcomes not yet observed at the time of forecasting.

</details>


### [1027] [CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36994v1)
*Bilge Celik,Anna Vettoruzzo,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CaLLM 将基于度量的元学习与轻量适配器的模块化参数隔离相结合，通过原型最近邻路由把输入批次分配给专用适配器，实现可扩展、低开销的 LLM 持续适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在任务分布持续演化下的持续适应仍受灾难性遗忘困扰；现有方法难以扩展，且缺乏稳健的零样本"任务到专家"分配机制。

Method: CaLLM 先把每个输入批次投影到任务无关的嵌入空间，检索其最近原型，再将批次路由到对应数据分布特化的适配器；新分布通过原型扩展无缝纳入，局部路由决策使在线与离线设置统一处理。

Result: 该路由机制能发现语义一致的任务分组，促进相似任务间的建设性干扰（正向迁移），并保持极小开销；在多类、细粒度持续学习基准上稳定优于传统隔离与回放方法。

Conclusion: 基于原型的模块化路由是一种有原则且可扩展的 LLM 终身适应范式，兼具可控的跨任务干扰、与任务数无关的常数复杂度及在线/离线统一性。

Abstract: Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. Across diverse and fine-grained continual learning benchmarks, CaLLM consistently outperforms traditional isolation and replay methods, establishing prototype-based modular routing as a principled and scalable approach to lifelong adaptation of LLMs.

</details>


### [1028] [Advancement or Acceleration? How Data Curation Improves LLM Training](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36983v1)
*Jiaxing Wang,Zicheng Zhang,Deping Xiang,Jin Xu,Yong Li,Chao Liu,Pengzhang Liu,Qixia Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文区分数据策展（data curation）的"推进"（提升可达性能）与"加速"（以更少数据达到同样性能），证明推进需要可纠正的训练-目标差距，并提出可在策展前计算的 Δ-test 作为该条件的可观测判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据策展被普遍认为能改进大语言模型训练，但一个基本问题尚未解决：策展究竟是扩展了模型最终能学到的内容（推进），还是只是更快到达同一解（加速）。这一区分此前缺乏形式化定义与可操作判据。

Method: 将推进与加速形式化区分；通过解析刻画与真实 LLM 实验证明推进需要"可纠正的"训练目标-目标目标差距；在"差距中心"的数据混合与选择视角下，将该条件操作化为 Δ-test——即未策展基线的训练损失与目标损失之间的可观测差异，可在昂贵的策展之前计算。

Result: 当基线训练目标与目标目标一致时，任何策展策略都无法提升终点性能（但仍可能加速训练）；大量实验中，显著非零的 Δ 能预测持续性收益，而 Δ≈0 时的收益随训练预算增大而趋于消失。

Conclusion: 应将数据策展的推进性归因于策展任务本身而非策展方法；研究结论把数据策展的重心重新放回任务设定，并指出目标集构建（target-set construction）是塑造策展效果的有前景方向。

Abstract: While data curation is widely credited with improving large language model training, a basic question remains unresolved: does curation expand what a model can ultimately learn, or merely reach the same solution faster? In this paper, we formalize this distinction between advancement (improving the attainable performance) and acceleration (reaching the same performance with less data). Through an analytic characterization and real-world LLM experiments, we show that advancement requires a correctable train-target gap. When the baseline training and target objectives coincide, no curation policy improves the endpoint, although curation may still accelerate training. This reframes advancement as a property of the curation task rather than the curation method. Under a common gap-centric view of data mixture and selection, we operationalize this condition as the $Δ$-test, an observable discrepancy between the uncurated baseline's training and target losses that is computable prior to expensive curation. Across extensive experiments, an appreciably nonzero $Δ$ predicts persistent gains, whereas gains near $Δ=0$ tend to diminish as the training budget grows. Beyond individual methods, our findings recenter data curation on the task itself and point to target-set construction as a promising direction for shaping what curation can achieve.

</details>


### [1029] [GNN-Guided Network Reduction for Centralized Urban Traffic Routing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36981v1)
*Nikolai Antonov,Lukáš Chrpa,Andrii Nyporko,Jan Hůla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于图神经网络（GNN）的城市路网约减方法用于集中式交通路由（CTR）：GNN依据路网与OD车流信息对路段打分，高分路段进入完整OD路径并构成约减路网，再在其上求解原始路段流量MILP。在Prague-Dejvice、London、New York、Sydney四个真实路网、两种交通状态下，该方法相对30秒全图参考解的目标值差距最小，平均比最优对比方法低六倍以上；仿真显示其路径方案到达率最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CTR以MILP形式求解效率较高，但扩展到完整路网时在运行时限内计算不可行；Bounded Routes、Smart Routes等基于预计算约减网络的方法可加速优化，却不利用每个OD流内部的车辆信息，导致约减质量受限。

Method: 设计专用GNN，输入路网结构与车辆流（OD流）信息，对每个OD流的路段进行相关性打分；将高排名路段嵌入完整OD路径，构造约减路网；在该约减网络上求解原始的路段流量MILP，由求解器保证可行性与最终路由决策，GNN仅指导约减。

Result: 在四个真实城市路网、两种交通状态下，所提方法相对30秒全图参考解的相对目标差距在每座城市均为最小；跨城市平均差距比最佳对比方法低六倍以上。交通仿真表明优化收益转化为更高效路由，聚合到达率最高，且每到达百分点行程时长具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 将学习型路网约减与精确MILP求解相结合，可在运行时限内获得接近全图解质量的路由方案，说明车辆流感知的约减优于传统预计算约减，并能在仿真层面改善交通效率。

Abstract: We consider the centralized traffic routing (CTR) problem, where a central planner assigns routes to origin-destination (OD) vehicle flows to minimize congestion-dependent segment cost. Prior work formulates CTR efficiently as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), but scaling this formulation to the full road network is computationally prohibitive within an operational time budget. Bounded Routes and Smart Routes speed up optimization using precomputed reduced networks; however, these methods do not account for vehicle information within each OD flow. Motivated by this gap, we propose a learning-based urban network reduction approach. A dedicated graph neural network (GNN) first scores road segments for each OD flow using the road network and vehicle-flow information. Highly ranked segments are then incorporated into complete OD routes, and the original segment-flow MILP is solved on the resulting reduced road network. The GNN thus guides the reduction of the road network, while the solver enforces feasibility and determines the routing. Experiments on four real urban networks -- Prague-Dejvice, London, New York, and Sydney -- show that the proposed approach achieves the smallest relative objective difference to the $30$-second full-graph reference in every city under both traffic regimes. Averaged across cities, this difference is more than six times lower than that of the best competing method. Moreover, traffic simulation results show that the optimization gains of the proposed method lead to more efficient routing, with the highest aggregate arrival rate and a competitive trip duration per arrival percentage point.

</details>


### [1030] [On the VC Dimension of Autoregressive Linear Threshold Functions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36970v1)
*Ilan Doron-Arad,Idan Mehalel,Elchanan Mossel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文确定了确定性自回归线性阈值函数（LTF）在 $T\ge d^2$ 时的 VC 维为 $\Theta(d^2)$，并证明确定性模型与随机（logistic 采样）模型之间存在指数级分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归模型读取最近 $d$ 位并迭代生成下一位，其单步类 VC 维为 $d$，但 $T$ 步复合后仅有 $O(d^2)$ 的计数上界，下界与上界之间存在二次间隙，作者希望刻画真实复杂度并厘清确定性与随机情形的本质差异。

Method: 构造性下界证明：利用自回归迭代中阈值函数的复合结构，设计使 $T\ge d^2$ 时可真实化 $\Theta(d^2)$ 个自由度的输入序列与参数族；随后将同一技术迁移到随机模型，把 LTF 的符号函数替换为 logistic 采样，分析最终多数表决预测类的增长函数。

Result: 证明对所有 $T\ge d^2$，确定性自回归 LTF 的 VC 维为 $\Theta(d^2)$，闭合了二次间隙；同时表明采用 logistic 采样时，最终多数预测类的 VC 维从 $d$ 的二次增长提升为指数增长。

Conclusion: 自回归迭代可将有效容量提升至平方量级且该界紧；引入随机化后模型表达能力发生质的跃迁，说明随机性与确定性自回归模型在统计学习意义上不可互替。

Abstract: Linear threshold functions (LTFs) are a canonical class of Boolean predictors. In the autoregressive setting, the same LTF reads the most recent $d$ bits, generates the next bit, and returns the bit produced after $T$ steps. While the one-step class has VC dimension $d$, for general $T$ the counting upper bound is $O(d^2)$. We prove that the VC dimension is $Θ(d^2)$ for every $T\ge d^2$, resolving the quadratic gap for deterministic autoregressive LTFs. We then adapt the same technique to show an exponential separation between deterministic and stochastic autoregressive models: replacing the sign of LTFs by logistic sampling can increase the VC dimension of the final majority prediction class from quadratic to exponential in $d$.

</details>


### [1031] [Live-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Proactive Streaming Large Video Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36959v1)
*Kaixuan Du,Xin Wan,Dai Guan,Ming Chen,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Live-OPSD——一种 on-policy 自蒸馏方法，训练时借助特权提示（privileged hints）监督模型自身生成的输出，使流式多模态助手学会"何时回应、如何回应、何时沉默"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式多模态助手必须在事件尚未结束时即时决策：判断现有证据是否足以回应、给出恰当续写，否则保持沉默。监督微调（SFT）只能学习录制好的助手回合，无法直接针对演化策略自身产生的响应前缀进行训练，存在分布偏移问题。

Method: (1) 策略仅凭流式上下文生成续写；(2) 同一模型在附加"描述相关证据"的提示条件下重新评估该续写，得到带提示的分布；(3) 用该分布去指导无提示策略，实现 on-policy 自蒸馏。特权提示仅在训练阶段可用。

Result: 在 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 上，Live-OPSD 于 LiveProBench 取得平均 59.64 分，比最强的 continued-SFT 基线高 5.26 分；在 OVO-Bench 上保持竞争力（65.84）。

Conclusion: 用特权提示在策略自身输出上施加指导，可同时改善流式助手"何时回应"与"如何回应"的能力，验证了 on-policy 自蒸馏在流式多模态场景的有效性。

Abstract: Streaming multimodal assistants must make response decisions while events are still unfolding. They need to recognize when the available evidence warrants a response, produce an appropriate continuation, and remain silent otherwise. Supervised fine-tuning learns from recorded assistant turns, but does not directly train on the response prefixes produced by the evolving policy itself. We introduce Live-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation method that uses privileged hints available only during training to supervise the policy on its own outputs. The policy first generates a continuation from the streaming context alone. The same model then re-evaluates that continuation with a hint describing the relevant evidence, and the resulting distributions guide the unhinted policy. On Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, Live-OPSD attains an average score of 59.64 on LiveProBench, 5.26 points above the strongest continued-SFT baseline, and stays competitive on OVO-Bench (65.84). These results indicate that guiding the policy on its own outputs with privileged hints improves both when and how a streaming assistant responds.

</details>


### [1032] [DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36950v1)
*Egor Maximov,Aleksei Merkelov,Vasiliy Alekseev,Ivan Krivorotov,Valentin Beliaev,Nikita Arsenin,Dmitry Bocharov,Aleksei Goncharov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DCKV——首个端到端训练的KV缓存可微编解码器，对混合语言模型（仅少量全注意力层保留KV缓存）中的KV缓存做高倍率压缩，在Qwen3.5-2B上实现超过55倍（损失≤1.8分）乃至超过100倍（损失≤3.6分）的字节压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合语言模型只在少数全注意力层保留KV缓存，但该缓存仍是提示状态中随提示长度增长、且复用时必须存储或传输的部分，因此其存储与传输开销亟待压缩。

Method: 设计DCKV：一个可微KV缓存编解码器，包含变换、量化器与熵模型；熵模型以提示词元和已解码的相邻位置为条件；上述组件与冻结语言模型联合优化，目标同时包含熵模型给出的码长以及模型输出的变化量。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，DCKV存储压缩后token所用字节比bf16少55倍以上，三个长上下文基准最多损失1.8分；字节减少100倍以上时最多损失3.6分。

Conclusion: 端到端联合优化（码长+输出扰动）的KV缓存编解码能在极低比特率下保持长上下文性能，为混合模型KV缓存的复用与传输提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

</details>


### [1033] [Algorithmic Monoculture in Machine Learning-based Site-Specific Fertilizer Recommendation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36941v1)
*Abdelghani Belgaid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将"共享误差—农场特异误差"结构与社会损失联系起来的分析框架，用以评估多种推荐模型在互联决策者间组合部署时的福利后果，并以摩洛哥五大谷物系统的九类NPK施肥推荐模型进行基准校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习推荐通常逐模型单独评估，但实际部署发生在相互关联的决策者网络中；连续型NPK施肥推荐的相关误差会在农场间累积，形成系统性社会成本，因此需要从"生态系统"层面而非单一模型层面评估模型采纳结构与误差依赖性。

Method: 构建共享误差与农场特异误差的分解模型，将期望社会损失表示为模型采纳份额的函数；在共同误差独立且预测风险相等条件下用赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数（HHI）刻画集中度效应；给出协方差推广形式以处理模型族间依赖；推导"双模型阈值"判定私人最优单一化何时被社会最优所支配，并提出凸组合配置规则以约束平均私人预测后悔；以五类摩洛哥谷物系统、九个模型族进行基准校准，并做相关性与10%后悔上限的敏感性分析。

Result: 在示例参数与10%后悔上限下，受精度约束的多样化配置在全部五个系统中均降低模型化社会损失，降幅10.89%–41.53%（均值19.41%）；等权重配置在该设定下亦降低损失，但在每种作物上都突破后悔上限；相关性敏感性显示高度依赖的模型误差会削弱多样化收益。

Conclusion: 反事实结果并非农艺或货币福利的估计，框架的贡献在于识别出"采纳架构"与"误差依赖"应作为生态系统层面的评估变量。

Abstract: Machine learning recommendations are often evaluated one model at a time, despite deployment across interconnected decision makers. For continuous NPK fertilizer prescriptions, correlated errors can aggregate across farms and generate systemic costs. A model of shared and farm-specific recommendation errors links expected social loss to model adoption shares; the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index characterizes concentration effects when common model errors are independent and predictive risks are equal. A covariance-generalized formulation captures the dependence between model families. A two-model threshold characterizes when privately optimal monoculture is socially dominated, and a convex portfolio rule limits average private predictive regret. Nine model families across five Moroccan cereal systems provide a benchmark-based calibration. Under illustrative parameters and a 10% regret cap, accuracy-constrained diversification lowers modeled social loss in all five systems by 10.89-41.53% (mean 19.41%). Uniform allocation reduces modeled loss in this setting, but breaches the regret cap in every crop. Correlation sensitivity shows that highly dependent model errors attenuate the benefits of diversification. These counterfactual outcomes are not estimates of agronomic or monetary welfare; the framework identifies adoption architecture and error dependence as ecosystem-level evaluation variables.

</details>


### [1034] [TDLM: Adaptive Temporal Integration for Diffusion Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36940v1)
*Bohang Sun,Max Zhu,Francesco Caso,Christopher Irwin,Jialin Yu,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TDLM，让掩码扩散语言模型中未确定位置通过因果时间注意力复用自身历史隐表示，在冻结去噪器中以约0.84%额外参数实现最高7.15×加速生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤都会对未确定token重复计算表示，但传统去噪器并不显式保留这些表示以供跨步骤复用，造成大量重复计算浪费。

Method: 在冻结的去噪器中引入时间自条件模块：每个未确定位置可attending到自身的历史隐表示；训练时使用模型自生成轨迹，对相邻采样解码步之间被揭示的token采用简单交叉熵目标，并用因果时间注意力支持训练期并行评估；该模块仅增加约0.84%可训练参数。

Result: 在LLaDA与Dream上，相较原始扩散语言模型实现最高7.15×的生成加速，且在所评估任务上答案质量具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 时间记忆是一种实用手段，可更有效利用重复去噪计算，为扩散语言模型的高效推理提供新思路。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models repeatedly compute representations for unresolved tokens, but conventional denoisers do not explicitly retain these representations for reuse across steps. We introduce Temporal Self-Conditioning Diffusion Language Model (TDLM), which lets each unresolved position attend to its own history of hidden representations within a frozen denoiser. This gives later predictions access to computation already performed. Training uses self-generated trajectories and a simple cross-entropy objective for tokens revealed between consecutively sampled decoding steps, while causal temporal attention permits parallel evaluation during training. On LLaDA, the temporal modules add only approximately 0.84% trainable parameters. Across LLaDA and Dream, the main comparison shows up to 7.15$\times$ faster generation than the corresponding original diffusion language model, with competitive answer quality on the evaluated tasks. These results motivate temporal memory as a practical way to make more effective use of repeated denoising computation.

</details>


### [1035] [Gaussian Process Bandits for Constraint Black Box Lever Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36935v1)
*Bram van den Akker,Hidde Fokkema,Anastasiia Kornilova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种与分群无关的GP-UCB方法，在离散预算分配权重优化中通过高斯过程先验跨配置共享信息，降低探索成本；先用高保真合成模拟器对比核函数（Matérn+Linear组合最稳健），再通过生产环境大规模RCT验证其相对ε-greedy基线的显著效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享预算在多个竞争性分群间做离散权重分配是资源受限序贯决策中的基础难题。实际中受延迟、噪声、聚合反馈以及权重调整频率的严格运营约束限制；由此形成组合动作空间与极端数据稀疏，独立评估每个臂的经典多臂老虎机算法效率极低。

Method: 采用分割无关（segmentation-agnostic）的GP-UCB框架：在奖励函数上放置高斯过程先验，使相邻配置之间共享信息以压缩探索视界。构建高保真合成模拟器，在平稳、漂移、反应性三种环境下评测多种核配置，选出对局部噪声与全局漂移都稳健的复合Matérn + Linear核；最后在生产环境中开展大规模随机对照试验进行验证。

Result: 模拟实验表明复合Matérn + Linear核在平稳、漂移与反应性环境下最为稳健；生产环境RCT显示GP-UCB相较标准ε-greedy基线取得统计显著的效率提升，验证了其在实际黑箱杠杆优化中的可用性。

Conclusion: GP-UCB为真实场景黑箱杠杆优化提供了一种高度实用的方案，弥合了理论bandit研究与生产规模部署之间的差距；分割无关设计避免了按分群独立建模，核函数选择对稳健性至关重要。

Abstract: Optimizing discrete allocation weights across competing segments of a shared budget is a fundamental challenge in resource-constrained, sequential decision-making environments. In practice, this optimization is often hindered by delayed, noisy, and aggregate feedback, alongside strict operational constraints on how frequently weights can be adjusted. Because of the resulting combinatorial action space and extreme data sparsity, classical multi-armed bandit algorithms that evaluate arms independently are rendered highly inefficient. To overcome these limitations, we propose a segmentation-agnostic approach utilizing Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (GP-UCB) algorithms. By placing a Gaussian Process prior on the reward function, our method effectively shares information across neighboring configurations, drastically reducing the necessary exploration horizon. In this paper, we bridge the gap between theoretical bandit research and production-scale deployment. We first introduce a high-fidelity synthetic simulator to evaluate various kernel configurations under stationary, drifting, and reactive environments, identifying a composite Matérn + Linear kernel as the most robust choice for overcoming local noise and global shifts. Finally, we validate our findings through a large-scale Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) in a live production environment. Our empirical results demonstrate that the GP-UCB approach delivers a statistically significant efficiency lift compared to a standard $\varepsilon$-greedy baseline, offering a highly practical solution for real-world black-box lever optimization.

</details>


### [1036] [Provenance Signatures for Low Rank Adaptations of Image Diffusion Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36933v1)
*Tobias Cheung,Mohan Dantam,Marc Juarez,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对扩散模型（含LoRA等适配）在开放世界场景下的溯源问题，提出基于图像集内在维度的黑盒签名，并用假设检验区分基础模型、LoRA适配与完全不同的模型族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型可被LoRA高效改造以适配特定用途，但也可能被在线服务用于生成有偏、有害或违规图像。此前模型识别工作局限于已知候选模型列表，缺乏对"未知适配集与未知替代模型"这一现实开放世界场景的溯源手段，因此需要新的来源检测协议。

Method: 形式化溯源问题的精确设置与威胁模型；指出模型族多样性与多重适配导致的两种子问题；采用假设检验（hypothesis testing）框架；构建仅依赖模型生成图像集内在维度（intrinsic dimension）的黑盒签名，无需访问模型参数。

Result: 所提协议能够区分基础模型、LoRA适配以及完全不同的模型族，且在适配与替代模型集合均未知的开放世界设定下有效。

Conclusion: 图像集内在维度可作为扩散模型的有效黑盒签名，为开放世界下的模型来源归因与滥用追责提供可行途径。

Abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized the generation of realistic artificial images. Efficient techniques such as Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can modify these models for particular use cases, making them more diverse and widely usable. At the same time, open base models may be adapted to deliver biased, harmful or illegal images in an online service. In this paper, we develop a protocol to detect when a service may be using an adaptation of an otherwise standard model. We describe the precise setup and threat model for this provenance question and define two different problems arising due the presence of multiple model families and multiple adaptations. In contrast to previous works that have considered model identification within lists of known candidate models, we consider the realistic open world scenario where the set of possible adaptations and alternative models are unknown. Using a hypothesis testing approach, our protocols can distinguish between the base model, a LoRA adaptation and other completely different families of models. For this test, we develop a black box signature of the models based only on intrinsic dimension of sets of images generated by the models.

</details>


### [1037] [HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36901v1)
*Xiang Li,Chengting Yu,Jungang Li,Yilun Zheng,Junzhuo Li,Xingyao Zhang,Wenbo Su,Xuming Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HiLo-RD（High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation），通过将大窗口教师状态与裁剪后的小窗口视图配对并在已提交位置对齐隐藏表示，实现无需外部教师的自蒸馏，缓解掩码扩散语言模型在有限生成预算下的"预算诱导的过早提交"问题，从而提升低预算下的准确率并缩短回答长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）与自回归模型不同，需同时决定"生成什么内容"与"在何处提交"，由此产生两个耦合难题：在推理未完成前预测有用内容，以及决定何时固定会影响后续预测的答案 token。作者识别出"预算诱导的过早提交"现象：即使正确答案本可容纳于窗口内，模型仍可能在窗口边界附近提前固定答案片段，使其成为后续预测的上下文并误导推理方向。现有后训练方法无法直接迁移同一模型在大窗口下所走的更优轨迹。

Method: HiLo-RD 采用自蒸馏框架：(1) 将大窗口教师状态与裁剪得到的小窗口视图配对；(2) 在已提交位置上匹配二者的隐藏表示。该监督同时引导 token 预测与提交顺序，且无需外部教师模型。

Result: 在多个数学基准上，HiLo-RD 提升了低预算准确率并缩短了回答长度；这些收益可迁移至代码生成任务，且未使用代码领域训练。在 GSM8K 上，准确率提升 9.4 个百分点，同时平均可读长度下降约 25%。注意力诊断与固定预算下的顺序干预实验支持所提出的机制。

Conclusion: 结果表明大窗口推理可用于改进小窗口解码，即借助同一模型在更大预算下的轨迹来监督小预算解码过程。

Abstract: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.

</details>


### [1038] [Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36882v1)
*Nihal Acharya Adde,Hanno Gottschalk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双分支进化框架，在自动驾驶强化学习任务中同时进行神经架构搜索（NAS）与超参数优化（HPO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS 在 CNN 自动化设计上潜力强，但在 RL 中应用有限，尤其是需要同时优化架构与训练动态（超参数）的场景；已有 EMNAS 工作仅处理架构。

Method: 基于此前进化多目标 NAS（EMNAS）工作，构建双分支进化框架：一个分支进化离散网络架构（针对 RL 策略网络中负责视觉特征提取的卷积层），另一分支进化连续 RL 关键超参数；二者在统一多目标搜索策略下并行优化。并引入并行评估与教师-学生策略迁移机制以加速收敛、提升泛化。

Result: 在高保真驾驶模拟器实验中，联合 NAS-HPO 框架稳定优于单独 NAS：策略奖励更高、参数量更少、稳定性更好。

Conclusion: 联合优化模型结构与训练动态，可为可扩展且高效的 RL 智能体设计带来收益。

Abstract: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism.
