Experiments in a high-fidelity driving simulator show that the joint NAS-HPO framework consistently outperforms standalone NAS, yielding policies with higher rewards, fewer parameters, and improved stability. These results highlight the benefits of jointly optimizing model structure and training dynamics for scalable and effective RL agent design.

</details>


### [1039] [Tail Cues, Principal Corrections: Plug-and-Play Rectification for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36870v1)
*Yingkai Yang,Chaoqi Chen,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TALOR：以源模型线性分类头为几何锚点的轻量、免反向传播校正模块，在开集测试时自适应中修正主坐标漂移，实现高精度、低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开集测试时自适应（OSTTA）面临协变量偏移与语义偏移共存，现有方法依赖参数更新或可变异记忆来获取自适应信号，代价高且易受未知样本干扰。

Method: 利用源线性头诱导的基，将归一化特征分解为高增益主坐标与低增益尾部坐标；在主坐标子空间估计软路由仿射校正，融合制度级主偏置与刻画样本级尾-主耦合的尾部条件斜率；通过加权岭回归估计漂移并从主坐标中减去，重构特征后送入源头，全程无反向传播。

Result: 在ImageNet-C及六个csOOD数据集上，H-score比次优UniEnt高2.2%，速度快2.5倍，GPU显存仅为其12%；作为后置校正插件可将COME提升至68.4% H-score，额外显存开销仅2%。

Conclusion: 线性头诱导的子空间为特征校正提供了有效几何先验，轻量后处理式校正可在不更新参数、不受未知样本显著干扰的前提下显著提升OSTTA性能与效率。

Abstract: Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation (OSTTA) operates on non-stationary target streams where covariate and semantic shifts coexist. Existing TTA methods often obtain adaptation signals by updating model parameters or maintaining mutable memories, which can be costly and vulnerable to unknown samples. We present TALOR, a lightweight, backward-free rectification module that uses the source linear head as a geometric anchor. The head-induced basis decomposes each normalized feature into high-gain principal coordinates and low-gain tail coordinates. TALOR estimates a soft-routed affine correction in the principal subspace, combining a regime-level principal bias with a tail-conditioned slope that captures sample-level tail-to-principal coupling. Using weighted ridge regression, it subtracts this drift estimate from the principal coordinates, reconstructs the feature and feeds it into the source head. On the ImageNet-C benchmark with six csOOD datasets, TALOR outperforms the next-best UniEnt by 2.2% H-score while running 2.5x faster and using only 12% of its GPU memory; as a post-correction plug-in, it further boosts COME to 68.4% H-score with only 2% additional memory overhead.

</details>


### [1040] [When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36849v1)
*Zehao Wang,Hanzhu Chen,Runquan Gui,Zhe Wang,Lin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PICO 通过分布约束的联合解码生成"可验证且策略兼容"的专家轨迹，并与 on-policy rollout 混合优化，缓解 RLVR 在难题上的学习悬崖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 依赖组内相对估计（GRPO、RLOO）从二值奖励中学习，但在超出模型当前能力的难题上，所有 rollout 均失败，样本无法揭示正确解，优势坍缩为零，更新失效。引入专家轨迹虽可补救，但专家轨迹与当前策略不兼容、常位于学生低概率区，导致需要大参数偏移，退化为表层模仿而非可迁移推理。

Method: 提出 PICO：(1) 分布约束的联合解码——token 级由专家数据引导解码，同时保留学生的相对 token 概率；(2) 动态 top-k 机制在有限散度预算下限制采样分布，使轨迹"按构造"兼具可验证性与策略兼容性；(3) 混合行为目标，将这些轨迹与 on-policy rollout 联合优化，并用重要性采样缓解分布不匹配。

Result: 在多种推理数据集与 agentic 基准上，PICO 一致优于标准 RLVR 与既有 off-policy 基线。

Conclusion: 困难问题上的有效学习信号需同时满足"可验证正确"与"与当前策略足够兼容"；通过受控偏离策略的专家引导解码并配合混合行为优化，可稳定提升推理与智能体任务表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. We propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning (PICO), which performs distribution-constrained joint decoding: expert data guides decoding at the token level while preserving the student's relative token probabilities, and a dynamic top-k mechanism confines the sampling distribution under a finite divergence budget, yielding trajectories that are verified and policy-compatible by construction. These trajectories are optimized jointly with on-policy rollouts under a mixed-behavior objective that mitigates their distribution mismatch via importance sampling. Experiments across reasoning diverse datasets and agentic benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and prior off-policy baselines.

</details>


### [1041] [SetGRPO: Calibrating Grader-Induced Policy Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36807v1)
*Jiale Huang,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Jinhe Bi,Yupeng Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SetGRPO，通过联合奖励不确定集校准、几何引导的安全恢复与选择性风险门控，控制基于评分标准的强化学习（GRPO）中评分器随机性带来的更新偏移与方向反转风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习用细粒度评分器反馈训练大模型处理开放式任务，但评分器随机性会改变 GRPO 更新。由于 GRPO 在组内对奖励做联合归一化，再把训练系数与响应级梯度结合，单个评分偏差会改变整组系数并产生依赖策略的更新变化；选择性执行还会影响被保留更新的方向反转风险。仅靠分数差异无法刻画这一问题。

Method: SetGRPO 含三个模块：(a) 联合奖励集校准，为训练系数构造联合不确定集；(b) 几何引导的安全恢复，将候选系数映射到当前策略的局部更新几何中，并为每个响应组确定最大安全恢复比例；(c) 选择性风险门控优化，通过独立风险校准选取全局阈值，在保持原始 GRPO 目标的同时控制被接受更新的条件方向反转风险。

Result: 在可交换性假设下，SetGRPO 为联合系数集提供有限样本的边际覆盖，并对候选阈值实现同时风险控制。在覆盖三个领域的十个开放式基准上，SetGRPO 在 Qwen3.5 与 Llama3.2 两个模型家族的宏平均指标均为所有对比训练方法中最高。

Conclusion: SetGRPO 将评分器随机性引发的 GRPO 更新不确定性形式化为系数集与风险门控问题，在具备统计保证的同时提升开放式任务的训练效果，具有跨模型家族与领域的有效性。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning uses fine-grained grader feedback to train large language models on open-ended tasks, but grader randomness can alter GRPO updates in ways that score discrepancies alone cannot characterize. Because GRPO jointly normalizes rewards within each response group and combines the resulting training coefficients with response-level gradients, a scoring discrepancy can shift the coefficients of the entire group and induce policy-dependent update changes. Selective execution further affects the direction-reversal risk of retained updates. To address this, we propose Set-Valued Group Relative Policy Optimization (SetGRPO). It comprises three modules: (a) Joint Reward Set Calibration constructs a joint uncertainty set for the training coefficients; (b) Geometry-Guided Safe Recovery maps candidate coefficients into the current policy's local update geometry and determines the largest safe recovery ratio for each response group; and (c) Selective Risk-Gated Optimization selects a global threshold through independent risk calibration to control the conditional direction-reversal risk of accepted updates while preserving the original GRPO objective. Under exchangeability, SetGRPO provides finite-sample marginal coverage for the joint coefficient set and simultaneous risk control across candidate thresholds. On ten open-ended benchmarks spanning three domains, SetGRPO achieves the highest macro average among all compared training methods on both Qwen3.5 and Llama3.2 model families.

</details>


### [1042] [LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36806v1)
*Sølve Langseth,Kristoffer Herland Hellton,Hugo L. Hammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验能否用大语言模型（LLM）elicited 的系数先验替代零收缩目标，作为正则化回归的先验，从而改善分布外（OOD）预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测模型在部署总体与训练总体不一致时会退化，而训练数据本身无法告知哪些特征-响应关系可迁移；专家先验获取慢且难以扩展，因此探索用LLM规模化地提供系数先验。

Method: 在五个表格数据集上按真实协变量划分，以LLM elicitation 得到的系数先验作为正则化回归的收缩目标（替代零收缩），仅用源域交叉验证选择provider与先验结构；并设置损坏先验的对照实验以区分“特征特异内容”与“尺度”的贡献。

Result: 五个数据集中四个有改善，OOD MSE 最多降低 7.9%，24 个含先验结果中 10 个在常规置信水平下显著（单次部署区间宽得多）；分类任务上增益体现在概率精度而非排序；对照实验显示收益来自特征特异内容而非尺度。但候选先验间差异大于平均收益，交叉验证边际低于其自身噪声，选择只是避开最差先验；三个数据集上域内提升与域外相当，说明更像改善正则化而非校正分布漂移。

Conclusion: 只有当训练数据足够大、域内增益消失时，elicited 知识才可证实地改善迁移；总体上LLM先验是可靠但有限的OOD改善手段，其作用更接近正则化而非偏移校正。

Abstract: Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone. The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. On classification the gain is in probabilistic accuracy, not ranking, and control tests with corrupted priors attribute the benefit to feature-specific content rather than scale. Two findings temper this. Variation across candidate priors exceeds the average benefit, yet cross-validation margins fall below their own noise, so selection avoids the worst prior rather than finding the best. On three datasets the prior improves in-domain accuracy as much as out-of-domain, making it better regularisation than shift correction. Only where the training data are large enough that the in-domain gain disappears does elicited knowledge demonstrably improve transfer. Code, priors and results: https://github.com/hugohammer/llm-priors-ood.

</details>


### [1043] [API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36801v2)
*Haocheng Mei,Yuchuan Tian,Ye Yuan,Chao Xu,Allen Chen,Kai Han,Yunhe Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出API-TAIL典型性审计方法，用于检测商业语言模型API中"部分请求被暗中路由到廉价替代模型却按宣称模型计费"的行为，在合法解码配置构成的复合零假设下实现低误报、低查询预算的高检出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业LLM API仅返回文本，提供方可悄悄将部分请求转给更便宜的替代模型以降低成本，同时按宣称模型收费。检测难点在于：诚实提供方的合理变化（温度缩放、采样截断、重复/存在惩罚、默认系统提示等未公开的解码与服务配置）也会改变输出分布，因此审计面对的是"合法配置复合零假设"而非单一参照分布。

Method: 关键洞察：合法配置变化主要是在整批层面整体平移响应的典型性（typicality），而部分替换则注入在宣称模型下仍属异常的个别响应。基于此，API-TAIL先对齐一个单一"有效温度"，使标准化惊讶度（standardized surprisal）分数在受审批次上居中，从而吸收批级偏移；随后统计剩余尾部响应的数量，若超过在合法配置集合上校准得到的阈值，则判定该端点存在替换。

Result: 在真实API响应与构造的替换混合数据上评估：API-TAIL在多种诚实提供方下控制误报率，能以较小查询预算检出低比例部分替换；在统一的复合校准下，优于经适配的基于排名（rank）与MMD的审计基线。

Conclusion: 通过"批级典型性对齐 + 尾部异常计数阈值校准"的两阶段设计，可在未知合法解码配置的复合零假设下有效审计模型替换行为，为黑盒API的模型身份/计费一致性核查提供实用且低成本的统计检验方案。

Abstract: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world API responses and constructed substitution mixtures, API-TAIL controls false alarms across diverse honest providers and detects low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget. Under a common composite calibration, it outperforms the adapted rank- and MMD-based audit baselines.

</details>


### [1044] [Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36794v1)
*Yue Wu,Yang Zhang,Weinan Gan,Chongming Gao,Xinsen Guo,Xiaoyuan Li,Fuli Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对 In-Place TTT 在真实网页长上下文问答中收益消失的问题，提出 Select-TTT：利用冻结输出头读取到的查询相关性信号，按块调节 fast-weight 的写入强度（无需监督、无需新参数），在两个基准、两个骨干上一致提升长上下文问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: In-Place TTT 通过把标准 MLP 的降维投影复用为 fast weights，使测试时训练（TTT）在大模型上变得可行。但作者发现其在真实网页长上下文问答任务上收益基本消失。原因在于其均匀写入策略：每个上下文块以相同强度写入 fast-weight 记忆，无关内容会稀释与查询相关的信息。

Method: 提出 Select-TTT：一种模型无关、以查询为条件的 In-Place TTT 写入规则。将每块的写入强度按其与用户查询的相关性进行缩放。相关性信号无需监督、不引入新参数，直接取自模型冻结的输出头——即该块隐状态分配到查询 token 上的概率质量；随后用带温度参数的 softmax 将分数转为学习率乘子，从而保持 In-Place TTT 原有的分块、上下文并行计算结构不变。

Result: 在两个长上下文问答基准、两个骨干模型上，Select-TTT 均稳定提升性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明，查询条件的 fast-weight 写入对实用的长上下文问答测试时训练具有价值，且有望用于涉及多轮用户查询、上下文持续演化的长时程智能体任务。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

</details>


### [1045] [Does LLM Pre-Training Typically Occur at the Edge of Stability?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36778v1)
*Yuhang Cai,Haodong Wen,Haofeng Huang,Deyi Liu,Yiyuan Ma,Kaifeng Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视二次近似作为神经网络训练动力学模型的保真度，聚焦其在LLM训练中的失效模式。作者提出"凸性边缘"（EoC）现象：持续负曲率使二次动力学无论学习率如何都会发散，而真实动力学保持稳定；在剔除该与学习率无关的不稳定后，作者为自适应优化器的随机训练提出推广的"稳定性边缘"（EoS）定义。在最大787M参数的多种LLM预训练中，EoC普遍存在，EoS广泛存在但非普遍——学习率足够小（如衰减后）或批量低于与临界批量正相关的阈值时EoS消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次近似是研究神经网络优化的常用视角，但近期证据（如全批量梯度下降中的Edge of Stability，最大Hessian特征值集中在2/η附近，与经典二次近似的稳定性条件相悖）对其预测有效性提出挑战。作者希望系统考察二次近似何时、以何种方式失效，特别是在LLM训练这一重要但缺乏分析的情境中。

Method: 1）识别二次近似的独立失效模式EoC：训练中存在持续负曲率，导致二次近似动力学对任意学习率都发散，而真实动力学稳定；2）在剥离该学习率无关的不稳定后，提出面向自适应优化器随机训练的广义EoS定义：以"提高学习率使二次动力学显著发散、而真实动力学基本不变"为判据；3）在多种模型规模（最大787M）的LLM预训练运行中实证检验EoC与EoS的出现条件，并考察学习率衰减与批量大小的影响。

Result: 在多种LLM预训练设置下发现：(1) EoC在所有LLM预训练中均被观察到；(2) EoS广泛存在但并非普遍——当学习率足够小（如衰减之后）时消失，当批量大小低于某个与临界批量呈正相关的临界阈值时也消失。

Conclusion: 二次近似的有效性取决于学习率与批量所处的区间，其失效可被刻画为区分EoC（学习率无关的发散）与EoS（学习率相关的发散）两类模式。这些结果为理解LLM训练动力学及后续研究提供了基础框架。

Abstract: Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. In full-batch gradient descent with learning rate (LR) $η$, Cohen et al. (2021) observed the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the largest Hessian eigenvalue concentrates near $2/η$, seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. In this work, we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics, with a particular focus on their failure modes in LLM training. We first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation, where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the LR, even though the real dynamics remain stable. We term this phenomenon the Edge of Convexity (EoC). After removing the effect of this LR-independent instability, we then propose a generalized definition of Edge of Stability (EoS) for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers, based on whether increasing the LR induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. Across different LLM pretraining runs with various model sizes up to 787M, we find that (1) EoC is always observed across LLM pretraining, and (2) EoS is also prevalent but not universal: it disappears when the LR becomes sufficiently small (e.g., after decay) or when the batch size falls below a critical threshold that has a positive correlation with the critical batch size. Together, these findings characterize when and how quadratic approximations fail and provide a foundation for future work on understanding training dynamics.

</details>


### [1046] [Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36755v1)
*Jia Gu,Liang Pang,Huawei Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出内容不变梯度归因（CIGA）框架，用于缓解指令微调数据选择中梯度归因的表面形式偏差，提升归因稳定性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全局梯度归因方法（用于LLM指令微调的数据选择）存在表面形式偏差：措辞、格式等语义无关细节的微小改动会导致归因分数高度不一致，即使底层内容不变。

Method: CIGA包含两步：①识别既对归因有影响力、又在保持语义的表面形式扰动下梯度稳定的层，以减少梯度特征中的格式噪声；②将这些归因信号与输入的语义表示动态融合，结合优化层面影响力与内容层面信息。

Result: 在多基准实验中，CIGA在表面形式扰动下产生更稳定的排名，同时保持下游能力并提升平均性能，且降低了归因开销。

Conclusion: CIGA为LLM指令微调的数据选择提供了一种稳健且高效的方法，兼顾归因稳定性、下游性能与计算成本。

Abstract: Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream capabilities and improving average performance. CIGA also reduces attribution cost, offering a robust and efficient approach to data selection for LLM instruction tuning.

</details>


### [1047] [Generative Refinement Learning for Temporal Interpolation in Scientific Machine Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36751v1)
*Pu Ren,Michael W. Mahoney,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 iFLEX，用条件扩散模型学习"简单加权时间插值"的残差，实现低时间分辨率科学场的时间超分辨重建，在湍流、雷达降水、海温数据上误差低于光流与视频插帧扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学仿真与观测的时间分辨率常低于下游任务需求；固定网格点上的平均会引入误差，而仅靠运动估计（光流）无法确定物理场数值如何变化，因此需要专门的时间插值/重建方法。

Method: iFLEX 先以两帧观测在每格点做按时间距离加权的线性平均作为初始估计；训练时用真实中间场减去该估计得到残差作为扩散模型目标。条件扩散模型以两帧观测、目标时刻、观测间隔及可用物理参数为条件学习生成残差，推理时把生成的残差加回加权平均得到中间场重建。

Result: 在 Navier–Stokes Kraichnan 湍流、上海雷达降水、海表温度三个数据集上，iFLEX 的重建误差均低于所比较的基线（含光流法与面向视频插帧的扩散模型）。在 Re=36,000 的受控湍流对比中，固定扩散骨干与训练设置时，学习残差将相对 Frobenius 范数误差从直接生成场的约 13.7 降至 10.5。

Conclusion: 学习修正简单数值插值的残差比直接生成中间场更有效，可作为科学场时间超分辨的通用范式；代码已开源。

Abstract: Computationally expensive simulations and real-world observations often provide data at a lower temporal resolution than downstream tasks require. Averaging observations at fixed grid points can introduce errors, and motion estimates alone do not determine how the physical field values change. In this work, we study whether learning to correct a simple numerical interpolation improves the reconstruction of intermediate scientific fields. Our model, interpolative FLow EXpert (iFLEX), first estimates the missing field by taking a weighted average of the two observations at each grid point, giving more weight to the observation closer to the requested time. During training, subtracting this estimate from an observed intermediate field gives the residual that a conditional diffusion model learns to generate. Both observations condition the model, together with the target time, the interval between observations, and available physical parameters. To reconstruct an unobserved intermediate field, the generated residual is added to the weighted average. We evaluate iFLEX on Navier-Stokes Kraichnan turbulence, Shanghai radar precipitation, and sea surface temperature. Across these datasets, iFLEX achieves lower reconstruction error than the evaluated baselines, including optical-flow and diffusion models developed for video frame interpolation in computer vision. In a controlled turbulence comparison at a Reynolds number of 36,000, learning the residual reduces relative Frobenius norm error from about 13.7 for direct field generation to 10.5, with the diffusion backbone and training setup held fixed. Code is available at https://github.com/paulpuren/iflex.

</details>


### [1048] [What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37719v1)
*Shikhar Shiromani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"杠杆率"(leverage)这一精确度量——用更新方向的Fisher二次型除以同规模随机方向的Fisher二次型——刻画"单位权重变化买到了什么"。该指标在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2等已发布checkpoint上跨越四个数量级地排序了不同训练阶段：预训练窗口与随机方向无异，SFT约为5倍，RL-Zero/RLVR为400–1500，DPO为400–23000。作者据此发现预训练积累的更新近似噪声、bf16无fp32主权重会冻结大量坐标并降低杠杆率，并推导出预测DARE随机drop-and-rescale损伤的复用定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练只把权重移动约千分之一范数却带来剧烈行为变化，预训练移动三分之一范数却只换来缓慢漂移，说明"权重变化幅度"本身无法解释行为变化。现有分析缺乏一个能定量刻画"单位权重变化所换来效果"的精确工具，因此作者提出leverage来统一衡量不同训练阶段的更新效力。

Method: 定义leverage为更新方向的Fisher二次型，除以同一checkpoint下同规模随机方向的Fisher二次型；每个方向用一次前向模式(fwd-mode)传播即可精确计算。基于该仪器：(1)在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2的已发布checkpoint上分阶段测量（预训练、SFT、RL-Zero、RLVR、DPO）；(2)对比bf16无fp32主权重训练与fp32训练，考察坐标冻结比例、leverage变化及更新幅度与对角Fisher的对齐；(3)推导sign-flip零假设下DARE在保留率p时的相对损伤公式(1-p)/(p ρ_sign)；(4)以可控SFT/DPO轨迹和DPO阶段重跑作为对照验证测量可靠性。

Result: leverage在四个数量级上清晰排序各阶段：预训练窗口在散文上处于随机水平，SFT约5倍，RL-Zero与RLVR达400–1500，DPO达400–23000。预训练30k–1M步的窗口在散文上并不比同规模随机方向更有影响，符合SGD的噪声二次模型。bf16无fp32主权重会冻结36–99%的坐标，使leverage最多降低7倍，并产生fp32训练中不存在的更新幅度与对角Fisher对齐。DARE损伤定律在成功适用的区间内与实测相差不超过2倍。对照实验：所有带fp32主权重的可控SFT/DPO轨迹在移动中leverage下降；按发表配方从锚点重跑DPO可复现1%以内的位移和4%以内的leverage，而普通配方读数低5–6倍；剔除单一成分可将水平追溯到长度归一化损失与其batch size 128的组合。

Conclusion: leverage是一个精确、可复现、跨阶段可比的权重量化指标，能揭示预训练更新近似噪声、训练精度改变更新几何、以及随机drop-and-rescale的损伤规律。它把"权重变化幅度"与"行为变化"解耦，为理解预训练与后训练的本质差异、训练数值格式选择和模型复用/合并策略提供了统一工具。

Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

</details>


### [1049] [Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment for Scalable Backpropagation-Free Training](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36718v1)
*Wu Lin,Yan Fan,Chenxiang Ma,Yinglan Feng,Jia Wang,Ka-Chun Wong,Qiuzhen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非线性直接反馈对齐（NDFA）：用轻量非线性代理子网络构造各隐藏层反馈，并设计代理子网络更新策略，缩小DFA与BP的性能差距并保持并行训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BP存在生物不合理性与"反向锁定"问题，层间难以并行；DFA通过固定反馈矩阵直接将全局输出误差传给各隐藏层，但固定线性反馈难以刻画"隐藏表示→网络输出"的非线性变换，导致与BP仍有明显性能差距。

Method: 将每层反馈由固定矩阵替换为轻量级非线性代理子网络（surrogate subnetwork），用于近似隐藏表示到输出的非线性映射；并提出一种学习策略在训练过程中更新该代理子网络，使其持续更准确地逼近该非线性变换。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN与ImageNet上，针对残差网络与视觉Transformer进行大量实验，NDFA一致优于现有DFA类方法，显著缩小与BP的差距，同时保持高效的并行训练。

Conclusion: 以非线性代理子网络替代固定反馈矩阵是提升DFA性能的有效途径，可在不牺牲并行性的前提下接近BP精度；代码已开源。

Abstract: Backpropagation (BP) remains the predominant algorithm for training deep neural networks, but it is biologically implausible and suffers from the backward locking problem, constraining parallelization across layers. Direct Feedback Alignment~(DFA), which propagates the global output error directly to each hidden layer via fixed feedback matrices, has emerged as a promising alternative for addressing these limitations. However, a significant performance gap persists between DFA and BP, which we attribute to the limited ability of fixed feedback matrices to capture the nonlinear transformation from hidden representations to the network output. To address this limitation, we propose Nonlinear Direct Feedback Alignment (NDFA), which constructs each hidden-layer feedback using a lightweight nonlinear surrogate subnetwork. To enhance the effectiveness of the feedback throughout training, we further propose a learning strategy to update the surrogate subnetwork, thereby better approximating the underlying nonlinear transformation. Extensive experiments across residual networks and vision transformers on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet datasets demonstrate that NDFA consistently outperforms existing DFA-based methods and substantially narrows the performance gap to BP, while maintaining efficient parallel training. The code is available at https://github.com/YanFan321/NDFA.

</details>


### [1050] [Conservative Dueling Bandits: Preference Learning under Baseline Constraints](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36708v1)
*Rohan Deb,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Arindam Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究"保守上下文对决赌博机"问题：每轮要求展示的较优项的累计得分不低于可信基线得分的(1-α)比例，得分定义为击败当前最优项的概率。作者证明直接套用CLUCB的安全检验会产生线性遗憾，并提出线性情形下的MaxInP-BC与一般效用类下的BTIGW-BC，二者均实现任意时刻高概率安全、有限次回退与次线性遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文对决赌博机使用成对比较反馈（与RLHF微调语言模型相同），但标准算法探索激进，可能向用户展示两个糟糕选项，缺乏与可信基线对齐的安全保证。同时，既有安全认证方式（如CLUCB的检验）在上下文与相对得分约束下不再适用。

Method: 提出基于"效用差"而非绝对奖励的保守约束形式；证明迁移CLUCB安全检验的失败（线性遗憾）。设计MaxInP-BC：通过效用间隙认证得分，回退时将基线与"有信息量的伙伴"配对，使回退轮仍能驱动学习。设计BTIGW-BC：将在线逻辑回归oracle的保证转化为累计安全证书，适用于一般效用类。

Result: MaxInP-BC在线性效用下任意时刻高概率安全，遗憾为 Õ(d√T/κ) 加上不随horizon增长的保守性附加代价；BTIGW-BC在任意时刻安全、回退次数有限，且当oracle逻辑遗憾为次线性时整体遗憾次线性。实验显示两者均满足约束（无约束对照算法常违反），遗憾代价适中。

Conclusion: 保守性约束在相对得分形式下可被有效认证，关键在于通过效用间隙认证与信息性回退设计；朴素迁移既有安全检验不可行。所提方法在保证全程安全的同时保持近最优遗憾，为偏好反馈场景下的安全学习提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: Contextual dueling bandits learn from pairwise comparisons, the same feedback used to fine-tune language models from human preferences. Standard algorithms explore aggressively and can show users two poor options. We study conservative contextual dueling bandits, which require that, at every round, the cumulative score of the better displayed item stay above a $(1-α)$ fraction of a trusted baseline's. An item's score is its probability of beating the best available item, so the constraint depends only on utility differences and needs no absolute rewards. This also changes how safety can be certified: we show that transferring the safety test of the conservative bandit algorithm CLUCB unchanged can incur linear regret, even when the baseline's utilities are known exactly. For linear utilities, we develop MaxInP-BC, which certifies scores through utility gaps and, when it must fall back, pairs the baseline with an informative partner so that fallback rounds still drive learning. It is safe with high probability at all times, with regret $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}/κ)$ plus an additive cost of conservatism that does not grow with the horizon. For general utility classes, we develop BTIGW-BC, which turns the guarantee of an online logistic-regression oracle into cumulative safety certificates. It is safe at all times, makes finitely many fallbacks, and has sublinear regret whenever the oracle's logistic regret is sublinear. In experiments, both satisfy the constraint, which their unconstrained counterparts often violate, at a moderate cost in regret.

</details>


### [1051] [RankFormer: Rethinking Time Series Transformers through Representation Capacity Analysis and Progressive Decoding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36703v1)
*Peiwang Tang,Cheng HE,Xijie Liang,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RankFormer，一种基于秩（rank）分析框架设计的多变量时间序列预测编码器-解码器架构，通过 Hourglass Attention 增强编码秩稳定性，并用交互式渐进解码器提升多变量动态建模，在长期预测基准上达到与 SOTA 竞争的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 Transformer 的多变量时间序列预测模型虽经验性能强，但其表示表达能力的理论基础理解不足；同时许多模型采用通道独立建模与直接投影头等简化解码策略，限制了捕捉复杂多变量动态的能力。

Method: 建立基于秩的分析框架，考察 tokenization、embedding 与 attention 设计如何影响时间序列 Transformer 的表示容量；据此设计秩增强编码器（含 Hourglass Attention）以提升信息交互中的秩稳定性，并提出交互式渐进解码器（IPD），通过全局引导的跨通道交互与渐进式细化改进未来轨迹建模。

Result: 分析表明 patchification 通过将多个时间观测聚合到单个 token 提升了潜在表示容量，而后续编码操作决定该容量实现的程度；在真实世界长期预测基准上，RankFormer 与最先进方法相比取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 从秩的角度为时间序列 Transformer 的表示容量提供了理论解释，并据此指导架构设计，验证了秩增强编码与跨通道渐进解码在多元长期预测中的有效性。

Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data. Transformer-based models have achieved strong empirical performance in this domain, yet the principles governing the expressive capacity of their learned representations remain insufficiently understood. Moreover, many existing models rely on simplified decoding strategies, including channel-independent modeling and direct projection heads, which limit their ability to capture complex multivariate dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose RankFormer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture for multivariate time series forecasting. We establish a rank-based analysis framework to investigate how tokenization, embedding, and attention designs affect the representation capacity of time series Transformers. Our analysis reveals that patchification increases the potential representation capacity by aggregating multiple temporal observations into each token, while subsequent encoding operations determine how much of this capacity is realized. Guided by these insights, we develop a rank-enhancing encoder with Hourglass Attention to improve rank stability during information interaction. Furthermore, we introduce the Interactive Progressive Decoder (IPD), which improves future trajectory modeling through global-guided cross-channel interaction and progressive refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world long-term forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that RankFormer achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code repository: https://github.com/TangPeiwang/Rankformer.

</details>


### [1052] [HeteGCD: Statistics-Aware Dual-Prototype Learning for Generalized Category Discovery on Heterophilous Graphs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36696v1)
*Xuanzhi Xi,Tongze Zhang,Zhili Qin,Yulin Tao,Hongliang Wang,Zhong Zhang,Qinli Yang,Junming Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HeteGCD，从"统计感知的双原型学习"视角解决异质图上的广义类别发现（GCD）问题，在特征空间与概率空间同时挖掘判别信息，五个异质图数据集上优于24种基线组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质图（相连节点属性/类别不一致）在现实中普遍存在，但现有图GCD方法依赖同质性归纳偏置，难以适配；而现有异质图学习方法对邻居信号的选择与融合依赖全类别（含新类）监督，在GCD设定下不可用。因此核心问题是：在无新类监督的情况下，如何有效利用异质邻域信息进行类别发现。

Method: 提出统计感知的双原型学习框架：1) 门控双流编码器，同时输入节点属性与局部属性差异统计量，学习有判别力的节点表示；2) 双原型分类器，融合基于特征的相似性与基于分布的一致性，共同支撑类别发现；整个流程不依赖新类标签。

Result: 在五个异质图数据集上，与24种基线组合相比取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 利用局部属性差异统计与邻域类别分布这两类无需新类监督的信号，可在特征空间与概率空间协同提升异质图上的已知类识别与新类发现；统计感知的双原型设计是适配异质图GCD的有效范式。

Abstract: Heterophilous graphs are prevalent in real-world applications, where connected nodes often exhibit dissimilar attributes or belong to different classes, posing significant challenges to conventional graph learning methods based on homophily. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced in generalized category discovery (GCD), which requires models to recognize known classes and discover novel ones using labels from known classes only. However, existing graph GCD methods typically rely on aforementioned homophily-based inductive biases, which are ill-suited to heterophilous graphs. Meanwhile, although current heterophilous graph learning methods exploit diverse neighborhood signals, their selection and fusion are often guided by supervision across all classes, including novel classes whose labels are unavailable in GCD. These limitations raise a key question: how can heterogeneous neighborhood information be effectively leveraged for category discovery without any novel-class supervision? To answer this question, in this study we propose HeteGCD, a new statistics-aware dual-prototype learning perspective for generalized category discovery on heterophilous graphs. The key idea is to examine both statistics of local attribute differences and neighborhood class distribution to extract discriminative information in feature and probability spaces simultaneously. Specifically, a gated dual-stream encoder integrates both node attributes and local attribute-difference statistics to learn informative node representations. Afterwards, a dual-prototype classifier combines feature-based similarity with distribution-based consistency to support category discovery. Experiments on five heterophilous graphs show that HeteGCD achieves competitive performance against 24 baseline combinations.

</details>


### [1053] [Log-Derivative Trick for Parametric Markov Chains](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36655v1)
*Arthur Gall,Ichiro Hasuo,Thomas Seiller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于测度论广义对数导数技巧的可扩展蒙特卡洛梯度估计器，用于参数化马尔可夫链中期望奖励与可达概率优化，避免全局状态空间物化与线性系统求解，并证明无偏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号化合成方法（参数提升、有理函数生成）存在可扩展性瓶颈；已有梯度方法仍需在全局状态空间上做符号梯度计算（如求解大规模线性系统），同样受限；有限时域近似虽可行但引入不可控偏差。

Method: 将log-derivative trick推广到测度论框架，构造基于采样轨迹的蒙特卡洛梯度估计器：仅沿单条轨迹进行局部转移概率（或密度）及其导数的黑盒求值，不做全局状态空间物化，不求解线性系统。

Result: 在几乎必然终止与标准正则条件下证明估计器无偏；实验在合成离散pMC与连续状态案例中，可扩展至现有求解器无法企及的状态规模，显著降低运行时间且不引入偏差；框架自然覆盖连续及一般σ-有限状态空间。

Conclusion: 测度论蒙特卡洛梯度估计为pMC优化提供了一种无偏、可扩展且适用于连续/一般状态空间的替代方案，突破现有pMC技术局限于有限离散系统的限制。

Abstract: Optimizing expected rewards and reachability probabilities in parametric Markov chains (pMCs) is central to the analysis and synthesis of probabilistic systems with loops. While traditional symbolic synthesis approaches--such as parameter lifting and rational function generation--suffer from scalability bottlenecks, gradient-based optimization emerges as an effective alternative. However, existing gradient-based techniques still rely on symbolic gradient computation--such as solving large linear systems--over the global state space, inheriting scalability limits. Finite-horizon approximation is possible but introduces uncontrollable bias.
  In this paper, we introduce a scalable Monte Carlo gradient estimator based on a measure-theoretic generalization of the log-derivative trick. We prove that our estimator provides unbiased gradient estimates under almost-sure termination and standard regularity conditions. Crucially, our method avoids global state-space materialization and linear system solving entirely: it operates purely along sampled trajectories, requiring only black-box evaluations of local transition probabilities (or densities) and their derivatives. Unlike existing pMC techniques that are fundamentally restricted to finite discrete systems, our measure-theoretic framework naturally extends to continuous and general $σ$-finite state spaces. Empirical evaluations on synthetic discrete pMCs and continuous-state case studies demonstrate that our method scales to state spaces far beyond the reach of existing solvers, significantly reducing execution time without introducing bias.

</details>


### [1054] [TACO-Graph: Automated Construction of Text-Atributed Graphs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36650v1)
*Amiri Hayes,Kristina Wicke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TACO-Graph：用可解释决策树学习“给定数据集与任务下，哪种文本属性图(TAG)构建设计最有效”，在5个数据集上对节点分类与GraphRAG检索的构建质量预测Spearman ρ >0.9/>0.8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图结构文本表示被广泛使用，但如何从数据集中系统性构建图（哪些实体作节点、哪些关系作边、节点含哪些文本）缺乏原则性方法；不同构建选择显著影响下游性能，实践中依赖专家知识或手工试错。

Method: 聚焦于由多属性表格数据构建的文本属性图(TAG)。TACO-Graph先枚举所有有效的TAG表示；对每种表示在小型代表性子集上做快速代理评估(proxy evaluation)打分；再以这些分数训练可解释决策树，从而建模"数据集/任务特征—构建选择—构建质量"的关系。

Result: 在引用网络、产品评论、文献关系三类共5个数据集上，决策树对单独抽取的评估样本预测构建质量：节点分类平均Spearman ρ>0.9，GraphRAG检索平均ρ>0.8；决策树能系统性地区分在GNN与GraphRAG任务中表现更优的构建方式；流水线以开源库形式发布。

Conclusion: TACO-Graph为"如何将表格数据转换为文本属性图以服务下游任务"提供了系统化、可解释的指导，并可作为评估新任务与新数据集的开源工具。

Abstract: Graph-structured representations of text data have become foundational across machine learning, yet it remains unclear how to systematically construct a graph from a given dataset for a target task. Choices about which entities become nodes, which relationships become edges, and what text each node contains can substantially affect downstream performance. In practice, finding optimal constructions often requires expert knowledge or manual trial and error. We introduce TACO-Graph, a decision tree framework for learning which graph construction choices are most effective for a given dataset and task. Specifically, we focus on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) constructed from multi-attribute tabular data. TACO-Graph enumerates valid TAG representations, scores each using fast proxy evaluation on small representative subsets, and trains an interpretable decision tree on those scores. Across five datasets spanning citation networks, product reviews, and bibliographic relationships, our decision trees predict construction quality on separately drawn evaluation samples with mean Spearman $ρ$ above $0.9$ for node classification and above $0.8$ for GraphRAG retrieval. Our trees systematically identify which constructions perform better across both GNN and GraphRAG tasks, and the full pipeline is released as an open-source library to support evaluation on new tasks and datasets at https://github.com/AmiriHayes/text_attributed_graphs. TACO-Graph provides a systematic and interpretable guide for determining how to convert tabular data to text-attributed graphs for downstream tasks.

</details>


### [1055] [When Is a Cheap Fairness Edit Safe? Screening Post-Hoc Edits in Two-Sided Matching Markets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36649v1)
*Moirangthem Tiken Singha,Rabinder Kumar Prasada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究在双向匹配系统（如招生管道）推理阶段用闭式线性投影器降低受保护属性影响，并给出可证界与部署前筛选：对保持垂直序的市场界定福利变化上界，提出概率化精化与 PASS/KILL/OUT-OF-SCOPE 三态筛选，实验显示无违规且风险可控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双向匹配系统联合分配机会，降低受保护属性的影响通常需要重训练编码器，成本高且可能破坏原有结构。作者希望在推理时不重训练，直接用闭式线性投影完成编辑，同时能够对编辑后的平均福利变化给出可验证的界，并判断该后处理编辑在何种市场结构下是"可接受"的。

Method: 1）提出闭式线性投影器，在推理阶段对表征做编辑，避免编码器重训练。2）针对编辑前后仍保持垂直序（verticality：机会按吸引力对申请者排序）的市场，将平均福利变化用编辑引起的吸引力偏移(appeal shift)加显式余项(remainder)来界定。3）给出概率化精化：以数据依赖的偏差项替代最坏情形常数。4）设计部署前筛选：垂直性检验 + 福利扫描，输出 PASS / KILL / OUT-OF-SCOPE。5）区分 exact tier（每个机会都严格按吸引力排序申请者）与 graded tier（容许近似垂直市场）。

Result: 在 30 个留出合成市场上，筛选结果与所有预设制度判定一致，未观察到假 PASS；在 60 个严格垂直市场上无界被违反，概率界在 69%–87% 的配置中具有信息性；在来自三个真实市场的 2700 个配置（未达 exact tier）中，没有 plug-in 界表达式被违反。闭式因式分解在 90%–100% 的实例中保持在 graded 范围内，而 two-tower 与图神经网络编码器在所有实例中都落在范围外。

Conclusion: 后处理编辑是否可接受取决于编码器架构：闭式因式分解结构大多满足 graded 垂直性前提，two-tower/GNN 编码器则不满足。该筛选可作为部署前的可证安全关卡，且概率界比最坏情形界更有实际信息量。

Abstract: Two-sided matching systems, such as admissions pipelines, allocate opportunities jointly. Reducing a protected at tribute's influence usually requires encoder retraining. We study a closed-form linear projector that does this at inference time. For markets that stay vertically ordered before and after the edit, we bound the mean welfare change by the edit-induced appeal shift and an explicit remainder. A probabilistic refinement replaces worst-case constants with a data-dependent deviation term. A pre-deployment screen combines a verticality test with a welfare sweep and returns PASS, KILL, or OUT-OF-SCOPE. An exact tier requires every opportunity to rank applicants by appeal, and a graded tier admits near-vertical markets. On 30 held-out synthetic markets, the screen agrees with every pre-specified regime verdict, with no observed false PASS. On 60 exactly vertical markets, no bound is violated, and the probabilistic bound is informative in 69% to 87% of configurations. On 2700 configurations from three realistic markets, which do not reach the exact tier, no plug-in bound expression is violated. A closed-form factorization stays within graded scope in 90% to 100% of instances, whereas two-tower and graph neural network encoders fall outside it in every instance. Architecture choice thus appears to affect whether a post-hoc edit is admissible.

</details>


### [1056] [When Does Perturbation Consistency Add Information Beyond Softmax Confidence? Theory and Evidence for the Decision Consistency Framework](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36640v1)
*Amit Kalitaa,Moirangthem Tiken Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统检验扰动一致性分数（CS/CAG）是否提供干净softmax输出之外的信息，结论是：在干净数据上CS的误分类检测能力全面弱于MSP（冻结CNN下AUROC低0.057），代价却高8–15倍；但在置信度被误导的场景（噪声腐蚀、对抗攻击）下CS确有增益，且增益不迁移到未见偏移族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扰动一致性分数被广泛用作鲁棒性或不确定性代理，但缺乏对其"信息含量是否超出干净softmax输出"的严格判据。作者希望明确一致性分数何时有用、何时只是昂贵冗余，并从理论上刻画标签翻转的条件。

Method: 提出Decision Consistency Framework（DCF）：对每张图像在六种温和算子下计算标签稳定性（LS）与置信度偏差（CD），合成一致性分数CS，并以准确率与平均一致性之差（CAG）概括模型。开展201组评估、每组3个随机种子；与MSP比较AUROC；推导标签翻转的必要条件（logit margin ≤ √2 × logit位移）；据此构造无标签的split-conformal no-flip证书；在CIFAR-10-C噪声腐蚀与PGD攻击（预算2/255）下进行预注册测试，并考察跨偏移族迁移与OCTMNIST的负CAG成因。

Result: CS在所有模型族上对干净数据误分类的检测均弱于MSP；冻结CNN下AUROC差0.057（95% CI 0.043–0.073），计算量高8–15倍。固定margin下，位移预测错误的AUROC仅0.515（近乎随机）。no-flip证书在84次运行中从未被违反。噪声腐蚀下CS胜过margin，PGD攻击下CS区分干净/受攻击输入的AUROC为0.83，而MSP为0.37。噪声下的增益未能迁移到未见偏移族。OCTMNIST上大幅负CAG在全量微调与域内训练下仍存在，属部分类先验效应，校正先验可恢复约40%的差距。

Conclusion: 一致性分数的价值是条件性的：在干净数据上它不如MSP且代价高，不应作为通用不确定性度量；其信息仅在置信度被系统性误导（噪声、对抗扰动）时显现，且不保证跨偏移族泛化。logit-margin不等式同时给出了理论解释与可用的无标签no-flip证书。CAG作为模型级指标受类先验污染，需谨慎解读。

Abstract: Perturbation consistency scores judge whether a prediction survives small input changes. The Decision Consistency Framework (DCF) scores each image by label stability (LS) and confidence deviation (CD) under six mild operators, combines them into a consistency score (CS), and summarises a model by the gap between accuracy and mean consistency (CAG). We ask when these scores carry information that the clean softmax output lacks. Across 201 evaluations with three seeds per configuration, CS detected misclassifications on clean data less well than the maximum softmax probability (MSP) in every model family. For frozen CNNs, the deficit was 0.057 in area under the ROC curve (AUROC; 95% CI 0.043 to 0.073), at 8 to 15 times the compute. A label flip requires the logit margin to be at most the square root of two times the logit displacement, and at a fixed margin, the displacement predicted errors at AUROC 0.515. The same inequality gives a label-free split-conformal no-flip certificate, never violated in 84 runs. Consistency did add information where confidence is misled: under noise corruptions of CIFAR-10-C, it beat the margin, and under projected gradient attacks, it separated clean from attacked inputs with AUROC 0.83 against 0.37 for MSP at a budget of 2/255, as pre-specified. The gain under noise did not transfer to unseen shift families. The large negative CAG on OCTMNIST persists under full fine-tuning and in-domain training and is partly a class-prior effect: correcting the prior recovers about 40% of the gap.

</details>


### [1057] [Deep Bayesian Filtering for Nonlinear Structural System Identification: A Tutorial on Structural and Physical Inductive Biases](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36633v2)
*Wei Liu,Konstantinos Vlachas,Eleni Chatzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次以统一教程的形式系统梳理"深度贝叶斯滤波"在非线性结构系统辨识中的应用，连接模型构建、学习、后验推断与评估，并在含Bouc-Wen滞回连接的3D剪切框架基准上比较DMM、PgDMM与Neural EKF。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性结构系统辨识面临两大困难：控制物理仅部分已知、量测稀疏。深度贝叶斯滤波通过将可学习动力学表示与概率状态空间模型、物理归纳偏置和不确定性感知推断相结合来应对，但该领域尚缺乏统一的教程式梳理与方法论层面的比较。

Method: 提出统一教程框架，整合模型表述、学习、后验推断与评估；引入摊销变分推断与可微卡尔曼滤波作为互补策略。以深度马尔可夫模型（DMM）为数据驱动参照，物理引导深度马尔可夫模型（PgDMM）与神经扩展卡尔曼滤波（Neural EKF）为示例实例；在含滞回Bouc-Wen连接、稀疏加速度量测的三维剪切框架基准上开展动态状态估计与状态-参数联合估计。

Result: 对比分析得到若干新观察：物理结构提升潜状态可解释性，但不必然保证预测动力学忠实；典型重构精度相当的情况下，估计鲁棒性可能存在显著差异；重构精度、预测保真度、物理可解释性与估计鲁棒性之间关系并非单调一致。

Conclusion: 提出面向模型构建、训练与评估的实用准则，强调需区分重构、预测、状态恢复与参数辨识四类目标；并展望不确定性校准、可辨识性及真实结构验证等未来挑战。

Abstract: Nonlinear structural system identification remains challenging when governing physics is only partially known and measurements are sparse. Deep Bayesian filtering addresses these challenges by combining learnable dynamical representations with probabilistic state-space models, physical inductive biases, and uncertainty-aware inference. This paper presents, for the first time, a unified tutorial treatment of deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, connecting model formulation, learning, posterior inference, and evaluation. Amortized variational inference and differentiable Kalman filtering are introduced as complementary strategies within this broader framework. The Deep Markov Model (DMM) provides a data-driven reference, while the Physics-guided Deep Markov Model (PgDMM) and Neural Extended Kalman Filter (Neural EKF) serve as illustrative instances through which methodological choices and their implications are examined. Dynamic state estimation and joint state and parameter estimation are demonstrated on a three-dimensional shear-frame benchmark with hysteretic Bouc-Wen connections and sparse acceleration measurements. The comparative analysis yields new observations concerning the relationships among reconstruction accuracy, predictive fidelity, physical interpretability, and estimation robustness. Physical structure improves latent-state interpretability without necessarily ensuring faithful predictive dynamics, while comparable typical reconstruction accuracy can conceal substantial differences in estimation robustness. These findings motivate practical guidelines for model construction, training, and evaluation that distinguish reconstruction, forecasting, state recovery, and parameter identification. The tutorial concludes by outlining challenges in uncertainty calibration, identifiability, and validation on real structures.

</details>


### [1058] [The Batch Size Can Be One: Test-Time Adaptation from Classifier Geometry](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36628v1)
*Jaeho Hwang,Yujin Oh,Juhyeon Shin,Juhye Lee,Sungroh Yoon,Uiwon Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OriTTA：以源模型的合成原型为各类构建固定几何锚点（原点、类轴与理想点），将测试流中的选中特征对齐到预测类轴并约束半径，结合按类记忆与崩溃重置，在合成流上无需逐设定调参即在CIFAR-10-C/100-C/ImageNet-C的16种骨干-协议-顺序组合中取得batch size=1最高平均精度，且避免已有方法在ImageNet-C雾天上的崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实部署中测试流常逐样本到达且类别无序，单样本难以估计分布级统计量；基于置信度的样本选择会引入"错而自信"的伪标签；而腐蚀只使特征发生偏移、冻结分类器的决策区域不变，这一事实尚未被用于构造稳定的适应目标。

Method: （1）在特征空间中选择新原点，使各类得分更接近，同时保持其接近每类一个合成原型的均值特征；（2）由此原点出发，各原型方向分布更均匀，为每类预先得到一条类轴与一个理想点，构成与测试数据无关的固定几何目标；（3）在线适应时，将选中特征沿预测类轴对齐并惩罚过大半径；（4）按预测类在内存中各保留一个样本，限制流中缺失类别的特征漂移；（5）通过对内存样本重新分类检测崩溃并触发模型重置。

Result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C与ImageNet-C上，四种骨干、两种协议、两种流顺序共十六种组合中，batch size=1时平均精度均最高且无需逐设定调参；ImageNet-C fog上近期方法在100次运行中最多有三分之二崩溃，OriTTA从未崩溃。

Conclusion: 以源模型导出的固定几何目标替代对分布统计量的在线估计，可在单样本、类别无序的流式场景下实现稳健且免调参的测试时适应，并显著提升抗崩溃性。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation updates a deployed model on an unlabeled test stream. In practice this stream often arrives one sample at a time, with the classes in no particular order. A single sample then provides limited information for estimating distribution-level statistics, and selecting samples by confidence can admit predictions that are wrong yet confident. A corruption, however, shifts the features while leaving the decision regions of the frozen classifier unchanged. We therefore propose Origin-recentered Test-Time Adaptation (OriTTA), which constructs fixed geometric targets from the source model and adapts selected features toward them. Seen from the origin of the feature space, the classes lean toward a common direction. We choose a new origin to bring class scores closer together while keeping it near the mean feature of one synthetic prototype per class. From this origin, prototype directions spread more evenly, and each class obtains an axis and an ideal point before any test data arrives. During adaptation, OriTTA aligns selected features with their predicted class axis and penalizes excessive radius, keeps one input per predicted class in memory to limit feature changes for classes absent from the stream, and resets the model when re-classifying this memory reveals collapse. Without tuning for each setting, OriTTA achieves the highest mean accuracy at batch size 1 on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C and ImageNet-C in all sixteen combinations of four backbones, two protocols and two stream orders. On ImageNet-C fog, recent methods collapse in up to two thirds of one hundred runs, while OriTTA never does.

</details>


### [1059] [Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36618v1)
*Kuan Xu,Jianming Wang,Ni Zhang,Yaoxin Wu,Yong Wang,Zhiguang Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Dream-COP：将过往搜索轨迹及其记录结果视为"经验世界"（experience world），通过策略智能体在其中"做梦"（回放学习）得到可执行探索策略，用来指导发现智能体生成与改进组合优化算法程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可通过迭代程序生成与评估实现组合优化问题（COP）的算法发现，核心难题在于如何在有限预算内组织搜索以发现更优算法。作者观察到历史搜索轨迹及结果是可利用的经验资源，但现有方法（如固定探索策略）未能有效利用。

Method: 双智能体框架：①policy agent 在经验世界中通过dreaming（策略回放）学习可执行的探索策略，回放提供程序质量反馈与所耗搜索步数反馈，从而更有效地进行策略选择；②discovery agent 在该策略指导下生成与精化COP程序（启发式组件设计与完整求解器生成）。

Result: 在五类COP上，Dream优于固定探索策略；在KP上达到最优值，在OBPP上将间隙从2.112%降至1.199%，同时搜索请求减少42.5%；所学探索策略借助经验世界可有效跨COP迁移。

Conclusion: 将搜索历史组织为可回放的经验世界并学习探索策略，是提升LLM自动化算法发现预算效率与泛化性的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. Across five COPs, \textsc{Dream} discovers better algorithms than fixed exploration in both heuristic component design and complete solver generation. Particularly, it matches the optimal values on KP and reduces the gap on OBPP from 2.112\% to 1.199\% while using 42.5\% fewer search requests. Moreover, the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.

</details>


### [1060] [Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36617v1)
*Shang Tingyu,Cao Wenfei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于平衡截断的状态压缩方法，将 Mamba-2 的循环状态压缩目标从"逐坐标"转向"写入–读取子空间"，并配合按层分配秩的 HARP 策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba-2 将全部上下文压缩进固定尺寸循环状态，该状态主导解码显存与带宽。现有压缩器（量化和剪枝）在每个通道上独立打分，忽略了状态各坐标之间的方向结构，因而无法命中真正决定输入–输出映射的方向。

Method: 先对训练后的 Mamba-2 状态做经验分析：能量近似秩一，但能量集中在由递推累积的偏置式方向上，而输出实际读取的内容位于与状态坐标不对齐的低维子空间。据此提出一种训练后变换，用完整可控性/可观测性 Gramian 实现平衡截断，并借助 Mamba-2 的标量‑恒等状态转移精确施加旋转；再引入 HARP，依据 Hankel 谱为每层分配秩，并保护对检索敏感的层。校准仅需一次前向传播。

Result: 在 130M–2.7B 规模上，配合 HARP 将状态维度减半，WikiText-2 困惑度平均仅上升 0.3（1.8%），而 GHOST 上升 1.6（9.3%）；在 25% 保留率下差距进一步扩大；校准速度比 GHOST 公开协议快一个数量级，且峰值显存更低。

Conclusion: 状态压缩应针对写入–读取子空间而非单个坐标；平衡截断与 Hankel 谱驱动的逐层秩分配可在显著降低状态维度的同时保持困惑度与检索性能，并具备更低校准成本。

Abstract: Mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. Existing compressors quantize state values or prune state coordinates, scoring each channel independently in the native basis. We examine trained Mamba-2 states and find that energy is almost rank-one, but the output does not read the energetic directions: energy concentrates in a bias-like direction accumulated by the recurrence, while the content the output reads lives in a low-dimensional subspace that is not aligned with the state's coordinates. Even output-aware scores are computed coordinate by coordinate, so they miss the directions that determine the input--output map. Compression should therefore target the write--read subspace rather than individual coordinates. We propose \method{}, a post-training transform that instantiates balanced truncation with full controllability and observability Gramians and applies the rotation exactly via Mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. Because the useful rank varies widely across layers, we further introduce HARP, which allocates ranks per layer from the Hankel spectrum and protects retrieval-sensitive layers, improving both perplexity and retrieval over uniform budgets. Calibration takes a single forward pass, an order of magnitude faster than GHOST's released protocol, with lower peak memory. With HARP, \method{} halves the state dimension at an average WikiText-2 perplexity increase of $0.3$ points ($1.8\%$) across 130M--2.7B, versus $1.6$ ($9.3\%$) for GHOST, and the gap widens at 25\% retention.

</details>


### [1061] [Normalized Cuts and Data Clustering via Matrix Fractional Programming](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36616v1)
*Yannan Chen,Beichen Huang,Licheng Zhao,Chris Ding,Kaiming Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多维二次变换，将归一化割（NCut）问题从分数规划视角重构为二分匹配问题，可用线性搜索求解，并通过MM理论分析收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NCut是数据聚类的核心问题，但其分数结构很少从分数规划（FP）角度研究。原因在于传统FP方法不适用：经典Dinkelbach变换只能处理单一比值，仅适用于二类聚类，而多类聚类的NCut涉及多个比值项。

Method: 提出多维二次变换（multidimensional quadratic transform）以处理多比值情形，将NCut问题重铸为二分匹配问题，通过线性搜索即可求解；并探讨该方法与minorization-maximization（MM）理论的联系，据此刻画算法收敛行为。

Result: 在多种数据聚类与图像分割任务上的数值实验表明，所提基于FP的算法具有明显优势；并从MM理论角度给出了收敛性刻画。

Conclusion: 多维二次变换突破了Dinkelbach变换仅限单一比值的局限，为多类NCut提供了新的FP求解框架，兼具理论收敛保证与实验性能优势。

Abstract: The normalized cut (NCut) problem is a fundamental one in the area of data clustering. Despite its fractional structure, the NCut problem is seldom considered from a fractional programming (FP) perspective in the existing literature. The main reason is that the conventional FP method is inadequate for this problem case: the classical Dinkelbach's transform can only handle a single ratio and hence is limited to the two-class clustering, whereas the multi-class clustering involves multiple ratio terms. This work proposes a novel so-called multidimensional quadratic transform that is capable of dealing with the multi-ratio case; it recasts the NCut problem into a bipartite matching problem---which can be immediately solved by linear search. Furthermore, we explore the connection between the proposed FP method and the minorization-maximization (MM) theory, and in turn characterize the convergence behavior of our algorithm. Finally, we conduct experiments to numerically demonstrate the advantages of the proposed FP-based algorithm in a variety of data clustering and image segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [1062] [Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36587v1)
*Zeyu Wang,Yiheng Duan,Tao Chen,Donghyun Koo,Sihan Liu,Wenbo Zhang,Chuan He,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构化子空间随机舍入（S3R）及其误差校正版本 S3R-EC，通过为每个 token 在隐藏维度上共享单一随机阈值，并显式减去结构化均值舍入误差，在保持与独立 SR 相当收敛的同时，显著加速 INT8 训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准随机舍入（SR）需为每个梯度元素抽取独立阈值，而加速器的向量单元随机数生成吞吐远低于矩阵单元，导致 INT8+SR 训练反而慢于 BF16。跨元素共享阈值虽可消除该开销，但会迫使共享元素同向舍入并引入共同偏移；该偏移主要经激活梯度反向传播，前层无法用自身局部舍入误差抵消，故须在产生偏移的层处去除。

Method: 提出 S3R：对上游梯度只量化一次（复用于激活梯度与权重梯度两次矩阵乘），并在隐藏维度上按 token 共享单一随机阈值。进一步提出 S3R-EC 误差校正：从激活梯度与权重梯度中减去结构化均值舍入误差，且不改变优化器。

Result: 在 LLM 预训练实验中，未校正的阈值共享会使收敛退化；S3R-EC 可消除该退化，验证损失与独立 SR 持平。在 TPU v5p 上，稠密 LLM 的完整 INT8 训练步较 BF16 加速 1.24x–1.32x，较独立 SR 加速 1.11x。

Conclusion: 按 token 结构化共享随机阈值可在几乎零随机数开销下实现无偏性近似，但必须配合结构化均值误差校正；S3R-EC 是一种不侵入优化器、可显著加速低精度 LLM 训练的有效方案。

Abstract: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

</details>


### [1063] [Recall or Relearn? A Mixture of In-Context Experts for Recurring Concept Drift](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36585v1)
*Zhangkai Wu,Xu Zhang,Zhihong Cui,Yiqi Wang,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法MICE，将数据流按检测到的变化切分，把已结束段落合并为存储上下文，并用快慢两级加权在“回忆已见概念”与“重新学习”之间做权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）在网络入侵检测等Web数据流上靠更新上下文中的有标签行来适应，无需重训。当过去的概念离开上下文后又重现时，模型面临“回忆存储行”还是“用新标签重新学习”的抉择，且上下文容量有限，需要理论依据与实用策略。

Method: MICE按检测到的变化把流切分为段；当TFM在该段上的估计额外误差在容差内时，将闭合段合并进存储上下文，受存储上下文数量的容量上限约束。快级：按存储上下文与FIFO窗口在最近一个有标签批次上的对数损失加权；慢级：将快级预测与最近有标签行的FIFO窗口预测混合，限制折扣半Brier遗憾。

Result: 理论：在纯存储上下文与间隔（margin）条件下，快级相对重新学习的期望精度增益等于存储上下文精度曲线与TFM学习曲线之间的归一化正面积（至多差一个首批次项）；慢级在任意时刻对FIFO窗口的折扣半Brier遗憾有界。实测：学习曲线可预测回忆增益的排序；在随机边界相位的网格流上优于漂移即清空上下文的reset；合并得到的专家数少于存储每段的池化方法；固定切分下时间匹配的快照池在平移网格上与MICE持平；真实流上平均精度最高。

Conclusion: MICE为TFM在概念重现场景下的“回忆还是重学”提供了有理论保证的免训练方案，在合成与真实流上均优于对比策略且更节省存储，学习曲线还可作为回忆收益的预测量。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. We show that, with pure stored contexts and a margin condition, this fast level gains over relearning, in expected accuracy, the normalised positive area between the stored context's accuracy and the TFM's learning curve, up to a first-batch term. A slow level mixes the fast level's prediction with that of the FIFO window of the last labelled rows and bounds the discounted half-Brier regret of MICE against this window at every time. Learning curves measured beforehand predict the ordering of the observed recall gains. MICE outperforms reset, which empties the context at detected drifts, on grid streams with random boundary phases. Merging keeps fewer experts than pools that store every segment, and with fixed segmentation a time-matched snapshot pool matches MICE on the shifted grid. On real streams, MICE has the highest mean accuracy of all policies we compare.

</details>


### [1064] [MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36583v1)
*Md Wahiduzzaman Suva,Esm E Moula Chowdhury Abha,Md Imtiaj Alam Sajin,Md Iftekharul Mobin,Jia Uddin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MM-Net多模态多任务框架，通过cross-fitting与ridge嵌入对齐解决预训练EEG编码器在未见患者上的表示不一致问题，联合完成睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测，在卒中、健康及睡眠障碍队列上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺血性卒中后的自动多导睡眠图分析困难：睡眠相关神经活动改变且常合并呼吸紊乱。现有卒中专用方法多只做睡眠分期，缺乏睡眠结构与呼吸事件的联合分析；同时直接微调预训练EEG编码器会在训练（已见患者嵌入）与评估（未见个体）之间引入表示不一致。

Method: MM-Net：多模态多任务框架。采用cross-fitting与基于ridge的嵌入对齐消除表示不一致；将睡眠适配的EEG-EOG表示与工程化神经描述子，与学习得到的心肺特征通过cross-attention和共享时序建模融合，同时进行睡眠分期与呼吸事件检测。在iSLEEPS（99例亚急性缺血性卒中患者）上做十折患者独立评估，并在Sleep-EDF、ISRUC-I、UCD上验证泛化。

Result: iSLEEPS上分期准确率76.3%（Cohen's κ=0.656），呼吸事件AUC 0.825，匹配协议下优于所评估基线；对齐后睡眠适配编码器较冻结编码器提升1.4个百分点（p=0.020），未对齐仅0.2个百分点。Sleep-EDF分期准确率86.4%，高于所有重实现的单EEG架构；ISRUC-I上80.3%分期准确率与0.889呼吸AUC，超过重训分期基线。不重训时，iSLEEPS模型在ISRUC-I与UCD上仍保持呼吸AUC 0.833与0.841。

Conclusion: 结果支持表示一致的神经适配与联合生理建模在卒中、健康睡眠及睡眠障碍队列间的有效性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. Sleep-adapted EEG-EOG representations and engineered neural descriptors are fused with learned cardiorespiratory features through cross-attention and shared temporal modeling for simultaneous sleep staging and respiratory-event detection. On iSLEEPS (99 patients with subacute ischemic stroke), ten-fold patient-independent evaluation achieved 76.3% staging accuracy (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.656) and 0.825 respiratory-event AUC, outperforming the evaluated baselines under matched protocols. The sleep-adapted encoder improved the downstream model when its embeddings were aligned, raising staging accuracy by 1.4 percentage points over the frozen encoder ($p$ = 0.020) versus 0.2 points without alignment. MM-Net also achieved 86.4% staging accuracy on Sleep-EDF, above every single-EEG architecture reimplemented on the same recordings, and 80.3% staging accuracy with 0.889 respiratory AUC on ISRUC-I, exceeding its retrained staging baselines. Without retraining, the iSLEEPS-trained model retained respiratory AUCs of 0.833 on ISRUC-I and 0.841 on UCD. These findings support representation-consistent neural adaptation and joint physiological modeling across stroke, healthy-sleep, and sleep-disorder cohorts.

</details>


### [1065] [Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36576v1)
*Yihan Wang,Peiyu Liu,Runyu Chen,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AutoProfiler，从优化反馈中学习确定性的profiling决策树，为不同kernel自适应选择profiling信息，提升GPU kernel自动优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的GPU kernel优化系统依赖预定义的profiling策略，"该profiling什么"被排除在优化过程之外；且作者发现profiling指标数量增加并不单调提升优化效果，最有用的profiling信息因kernel而异。

Method: 理论分析表明在profiling效用异质的情况下，以kernel为条件的选取可优于任意单一固定配置。据此提出AutoProfiler：以优化反馈为驱动，学习一棵确定性profiling树，通过REWRITE与SPLIT操作迭代改进，由LLM生成候选修改、经验评估决定是否接受；树构建完成后可快速为任意kernel采集所需profiling信息，仅需调用一次LLM rewriter。

Result: 在KernelBench上，于受限profiling预算下，相比固定profiling配置取得了更好的kernel优化效果。

Conclusion: 硬件profiling应从静态指标采集转向profiling推理，使profiling本身成为改进kernel优化的新维度。

Abstract: Large language models have recently shown strong potential for automatically optimizing GPU kernels, yet their effectiveness depends critically on the hardware information available to the kernel optimization model. Existing systems typically rely on predefined profiling strategies, leaving what to profile largely outside the optimization process. We show that effective profiling is not simply about collecting more information: increasing the number of profiling metrics does not monotonically improve kernel optimization, while the most useful profiling information varies across kernels. Our theoretical analysis further shows that, under such heterogeneous profiling utility, kernel-conditioned selection can outperform any single fixed profiling configuration. Motivated by this observation, we propose AutoProfiler, a feedback-driven framework for learning a deterministic profiling tree from optimization feedback. The tree is iteratively refined through REWRITE and SPLIT operations, with an LLM generating candidate modifications and empirical evaluation determining their acceptance. Once constructed, the tree quickly gathers the required profiling information for any kernel, allowing the LLM rewriter to be invoked only once. Experiments on KernelBench show that our approach improves kernel optimization over fixed profiling configurations under constrained profiling budgets. These results suggest that hardware profiling should evolve from static metric collection toward profiling reasoning, making profiling itself a new dimension for improving kernel optimization. The codes are available at https://github.com/Satissss/AutoProfiler.

</details>


### [1066] [Learning from Points and Patches: A Pre-trained Hybrid Attention Transformer for Time Series Analysis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36572v1)
*Peiwang Tang,Cheng HE,Yupeng Ye,Weitai Zhang,Qinghua Sun,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出通用时间序列预训练框架 TimeHAT，以统一点-片段掩码策略（UPPMS）解决"学什么"、以混合注意力编码器（HAE）解决"怎么学"，在分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测四类任务及微调/少样本/零样本设定下取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web 服务与互联系统产生的时间序列支撑用户活动分析、服务监控与资源管理等应用，但从异构时间序列中学习可迁移表征仍具挑战：时间模式多样、序列长度可变、高质量标注稀缺。NLP 与 CV 中预训练虽成功，但时间序列预训练需要针对时序数据定制的策略。

Method: 框架围绕"学什么"与"怎么学"两个互补问题展开：(1) 学什么——提出统一点-片段掩码策略（UPPMS），在统一框架内整合点级与片段级监督，同时用于上下文重建与因果外推，使模型兼顾细粒度时序变化与宏观时序模式；(2) 怎么学——设计混合注意力编码器（HAE），在浅层使用前缀约束的双向注意力、在深层使用方向性混合注意力，以在保留有效上下文交互的同时缓解秩退化（rank degeneration）。

Result: 在真实数据集与四类下游任务（分类、长期预测、插补、异常检测）上评测，覆盖微调、少样本与零样本迁移设置，均表现出有竞争力的性能。代码已开源。

Conclusion: TimeHAT 作为通用时间序列预训练框架，通过点-片段联合掩码监督与分层混合注意力设计，有效支撑多任务、多迁移设定的时序分析，验证了面向时序数据定制预训练策略的必要性与可行性。

Abstract: Time-series data generated by Web services and connected systems support applications such as user activity analysis, service monitoring, and resource management. However, learning transferable representations from heterogeneous time series remains challenging due to diverse temporal patterns, variable sequence lengths, and limited high-quality annotations. Despite the success of pre-training in natural language processing and computer vision, effective time-series pre-training requires strategies tailored to temporal data.
  We propose TimeHAT (Hybrid Attention Transformer), a general-purpose pre-training framework for time-series analysis that addresses two complementary questions: what to learn and how to learn. For what to learn, we introduce a Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy (UPPMS) that integrates point-level and patch-level supervision within a unified framework for contextual reconstruction and causal extrapolation, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained temporal variations and broader temporal patterns. For how to learn, we develop a Hybrid Attention Encoder (HAE) that combines prefix-constrained bidirectional attention in initial layers with directional hybrid attention in deeper layers, aiming to preserve effective contextual interactions while mitigating rank degeneration.
  We evaluate TimeHAT across real-world datasets and four downstream tasks: classification, long-term forecasting, imputation, and anomaly detection. Experiments cover fine-tuning, few-shot, and zero-shot transfer settings, demonstrating competitive performance across diverse time-series analysis tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/TangPeiwang/TimeHAT.

</details>


### [1067] [Holomorphic Cauchy Networks for Efficient Stationary Tail Computation in High-Dimensional Reflected Brownian Motions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36558v1)
*Kehan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出全纯柯西网络（HCN），在NN4MGF的BAR框架基础上以复值有理柯西子网络原生强制全纯性，实现高维反射布朗运动稳态尾概率的高效精确计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维反射布朗运动（RBM）的稳态尾计算在计算上仍具挑战性；现有NN4MGF方法依赖采样柯西-黎曼惩罚项及其输入导数图，带来额外计算与内存开销，且缺乏结构性约束的理论保证。

Method: 构建HCN：采用复值有理柯西子网络，在无极点域上原生满足全纯性，去除采样CR惩罚与相应导数图；通过精确原点锚定与边界坐标排除强制结构恒等式，以锚定交互表示相依变换；闭式实轴导数与顺序反向传播控制内存。理论上在全纯对数假设下证明值函数与一阶导数的同时逼近，并给出非零互协方差下仅坐标表示的混合导数下界。

Result: 同一NVIDIA H100 NVL上，30D配置峰值显存约为NN4MGF的1/10，平均更新时间快9.7倍，外推全调度更新耗时比为58.2；高维运行每轮采样6400万基础输入，在笔记本GPU上达到50维、阈值1–8平均相对误差6.367%；同次数匹配比较中主评估区间误差更低，2D Harrison非乘积基准为1.422% vs 6.684%；10D相关算例验证了交互扩展。

Conclusion: HCN通过将全纯性内建于网络结构，在保持逼近精度的同时显著降低内存与时间开销，可扩展至50维RBM尾计算，并为受约束架构提供逼近理论支撑。

Abstract: Stationary tail computation for high-dimensional reflected Brownian motions (RBMs) remains computationally challenging. Building on NN4MGF's shared-coordinate basic-adjoint-relationship (BAR) framework, we develop Holomorphic Cauchy Networks (HCNs). Native complex-valued rational Cauchy subnetworks enforce holomorphicity on pole-free domains, removing sampled Cauchy-Riemann penalties and their input-derivative graphs. Exact origin anchoring and boundary-coordinate exclusion enforce structural identities, while anchored interactions represent dependent transforms. Under holomorphic-log assumptions, we establish simultaneous value and first-derivative approximation for the constrained architectures and a mixed-derivative lower bound for coordinate-only representations under nonzero cross-covariance. Closed-form real-axis derivatives and sequential backpropagation further control memory. On the same NVIDIA H100 NVL, the tested 30D HCN configuration uses approximately tenfold less peak allocated memory and has 9.7-fold lower mean update time than NN4MGF; extrapolation to the respective scheduled update counts gives a projected full-schedule update-time ratio of 58.2. With 64 million sampled base inputs per high-dimensional run, HCN reaches 50 dimensions on a laptop GPU with 6.367% mean relative error over thresholds 1 through 8. Degree-matched comparisons yield lower reported mean relative errors over the primary evaluation ranges, including 1.422% versus 6.684% on the 2D Harrison non-product benchmark. An exploratory 10D correlated example illustrates the interaction extension.

</details>


### [1068] [NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36553v1)
*Shuo Chen,Li Cui,Cunxin Huang,Ya-Feng Liu,Minghang Xie,Meng Xu,Zaikun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于大语言模型智能体的无导数优化求解器NextEval，将LLM智能体与数值环境结合以引导序贯采样点选择，并配套构建NextEval Bench基准协议，在低维DFO问题上展现出优于最先进基线的函数评估效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无导数优化中导数不可用或代价高昂，常见于仿真与实验场景，黑箱目标函数评估本身昂贵。因此在有限预算下有效利用已累积的观测信息、选择高信息量的评估点，仍是DFO的核心挑战。

Method: 构建LLM智能体与数值环境耦合的系统：环境提供历史评估分析与数值方法执行工具，并维护共享评估历史与方法特定状态以支持方法切换后的延续；LLM智能体依据观测与工具反馈选择工具、配置参数并分配评估预算，候选点由数值方法计算与评估。同时提出NextEval Bench基准协议，在相同数值工具、匹配评估预算与信息约束下比较不同智能体配置。

Result: 在低维DFO问题上的数值实验表明，NextEval求解器在函数评估效率上优于最先进的DFO基线方法。

Conclusion: 将LLM智能体与数值优化工具结合，可有效调度多种DFO方法并提升有限预算下的评估效率；所提出的基准协议为智能体式DFO配置的公平比较提供了规范框架。

Abstract: Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing agent configurations on shared DFO tasks using the same numerical tools under matched evaluation budgets and information constraints. Numerical results on low-dimensional DFO problems demonstrate that the NextEval solver outperforms the state-of-the-art DFO baselines in function-evaluation efficiency.

</details>


### [1069] [Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36520v1)
*Utkarsh Kanwat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"折叠"方案，把 Attention Matching 的逐键偏置沿每头一条闭式方向并入键向量，从而得到普通 KV cache，可在未改动的 FlashAttention/vLLM paged cache 中直接服务，精度与 AM 相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Attention Matching (AM) 通过每头保留部分 key、重拟合 value、并给每个保留 key 的 logit 加偏置来压缩 KV cache，但 FlashAttention 与 vLLM 的 paged cache 没有接收该偏置的接口，导致 AM 难以在主流推理栈落地。

Method: 将偏置并入 key：对每个 head，在 context queries 上拟合一条闭式求解的方向，把该偏置沿这一方向折算进 key；得到的 cache 规模与 head 维度同 AM 一致，且沿用模型自身的 query 路径，输出误差由每个 query 在该方向上投影偏离 1 的程度所界定。以相等每头预算，通过 KV connector 在未改动的 vLLM 中服务折叠 cache。

Result: 等每头预算下：Qwen3-4B 全部 51 题与 Hugging Face 答案一致，Qwen3-14B 的 200 条 LongBench 样本中 180 条贪心输出一致；QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B、Llama-3.1-8B）与 LongHealth（三个 Qwen3）共 14 个设置中 13 个与 AM 精度在噪声范围内，且 12 个可比设置中 KL 均低于去掉偏置的版本。按论文发布的每头预算：Qwen3-4B、其 Instruct-2507 变体与 Llama-3.1-8B 共 10 个设置中 9 个与 AM 在噪声范围内，KL 不再优于去偏置版本，两者在精度上各胜一次。

Conclusion: 偏置折叠可在不修改注意力内核的前提下保留 AM 的压缩收益，使 AM 类方法可直接部署于 vLLM；在宽松预算下与 AM 精度持平并优于朴素去偏置，在紧预算下与 AM 基本持平、KL 优势消失。

Abstract: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.

</details>


### [1070] [PRISM: Pathology Reliability In Scarce-label Medicine. A Tile-level Benchmark of Pathology Foundation Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36517v1)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个 tile 级病理基础模型基准，围绕模型选择、标签比例、校准与跨机构分布外迁移四轴，联合评估 8 个基础模型在 6 个数据集、6 档标签比例（1%–100%）、3 个随机种子下的 864 次线性探针实验，并扩展至 Camelyon17 的 5 家医院 20 组有向迁移对（共 288 个评估单元）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型评测多局限于全标签、同分布测试集上的分类性能，校准性、低标签预算下的行为以及跨机构分布偏移下的鲁棒性很少被联合考察，缺乏对"可靠性"的整体刻画。

Method: 构建 tile 级基准 PRISM：选取 8 个基础模型（CLIP、PLIP、CONCH、UNI、Virchow2、GigaPath、H-Optimus-0、Midnight），在 6 个 tile 级数据集上以 6 档标签比例与 3 个种子进行线性探针训练（864 次运行），并在 Camelyon17 上构造 5 家医院间的 20 组有向迁移对，联合测量 AUROC、ECE 与温度缩放校准效果，辅以 Spearman 相关与 I² 异质性分析。

Result: 得到四点发现：(i) 全监督下 AUROC 排名可稳定预测温度缩放后的校准排名（rho=0.52，I²=0%），而 1% 标签时该关系转为数据集特异（rho=-0.24，I²=67%）；(ii) 在较难数据集上，标签比例低于某一数据集特定阈值时线性探针塌缩为单一预测类别；(iii) 额外源域标签是否有益取决于迁移质量，迁移 AUROC 低于约 0.85 时，更多标签在 86–88% 的组合中使目标域 ECE 恶化；(iv) 温度缩放在 288 个单元中有 49 个未能降低 ECE，误校准以欠自信为主，迁移失败时源域拟合温度具有负作用。

Conclusion: 模型的分类能力排名不能可靠外推到校准与低标签/跨机构场景，病理基础模型的可靠性需多轴联合评估；PRISM 以 pip 可安装包形式发布，并提供全部 288 个单元的参考结果与开源代码数据，便于后续复现与扩展。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly. We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer. PRISM evaluates eight foundation models (CLIP, PLIP, CONCH, UNI, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-0, Midnight) on six tile-level datasets at six label fractions (1% to 100%) with three seeds (864 linear probe runs), extended with a five-hospital Camelyon17 study of 20 directed transfer pairs. Four phenomena emerge. (i) Under full supervision, AUROC rank predicts post-temperature calibration rank consistently across datasets (Spearman rho = 0.52, I^2 = 0%), whereas at 1% labels the relationship becomes dataset-specific (rho = -0.24, I^2 = 67%). (ii) On harder datasets the linear probe collapses to a single predicted class below a dataset-specific label fraction.
