We construct four movie-trailer editing task types---Content Selection, Narrative Sequencing, Rough Cut, and Fine Cut---that reflect real-world editing workflows and span different levels of task complexity and interaction horizon. Decaying process rewards provides the largest benefit on Fine Cut, with a 45.4% relative gain over outcome-only GRPO on tasks averaging more than 60 turns under outcome-only GRPO. On the three shorter-horizon task types averaging 30--40 turns under the same baseline, outcome-only GRPO remains competitive, with decaying process rewards yielding at most a 10.4% relative gain. Process rewards from an LLM judge initially improve tool use and encourage visual inspection. As training progresses, however, GRPO+PRM with a fixed process-reward weight increasingly exhibits excessive reasoning and redundant tool calls: process rewards continue to rise while task completion rates and outcome scores decline. Decaying the process-reward weight to zero mitigates this reward-hacking behavior while preserving the early gains. Despite dense token-level supervision, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) yields little improvement or substantial degradation and is highly sensitive to the choice of privileged information. Our analysis reveals differences in teacher--student disagreement and gradient magnitudes, and suggests possible dilution of informative signals over long trajectories.

</details>


### [1140] [Evaluating Bayesian deep learning for robust biomedical time-series classification under distribution shift: A sleep scoring case study](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35484v1)
*Mads Birch Sørensen,Ulrike Richter,Francois Gastambide,Michael Riis Andersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文以啮齿动物睡眠分期为案例，系统评估贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）在基因型、实验室和物种三类分布偏移下的鲁棒性，比较9种近似推断方法与2种网络骨干，发现多盆地（multi-basin）方法最优，BMA总体提升OOD准确率与校准，但ID增益有限，且在评分者间分歧检测上未见改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学时间序列分类中，机器学习模型在分布偏移下准确率与校准性能下降。作者希望量化贝叶斯式深度学习通过BMA在多大程度上改善鲁棒性。

Method: 以啮齿动物睡眠分期为案例，在基因型、实验室、物种分布偏移下评估BMA；系统比较涵盖单盆地与多盆地两类范式的9种近似推断方法，跨2种神经网络骨干，在ID数据和5个OOD数据集上进行评测。

Result: 多盆地方法表现最佳，优于基线与单盆地方法；相较点估计，BMA在两种架构上普遍提升OOD准确率与校准，ID增益仅为适度；BMA常改善选择性预测、OOD检测与伪迹检测，但未改善评分者间分歧检测。

Conclusion: BMA可作为一种有效的鲁棒性手段提升生物医学时间序列分类的OOD准确率与校准，其中多盆地近似推断更为可取；但其收益具有任务依赖性，对标注主观性（评分者分歧）无显著帮助。

Abstract: In biomedical time-series classification, machine learning models often suffer from deteriorating accuracy and calibration due to distribution shift. We investigate to what degree Bayesian-inspired deep learning improves robustness through Bayesian model averaging (BMA). Using rodent sleep scoring as a case study, we evaluate BMA under distribution shifts in genotype, laboratory, and species. We systematically compare nine approximate inference methods spanning single- and multi-basin approaches across two neural network backbones on in-distribution (ID) data and five out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. In our results, multi-basin methods perform best, outperforming baselines and single-basin methods. Compared with point estimates, BMA generally improves OOD accuracy and calibration across both architectures, while yielding only modest ID gains. It also often improves selective prediction and OOD and artifact detection, but, interestingly, not inter-rater disagreement detection.

</details>


### [1141] [GPDPO: Learning from Reward Conflicts via Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35480v1)
*Zixuan Xu,Haoxuan Chen,Jiangxin Sun,Jian-Fang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GPDPO：从被冲突过滤的rollout中挖掘Pareto支配关系，转化为成对偏好辅助信号与原策略目标联合优化，实现多奖励对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励RL对齐LLM时，冲突奖励信号导致更新方向模糊、优化不稳定。现有方法（奖励重加权、梯度协调、rollout过滤）仅在逐响应或组级信号上操作，未利用采样响应间的关系信息，导致被冲突过滤的rollout中仍有可用监督被丢弃。

Method: GPDPO识别采样响应间的Pareto支配关系，将其转换为辅助偏好信号，并与原始策略优化目标联合训练；无需额外采样或奖励评估即可复用现有rollout。

Result: 在API-Bank上跨多种模型规模与奖励配置，GPDPO一致优于竞争性多奖励优化基线；分析显示其同时降低了组内相对奖励冲突与成对奖励冲突。

Conclusion: 利用响应间关系监督可有效复用被过滤rollout，缓解多奖励冲突，为多奖励对齐提供有效路径；代码将开源。

Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning offers a promising framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse objectives, but conflicting reward signals can induce ambiguous update directions and hinder stable optimization. Existing approaches address such conflicts through reward reweighting, gradient coordination, or rollout filtering, yet they primarily operate on per-response or group-level optimization signals and underexploit relational information among sampled responses. As a result, conflict-filtered rollouts may still contain useful supervision that is discarded during training. We propose Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization (GPDPO), a multi-reward policy optimization method that recovers pairwise supervision from conflict-filtered rollouts. GPDPO identifies Pareto-dominance relations among sampled responses and converts them into auxiliary preference signals, which are jointly optimized with the original policy objective. This enables more effective reuse of existing rollouts without additional sampling or reward evaluation. Experiments on API-Bank across multiple model scales and reward configurations show that GPDPO consistently outperforms competitive multi-reward optimization baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that GPDPO reduces both group-relative and pairwise reward conflicts, supporting the effectiveness of exploiting relational supervision for multi-reward alignment. Code will be released.

</details>


### [1142] [Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE) on Rare-Failure Rates of Fine-Tuned LLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35472v1)
*Patrick Reichherzer,Jonathan Evertz,Thorsten Holz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ALE（Amplify, Locate, Estimate）方法，利用安全微调引起的token对数概率变化构造"放大方向"，将罕见失败率提升到可廉价测量的区间，再通过得分函数估计与重要性采样反推回极低目标失败率（低至约1e-5）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全微调使不良行为出现频率极低，直接采样测量其频率成本过高：在固定相对精度下，所需采样预算与失败概率成反比，可能导致数十万次rollout。

Method: 1）以安全微调前后的token对数概率变化定义放大方向，沿该方向提高失败率以便低成本测量；2）构建得分函数估计器，用被选中放大批次中失败样本的token概率恢复对数失败率的局部斜率，从而外推回罕见目标率；3）同时利用放大批次给出重要性采样估计。

Result: 在41个评测目标上，ALE的估计值与参考值之比中位数接近1，其中37个估计值与独立直接测量得到的参考值相差在三倍以内。消融实验表明，在约1000条有标注rollout加上一次廉价无标注扫描的预算下，ALE可估计Qwen3-8B微调模型低至约1e-5的失败概率。

Conclusion: ALE以"放大—定位—估计"的框架显著降低罕见失败概率测量的采样成本，在保持估计准确性的同时将可测量范围推进到直接采样难以企及的极低概率区间。

Abstract: Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive. We introduce Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE), a method for estimating such rare failure probabilities efficiently. ALE uses the change in token log-probabilities induced by the safety fine-tuning to define an amplification direction, along which we increase the failure rate for cheap measurement. We develop a score-function estimator that uses the selected amplified batch to recover the local slope of the log failure rate from the token probabilities of the sampled failures, enabling extrapolation back to rare target rates. We also use the amplified batch to obtain an importance-sampling estimate. Across 41 evaluation targets, ALE's estimate-to-reference ratios have a median close to one, with 37 ALE estimates within a factor of three of reference values obtained from independent direct measurements. Ablation tests show that with a budget of up to $\sim$1000 labeled rollouts, in addition to a cheap unlabeled scan, ALE estimates failure probabilities for Qwen3-8B fine-tunes down to about $10^{-5}$, where direct measurement can require hundreds of thousands of rollouts, as the required sampling budget scales inversely with failure probability at fixed relative precision.

</details>


### [1143] [Multi-Horizon Future Discovery for Physics-Informed Exploration](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35468v1)
*Shuwei Wang,Qiang Guan,Brian Qiu,Haoxiang Huang,Haoxi Wang,Chenyu Li,Bo Xu,Sen Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HTC²：用多尺度时序对比表征与哈密顿相空间结构调制内在奖励，提升物理控制环境中的探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理控制环境中的有效探索需找到"后果能揭示未知动力学"的动作，但现有内在动机方法依赖即时预测误差、状态新颖性或局部物理变化，容易忽略在较长时域上才显现信息的探索后果。

Method: 提出 Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC²)：以带时域条件（horizon-conditioned）的对比式 critic，在同轨迹内采样未来状态对学习多时域时序表征；将正样本对表征间距离作为内在奖励，鼓励探索表征中尚未被组织的未来；并用有界多步哈密顿量变化（非直接奖励哈密顿量本身的变化）对该奖励进行调制以注入物理动力学信息。框架与 SAC、PPO 集成。

Result: 在六个 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上评测，与 ICM、RIDE、E3B、Plan2Explore 及单步哈密顿好奇心基线比较，并辅以状态覆盖度评估、组件消融与相空间诊断，用于刻画时序学习与物理结构各自对探索行为的贡献。

Conclusion: 结构化可达未来表征可作为更有效的探索基础：多时域时序对比学习提供奖励信号，哈密顿相空间结构以调制方式而非直接奖励形式提供物理先验，二者结合在物理控制任务中改善探索表现。

Abstract: Exploration in physical control environments requires agents to identify actions whose consequences reveal previously unexplored aspects of the underlying dynamics. However, many intrinsic motivation methods rely on immediate prediction errors, state novelty, or local physical changes, which may overlook informative outcomes that emerge across extended temporal horizons. We investigate whether learning structured representations of reachable futures can provide a more effective basis for exploration. To this end, we introduce Hamiltonian Temporal Contrastive Curiosity (HTC$^2$), a framework that combines multi-horizon temporal representation learning with Hamiltonian phase-space structure. A horizon-conditioned contrastive critic learns temporal relationships from future-state pairs sampled within the same episode. The distance between positive-pair representations is then used as an intrinsic reward, encouraging the agent to explore futures that remain insufficiently organized in the learned representation. To incorporate information about physical dynamics, we additionally modulate this reward using bounded multi-step Hamiltonian variation, rather than directly rewarding changes in the Hamiltonian itself. We integrate HTC$^2$ with both Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and evaluate it across six DeepMind Control Suite tasks. Comparisons with ICM, RIDE, E3B, Plan2Explore, and a single-step Hamiltonian curiosity baseline are complemented by state-coverage evaluations, component ablations, and phase-space diagnostics to characterize the contributions of temporal learning and physical structure to exploratory behavior.

</details>


### [1144] [Prior Predictive Matching for Bayesian LoRA](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35457v1)
*Tomasz Kuśmierczyk,Eliezer de Souza da Silva,Marcin Sendera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种在微调之前即可运行的闭式先验预测估计器，用于为贝叶斯LoRA自动选择先验超参数。作者通过二阶展开证明先验预测量仅依赖"秩×先验尺度四次方"，利用样本残差协方差构造矩匹配估计器，并从理论上得出最优先验精度随秩按 $r^{-1/2}$ 缩放，从而一次估计即可推广到所有秩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯LoRA变体能在微调大基础模型时提供有原则的不确定性估计，但其正确性依赖于对低秩权重更新的先验设定；该先验超参数（尺度/精度）难以选择，现有做法如边际似然选择或依赖验证数据均有代价。

Method: 1) 对网络做二阶展开，量化低秩先验如何驱动函数空间相对预训练输出的偏差；2) 证明先验预测量仅通过 $r\cdot\sigma^4$（秩与先验尺度四次方之积）依赖先验；3) 由于训练目标共享同一潜在权重更新采样，利用样本残差之间的协方差进行矩匹配，得到闭式估计器；4) 理论分析给出最优先验精度关于秩的 $r^{-1/2}$ 缩放律。

Result: 在回归与分类的受控实验中，近似得到验证，估计器能恢复真实先验尺度；在RoBERTa-large上，无需验证数据即可在预测NLL与校准上优于MAP选择与边际似然选择，OOD检测性能具竞争力。

Conclusion: 先验尺度可由微调前的闭式矩匹配一次性估计，且借助 $r^{-1/2}$ 缩放律可跨秩泛化，为贝叶斯LoRA提供了实用、免验证集的先验选择方案。

Abstract: Bayesian variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provide principled uncertainty estimation when fine-tuning large foundation models, but require specifying the prior over the low-rank weight updates. We address this hyperparameter selection problem by introducing a closed-form prior-predictive estimator that operates before fine-tuning.
  We analyze a second-order expansion of the network and quantify how the low-rank prior drives function-space deviations from the pretrained outputs. We also show that these prior-predictive quantities depend on the prior only through the product of the adaptation rank and the fourth power of the prior scale. Because the training targets share a single draw of the latent weight update, we can leverage the covariance between example residuals to derive a moment-matching estimator. Furthermore, our theoretical analysis establishes that the optimal prior precision scales as $r^{-1/2}$ with the rank $r$, allowing a single estimate to generalize across all ranks.
  Controlled experiments across regression and classification tasks validate our approximation and show that our estimator recovers the true prior scale. On RoBERTa-large, our approach improves predictive negative log-likelihood (NLL) and calibration over both MAP and marginal-likelihood selection without requiring validation data, while achieving competitive out-of-distribution detection.

</details>


### [1145] [Intent-Preserving Adversarial User Simulation for Multi-Turn Agent Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35426v1)
*Atri Vivek Sharma,Brian Formento,Alessio Lomuscio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 StressSim：一种保持用户意图不变的对抗式用户模拟器框架，通过遗传式提示优化为每个任务实例生成"有挑战但合理"的用户交互，用于压力测试多轮对话 agent，暴露标准模拟器掩盖的鲁棒性缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的多轮 agent 评测普遍使用模拟用户，而模拟用户往往过度配合，导致对 agent 性能的高估，难以揭示真实部署中的鲁棒性缺陷；手工设计的非协作用户行为又缺乏覆盖度和真实性。

Method: StressSim 针对每个任务实例优化模拟器的"高层对抗计划"：用遗传式提示优化（genetic prompt optimisation）循环进化候选规划器提示，以 rollout 轨迹、细粒度任务完成信号和有效性反馈作为适应度信号，在"降低任务成功率"的同时约束"不改变用户潜在目标"，全程不做模型微调，优化预算为每任务 20 次 rollout。

Result: 在 MultiWOZ 以及 tau-bench 的 retail、airline 域上，对三个目标 LLM agent 与标准模拟器、手工设计的非协作行为进行对比：tau-bench pass^4 在 gemini-3.8-flash 上最多下降 69%、在 gpt-5.6-sol 上最多下降 62%；目标保持性能至多下降 10%；敏感性分析显示扩大预算可进一步降低任务成功率。

Conclusion: StressSim 仅依靠轻量级提示优化即能暴露标准模拟器与手工设计模拟器遗漏的鲁棒性缺口，同时保持对话真实性与用户目标一致性，可作为更具区分度的多轮 agent 压力测试工具。

Abstract: Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance. We here introduce StressSim, an intent-preserving adversarial user simulator framework for stress-testing agents with challenging yet valid user interactions. StressSim optimises the simulator's high-level adversarial plan for each task instance. Candidate planner prompts are evolved with a genetic prompt-optimisation loop that uses rollout traces, granular task-completion signals, and validity feedback to favour conversations that reduce task success without changing the user's underlying goal. We evaluate the approach on the MultiWOZ dataset and the retail and airline domains from tau-bench with three target LLM agents, comparing against standard simulators and hand-designed non-collaborative user behaviours. We demonstrate the effectiveness of StressSim in exposing robustness gaps across frontier LLMs, with tau-bench pass^4 scores decreasing by up to 69% on gemini-3.8-flash and 62% on gpt-5.6-sol. StressSim maintains goal preservation performance (which decreases by at most 10%), using an optimisation budget of 20 rollouts per task. Sensitivity analysis suggests that increasing the budget further decreases task success. Overall our results demonstrate that StressSim exposes robustness gaps missed by standard and hand-designed user simulators while maintaining conversation realism. This is achieved through lightweight prompt optimisation alone, without model fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1146] [TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35378v1)
*Ahtisham Ayyub,Fasih Haider,Muhammad Rehan Usman,Saturnino Luz,Christos Politis,Muhammad Arslan Usman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TransECG-SSL 自监督框架，用掩码重建+对比学习混合目标预训练 Transformer 编码器，冻结后线性探针评估；在三个公开 ECG 数据库、七组跨库设置中优于随机初始化与源域有监督预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨数据集泛化是 ECG 心律失常自动分类的主要难题，源于人群、采集协议、标注规范与类别分布差异；希望学得跨独立数据集仍具判别力的表征，减少对数据集特定标注数据的依赖。

Method: TransECG-SSL：以 Transformer 编码器为主体，采用混合自监督目标（掩码信号重建 + 对比学习）在无标注 ECG 上预训练；预训练后冻结编码器，在患者不交叉（patient-disjoint）划分下做线性探针评估。

Result: 三个公开 ECG 数据库、七组源—目标设置：混合 SSL 稳定优于随机初始化 Transformer，平衡准确率高于同架构源域有监督预训练；仅重建 SSL 与混合 SSL 相当，仅对比预训练明显更差；但跨库迁移的平衡准确率低于目标域特定自监督预训练，少数类心律失常在严重类别不平衡下仍难识别。

Conclusion: 结果显示了标签高效的自监督学习在跨数据集 ECG 表征迁移上的潜力，同时揭示了域偏移与类别不平衡带来的持续局限。

Abstract: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pretraining. Reconstruction-only SSL remains competitive with Hybrid SSL, whereas contrastive-only pretraining performs substantially worse, highlighting the importance of masked reconstruction for transferability. Cross-dataset transfer nevertheless reduces balanced accuracy relative to target-specific self-supervised pretraining, while minority arrhythmia classes remain challenging under severe class imbalance. These findings demonstrate the potential of label-efficient self-supervised learning for cross-dataset ECG representation transfer while highlighting persistent limitations from domain shift and class imbalance.

</details>


### [1147] [Benchmarking uncertainty quantification for engineering regression under graded distribution shift](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35356v1)
*Ahmad Lawal,Rahim Pasbanigoloojeh,Asmau Lawal Bilbis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文引入沿物理意义漂移变量构建的三级漂移阶梯（同分布、软漂移、硬漂移），在7个公开工程数据集上评估5个族系的12种回归不确定性量化方法；发现同分布下保形方法覆盖率≥0.946，但硬漂移下平均覆盖率降至0.40–0.75，且方法间无系统性优劣（Friedman p=0.63）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程机器学习模型常在超出训练条件的情形下使用，恰是可靠性UQ最关键之处；而现有回归UQ方法比较依赖随机划分，只能在同分布下评估校准性，无法揭示部署漂移下的真实表现。

Method: 构建沿物理意义漂移变量的三级漂移阶梯（同分布/软漂移/硬漂移），在7个公开工程数据集（5个外推设定、1个未见涡扇故障模式、1个冬季空气质量传感器部署）上评测来自5个族系的12种方法；全部调参仅用源数据。

Result: 同分布下保形方法在每个数据集上覆盖测试点≥0.946；硬漂移下，11种始终输出区间的方法平均覆盖率降至0.40–0.75，方法排序无系统性差异（Friedman p=0.63）。加权保形分位数回归在其作答点上接近名义覆盖，但平均对85%的硬漂移点弃答，且在其作答的少量Concrete点上一覆盖率仅0.67。源验证增益可预测同分布与软漂移下的改善，但不能预测硬漂移（Spearman ρ=0.04）。

Conclusion: 工程评估应按部署单元划分校准数据、报告子组覆盖率与锐度，并将弃答视为显式的运行结果指标。

Abstract: Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most. Existing comparisons of regression UQ methods rely on random splits, which assess calibration only in distribution. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. All tuning uses source data only. In distribution, conformal methods cover at least 0.946 of test points on every dataset. Under hard shift, mean coverage falls to 0.40-0.75 across the 11 methods that always return an interval, and no systematic difference in method ranks is detected (Friedman p = 0.63). Weighted conformalised quantile regression stays near nominal on the points it answers, but abstains on 85\% of hard-shift points on average and covers only 0.67 of the few Concrete points it answers. Source-validation gains predict improvement in distribution and under soft shift, but not under hard shift (Spearman's rho = 0.04). Engineering evaluations should split calibration data by deployment unit, report subgroup coverage and sharpness, and treat abstention as an explicit operational outcome.

</details>


### [1148] [OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35355v1)
*Jiacheng Zhang,Xueyi Zhang,Xin Lu,Siqi Cai,Haizhou Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OneEEG：统一的 EEG-多模态大模型框架，结合数值与视觉脑电表示、任务感知的 MoP 投影器实现多任务 EEG 理解，并构建 OneEEG-Instruct 指令微调数据集与 OneEEG-Bench 评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 在临床评估、脑机接口与认知状态分析中应用广泛，但 EEG 建模长期在不同任务范式间割裂、缺乏统一框架；现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）虽具备灵活的多模态推理接口，但对 EEG 输入的理解能力仍有限。

Method: 1) 整理构建多任务 EEG 指令微调数据集 OneEEG-Instruct；2) 在统一框架中联合建模 EEG 的数值表示与视觉（渲染图）表示；3) 提出任务感知的 Mixture of Projectors（MoP），将不同任务族的异构 EEG 特征对齐至 LLM 嵌入空间；4) 建立 OneEEG-Bench 用于评测多任务 EEG 理解。

Result: 实验表明现有 MLLM 解释 EEG 输入的能力有限；OneEEG 通过融合数值与视觉 EEG 表示并采用任务感知的 EEG-to-LLM 投影，取得更强性能。消融与分析进一步揭示了视觉 EEG 渲染、MoP 变体、路由器行为以及不同 EEG 任务间特征离散度的影响。

Conclusion: 统一的 EEG-MLLM 框架可有效缓解 EEG 建模的任务割裂问题；数值+视觉双表示与任务感知 MoP 投影是提升多任务 EEG 理解的关键，相关数据集与基准为后续研究提供了统一评测基础。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. We further establish OneEEG-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating current MLLMs and our method on multi-task EEG understanding. Experiments show that existing MLLMs have limited ability to interpret EEG inputs, while OneEEG achieves stronger performance by integrating numerical and visual EEG representations with task-aware EEG-to-LLM projection. Extensive ablations and analyses further reveal the effects of visual EEG renderings, MoP variants, router behavior, and feature dispersion across EEG tasks.

</details>


### [1149] [Should Pseudo-Labels Share Mini-Batches with Labeled Examples? Semi-Supervised Continual Active Learning with Limited Training Cost](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35345v1)
*Shiqi Zhang,Tuomas Virtanen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将"每轮固定小批量步数的持续主动学习(CAL)"中伪标签如何与有标签样本共享小批量这一问题形式化为两个决策，提出SSCAL方法，在等训练步数条件下平均排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动学习减少标注，CAL进一步削减梯度步数；伪标签可免标注地增加监督，但会提高训练成本。在CAL每轮固定小批量训练的限制下，伪标签样本是否、以及如何与有标签样本共享这些小批量尚无研究，作者填补这一空白。

Method: 将问题形式化为每次查询后的两个决策：(i)哪些无标签样本应以伪标签进入训练；(ii)它们在每个小批量中占多大比例。提出SSCAL：与任意采集函数兼容；伪标签依据无标签样本到有标签近邻的距离生成；限制其占比；并对有标签样本损失重加权，保持其期望梯度贡献不变；在冻结嵌入上伪标注器可增量更新且无需额外前向传播。

Result: 在两个音频数据集、两种冻结编码器、六种采集函数、十个随机种子下，SSCAL在四种等训练步数协议中平均排名第一。

Conclusion: 在CAL固定小批量预算下引入伪标签是有效的，且需通过占比上限与损失重加权控制其与小批量分享方式，验证了对该问题的肯定回答。

Abstract: Active learning (AL) reduces annotation by querying informative examples. Continual active learning (CAL) also cuts the training cost, the total number of gradient steps, by training one model across AL rounds with a fixed number of mini-batch steps per round. Pseudo-labels add supervision without annotation, but they increase training cost. In CAL, where every round trains on a fixed number of mini-batches, whether and how pseudo-labeled examples should share these mini-batches with labeled examples is therefore open. We provide the first formalization of this problem as two decisions after each query, namely (i) which unlabeled examples should enter training with a pseudo-label and (ii) what share of each mini-batch they should take. Our method, semi-supervised continual active learning (SSCAL), works with any acquisition function. It admits pseudo-labels based on distances from unlabeled examples to labeled neighbors, caps their share, and reweights the loss on labeled examples to keep their expected gradient contribution unchanged. On frozen embeddings, its pseudo-labeler updates incrementally without extra model forward passes. Across two audio datasets, two frozen encoders, six acquisition functions and ten seeds, SSCAL ranks first on average among four protocols with equal training steps, answering the question affirmatively.

</details>


### [1150] [CoPE-CGL: Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Replay-Free Continual Graph Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35313v2)
*Bo-Young Lim,Seokhwan Kim,Kisung Lee,Hyuk-Yoon Kwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoPE-CGL 是一个无回放、无需任务标识的持续图学习框架，利用多跳拉普拉斯平滑预计算的无参数结构先验来统一锚定学习、记忆与推理，在存储、速度与遗忘上全面优于强回放基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续图学习（CGL）方法通常只针对直推或归纳单一设定，且往往需存储过往子图或在推理时需要任务标识，导致存储开销大、适应性受限。作者希望在无回放、无任务标识、恒定存储的条件下缓解灾难性遗忘并保持高效。

Method: 提出 CoPE-CGL：以多跳拉普拉斯平滑预计算的无参数结构先验锚定学习、记忆与推理；结合拓扑注入的瓶颈适配（bottleneck adaptation）、社区级原型（community-level prototypes）与基于节点-原型匹配多数投票的动态路由。默认协议假设每个测试图来自单一已学任务，另设节点级变体处理混合任务图；每个任务仅增加常数级存储，不保留历史图数据。

Result: 在同等存储且不给任务标识条件下，CoPE-CGL 与获得真实任务标识的最强回放基线相当：Arxiv 与 CoraFull 上 AP 分别为 95.17%/95.72% 对 94.28%/95.82%，运行速度快 5.9–14.0 倍且零遗忘。跨 4 个直推与 3 个归纳基准及混合流，比最多 11 个基线中的次优者分别高出至多 1.41、6.32、9.33 个 AP 百分点；端到端速度较各基准最准确竞争者快 1.3–7.9 倍，并可扩展至最大基准图。双任务混合图上节点级变体取得 CGL 方法中最佳 AP。

Conclusion: CoPE-CGL 证明了无回放、无任务标识的持续图学习可在存储与效率上取得优势的同时保持甚至超越回放方法的精度，且在直推、归纳与混合流设定下均表现稳健，能扩展至大规模图；其设计面向具社区结构的同配（homophilic）图。

Abstract: Continual graph learning (CGL) maintains models as graphs evolve without retraining from scratch, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods typically target either transductive or inductive settings and often store past subgraphs or require task identifiers at inference. We propose Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Continual Graph Learning (CoPE-CGL), a replay-free framework that uses a parameter-free structural prior, precomputed by multi-hop Laplacian smoothing, to anchor learning, memory, and inference. CoPE-CGL combines topology-infused bottleneck adaptation, community-level prototypes, and dynamic routing by majority vote over node-to-prototype matches. The default protocol assumes each test graph comes from one learned task; a node-level variant handles mixed-task graphs. Each task adds at most a constant amount of storage, with no past graph data retained. At equal storage and without task identifiers, CoPE-CGL matches the strongest replay baseline even when it receives true task identifiers: average performance (AP) is 95.17% and 95.72% versus 94.28% and 95.82% on Arxiv and CoraFull, respectively, with 5.9-14.0 times faster runtime and zero forgetting. Across four transductive and three inductive benchmarks and mixed streams, CoPE-CGL exceeds the second-best of up to eleven baselines by up to 1.41, 6.32, and 9.33 AP percentage points, respectively. It runs 1.3-7.9 times faster end-to-end than the most accurate competitor on each benchmark and scales to the largest benchmark graph. On graphs mixing two tasks, its node-level variant achieves the best AP among CGL methods. The design targets homophilic graphs with community structure.

</details>


### [1151] [Shared Context, Separate Engines: Stateful Streaming Inference for Multimodal LLMs on Edge SoCs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35309v3)
*Yilong Li,Chengpo Yan,Yijing Zeng,Hanlei Wu,Mingjun Song,Suman Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向边缘SoC的MLLM运行时，将逻辑历史与引擎私有KV状态解耦，实现跨引擎流式生成、并行序列生成与阶段级状态续接，并按预测完成时间进行状态驱动执行规划（SDEP），在多款SoC上显著降低时延并提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边缘SoC同时具备CPU、GPU、NPU，但MLLM运行时通常只把生成绑定在单一引擎上，其余引擎空闲；流式负载虽可让摄入与回答重叠，但后端本地的KV状态使查询被绑定在构建其历史的引擎上；各引擎阶段性能与共跑干扰差异大，不存在通用的最优放置。

Method: 将逻辑对话历史与引擎相关的KV状态分离，使任意语言引擎都能续接某条流；采用有状态流式生成（SSG）重叠摄入与回答，并用以并发序列生成并行服务就绪查询；通过阶段级状态续接，让一个引擎做prefill、另一个引擎做decode，从而释放前者继续摄入；SDEP依据预测完成时间选择执行路径，并利用到达率与实测服务时间分配各引擎的查询份额。

Result: 在M4 Max、RK3588与QCS6490上均优于最强单引擎基线（即使基线重用上下文）。M4 Max上SDEP将在线流p95首token时延降低76%，所有首token均在一秒内，积压场景吞吐较仅Metal并复用上下文最高提升35%。两条RK3588流上，SDEP请求吞吐比最佳单引擎加上下文复用高19.6%，比无共享状态的并行引擎高27.2%。有状态流式生成在同引擎上达最高2.48×串行吞吐，且所有答案与串行参考一致。

Conclusion: 通过解耦逻辑历史与引擎KV状态并进行跨引擎阶段级调度，可充分利用边缘异构算力，在保证输出正确性（与串行参考完全一致）的前提下降低首token时延并提升吞吐。

Abstract: Edge SoCs combine CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, yet runtimes for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep generation on one engine and leave others idle. Streaming workloads allow ingestion and answering to overlap, but backend-local KV state binds queries to the engine that built their history. Stage performance and co-running interference vary, so no single placement wins across SoCs and workloads. \name separates logical history from engine-specific KV state so any language engine can continue a stream. Stateful Streaming Generation overlaps ingestion and answering, while Concurrent Sequence Generation serves ready queries in parallel. Phase-level state continuation lets one engine prefill a query and another decode the answer, freeing the first to resume ingestion. State-Driven Execution Planning (SDEP) chooses paths by predicted completion time and sets each engine's share of queries using arrival rates and measured service times. Across M4 Max, RK3588, and QCS6490, \name beats the strongest single-engine baselines, even when they reuse context. On M4 Max, SDEP cuts live-stream p95 time to first token by $76\%$, with every first token within one second, and raises throughput under backlog by up to $35\%$ over Metal-only execution with context reuse. On two RK3588 streams, SDEP delivers $19.6\%$ higher request throughput than the best single engine with context reuse and $27.2\%$ more than parallel engines without shared state. Stateful Streaming Generation reaches up to $2.48\times$ serial throughput on the same engines. Every answer matches its serial reference.

</details>


### [1152] [Inference Latency-Aware Tsetlin Machine Training](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35304v1)
*Yefan Zeng,Shengyu Duan,Rishad Shafik,Alex Yakovlev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究 Tsetlin Machine 训练超参数 T 与 s 对分类精度和推理延迟的影响，提出一种以精度为约束、沿 T-s 反比关系定向增大 s 的搜索策略，在 gem5+ARM 仿真上将推理延迟最多降低 16.34%，精度损失最低仅 0.06%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TM 适合资源受限边缘设备的低延迟推理（子句为布尔文字的 AND，可按位评估并在任一文字为 0 时提前退出）。但训练超参数 T、s 对精度与推理延迟的联合影响缺乏系统认识，而穷举 (T, s) 网格搜索训练成本过高，因此需要在有限评估预算下找到降低延迟的配置。

Method: 利用 T 与 s 近似反比（s = T·N/2 一类关系）使精度近乎恒定的性质，将精度视为约束而非优化目标，提出定向搜索：沿反比方向逐步增大 s，以降低推理延迟，避免穷举网格搜索；在 gem5 + ARM 处理器仿真器上跨六个数据集进行验证。

Result: 六个数据集上推理延迟最多降低 16.34%；部分数据集精度仅下降 0.06%（近似可忽略）；所需配置评估次数远少于穷举网格搜索。

Conclusion: 在固定评估预算下，以提高 s 为导向的搜索可同时获得低延迟与近基线精度，是一种高效实用的 TM 超参数调优方式；对边缘端 TM 部署有直接价值。（摘要未给出与穷举搜索延迟收益的定量对比及不同数据集差异的原因，可作为后续工作。）

Abstract: The Tsetlin Machine (TM) is a logic-based machine learning model well suited to low-latency inference on resource-constrained edge devices. Because each clause is an AND over Boolean literals, both the literals and their associated Tsetlin Automaton (TA) actions can be represented at the bit level, enabling bitwise evaluation and an early exit that is triggered as soon as any included literal evaluates to zero, forcing the clause output to zero. In this work, we study how the two TM training hyperparameters, T and s, govern both classification accuracy and inference latency. Building on the inversely proportional T-s relationship along which accuracy is nearly constant, we find that inference latency is reduced primarily by increasing s; rather than exhaustively searching the (T, s) grid at high training cost, we propose a directed search strategy that treats accuracy as a constraint and advances toward larger s to reduce inference latency within a fixed evaluation budget. Experimental results on the gem5 simulator with an ARM processor show that, for certain datasets, the search is able to increase s while preserving the baseline accuracy, thereby reducing inference latency at negligible accuracy cost: across six datasets, the method reduces inference latency by up to 16.34%, while some datasets exhibit an accuracy reduction of only 0.06%. The proposed strategy requires far fewer configuration evaluations than an exhaustive grid search.

</details>


### [1153] [InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35303v1)
*Yingbo Hao,Song Liu,Guanghua Yu,Zhaojing Zhou,Jianchen Zhu,Yi Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 InterQ-RL，在量化多轮智能体 RL 中沿"到达状态的历史策略"做有界执行前缀校正，在不增加前向开销的前提下消除量化回放与学习器之间的残余失配，量化端点性能基本追平 BF16。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体 RL 需长闭环 rollout，生成与 KV-cache 开销大；量化 rollout 虽降本，但低精度执行器同时充当行为策略，与学习器产生执行失配。现有量化 RL 方法面向单轮生成，只做学习器前向对齐或修正当前 token 的 rollout-learner 比率，未建模产生每个智能体状态的策略历史，故对齐后残余失配仍沿历史累积，导致"局部对齐、历史失配"。

Method: InterQ-RL（交互感知量化 RL）：1) 对到达状态的策略历史施加有界执行前缀校正；2) 在固定位移预算下，依据有效支撑度在各动作段间分配校正强度；3) 无需额外模型前向。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上评测 4B–30B 的 dense 与 MoE 骨干，所有量化臂共享 W8A8-KV8 回放。

Result: 在四组环境-骨干设置中，InterQ-RL 均取得最强量化端点结果，与 BF16 差距在 0.7 分以内，并在两组设置中超过 BF16；学习速度匹配或超过仅做对齐的基线，且避免了后者的后期性能回退。

Conclusion: 多轮量化 RL 的关键残余失配来自状态到达历史而非单步动作，有界前缀校正可在零额外前向代价下有效补偿，使量化训练在性能与学习速度上逼近 BF16 并保持后期稳定。

Abstract: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

</details>


### [1154] [Layerwise Repacking: Variable-Length Hybrid-Attention Training without an Extra Redistribution Pass](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35989v1)
*Jiahao Zhang,Junwei Feng,Dongliang Huang,Xiaoling Zhou,Yiqiao Liao,Chengru Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Layerwise Repacking：按层将全注意力所需的SP16/32宽序列并行组的样本重打包到节点内SP{1,2,4,8}稀疏子组，并复用全层已有的Ulysses通信点完成重排，无需额外重分布；配合父组求解器再平衡，1F3S混合注意力模型端到端时间降低7.61%、MFU提升4.83个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变长训练下混合注意力模型的各层对并行度需求冲突：全注意力层因二次复杂度需要16/32卡的宽SP组，而近线性MoE主导的稀疏注意力层在节点内SP8即可平衡负载。复用宽组会使稀疏层的all-to-all跨节点，实测有效带宽低7.0倍；但改用小组会改变样本的rank归属，若在每个全-稀疏层边界都单独重分布，又会引入额外数据传输。

Method: 为全注意力保留SP16/32父组，并把其样本重打包为节点内SP{1,2,4,8}稀疏子组，隐藏状态在全注意力层之间保持驻留；布局切换搭载于两个既有的全层Ulysses通信点，每次用一个变长all-to-all同时完成head交换与样本重打包，不新增重分布过程。由于子组可达的负载均衡取决于父组内样本构成，引入辅助父组求解器在子组形成前再平衡父组成员。

Result: 在1F3S（每三层稀疏注意力配一层全注意力）混合注意力模型前200个训练步中，共22步使用SP16/32父组：仅启用重打包，平均端到端时间降低5.95%，MFU提升3.75个百分点；再加入改进求解器后，端到端时间降低7.61%，MFU提升4.83个百分点。

Conclusion: 层内差异化的序列并行组尺寸是可行的：通过复用现有Ulysses通信完成零额外开销的样本重打包，并辅以父组再平衡，可在不增加通信量的前提下显著改善混合注意力变长训练的吞吐与MFU。

Abstract: Variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. The longest samples require wide sequence-parallel (SP) groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention, whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. Sparse-attention layers, dominated by near-linear MoE work, can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local SP8 groups. Reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes, where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. Yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample; a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer.
  Layerwise Repacking keeps each SP16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at SP{1, 2, 4, 8}, where hidden states persist between full layers. The layout change rides on the two existing full-layer Ulysses sites: at each, one variable-size all-to-all performs both the head exchange and the sample repacking, so no redistribution pass is added. Because the balance the children can reach depends on which samples share a parent, an auxiliary parent solver rebalances parent membership before the children are formed.
  On all 22 steps with SP16/32 parents among the first 200 training steps of a 1F3S hybrid-attention model (one full-attention layer per three sparse-attention layers), repacking alone reduces the mean end-to-end time by 5.95% and raises model FLOPs utilization (MFU) by 3.75 percentage points over the baseline with repacking disabled; with the improved solver, end-to-end time falls by 7.61% and MFU rises by 4.83 percentage points.

</details>


### [1155] [Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35985v1)
*Tianqi Chen,Xunchao Li,Linchuan Xie,Guanghua Yu,Jianchen Zhu,Peisong Wang,Jian Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GateRQ：按门的量化误差加权对检索行做多级 1-bit 残差码阶梯式存储，将首级常驻 GPU 以计算门值，其余层级仅对门值最高的检索按需读取，从而在无重训练下实现大幅压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件记忆层（如 Engram）对模型性能贡献显著（移除后在 PopQA 上损失 36.8 分），但低比特量化会优先损害长尾事实；而"按访问频率分配更多比特"这一常规做法反而失效——按频率细化查询竟不如随机细化。作者将该现象归因于门控机制。

Method: 从理论上揭示检索行的量化误差被其门值加权：高频 n-gram 门值小、长尾实体的稀有 n-gram 门值大，且门值可由 1-bit 码计算得出。据此设计 GateRQ——将每行存储为 1-bit 残差码阶梯，第 1 级常驻 GPU 显存用于计算门，仅在门排名靠前的检索上读取更深层级。

Result: 无需重训练即在 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上把 GPU 表显存降低 7.8 倍，相对 FP8 表将 vLLM 吞吐提升 11%–31%；在每次检索读取 1.50 bit 时 PopQA 约损失 1 分，2.10 bit 时仅损失 0.2 分（两个模型上）。

Conclusion: 量化误差应按门值加权的"重要性"而非访问频率来分配比特，GateRQ 以门控驱动的多级残差编码在显存、吞吐与精度间取得更优权衡。

Abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

</details>


### [1156] [Conversational Generalized Linear Bandits with Hybrid Feedback](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35262v1)
*Yurui Zou,Qirun Zeng,Jinhang Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究混合反馈下的对话式广义线性赌博机，提出HyConUCB算法，统一融合物品的绝对奖励与关键项的成对比较，并从双反馈源联合导出更优遗憾界，实验验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话式赌博机方法假设物品与关键项反馈同质，统一用绝对奖励或成对比较；但实际中物品反馈常为点击/评分（绝对奖励），关键项反馈更自然为比较（相对反馈），二者异质性未被建模。

Method: 提出Conversational UCB with Hybrid Feedback (HyConUCB)：由异质反馈构造统一置信界，并自适应选择关键项比较查询，在信息增益与方向覆盖之间取得平衡；配合细化遗憾分析，联合利用两类反馈源。

Result: 理论分析得到联合利用双反馈源的遗憾界，优于仅用奖励（reward-only）与改写的仅成对比较（dueling-only）基线；合成与真实数据集实验均验证算法有效性。

Conclusion: 混合绝对与相对反馈的对话式广义线性赌博机框架及其HyConUCB算法能够更贴合真实交互形式，并在理论上与实验上均优于同质反馈基线。

Abstract: Conversational bandits improve recommendations by actively querying users about key-terms to elicit their item preferences. However, existing methods typically assume homogeneous feedback for items and key-terms, using either absolute rewards or pairwise comparisons. In practice, item feedback often takes the form of clicks or ratings, while comparisons are more natural for key-terms. To address this gap, we study conversational generalized linear bandits with hybrid feedback, combining absolute item rewards and relative key-term comparisons. We propose Conversational UCB with Hybrid Feedback (HyConUCB), which constructs unified confidence bounds from heterogeneous feedback and adaptively selects key-term comparisons by balancing information gain and directional coverage. Through a refined regret analysis that jointly exploits both feedback sources, we establish a regret bound that improves upon reward-only and adapted dueling-only benchmarks. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

</details>


### [1157] [NOMAD-EEG: Native Omni-Montage Adaptive Diffusion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35246v1)
*Abdulkader Helwan,Khadidja Henni,Lina Abou-Abbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NOMAD-EEG是一个仅12.0M参数的扩散式脑电基础模型，通过沿时间维的状态空间层（无分块patch）与基于电极3D头皮位置的跨电极注意力，实现了与电极数量、身份、顺序及输入长度无关的生成式预训练，并在多任务上超越更大规模基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑电的导联配置、通道数与记录时长差异极大，而现有绝大多数EEG基础模型被绑定在其训练时的固定通道集合与输入长度上，泛化性受限。作者希望构建一个与电极数量、身份、顺序及输入长度均无关的生成式脑电基础模型。

Method: NOMAD-EEG为12.0M参数的扩散模型：沿时间维交替使用状态空间层且不做patch分块；跨电极采用注意力机制，电极仅以3D头皮空间位置标识。在单一语料的147小时无标签脑电上预训练；用冻结线性探针在10个数据集（1–64个电极）上与7个基础模型在统一协议下对比，并在两个未见人群上测试。

Result: 尽管参数规模小（12.0M vs REVE的69M）且仅用单一预训练语料，NOMAD-EEG在EEGMMIDB运动想象（平衡准确率0.442）、Siena癫痫发作检测（宏F1 0.622）、Bonn发作检测（AUROC 0.999）上优于全部7个基础模型；在TUEP癫痫诊断上取得七模型中最高的准确率（0.640）；微调后在TUEV事件分类上取得最高kappa（0.635）与加权F1（0.814）；在未见八电极导联的自闭症P300检测中为五个模型中最佳（AUROC 0.718）。仅使用19个电极中的5个时，平均AUROC仅从0.942降至0.891。

Conclusion: 以电极位置标识电极、且不做patch的时间建模，使这个在单一语料上预训练的小模型在癫痫发作检测、癫痫样事件分类、癫痫诊断和运动想象任务上优于规模大得多的EEG基础模型。

Abstract: Purpose. Electroencephalography (EEG) montages, channel counts and recording lengths vary widely, but most EEG foundation models are bound to the channel set and input length they were trained on. We aimed to build a generative EEG foundation model independent of the number, identity and order of electrodes and of the input length. Methods. NOMAD-EEG is a 12.0 M-parameter diffusion model that alternates state-space layers along time, without patches, with attention across electrodes identified only by their 3D scalp position. It was pre-trained on 147 h of unlabelled EEG from a single corpus and evaluated with frozen linear probes on ten datasets with 1 to 64 electrodes against seven foundation models run under one protocol, and on two unseen populations. Results. Despite its small size (12.0 M parameters against 69 M for REVE) and single pre- training corpus, NOMAD-EEG outperformed all seven foundation models on EEGMMIDB mo- tor imagery (balanced accuracy 0.442), Siena seizure detection (macro F1 0.622) and Bonn seizure detection (AUROC 0.999), had the highest accuracy of the seven compared models on TUEP epilepsy diagnosis (0.640) and, after fine-tuning, the highest \k{appa} (0.635) and weighted F1 (0.814) on TUEV event classification. It was the best of five models on P300 detection in autism with an unseen eight-electrode montage (AUROC 0.718). With only 5 of 19 electrodes, its mean AUROC fell only from 0.942 to 0.891. Conclusion. Identifying electrodes by position and modelling time without patches let one small model, pre-trained on one corpus, outperform much larger EEG foundation models on seizure detection, epileptiform event classification, epilepsy diagnosis and motor imagery.

</details>


### [1158] [SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35215v1)
*Chenxu Zhang,Zhou Liu,Wu Xin,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 SkillLifeBench 基准，将 Web Agent 的技能存储代码、所选版本与加载实现三种状态的差异与任务结局关联，覆盖 388 个配对场景（实现、接口、运行时、组合、版本五类变化），并在 89 个运行时任务与 60 个自主生命周期任务两条配对的决策轨道上评测 14 个模型。结果显示运行时分数相近的模型在生命周期任务上差异显著，执行溯源信息可显著提升恢复成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web Agent 会复用技能，而技能"存储代码—所选版本—实际加载实现"三者可能在跨任务和软件更新中发生偏离，既有评测未将这种状态不一致与任务成败挂钩，也缺乏能区分模型真实能力的评测手段。

Method: 构建包含 388 个配对场景的 SkillLifeBench，覆盖实现、接口、运行时、组合与版本五类变化；设计两条配对决策轨道：89 个运行时任务，以及由引入案例衍生的 12 个模板、共 60 个自主生命周期任务（允许 Agent 检查、选择并重新配置技能以完成可验证的用户请求）。以"联合成功"（完成任务且未达成注册攻击目标）为主要指标，评测 14 个模型；并开展配对恢复实验，对比日志与元数据、执行溯源、确定性执行一致性规则与完全恢复等策略。

Result: GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Sonnet 4.6 在运行时任务上均为 82.0%，但在生命周期任务上分别为 96.7% 与 56.7%。生命周期评测中受挑战任务成功率为 77.5%，联合成功仅 65.2%，另有 103 次运行在完成任务的同时达成了攻击目标。恢复研究中，加入执行溯源使联合成功率从 49.35%（仅日志与元数据）提升至 65.58%；确定性执行一致性规则达 64.94% 且良性效用更高，完全恢复达 69.48%。

Conclusion: 生命周期任务能够区分运行时分数相近的模型，揭示技能状态偏离带来的隐性风险；执行证据（尤其是溯源与一致性校验）可有效改善恢复表现，为 Web Agent 技能的可靠复用与安全评测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility joint success from 49.35% with logs and metadata to 65.58%. A deterministic execution-consistency rule reaches 64.94% with higher benign utility, while full restoration reaches 69.48%. Lifecycle tasks distinguish models with similar runtime scores, and execution evidence improves recovery.

</details>


### [1159] [One-Shot Federated Model Editing for Device Dynamics at the Edge](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35212v1)
*Youming Tao,Weijun Yin,Huanyi Xie,Yanqing Yao,Dongxiao Yu,Xiuzhen Cheng,Di Wang,Falko Dressler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出F-SOSA，首个支持快速、精确模型编辑的稳定单轮联邦学习（one-shot FL）算法，并基于其稳定性衍生出单轮遗忘（F-SOSA-U）与单轮增量学习（F-SOSA-I）两种编辑算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准联邦学习需要多轮持续连接，不适用于车辆网等客户端频繁加入/退出的动态环境；单轮FL虽只需一次通信，但存在"模型固化"问题，难以适应后续客户端动态（新增贡献的纳入与既往贡献的撤回），而从头重训练代价过高。

Method: 作者指出高效编辑的关键在于学习稳定性。F-SOSA采用经精细调节采样率的本地模型子采样以实现稳定聚合，并进行曲率感知（curvature-aware）的模型融合以保持效用；在此基础上构建两个单轮编辑算法：F-SOSA-U（通过遗忘移除撤回的贡献）与F-SOSA-I（通过增量学习纳入新贡献）。

Result: 理论证明F-SOSA具有趋于零的训练误差与合理较小的泛化误差界；并证明编辑后的模型及其所有中间算法状态与从头重训练在统计上不可区分，而代价仅为重训练的期望O(ρ)比例（ρ刻画稳定性）。在城市移动性仿真实验中，该方法性能与重训练相当，累计时间与通信开销分别至少降低36%与22%。

Conclusion: 学习稳定性是单轮FL中实现精确模型编辑的核心；F-SOSA通过稳定聚合与曲率感知融合，使单轮FL具备可编辑性，在保证与重训练统计等价与相当效用的同时显著降低时间与通信成本，适用于高动态的车辆网络场景。

Abstract: Standard federated learning (FL) requires persistent device connectivity across multiple communication rounds, making it unsuitable for dynamic environments such as vehicular networks, where devices frequently join and leave. One-shot FL offers a promising alternative by completing training in a single communication round. However, one-shot FL suffers from model solidification and cannot readily adapt to subsequent client dynamics, including new client contributions and the withdrawal of previous contributions. We therefore consider exact model editing, which removes withdrawn contributions through unlearning or incorporates newly contributed ones through incremental learning without retraining from scratch. We identify that efficient editing fundamentally hinges on learning stability. To this end, we propose F-SOSA, the first stable one-shot FL algorithm that enables rapid and exact model editing. F-SOSA leverages sub-sampling of local models with carefully tuned rate for stable aggregation and performs curvature-aware model fusion to preserve utility. We prove that F-SOSA achieves vanishing training error and reasonably small generalization error bounds. Building on this stability, we further develop two single-round editing algorithms: F-SOSA-U for unlearning and F-SOSA-I for incremental learning. They ensure that the edited model, along with all intermediate algorithmic states, is statistically indistinguishable from retraining while incurring only an expected $O(ρ)$ fraction of its cost, where $ρ$ quantifies stability. Experiments demonstrate that our approach matches retraining performance while reducing cumulative time and communication overhead by at least 36% and 22%, respectively, under realistic urban mobility simulations.

</details>


### [1160] [Efficient Exact Unlearning for Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35211v1)
*Weijun Yin,Yanqing Yao,Falko Dressler,Di Wang,Youming Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出两种具有总变差稳定性的联邦零阶优化算法（FedZOO-S、FedZOO-NS）及其精确遗忘程序（FedZOUL-S、FedZOUL-NS），通过耦合复用计算实现高效精确遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦零阶优化（FedZOO）虽降低内存与通信开销，但缺乏高效精确遗忘机制，难以在用户请求删除数据时彻底移除训练数据影响。

Method: 核心洞察是算法的总变差稳定性使删除前后模型分布存在重叠，从而可通过耦合复用计算。据此联合设计：FedZOO-S 通过客户端与微批子采样获得稳定性，FedZOUL-S 保留早期更新并从首个受影响步重启；FedZOO-NS 进一步结合子采样与高斯噪声增大更新分布重叠，FedZOUL-NS 利用拒绝–反射耦合在耦合被接受时复用受影响更新。

Result: 证明两种算法均实现精确遗忘（模型与保存状态和用保留数据重新训练的联合分布一致）；给出稳定性与收敛性保证及期望遗忘代价上界。实验显示遗忘有效、模型效用具竞争力，累积遗忘时间比重新优化最多减少 56.1%，通信开销比一阶基线降低约四个数量级。

Conclusion: 总变差稳定性可支撑精确遗忘中的计算复用，所提稳定零阶学习–遗忘联合设计在保证精确遗忘与收敛性的同时显著降低遗忘时间与通信开销。

Abstract: Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropagation while communicating only random seeds and scalar coefficients. However, existing methods lack efficient mechanisms for exact unlearning to fully remove the influence of training data when users request deletion. A key insight is that total variation stability of the learning algorithm creates overlap between model distributions before and after data deletion, allowing exact unlearning to reuse computation through coupling. Based on this observation, we jointly design two stable zeroth-order learning algorithms and their corresponding exact-unlearning procedures: \textsc{FedZOO-S} obtains stability through client and mini-batch subsampling, enabling \textsc{FedZOUL-S} to perform efficient unlearning by preserving earlier updates and restarting from the first affected step. \textsc{FedZOO-NS} further combines subsampling with Gaussian noise to increase overlap between update distributions; \textsc{FedZOUL-NS} exploits this overlap through rejection--reflection coupling to reuse affected updates when the coupling is accepted. We prove exact unlearning for both algorithms: the model and saved state have the same joint distribution as retraining with the corresponding learner on retained data. We further establish stability and convergence guarantees for the learning algorithms and derive upper bounds on expected unlearning cost. Experiments demonstrate effective unlearning with competitive model utility and up to $56.1\%$ less cumulative unlearning time than re-optimization. Compared with first-order baselines, our methods reduce communication overhead by up to approximately four orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [1161] [Understanding Practical Optimization in Machine Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35209v1)
*Egor Shulgin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文主张对实际机器学习优化方法（子模型训练、梯度裁剪/归一化、逐层非欧方向、近似内层计算）按其真实目标、假设、更新与计算方式进行分析，而非用简化代理模型；分别揭示了子网络训练与私有优化的偏差来源，并给出修正方案与收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习的实用优化过程与经典分析所研究的算法存在明显差异：它们会训练子模型、裁剪或归一化梯度、采用逐层非欧几里得方向、近似昂贵的内层计算。用简化代理算法做理论分析，无法解释这些实际过程本身的优化行为，因此需要“忠实于实践”的理论分析。

Method: 按四个维度（目标、假设、更新、计算）分析实际算法：(1) 子模型训练：指出 Independent Subnetwork Training 因“先 sketch 后微分”使更新对原目标有偏，只能收敛到偏移不动点；提出 Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training，将 sketch 分布纳入目标，使 sketched 梯度无偏。(2) 私有优化：分析自适应分位数裁剪在任何固定分位数下的偏差，设计分位数调度以在重尾噪声下恢复近优非凸收敛率；结合平滑归一化与误差补偿，在标准假设下（不假定梯度有界）给出分布式私有收敛保证。(3) 基于线性最小化 oracle 的优化器：提出并验证逐层广义平滑性模型，据此构建 Gluon 框架，覆盖 Muon 与 Scion 类方法；并量化 Muon 中近似正交化的精度—步长耦合关系。

Result: Independent Subnetwork Training 被证明收敛到偏移固定点（偏差源于微分前的 sketch）；Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training 具有无偏 sketched 梯度并具备收敛保证。固定分位数裁剪在任意固定分位数下保留偏差，而分位数调度可在重尾噪声下达到近优非凸速率；归一化+误差补偿方案在无有界梯度假设下获得分布式私有收敛保证。逐层广义平滑性模型得到验证并支撑 Gluon 框架；Muon 中正交化精度越低所需步长越小，故精度应与学习率联合调优。

Conclusion: 当理论保留决定优化行为的关键特征时，实用优化方法才能被更好理解：偏差往往来自目标与更新之间的不一致（如 sketch 置于微分之前、固定分位数裁剪），而通过把算法特征纳入目标或调度设计即可恢复无偏性与收敛保证。实践建议包括：将近似计算的精度（如正交化精度）与学习率一并调优。

Abstract: Modern machine learning relies on practical optimization methods that often differ from the algorithms studied in classical analyses: they train submodels, clip or normalize gradients, use layer-wise non-Euclidean directions, or approximate costly inner computations. This thesis analyzes the objective, assumptions, update, and computation defined by these procedures, rather than those of simplified proxies. For submodel training, we show that Independent Subnetwork Training can converge to a shifted fixed point because sketching before differentiation biases the update for the original objective. Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training instead incorporates the sketch distribution into its objective, which makes sketched gradients unbiased and admits convergence guarantees. For private optimization, we show that adaptive quantile clipping retains bias at any fixed quantile, while suitable quantile schedules recover near-optimal nonconvex rates under heavy-tailed noise. We then combine smoothed normalization with error compensation and obtain distributed private convergence guarantees under standard assumptions, without assuming bounded gradients. For optimizers based on linear minimization oracles, we develop and validate a layer-wise generalized smoothness model and build on it the Gluon framework for Muon- and Scion-style methods. We also show that the approximate orthogonalization in Muon matters: less precise orthogonalization calls for smaller stepsizes, so its precision should be tuned together with the learning rate. Overall, practical methods are better understood when theory retains the features that determine their optimization behavior.

</details>


### [1162] [LEAP: a Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer for time-series anomaly detection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35190v1)
*Cristhian Moya-Mota,Ignacio Aguilera-Martos,Diego García-Gil,Julián Luengo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LEAP（Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer），以"掩码预测 + 潜在表征异常证据"取代重建式目标，在 TSB-AD 基准上取得 VUS-PR 0.5179（多变量）与 0.6194（单变量）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建式检测器的目标函数存在结构性缺陷：输入即目标，表达力强的模型同样能重建异常点，导致残差缺乏信息量；新的大规模基准也表明精心设计的深度模型在精修数据上难以超越简单统计基线，而当前领先方法依赖表征学习。

Method: LEAP 从窗口内移除若干 patch，仅依据剩余的时间与跨通道上下文预测被移除片段，使预测误差度量学习到的动力学对隐藏段的解释能力；采用确定性互补分组掩码，保证每个时间步在被隐藏时被打分，且训练与推理的可见比例一致。另引入三类无标签证据：以局部密度校准的潜在嵌入新颖度、局部时间对比度、以及按六项无标签准则筛选通道后做逐通道新颖度池化；不使用重建误差或基于注意力的打分。单变量变体使用多尺度掩码预测打分与潜在新颖度。

Result: TSB-AD 协议下，完整模型在 180 条留出多变量序列上 VUS-PR 为 0.5179±0.0022；单变量变体在 TSB-AD-U 的 350 条留出序列上为 0.6194±0.0016；均为三个随机种子平均。TSB-AD-M 上的五阶段消融配合配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验显示各组件逐步带来统计显著增益。

Conclusion: 掩码预测与潜在新颖度证据的组合是无重建、无注意力打分的高效异常检测范式，各组件的贡献经显著性检验得到验证，并在标准化基准上给出可复现的强基线。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection is dominated by reconstruction-based neural detectors, whose objective is structurally flawed. Since the target is also the input, an expressive model can learn to reconstruct anomalies too, leaving uninformative residuals. Recent large-scale benchmarks show that, on curated data, elaborate deep detectors rarely beat simple statistical baselines, while current leaders rely on representation learning. We propose LEAP (Latent Embedding Anomaly Patch-Transformer), which combines masked prediction with latent representation-based anomaly evidence, without relying on reconstruction or attention-based scoring. The model removes patches from a window and predicts them from the remaining temporal and cross-channel context, so prediction errors measure how well learned dynamics explain hidden segments. Deterministic complementary group masking ensures every time step is scored while hidden, with identical visible fractions during training and inference. LEAP adds three label-free evidence sources: latent-embedding novelty calibrated by local density, local temporal contrast, and per-channel novelty pooled over channels selected by six label-free criteria. Under the TSB-AD protocol, the full model achieves a VUS-PR of $0.5179 \pm 0.0022$ on $180$ held-out multivariate series. On TSB-AD-U, a univariate variant combining multi-scale masked-prediction scoring with latent novelty, without contrast or channel-pool novelty, achieves $0.6194 \pm 0.0016$ on $350$ held-out series. Both results average three random seeds. A five-stage ablation on TSB-AD-M, supported by paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, shows statistically significant gains from each successive component.

</details>


### [1163] [DAC-Loop: Distillation-Aware Compression for Remote Sensing CNN](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35175v1)
*Rico Staedeli,Lorena Raichle,Konstantinos Tzevelekakis,Aron Asefaw,Damian Borth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DAC-Loop，将知识蒸馏与结构化剪枝、非结构化稀疏化统一为迭代压缩循环，在遥感场景分类的紧凑CNN上实现超90%参数削减仍保持高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在遥感场景分类精度虽高，但边缘设备受算力、内存和能耗限制难以部署；紧凑CNN骨干更实用，需进一步压缩而尽量不掉精度。

Method: DAC-Loop：在结构化通道剪枝前后均施加知识蒸馏，并采用结构化剪枝与非结构化稀疏化交替的迭代压缩调度。

Result: 在EuroSAT与NWPU-RESISC45上，相较一次性剪枝与单阶段KD恢复，DAC-Loop持续改善精度-压缩权衡，参数削减超90%仍保持较强精度。

Conclusion: 将蒸馏与剪枝整合进统一迭代循环，是获得紧凑遥感模型的有效途径。

Abstract: While large-scale models achieve strong results in remote sensing scene classification, deploying them on edge devices remains difficult due to limited compute, memory, and energy budgets. Compact CNN backbones are therefore a practical choice in many real-world settings, offering efficient inference with well-optimized implementations on embedded hardware. To push this efficiency further, we investigate how far a knowledge-distilled student model can be compressed while preserving high accuracy. We propose a Distillation-Aware Compression Loop (DAC-Loop) that integrates (i) knowledge distillation applied both before and after structured channel pruning, and (ii) an iterative compression schedule that alternates structured pruning with unstructured sparsification. Across EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45, the DAC-Loop consistently improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to standard one-shot pruning and single-stage KD recovery, maintaining strong accuracy even beyond 90% parameter reduction. These results demonstrate that combining distillation and pruning in a unified iterative loop offers an effective path toward compact remote sensing models.

</details>


### [1164] [Biology-Guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation for Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35167v1)
*Vu Van An,Long D. Nguyen,Ho Viet Duc Luong,Binh P. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BCARP，一个生物学引导的上下文感知残差传播框架，用于从H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达；在3个ST数据集与10个HEST-1k队列上取得最高平均相关性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组（ST）成本高、通量有限、实验复杂，难以大规模常规使用；而从H&E图像预测空间表达是可扩展替代方案。但组织学仅提供分子活动的间接形态学视角，现有方法多为单阶段从视觉特征解码表达（即便加入空间聚合、检索或多分辨率融合），该范式受限：spot级表达不仅反映局部形态，还依赖细胞身份、邻域组成与组织级结构。

Method: BCARP不直接从组织学嵌入预测表达，而将其作为形态学视觉先验，在面向转录组的潜在空间中逐步精化spot表示；每一步精化融合细胞核引导的局部细胞上下文与原型引导的全局上下文传播，实现邻近与空间远距spot间的信息交换；再用模式尺度解码器将空间表达分解为模式预测与原始表达，并进行尺度校准。

Result: 在3个ST数据集和10个HEST-1k队列上评估，BCARP相较于其他基线取得最高的平均相关性类指标表现。

Conclusion: 数值结果支持"生物学引导的局部-全局残差传播"可作为组织学到转录组预测中视觉解码的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics provides spatially resolved molecular profiling, but its cost, limited throughput and experimental complexity hinder routine large-scale use. Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin-and-eosin-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative, yet remains challenging because histology provides only an indirect morphological view of molecular activity. Existing methods typically decode expression from visual features in a single stage, even when enhanced with spatial aggregation, retrieval or multi-resolution fusion. This formulation is restrictive because spot-level expression reflects not only local morphology but also cellular identity, neighborhood composition and tissue-level organization. We propose BCARP, a Biology-guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation framework for histology-guided spatial transcriptomics prediction. Instead of directly predicting gene expression from histology embeddings, BCARP treats them as morphology visual priors and progressively refines spot representations in a transcriptomics-oriented latent space. Each refinement step integrates nuclei-guided local cellular context with prototype-guided global context propagation, enabling information exchange across both neighboring and spatially distant spots. A pattern-scale decoder further separates spatial expression into pattern prediction from raw expression with scale calibration. Evaluated on three ST datasets and ten HEST-1k cohorts, BCARP achieves the highest mean correlation-based performance against other baselines. Numerical results support biology-guided local-global residual propagation as an effective alternative to visual decoding for histology-to-transcriptomics prediction.

</details>


### [1165] [Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35164v1)
*Denghui Lu,Alexander Maeder,Alexandros Nikolaos Ziogas,Mathieu Luisier,Manasa Kaniselvan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FlashSO(2)：基于整数 Ozaki 方案的定制化"仿真"低精度算子，加速 SO(2)-等变 GNN 处理层，在吞吐、精度和显存三项指标上同时超越 TF32，并在 MALOQ 与 UMA 模型上实现约 3.3–3.9 倍端到端训练/推理加速与约 51–58% 显存降低且精度无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旋转等变架构能提升基于 GNN 的通用材料模型的物理保真度，但其训练与推理依赖高精度张量运算，可扩展性受限。采用 FP8 等低精度矩阵乘单元（MMU）格式虽可将吞吐提升至 30 倍（Hopper）/60 倍（Blackwell），却会带来严重精度损失，因此需要一种兼顾高吞吐与高精度的方法。

Method: 在整数 Ozaki 方案下构造定制化的"仿真"低精度运算，专门用于加速 GNN 中主导运行时间的 SO(2)-等变处理层（该层在 SOTA 机器学习原子间势 MLIP 与多数通用机器学习哈密顿量 MLH 模型中占主要开销），形成框架 FlashSO(2)。

Result: 在 SO(2) 层级别，吞吐分别达到 MALOQ（MLH）与 UMA（MLIP）参考实现的 40 倍与 7 倍，在 NVIDIA GH200 上实现最高 236（232）有效 Tflop/s，为 FP32 峰值的 3.5 倍；并同时在吞吐、精度与显存占用上优于最精确的原生低精度格式 TF32。模型级别：MALOQ 训练比纯 FP32 快 3.9 倍、峰值显存降低 58%，精度无损；UMA 分子动力学模拟加速 3.3 倍、峰值显存降低 51%。

Conclusion: FlashSO(2) 将等变材料模型的"速度—精度"帕累托前沿推进至原生低精度格式之外，并显著降低利用其缩放律所需付出的计算资源代价。

Abstract: Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. Our framework, FlashSO(2), outperforms TF32, the most accurate native low-precision MMU format, in throughput, accuracy, and memory footprint at once. At the SO(2) layer level, it reaches 40x (7x) the throughput of MALOQ's (UMA's) reference implementation, an MLH (MLIP) model, sustaining up to 236 (232) effective Tflop/s on an NVIDIA GH200, 3.5x the FP32 peak. At the model level, FlashSO(2) helps train MALOQ 3.9x faster than its pure-FP32 version while reducing peak memory by 58% at no loss in accuracy. In molecular dynamics simulations with UMA, the speedup factor is 3.3x, and the peak memory is reduced by 51%. FlashSO(2) thus pushes the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of equivariant materials models beyond the native low-precision formats and substantially lowers the resources required to exploit their scaling laws.

</details>


### [1166] [Locked In: Multi-Objective RL for the AI Data Center Build-Out](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35147v1)
*Satyapragnya Kar,Rajarshi Das,PR Panigrahi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将AI数据中心长期扩建选址/供电/冷却决策形式化为分层多目标马尔可夫决策过程（战略承诺受离散窗口、切换成本与前置时间约束，运营调度受物理容量约束），用偏好条件化的半马尔可夫"管理者-执行者"分层智能体求解，在真实站点数据上验证了成本-碳-水-可靠性之间的可操纵权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据中心选址与供电、冷却决策依赖静态、单点评分工具，只在第0天的数字上评估一次；而站点的水、电、碳特征在10–20年资产寿命内会显著漂移，且关键决策不可逆、长期锁定资本与实体设施，因此静态工具与问题本质严重不匹配。

Method: 将长期扩建建模为分层多目标MDP：战略承诺限定在离散决策窗口、产生切换成本、并需经来源相关的前置时间后才投运；运营调度仅允许使用实际存在的容量。求解采用偏好条件化的多目标智能体，含半马尔可夫管理者与执行者层级，可在推理时沿成本、碳、水、可靠性方向调节策略族。另用轻量反事实推演模型校验长期动态。基于真实互联排队、水压力与电网排放数据，在不可逆、可逆、一次性承诺三种机制下评估。

Result: 在三种承诺机制下，偏好条件化在两组目标对上均产生经确认、可操纵的权衡；引入锁定（不可逆）比自由可逆形式得到覆盖更均匀的帕累托前沿，且在约束性水压力限制到来前的预期性改造速率显著更一致。同时，紧凑反事实动态模型对慢变状态跟踪良好，但在水压力轴上明显劣于简单持续性基线。

Conclusion: 长期数据中心扩建应由带承诺不可逆性与偏好条件的多目标序贯决策框架而非静态评分工具来支持；锁定结构对前沿覆盖与前瞻性改造行为有实质影响。作者如实报告反事实动力学模型在水压力维度的不足，并开源环境、智能体、基线与评测框架。

Abstract: AI data center build-out is a multi-trillion-dollar, multi-decade infrastructure program. Yet siting, power procurement, and cooling decisions are still made with static, single-point scoring tools. These tools are evaluated once, on day-zero numbers. This is a poor fit. A site's water, power, and carbon profile drifts substantially over the 10 to 20 year asset life. The governing decisions are also irreversible, and they bind capital and physical plant for years. We formalize long-horizon build-out as a tiered multi-objective Markov decision process. Strategic commitments are gated to discrete windows, incur switching costs, and energize only after source-dependent lead times. Operational dispatch is restricted to capacity that physically exists. We solve the problem with a preference-conditioned multi-objective agent that has a semi-Markov manager and worker hierarchy. The agent recovers a family of policies that a planner can steer across cost, carbon, water, and reliability at inference time. We validate long-horizon dynamics with a lightweight counterfactual rollout model. Across three commitment regimes (irreversible, reversible, and commit-once) on real site data, preference conditioning yields a confirmed, steerable trade-off on both objective pairs in every regime. Imposing lock-in produces a more evenly covered frontier and a far more consistent rate of anticipatory retrofit ahead of a binding water-stress constraint than a freely reversible formulation. Finally, a compact counterfactual dynamics model tracks slow-moving state well. It is measurably outperformed by simple persistence on the water-stress axis. We report this limitation rather than obscure it. We release the environment, agents, baselines, and evaluation harness. All of them are grounded in real interconnection-queue, water-stress, and grid-emissions data.

</details>


### [1167] [TUON: A Tensor-Aware Optimizer Utilizing Tensor-SVD and Polarization for Large Language Model Pretraining](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35130v1)
*Anda Tang,Xuanlin Yang,Junjie Wang,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出张量感知优化器 TUON，基于 T-SVD 的变换域张量代数，通过"先混合后分离"（unitary 变换混合层、切片极分解、逆变换还原）捕捉跨层相关性，并证明其为 Q-变换张量谱范数下的最速下降与 T-SVD 张量极分解因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 预训练受优化器效率制约，优化器设计从 AdamW 等向量感知方法走向矩阵感知方法（如 Muon）。矩阵感知方法利用矩阵结构但独立处理各层，忽略跨层相关性；已有张量感知方法依赖 matricization 张量代数，仅支持浅层堆叠与特定模块（如 QKV），存在结构维度不平衡与跨层错位问题。

Method: TUON 基于由 T-SVD 导出的变换域张量代数：先用酉变换 Q 混合各层，再对每个变换后切片做极分解（polarization），最后逆变换恢复更新。该 mix-then-separate 策略在保留逐层多样性的同时捕获跨层相关性。理论上证明其等价于 Q-变换张量谱范数下的最速下降，更新量即 T-SVD 的张量极分解因子，并给出变换非冗余性、与 Muon/TEON 的范数与光滑性比较及收敛保证。

Result: 在 GPT-124M/350M 与 Qwen-0.6B/4B 上稳定优于 Muon 与 TEON；消融实验验证了变换机制的有效性、超过两层堆叠的跨层结构收益、超越 QKV 的模块适应性，以及对极分解方法的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: TUON 通过变换域张量代数将矩阵感知优化器推广为可扩展的张量感知优化器，兼顾跨层相关性与逐层多样性，在理论与实证上均优于现有矩阵/张量感知方法，且具备规模化与模块通用性。

Abstract: Large scale language model~(LLM) pretraining is increasingly bottlenecked by optimizer efficiency, driving optimizer design from vector-aware methods such as AdamW to matrix-aware methods. Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon exploit matrix structure but treat layers independently, neglecting cross-layer correlations. Tensor-aware optimizers are therefore needed, yet existing ones rely on a matricization-based tensor algebra and remain restricted to shallow stacking and specific modules. In this paper, we propose \textbf{TUON}, a novel optimizer built on a transform-based tensor algebra derived from the Tensor-SVD (T-SVD). Unlike methods that polarize a globally unfolded matrix, TUON mixes layers via a unitary transform $\boldsymbol{Q}$ and then polarizes each transformed slice, and inverts the transform to recover the update. This mix-then-separate strategy captures cross-layer correlations while preserving per-layer diversity, avoiding the structural dimension imbalance and cross-layer misalignment of unfolding. Thus it successfully scales to more layers and diverse modules beyond QKV. Theoretically, we prove that TUON performs steepest descent under a $\boldsymbol{Q}$-transformed tensor spectral norm, and identify its update as the tensor polar factor of the T-SVD. We further establish transform non-redundancy, norm and smoothness comparisons with Muon and TEON, and a convergence guarantee. Empirically, TUON improves consistently over Muon and TEON on GPT-124M/350M and Qwen-0.6B/4B, with ablations confirming the transformation mechanism, cross-layer structure beyond two-layer stacking, adaptability beyond QKV, and robustness to the polarization method.

</details>


### [1168] [STeP-TS: Shared Temporal Filters with Pruning for Time Series](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35128v2)
*Hanne Raum,Jasper Hoffmann,Joschka Boedecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种紧凑的单层卷积多变量时间序列预测框架，学习共享的多尺度时序滤波器组，用轻量变量专属标量权重组合各时序分量，并利用这些权重与滤波输出能量进行结构化剪枝，配合幅度自适应归一化，在显著更少参数与FLOPs下取得与SOTA相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时序预测需同时刻画多尺度时序依赖与变量间“共享结构+变量特异动态”；现有趋势是堆叠大型架构，参数量与计算成本高，难以在严格算力与内存预算下保持预测精度，因此需要紧凑且高效的模型。

Method: 1) 单层卷积骨干：为每个变量学习一组共享的多尺度时序滤波器（filter bank）；2) 变量特异标量权重：以轻量标量加权各时序分量的贡献，实现共享时序结构下对变量特异动态的自适应；3) 结构化剪枝：以学到的标量权重及滤波输出能量作为重要性信号，对卷积滤波器做结构化剪枝以降低复杂度；4) 幅度自适应归一化：保留变量相关的时间幅度信息。

Result: 在多个数据集上，预测性能与SOTA方法相当或具竞争力，同时参数量与推理FLOPs大幅减少，并实现较低的每样本推理延迟。

Conclusion: 紧凑的单层卷积+共享多尺度滤波器+变量标量加权是一种有效的时间序列预测范式；权重与能量可作为天然的可解释剪枝信号，在保持精度的同时显著压缩模型，适合算力/内存受限场景。

Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing temporal dependencies across multiple scales while accounting for both shared and variable-specific dynamics. Compact forecasting models have emerged as an attractive alternative to increasingly large architectures, but preserving strong predictive performance within tight computational and memory budgets remains challenging. We propose a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns a shared bank of multi-scale temporal filters of each variable. Lightweight variable-specific scalar weights determine the contribution of each temporal component, enabling the model to capture shared temporal structure while adapting to variable-specific dynamics. The learned weights and filter-output energy further provide a natural signal for structured pruning of convolutional filters, reducing computational complexity with minimal degradation in forecasting performance. We additionally introduce an amplitude-adaptive normalization mechanism that preserves variable-dependent temporal amplitudes. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate forecasting performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods while requiring substantially fewer parameters and inference FLOPs and achieving low per-sample latency.

</details>


### [1169] [UTA: Universal Training Adaptive Learning Rate Decay](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35113v1)
*Anda Tang,Junjie Wang,Xuanlin Yang,Cong Fang,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出通用训练自适应（UTA）学习率衰减方法，将LRD建模为闭环的“形状+尺度”问题，并与训练状态自适应耦合，在语言与视觉模型上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习率衰减（LRD）设计多为经验驱动；理论化的Universal Budget Aware（UBA）LRD依赖SGD动力学，难以适用于Adam类优化器，且其“优化难度参数”含义不透明。

Method: 提出UTA LRD：通过连续时间建模，将LRD视为闭环的形状与尺度求解问题，采用分段最优形状，使外部迭代与内部训练状态相互关联，实现随训练状态自适应调整。

Result: 在LLaMA 60M–1B语言模型及ImageNet上的ResNet50、ViT-B视觉模型上均取得一致改进；即插即用、开销可忽略。消融实验验证了其在峰值LR、最终衰减比、参数φ0、各组件有效性及微调场景泛化上的稳健性。

Conclusion: UTA在进度形状与LR尺度上获得近最优路径（其他LRD包括UBA难以实现），具备良好实用性与可实施性。

Abstract: Learning rate decay (LRD) is critical for training high-performance models, yet most designs remain empirically driven. Although the Universal Budget Aware (UBA) LRD offers a theoretical framework, its reliance on SGD dynamics limits its applicability to modern Adam-type optimizers and leaves its key `optimization difficulty parameter' opaque. To bridge this gap, we propose the Universal Training Adaptive (UTA) LRD. Unlike UBA's fixed offline trajectory anchored solely to iterations, UTA treats LRD as a closed-loop shape-and-scale problem. By continuous-time formulation, UTA is training-state adaptive with segment-wise optimal shape. This adaptivity links external iterations with internal training states, enabling a near-optimal path in both progression shape and learning rate (LR) scale, a property unattainable by other LRDs, including UBA. Empirically, we demonstrate consistent improvements across language models (LLaMA 60M to 1B) and vision models (ResNet50, ViT-B) on ImageNet with plug-and-play ease and negligible overhead. Extensive ablation studies further confirm UTA's robustness across dimensions, including peak LR, final decay ratio, its parameter $\varphi_0$, component efficacy and generalization to fine-tuning scenarios, underscoring its practical implementability.

</details>


### [1170] [Subspace Crystallization in Grokking: Rank Compression Tracks the Phase Transition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35112v1)
*Shlok Mehendale,Paras Chopra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究神经网络中"顿悟"（grokking）与权重矩阵有效秩下降之间的因果关系，结论是：压缩是顿悟的标志（signature），而非其原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究将 grokking 的延迟与权重矩阵有效秩的下降联系起来，但"秩压缩究竟是驱动 grokking 还是随之发生"这一问题仍未解决。作者因此系统性地检验二维方向上的因果顺序。

Method: 在模算术任务上训练平均场 MLP 与单层 Transformer，并进行三组分析：(i) 比较记忆完成时间（250 步内）、grokking 起始步（测试准确率达 95% 的首步，6,500–21,000 步）与有效秩最陡下降时间之间的时序关系；(ii) 提出"充分子空间"概念——保持 99% 测试准确率所需的最少顶部奇异方向，并进一步统计将输出保持在 10% 误差内所需的方向数，以刻画"子空间结晶"；(iii) 与因式化满秩对照模型比较，人为对 Transformer 的 MLP 输入权重与嵌入做秩上限约束。

Result: (i) 压缩发生在 grokking 起始之后而非记忆之后：有效秩最陡下降始终出现在起始后约 900 步，与起始发生得早晚无关；仅记忆而未能 grokking 的网络压缩程度明显更弱。(ii) 子空间结晶：Transformer 中所需方向数在转变期从可用方向的四分之一以上降至约十分之一。(iii) 施加低秩并不加速 grokking：限制 MLP 输入权重秩会推迟起始，限制嵌入秩则使 20 次运行中 15 次无法 grokking。

Conclusion: 有效秩压缩与子空间结晶是 grokking 伴生的结构特征而非其驱动因素；强制低秩不能促进泛化，反而延迟或阻断 grokking，因此压缩应被视为顿悟的标志性信号。

Abstract: Grokking describes understanding something deeply and intuitively. In neural networks, it is the phenomenon where a network generalizes long after memorizing its training data. This delay has been linked to a fall in the effective rank of the network's weight matrices, but whether this rank compression drives grokking or follows it is still unresolved. We study a mean-field MLP and a one-layer transformer trained on modular arithmetic and observe that: (i) Compression follows the onset, not memorization. Every transformer memorizes its training data within 250 steps, while the grokking onset (the first step at which test accuracy reaches 95%) varies from 6,500 to 21,000 steps. The steepest fall in effective rank comes about 900 steps after the onset, however late the onset occurs, and networks that memorize without grokking compress far less. (ii) Subspace crystallization. We call the span of the fewest top singular directions of a weight matrix that preserve 99% of test accuracy its sufficient subspace. Its size can shrink as the margin between the correct and the best wrong output grows, so we also count the directions needed to keep the outputs within 10%. In the transformer, this count falls during the transition from a quarter or more of the available directions to about a tenth, which we call subspace crystallization. (iii) Imposing low rank does not speed up grokking. Against a factorized full-rank control, capping the rank of the transformer's MLP input weights delays the onset, and capping the rank of its embedding stops 15 of 20 runs from grokking. Compression is therefore a signature of grokking rather than its cause.

</details>


### [1171] [FlowGenesis: Representation-Driven Self-Organization of Neural Architectures](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35108v1)
*Maksim A Kazanskii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowGenesis：以表示通量（Representation Flux）驱动神经元分裂与剪枝，使网络结构在训练中自适应演化，无需预定架构或独立搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络架构通常在训练前即固定，而内部表示却在持续演化；这种"结构先验"与表示动态之间的脱节限制了容量分配的合理性。

Method: 提出表示通量——捕获小批量平均激活变化的局部统计量。通量持续高的神经元进行近似保持网络功能的分裂；低通量与低活跃度的神经元被剪枝。以该反馈回路实现容量的在线结构演化，避免预设目标架构与额外架构搜索；并扩展至持续学习场景。

Result: 图像与文本分类实验显示，不同初始规模的网络在各数据集上收敛到相近的神经元数量区间，且预测性能相当。在任务增量式持续学习中，表示引导的结构适应减少了后续任务分配的神经元与参数，精度与定宽渐进神经网络（PNN）相当。

Conclusion: 神经架构可通过表示学习与结构变化之间的反馈实现自适应，为"训练前预设网络容量"提供了替代思路。

Abstract: Deep neural networks typically rely on architectures specified before training, despite the continuous evolution of their internal representations. We introduce FlowGenesis, a framework in which neural architectures adapt through neuron birth and pruning guided by Representation Flux, a local statistic capturing changes in minibatch mean activations. Neurons exhibiting persistently high Flux undergo splitting designed to approximately preserve the network function, while neurons with low Flux and low activity are pruned. This mechanism allows network capacity to evolve without prescribing a target architecture or performing a separate architecture search. Experiments on image and text classi- fication show that networks initialized with different sizes approach similar final neuron-count ranges within each dataset while maintaining comparable predictive performance. We further extend FlowGenesis to continual learning, where representation-guided structural adaptation reduces the neurons and parameters allocated to successive tasks while maintaining accuracy comparable to fixed-width Progressive Neural Networks in a task-incremental learning setting. These findings demonstrate that neural architectures can adapt through feedback between representation learning and structural change, suggesting an alternative to prescribing network capacity before training.

</details>


### [1172] [Spherical Brownian Diffusion for Language Modeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35101v1)
*Andrea Miele,Ilija Bogunovic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出球面布朗扩散（Spherical Brownian Diffusion），以布朗运动作为球面上标准的各向同性扩散过程，从理论上与实验上分离"前向腐蚀过程"与"推理采样器"两个设计维度，说明在球面连续扩散语言模型中采样器选择远比前向过程选择重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球面连续扩散语言模型存在两个耦合的设计选择：如何腐蚀连续token表示，以及生成时如何逆转该腐蚀。已有工作用测地线或vMF路径在单位球面上做生成，但"该选哪种前向过程""该选择相对推理阶段有多重要"这两个问题尚无清晰答案，作者希望将二者解耦并量化各自贡献。

Method: 1）引入布朗运动作为球面上的典范各向同性扩散，其热半群给出有原则的前向过程、与维度无关的加性噪声时钟以及精确的祖先桥（ancestral bridge）；2）用交叉熵学习干净token后验，支持多种采样器；3）推导布朗腐蚀与矩匹配vMF腐蚀在高维下的近似速率，据此进行受控替换实验以分离腐蚀与推理的影响。

Result: 在Sudoku上，布朗与矩匹配vMF在四种采样器、五档预算下结果几乎一致；而固定腐蚀过程时，采样器选择在180次调用预算下造成25.0个百分点差距。借助祖先桥，将收益分解为：重加噪状态带来的"记忆效应"（Sudoku与GSM8K均存在），以及"token选择效应"（见于GSM8K，且在小预算下最大）。在推理任务上类别式精修更优，而无条件文本生成则受益于保持多样性的随机更新。

Conclusion: 球面几何上前向腐蚀过程的具体形式影响甚微，推理采样器才是主导性能差异的因素；不同任务类型对采样策略有不同偏好（推理任务偏类别精修，开放生成偏随机更新），为球面扩散语言模型的设计提供了明确指引。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models involve two coupled design choices: how to corrupt continuous token representations and how to invert that corruption at generation time. Recent work has explored language generation on the unit sphere through geodesic and von Mises--Fisher (vMF) paths, raising the question of which forward process to use on this geometry and how much that choice matters relative to inference.
