*Yixiang Guo,Lin Tie,Quan Quan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文在"轨迹族"层面形式化Lyapunov稳定性判据，区分判据的**可采纳性**（结构条件足以推出结论）与**紧性**（必要性），并给出"迁移"（Lyapunov函数沿轨指数衰减 ⇒ 状态指数稳定）成立与否的充要结构条件：离散时间下为"正则性包 + 联合下界"同时成立，连续时间下后者加强，两者恰由最小步长区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lyapunov第二方法中长期默认"Lyapunov函数沿轨指数衰减可推出状态指数稳定"（作者称之为migration），但这一推断从未在判据层面被刻画，即缺少可采纳性与必要性的精确边界。作者希望厘清哪些结构条件下该推断成立、在何处失效，并借此重新审视Panteley–Lor'ia判据与Hahn以来的径向无界性假设。

Method: 1) 在轨迹族上形式化稳定性判据，定义可采纳性（结构条件充分）与紧性（必要性），并给出判据有效的充要结构条件；2) 引入对数坐标，将理论约化为比较对（comparison pair）的单个双侧位移函数；3) 离散时间：证明迁移成立当且仅当"正则性包"（排除由无穷多步有限位移导致的失效）与"联合下界"（排除单步无界扩张导致的失效）同时成立；4) 连续时间：证明对应条件被加强，且离散与连续判据恰由最小步长精确区分；5) 将Panteley–Lor'ia判据改写为无反函数形式后与本文条件对比；6) 用包络（envelope）构造说明正则化不损失判别力，并检验径向无界性假设的必要性。

Result: 得到迁移成立的充要结构条件：离散时间下为"正则性包 + 联合下界"的联合条件；连续时间下联合下界被加强，两判据的差异精确对应于最小步长。改写为无反函数形式的Panteley–Lor'ia判据在任意非减比较对上与本文连续时间条件完全一致，而一旦超出该形式则失去可靠性（soundness）；即该经典判据在其正则性类上本就完整。此外，包络构造表明正则化不付出判别力代价，且自Hahn以来的径向无界性假设可去除。

Conclusion: "Lyapunov函数指数衰减 ⇒ 状态指数稳定"并非普遍成立，其成立与否由比较对的双侧位移函数上的两个结构条件精确刻画；离散与连续情形的差别仅在最小步长。经典Panteley–Lor'ia判据是本文框架在非减比较对上的等价刻画，超出该范围有效性丧失。正则化不损失判别力，径向无界性可作为冗余假设删除。

Abstract: Whether the exponential decay of a Lyapunov function along trajectories implies exponential stability of the state---an inference we call migration---is long assumed in Lyapunov's second method but never characterized at the criterion level. We formalize stability criteria over trajectory families, distinguish admissibility of a criterion (its structural condition suffices for its conclusion) from tightness (its necessity), and establish the necessary and sufficient structural conditions for validity. In logarithmic coordinates the theory reduces to a single two-sided displacement function of the comparison pair: in discrete time, migration holds if and only if a regularity package (excluding failure by infinitely many steps of finite displacement) and a joint lower bound (excluding failure by a single step of unbounded expansion) hold simultaneously. Continuous time strengthens the latter; the two criteria are separated exactly by the minimum step size. Written without its inverse-function formulation, the Panteley--Lor'ia criterion coincides with our continuous-time conditions on every nondecreasing pair, and loses soundness beyond: it was already complete on the classical regularity class. An envelope construction shows that regularization costs no discriminative power, and radial unboundedness, a standing assumption since Hahn, is dispensable.

</details>


### [1311] [Data Center Load Reductions: Attribution, Measurement Limits, and Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38216v1)
*Abdallah Alalem Albustami,Ahmad F. Taha,Mohammad Alwahdanee,Zuhaib Shakeel Muhammad*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了仅凭并网点（POI）电气测量能否区分数据中心负荷骤降的原因（工作负载变化 vs. 切换至备用电源），给出了可辨识条件，并在POI数据不足时提出利用工作负载数据的估计器来判断设施仍并网的比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI与云计算推动数据中心负荷激增，数百GW级负荷申请并网；近年多次出现数据中心数百至数千MW的负荷骤降事件，引发电网可靠性担忧。监管机构要求制定计算负荷并网可靠性标准，NERC要求输电业主在数据中心安装扰动记录仪以支持根因分析。但这类记录仪通常只观测POI处的电气量，而负荷骤降可能源于工作负载变化或切换至备用电源，因此需要明确POI测量能否、何时能区分这两种机理。

Method: 建立准静态恒功率模型，证明两种机理可产生完全相同的POI电压与电流；进而分析暂态过程，识别区分二者的关键因素：负荷降幅相对于测量噪声的大小、切除时间（clearing time）、工作负载传导至POI的动态特性，以及记录仪带宽。当POI数据不足时，提出一种融合工作负载数据的估计器，用于估计设施仍保持连接的比例。

Result: 在准静态恒功率模型下，两种负荷骤降机理在POI处不可区分；在暂态中其可分离性取决于上述四个因素。所提基于工作负载数据的估计器可在POI信息不足时判定设施仍并网的比例。

Conclusion: 本文界定了POI测量在数据中心负荷骤降根因辨识中的能力边界，并明确了电力公司与电网运营方判定负荷骤降原因所需的测量量与电网信息（如记录仪带宽、工作负载数据等），为可靠性标准的落地提供依据。

Abstract: Hundreds of gigawatts of data center loads are seeking interconnection in the United States given the massive growth of artificial intelligence and cloud computing. In recent years, several incidents of data centers reducing their loads by hundreds to thousands of megawatts have been documented, raising grid reliability concerns. U.S. regulators have since ordered reliability standards for the integration of computational loads, and the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) now calls on transmission owners to install disturbance recorders at these facilities to support root cause analysis. Such recorders usually observe only electrical quantities at the point of interconnection (POI). A sudden load reduction can be caused by a change in workload or a switch to backup supply. This work shows when POI measurements can distinguish the two mechanisms. It is established that they can produce identical POI voltage and current in a quasi-static constant power model, and during the transient their separation depends on the reduction relative to measurement noise, the clearing time, the dynamics through which workload reaches the POI, and the recorder bandwidth. When POI data are insufficient, an estimator that uses workload data is proposed to determine how much of the facility stayed connected. The results of this work identify the measurements and grid information utilities need to determine why data center load dropped.

</details>


### [1312] [Machine learning-guided real-time AC optimal transmission switching](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38180v1)
*Weimin Huang,Weiwei Yang,Bistra Dilkina,Konstantina Mellou,Ishai Menache,Marco Molinaro,Chris White,Baosen Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种机器学习引导的方法，通过微调预训练的AC-OPF模型构建面向特定电网的"开关价值模型"，快速估计断开输电线路带来的发电成本降低，并结合多种搜索策略在实时尺度内求解最优输电开关（OTS）问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最优输电开关（OTS）可降低发电成本与电价，但其本质是混合整数非线性优化问题，在快速变化的负荷下难以在实时运行尺度内求解，亟需高效方法。

Method: 微调预训练的AC-OPF模型得到电网专用的开关价值模型（代理模型），用于快速估计开断线路的成本收益并给出候选拓扑；再由精确AC-OPF求解器验证可行性并计算真实发电成本；提出Fixed-Rank Search、Adaptive-Rank Search与Swap-Enhanced Search三种策略高效探索组合拓扑空间。

Result: 在多个基准网络上，方法在50秒计算预算内显著降低发电成本；在2000节点合成德州电网的真实数据中心扩张场景下，发电成本降低31.97%，节点总负荷支付降低94.34%。

Conclusion: 即使代理模型不保证可行性，微调后的代理模型仍能有效引导搜索，使经典优化方法可在运行相关的时间尺度上处理大规模非线性组合问题。

Abstract: The operation of power grids has substantial economic consequences, affecting generation costs and, ultimately, electricity prices. The Optimal Transmission Switching (OTS) problem seeks to reduce these costs by selectively switching off transmission lines. However, OTS gives rise to a challenging mixed-integer nonlinear optimization problem that is difficult to solve at operationally relevant timescales, particularly as rapidly changing loads create a need for real-time switching decisions. To address this challenge, we develop a machine learning-guided method that identifies high quality line switching decisions in real time. Specifically, we construct a grid-specific switching-value model that rapidly estimates the generation-cost reduction associated with opening transmission lines by fine-tuning a pretrained model for AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF). The switching-value model provides signals to guide promising switching decisions, and topologies proposed by the model are evaluated using exact AC-OPF solvers to verify feasibility and obtain the actual generation cost. We develop multiple strategies that use the ML surrogate to efficiently explore the combinatorial space of transmission topologies, including Fixed-Rank Search, Adaptive-Rank Search, and Swap-Enhanced Search. Across multiple benchmark networks, our proposed algorithms identify line switching decisions that significantly reduce generation cost within a 50s computational budget. In particular, under a realistic data center buildout scenario on the 2,000-bus synthetic Texas grid, our approach reduces generation costs by 31.97% and gross nodal load payments by 94.34%. More broadly, our results demonstrate that a fine-tuned surrogate can effectively guide search even without guaranteeing feasibility, enabling classical optimization methods to tackle large nonlinear combinatorial problems on operationally relevant timescales.

</details>


### [1313] [Physics-Guided Inferencer-in-the-Loop Digital-Twin for Real-Time Adaptive Emulation of Nonlinear PMSMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38149v1)
*Songyang Zhang,Yuzhong Zhang,Venkata Dinavahi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可学习的永磁同步电机实时数字孪生：以物理引导机器学习(PGML)网络单步推进电流并预测转矩，采用Inferencer-in-the-Loop架构（GPU在线重训练、FPGA执行已接受权重），实现亚微秒级内核延迟与分钟级重训练收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RTDT依赖离线辨识参数或FEA/表征试验得到的磁链查找表，机器变化时需离线重新生成映射；在线估计器只能跟踪电阻、永磁磁链等少数参数，模型本身不可学习、适应性受限。

Method: 将执行模型改为可学习结构：PGML网络单步推进电流、预测转矩，用解析一步标签训练；构建IIL架构，GPU在后台基于参考数据重训练，FPGA执行最近一次被接受的权重。提供两种形式：通用kernel形式（含阻尼绕组、参数偏移、FEA标定饱和电机）与残差形式（在磁路线性200 W驱动上修正解析步并学习物理参数、在线更新磁头）。

Result: kernel形式平均NMAE 0.19%–0.67%，FPGA实测内核延迟0.30–0.34 μs；参数偏移机器重训练94 s内接近最终损失。200 W驱动上残差形式每步<2.5 μs，比实时快20倍，20 kHz采样下仍领先物理驱动测量；6段留出运行(1193 s)中i_q误差为实测RMS的5.9%–9.4%，优于独立拟合灰箱模型的10.4%–13.2%；30 min负载加热中在线更新头跟踪4.1%绕组电阻上升，RMS误差0.44 mΩ。

Conclusion: 将数字孪生的执行模型与训练解耦为“GPU重训练+FPGA执行”的IIL架构，可在保持微秒级实时性的同时使模型可学习，精度优于灰箱基线并支持在线参数跟踪，适合HIL控制器测试。

Abstract: A real-time digital-twin (RTDT) of a permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) allows drive controllers to be tested in hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) before they meet the real machine. Its machine model rests on identified parameters or flux look-up tables (LUTs) from finite-element analysis (FEA) or characterization tests; the maps are regenerated offline when the machine changes, and online estimators track a few parameters such as resistance and PM flux. This article makes the executed model learnable from reference data. A physics-guided machine learning (PGML) network advances the currents and predicts torque in one step, trained with analytical one-step labels. In the proposed Inferencer-in-the-Loop (IIL) architecture, a GPU retrains the network while a field-programmable gate array (FPGA) executes the last accepted weights. For damper circuits, shifted parameters, and an FEA-calibrated saturated machine, one kernel form reaches average normalized mean absolute errors (NMAEs) of 0.19%-0.67% at measured FPGA kernel latencies of 0.30-0.34 $μ$s, and retraining for a shifted machine nears its final loss within 94 s. On a magnetically linear 200-W drive, a residual form corrects the analytical step and learns its physical parameters from operating data; each step takes under 2.5 $μ$s, 20 times faster than real time and ahead of the physical drive's measurements even at 20-kHz sampling. On six held-out runs (1193 s), its $i_q$ error is 5.9%-9.4% of measured RMS, against 10.4%-13.2% for an independently fitted grey-box model, and over 30 min of loaded heating its online-updated heads track a 4.1% winding-resistance rise with an RMS error of 0.44 m$Ω$.

</details>


### [1314] [Passive Identification of Unequal Phase Grid Impedances by Phase-Domain Source Cancellation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38131v1)
*Songyang Zhang,Xun Gong,Bo Cao,Reza Iravani*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出无注入扰动的分相电网阻抗估计方法：用周期差分或SOGID陷波差分消除电网源电压，用移动窗口积分替代电流微分，构造两参数回归以分别辨识各相R、L；给出频差残差与参数误差界分析，并在EMTP算例中验证远优于单一R–L对的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无源电网阻抗估计器只返回单一电阻–电感对，无法描述三相相阻抗不相等的情形；同时希望避免注入扰动和PLL角度依赖。

Method: 仅用PCC处记录的电压、电流：①以周期差分（PD）或二阶广义积分器陷波差分（SOGID）消去未知电网源电压；②用移动窗口积分（MWI）以积分加端点特征替代电流导数；③构成两参数回归逐相辨识R、L，仅需周期或陷波频率估计，不需PLL角度；④电压平衡分析给出频率失配的源残差，并以残差与两类特征条件数之比界定参数误差。

Result: 10 s EMTP构网型记录的不等相区间（8.3–9.8 s）：SOGID-MWI相平均R/L误差5.09%/0.33%，而共用单一值在1:0.5:2相阻抗比下最小误差达41.67%；50 s恒阻抗跟网型记录在20–30 s同步扰动期间误差0.56%/0.06%；40 dB噪声研究中，噪声参考更新规则将白噪声下GFL误差由55.9%/65.0%降至12.3%/11.5%。

Conclusion: 所作方法可在无扰动注入、无PLL角度条件下实现高精度分相阻抗辨识，对频率失配与噪声具备可量化、可控的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Passive grid impedance estimators that return a single resistance--inductance pair cannot represent a grid whose phase impedances are unequal. This paper identifies a separate pair for each phase from recorded point-of-common-coupling (PCC) voltage and current without injected perturbations. In each phase, the unknown grid-source voltage is cancelled by a periodic difference (PD) or by a second-order-generalized-integrator notch difference (SOGID), and moving-window integration (MWI) replaces the current derivative by an integral and an endpoint feature. The resulting two-parameter regression requires a period or notch-frequency estimate but no phase-locked-loop angle. A voltage-balance analysis gives the source residual left by frequency mismatch and bounds the parameter error by the ratio of this residual to the conditioning of the two features. In the unequal-phase interval (8.3--9.8~s) of a 10-s EMTP grid-forming record, SOGID-MWI attains phase-averaged R/L errors of 5.09/0.33\%; a shared value has a minimum error of 41.67\% for the phase ratio 1:0.5:2. On a 50-s constant-impedance grid-following record, the errors are 0.56/0.06\% over the 20--30-s synchronization disturbance. In a controlled 40-dB noise study, a noise-referenced update rule reduces the white-noise GFL error from 55.9/65.0\% to 12.3/11.5\%.

</details>


### [1315] [State-Dependent Delay Modeling of Wind-Farm Wake Dynamics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38057v1)
*Sengiyumva Kisole,Jungbae Chun,Peter Seiler,Matthew M. Peet*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文为两台风机的风电场建立了状态依赖时滞模型，用以刻画上游风机尾流对下游风机的影响，并证明PDE模型可转化为Abel型状态依赖时滞微分方程，同时提出简化模型以显式表达，两模型均预测出导致失稳的风机间耦合作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风电场中下游风机处于上游风机尾流内，需协调控制以实现最大发电。上游风机改变运行状态后，其影响经风传播延迟后才作用于下游，且该延迟随上游功率提取而变化，可能使耦合动态失稳。传统描述依赖非线性偏微分方程（PDE），控制设计与分析困难，因此需要更易处理的模型。

Method: 首先将刻画尾流效应的PDE模型表示为Abel型状态依赖时滞微分方程（该方程仅有隐式解）；随后引入简化状态依赖时滞模型以获得显式表达；通过数值算例分析时滞诱导的振荡。

Result: PDE模型可等价表示为Abel型状态依赖时滞微分方程；简化模型与原始模型均预测出两风机之间导致失稳的耦合交互；数值仿真展示了时滞诱导的振荡并验证了简化模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 状态依赖时滞微分方程为风机尾流耦合动态提供了比PDE更便于控制分析的建模框架，简化模型在保留失稳预测能力的同时具备显式表达，适用于两风机风电场的控制设计与仿真验证。

Abstract: Turbines convert wind to electrical power. In the wake of a turbine, wind speed is reduced in proportion to the amount of power extracted. In a wind farm, downstream turbines may be located in wake of an upstream turbine, requiring coordination to yield maximum power generation. This paper creates a state-dependent delay model for a two turbine wind farm. The upstream turbine creates a wake that diminishes the wind speed at the downstream turbine. Changing the upstream turbine operation will affect the downstream turbine after a delay that depends on the wind-propagation time between them. This delay depends on the upstream power extraction and it can destabilize the combined dynamics. Conventional models of this effect rely on nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs). Control design and analysis with such models is difficult with established methods. We first show that the PDE model can be represented by an Abel-type state-dependent delay differential equation. The equation has an implicit solution. To obtain an explicit representation, we then introduce a simplified state-dependent delay model. Both models predict destabilizing interactions between the two turbines. Numerical examples illustrate delay-induced oscillations using the simplified model and verify their effectiveness in simulation.

</details>


### [1316] [Robust Dynamic Safety Margins are Robust Control Barrier Functions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37900v1)
*Victor Freire,Saber Jafarpour,Marco M. Nicotra*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文证明基于动态安全裕度（DSM）构造的控制屏障函数可作为鲁棒CBF，并针对线性系统给出闭式鲁棒DSM-CBF（RDSM-RCBF），仿真显示其鲁棒性优于名义DSM-CBF基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准DSM-CBF在存在扰动/不确定性时缺乏鲁棒性保证，需建立其鲁棒性理论并构造显式鲁棒形式。

Method: 对基于Lyapunov构造的DSM利用输入-状态稳定性（ISS）论证其鲁棒CBF性质；对基于轨迹预测的构造利用收缩性（contractivity）论证；针对线性系统推导闭式RDSM-RCBF。

Result: DSM可充当鲁棒CBF；线性系统下得到闭式RDSM-RCBF；仿真表明其鲁棒性优于名义DSM-CBF基线。

Conclusion: DSM构造具备可证的鲁棒安全性，闭式RDSM-RCBF为线性系统提供了实用的鲁棒安全滤波器设计手段。

Abstract: This paper establishes robustness properties for control barrier functions (CBFs) constructed using dynamic safety margins (DSMs). We show that DSMs can act as robust CBFs by leveraging input-to-state stability for Lyapunov-based constructions, and contractivity for trajectory-prediction-based approaches. Additionally, we derive closed-form DSM-based robust CBFs (RDSM-RCBFs) specifically for linear systems. Simulations highlight the improved robustness of the proposed RDSM-RCBFs compared to nominal DSM-CBF baselines.

</details>


### [1317] [Efficient Joint Trajectory Optimization and Resource Allocation for Secure UAV Networks: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37897v1)
*Abdulmalik Alwarafy,Mohamed Hayajneh,Mustafa Al Juboori,Abdulaziz Almarzooqi,Tahnoon Almazrouei,Robera Abera,Kaleab Nega*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对含系留UAV中心与地面窃听者的UAV网络，提出联合轨迹优化与资源分配方法，用PPO深度强化学习在保密速率、能耗与干扰间权衡，获得优于传统与DRL基线方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV在无线网络中应用日益广泛，但安全通信与高效能耗仍具挑战；本文关注存在恶意地面窃听者与系留UAV中心场景下的保密性与能效联合问题。

Method: 构建UAV具备能量收集能力、可在发送/干扰/中继三种角色间自适应切换的模型，向系留UAV中心回传数据；将保密速率、能耗与干扰的加权效用最大化建模为优化问题；针对其高度非凸性与实时决策需求，采用基于PPO的深度强化学习算法求解并学习网络动态。

Result: 大量仿真表明，所提方法在保密性能、能耗与干扰抑制方面均优于传统方法及已有DRL方法。

Conclusion: 将角色自适应切换、能量收集与PPO-DRL联合优化相结合，可有效提升UAV网络的安全性与能效，为动态未知环境下的实时决策提供可行方案。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in wireless networks; however, ensuring secure communication and efficient energy usage remains challenging. This paper addresses the joint trajectory optimization and resource allocation problem in UAV networks in the presence of a tethered UAV flying center and a malicious ground eavesdropper. In the proposed model, UAVs are equipped with energy harvesting capabilities and can adaptively switch between transmitting, jamming, and relaying roles to deliver data to a tethered UAV center for optimized network performance. An optimization problem is formulated to maximize a utility function that balances secrecy rate, energy consumption, and interference. To address the high non-convexity of the problem and its real-time decision requirements, a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm is proposed to solve the problem and learn the network dynamics. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior secrecy performance, lower energy consumption, and reduced interference compared to conventional and DRL-based methods.

</details>


### [1318] [A Community Impact-Centered Network Reduction Method for Power Systems Resilience Planning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37857v1)
*Jiarui Gao,Abigail L. Beck,Rabab Haider*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种兼顾网络物理特性与社区数据空间分布的配电网降阶方法，在Kron降阶中嵌入家庭级稀缺资源评分，实现公平性感知的韧性规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力系统韧性规划需评估大量灾害场景与投资组合，常依赖网络降阶以保证计算可行性；但降阶聚合会掩盖公平规划所需的社区影响数据。

Method: 在基于优化的Kron降阶中嵌入家庭级稀缺资源评分（刻画停电影响），提出两种形式：稀缺加权法（优先保留脆弱节点）与稀缺约束法（限制聚合簇内数据差异度）。

Result: 在德州加尔维斯顿岛真实配电馈线上评估，并与多种方法对比；稀缺约束法表现最佳，实现86%的规模缩减，最坏电压误差低于0.01 p.u.，同时保持社区数据的空间分布。

Conclusion: 通过在簇内与簇间显式控制数据异质性，所提方法得到的降阶网络在保持电气精度的同时保留了决策相关的社区信息。

Abstract: Power systems resilience planning requires evaluating many hazard scenarios and investment portfolios, often requiring network reduction for computational tractability. The resulting aggregation, however, can obscure community impact data needed for equitable planning. We present a network reduction method that jointly preserves network physics and the spatial distribution of community data. We embed a household-level scarce resource score that characterizes outage impact within optimization-based Kron reductions with two formulations: a scarcity-weighted method that prioritizes vulnerable nodes, and a scarcity-constrained method that bounds data dissimilarity within aggregated clusters. Both are evaluated on a realistic distribution feeder of Galveston Island, Texas and benchmarked against multiple approaches. The scarcity-constrained method performs best, achieving 86% reduction with worst-case voltage errors below 0.01p.u. while preserving the spatial distribution of community data. By explicitly controlling data heterogeneity within and across clusters, the proposed method yields reduced networks that retain decision-relevant community information without sacrificing electrical accuracy.

</details>


### [1319] [A heuristic for optimal coordination of autonomous vehicles: real-time algorithms](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37632v2)
*Saugat Shahi,Jonathan Frey,Filippo Fabiani,Moritz Diehl,Mario Zanon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出在无信号交叉口上联合决策联网自动驾驶车辆的通行次序与轨迹，对固定通行次序采用双层优化（下层各车求解最优控制问题，上层协调器优化进入/离开时刻），并用acados的算法微分计算下层问题的一阶、二阶灵敏度以支撑上层求解，结合定制算法实现高效计算，数值仿真验证了实时可行性与有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无信号交叉口的协调需要同时确定交叉次序与车辆轨迹，二者耦合难以直接求解；固定次序后可自然写成双层结构，但上层求解依赖下层问题关于进入、离开时刻的灵敏度信息，且需满足实时性要求。

Method: 将问题表述为双层优化：下层每辆车求解以其进入与离开时刻为参数的最优控制问题，上层协调器在优先约束下优化这些时刻。借助实时软件包acados与算法微分（AD）计算下层问题的一阶与二阶灵敏度，并设计定制算法以提升计算效率。

Result: 数值仿真表明该实现具备实时可行性，且所提协调算法有效。

Conclusion: 基于acados算法微分的灵敏度计算可高效支撑双层交叉口协调算法，实现实时可用的联合通行次序与轨迹优化。

Abstract: When coordinating connected and automated vehicles at an unsignalized intersection, the crossing order and the vehicle trajectories must be decided jointly. For a fixed crossing order, the problem can be formulated conveniently in a bi-level form where each vehicle solves its own optimal control problem, whose optimal value is a function of its entry and exit times, and a coordinator optimizes these times subject to precedence constraints. We compute the first and second order sensitivities of lower-level problems, which are required to solve the upper-level problem, by means of algorithmic differentiation using the real-time software package \texttt{acados}. This implementation exploits tailored algorithms to obtain a computationally efficient implementation of the optimal coordination algorithm. We validate our implementation in numerical simulations that demonstrate both real-time feasibility and effectiveness of our algorithm.

</details>


### [1320] [An Open-Source Hybrid Ray-Tracing and 3GPP Channel Simulator for Non-Terrestrial Network](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37536v1)
*Yu-Chien Lin,Cheng-Yi Chang,Yen-Cheng Lai,Ming-Chun Lee,Ta-Sung Lee*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种将站点特定射线追踪（RT）与3GPP统计信道模型融合的混合信道仿真框架，用于非地面网络（NTN），并开源统一工作流（Sionna RT + 3GPP + 混合仿真器）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RT仿真计算复杂度高、多径分量稀疏，纯统计NTN模型又缺乏站点特定传播特征，两类仿真器存在互补性局限，需要兼顾真实性与复杂度的折中方案。

Method: 以RT生成主导传播路径，再用3GPP统计方法生成附加路径与子径进行增强；将Sionna RT、3GPP统计模型与混合RT-3GPP仿真器集成到统一仿真流程中。

Result: 基于关键信道统计量与功率时延谱（PDP）的仿真结果表明，该方法在保持站点特定传播特性的同时提供了足够丰富的多径分量。

Conclusion: 混合框架有效弥补了纯RT与纯统计NTN信道仿真器各自的不足，且以开源形式发布以支持可复现性与后续NTN研究。

Abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid channel simulation framework that combines site-specific ray tracing (RT) with 3GPP-compliant statistical channel simulation for non-terrestrial networks (NTNs). The proposed approach uses RT to generate dominant propagation paths and augments them with statistically generated paths and subpaths to provide richer multipath realizations under practical simulation complexity. To provide a complete simulation framework, we integrate Sionna RT, 3GPP, and hybrid RT-3GPP simulators within a unified workflow. Simulation results based on key channel statistics and power delay profiles show that the proposed method preserves site-specific propagation characteristics while providing sufficiently rich multipath components, thereby addressing the complementary limitations of conventional RT-based and purely statistical NTN channel simulators. The developed simulator is also released as an open-source project to support reproducibility and further NTN research.

</details>


### [1321] [Joint Antenna Positioning and Pilot Power Allocation for Uplink Fluid Antenna-Aided Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37428v1)
*Manobendu Sarker,Soumaya Cherkaoui*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文研究无小区大规模MIMO上行URLLC场景下，联合优化流体天线（FA）位置与导频功率分配，以在导频污染下最小化平均NMSE，并满足有限块长与MMPP排队分析的时延约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: URLLC业务对时延与可靠性极为苛刻，导频污染限制信道估计精度；流体天线可通过连续调整阵元位置重塑空间相关结构以适应变化传播环境，但FA位置与导频功率的联合设计尚缺乏兼顾有限块长时延与排队约束的可解建模。

Method: 建立以平均NMSE为目标、以有限块长与MMPP排队导出的QoS为约束的联合优化问题；通过特征结构对齐因子推导NMSE与有效SINR的解析二次关系，将时延需求转化为显式NMSE阈值；采用交替优化：天线位置用基于解析梯度与闭式欧氏投影的连续凸近似（SCA）迭代更新，导频功率用带保护Newton步的块坐标下降（BCD）保证单调收敛；并提出自校准正则化变体以刻画精度-能耗Pareto前沿。

Result: NMSE-有效SINR映射的近似误差中位数低于0.03 dB，90%以上实际工况样本相对误差低于10%；所提定位方案相较固定均匀阵列NMSE最多改善22%，速度比粒子群优化快7–8倍；功率分配在计算成本低两个数量级以上时达到全局最优的0.5%以内，并实现最多39%的导频能耗降低且估计性能损失可忽略。

Conclusion: FA位置优化与高效导频功率分配可在导频污染下显著提升URLLC无小区大规模MIMO的信道估计精度与能效，且所提低复杂度算法逼近最优性能，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: This paper investigates joint fluid antenna (FA) position optimization and pilot power allocation for uplink cell-free massive MIMO networks supporting ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) traffic under pilot contamination. By continuously adjusting FA elements within a prescribed aperture, we adapt the spatial correlation structure to the varying propagation environment. We formulate a joint problem to minimize the average normalized mean-squared error (NMSE) subject to QoS constraints governed by finite blocklength and Markov-modulated Poisson process queueing analyses. To ensure tractability, we establish an analytical quadratic relationship between the NMSE and the effective signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio through eigenstructure alignment factors. This mapping translates complex latency requirements into explicit NMSE thresholds, maintaining a median absolute approximation error below 0.03 dB and less than 10% relative error for over 90% of practical-regime samples. Given the nonconvex nature of the formulation, we propose an alternating optimization framework. Antenna positions are iteratively updated via successive convex approximation using analytical gradients and closed-form Euclidean projections. Pilot powers are allocated through a block coordinate descent scheme that employs safeguarded Newton steps to guarantee monotonic convergence. Furthermore, we introduce an auto-calibrated regularization variant to navigate the Pareto frontier between estimation accuracy and energy consumption. Numerical results show the proposed positioning yields up to 22% NMSE improvement over fixed uniform arrays while operating 7-8x faster than particle swarm optimization. The power allocation achieves within 0.5% of the global optimum at over two orders of magnitude lower computational cost, providing up to 39% pilot energy reduction with negligible estimation penalty.

</details>


### [1322] [A New Parametric Uncertainty Approach to Systems with Time-Varying Delay and Feedback Stabilization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37354v1)
*Aleksandr Talitckii,Eduardo S. Tognetti,Peter Seiler,Matthew M. Peet*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 将含时变状态时滞的DDE重构为"标称固定时滞DDE + 乘性参数不确定性算子"的反馈互联，使不确定性算子具备紧致的范数界，并借助PIE表示实现稳定性分析与反馈控制器综合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上含不确定时变时滞的DDE被建模为标称时不变系统与时变不确定性算子的反馈互联，但常用不确定性算子选择无法给出紧致的输入-输出（范数）刻画，导致稳定性分析与控制器综合结果保守或难以直接应用。

Method: 提出新的DDE表示：以"固定时滞的标称DDE"与时变乘性参数不确定性算子互联，参数以L∞范数有界，从而得到不确定性算子的范数上界；进一步给出修正表示，用参数的L2范数界定算子范数；再用偏积分方程（PIE）表示标称系统，使这些不确定性刻画可用于稳定性判别与镇定反馈控制器设计。

Result: 通过简单数值算例验证了所提表示与PIE框架下稳定性分析及镇定控制器综合的有效性。

Conclusion: 将时变时滞DDE表示为固定时滞标称系统与乘性参数不确定性的互联，并结合PIE，可获得紧致的不确定性算子范数界，为鲁棒稳定性分析和控制器综合提供可行且有效的途径。

Abstract: Delay Differential Equations (DDEs) with an uncertain time-varying state delay are often modeled as a feedback interconnection of a nominal time-invariant system with a time-varying uncertainty operator. However, typical choices of uncertainty operators do not admit tight characterizations of input-output properties. In this paper, we propose a new representation of a DDE with time-varying delay system as a feedback interconnection of a nominal fixed delay DDE with a time-varying multiplicative parametric uncertainty operator, where the parameter is bounded in $L_\infty$ norms -- yielding an operator norm bound on the uncertainty. We then provide a modified uncertainty representation which uses the $L_2$ norm of the parameter to bound the operator norm of the uncertainty. Finally, we show that by representing the nominal system using Partial Integral Equations (PIEs), these characterizations of the uncertainty operator can be used for stability analysis or stabilizing feedback controller synthesis. The effectiveness of the approach is illustrated with simple numerical examples.

</details>


### [1323] [Probabilistic Sequential Safety for Stochastic Dynamical Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37311v1)
*Abhijit Mazumdar,Manuela L. Bujorianu,Rafal Wisniewski*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出并研究随机动力系统的“序列安全性”(sequential safety)概念：安全性不再要求每个时刻都避开单一不安全区域，而是要求避免按顺序命中一组目标区域，并将其求解归结为随机系统的序列可达性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准安全性定义基于“每个时刻都须避开状态空间中的不安全区域”，难以刻画许多实际场景中需要按序避开多个目标区域的失效模式，例如大语言模型越狱攻击的建模与危险化学反应预测。因此需要一种更贴合此类应用的序列化概率安全概念。

Method: 提出基于避免状态空间中一组目标区域元组（而非单一不安全集）的序列安全概念，赋予其概率语义；在求解该序列安全问题时，将其转化为随机动力系统的序列可达性问题（sequential reachability）来处理。

Result: 建立了序列安全性概念与序列可达性问题之间的对应关系，即序列安全性的求解可归约为对随机动力系统的序列可达性分析；文中以LLM越狱攻击与危险化学反应等实例说明了该概念的适用性。

Conclusion: 序列安全性提供了比逐时刻避障更一般、更贴合实际的安全刻画，为随机系统安全性验证提供了新视角，并指出后续可通过序列可达性工具进行定量概率分析。

Abstract: In this letter, we investigate a notion of probabilistic safety for a stochastic dynamical system. Standard safety notions are based on the idea that an unsafe region of the state-space must be avoided at each instant. In contrast, we study a sequential safety notion which is based on avoiding a tuple of target regions of the state-space. The proposed safety notion is inspired by many practical systems, ranging from modeling jailbreak attacks in large language models (LLMs) to predicting hazardous chemical reactions. In solving the sequential safety problem, we solve a sequential reachability problem for a stochastic dynamical system.

</details>


### [1324] [A heuristic for optimal coordination of autonomous vehicles: dynamic problems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37288v2)
*Saugat Shahi,Filippo Fabiani,Mario Zanon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于到达触发的滚动时域方案，围绕"调度精化"启发式，联合优化无信号交叉口自动驾驶车辆轨迹与通行顺序，在数百辆异质车辆场景下弥补了FIFO调度的大部分最优性差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无信号交叉口的车辆协调需同时决定各车轨迹与通行顺序（通行序列），且要协调的车辆集合随交通流不断变化。所形成的问题为混合整数最优控制问题，在线求解困难；而简单采用先进先出（FIFO）调度又会带来明显的最优性差距。

Method: (1) 采用到达触发的滚动时域（receding-horizon）框架，仅当新车辆到达时才触发重规划；(2) 在固定通行顺序下，用单个非线性规划（NLP）同时优化全部车辆轨迹与通行时刻；(3) 利用代价对车辆调度（顺序）的一阶灵敏度，筛选出可能降低总代价的相邻交换（adjacent swaps），构成调度精化启发式；(4) 新到达车辆追加到当前通行顺序末尾；(5) 维护跨重规划步骤持久保存的已评估交换记忆，避免重复计算。

Result: 在涉及数百辆异质车辆流的仿真交通场景中，所提方案可弥补FIFO调度所产生的绝大部分最优性差距（recover most of the optimality gap）。

Conclusion: 以NLP求解加灵敏度引导的相邻交换，配合到达触发重规划与交换记忆，能够在动态车辆集合下高效近似求解无信号交叉口协调的混合整数最优控制问题，显著优于FIFO基线，具备在线可行性。

Abstract: The coordination of autonomous vehicles at unsignalized intersections requires deciding both the trajectories of the vehicles and their crossing order, with the additional difficulty that the set of vehicles to be coordinated changes as traffic flows through the intersection. Since the resulting mixed-integer optimal control problem is hard to solve online, we propose an arrival-triggered receding-horizon scheme built around a schedule-refinement heuristic: for a fixed crossing order, a single nonlinear program (NLP) optimizes all trajectories and crossing times, and the first-order sensitivities of the cost with respect to the vehicle schedule are used to select adjacent swaps that are likely to reduce the overall cost. Replanning is triggered only when a new vehicle arrives, the new vehicle is appended at the tail of the current crossing order, and a memory of evaluated swaps that persists across replanning steps avoids redundant computations. Simulations of traffic scenarios involving streams of a few hundred heterogeneous vehicles show that the proposed scheme recovers most of the optimality gap incurred by first-in-first-out scheduling.

</details>


### [1325] [A heuristic for optimal coordination of autonomous vehicles: static problems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37275v2)
*Saugat Shahi,Filippo Fabiani,Mario Zanon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对无信号交叉口自动驾驶车辆轨迹规划与通行次序决策强耦合、难以联合优化的问题，提出下层非线性规划（NLP）+上层启发式调度的双层框架，在保持计算可解性的同时显著优于先到先服务（FIFO）次序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无信号交叉口下，各车轨迹规划与穿越/通行次序决策本质耦合，联合优化在实际中不可解（计算上难以处理），需要一种兼顾最优性与实时可解性的分解式方法。

Method: 采用层次化结构：下层为一组非线性规划（NLP），在给定通行次序下优化各车轨迹；上层为启发式算法，利用下层NLP的灵敏度信息（sensitivity information）设计新的通行调度方案（crossing schedules），即在上层搜索次序、下层评估轨迹代价。

Result: 在广泛交通场景下的大规模数值仿真表明，相较先到先服务（FIFO）次序，所提策略取得显著更优的调度效果，同时保持计算可解性（computational tractability）。

Conclusion: 将耦合的次序决策与轨迹规划分层解耦，并以灵敏度信息驱动上层搜索，是求解无信号交叉口协同调度的一种有效且可扩展的途径；该框架在性能与计算成本之间取得良好折中，优于FIFO基线。

Abstract: We consider the coordination of autonomous vehicles at unsignalized intersections, where trajectory planning and crossing-order decisions are intrinsically coupled, thereby making their simultaneous optimization intractable in practice. To this end, we propose a heuristic based on a hierarchical structure consisting of a series of nonlinear programs (NLP) in the lower level, which optimizes trajectories of each vehicle for a given crossing order, and a high-level heuristic to design new crossing schedules that exploits sensitivity information from the lower-level NLPs. Extensive numerical simulations across a broad range of traffic scenarios demonstrate that our strategy achieves substantially improved scheduling with respect to first-in-first-out ordering while preserving computational tractability.

</details>


### [1326] [Co-Optimization of Network Topology and Variable Impedance Devices under Dynamic Line Ratings Using Iterative McCormick Relaxation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36871v1)
*Junseon Park,Hyeongon Park,Rahul K. gupta*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一协同优化框架，将网络拓扑优化（NTO）、动态线路容量（DLR）与可变阻抗装置（VID）整合建模，用McCormick松弛与迭代精化处理双线性项，在IEEE 118节点等系统上实现接近非线性模型的精度与良好计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GETs（NTO、DLR、VID）在输电网中部署增多以缓解阻塞、提升利用率，但单独运行难以充分释放其效益，需要协调运行；同时NTO的离散开关决策与VID的双线性潮流项使模型成为混合整数非线性规划，求解困难。

Method: 构建NTO、DLR、VID的统一协同优化模型：NTO采用节点—断路器（node-breaker）建模以获得更细的开关粒度；DLR纳入风速与环境温度等气象相关参数动态调整传输限额；针对含双线性VID项的潮流约束与离散拓扑决策形成的MINLP，采用McCormick松弛线性化双线性项，并提出迭代精化机制提升精度。

Result: 在IEEE 118节点系统上开展详细分析，并在其他基准系统上做可扩展性案例研究；结果表明所提方法相较标准McCormick松弛提高了求解精度，解质量接近非线性原模型，同时保持计算效率。

Conclusion: NTO、DLR与VID的协同优化可有效缓解阻塞并降低运行成本；迭代精化的McCormick松弛在精度与可解性之间取得良好折中，适用于实际规模的输电网GETs协同调度。

Abstract: Grid Enhancing Technologies (GETs), such as Network Topology Optimization (NTO), Dynamic Line Rating (DLR), and Variable Impedance Devices (VIDs) are increasingly deployed in power transmission grids to address congestion and improve grid utilization. However, their growing adoption necessitates coordinated operation to fully exploit their benefits. This paper presents a unified co-optimization framework that integrates NTO, DLR, and VID to alleviate congestion and minimize operational costs. NTO is modeled using a node-breaker formulation to provide enhanced switching granularity, while DLR incorporates weather-dependent parameters, including wind speed and ambient temperature, to dynamically adjust transmission limits. The resulting formulation is a mixed-integer nonlinear program due to power flow constraints with bilinear VID terms, and discrete topology decisions. To improve tractability, we propose using a McCormick relaxation approach to linearize bilinear terms. Furthermore, we propose an iterative refinement of the McCormick relaxation scheme to enhance solution accuracy. The proposed framework is validated through detailed analyses on the IEEE 118-bus system, along with additional case studies on other benchmark systems to assess scalability. Results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves solution accuracy compared to standard McCormick relaxation, achieves solution quality close to the nonlinear formulation, and maintains computational efficiency.

</details>


### [1327] [Whittle Index Policy for Three State Collapsing Bandits](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36733v2)
*Rahul Meshram,Anu Krishna,Kesav Ram Kaza*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测的三状态restless multi-armed bandit（称为collapsing bandit）：只有被调度的臂状态可完全观测，未被调度时状态不可观测，且每时隙有调度预算约束，目标是最大化长期折扣累计奖励。作者用MLR序与单调奖励结构证明最优值函数在信念向量上的凸性与单调性，进而给出阈值型最优策略与Whittle index的indexability，并给出索引计算算法与仿真比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测下的动态资源分配（如传感器/健康监测调度）需要在预算约束下决定调度哪些臂；已有关于阈值策略与indexability的结果依赖较强模型假设，作者希望在更弱的转移概率与折扣因子假设下推广到三状态情形。

Method: 将N臂collapsing bandit解耦为N个单臂问题；利用信念向量上MLR序与单调奖励结构假设推导最优值函数的凸性与单调性；在值函数关于信念的Lipschitz界等充分条件下证明最优策略为信念上的阈值型；通过补贴敏感性的Lipschitz界证明单臂的indexability；给出索引计算算法。

Result: 证明了值函数的凸性与单调性、最优策略的阈值结构，并在对转移概率模型与折扣因子β最小限制性假设下证明了indexability；结果推广至三状态并强化了现有阈值策略与indexability结论；仿真中比较了Whittle索引、myopic与round-robin策略。

Conclusion: 三状态部分可观测collapsing bandit在较弱假设下仍具有阈值最优策略与Whittle index可索引性，所提索引算法可行，仿真显示其相对myopic与round-robin策略具竞争力。

Abstract: Partially observable restless multi-armed bandit models have been studied for dynamic resource allocation problems under uncertainty. This paper analyzes three-state restless multi-armed bandits with partial observability. These are called collapsing bandit problems if the state of an arm (bandit) is perfectly observable when it is scheduled for allocation. The state is not observable when the arm is not scheduled. The planner has a budget constraint on the scheduling decisions in each time slot. The planner's goal is to maximize expected cumulative long term discounted reward. We study the Whittle index policy. To analyze index policy, first the $N$-armed collapsing bandit problem is decoupled into $N$ single arm problems, and convexity and monotonicity of the optimal value function in belief vector are derived using monotone likelihood ratio (MLR) ordering on state transition dynamics and monotone reward structure assumption.
  We next show that the optimal policy is of threshold type in belief under sufficiency conditions on the model. These sufficiency conditions depend on Lipschitz bound on the value function in the belief. We further prove the indexability for an arm using Lipschitz bound on subsidy sensitivity with minimal restrictive assumption on the transition probability model and discount factor $β.$ Our results generalize to three state and strengthen existing results on threshold policy and indexability with weaker model assumptions. We provide index computation algorithm and we present comparison of the Whittle-index, myopic policy and round-robin policies in the simulation study.

</details>


### [1328] [Retrofitting centralized air compressor stations with end-use-aware predictive set-pressure control using a physics-constrained pressure-drop model](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36678v1)
*Taito Watanabe,Yohei Kono,Akira Iyozumi,Takashi Nakajima*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对中小型工厂集中式压缩机站，提出一种轻量级分层NMPC，仅用两只压力表和压缩机数据即可在满足末端需求的前提下降低设定压力，实测年能耗较恒压运行降低2.8%（相对0.70 MPa降低9.3%），单次更新≤1.41 s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压缩空气系统通常按远高于末端需求的恒定设定压力运行，这部分余量即被浪费的能量；而常规方案依赖流量计与管网调研，或需要PID整定用的阶跃试验，在运行中的工厂难以实施。

Method: 在典型集中式压缩机站顺序控制器上改造加装分层非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）；仅使用储气罐与一个关键末端点两只压力表及压缩机数据，无流量计、无管网调研；末端压力由低阶压降模型预测，该模型在稳定性、阻尼与稳态平衡约束下用最小二乘辨识，约束服务的是可用性而非精度，使实测压降能以单位增益在预测时域内保持。

Result: 三阶段验证（现场数据、经实测校核的管网仿真器、实际控制器，单次更新最长时间1.41 s）；NMPC在真实需求下满足所需压力，估计年能耗较现有恒压运行降低2.8%（相对0.70 MPa降低9.3%）；采用同一压力表的PID串级仅在按标准规则、以恒负载阶跃试验的推荐整定值时才能取得相近节能效果；工厂扩建与管网拆分后，NMPC不改模型和默认权重仍保持性能。

Conclusion: 压力余量由固定过压量转变为可设计参数，控制器信号还能指示供气系统何处缺乏压力裕度；该方法无需阶跃试验、易于在运行工厂中改造部署。

Abstract: Compressed air systems usually run at a constant set pressure well above the end-use requirement; the excess margin is wasted energy. A lightweight hierarchical nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) scheme, retrofitted to the sequencing controller of a centralized compressor station typical of small and medium-sized plants, lowers the set pressure as far as the end-use requirement allows. It uses only two pressure gauges (receiver and one critical end-use point) and compressor data, without flow meters or piping surveys. The end-use pressure is predicted by a low-order pressure-drop model identified by least squares under stability, damping and steady-state equilibrium constraints, which serve use rather than accuracy: they let the measured pressure drop be held over the horizon with unit gain. Validated in three stages (plant data, a pipe-network simulator checked against measurements, and the actual controller, at most 1.41 s per update), the NMPC meets the required pressure under real demand and reduces the estimated annual energy consumption by 2.8 % relative to the current constant operation (9.3 % relative to 0.70 MPa). A PID cascade with the same gauge saves about as much only when tuned by a standard rule at its recommended setting from a constant-load step test, difficult in an operating plant; the NMPC needs no such test and keeps its performance with its initial model and default weights after plant expansion and network split. The margin becomes a design parameter instead of a fixed excess, and the controller's signals show where the supply system lacks headroom.

</details>


### [1329] [Thermal-Mass Coupled Modeling and Optimal Scheduling of Aluminum Smelting Loads for Safe Demand Response Participation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36555v1)
*Yan Shen,Ruike Lyu,Shuoqi Wang,Jing Dai,Hongye Guo,Chongqing Kang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对铝冶炼负荷（ASL）参与需求响应时因电解槽热动态模型过于简化而导致的灵活性低估或温度约束违背问题，提出热-质耦合（TMC）动态模型，并重构为可解的MILP模型，在PBDR与IBDR算例中净经济收益分别比ETP模型高122.4%与325.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铝冶炼负荷具备可观的灵活性潜力，但由于功率调节会扰动电解液温度与过热度，可能引发电解质凝固或产量损失，实际需求响应参与度保守。现有ASL需求响应方法多采用线性模型或等效热参数（ETP）模型等过度简化的电解槽热动态模型，可能违背温度约束或低估可用灵活性。

Method: 提出热-质耦合（TMC）动态模型，刻画电解槽的关键物理机理：氧化铝下料动态、结壳相变动态以及状态依赖的电流效率；并利用泰勒近似与McCormick包络重构，将所得非线性关系转化为可处理的混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型。

Result: 在PBDR与IBDR的说明性算例中，基于非线性参考模型的评估显示，TMC模型的净经济改善分别比ETP模型高出122.4%和325.1%。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够在显式评估运行安全约束满足情况的同时，支持铝冶炼厂更深层次地参与需求响应。

Abstract: Aluminum smelting loads (ASLs) offer substantial flexibility potential, yet their actual participation in demand response remains conservative owing to the risk of operational failures. Power adjustments disturb the electrolyte temperature and superheat, which may lead to electrolyte freeze-out or yield loss. Existing ASL demand response methods often rely on oversimplified dynamic models of the electrolytic cell's thermal behavior, such as linear models and the Equivalent Thermal Parameter (ETP) model, which may either violate temperature constraints or underestimate the available flexibility. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a Thermal-Mass Coupled (TMC) dynamic model. The model captures the essential physical mechanisms of electrolytic cells, including alumina feed dynamics, ledge phase-change dynamics, and state-dependent current efficiency. The resulting nonlinear relations are reformulated into a tractable mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model using Taylor approximations and McCormick-envelope reformulations. In the illustrative PBDR and IBDR case studies, the nonlinear reference-model assessment shows that the TMC model achieves net economic improvements 122.4% and 325.1% higher, respectively, than the ETP model. The proposed framework can therefore support deeper demand response participation by aluminum smelters while explicitly assessing adherence to operational safety constraints.

</details>


### [1330] [A Topology-Aware Neural Network for Fault Location With Missing Measurements](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36474v1)
*Fan Jiang,Linhan Fang,Xingpeng Li,Kaushik Rajashekara*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种考虑拓扑的神经网络故障定位器（TANFL），用于辐射状配电网馈线，可同时辨识故障母线/线路并估计连续故障位置，且单一模型能兼容完整量测与任一处母线量测装置失效的场景。在IEEE 15节点馈线上优于传统MLP，单母线量测缺失情形下5%容差内精度居三者最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辐射状配电馈线的故障定位需要兼顾拓扑结构与线路参数信息，同时实际配电网中母线量测数据常出现缺失，传统MLP与基于公式的方法在量测不完整时精度下降，缺乏单一模型同时适应完整与缺失量测场景的能力。

Method: 输入为故障暂态衰减后的电压、电流相量，以及馈线连接关系与线路参数；网络由共享母线编码器、母线读出模块和门控线路读出模块组成，用于识别故障母线或线路并回归所选线路上的连续故障位置；训练中引入显式缺失数据指示与随机母线数据块掩蔽，使单一模型可处理完整量测及任一允许母线量测装置失效的情形。

Result: 在IEEE 15节点馈线上，于相同数据、相同量测可用性场景与相同评价指标下与常规MLP及基于公式的定位方法对比：测试集上TANFL优于常规MLP；完整量测时线路故障定位性能略低于公式法，但在单母线量测块缺失场景的平均结果中，5%容差下精度为三者最高。

Conclusion: 拓扑感知结构与缺失数据训练策略使TANFL在量测完整与部分缺失场景间取得较好平衡，鲁棒性优于对比方法；在完全量测下精度尚略逊于公式法，后续可进一步缩小该差距。

Abstract: This paper proposes a topology-aware neural network-based fault locator (TANFL) for radial distribution feeders, which uses voltage and current phasors obtained after the decay of fault induced transients, as well as feeder connection relationships and line parameters, as inputs. The shared bus encoder, bus readout module, and gated line readout module work together to identify the faulty bus or line and estimate the continuous fault location on the selected line. During training, explicit missing data indicators and random bus data block masking are introduced, enabling a single trained model to handle both complete measurement sets and scenarios where any permitted bus measurement device fails. On the IEEE 15 bus feeder, this paper compares TANFL with a conventional multilayer perceptron (MLP) and the formula-based localization method under identical data, measurement availability scenarios, and evaluation metrics. On the test partition, TANFL outperforms the conventional MLP; with complete measurements, its line fault location performance is slightly lower than that of the formula-based method, but in the average results for scenarios with one missing bus measurement block, its accuracy is the highest among the three methods at a 5% tolerance.

</details>


### [1331] [Phase-Coordinated Model Predictive Control for AI Training Power Smoothing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36441v1)
*Jie Zhu,Ye Tian,Yinliang Xu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种利用短启动时延的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，通过协调独立AI训练任务的相对相位，在计算源头抑制电源功率波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI训练负载的周期性功率波动可能激发电力系统振荡；现有平滑手段需中断任务或增设硬件，成本高。

Method: 构建滚动时域MPC框架，利用任务启动的短时延空间；以余弦/正弦投影量化主导振荡分量，用其幅值构造凸二次功率平滑目标，随新负载信息更新启动决策并保证调度可行性。

Result: 0.2–2 Hz频段内均方功率波动降低74.39%，功率标准差降低46.6%，平均启动时延2.188 s；全部启动截止时间满足，最大端到端计算时间0.390 s，低于0.50 s的MPC更新周期。

Conclusion: 无需中断任务或额外硬件，仅靠相位协调的启动调度即可显著平滑AI负载功率波动，且计算开销满足实时闭环要求。

Abstract: Periodic power fluctuations from artificial intelligence (AI) training workloads can excite oscillations in power systems. This paper proposes a model predictive control (MPC) framework that exploits short start-time delays to mitigate power fluctuations at the computing source. By coordinating the relative phases of independent training jobs, the proposed method reduces the superposition of oscillatory power components without interrupting running jobs or requiring additional power-smoothing hardware. To obtain a tractable optimization formulation, cosine and sine projections are employed to quantify the dominant oscillatory power components, and their magnitudes are used to construct a convex quadratic power-smoothing objective. The receding-horizon framework updates launch decisions as new workload information becomes available while maintaining scheduling feasibility under limited computation time. Numerical results demonstrate reductions of 74.39\% in mean-square power fluctuations within the 0.2--2-Hz band and 46.6\% in power standard deviation, with an average launch delay of 2.188~s. All launch deadlines are satisfied, and the maximum end-to-end computation time is 0.390~s, below the 0.50-s MPC update period.

</details>


### [1332] [Electric Vehicle Scheduling and Carbon-Aware Energy Dispatch for Charging Stations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36426v1)
*Fulong Yao,Yiming Xu,Maurizio Albano,Liana Cipcigan,Naeima Hamed,Shangyin Weng,Omer Rana*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出SFGH（无求解器贪心启发式）做动态车辆调度、TD3控制器做碳感知能量调度的两阶段方法，用于光伏-储能-双向电网的电动汽车充电站协同优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EV充电站同时集成光伏发电、电池储能与电网双向交换，需在有限充电桩资源下协调车辆接入与能量供给，并同时兼顾用能成本与碳排放；现有调度/调度方法难以兼顾实时性与多目标。

Method: 将问题分解为车辆调度（VS）与能量调度（ED）两层：VS采用无求解器贪心启发式SFGH，按服务时延缩减量分配EV到充电桩；ED采用TD3深度强化学习控制器控制电池充放电，在满足VS产生的充电需求下平衡成本与碳排。模型允许PV与电池向电网售电，计入售电收益与碳信用。

Result: 在为期一年的案例仿真中，与所评估的多种启发式及多智能体DRL配置相比，SFGH–TD3取得最低的累计服务时延、用能成本与碳排放。

Conclusion: 启发式调度与DRL能量调度的组合可在动态、多目标场景下同时改善服务质量、经济性与碳绩效，双向售电与碳信用机制可进一步释放灵活性价值。

Abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging stations integrating photovoltaic (PV) generation, battery storage, and bidirectional grid exchange must coordinate access to limited chargers with energy supply while considering both energy cost and carbon emissions. This paper proposes a solver-free greedy heuristic (SFGH) for dynamic vehicle scheduling (VS) and a twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (TD3) controller for carbon-aware energy dispatch (ED). SFGH assigns EVs according to reductions in service delays, and TD3 controls battery operation to balance energy costs and carbon emissions while meeting the resulting charging demand. The model allows both PV and battery exports, accounting for export revenue and carbon credits. Simulations on year-long case studies show that SFGH--TD3 achieves the lowest accumulated service delay, energy cost, and carbon emissions among the evaluated heuristic and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) configurations.

</details>


### [1333] [Data-Driven Hamiltonian for Neural Optimal Control](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36378v1)
*Christopher A. Strong,Aswin Surya,Namhoon Cho,Jason J. Choi,Claire J. Tomlin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出数据驱动哈密顿量（DDH）框架，用数据替代显式动力学模型来评估哈密顿量，并借Lipschitz常数等极少先验信息量化数据未覆盖区域的不确定性，从而在有限/低质数据下获得带性能保证的最优控制策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习虽为数据驱动最优控制的主流方法，但通常需要大量数据，且面对分布外状态-动作对时缺乏保证；显式解析动力学模型又往往不可得。

Method: 基于最优控制的Hamilton-Jacobi理论：以数据驱动哈密顿量替代需要解析模型的哈密顿量，并推广到一大类最优控制问题；利用Lipschitz常数等少量先验信息对数据未覆盖区域的不确定性进行量化与补偿，从而推导带性能保证的控制器；可灵活融合额外先验知识；对高维系统引入物理信息的值函数神经网络近似，并用通过DDH评估的最坏情况虚构轨迹生成新训练流程。

Result: LQR问题中DDH在全部测试数据集上接近最优代价（包括离线RL仍远非最优的随机数据），且样本需求远少于在线RL；非线性月球着陆器基准上，相对轨迹优化参考的最优性差距比CQL和FQL小3倍以上，并以约37倍更少的样本达到与SAC相当的性能。

Conclusion: DDH可作为数据驱动最优控制的有前景框架，尤其适用于数据数量或质量受限的场景。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a prominent data-driven approach to optimal control, but often requires substantial amounts of data and provides limited guarantees when encountering out-of-distribution state-action pairs. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach grounded in the well-established Hamilton-Jacobi framework in optimal control theory. Rather than requiring an explicit analytical model of the system dynamics to evaluate the Hamiltonian, we replace this with a data-driven Hamiltonian (DDH), which we generalize to a broad class of optimal control problems. In contrast to standard RL approaches, the DDH provides a principled mechanism, requiring only minimal prior system information such as a Lipschitz constant, for quantifying and accounting for uncertainty in regions not covered by the data, enabling the derivation of controllers with performance guarantees. Additional prior system knowledge, when available, can be readily incorporated to improve performance. For high-dimensional systems, we further introduce a physics-informed neural approximation of the value function, trained using a novel procedure that generates worst-case fictitious rollouts evaluated through the DDH. On an LQR problem, the DDH reaches near-optimal cost on every dataset we test, including random data on which offline RL methods remain far from optimal, and needs far fewer samples than online RL. On a nonlinear lunar lander benchmark, the DDH achieves an optimality gap to a trajectory-optimization reference more than $3\times$ smaller than CQL and FQL, and matches the performance of SAC with approximately $37\times$ fewer samples. These results establish the DDH as a promising framework for data-driven optimal control, particularly in settings where available data are limited in quantity or quality.

</details>


### [1334] [Multi-time-scale Control of Power Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36357v1)
*Emiliano Dall'Anese,John W. Simpson-Porco,Florian Dorfler,Saverio Bolognani,Sairaj Dhople*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文重新审视电力系统传统的"一次控制—自动发电控制(AGC)—经济调度"分层组织，指出电力电子变换接口的大规模接入要求重构系统级控制层级，并论证多时间尺度建模、反馈控制与反馈优化三类工具可将传统有机演化形成的层级重新诠释为现代控制架构，以实现异构资源协调、约束处理与快速执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电网以大型同步发电机为主，控制层划分清晰、分离明确。如今电力电子能量变换接口快速部署，系统惯量与动态特性发生改变，原有层级是否仍适用值得重新考察，因此需要从系统层面重新审视控制层级设计。

Method: 以综述/架构性论述为主：先概述电力系统模型与常规运行实践，再建立其与现代控制架构的联系，具体借助多时间尺度建模、反馈控制与反馈优化三类方法，对一次控制、AGC、经济调度这三层结构进行重新诠释，并强调在不忽视第一性原理物理的前提下利用更快的执行能力。

Result: 论文并非给出单一实验数值结果，而是梳理出可连接传统运行实践与现代控制设计的映射关系，表明所提架构能够协调异构资源、计入运行约束，并充分利用快速响应能力。

Conclusion: 多时间尺度建模、反馈控制与反馈优化为当代电力系统的分层控制提供了统一视角，使有机演化而成的控制层级得以被系统化重构，从而支撑高比例电力电子化电网的协调控制与优化运行。

Abstract: The power grid has been dominated by large synchronous generators and clearly separated control layers. Today, power-electronics energy conversion interfaces are rapidly being deployed calling for another look at system-level control hierarchies. This article examines how multi-time-scale modeling, feedback control, and feedback optimization can help reinterpret the traditional organically grown hierarchy of primary control, automatic generation control, and economic dispatch, and enable new approaches for control of contemporary power systems. Beginning with an overview of power system models and conventional operational practices, the article develops connections to modern control architectures that can coordinate heterogeneous resources, account for operational constraints, and exploit faster actuation without overlooking first-principles physics.

</details>


### [1335] [Distribution Grid Reconfiguration and Restoration via Linearizable Multi-phase Power Flow Modeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36252v1)
*Young-ho Cho,Hao Zhu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出拓扑自适应、低复杂度的神经分段线性潮流模型N-PWL，可直接嵌入支路状态变量并保持支-节点一致性，支持MILP求解配电网重构与恢复排序问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配电网拓扑优化中离散支路状态决策显著提升计算复杂度；现有线性化潮流精度不足，AC非线性潮流与神经网络端到端模型在未训练拓扑上泛化差、难以嵌入MILP。

Method: 设计顺序分层（sequential layer）结构，将支路状态变量直接注入"支路潮流→节点注入"的映射，从而内生满足支-节点一致性；采用馈线固定尺寸区域划分实现神经网络参数规模随区域数线性增长；输出分段线性形式，可嵌入MILP求解DNR与ROP。

Result: 在不平衡多相IEEE 123节点系统上，N-PWL在潮流预测上优于端到端基线，并能准确表征任意未见拓扑；用于DNR/ROP时相较线性化潮流显著提升AC可行性，拓扑决策数较多时计算时间明显优于基于AC非线性潮流的模型。

Conclusion: 拓扑自适应的低复杂度分段线性神经潮流模型可兼顾精度、可扩展性与MILP兼容性，为配电网拓扑优化提供有效建模途径。

Abstract: Accurate and tractable power-flow (PF) modeling is essential for distribution grid topology optimization, where the presence of discrete branch-status decisions therein significantly increase the computational complexity. To tackle this challenge, we develop a topology-adaptive, low-complexity neural piecewise-linear (N-PWL) PF model. We propose a sequential layer design that can directly incorporate branch status variables into the PF mapping from branch flows to nodal injections. As a result, our N-PWL model not only preserves the PF branch-node consistency but also facilitates the representation of any unseen topologies without retraining. A low-complexity model design is further pursued to attain a linear NN parameter scaling by using a fixed-size area partition of the feeder. The resulting scalable N-PWL model enables mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulations of feeder topology optimization tasks, including distribution network reconfiguration (DNR) and restoration ordering problems (ROP). Numerical studies on the unbalanced, multi-phase IEEE 123-bus feeder demonstrate our N-PWL model outperforms existing end-to-end baselines in PF prediction and, more importantly, can fill the gap by achieving accurate representation of any unseen topologies. For solving DNR/ROP, our model can significantly improve the AC feasibility over linearized PF models, with a notable reduction of computation time compared with AC-PF based nonlinear formulations, particularly under a large number of topology decisions.

</details>


### [1336] [Improving Learned AC-OPF Feasibility under Distribution Shift with PF-in-the-Loop Correction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36236v1)
*Afia Afrin,Omid Ardakanian*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文分析三种先进的基于学习的交流最优潮流(AC-OPF)方法，指出它们在部署阶段均未利用潮流(PF)实际状态的反馈来保证预测控制的可行性；作者用一个简单的"潮流在环"可行性恢复滤波器，实证表明该反馈可在四个分布外场景下显著提升硬可行性，且运行开销适中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的AC-OPF虽能实现快速调度，但在分布偏移下可行性会退化。作者希望找到现有方法共有的、部署阶段的关键缺陷，并以低成本方式弥补。

Method: 对三种SOTA方法进行对比分析，归纳出共同局限：均不使用潮流实际状态反馈来确保预测控制的可行性。据此设计一个简单的PF-in-the-loop可行性恢复滤波器，对预测控制进行后处理修复。

Result: 在四个分布外(OOD)场景下，引入PF反馈后硬可行性大幅提升，而额外运行时开销较小。

Conclusion: 部署阶段的潮流反馈是提升学习型AC-OPF可行性的关键且易被忽视的环节；简单的在环恢复滤波器即可作为有效的通用补丁。

Abstract: Learning-based AC-OPF enables fast dispatch, yet its feasibility can degrade under distribution shift. We analyze three state-of-the-art methods and identify a shared deployment-time limitation: none use feedback from the power-flow (PF)-realized state to ensure feasibility of the predicted control. Using a simple PF-in-the-loop feasibility restoration filter, we empirically show that such feedback substantially improves hard feasibility across four out-of-distribution scenarios with modest runtime overhead.

</details>


### [1337] [Nonprehensile Robotic Catching Using Virtual Constraints](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35851v1)
*Aakash Khandelwal,Ranjan Mukherjee*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出用虚拟非完整约束（VNHC）解决非抓取式机器人接球问题：直接在末端执行器上以被接物体的状态设计并控制末端运动，无需物体轨迹预测与时变轨迹生成，并以MPC实现接触后稳定停位，仿真验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非抓取接取方法依赖对物体轨迹的预测，并据此生成时变的机器人轨迹，计算与实现复杂且对预测误差敏感。作者希望绕开轨迹预测环节，改为以物体状态直接刻画末端执行器的运动。

Method: 聚焦平面情形，构造虚拟非完整约束，使末端执行器在期望高度上以最小相对法向速度于接触瞬间接住物体；该VNHC函数仅依赖期望接取高度，可对一组初始条件通用；接触后采用模型预测控制（MPC）将物体与末端执行器共同制动至期望位置。

Result: 仿真表明，该方法能在期望高度接住物体，接触瞬时相对法向速度最小；同一VNHC函数可覆盖多组初始条件，且接触后经MPC可将物体与末端执行器停稳于指定位置。

Conclusion: 虚拟非完整约束为无预测、无时变轨迹生成的非抓取接取提供了可行框架，其参数（接取高度）少、适用初始条件范围广；后续可拓展至三维情形与实物实验。

Abstract: The problem of nonprehensile robotic catching is addressed using virtual nonholonomic constraints (VNHCs); the motion of the robot end-effector is designed and controlled directly in terms of the states of the object before it is caught on the surface of the end-effector. In contrast to contemporary approaches, our approach avoids the need for object trajectory prediction, and consequent time-varying robot trajectory generation. With a focus on the planar case, we demonstrate that our VNHC approach can be used to catch an object on an end-effector at a desired height, with minimal relative normal velocity at the contact instant. Moreover, the VNHC function depends only on the desired catching height, and the same VNHC can be used for a range of initial conditions. We use model predictive control (MPC) to bring the object and end-effector to rest at a desired location after contact is made. The approach is validated in simulation.

</details>


### [1338] [Security Region Compression via Hybrid Vertex Pruning for Enhanced Computational Efficiency](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35815v1)
*Sicheng Gong,Zeyu Liu,Danyang Xu,Hongjie Jia*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出混合局部搜索与回溯搜索的顶点剪枝方法实现安全域（SR）压缩，在至多1.65%超体积损失下减少96%以上SR数据量，使8维SR可计算，并将相关优化问题求解时间至少降低52.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全域以凸包多面体表示可刻画电力系统多设备联合可行域，但计算过程会产生大量对整体超体积贡献极小的低质量顶点，导致数据规模庞大、存储开销高、相关优化问题求解效率低。

Method: 构造由顶点集生成的凸包多面体表示SR；提出混合"局部搜索"与"回溯搜索"的顶点剪枝策略进行SR压缩，其中回溯搜索允许此前被剪除的顶点在被重新识别为关键顶点时被回收复用；并将该压缩方法嵌入SR计算与SR相关优化问题求解中以提升效率。

Result: 在两个实际荷兰中压电网算例上验证：压缩后超体积损失至多1.65%，SR数据量减少超过96.0%；8维SR变得计算可行；在电网感知计算任务中求解时间至少缩短52.9%，最优性损失至多1.36%。

Conclusion: 所提SR压缩方法在精度损失可接受的前提下显著降低数据规模与计算负担，兼顾有效性与应用价值。

Abstract: The security region (SR) specifies a joint feasible region in the operational space involving various installations within the power system. It enables dynamic allocation of capacity among these energy units, thereby unlocking additional grid potential for power delivery and mitigating congestion. By constructing a convex hull from a set of vertices to form a polytope, the SR can be effectively represented with an acceptable accuracy loss. However, the SR computation inevitably generates many low-quality vertices, which contribute little to the overall hypervolume and can be discarded. By introducing SR compression, the SR data size can be reduced, which in turn facilitates the memory-efficient computation of SR and time-efficient solution of SR-related optimization problems. Accordingly, this paper proposes a vertex pruning approach that mixes local and backward search policies to achieve effective SR compression. In particular, the backward search strategy allows previously pruned vertices to be recycled when they are re-identified as critical. Subsequently, we incorporate this approach to enhance computational efficiency in the aforementioned applications. Numerical validations are conducted on two realistic medium-voltage Dutch grid cases. The results demonstrate at most 1.65% hypervolume loss with over 96.0\% SR data size reduction after applying the proposed compression approach. Empowered by this compression, the 8-dimensional (8D) SR becomes computationally tractable. Moreover, in relevant grid-aware computation challenges, the solving time can be reduced by at least 52.9% with at most an 1.36% optimality loss. All above validate both the efficacy and values of the proposed SR compression approach.

</details>


### [1339] [Grid-Forming AC/DC Converters for Meshed DC Networks via Dual-Measurement Frequency Droop](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35709v1)
*Hisham Mahmood,Marcelo A. Elizondo*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出并分析双测量频率下垂（DMFD）控制器，仅用母线电压偏差与滤波后的直流端口电流/功率偏差两个本地测量，便可在中压直流（MVDC）网状网络中实现AC、DC端口构网运行与唯一稳态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网状MVDC网络中，基于PLL的跟网控制在大扰动或弱网条件下易失稳、失去阻尼；需要一种仅依赖本地直流测量的构网控制方案，并给出其稳态与动态特性的可解析设计依据。

Method: DMFD仅调节端口频率，不直接调节直流电压或电流。通过AC侧同步作用，在每个同步端口等效闭合成直流下垂。建立稳态模型：终端恒定频率偏差与单端孤岛均以等效电流偏置形式进入同一组直流方程，孤岛频率由孤岛功率平衡确定，节点电压与支路电流由单一线性系统求解；据此给出将下垂比与净直流注入水平映射为电压偏差与端口电流界的稳态设计包络。另建立小信号动态模型，绘制特征值轨迹与阻尼比图以指导增益选取。

Result: 证明网状网络稳态工作点存在且唯一；稳态模型给出设计用包络；四端环形网络的平均值EMT仿真表明，在PLL跟网控制已知丧失阻尼的工况下，DMFD仍保持稳定，并遵循预测的稳态特性。

Conclusion: DMFD以极简本地测量实现了AC/DC双端口构网与唯一稳态，打通了稳态解析、设计包络与动态整定的完整链条，为网状MVDC网络提供了对PLL弱网失稳问题的稳健替代方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes and analyzes a dual-measurement frequency-droop (DMFD) controller for meshed MVDC networks. Using only two local DC measurements, bus-voltage deviation and a filtered DC-port current or power deviation, the controller enables grid-forming operation at both AC and DC ports across the mesh. Although the DMFD regulates neither the DC voltage nor the DC current directly and acts only on the terminal frequency, it is shown that AC-side synchronization closes an effective DC droop at every synchronized terminal, so that the steady operating point of the mesh exists and is unique. Constant frequency deviations at a terminal and single-terminal islanding enter the same DC equations as equivalent current offsets, with the island frequency fixed by the island power balance, allowing node voltages and branch currents to be obtained from one linear system. The steady-state model yields design-use envelopes to map the droop ratios and the net DC-injection levels into bounds on DC-voltage deviation and terminal currents. A small-signal dynamic model is developed and used to generate eigenvalue loci and damping-ratio charts that guide controller-gain selection. Averaged EMT simulations on a four-terminal ring corroborate the analysis: in regimes where PLL-based grid-following control is known to lose damping, the DMFD controller maintains stable operation and follows the predicted steady-state characteristics.

</details>


### [1340] [FedAvgIm: Federated Learning for Multi-Site Impedance Identification of Inverter-Based Resources](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35640v1)
*Quang Manh Hoang,Guilherme Vieira Hollweg,Akhtar Hussain,Wencong Su,Van-Hai Bui*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文提出FedAvgIm——一种隐私感知的联邦学习框架，用于在本地数据严重稀缺且原始数据不出本地的前提下，实现多站点dq导纳辨识，并将其用于小信号交互稳定性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆变器型资源（IBR）大量接入使小信号交互稳定性评估变得必要；阻抗/导纳模型可在不获取厂商内部控制细节的情况下进行频域刻画，但基于测量的辨识耗时长且需随运行点重复进行，同时原始测量数据存在本地性与隐私约束，各站点可用样本极少。

Method: 每个IBR站点仅用少量“运行点-频率”样本训练本地前馈神经网络，只上传模型参数至云端聚合器；聚合器执行按样本量加权的FedAvg更新全局模型并下发回各站点。文中针对9台参数、拓扑、测量噪声水平及非IID设置各异的构网型（grid-following）IBR构建了基于EMT测量的导纳数据集，每客户端仅40–390个训练样本，并与集中式训练、本地独立训练及保持原始数据本地性的迁移学习基线对比。

Result: FedAvgIm性能接近集中式训练，并持续优于本地独立学习与保持原始数据本地性的迁移学习基线；在测量噪声下学习行为稳定，在中等非IID条件下仍具收益。所辨识的dq导纳模型进一步用于广义奈奎斯特稳定性分析，并在多运行点与多电网强度条件下与EMT时域仿真结果一致。

Conclusion: 联邦学习可在满足隐私与数据本地性约束、且样本极度稀缺的条件下有效实现多站点dq导纳辨识，所得模型可直接支撑基于广义奈奎斯特判据的小信号交互稳定性评估，并经EMT时域仿真验证。

Abstract: With the increasing integration of inverter-based resources (IBRs) into power systems, assessing small-signal interaction stability has become essential. Impedance/admittance models enable frequency-domain characterization of IBR dynamics without requiring access to proprietary internal control details, but measurement-based identification is time-consuming and must be repeated across operating points. This paper proposes FedAvgIm, a privacy-aware federated-learning framework for multi-site dq-admittance identification under severe local data scarcity and raw-data-locality constraints. Each IBR site trains a local feed-forward neural network using a small set of operating-point-frequency samples, while only model parameters are shared with a cloud aggregator that performs sample-size-weighted FedAvg to update a global model and broadcast it back to all sites. To demonstrate effectiveness, EMT measurement-based admittance datasets are constructed for nine grid-following IBRs with different parameters, architectures, measurement-noise levels, and non-IID settings, where each client has only 40-390 training samples. Results show that FedAvgIm achieves performance close to centralized training and consistently outperforms local-only learning and raw-data-locality-preserving transfer-learning baselines. Additional studies show that FedAvgIm maintains stable learning behavior under measurement noise and remains beneficial under moderate non-IID conditions. The estimated dq-admittance models are further applied to generalized Nyquist stability analysis and validated against EMT time-domain simulations under multiple operating points and grid-strength conditions.

</details>


### [1341] [Accelerated Push-Pull with Local Updates for Decentralized Stochastic Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35275v1)
*Sheng Dong,Weiguo Xia,Huijie Tao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文将递归动量引入有向网络上的随机 Push-Pull 框架，提出 ASPP 及其局部更新变体 LASPP，在均方光滑条件下证明收敛速率提升与两重线性加速，并降低通信复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Push-Pull 为有向网络去中心化优化提供了高效框架，但在随机情形下梯度方差会拖慢收敛并使线性加速的分析变得复杂。

Method: 在随机 Push-Pull 中嵌入递归动量实现方差缩减，得到 ASPP 算法；在此基础上允许各智能体在通信轮之间执行多步局部更新，得到 LASPP 变体。理论分析基于均方光滑（mean-squared smoothness）假设。

Result: 证明 ASPP 相较随机 Push-Pull 提升了收敛速率，并实现关于智能体数量的渐近线性加速；LASPP 进一步获得关于局部步数的渐近线性加速，在选取合适局部步数时，通信复杂度下降而随机梯度复杂度与 ASPP 保持一致；真实数据集实验验证了算法有效性。

Conclusion: 递归动量方差缩减与局部更新可与 Push-Pull 有效结合，在去中心化非凸随机优化中同时实现计算加速与通信节省。

Abstract: We consider decentralized stochastic nonconvex optimization over directed networks. Push--Pull provides an efficient decentralized optimization framework for such networks, but in the stochastic setting, gradient variance can slow its convergence and complicate the analysis of linear speedup. Motivated by this observation, we incorporate recursive momentum into stochastic Push--Pull for variance reduction, yielding the accelerated stochastic Push--Pull (ASPP) algorithm. Under mean-squared smoothness, we prove that ASPP improves the convergence rate of stochastic Push--Pull and achieves asymptotic linear speedup with respect to the number of agents. To further reduce communication, we develop LASPP, a local-update variant of ASPP that allows each agent to perform multiple local updates between communication rounds. We show that LASPP achieves an additional asymptotic linear speedup with respect to the number of local steps. With a suitable number of local steps, LASPP reduces communication complexity while maintaining the same stochastic gradient complexity as ASPP. Numerical experiments on real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

</details>


### [1342] [Right Model, Right Task: Capability-Constrained Carbon Labeling to Decarbonize Generative AI](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35189v1)
*Jiawei Qu,Kai Hou,Hongjie Jia,Jinyue Yan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文主张建立"能力约束型碳标签"框架，将生成式AI环境评估从"单次推理碳排放"转向"在满足任务能力要求前提下的每成功任务期望碳排放"，以通过需求侧的模型—任务匹配来降低排放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI推理碳足迹不仅取决于硬件效率和电力供给，还取决于所选模型是否与任务匹配：前沿模型处理常规请求会浪费算力，能力不足的模型则因失败、重试、延长推理与升级调用而增加能耗。然而，目前缺乏同时考虑任务特定能力要求与"成功完成任务"所对应碳排放的标准化评估框架。

Method: 提出一个Perspective层面的评估框架设计（非实验方法）：先依据任务特定能力要求对模型进行筛选，仅对达标模型比较其期望能耗与实际运行碳排放，并以"能力达标条件下每成功任务的期望碳排放"作为核心指标，配以标准化能力导向服务评估、全面能耗核算与透明碳披露三项支撑条件。

Result: 框架在概念上建立了服务质量与碳成本的关联，可支持"合适的模型用于合适的任务"的匹配决策；文中未报告定量实验或实测数据结果。

Conclusion: 将环境评估单位由每推理碳强度改为每成功任务的期望碳排放，可为降低生成式AI token 使用相关排放提供需求侧路径；其落地依赖标准化能力评估、完整能耗核算与透明碳披露。

Abstract: The carbon footprint of generative-AI inference depends not only on hardware efficiency and electricity supply, but also on whether the selected model is appropriate for the task. A frontier model may expend unnecessary computation on a routine request, whereas an under-capable model may increase energy use through failure, retries, extended reasoning and escalation. However, a standardized evaluation framework that accounts for task-specific capability requirements and the carbon emissions associated with successful task remains lacking. In this Perspective, we argue for a capability-constrained carbon labeling framework that shifts environmental assessment from carbon intensity per inference towards the expected carbon emissions per successfully completed task at the required capability level. Under this framework, models would first be assessed against task-specific capability requirements, and only models capable of meeting those requirements would be compared on their expected energy use and operational carbon emissions. By linking service quality to carbon cost, this approach could enable more informed matching of the right model to the right task, offering a demand-side pathway to reducing emissions associated with generative-AI token use. Realizing this vision will require standardized capability-based service assessments, comprehensive energy accounting and transparent carbon disclosures.

</details>


### [1343] [Adaptive Control for General Nonlinear Stochastic Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35182v1)
*Haizheng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文将经典线性自校正调节器的“最小二乘 + 确定性等价 + 最小方差”框架推广到参数紧空间上的一大类非线性参数化系统（含深度神经网络），给出在线预测误差与闭环regret的显式收敛速率，并确立稳定性和渐近最优跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典线性自校正调节理论依赖线性参数化与可辨识性/激励条件，难以直接用于深度神经网络等非线性参数化模型；需要回答：在无需激励与参数可辨识性的前提下，能否仍保证闭环稳定与渐近最优跟踪，且速率如何。

Method: (1) 在一般连续性模数（modulus of continuity）下，把历史上的非线性最小二乘拟合保证转化为在线一步预测界，并在参数Lipschitz连续与有限矩噪声假设下给出显式regret速率；(2) 采用近似NLS估计加确定性等价（最小方差类）控制，分析闭环稳定性与跟踪性能；(3) 通过闭环反例/下界说明该调节器的regret速率一般不可改进；(4) 分析对小幅未建模动态的鲁棒性。

Result: 得到参数Lipschitz情形下的显式闭环regret与跟踪误差速率；在无激励、无参数可辨识性的温和条件下证明闭环稳定与渐近最优跟踪；构造闭环例子表明regret速率对该调节器一般不可进一步提升；并证明存在小幅未建模动态时稳定性保持，跟踪误差界由趋于零项与由模型偏差决定的残差项组成。

Conclusion: 非线性最小二乘 + 确定性等价最小方差控制可视为线性自校正调节理论的严格非线性推广，其对深度神经网络类模型在无需激励/可辨识性时依然有效，并具有可量化的最优性（速率不可改进）与鲁棒性保证。

Abstract: This paper extends the least-squares and certainty-equivalence minimum-variance framework of classical linear self-tuning regulators to a broad class of nonlinearly parameterized systems with compact parameter spaces, including commonly used deep neural network models. First, historical nonlinear least-squares fitting guarantees are converted into online one-step prediction bounds under a general modulus of continuity, with explicit regret rates under parameter Lipschitz continuity and finite-moment noise. Second, approximate NLS estimation combined with certainty-equivalence control achieves closed-loop stability and asymptotically optimal tracking under mild conditions without requiring excitation or parameter identifiability. Explicit closed-loop regret and tracking error rates are established in the parameter-Lipschitz case, and closed-loop examples show that the regret rates cannot, in general, be improved for this regulator. Finally, robustness to small unmodeled dynamics is established by showing that closed-loop stability is preserved and the tracking error bounds comprise a vanishing term and a residual term determined by the model discrepancy.

</details>


### [1344] [Moving bits instead of watts: Accelerating global AI data-centre deployment at the energy-digital-water-land nexus](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35088v1)
*Jiawei Qu,Xiaoying Shi,Kai Hou,Hongjie Jia,Jinyue Yan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该研究提出将"计算负载"通过全球光纤网络转移以替代电力输送的全球框架：把未来数据中心部署在能源富裕地区，再用光纤路由计算负载。基于1100万余次小时级次国家级运行仿真，结果显示可降低建设成本44–47%、碳排放38%，避免34–67 GW高压输电容量，并使95%以上受并网延迟困局的数据中心在2030年上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI推动数据中心规模空前扩张，但电网输电约束使新数据中心长期滞留在多年期的并网排队队列中，"有电送不出、有算力上不了"。电力难以跨境长距离输送，而计算可通过光纤网络全球流动；然而这种空间迁移能否绕开受限电网、加速全球AI数据中心部署，此前尚不清楚。

Method: 构建全球性优化框架：将未来数据中心容量布局于能源富裕地区，并以光纤网络传输计算工作负载而非输电。求解与评估基于1100万次以上小时级运行仿真，分辨率为次国家级（subnational），综合约束覆盖能源系统、水资源、数字连接性、土地与融资风险，并跨多种数据中心发展情景与气候政策情景进行分析。

Result: 在多种数据中心发展与气候政策情景下，利用全球数据传输可使新建数据中心选址于上述条件有利的地区，建设成本下降44–47%、碳排放下降38%；将全球光纤网络视为能源系统资产，可避免34–67 GW高压输电容量（量级相当于意大利全国峰值电力需求）；可使2030年95%以上受并网延迟影响的数据中心投产；加拿大、北欧国家与阿拉伯半岛成为首选区位。

Conclusion: "计算流动性"（computational mobility）可作为能源系统扩容的替代路径，为能源与AI基础设施的全球协同规划提供依据。局限：结论依赖光纤容量/时延与主权数据约束的理想假设，未量化长距离传输时延与数据治理成本；成本与碳减排幅度为情景仿真结果，需实证验证。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is driving an unprecedented expansion of data centres. However, this growth is increasingly stalled by grid transmission constraints that trap new data centres in years-long connection queues. Unlike electricity, computation can be moved across the globe through fibre-optic networks, but whether this spatial transfer can bypass constrained grids and accelerate global AI data-centre deployment remains unknown. Here we develop a global framework that places future data-centre capacity in energy-abundant regions and routes computational workloads through fibre-optic networks rather than transmitting electricity. We evaluate the framework through more than 11 million hourly operation simulations at subnational resolution, integrating constraints on energy systems, water, digital connectivity, land and financing risk. Results show that across multiple data-centre development and climate-policy scenarios, leveraging global data transfer allows new data centres to be sited where these conditions are favourable, lowering construction costs by 44-47% and carbon emissions by 38%. By treating the global fibre-optic network as an energy-system asset, it avoids 34-67 GW of high-voltage transmission capacity, comparable in magnitude to Italy's national peak electricity demand. Crucially, this methodology could bring more than 95% of connection-delayed data centres online in 2030, with Canada, the Nordic countries and the Arabian Peninsula emerging as preferred locations for data-centre development. Our findings establish computational mobility as an alternative to energy-system expansion, informing the coordinated global development of energy and artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

</details>


### [1345] [Joint Dynamic Lane Reversal and Variable Speed Limit Control: A Graphormer-Based Approach](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35070v1)
*Hamed Araab,Abbas Ahmadi,Mohammad Hossein Basiri*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文将全网动态车道方向分配与方向性限速控制建模为带单行道强连通约束的优化问题，用图定向理论保证可通行图始终强连通，并采用共享Transformer（GERASTSA）预训练+逐路PPO微调求解；在6×6网格通勤场景下日延误较固定初始配置降低90%、较调优双向负载均衡器降低85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联网自动驾驶车辆使车道方向与限速可高频重配，但收益取决于交通再路由，且单向化可能孤立路口，因此需要在全网层面同时处理车道分配、限速与强连通性约束，并解决大规模路网协同控制的学习难题。

Method: 问题建模包含全网动态车道分配、方向性限速、每次反向前的清空阶段，以及始终强连通的可导航图。动作解析算法基于图定向理论：仅在关闭某方向后网络仍强连通时才接受提议，否则松弛或回退，保证清空过程中各路口互相可达。所有道路控制器共享一个Transformer，其注意力机制GERASTSA覆盖全部"道路-时间"token并以道路间端点关系作为偏置。模型先在动作条件交通预测任务上预训练，再用逐路PPO和混合奖励（额外计入邻路与全网贡献）微调。

Result: 6×6网格通勤高峰实验中，学得策略使约三分之二道路在高峰方向单向化，日延误较固定初始配置降90%、较调优双向负载均衡器降85%。测试时限制为双向道路，其增益仅与负载均衡器相当，而其学到的限速反而增加延误。预训练将超越固定配置所需更新次数约减半。消融显示，仅移除关系偏置或空间嵌入影响显著，可使延误约增至五倍。

Conclusion: 结果说明可逆单行道与限速协同策略的效益主要来自车道方向重分配，强连通约束下的动作解析可安全实现高频反向；关系偏置与空间嵌入是关键设计，预训练显著提升样本效率。

Abstract: Connected and automated vehicles could allow reassigning lane directions and speed limits on every road frequently, but the benefit hinges on how traffic reroutes, and one-way roads can isolate junctions. We formulate network-wide dynamic lane allocation and directional speed limit control with one-way roads, lane clearing before each reversal, and a navigable graph kept strongly connected at all times. An action-resolution algorithm grounded in graph orientation theory admits a proposal closing a direction only if the network stays strongly connected and otherwise relaxes or reverts it, keeping all junctions mutually reachable within the model, even during clearing. All road controllers share one transformer whose attention, Global Endpoint Relation-Aware Spatio-Temporal Self-Attention (GERASTSA), spans all road-time tokens, biased by the endpoint relations between roads. It is pretrained on action-conditioned traffic forecasting and fine-tuned with per-road proximal policy optimization under a mixed reward that also credits neighboring roads and the network. On a 6 x 6 grid with commuter rush hours, the learned policy makes about two thirds of roads one-way in the peak direction and cuts daily delay by 90% against the initial configuration held fixed and by 85% against a tuned two-way load balancer. Restricted to two-way roads at test time, it gains only about as much as this balancer, whereas its learned speed limits add delay. Pretraining roughly halves the updates needed to surpass the fixed configuration. Of the ablations, only removing the relational bias or the spatial embedding clearly matters, multiplying delay about fivefold.

</details>


### [1346] [Compositional Approximately Bisimilar Abstractions of Stochastic Interconnected Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34895v1)
*S. Saharsh,B. A. Sadek,Abdalla Swikir,Pushpak Jagtap,Adnane Saoud*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于改进随机可达集过近似与δ-ISS-Mq性质的组合式(交替)互模拟符号模型构建框架，用于离散时间随机互联系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局互联随机系统的符号抽象计算量随子系统数量爆炸式增长，单体（monolithic）方法难以扩展甚至无法收敛，因此需要能保持局部关系可组合的模块化抽象方法。

Method: 利用精化的随机可达集过近似与q阶矩输入-状态稳定性（δ-ISS-Mq），先在随机系统与其确定性无噪对应系统间建立近似互模拟关系，再推导子系统组合为全局互联系统时局部互模拟关系得以保持的形式化条件。

Result: 在固定十房间建筑及6至14房间环形级联互联的温度调节案例中，子系统数量超过少量阈值后，该方法抽象计算时间显著快于单体方法，且差距随子系统数增加而扩大；单体方法在超过十房间时无法收敛。

Conclusion: 所提组合框架在保持形式化互模拟保证的同时，显著提升了随机互联系统符号抽象的扩展性与工程可用性。

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of constructing (alternating) bisimilar symbolic models for discrete-time, stochastic, interconnected systems. By leveraging a refined over-approximation of the stochastic reachable sets and the q-th moment input-to-state stability (delta-ISS-Mq) property, we establish an approximate bisimulation relation between stochastic systems and their deterministic (noise-free) counterparts. This approach significantly simplifies the analysis of the approximate (alternating) bisimulation between the global interconnected stochastic system and its symbolic model. We derive formal conditions under which local bisimulation relations are preserved when composing subsystems into a global interconnected system. The engineering relevance of the proposed compositional framework is demonstrated through temperature regulation case studies involving a fixed ten-room building and a circular cascade interconnection scaled from six to fourteen rooms. The results show that, beyond a small number of subsystems, the proposed method achieves substantially faster abstraction computation times than standard monolithic approaches, with the performance gap widening as the number of interconnected subsystems grows and the monolithic approach failing to converge beyond ten rooms.

</details>


### [1347] [Symbolic Direct Construction of Augmented Systems for Levenberg-Marquardt Power Flow](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34509v1)
*Tianshi Cheng,Venkata Dinavahi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出增广型 Levenberg-Marquardt 潮流（LMPF）形式，直接用符号置换算子组装增广块，证明矩阵对称准定（positive damping 下），从而可用定序、免主元 QDLDL 分解；并给出半径与阻尼的单探测自适应信赖域初始化。直接组装比坐标表路径快 7.5–11.9 倍，QDLDL 数值重分解与三角求解最多提速 3.40 倍，自适应初始化使 RTE 平坦启动仅需 19–25 次分解，case2383wp 达 237 ms（相对文献加速 847–1860 倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
