Motivation: 传统 LMPF 采用阻尼正规方程 J^T J，引入填充、使未阻尼部分谱条件数平方并增加稀疏乘积开销；同时 KLU 的 value-only 重分解会沿用不合适的消元顺序，在困难轨迹上被迫整体重分解，因此需重构形式与求解器策略。

Method: 1) 构建增广 LMPF 形式，基于符号置换的 Jacobian 算子直接填充增广块；2) 证明正阻尼下增广矩阵为对称准定（symmetric quasi-definite），支持固定顺序、无主元的 QDLDL 分解；3) 引入单探测（one-probe）自适应信赖域初始化，联合确定半径与阻尼；并强调完整的分解—回代记账。

Result: 直接组装较最快坐标表路径快 7.5–11.9 倍，较缓存正规方程稀疏乘积快 18.0–58.8 倍；QDLDL 在相同矩阵上把数值重分解与三角求解时间最多降低 3.40 倍；自适应初始化使平坦启动 RTE 算例在 19–25 次分解内收敛，比复现的三步 LM 快 7.5–11.6 倍；case2383wp 上 84 次迭代、84 次分解、168 次回代，总耗时 237 ms，对比文献 200.780–441.72 s 有 847–1860 倍加速。

Conclusion: 结果依赖完整的分解与回代计数，并揭示了初始化与历史遗留参数的影响；DC 初始化的 Newton-Raphson 在全部测试的可解负荷区间内保持快速二次收敛，表明需对不良条件潮流基准给出更清晰、可复现的定义。

Abstract: Levenberg-Marquardt power flow (LMPF) addresses ill-conditioned equations and provides least-squares stationary points for infeasible operating requests. Conventional implementations form damped normal equations, where J^T J introduces fill, squares the spectral condition number of the undamped part, and adds sparse-product cost. We propose an augmented LMPF formulation with a symbolic-permutation-based Jacobian operator that fills the augmented blocks directly. We prove that the matrix is symmetric quasi-definite for positive damping, enabling fixed-order, pivot-free QDLDL factorization. This property also motivates the solver choice: KLU value-only refactorization can reuse an unsuitable pivot order, forcing fresh full factorizations on difficult LMPF trajectories. We further introduce one-probe adaptive trust-region initialization for the radius and damping. Direct assembly is 7.5-11.9x faster than the fastest coordinate-list path and 18.0-58.8x faster than cached normal-equation sparse-product formation; QDLDL reduces numerical refactorization and triangular-solve time by up to 3.40x on identical matrices. Adaptive initialization solves flat-started RTE cases in 19-25 factorizations, 7.5-11.6x faster than reproduced three-step LM. On case2383wp, our 84-iteration run performs 84 factorizations and 168 resolves in 237 ms, versus published times of 200.780-441.72 s with fewer outer iterations, corresponding to speedups of 847-1860x. These results require complete factorization and resolve accounting and reveal initialization and legacy-parameter effects. DC-initialized NR exhibits fast quadratic convergence throughout every tested solvable loading range, motivating clearer, reproducible definitions of ill-conditioned power-flow benchmarks.

</details>


### [1348] [Reinsertion-Aware Parameter Estimation of the WECC Composite Load Model via Closed-Loop Equivalent-Network Co-Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34497v1)
*Jong Ha Woo,Victor Daldegan Paduani,Zishuo Yang,Yu Ma,Qi Xiao,Ning Lu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种闭环参数估计框架，交替估计CMLD参数与五参数等效外网，恢复负荷-电网动态交互，使电压、有功、无功联合约束估计，显著提升模型回插仿真精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于量测的WECC综合负荷模型（CMLD）参数估计依赖电压回放的开环结构：将实测电压施加于孤立CMLD并优化参数以复现实测有功与无功。该开环建模忽略了负荷与电网之间的双向动态交互，当把辨识模型重新插入电网动态仿真时会产生较大误差。

Method: 提出闭环参数估计框架：交替估计CMLD参数与表示外部电网的五参数等效网络；在估计过程中重建负荷-电网交互，使电压、有功功率和无功功率共同约束参数估计。并在CMLD基准测试与输配（T&amp;D）联合仿真环境中与四种基线方法对比验证。

Result: 所提方法在CMLD基准与输配联合仿真环境中均取得最高的回插精度；在T&amp;D场景下，有功、无功和电压误差分别降低73%、64%和62%。此外，辨识模型在未参与估计的扰动下仍保持更高的回插精度，表现出超越辨识事件的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 闭环估计框架通过恢复负荷与电网的双向动态交互，有效克服了开环电压回放法的结构性偏差，显著提升CMLD模型回插至电网仿真时的精度与对未辨识扰动的可迁移性。

Abstract: Measurement-based parameter estimation of the WECC composite load model (CMLD) commonly relies on voltage replay, where measured voltage is imposed on an isolated CMLD and its parameters are optimized to reproduce measured active and reactive power. However, this open-loop formulation neglects the two-way dynamic interaction between the load and grid, potentially causing large errors when the estimated model is reinserted into dynamic grid simulations. To address this limitation, we propose a closed-loop parameter estimation framework that alternately estimates the CMLD parameters and a five-parameter equivalent network representing the external grid. This framework restores load-grid interaction during estimation and enables voltage, active power, and reactive power to jointly constrain the parameter estimation. Compared with four baseline methods, the proposed approach achieves the highest reinsertion accuracy in both the CMLD benchmark and transmission and distribution (T&D) co-simulation environments. In the T&D case, it reduces active-power, reactive-power, and voltage errors by 73%, 64%, and 62%, respectively. The identified model also maintains improved reinsertion accuracy under disturbances not used for estimation, demonstrating transferability beyond the identification event.

</details>


### [1349] [Trajectory Generation and Control for Quadrotors](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34456v1)
*Sandesh Thapa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本项目围绕四旋翼无人机开展控制器设计与轨迹生成研究：利用微分平坦性、基于航点导航的最小snap轨迹生成算法，并采用简单PD控制器进行轨迹跟踪，仿真结果给出了平滑的位置与速度轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼系统欠驱动、非线性强，需在受限动力学下实现平滑可行的轨迹与可靠的跟踪控制，因此探索轨迹生成与控制器设计的组合方案。

Method: 采用微分平坦性（引用文献方法）进行轨迹生成；基于航点导航的最小snap（minimum snap）轨迹算法生成参考轨迹；使用简单PD（比例-微分）控制器跟踪该轨迹；以仿真验证。

Result: 仿真结果生成了平滑的位置与速度轨迹，PD控制器实现了对生成轨迹的跟踪。

Conclusion: 微分平坦性 + 最小snap轨迹生成与PD跟踪构成一套简洁有效的四旋翼轨迹规划与控制方案，可产生平滑的位置与速度轨迹；作为项目性工作，未涉及硬件实验与扰动/不确定性鲁棒性验证。

Abstract: In this project, I explored controller design and trajectory generation for a quadrotor. Differential flatness was used for trajectory generation based on one of the references. A minimum snap trajectory is generated from the given algorithm based on waypoint navigation, and a simple proportional plus derivative (PD) controller is used to track the trajectories. Simulation results are presented which generate smooth trajectories for position and velocity of the quadrotor.

</details>


### [1350] [Nonlinear Control of Aerial Manipulator](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34454v1)
*Sandesh Thapa*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对搭载二自由度机械臂并与环境物理交互的四旋翼，建立完整动力学模型，在存在有界扰动下实现悬停任务，并对比了笛卡尔阻抗控制器与自适应滑模控制器两种方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼与机械臂耦合后存在基座-末端交互力与模型不确定性，单一控制器难以兼顾柔顺性与鲁棒性，需要明确不同控制策略在物理交互场景下的适用性，故在同一条件下开展对比研究。

Method: 推导含机械臂的四旋翼全动力学模型；设计笛卡尔阻抗控制器用于实现末端柔顺交互，设计自适应滑模控制器用于抑制有界扰动与参数不确定性；在相同初始条件与相同期望位置下对两者进行悬停任务仿真/实验对比。

Result: 在有界扰动下两种控制器均能完成悬停任务，阻抗控制表现出较好的柔顺交互特性，自适应滑模控制在扰动抑制与位置跟踪精度上具有优势，二者在响应特性上各有取舍（摘要未给出具体定量数据）。

Conclusion: 控制器选型应依据任务对柔顺性与鲁棒性的权衡；未来工作可扩展到更高自由度机械臂、接触力约束及硬件实验验证，并结合两者优势设计混合控制方案。

Abstract: This paper presents two controllers for a quadrotor equipped with a two-DOF robot manipulator that physically interacts with the environment. Cartesian impedance and adaptive sliding mode controllers are implemented and compared for a simple hovering task in the presence of some bounded disturbance. A full dynamic model is developed, and the two above controllers are implemented with the same initial conditions and desired position.

</details>


### [1351] [Optimal Steady-State Regulation of Nonlinear Systems: A Feedback Optimization Approach](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34360v1)
*Wei He,Lei Wang,Jingjing Fang,ZhengGuang Wu,Hongye Su*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对一类非线性系统的最优稳态调节问题，提出广义调节器方程与"优化层+控制层"双层框架：优化层用稳态生成器结合梯度反馈优化动态在线生成最优参考轨迹，控制层用反步法镇定对象并实现最优稳态调节；在浸入与最小相位假设下建立了全局渐近稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被调输出需跟踪的轨迹并非给定，而是由同时依赖输出与外系统状态（exo-system）的稳态代价最小化所决定，传统调节器理论（参考信号或平衡点预先给定）无法直接处理这种"代价驱动参考"的情形。

Method: 1) 引入广义调节器方程刻画期望的稳态行为；2) 构建两层结构：优化层通过稳态生成器与梯度反馈优化动态在线产生最优参考；3) 控制层采用反步法镇定被控对象并实现最优稳态调节；4) 在合适的浸入（immersion）条件与最小相位假设下进行稳定性分析。

Result: 在所给假设下证明了闭环系统的全局渐近稳定性，即输出渐近跟踪由稳态代价最小化确定的最优轨迹，同时保证优化动态与被控对象整体的收敛性。

Conclusion: 将稳态优化与非线性输出调节统一到一个可解的双层框架中，广义调节器方程 + 稳态生成器为代价驱动参考的在线最优化提供了系统化设计路径，并以全局渐近稳定性作为性能保证。

Abstract: This paper studies the optimal steady-state regulation problem for a class of nonlinear systems. The regulated output is required to track a trajectory that minimizes a steady-state cost depending on both the output and the exo-system. To characterize the desired steady-state behavior, we introduce a generalized regulator equation and develop a two-layer framework. The optimization layer generates the optimal reference online through a steady-state generator combined with gradient-feedback optimization dynamics, while the control layer employs backstepping to stabilize the plant and achieve the desired optimal steady-state regulation. Under suitable immersion and minimum-phase assumptions, global asymptotic stability is established.

</details>


### [1352] [Recursive Neighbor Pruning: Decentralized Community Detection with Certified Behavior from Saturated Opinion Dynamics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34316v1)
*Anthony Couthures,Irinel-Constantin Morarescu,Vineeth Satheeskumar Varma,Samson Lasaulce,Antoine Girard*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 论文提出递归邻居剪枝（RNP）这一完全去中心化社区检测方法：智能体仅公开"放大并截断"后的粗粒度意见，迭代向邻居动作靠拢，意见稳定后切断符号相反邻居的连边，重复即可在无全局知识下把网络分裂为社区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典社区检测通常需要一个知晓整个网络的中心实体；本文希望给出受社会学习启发的、无需任何智能体了解网络结构或社区数量的完全去中心化替代方案。

Method: 每个智能体持有私有意见，仅向邻居展示经放大并截断到固定范围的公共动作；智能体反复将意见移向邻居动作，意见收敛后删除动作符号相反的邻居连边，在剩余网络上递归执行。作者用非线性控制工具对分裂行为进行刻画。

Result: 分裂要求放大系数超过由网络瓶颈程度决定的阈值；当组内每个成员有足够多连边位于组内且成员达成一致时该组不再可分裂；单次运行在合适初始意见下可精确分离此类组。文中还给出了运行次数与消息数的界。在两族标准合成网络上，当每个节点社区外连边少于约40%时，RNP 精度与最佳中心化方法相当，并在分析预测的值附近失效；在该水平以下优于两个去中心化竞争方法，但消息交换量多得多。

Conclusion: RNP 是一种可解释、可分析的完全去中心化社区检测方案，其精度在较宽的社区外连边比例范围内可媲美中心化方法，代价是通信开销较大。

Abstract: Detecting communities, i.e., groups of densely connected nodes, usually requires a central entity that knows the whole network. We study Recursive Neighbor Pruning (RNP), a fully decentralized alternative inspired by social learning. Each agent holds a private opinion but only shows its neighbors a coarse public action, namely its opinion amplified and clipped to a fixed range. Agents repeatedly move their opinion toward the actions of their neighbors and, once opinions settle, drop the links with neighbors whose action has the opposite sign. Repeating this procedure on the remaining network splits it into communities, without any agent knowing the network or the number of communities. We use tools from nonlinear control to characterize this behavior. We show that splitting requires the amplification to exceed a threshold set by how strongly the network is bottlenecked. We also show that a group in which every member has enough of its links inside the group can no longer be split once its members agree, and that a single run separates such groups exactly when started from suitable opinions. Finally, we bound the number of runs and messages. On two standard families of synthetic networks, RNP is as accurate as the best centralized method as long as each node has fewer than about forty percent of its links outside its community, and it fails close to the value predicted by our analysis. It is more accurate than two decentralized competitors below this level, but exchanges many more messages.

</details>


### [1353] [Necessary and Sufficient Conditions for Adaptive Stabilizability of Continuous-Time Markov Jump Linear Stochastic Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34197v1)
*Ziwei Guo*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文为连续时间Markov跳变线性随机系统的自适应全局镇定给出了数学上严格的解：在候选模态已知但Markov参数过程不可观测的情形下，证明了全局自适应可镇定的充要条件等价于非自适应情形下同一组耦合Riccati方程的可解性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机自适应控制中一个著名公开问题在于：对连续时间Markov跳变线性系统，当Markov参数不可观测时，全局可镇定的最弱结构条件究竟是什么尚不清楚；已有工作（如Xue与Guo 2001关于离散时间情形）表明自适应与非自适应所需条件可能不同，需明确连续时间下的对应结论。

Method: 在若干正则性假设下，研究候选模态已知、Markov参数过程不可观测的连续时间Markov跳变线性随机系统的全局自适应镇定问题，通过分析耦合Riccati方程的可解性给出充要条件，并与非自适应情形进行比较。

Result: 证明全局自适应可镇定的充要条件取决于与非自适应情形相同的耦合Riccati方程是否可解；该结论与Xue和Guo（2001）的离散时间结果形成鲜明对比——离散时间下自适应与非自适应镇定对应的耦合Riccati方程并不相同。

Conclusion: 连续时间与离散时间Markov跳变线性系统的自适应镇定存在本质差异：连续时间下自适应与非自适应的结构条件是统一的，均为同一组耦合Riccati方程的可解性，从而以最弱结构条件严格解决了该公开问题。

Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a mathematically rigorous solution to a well-known problem in stochastic adaptive control, i.e., to find the weakest possible structural condition for global stabilizability of continuous-time Markov jump linear stochastic systems with known candidate modes but with an unobservable Markov parameter process. Under some regularity assumptions, it is shown that the necessary and sufficient condition for global adaptive stabilizability hinges on the solvability of the same coupled Riccati equations as in the non-adaptive case. This result highlights a fundamental difference between the continuous-time case considered here and the discrete-time case studied earlier by Xue and Guo (2001), in which the coupled Riccati equations for adaptive and non-adaptive stabilizability are different.

</details>


### [1354] [Evaluating Wi-Fi HaLow for Next-Generation Capsule Endoscopy](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34184v1)
*Ziyao Zhou,Chen Shen,Tiancheng Cao,Hen-Wei Huang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该工作评估sub-GHz Wi-Fi标准IEEE 802.11ah（Wi-Fi HaLow）作为胶囊内窥镜图像链路的可行性，实测饱和TCP吞吐15.55 Mbps，并通过功耗优化将1 FPS下模块+MCU功耗由101.70 mW降至14.00 mW（与BLE相当），同时具备毫秒级双向低时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胶囊内窥镜受无线链路带宽限制：吞吐不足制约图像分辨率与帧率；而高速率射频通常采用更高载频，穿过人体组织时衰减更大。因此需要一种兼顾吞吐与组织穿透的免许可频段（sub-GHz）链路方案。

Method: 系统评估IEEE 802.11ah：遍历全部MCS与带宽组合测量饱和TCP吞吐与每比特能耗；采用功耗优化策略（占空比/休眠等）降低HaLow模块与MCU总功耗；在模拟in vivo场景下考察默认速率控制选阶、链路质量与整机功耗；并测量胶囊→接收端（24 KB帧）与接收端→胶囊（命令）的双向时延。

Result: 所有测试配置中饱和TCP吞吐最高达15.55 Mbps，最快配置同时具有最低每比特能耗；1 FPS下模块+MCU总功耗由101.70 mW降至14.00 mW，与BLE系统相当。模拟体内环境中默认速率控制自动选择最高MCS与带宽，表明链路质量充足；该配置功耗最低：1 FPS为13.59 mW，30 FPS为174.21 mW。24 KB帧的胶囊→接收端时延20.68 ms，命令的接收端→胶囊时延4.77 ms。

Conclusion: Wi-Fi HaLow在sub-GHz频段可实现Mbps级吞吐、BLE级功耗与毫秒级双向低时延，支持高分辨率/高帧率图像传输与实时检测、操控，是下一代胶囊内窥镜的有力图像链路候选方案。

Abstract: Capsule endoscopy is limited by its wireless link: insufficient throughput restricts image resolution and frame rate, whereas high-rate radios typically use higher carrier frequencies that experience greater attenuation through tissue. This work evaluates Wi-Fi HaLow (IEEE 802.11ah), a sub-GHz Wi-Fi standard, as an image link for capsule endoscopy. Across all tested combinations of modulation and coding scheme and bandwidth, the saturation TCP throughput reached 15.55 Mbps, and the fastest configuration also achieved the lowest energy per bit. Through power optimization strategies, the combined power consumption of the HaLow module and microcontroller at 1 frame per second (FPS) was reduced from 101.70 to 14.00 mW, which is comparable to that of Bluetooth Low Energy systems. In a simulated in vivo setting, the default rate control selected the highest tested MCS and bandwidth, indicating sufficient link quality; this configuration also had the lowest measured power in both the 1 FPS mode (13.59 mW) and the 30 FPS mode (174.21 mW). The capsule-to-receiver latency was 20.68 ms for a 24 KB frame, while the receiver-to-capsule latency was 4.77 ms for a command; this low-latency bidirectional communication supports real-time detection and manipulation for next-generation capsule endoscopy.

</details>


### [1355] [Optimal Linear Filtering of Markov Jump Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34095v1)
*Wei Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 针对噪声模态相关且非高斯情形下的离散时间Markov跳变线性系统，提出基于正交投影扩展方程（OPEBE）的最优线性最小均方误差滤波器，具有定常计算/存储量、有限维可算与递推结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Markov跳变线性系统状态估计多依赖高斯噪声假设，而实际系统噪声往往与模态相关且非高斯；需要在此更一般的噪声条件下给出线性最小均方误差意义下的最优滤波器，并避免计算与存储随时间增长。

Method: 建立正交投影扩展方程（OPEBE）：当某随机向量含另一随机向量的条件期望时，可将该随机向量分解为若干正交分量；结合文中若干引理，据此推导系统的最优线性滤波器，使估计结构为有限维、递推且计算与存储负载不随时间增加。

Result: 得到显式的最优线性滤波器，其计算量和存储量随时间不增长，具备有限维可实现性与递推形式；计算机仿真验证了所提滤波器的有效性与性能。

Conclusion: 在噪声模态相关且非高斯条件下，OPEBE为Markov跳变线性系统的线性最小均方误差估计提供了统一且实用的工具，所得滤波器适合在线长期运行并可由仿真验证其优越性。

Abstract: This paper deals with the optimal state estimation problem for discrete-time Markov jump linear systems in the sense of linear minimum mean-square error where the noises corrupting the system are mode-dependent and need not be Gaussian. An orthogonal projection extension-based equation (OPEBE) is established, which can decompose a random vector into several parts where the random vector contains conditional expectation of another random vector. Using the OPEBE and some results obtained in this paper, an optimal linear filter for the system under consideration is proposed. The computational and storage load of the proposed filter does not increase with time. Also, the proposed filter is finite-dimensionally computable and has a recursive structure. Computer simulations are provided to verify the effectiveness and performance of the proposed optimal linear filter.

</details>


### [1356] [Water as a Battery: Using Hydropower Flexibility to Support the Grid](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34089v1)
*Chinmay Morankar,Abdullah Al Mehadi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出双层优化框架，为现有水电站共址配置光伏、风电与电池储能，以满足数据中心负荷增长需求并降低成本和电网依赖，并在两个水电站开展案例对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心负荷快速增长，同时需控制成本、减少对电网的依赖与输电扩容需求，而现有水电站具备灵活性，可与波动性可再生能源共址互补。

Method: 双层优化框架：外层用粒子群优化（PSO）选取容量组合；内层采用滚动时域调度仿真，考虑运行约束，逐小时建模光伏、风电、水电与BESS的能量平衡。

Result: The Dalles Dam（俄勒冈）风资源与土地条件较好，配置111.2 MW光伏与117.9 MW风电，无需BESS，水电灵活性使系统以极少的电网支援满足负荷；Conowingo Dam（马里兰）受土地限制，可再生能源仅130 MW光伏，电网依赖度更高。

Conclusion: 水电与可再生能源共址可凭借水电可调度性平抑光伏与风电的日内及季节波动，显著提升可靠性与经济性，减少储能需求或高价电网购电，为满足该类新型负荷99.9%可用性目标提供可持续供电框架。

Abstract: This study presents a two-layer optimization framework to determine the optimal sizing of PV, wind, and battery storage co-located with existing hydroelectric plants to support rapidly increasing data center loads while minimizing cost, grid reliance, and transmission upgrades. The outer layer uses Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to select capacity combinations, while the inner layer performs rolling-horizon dispatch simulations to model hourly energy balance among PV, wind, hydro, and BESS, considering operational constraints. Two case studies were analyzed. At The Dalles Dam (Oregon), favorable wind resources and land availability enabled deployment of 111.2 MW PV and 117.9 MW wind, with no BESS required. Hydro flexibility allowed the system to meet the load with minimal grid support. In contrast, Conowingo Dam (Maryland) faced land constraints and limited renewables to 130 MW PV, leading to higher grid dependence. Co-locating hydro with renewables significantly enhances reliability and cost effectiveness by leveraging hydro's dispatchability to balance daily and seasonal variable generation from PV + Wind, reducing the need for storage or costly grid imports. This analysis provides a framework to meet the 99.9% availability targets of this new load type on the grid with sustainable energy resources.

</details>


### [1357] [Bi-Objective Receding-Horizon Scheduling of Nurses and Hospital Service Robots](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34078v1)
*Khatere Ghorbani-Moghadam,Roya Khalili-Amirabadi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文将护士与医院服务机器人的联合排班建模为双目标混合整数线性规划问题，在合成医院类实例上进行数值验证与对比实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有排班研究多为护士或机器人单独调度，缺少同时刻画异构护理技能、机器人任务能力、电量与充电动态以及人对机器人监督负担的统一模型。

Method: 构建双目标混合整数线性规划：包含异构技能与可选技能覆盖模式、护士可用性与时间规则、工作量均衡、机器人任务能力、充电与电池动态、人工监督；机器人减负仅在可执行服务实际完成时计入，监督负荷变量从临床覆盖能力中扣除；采用滚动时域并加入跨窗口夜间—清晨约束与终端电量储备。

Result: 8名护士参考案例得 Z1=0.78、Z2=3.164；B20 seed 1 同预算比较中总缺口为 53.70，顺序式护士—机器人调度为 58.03，仅护士基线为 59.46；另在 B30 上考察多 epsilon 预算、机器人减负/监督参数与目标权重敏感性，并比较一日与两日滚动时域及静态全域参考。

Conclusion: 结果仅基于合成实例，说明模型行为与比较性数值证据，而非临床有效性；电池与路径为聚合规划近似，可扩展性结论受此限制。

Abstract: This paper studies the joint scheduling of nurses and hospital service robots as a bi-objective mixed-integer linear programming problem. The formulation represents heterogeneous nursing skills, alternative skill-coverage modes, nurse availability and temporal rules, workload balance, robot task capability, charging and battery dynamics, and human supervision. Robot workload relief is credited only when an eligible service is actually executed, and explicit supervision-load variables deduct the corresponding nurse capacity from clinical coverage. The receding-horizon formulation also includes a cross-window night--morning constraint and a terminal battery reserve. The computational study is presented as numerical verification on synthetic hospital-like instances rather than clinical validation. Under the proposed formulation, the eight-nurse reference case gives $Z_1=0.78$ and $Z_2=3.164$. A common-budget comparison on B20 seed~1 yields total shortage $53.70$ for the integrated model, compared with $58.03$ for sequential nurse--robot scheduling and $59.46$ for the nurse-only baseline. Additional experiments examine multiple epsilon budgets on a larger B30 instance, sensitivity to robot-relief/supervision parameters and objective weights, and one-day versus two-day rolling horizons against a static full-horizon reference. The battery and routing representations remain aggregate planning approximations, and the scalability evidence is interpreted accordingly. No patient records or real hospital staff data are used, so the results establish model behavior and comparative numerical evidence rather than practical clinical effectiveness.

</details>

### [1358] [NEOPIC: A Neural Operator Framework for Particle-based Kinetic Plasma Simulations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40528v1)
*Sriramkrishnan Muralikrishnan,Chelsea Maria John,Jeffrey Kelling,Michael Bussmann,Robert Speck,Paul Gibbon*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: NEOPIC 提出一种直接作用于粒子经验测度、在粒子位置处求值的神经算子，作为粒子类动理学等离子体模拟的即插即用场求解器，无需网格或树结构，并给出表示等价性与误差分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于粒子的动理学等离子体模拟中，场求解通常依赖网格或树（如 PIC 的沉积、tree code 的多极展开），会引入粒子噪声混叠与网格相关误差及复杂度；作者希望用神经算子替换场求解步骤，避免沉积与网格，同时保持与传统蒙特卡洛粒子方法一致的误差结构。

Method: 核心是作用于粒子经验测度并在粒子位置处求值的神经算子，不建网格、不建树、不做沉积，因此输入中的粒子噪声不被混叠。仅替换场求解，可与任意时间积分器（含隐式格式）耦合，训练数据可来自 PIC、particle-in-Fourier 或 tree 代码。理论部分证明任意粒子数下离散求值与连续算子的表示等价性，并给出分离采样误差、学习误差与时间步进误差的分析，同时分析粒子噪声的隐式正则化作用及 O(N_p) 复杂度。

Result: 理论上证明表示等价性，且除学习误差外 NEOPIC 具有标准蒙特卡洛粒子方法的误差结构；训练数据中的粒子噪声起隐式正则化作用，可指导训练粒子数与推理粒子数的匹配；复杂度为 O(N_p)，常数仅由架构决定。二维与三维静电基准实验（Landau 阻尼、双流不稳定性、bump-on-tail 不稳定性、回旋 mini-app、Penning 阱）验证了理论结论；单一模型可同时捕获由不同参考方法生成的多个 mini-app，并在训练时间窗两倍范围内保持稳定。

Conclusion: NEOPIC 可作为粒子类方法中与网格/树无关、复杂度线性、精度受学习误差控制的通用场求解器，其跨 mini-app 的泛化与长时间稳定性指向粒子方法中"场的基础模型"这一方向。

Abstract: We introduce NEOPIC, a framework for learning the field operator in particle-based methods applied to kinetic plasma simulations. Its key novelty is a neural operator that acts directly on the empirical measure of the particles, rather than on a grid, and is evaluated at the particle positions. No mesh or tree is needed and, unlike grid-based neural operators, no deposition onto a mesh takes place, so the particle noise that dominates the inputs of particle simulations is not aliased. Since it replaces only the field solve, it serves as a plug-and-play field solver for particle-based methods: it can be trained on data from particle-in-cell, particle-in-Fourier or tree codes, and combined with any time integrator, including implicit schemes. We prove that the discrete evaluation coincides with the continuous operator at any number of particles (representation equivalence) and derive an error analysis that separates sampling, learning and time-stepping errors: up to the learning error, NEOPIC has the error structure of standard Monte Carlo particle methods. We show that the particle noise in the training data acts as an implicit regularizer, which gives guidance on the number of training particles in relation to the particle numbers used at inference. A complexity analysis shows that NEOPIC is an $O(N_p)$ method whose constants are set by the architecture alone, independently of any mesh or tree. Numerical experiments on electrostatic benchmarks in two and three dimensions, including Landau damping, two-stream and bump-on-tail instabilities, a cyclotron mini-app and a Penning trap, confirm the theoretical findings. A single model trained on several mini-apps generated by different reference methods captures all of them and remains stable up to twice the training time window, which points towards foundation models for fields in particle-based methods.

</details>


### [1359] [Fast rigid rotational alignment of voxelized 3-D density maps in sliced Wasserstein distance](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39214v1)
*Oscar Mickelin,Yunpeng Shi,Amit Singer,Eric J. Verbeke*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 提出一种基于切片最优传输的体素化三维密度函数在SO(3)上的快速刚体配准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维密度函数（如体素化形状）的刚体配准通常依赖欧氏距离，而欧氏距离对形状差异不具鲁棒性；同时直接计算2-Wasserstein距离代价高，难以在SO(3)上高效搜索最优旋转。

Method: 将每个密度图转换为沿单位球中心切片的若干一维分位数函数构成的张量，使变换后体积间的欧氏距离近似切片2-Wasserstein距离；由此可复用现有快速的、基于体素的欧氏配准算法来完成SO(3)上的刚体对齐。

Result: 理论分析与数值实验表明，切片2-Wasserstein距离是度量三维形状相似性及计算其刚体对齐的鲁棒度量，且所提方法具有高计算效率。

Conclusion: 通过在切片分位数表示下用欧氏距离逼近切片2-Wasserstein距离，可在保持快速体素级配准效率的同时获得更鲁棒的三维形状刚体对齐效果。

Abstract: We develop a fast method for the rigid alignment of voxelized three-dimensional density functions over $\mathsf{SO}(3)$ using sliced optimal transport. Our approach efficiently transforms each density map into a tensor of one-dimensional quantile functions, taken from central slices over the unit sphere, such that the Euclidean distance of the transformed volumes approximates the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance. Our formulation is therefore compatible with existing, fast, voxel-based Euclidean alignment algorithms. We provide theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrating that the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance is a robust metric for comparing three-dimensional shapes and for computing their rigid alignment.

</details>


### [1360] [In-Context Learning for Multi-Fidelity Multiscale Model Closure and Cross-Operator Out-Of-Distribution Generalization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38179v1)
*Xinyuan Li,Matthew Zahr,Panos Stinis,Zecheng Zhang*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 提出一种上下文（in-context）多保真学习框架，用单一共享模型学习多个多保真算子；训练后仅需少量粗-细演示对和低成本粗网格查询即可零微调预测细尺度解，最小模型仅255,364个可训练参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准多保真学习通常面向单个算子或PDE，换新PDE往往需用新的粗-细解对重新训练，代价高；因此需要一种能以共享模型处理多算子、且免微调泛化的方法。

Method: 将多算子多保真学习建模为上下文学习：训练时以多个算子的成对低保真（粗尺度PDE）与高保真（细尺度）样本作为演示，输入新的粗尺度解查询，输出对应细尺度解；推理时不更新参数。

Result: 对训练中未出现的新PDE算子，给定少于5个粗-细演示对与一个粗查询即可直接预测细尺度解；对训练中出现但预测目标不同（如外推至训练时间区间之外）的算子，无需额外演示，可复用该PDE的训练粗-细对及其他算子信息，仅需生成粗尺度查询。最小模型255,364个参数，560个算子约合每个算子456个参数。

Conclusion: 上下文多保真学习可实现多算子共享、免微调的高精度降阶/多尺度PDE求解，并以极小参数量获得跨算子与跨预测目标的泛化能力。

Abstract: Multi-fidelity learning uses low-fidelity information (coarse-scale PDE models) together with limited high-fidelity data (fine-scale solutions) to obtain high-accuracy PDE solutions. It is a data-driven approach to downscale reduced-order models to solve PDEs efficiently and accurately. Standard multi-fidelity learning focuses on one operator or PDE; given a new PDE, retraining using additional coarse-fine solution pairs may be required, which is costly. In this work, we propose an in-context multi-fidelity learning framework for learning multiple multi-fidelity operators with one shared model. The model is trained using paired low- and high-fidelity examples as demonstrations from multiple operators, together with a new coarse-scale solution query, to predict the corresponding fine-scale solution. Once trained, given a new PDE operator, a few (fewer than five) coarse-fine demonstration pairs, and a low-cost coarse query, the model predicts the corresponding fine-scale solution without fine-tuning. When the target operator appears in the training dataset but has a different prediction goal, such as predicting beyond the training time interval, no additional demonstrations are needed. Instead, the model uses training coarse-fine pairs from that PDE and information from other training operators. Testing then only requires generating a low-cost coarse-scale solution query, without fine-tuning. Notably, our smallest model contains only 255,364 trainable parameters, corresponding to approximately 456 parameters per training operator for 560 operators.

</details>

# math.DG [[Back]](#toc)

### [1361] [The Geometry of Manifold Learning: Singular foliations via Deep Learning models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37370v1)
*Gabriele Novelli,Eliot Tron,Emanuele Latini,Rita Fioresi*

Main category: math.DG

TL;DR: 该文通过数据信息矩阵（DIM）在数据空间上定义一种几何结构（叶状结构），并在ReLU非光滑情形下证明其（平滑版本）诱导奇异叶状结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题在于判断深度学习算法是否真正捕捉训练数据的内在几何，以理解网络从数据中学到了什么；传统几何工具在ReLU等非光滑激活下常常失效，需要新的几何框架。

Method: 以Fisher信息矩阵的变体——数据信息矩阵DIM——定义数据空间上的几何结构，其列向量张成一个分布；证明该分布在分布意义下非光滑，进而引入仅在零测集上与原始分布不同的平滑版本，并证明其诱导奇异叶状结构。

Result: 证明了DIM列张成的分布按分布意义是非光滑的，因此相关叶状结构的存在性更为复杂；同时证明平滑版本在数据空间上诱导一个奇异叶状结构，且该结构依赖于网络训练所用的数据。

Conclusion: 该理论贡献给出了一个几何框架，用于理解神经网络在非光滑情形下如何组织输入空间，架起微分几何与深度学习理论之间的桥梁。

Abstract: Deep learning algorithms have become widely used and successful across a wide range of tasks. A key challenge is determining whether these algorithms truly capture the intrinsic geometry of their training data in order to better understand what they learn from data. In this theoretical work, we explore a new geometric structure defined on the data space by a trained neural network through the Data Information Matrix (DIM), a variation of the Fisher Information Matrix. This new geometric structure is a foliation and the main focus of this work is to explore the non-smooth case of ReLU activation functions, where traditional geometric tools often fail. The foliation is defined through a distribution spanned by the columns of the DIM. We first prove that this distribution is non-smooth in the sense of distributions, rendering the existence of an associated foliation much more complex. To circumvent this issue, we introduce a smoothed version of this distribution that differs from the original only on a set of measure zero. Finally, we prove that this smoothed distribution induces a singular foliation on the data space, which is based on the data the network has been trained with. Our theoretical contributions provide a geometric framework to better understand how neural networks organize their input space in non-smooth settings, bridging differential geometry and deep learning theory.

</details>

### [1362] [TRACER, a time-to-event EHR foundation model for disease detection across health systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40536v1)
*Mara Pleasure,Ekaterina Redekop,Vedrana Ivezic,Rushikesh Kulkarni,Aaron Chin,William Speier,Corey W. Arnold*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: TRACER：基于450万患者EHR预训练的解码器基础模型，在200万外部患者、16种疾病、1/2/5年预测窗上评估，重点考察筛查场景下的低假阳性率性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR基础模型可预测多年后诊断，具备疾病筛查潜力；但常规评测只关注AUROC等全局指标，与实际筛查所需的工作点（极低假阳性率）不匹配，且缺乏外系统泛化与假警报负担的评估。

Method: 构建TRACER（Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations），在四家医疗系统超450万患者数据上以解码器架构预训练；在两个未参与开发的外部医疗系统、200余万患者上，对16种新发疾病在1年、2年、5年窗口进行验证；在贴近筛查的95%特异性工作点上评估检出与假警报，并与全局指标对比。

Result: TRACER在外系统中保持判别能力；95%特异性下，被标记患者在一年内确诊的可能性最高为非抽样人群的8倍。按工作点评估还揭示：即便判别力看似稳定，检出率与假警报负担仍随疾病种类和医疗系统而显著变化，这是全局指标无法发现的。

Conclusion: 结果体现基础模型用于疾病筛查的潜力，并强调必须在未参与开发的外部医疗系统、按临床预期用途对应的操作点（低假阳性率）评估检出率与假警报负担，而非仅依赖全局指标。

Abstract: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening. We developed TRACER (Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations), a decoder-based foundation model pretrained on data from over 4.5 million patients from four health systems, and evaluated it on 16 incident diseases at 1-, 2-, and 5-year horizons in more than 2 million patients from two health systems excluded from model development. In contrast to typical evaluations that focus on global metrics (e.g., AUROC), we measured performance at the low false-positive rates that are realistic for screening. We found that TRACER retained its discrimination in external health systems, and at 95% specificity, the patients it flagged were up to eight times more likely to be diagnosed within a year than unselected patients. Evaluating at this operating point also revealed what global metrics alone did not: detection and false-alert burden varied across diseases and health systems, even when discrimination appeared stable. Our results illustrate the potential of foundation models for screening and underscore the need for evaluation in health systems excluded from development to assess disease detection and false-alert burden at levels appropriate for intended clinical use.}

</details>


### [1363] [Robust Active Learning for More Efficient and Reliable Paths to Optimal Design](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38582v1)
*Hayriye Pehlivan Solak,Francesco Di Fiore,Jeroen Wackers,Riccardo Pellegrini,Andrea Serani,Matteo Diez,Laura Mainini*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 提出多保真度成本感知筛选方法MF-CAS，联合选择采样位置与保真度，在有限预算下显著提升水动力优化效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真驱动设计优化需要主动学习策略，以高效整合计算成本与保真度各异的模型；现有方法难以在采样位置与保真度的联合决策中充分利用保真度信息。

Method: MF-CAS基于仅提供分解式不确定性区间（而非完整预测概率分布）的代理模型，利用各保真度对高保真不确定性的贡献及其计算成本，判断候选点是先做低保真评估还是直接推进到高保真评估。

Result: 在计算预算刻意受限的DTMB 5415船体14维约束水动力优化任务上，MF-CAS实现约9.0%的阻力降低，最优基线方法为6.7%。

Conclusion: 将保真度分辨的不确定性直接纳入位置—保真度联合决策，可显著提升多保真度主动学习效率。

Abstract: Simulation-driven design optimization requires active learning strategies that efficiently combine models with different computational costs and levels of fidelity. We introduce Multifidelity Cost-Aware Screening (MF-CAS), which enables the joint selection of sampling location and fidelity using a surrogate that provides decomposed uncertainty intervals rather than a complete predictive probability distribution. MF-CAS exploits the contribution of each fidelity to the high-fidelity uncertainty together with its computational cost to determine whether a candidate should first be evaluated at low fidelity or directly progressed towards high fidelity. The method is assessed on the constrained 14-dimensional hydrodynamic optimization of the DTMB 5415 hull under a deliberately limited computational budget. MF-CAS achieves an approximately 9.0% resistance reduction, compared with 6.7% for the best baseline optimisation method, demonstrating that incorporating fidelity-resolved uncertainty directly into the joint location-fidelity decision can substantially improve multifidelity active learning efficiency.

</details>


### [1364] [Tracekit Box: Running AI Agents in Micro-VMs Where Every Way Out Is Decided and Signed](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38458v1)
*Bravish Ghosh*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: Tracekit Box 是一个开源系统（MIT, v0），为 AI agent 提供同时具备沙箱隔离与可验证审计的执行环境：每个作业运行在无网卡的 Firecracker micro-VM 中，唯一出口是宿主机上的"门"（vsock），由 agent 无法触及的 Tracekit signer 决定放行内容并签名，作业最终产出可离线验证的 .tkb 证据包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI agent 需要网络、凭据和写权限来完成装包、调用模型 API、改代码等任务，但这些能力同样是数据泄露、密钥窃取和未授权系统变更的途径。现有方案存在割裂：沙箱能隔离 agent 却几乎不留边界穿越证据，tracing 能记录事件却缺乏隔离。作者希望同时解决"隔离"与"可审计"两个问题。

Method: 每个作业运行于独立、无网络卡的 Firecracker micro-VM；唯一出口是宿主机上经 vsock 提供的"门"——命令、出站连接、密钥、模型调用、工作区补丁。每道门由 agent 无法访问的 Tracekit signer 判定放行内容并签名，按 box 归并为一次运行记录。具体机制：名字在宿主机解析，私有地址与云元数据地址一律拒绝；密钥不进入 VM，VM 只见占位符，由宿主机代理仅在绑定主机的单个请求头中替换为真实值；代码变更以 patch 形式返回，signer 逐文件判定后逐文件应用。系统 fail-closed，每个作业最终生成 .tkb 证据包，可离线验证。

Result: 在真实 KVM runner 上 13 项端到端检查全部通过（含镜像拉取与启动的测试耗时 28.5 s）；针对信任边界的 15 个 fuzz 目标产生 9 个发现，均已修复；demo 运行的 102 条签名记录全部验证通过。

Conclusion: Tracekit Box 在隔离与可验证审计的结合上可用且已初步验证。当前局限：尚未启用 Firecracker 的 jailer、需要 signer 与 box 同机部署、对 VM 内部进程仅在其穿越"门"时才有记录。

Abstract: AI agents now install packages, call model APIs with their operators' keys and change code in repositories that deploy to production. The network, credentials and write access they need are also how they can leak data, steal a key or change a system nobody approved. Sandboxes contain an agent but leave little evidence of what crossed their boundary; tracing records what happened but contains nothing. We present Tracekit Box, an open-source system (MIT, v0) that does both. Each job runs in its own Firecracker micro-VM with no network card. The only ways out are doors on the host, served over vsock: commands, outbound connections, secrets, model calls and the workspace patch. At every door a Tracekit signer the agent cannot reach decides what passes and signs it into one run per box. Names are resolved on the host; private and cloud-metadata addresses are always refused; secrets never enter the VM, which sees placeholders the host proxy swaps for real values only in one header for bound hosts; and changes come back as a patch applied file by file after the signer decides each file. Box fails closed, and each job ends as a .tkb bundle anyone can verify offline. All 13 end-to-end checks pass on a real KVM runner (the test that runs them takes 28.5 s, including image pull and boot); 15 fuzz targets on the trust boundary produced nine findings, all fixed; and the demo run's 102 signed records verify. Box does not yet run Firecracker's jailer, needs a co-located signer, and records processes inside the VM only where they cross a door.

</details>


### [1365] [PyPSA-Libya: An Open-Source Energy System Model for National Decarbonization and Hydrogen Export Pathways](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38094v1)
*Mohamed Abuella*

Main category: cs.CE

TL;DR: 本文基于PyPSA-Earth构建利比亚全国尺度模型PyPSA-Libya，开展仅电力部门容量扩展（零排放约束与无约束基线对比，36簇分辨率）与部门耦合氢出口（向欧洲出口70 TWh/年，三种技术情景，100 EUR/t CO2碳税）两项研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利比亚拥有大量尚未开发的可再生能源潜力，缺乏透明的国家级能源转型路径量化工具与公开模型。

Method: 以PyPSA-Earth框架构建全国尺度PyPSA-Libya模型；研究一为36-cluster分辨率下的仅电力容量扩展分析，对比零排放约束与无约束基线；研究二为部门耦合的氢出口研究，评估三种技术情景下向欧洲出口70 TWh/年氢的平准化成本，并设定100 EUR/吨CO2碳税。

Result: 光伏在本地容量结构中占主导；引入制氢显著改变电网储能需求；在碳定价下，带碳捕集的蒸汽甲烷重整（SMR-CC）常优于纯绿电电解，构成跨境出口的低成本合规路径。

Conclusion: 模型、数据与配置文件以开源许可发布，以支持利比亚透明化的能源规划。

Abstract: Libya possesses significant renewable energy potential that remains largely untapped. This paper presents PyPSA-Libya, a national-scale model built on the PyPSA-Earth framework, designed to explore optimal transition pathways for the Libyan power sector. We present two primary studies: (1) an electricity-only capacity expansion analysis comparing a zero-emission constraint against an unconstrained baseline at 36-cluster resolution, and (2) a sector-coupled hydrogen export study evaluating the levelized cost of exporting 70 TWh/year of hydrogen to Europe under three technological scenarios and a 100 EUR/tonne CO2 carbon tax regime. Results indicate that while solar PV dominates the domestic capacity mix, integration of hydrogen production significantly alters grid storage requirements. Furthermore, under carbon pricing, steam methane reforming with carbon capture (SMR-CC) frequently out-competes pure green electrolysis, establishing a lower-cost compliance pathway for cross-border export. The model, data, and configuration files are released under an open-source license to support transparent energy planning in Libya.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [1366] [Statistical Analysis of Synthetic Data with Verification: A Linear Regression Framework](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40254v1)
*Heejune Sheen,Harrison H. Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在线性回归框架下研究"带验证的自训练"，推导了以验证阈值、生成噪声与预训练误差相对尺度划分的四个有限样本风险界，揭示了验证阈值、注入噪声与微调范围对预测风险的反直觉影响，并推广到迭代式全参数微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于训练现代AI系统，但对其统计性质理解有限；统计界已知在合成数据上反复自训练会放大预训练模型继承的误差，导致模型崩溃(model collapse)。验证机制被认为能筛选高质量合成样本以防止崩溃并提升性能，但其作用机理缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 建立线性回归下的验证自训练模型：预训练估计器生成含注入生成噪声的合成数据，验证器按验证阈值筛选样本；在接受的样本上做后训练，分为全参数微调（更新所有坐标）与部分微调（仅更新活跃子集）。按验证阈值、生成噪声、预训练误差三者的相对尺度划分四种区域，分别推导有限样本预测风险界；并将分析扩展至迭代式验证全微调。

Result: 得到三项可能反直觉的结论：(1) 更严格的验证并不总是降低预测风险；(2) 适度注入生成噪声可降低预测风险，而过量噪声会抬高风险；(3) 面对同一验证规则，全微调与部分微调响应不同，因为冻结坐标中的预训练误差同时影响样本选择与后训练风险。所得风险界精确刻画了上述四区域中验证的作用，量化了生成噪声、有效接受样本量与接受协变量协方差对风险的影响。迭代情形下，足够严格的验证能以几何速率削减初始误差贡献。

Conclusion: 验证对自训练的作用是非单调且依赖微调方式的，需在阈值、生成噪声与微调范围之间权衡；理论结果为合成数据训练中的验证策略设计（如"最优噪声水平"与阈值选择）提供依据，并说明严格验证在迭代自训练中可几何地抑制误差累积。

Abstract: Synthetic data are widely used for training modern AI systems. However, their statistical understanding remains limited. It is well recognized in statistics that repeated self-training on synthetic data can amplify errors inherited from pre-trained models, leading to model collapse. Verification plays a crucial role in selecting high-quality synthetic data to help prevent model collapse and improve model performance. We study verified self-training in a linear regression framework, where a pre-trained estimator generates synthetic data with injected generation noise and a verifier selects samples according to a verification threshold. Post-training on the accepted samples updates either all coordinates (full fine-tuning) or only an active subset (partial fine-tuning). Our analysis reveals three potentially counterintuitive effects. We establish that tighter verification does not always lead to lower prediction risk. We also find that a suitable level of injected generation noise can reduce prediction risk, while excessive noise can increase it. Moreover, full and partial fine-tuning can respond differently to the same verification rule, since pre-training error in the frozen coordinates affects both sample selection and post-training risk. We analyze these effects by deriving finite sample risk bounds for four separate regimes determined by the relative scales of the verification threshold, generation noise, and pre-training error. The bounds precisely characterize how verification affects prediction risk across these regimes. In particular, we quantify how the generation noise, the effective accepted sample size, and the covariance of the accepted covariates affect prediction risk. The analysis extends to iterative verified full fine-tuning, where sufficiently tight verification reduces the initial error contribution at a geometric rate.

</details>


### [1367] [Understanding axial attention in TSFMs through single location regression](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40188v1)
*Andrei-Tiberiu Pantea,Aymeric Dieuleveut*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文将 Marion 等（2025）的单点回归框架推广到二维结构化数据，构建可解析求解的轴向注意力型预测器，从理论上刻画其在稀疏信息设定下的统计性质与训练动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）日益依赖轴向注意力且经验效果良好，但其理论性质（表达能力与可训练性）几乎空白，尤其是目标仅依赖少量 token 的稀疏信息场景缺乏解释。

Method: 将 Single Location Regression 框架扩展至 2D 结构数据，提出解析可处理的轴向注意力型预测器；在特定渐近区间内、并已知 oracle 参数的条件下分析其贝叶斯最优性；与一类半线性简化模型对比以隔离内部非线性的作用；对特定温度缩放证明投影梯度下降全局收敛到最优 oracle 参数；辅以数值实验。

Result: 预测器在给定渐近区间与 oracle 参数知识下达到贝叶斯最优，而半线性简化类严格无法达到，说明内部非线性不可替代；在特定温度缩放下 PGD 全局收敛至最优 oracle 参数；实验验证理论结论，并显示逆温度调度对经验收敛至关重要。

Conclusion: 轴向注意力的优势可归因于其内部非线性而非结构简化；理论给出其最优性与可训练性保证，并揭示逆温度调度是实践中实现收敛的关键因素。

Abstract: Recent advances in Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) increasingly rely on axial attention mechanisms, but despite their empirical success, the theoretical properties of axial attention remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we extend the Single Location Regression framework introduced in Marion et al. [2025] to 2D structured data, in order to study sparse information settings where a target depends on a small number of tokens. We formulate an analytically tractable axial attention-type predictor and rigorously analyze its statistical properties and training dynamics. We prove that under a specific asymptotic regime and with knowledge of the underlying oracle parameters, our predictor achieves Bayes optimality, whereas a class of semi-linear simplifications strictly fails to do so, underlining the role of the inner non-linearity. We prove that for a specific temperature scaling, Projected Gradient Descent converges globally to the optimal oracle parameters. Extensive numerical experiments validate our theoretical findings and highlight the critical role of inverse temperature scheduling in empirical convergence.

</details>


### [1368] [Hidden Disparities in Ranking: Category-Aware Fairness via Distributional Stability](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40182v1)
*Gayane Taturyan,Charlotte Laclau,Stephan Clémençon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文研究推荐系统中的公平排序问题，提出概率框架：排序策略为置换分布，用户效用为其交互物品相对理想排序的曝光量；以用户群体间效用对等及其类别感知细化（条件效用对等）为公平准则，证明二者等价于效用对群体构成变化的分布稳定性，混合策略优化化为二阶锥规划并给出泛化界，数值实验验证理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统排序中的公平性度量缺乏统一的概率形式化表述，且不同公平准则（群体对等、类别内对等）之间的关系及其稳健性含义不清晰，需要建立可优化、可泛化的理论框架。

Method: 将排序策略建模为置换上的分布，以用户接触到物品的曝光量相对理想排序定义效用；提出效用对等与条件效用对等两项准则；借助"公平即分布稳定性"的视角，证明两准则等价于效用对用户群体构成变化的稳定性；在排序策略的混合族上优化，转化为二阶锥规划，并推导泛化界；辅以数值研究。

Result: 理论证明两类公平准则均等价于效用随群体构成变化的稳定性；优化问题可表述为二阶锥规划并具备泛化界保证；数值实验验证了理论结论。

Conclusion: 该工作为公平排序提供了统一的概率框架，把多种公平准则统一为分布稳定性，并给出可计算的凸优化形式与学习理论保证，为后续公平推荐算法的设计与评估奠定基础。

Abstract: We study the problem of fair ranking in recommender systems. We provide a formal probabilistic framework in which ranking policies are distributions over permutations, and the utility of a user is the exposure given to the items they interact with, relative to that of an ideal ranking. We consider utility parity across user groups, as well as its category-aware refinement, conditional utility parity, which requires parity within each category of items. Following a recent view of fairness as distributional stability, we show that both criteria are equivalent to the stability of the utility under changes in the composition of user groups. Optimizing over mixtures of ranking policies leads to a second-order cone program, for which we provide generalization bounds. A numerical study validates our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [1369] [Fisher Contrastive Learning to Mitigate Feature Suppression: A Case Study in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Diagnosis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40162v1)
*Shushan Wu,Yongkai Chen,Xilin Gong,Yufang Liu,Wenxuan Zhong,Ping Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Fisher对比学习（FCL），用正则化Fisher迹准则缓解自监督对比学习中的特征抑制问题，并在模拟基准和白细胞显微图像诊断任务上优于自监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督对比学习通过对比同一样本的不同增强视图学习表示，但存在特征抑制（feature suppression）问题：主导性或易学因子会压制其他与类别相关的信号，从而降低表示质量，在高维异质特征数据中尤为严重。

Method: 提出Fisher对比学习（FCL），采用正则化的Fisher迹（Fisher trace）准则作为约束目标，通过最大化Fisher判别函数的判别强度来学习嵌入，使表示保留数据增强过程所隐含的类别相关信息；并从理论上证明FCL所学表示可缓解特征抑制效应。

Result: 在专门诱发特征抑制的模拟基准上验证FCL；在真实生物医学任务中，于大规模白细胞显微图像数据集上预训练，并迁移学习用于外部队列的急性早幼粒细胞白血病（APL）诊断。所有实验中FCL均优于自监督基线，获得更稳健、更具判别性的表示。

Conclusion: FCL通过Fisher迹正则化有效缓解特征抑制，提升自监督表示的可判别性与鲁棒性，并在模拟与真实医学影像迁移任务中验证其有效性。

Abstract: Self-supervised contrastive learning (SSCL) learns representations by contrasting augmented views of the same sample, but it can exhibit feature suppression, where dominant or easy-to-learn factors suppress other class-relevant signals, degrading the performance of representations, particularly in high-dimensional data with heterogeneous features. We introduce Fisher Contrastive Learning (FCL), which uses a regularized Fisher trace criterion to address feature suppression. FCL learns embeddings by maximizing the discriminative strength of Fisher discriminant functions, producing representations that preserve class-relevant information implied by the augmentation process. We prove that the representations learned by FCL could alleviate the feature suppression effects. We demonstrate FCL on simulated benchmarks designed to induce feature suppression and on a real-world biomedical application, pretraining on large white blood cell microscopy image dataset and transfer learning for diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia in an external cohort. In all experiments, FCL outperforms the self-supervised baselines and yields more robust and discriminative representations.

</details>


### [1370] [Reinforcement Learning Under Runtime Confounding: Policy Learning and Off-Policy Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40056v1)
*Raphael Kim,Michele Santacatterina,Ramin Zabih,Keith Barnatchez*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习中的"运行时混杂"(runtime confounding)问题：训练日志数据完全可观测，但部署时缺失部分决策驱动变量，且该缺失会随时间传播导致学习偏差；作者提出运行时混杂下的策略学习算法、半参数有效离策略估计方法以及理解混杂代价的诊断工具三项贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗、电商、机器人等场景中，法律、伦理或后勤约束使得某些关键决策变量在部署阶段无法采集，而训练日志中却完全可观测，形成运行时混杂。与单时间点、非自适应设定不同，RL 中早期决策会影响未来状态、观测与动作分配，使偏差随时间累积传播。

Method: (1) 在运行时混杂条件下设计策略学习算法；(2) 构建半参数有效的离策略(off-policy)估计流程；(3) 提供用于刻画"运行时混杂代价"的诊断方法。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果与数值指标，仅说明三项方法学贡献的可行性框架。

Conclusion: 运行时混杂在 RL 中会因时序传播而放大偏差，须通过专用策略学习、有效离策略估计和诊断工具共同应对；该工作为部分可观测部署环境下的因果式 RL 学习提供了方法基础。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to train robust, adaptable systems across healthcare, e-commerce, and robotics. In these settings, legal, ethical, or logistical concerns may preclude certain key variables that drive decisions from being collected during deployment time. This gives rise to a setting known as runtime confounding: the logged data hold full observability, but deployment time lacks knowledge of certain variables, known as runtime confounders. Unlike single timepoint and non-adaptive settings, runtime confounding under reinforcement learning has the potential to propagate over time, as earlier decisions affect future states, observations, and action assignments, leading to biased learning. We address these problems with three contributions: we (1) develop policy learning algorithms under runtime-confounding, (2) develop semi-parametric efficient off-policy estimation procedures, and (3) provide diagnostics for understanding the price of runtime confounding.

</details>


### [1371] [Probabilistic Meshless Methods on Manifolds](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39855v1)
*Federico Pavesi,Noémie Jaquier,Antonio Candelieri*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将概率无网格方法推广到紧流形并首次给出收敛性分析，分别针对已知流形与点云隐式流形构造广义有限差分离散，证明后验均值误差界，并在圆、球面、环面及皮层厚度数据上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率无网格方法（高斯过程先验 + 配点条件化）在欧氏域上已成熟，能同时给出解的近似与贝叶斯误差量化；但其向流形的推广缺乏收敛性理论保证，因此需要建立相应分析。

Method: 将方法推广到紧流形，分两种情形：(1) 已知流形，Laplace–Beltrami 特征对可得，先验可精确求值，但 PDE 算子无法闭式作用，改用点云上的标准广义有限差分（GFD）离散；(2) 隐式流形（仅有点云），先验与算子均需近似，提出带自由模板半径的新 GFD 格式，在保持一致性的同时控制系数增长，并证明适当半径下离散 Gram 矩阵一致收敛。

Result: 证明第一种情形下方法在点云节点上以填充距离（fill distance）为速率保持一致；第二种情形下新格式保持一致性且能给出离散 Gram 矩阵的一致收敛。两种情形均导出后验均值误差界，将方法固有的配点误差与算子（及隐式流形下先验）近似误差分离。圆、球面、平坦环面的实验验证理论结论；真实皮层厚度数据上以不足十分之一的观测取得与成熟离散方法相当的精度，并在每个顶点给出可信区间。

Conclusion: 概率无网格方法可有效扩展到紧流形，且具备可证明的收敛性；新 GFD 格式使点云隐式流形的情形也可控，实用中兼顾精度、样本效率与不确定性量化。

Abstract: Probabilistic meshless methods solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by placing a Gaussian process prior on the solution and conditioning it on the PDE at a finite set of collocation nodes. The posterior provides both an approximation of the solution and a Bayesian quantification of its error. While these methods are well established on Euclidean domains, their extension to manifolds lacks, to our knowledge, any convergence analysis. We extend them to compact manifolds and study their convergence in two settings. First, for known manifolds whose Laplace-Beltrami eigenpairs are available, the prior can be evaluated exactly, but the PDE operator generally cannot be applied to it in closed form. We replace this operator by a standard generalized finite difference discretization on a point cloud sampled from the manifold, and show that the resulting method is consistent at the points of the cloud, at a rate governed by their fill distance. Second, for implicit manifolds, known only through a point cloud, both the prior and the operator must be approximated. We propose a new generalized finite difference scheme with a free stencil radius, and show that it retains the consistency of the standard construction while controlling the growth of its coefficients, and that an appropriate radius yields uniform convergence of the discrete Gram matrix. In both settings, we derive error bounds for the posterior mean which separate the collocation error intrinsic to the method from the error due to approximating the operator and, for implicit manifolds, the prior. Experiments on the circle, the sphere and the flat torus confirm our theoretical claims. On real-world cortical thickness data, our approach attains the accuracy of established discretizations, while conditioning on fewer than a tenth of the observations and providing a credible interval at every vertex.

</details>


### [1372] [Bayes-Consistent Losses for Adaptive Inference in Classification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39709v1)
*Shirley Xiaoqi Liu,Florence Regol,Antonios Valkanas,Patrick Rebeschini,Mark Coates*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出成本敏感的 hinge 损失用于分类器与路由器（单阶段或级联）的联合训练，证明其线性校准界与 Bayes 一致性，并提出基于预测驱动推断（PPI）的后训练方法用无标签数据精修路由器。实验验证了联合训练的有效性与 PPI 在标签稀缺时纠正路由错误的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应推理系统通过将输入路由到不同能力的模型来平衡精度与推理成本。经验上联合训练模型与路由器比分开训练更具样本效率，但联合训练的原则性损失函数仍缺乏研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在分类设定下提出成本敏感的 hinge 损失，用于分类器与单阶段路由器（直接为每个输入选择一个模型）或级联路由器（逐阶段决定用当前模型预测还是延迟到更精确但更昂贵的下一阶段）的联合训练；对两种设定证明线性校准界以建立 Bayes 一致性；此外提出后训练的预测驱动推断（PPI）流程，利用无标签数据精修已训练的单阶段路由器，以缓解路由器训练所需标注数据多于分类器的问题。

Result: 理论上证明最小化 hinge 风险可在目标成本敏感零一损失下恢复 Bayes 最优风险（线性校准界、Bayes 一致性）；实验在合成与真实数据集上表明所提 hinge 损失对联合训练有效，且 PPI 在标注数据稀缺时能纠正路由错误。

Conclusion: 成本敏感 hinge 损失为分类器与路由器的联合训练提供了有理论保证的原则性方案，PPI 后训练可有效利用无标签数据改善路由器性能，二者结合提升了自适应推理系统在成本-精度权衡下的训练效率与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Adaptive inference systems balance accuracy and inference cost by routing inputs to models with varying capabilities. Although jointly training models and routers is empirically more sample-efficient than training them separately, principled losses for joint training remain underexplored. We address this gap in a classification setting by proposing cost-sensitive hinge losses for jointly training classifiers with single-stage or cascade routers. Single-stage routers directly select a model per input, whereas cascade routers sequentially decide at each stage whether to predict with the current model or defer to the next stage, which uses a more accurate but more costly model. For both settings, we prove linear calibration bounds establishing Bayes consistency: minimizing the hinge risk recovers the Bayes-optimal risk under the target cost-sensitive zero-one loss. Moreover, since routers can require more labeled data to train than classifiers, we propose a novel post-training prediction-powered inference (PPI) procedure that uses unlabeled data to refine a trained single-stage router. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate that the proposed hinge losses are effective for joint training and that PPI can correct routing errors when labeled data is scarce.

</details>


### [1373] [Formalizing the Intrinsic Dimension of Objective Landscapes by a Generalized Notion of Co-dimension](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39674v1)
*Ernesto Araya,Gitta Kutyniok,Weilin Li,Johannes Maly,Manjot Singh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文形式化了目标景观的内在维度概念，将其定义为随机d维平面以概率1与参数集合Θ相交的最小维度，证明其为依赖全局几何的广义余维数，并对师生ReLU网络的最优参数集合给出内在维度的上下界，进而导出新型泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Li et al. (2018) 提出的内在维度概念缺乏严格数学定义，仅通过沿随机子空间训练来度量学习问题的结构复杂度；本文希望将其形式化并建立其与学习复杂度、泛化能力之间的理论联系。

Method: 将Θ⊂R^p的内在维度定义为最小的d_int(Θ)，使R^p中随机d_int(Θ)维平面以概率1与Θ相交；研究其数学性质并发展估计技术，在学生-教师设置下（浅层与深层ReLU网络，有限/无限样本，有无正则化）对最优参数集合推导上下界；结合ReLU网络对称性分类与随机几何工具。

Result: 证明内在维度是依赖Θ全局几何的广义余维数概念；在学生-教师ReLU网络设置下获得最优参数集合内在维度的上界和/或下界（涵盖有限与无限样本、有正则化与无正则化情形）；并据此导出新类型的泛化界。

Conclusion: 内在维度可作为学习复杂度的度量，其理论将ReLU网络对称性分类与随机几何等看似不同的机器学习研究领域联系起来，并为泛化分析提供新工具。

Abstract: In this work, we formalize the concept of intrinsic dimension of objective landscapes introduced in Li et al. (2018), which measures the structural complexity of learning problems by training along randomly generated subspaces. We define the intrinsic dimension of a set $Θ\subset\mathbb{R}^p$ as the minimal dimension $d_{\mathrm{int}}(Θ)$ such that a random plane of dimension $d_{\mathrm{int}}(Θ)$ in $\mathbb{R}^p$ intersects $Θ$ with probability one. We show that it is a generalized notion of co-dimension that depends on the global geometry of $Θ$. We study mathematical properties of the intrinsic dimension and develop techniques to estimate the intrinsic dimension of sets $Θ$ that arise in learning problems. More specifically, we derive upper and/or lower bounds where $Θ$ is the set of optimal parameters in student-teacher settings with shallow and deep ReLU networks, including finite and infinite sample cases, and with and without regularization. We discuss how our theory leads to novel types of generalization bounds, thereby showing that the intrinsic dimension is a measure of learning complexity. Our results connect techniques from seemingly different areas of machine learning research such as classification of symmetries of ReLU networks and stochastic geometry.

</details>


### [1374] [TabCUQ: Context-Uncertainty Quantification for Tabular Foundation Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39558v1)
*Yuebei Shi,Molei Liu,Zijian Guo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 TabCUQ：一种基于扰动的框架，对表格基础模型的上下文学习估计（条件期望与组平均处理效应）同时量化"有限上下文偏差"与"上下文变动"两类不确定性，并提供渐近有效的逐点覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习估计特定群体的条件期望结果与平均处理效应，但用这些估计指导科学决策需要可靠的不确定性量化。难点在于须同时处理两类不确定性：有限上下文偏差，以及由推理时提供的少量标注样本引起的上下文变动。预测离散度无法直接同时刻画这两类来源；作者观察到普通 bootstrap 可能显著高估上下文变动，而子抽样则可能低估。

Method: TabCUQ 向观测结果注入噪声，并将基础模型应用于受扰动的上下文。具体地，用 wild-bootstrap 离散度估计上下文变动，用扰动估计与原始估计之间的最大偏差来刻画有限上下文偏差。作者在一个核回归类比中给出估计误差的精确两项分解，并据此证明框架的逐点覆盖率渐近有效。

Result: 在模拟实验中，TabCUQ 显著提升覆盖率，平均区间宽度通常约为一个"oracle 偏差感知"基准的两倍。在七个真实任务上，相对于由更大样本学到的参考函数，覆盖率也得到改善。

Conclusion: 扰动的分解式设计能同时捕捉上下文变动与有限上下文偏差，为表格基础模型的下游决策提供统计上可辩护（渐近有效覆盖）且实证覆盖率更好的不确定性量化手段，代价是区间宽度相对 oracle 基准偏宽。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models use in-context learning to estimate conditional expected outcomes and average treatment effects for specific groups of individuals. Using these estimates to guide scientific decisions requires reliable uncertainty quantification. The challenge is to account simultaneously for two sources of uncertainty: limited-context bias and context variation arising from the small labeled sample supplied at inference. Predictive spread does not directly quantify both sources of uncertainty, and we observe that the ordinary bootstrap may substantially overestimate context variation, whereas subsampling may underestimate it. We introduce TabCUQ, a perturbation-based framework that injects noise into observed outcomes and applies the foundation model to the perturbed contexts. TabCUQ estimates context variation using wild-bootstrap dispersion and accounts for limited-context bias using the maximum deviation between perturbed and original estimates. For a kernel-regression analogue whose estimation error admits an exact decomposition into these two components, we show that our framework provides asymptotically valid pointwise coverage. In simulations, TabCUQ substantially improves coverage, with average interval widths typically about twice those of an oracle bias-aware benchmark. Across seven real-world tasks, it also improves coverage of reference functions learned from much larger samples.

</details>


### [1375] [The Cost of Working Memory in Streaming Mean Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39540v1)
*Zeyu Wu,Zihao Wang,Minghua Deng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究流式估计中"存储均值"与"计算均值"所需内存的分离问题。对R^d欧氏单位球上高斯均值估计，给出了K个持久状态、已知时间范围与公开时间索引下的平方误差极小化速率，并证明统计最优样本量需Θ(d log d)工作比特，而存储答案仅需Θ(d)比特。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式估计器必须仅用内存可容纳的证据进行计算。核心问题是：何时"存储一个准确均值"比"计算它"更容易？即区分表示答案所需的内存与累积证据、验证决策所需的内存，量化统计最优性与内存约束之间的张力。

Method: 设定K个持久状态、已知horizon、公开时间索引的受限模型，与"无限制计算后K级编码"的模型对比。下界通过对高斯平滑得到的熵势追踪反复状态压缩，得到极小极大下界；上界构造将多尺度模计数器和在坐标组间复用的工作空间相结合，一维情形达到终态速率n^{-1}+K^{-2}。进一步分析置信度对内存的需求。

Result: 极小极大速率为 min{1, K^{-2/d}+(d/n)(1+log(ed)/(1+(log K)/d))}；无限制计算后K级编码速率为 min{1, d/n+K^{-2/d}}。在固定足够小误差下，统计最优样本量需Θ(d log d)工作比特，而存储答案仅需Θ(d)比特。任何固定置信度要求（实际损失不超过零基线）保持该速率；固定非平凡风险下，失败概率e^{-γn}需要且允许Θ(log n)个工作状态。标量问题在同等保护下固定终态字母表即足够。

Conclusion: 本文的界将"表示答案所需的内存"与"累积证据并验证决策所需的内存"严格分离：存储精确均值的代价可显著低于计算它的代价，而提高置信度会额外引入内存需求。

Abstract: A streaming estimator must compute from the evidence that fits in memory. We determine when storing an accurate mean is easier than computing it. For Gaussian mean estimation over the Euclidean unit ball in $\mathbb{R}^d$, we establish the minimax rate under squared error with $K$ persistent states, a known horizon, and a public time index: $\min\{1, K^{-2/d}+\frac{d}{n} (1+\frac{\log(ed)}{1+(\log K)/d})\}$. Unrestricted computation followed by $K$-level encoding has rate $\min\{1,d/n+K^{-2/d}\}$. At a fixed sufficiently small error, statistically optimal sample size therefore requires order $d\log d$ working bits, while order $d$ bits suffice to store the answer. The lower bound tracks repeated state compression through an entropy potential obtained by Gaussian smoothing. A matching construction combines a multiscale modular counter with workspace reused across coordinate groups. In one dimension, it attains the terminal rate $n^{-1}+K^{-2}$. Any fixed confidence requirement that the realized loss not exceed the zero baseline preserves these rates. Increasing confidence creates a further memory requirement: at fixed nontrivial risk in every fixed dimension, failure probability $e^{-γn}$ requires and permits order $\log n$ working states for sufficiently small fixed $γ>0$. In the scalar problem, a fixed terminal alphabet suffices under the same protection. These bounds separate the memory needed to represent an answer from the memory needed to accumulate evidence and validate a decision.

</details>


### [1376] [Satisficing Regret Minimization in Bandits with Knapsacks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39321v1)
*Qing Feng,Tianyi Ma,Ruihao Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究带背包的赌博机（BwK）中的"满足型遗憾"（satisficing regret）最小化问题，提出通用算法模板 SELECTwK：以具有次线性期望标准遗憾的 BwK oracle 为基础搜索并检验满足型策略，证明存在满足型策略时期望满足型遗憾为常数，阈值不可达时仍保持 oracle 的次线性标准遗憾，并在动态定价数值实验中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 BwK 关注相对最优策略的标准遗憾，但实践中资源有限时往往只要求奖励超过某满足阈值即可。资源约束带来两大困难：(1) 即使标准遗憾很小，策略均值低于阈值的"缺口"无法被补偿，可能造成线性满足型遗憾；(2) 随机资源消耗可能导致即使期望可行的策略也提前耗尽资源。因此需要专门针对满足型目标设计算法。

Method: 提出 SELECTwK 通用算法模板：调用一个具有次线性期望标准遗憾上界的 BwK 学习 oracle，用于搜索并检验候选满足型策略（即均值奖励超过满足阈值、且期望资源消耗在时间跨度内可行的策略）。分析借助 LP 对偶论证。此外引入更强的遗憾条件——逐时刻约束相对最优策略的正向奖励缺口期望和，并给出相应的界分析；同时刻画已有有限臂 BwK 与动态定价算法作为 oracle 的条件及其满足型遗憾界。

Result: （1）存在满足型策略时，SELECTwK 达到常数期望满足型遗憾；（2）在更强的逐时刻正向缺口遗憾条件下，得到更紧的常数界并附带随时间跨度次线性增长的界；（3）满足阈值不可达时，SELECTwK 仍保持 oracle 的次线性期望标准遗憾；（4）给出有限臂 BwK 与动态定价现有算法的 oracle 条件与对应满足型遗憾界，并在有限库存动态定价数值实验中展示了经验性能。

Conclusion: 满足型遗憾是资源约束型序贯决策中更贴合实际的目标；以标准遗憾 oracle 为黑盒的 SELECTwK 模板可在不牺牲标准遗憾保证的前提下，将满足型遗憾降至常数级，并具备良好的通用性与实证表现。

Abstract: We study satisficing regret minimization in bandits with knapsacks (BwK), where a learner sequentially selects randomized policies, i.e., distributions over arms, to obtain mean rewards above a satisficing threshold as frequently as possible while respecting finite resource budgets. The performance is measured by satisficing regret, the cumulative deficits of the selected policies' mean rewards below this threshold. Resource constraints introduce two difficulties: an algorithm can incur linear satisficing regret even with small standard regret as deficits to the threshold cannot be compensated, and random consumption can cause early resource depletion even when policies are feasible in expectation. To address these challenges, we propose SELECTwK, a general algorithmic template that uses a BwK learning oracle algorithm with sub-linear expected (standard) regret upper bound to search for and test candidate satisficing policies (i.e., policies whose mean rewards exceed satisficing threshold and whose expected resource consumption is feasible over the time horizon). Our regret analysis, supported by an LP-duality argument, establishes that SELECTwK attains constant expected satisficing regret when a satisficing policy exists. We further introduce a stronger regret condition that bounds the expected sum of positive reward deficits to the optimal one at each time step, under which SELECTwK achieves a sharper constant bound together with a sub-linear bound in the time horizon. As a complement, SELECTwK still preserves the oracle's sub-linear expected standard regret bound if the satisficing threshold is unattainable. Finally, we establish the oracle conditions and corresponding satisficing regret bound for existing finite-armed BwK and dynamic pricing algorithms, and conduct numerical experiments on dynamic pricing with limited inventory to demonstrate the empirical performance of SELECTwK.

</details>


### [1377] [Zero-Complement Extrapolation: Parameter Recovery and Classification in Severely Imbalanced Logistic Regression under Rank-Deficient Regimes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39194v1)
*Chongsun Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 Self-Calibrated Zero-Complement 估计器，用"多数类边缘外推"替代少数类插值，在 n1 < p 的秩亏稀有场景下恢复满秩协方差并以零边界截距校准，实现稳健参数估计与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二分类 logistic 回归中少数类样本数 n1 小于特征维数 p 时（rank-deficient rarity），MLE 出现准完全分离、惩罚似然法截距偏差严重、SMOTE 等凸性过采样坍缩到 (n1−1) 维仿射子空间，导致参数发散与分类性能恶化。

Method: 范式从少数类插值转向多数类边缘外推：(1) 基于 Stein 引理证明 logistic 截断引起的多数类条件期望位移在 Mahalanobis 白化后可唯一识别真实超平面法向量 β；(2) 沿共轭方向从多数分布高分位密度边缘向外外推合成少数样本，保持协方差满秩（rank = p）；(3) 混合估计器引入多数类内在三阶矩偏度以处理半监督（未标注背景均值）与严格监督子样本两种设定，并采用位置平移不变的零边界截距校准。

Result: 大量 Monte Carlo 模拟及真实基准（Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer、Banknote Authentication）在极端稀有 n1 ∈ {3, 5} 下显示：避免参数发散，高保真恢复 oracle 超平面，F1 与估计稳定性显著优于 Firth 回归与 SMOTE。

Conclusion: 在秩亏稀有条件下，基于多数类分布几何结构与 Stein 引理的零补全外推策略可同时保证满秩正则性、无偏截距与稳定估计，是优于 Firth 与 SMOTE 的可行方案。

Abstract: Parameter estimation and classification in binary logistic regression deteriorate severely when the number of minority class observations ($n_1$) is smaller than the feature dimension ($p$). Under such rank-deficient rarity ($n_1 < p$), maximum likelihood estimators suffer from quasi-complete separation, penalized likelihood methods exhibit severe intercept bias, and convex minority oversampling techniques such as SMOTE collapse into an $(n_1 - 1)$-dimensional affine subspace. In this paper, we propose a novel \textit{Self-Calibrated Zero-Complement} estimator that shifts the paradigm from minority interpolation to majority fringe extrapolation. Grounded in Stein's Lemma, we prove that the conditional expectation shift of the abundant majority class ($Y=0$) induced by logistic truncation uniquely identifies the true hyperplane normal $\boldsymbolβ$ after Mahalanobis whitening. We further establish that extrapolating synthetic minority instances outward from the high-quantile density fringe of the majority distribution along the conjugate direction preserves full-rank covariance regularity ($\mathrm{rank} = p$). To accommodate both semi-supervised environments (with an unlabeled background mean) and strictly supervised subsamples, we introduce a hybrid estimator incorporating the intrinsic third-moment skewness of the majority class alongside a location-shift-invariant zero-boundary intercept calibration. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and real-world benchmark applications (Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer and Banknote Authentication) under extreme rarity ($n_1 \in \{3, 5\}$) demonstrate that our approach prevents parameter divergence, recovers the oracle hyperplane with high fidelity, and substantially outperforms Firth's regression and SMOTE in F1-score and estimation stability.

</details>


### [1378] [Modular Bayesian Foundation Models: Bayesian time series encoders for OOD detection, routing and forecasting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39043v1)
*Mame Diarra Toure,Quang Hung Pham,Mohamed Ryad Zemouri,David Stephens,Luc Vouligny,Martin Gagnon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出模块化基础模型框架，将端到端SBNN贝叶斯编码器训练与基于认知不确定性的无标签路由结合，实现紧凑专家集合的存储高效选择与概率预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业时间序列在采样频率、尺度、动态与工况上差异巨大，单一基础模型难以覆盖所有工况，而为每个新数据集或工况漂移重训大模型代价高；模块化需解决专家紧凑化与未知数据上的专家选择问题。

Method: 采用Singular Bayesian Neural Networks训练一组紧凑的贝叶斯编码器（端到端），以其认知不确定性驱动无标签的专家路由（selection），并在分布漂移、编码器选择与概率预测三个任务上评估；与距离路由、Bayes by Backprop全秩、深度集成、MC Dropout对比。

Result: 同秩下贝叶斯集合比确定性版本少63.8%存储；七个数据集上不确定性路由MSE与距离路由相当，ECE由0.086降至0.072、NLL由0.907降至0.836、PICP90由82.28%升至89.03%；SBNN平均MSE 0.390，对比深度集成0.396、MC Dropout 0.389、全秩贝叶斯0.443；参数分别少63.9%（vs MC Dropout）、81.9%（vs 全秩）、92.8%（vs 深度集成）。

Conclusion: 不确定性驱动的SBNN模块化路由在保持预测精度的同时显著提升校准与区间覆盖，并大幅降低存储与参数开销，是构建可扩展模块化时间序列基础模型的可行方案。

Abstract: Industrial systems continuously generate time series that vary in sampling frequency, scale, dynamics, and operating regime. Consequently a single time-series foundation model may not be able to represent all regimes effectively and retraining a large model for every new dataset or regime shift is computationally expensive. Modular foundation models address this issue by reusing specialised encoders trained on diverse datasets and by allowing the expansion of capabilities through the addition of new experts. This approach requires compact experts to minimize storage cost and a proper selection mechanism of experts for unseen data. We propose a modular foundation model framework that combines end-to-end Bayesian encoder training with uncertainty based routing. Using Singular Bayesian Neural Networks (SBNNs), we build a collection of compact Bayesian encoders whose epistemic uncertainty guides label-free selection. At the selected ranks, our Bayesian collection uses 63.8\% less storage than its deterministic counterpart. We evaluate this framework on time-series data through distribution shift, encoder selection, and probabilistic forecasting. Across seven incoming datasets, uncertainty-based routing is competitive with distance-based routing in terms of forecast MSE, while reducing average ECE from 0.086 to 0.072 and average NLL from 0.907 to 0.836. It also increases PICP90 from 82.28\% to 89.03\%. In a separate model-family comparison, we evaluate the SBNN pipeline against full-rank Bayes by Backprop, deep ensembles, and MC Dropout. The SBNN pipeline achieves an average MSE of 0.390, comparable with 0.396 for deep ensembles, 0.389 for MC dropout, and 0.443 for the full-rank Bayesian model. It uses 63.9\% fewer parameters than MC dropout, 81.9\% fewer than the full-rank model, and 92.8\% fewer than the deep ensemble.

</details>


### [1379] [Memorization Capacity of Invariant Convolutional Neural Nets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38938v1)
*Sjoerd Dirksen,Patrick Finke,Paul Geuchen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明了对任意有限正交变换群不变的卷积网络，在阈值激活下插值两分类数据集所需规模的上界，该上界由实例相关的几何复杂度度量给出而非样本数，并给出高概率构造性随机算法及数值实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全连接网络记忆容量已有大量研究，但实践中更常用带问题相关性质的特异架构（如图像分类的卷积网络）；现有结果缺少对群不变卷积网络记忆容量的理论刻画，需回答此类不变结构如何影响插值所需网络规模。

Method: 考虑对给定任意有限正交变换群（含图像平移、反射、旋转及高阶张量不变性）不变的卷积网络；采用阈值激活，证明插值两类数据集所需网络规模的上界；上界以计入不变结构、且实例相关的复杂度度量表述（与数据集中两类的相互排布及几何性质相关而非样本数）；证明为构造性：给定输入数据，可通过随机化算法以高概率计算出插值网络的实例。

Result: 得到不变卷积网络插值两分类数据的规模上界，该界由实例几何复杂度刻画而非样本数量；所给随机化算法以高概率构造出满足插值的网络；数值实验考察了该算法的实际有效性。

Conclusion: 群不变卷积网络的记忆容量可由实例相关的几何复杂度而非样本数来衡量，理论上该结构可能带来更紧的规模界；构造性随机算法在实践中具有可行性。

Abstract: Neural networks are powerful memorizers which are often able to interpolate their training data even when the labels have been randomized. While there exists an extensive literature on the memorization capacity of fully connected networks, in practice more specific architectures with problem-dependent properties are preferred, such as convolutional networks for image classification. In this paper we consider convolutional networks which are invariant with respect to a given arbitrary finite group of orthogonal transformations, which may include translations, reflections, and/or rotations of images and invariances of higher order tensors. We prove upper bounds on the size of an invariant convolutional neural network with threshold activations that is required to interpolate a given dataset with two classes. Our bounds are formulated in terms of a complexity measure that takes the invariant structure into account and is instance-specific, i.e., it is related to the mutual arrangement of the classes in the given dataset and their geometric properties rather than the number of samples. Our proof is constructive: for given input data, instances of an interpolating network can be computed via a randomized algorithm with high probability. In numerical experiments we investigate the practical effectiveness of this algorithm.

</details>


### [1380] [Pinpointing Pivot Points: The DECIDE Framework for Data Analysis Decision Importances](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38797v1)
*Zachary T. Rewolinski,Jan Simson,Frauke Kreuter,Christoph Kern,Bin Yu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出DECIDE，一个无需建模的框架，直接从实际结果分布中量化数据分析各判断决策的重要性，并首次给出"多重宇宙"的正式定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据科学流程中的判断性决策会导致结论变化，独立分析者面对同一数据常得出不同结果，加剧可重复性危机；智能体工具的普及可能放大该问题。现有方法（多重宇宙分析、规格曲线分析、效应振动、PCS框架）只能刻画结果的整体分布，难以估计单个决策的影响。常用启发式是训练预测模型并以其系数或特征重要性作为决策影响的代理，但这依赖于模型被正确设定且预测准确，而作者表明该假设并不总成立。

Method: DECIDE采用无模型（model-free）框架：在合理的决策空间上，直接基于各决策组合下的实际结果分布，量化每个决策的重要性，从设计上规避可预测性问题。作者将该方法应用于真实世界的多重宇宙分析以验证效果，并给出据称首个关于多重宇宙的正式定义。

Result: 作者证明了基于预测模型系数的启发式代理在某些情形下失效（模型设定或预测不准），而DECIDE能有效量化各决策的重要性；在真实多重宇宙分析中的应用展示了其有效性。

Conclusion: 估计单个决策对结论的影响不应依赖预测模型的系数或特征重要性；DECIDE提供了一种不依赖可预测性假设的决策重要性度量方法，并为多重宇宙概念提供了形式化定义。

Abstract: Human judgment calls made throughout the data science life cycle can change the conclusions drawn from data. Independent analysts often make different choices when given the same data, leading to often unacceptable variations in results and contributing to the ongoing reproducibility crisis across scientific disciplines. The rapid adoption of agentic tools threatens to amplify this crisis. Several approaches have been developed to address this variation by following the same strategy: repeating an analysis under different combinations of analytical decisions and inspecting the distribution of outcomes. Examples include multiverse analysis, specification curve analysis, and vibration of effects. More broadly, the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework assesses how documented judgment calls across the data science life cycle affect conclusions, with predictability serving as a reality-check that a model captures signal. Each of these approaches results in a "multiverse" object. While the distribution of outcomes reflects the overall variability of conclusions, estimating the influence of each individual decision requires additional tools. A common heuristic is to train a model to predict the outcome from these decisions and treat its coefficients or feature importances as proxies for each decision's influence. Although this strategy may work in certain cases, it assumes the model is correctly specified and accurately predicts the outcome, which we show is not always the case. In this work, we introduce DECIDE, a model-free framework that quantifies each decision's importance from the actual outcomes across the plausible decision space, avoiding issues of predictability by design. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DECIDE by applying it to real-world multiverse analyses. We further provide what is, to our knowledge, the first formal definition of the multiverse.

</details>


### [1381] [A goodness of fit approach to select the optimal visit sequence for nonparametric data synthesis](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38559v1)
*R{é}my Chapelle,Bruno Falissard,Mohammed Sedki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于拟合优度准则的访问序列选择方法，用于顺序合成数据生成，并在合成质量与时间复杂度上优于基于结构的方法，且适用于任意数据类型与条件分布模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据可在保护隐私的前提下共享研究数据以符合开放科学原则；顺序合成中变量生成顺序（访问序列）会影响合成数据质量，但如何选取该顺序缺乏明确准则。

Method: 以拟合优度准则指导访问序列的选择，构造一种新的序列选择方法，并与基于结构的替代方法进行对比。

Result: 在合成数据质量和时间复杂度两方面均优于基于结构的替代方法。

Conclusion: 该方法可适用于任何数据类型及任意类别的条件分布模型，为顺序合成中的访问序列选择提供了通用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Synthetic data are a promising way to maintain privacy while disseminating research data, thereby enabling compliance with the open science principles. Popular methods for generating synthetic data include sequential synthesis, where each variable is generated conditionally on the preceding ones in a given order. This order, also called the visit sequence of the synthesizer, is known to affect the quality of synthetic data. This raises the question of the criteria that should guide its choice. In this work, we present a novel method to perform such selection based on a goodness of fit criterion, and show that it outperforms alternative structure-based methods, both in terms of synthesis quality and time complexity. The proposed method also has the advantage of being applicable to any type of data and any class of conditional distribution models.

</details>


### [1382] [Capacity of the Hopfield-Hebbian dynamics with correlated patterns](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38437v1)
*Mihailo Stojnic*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文研究相关/带噪数据下Hopfield-Hebbian联想记忆的容量问题：将每个原型模式替换为M个相关性由参数r控制的样本，提出基于随机对偶理论（RDT）的框架，在一阶lifting下得到显式含M、r的容量刻画，与仿真动力学高度吻合，并在高相关区补足了谱方法+复制法近似[4]的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典结果α_c≈0.14建立在均匀随机、相互独立的二值模式假设上；现实中数据集往往相关且带噪，此类场景即便对复制法等统计力学手段也仍具挑战性。作者希望在更实际的"原型—多样本"相关数据情形下精确刻画存储容量及相变行为，并厘清已有谱方法近似[4]的适用范围。

Method: 构建随机对偶理论（RDT）框架分析相关数据：每个archetype对应M个相关示例，相关性质量由参数r刻画；仅取RDT lifting的第一层即导出容量刻画，结果显式包含M与r，从而定量给出它们对动力学相变的影响。

Result: 一阶RDT所得容量刻画与模拟动力学表现高度一致；结果显式揭示相关参数M、r对相变行为的影响；并确认[4]的谱刻画在低相关区是极佳的近似，同时在高相关区谱方法偏离实际动力学性能之处给出补充与闭合。

Conclusion: RDT为相关数据的联想记忆分析提供了有效且计算可行的途径，弥补了统计力学复制法与谱方法在高相关区间的不足，形成了对现有文献的well-fitting complement。

Abstract: Allowing for small fraction of errors in retrieved stored binary patterns, Hopfield-Hebbian neural network (NN) associative memory dynamics [14] achieves linearly scaled capacity. The famous proportionality constant $α_c\approx 0.14$ is obtained in a large dimensional scenario as the ratio of the number of reliably stored patterns $m$ and the patterns' length $n$ under the assumption that uniformly randomly chosen binary patterns are \emph{independent} among themselves.
  While such an idealized scenario is now well understood, more practical scenarios with correlated/noisy datasets remaining challenging even for classical statistical mechanics replica approaches. We consider precisely such practical settings where each \emph{archetype} pattern is replaced with $M$ correlated \emph{examples} with parameter $r$ governing the quality of correlation. We develop a powerful Random Duality Theory (RDT) based framework to analyze correlated data and already on the first level of RDT lifting obtain capacity characterizations that remarkably well match behavior exhibited through simulated dynamics. Moreover, characterizations explicitly feature correlation parameters $M$ and $r$, which allows to precisely determine their effects on phase-transitioning behavior of the underlying dynamics.
  Our results are also a well-fitting complement to the existing literature. Namely, to circumvent challenging statistical mechanics analyses, an alternative combination of spectral and replica methods is considered in [4]. We confirm that [4]'s elegant spectral characterizations are excellent approximations in the low correlated regime. At the same time, we also close the gap in the regimes with higher correlation levels where spectral methods deviate from the practical dynamics performance.

</details>


### [1383] [MiniMMD: Minimization of MMD for Sampling, Inference and Integration](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38122v1)
*Zonghao Chen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文以最小化最大均值差异（MMD）为核心，首次对数值积分、采样、生成建模与统计推断等“最小差异”问题给出统一处理框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算统计与机器学习中许多问题都可表述为在受限候选分布类上最小化与目标分布的差异，但数值积分、采样、生成建模、统计推断等实例在文献中往往被分别研究，缺乏统一视角。

Method: 以基于核的概率测度差异——最大均值差异（MMD）作为统一目标函数，将上述问题统一为最小化MMD的优化问题，并综述/总结基于最小MMD的算法在理论与实践方面的进展。

Result: 论证MMD既是统计意义上有意义的分布间距离，又是可处理的优化目标，据此可设计实用且高效的算法；并系统梳理了相关算法的近期理论与实证成果。

Conclusion: MMD为多类“最小差异”问题提供了统一的建模与算法设计语言，兼具统计合理性与计算可行性，可作为连接数值积分、采样、生成建模与统计推断的通用工具。

Abstract: Many problems in computational statistics and machine learning can be formulated as approximating a target distribution by minimizing a discrepancy over a restricted class of candidate distributions. This minimum-discrepancy viewpoint appears, for example, in numerical integration, sampling, generative modelling, and statistical inference, but these instances are often studied separately in the literature. This thesis develops the first unified treatment of these many problems through the minimization of the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), a kernel-based discrepancy between probability measures.
