The central theme is that MMD is not only a statistically meaningful distance between probability distributions, but also a tractable optimization objective to design practical and efficient algorithms. This thesis summarizes the recent theoretical and empirical advancements of such minimum-MMD based algorithms.

</details>


### [1384] [Interpretable Feature Discovery from Unstructured Data Using LLMs and Statistical Choice Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38082v1)
*Baptiste Arnaudo,Amine Bennouna,Sébastien Martin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种"成对比较+LLM生成理由+统计选择模型"的方法，自动从非结构化数据中挖掘可解释、与决策相关的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化数据的特征提取依赖不透明的嵌入表示，难以支持可解释决策；而人工构建可解释特征成本高且常不可行。直接让LLM对全样本抽取特征受上下文长度与注意力稀释限制，效果不佳。

Method: 核心思路是成对比较：让LLM对样本对进行比较，用可解释的语言说明区分该对的特征；将这些"理由"（rationales）视为数据，构建统计选择模型（choice model），跨多次比较聚合理由以识别相关特征，并估计每个样本在每项特征上的得分。

Result: 在含已知真实特征的人工合成求职信数据集上，特征恢复显著优于直接LLM特征抽取；在ChangeMyView辩论数据集上发现若干与说服相关的可解释特征，预测准确率与既有基线相当。

Conclusion: 同一套理由还可用于审计LLM决策：由可解释特征分解的整体得分能揭示LLM实际奖励了什么，方法兼具特征发现、预测与可解释性审计能力。

Abstract: Feature extraction from unstructured data typically relies on opaque embeddings unsuited to interpretable decision-making. Interpretable features, on the other hand, typically require costly, and often infeasible, hand-engineering. Large language models (LLMs) offer a natural bridge, as they can read raw data and describe it in interpretable terms. One could simply ask an LLM to extract features from a large sample of the dataset, but context limitations and diluted attention can lead to unsatisfactory results. We introduce a method that automatically discovers interpretable, decision-relevant features from unstructured data. Our key idea is to perform pairwise comparisons between items, asking an LLM to articulate, in interpretable terms, the features distinguishing each pair. We treat these explanations, or rationales, as data: we develop a statistical choice model that combines these rationales across the comparisons to identify relevant features and estimate per-item, per-feature scores. We first test our method on a synthetic hiring dataset of cover letters with known ground-truth features and show that it significantly outperforms direct LLM feature extraction in feature recovery. We then apply it to the ChangeMyView (Reddit) debate dataset, where it discovers several interpretable features associated with persuasion while reaching predictive accuracy comparable to established baselines. We also show how the same rationales can be used to audit LLM decisions, yielding a holistic score whose decomposition over interpretable features reveals what the LLM rewards.

</details>


### [1385] [Efficient Deep Gaussian Process Surrogates via Mini-Batch Latent MAP Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38038v1)
*Chun-Yi Chang,Chih-Li Sung*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出LaMP-DGP：用梯度优化求潜变量MAP估计、再经linked-GP计算实现高效概率预测的深度高斯过程推断方法，并配以微分批优化与增长批尺寸策略，在精度与速度上具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度高斯过程（DGP）是非平稳响应面计算机实验的灵活代理模型，但其潜表示的推断计算困难：现有方法依赖变分推断（受变分族假设限制）或MCMC（需昂贵的后验采样）。

Method: 提出潜变量最大后验深度高斯过程（LaMP-DGP）：用基于梯度的优化获得潜表示的MAP估计，并通过linked-GP计算实现高效概率预测；为扩展到大数据，设计微分批优化算法，并在多项式微分批偏差衰减条件下建立潜状态优化的平稳性界，据此给出增长批尺寸调度；提供R包"LaMPDGP"。

Result: 在数值实验与真实数据分析中，LaMP-DGP相对双随机变分推断、随机梯度哈密顿蒙特卡洛及全贝叶斯Vecchia DGP推断，预测性能持续具竞争力；计算上显著快于Vecchia MCMC方法，与随机梯度类替代方法大体相当。

Conclusion: LaMP-DGP是DGP推断中兼具竞争力与计算效率的替代方案，且已通过R包"LaMPDGP"提供实现。

Abstract: Deep Gaussian processes (DGPs) are flexible surrogate models for computer experiments with nonstationary response surfaces, but inference over their latent representations remains computationally challenging. Existing methods typically rely on variational inference or Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), which impose variational-family assumptions or require costly posterior sampling. We propose the latent maximum-a-posteriori deep Gaussian process (LaMP-DGP), which uses gradient-based optimization to obtain MAP estimates of the latent representations and enables efficient probabilistic prediction through linked-GP calculations. To scale LaMP-DGP to large datasets, we develop a mini-batch optimization algorithm and, under a polynomial mini-batch bias-decay condition, establish a stationarity bound for latent-state optimization that motivates a growing batch-size schedule. Across numerical experiments and real-data analyses, LaMP-DGP provides consistently competitive predictive performance relative to doubly stochastic variational inference, stochastic gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and fully Bayesian Vecchia DGP inference. Computationally, LaMP-DGP is substantially faster than the Vecchia MCMC approach while remaining broadly competitive with the stochastic-gradient alternatives. These results position LaMP-DGP as a competitive and computationally efficient alternative for DGP inference. An R package, "LaMPDGP", is available for implementing the proposed method.

</details>


### [1386] [New Multiple Descent Phenomena Induced by Heterogeneous Data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38002v1)
*Mark-Anthony Moisescu-Pareja,Elvis Dohmatob*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在线性随机特征模型中分析由多个协方差结构不同的数据源混合而成的训练集，推导高维极限下各数据源测试误差的精确渐近表达式，并表明协方差尺度与谱结构的异质性会随模型规模增大引入额外的、依赖数据组的插值阈值，从而产生多种多重下降现象——即使标签无噪声、激活为线性也依然发生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代模型常在多来源混合数据集上训练，各数据源统计性质差异明显；理解这种异质性如何影响泛化、以及性能随模型规模如何变化，尚缺乏清晰的理论解释。经典多重下降解释多归于标签噪声或激活非线性，作者希望检验这些因素是否为必要条件。

Method: 采用线性随机特征模型作为理论框架，在高维渐近（比例极限）体制下对每个数据源分别推导测试误差的精确解析表达式；以合成高斯混合与真实数据集（MNIST、CIFAR-10）进行实验验证。

Result: 发现混合不同协方差结构的数据集会诱发多重下降；协方差尺度与谱结构的异质性随模型规模增大会带来额外且分组相关的插值阈值；这些现象在无噪声标签与线性激活下同样出现，说明标签噪声与激活非线性均非多重下降的必要条件。

Conclusion: 多重下降可由数据异质性本身解释，提供了区别于经典解释的新视角；模型规模扩大会对不���数据组产生不均衡影响、放大组间泛化误差差距，对算法公平性具有潜在意义。

Abstract: Modern machine learning models are often trained on large datasets assembled from many different sources, whose statistical properties can differ substantially. Understanding how this heterogeneity affects generalization performance is therefore important for explaining how model performance changes as model size increases. In this work, we study this question in linear random-feature models and show that mixtures of datasets with different covariance structures can give rise to a range of multiple-descent phenomena. We derive exact asymptotic expressions for the test error of each data source in the high-dimensional regime, and show how heterogeneity in covariance scale and spectral structure can introduce additional, group-dependent interpolation thresholds as model size increases. These phenomena arise even with noiseless labels and linear activations, showing that neither label noise nor activation nonlinearity is necessary for multiple-descent. Our results therefore provide a different perspective from classical explanations of multiple descent. More broadly, our results have potential implications for algorithmic fairness by showing that model scaling can affect different data groups unevenly, amplifying disparities in their generalization errors. We validate our theoretical results on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and real-world datasets, including MNIST and CIFAR-10.

</details>


### [1387] [Finite-Sample Optimal Conformal Prediction Sets under Covariate Shift](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37866v1)
*Zhongyang Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究协变量偏移（已知协变量密度比）下的保形预测，证明"逆条件密度得分 + 随机化加权保形校准"在每个校准样本量下都在全加权可交换类上达到最小期望目标长度（Oracle最优），并用分位数/核直方图（含森林加权估计）近似该Oracle，通过重采样选择估计器与调参，给出L1密度误差线性的超额长度界及选择池/重采样误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协变量偏移下希望得到在目标分布上期望长度最小的预测集，而已有加权保形方法多为有效性保证，缺乏对"最小期望长度"的最优性刻画与可实现的估计-选择流程。

Method: 理论：在加权可交换类上对任意校准样本量证明逆条件密度得分+随机化加权保形校准的最优性。实现：用分位数直方图与核直方图（含森林加权估计器）近似Oracle，并以重采样估计校准后的目标长度来选取估计器与调参；在有界响应域上建立超额长度关于L1密度误差的线性界（无需真实密度有统一正下界），并界定选择池误差与重采样误差。

Result: 在显式增长条件下，所选过程在校准样本量固定时趋近同一Oracle；实验在36个已知密度配置与4个公开回归数据集上比较覆盖率、集合长度与运行时间。针对低覆盖与强偏移场景，逆密度选择在多数情形下给出更短的均值集合、平均运行时间低于所评估的加权基线，覆盖率存在一定差异。

Conclusion: 逆密度得分配合随机化加权保形校准在理论上逐校准样本量最优，且可经直方图近似与重采样选择实际逼近Oracle；实验显示在强偏移与低覆盖目标下兼具较短集合与较低运行时间，但覆盖率存在偏差需注意。

Abstract: We study conformal prediction under covariate shift with a known covariate density ratio, seeking prediction sets with minimum expected length under the target distribution. For every calibration sample size, we prove that the rule combining the inverse conditional-density score with randomized weighted conformal calibration minimizes this expected length among all rules valid over the full weighted-exchangeability class.
  We approximate the oracle using quantile and kernel histograms, including forest-weighted estimators, and select estimators and tuning parameters by resampling to estimate calibrated target length. On a bounded response domain, we bound excess length linearly in $L^1$ density error at fixed calibration size, without requiring a uniform positive lower bound on the true density. We also bound selection-pool and resampling errors. Under explicit growth conditions, the selected procedure approaches the same oracle while the calibration size remains fixed.
  Experiments on 36 known-density configurations and four public regression datasets compare coverage, prediction-set length, and runtime with existing methods.
  In targeted low-coverage and strong-shift comparisons, inverse-density selection yields shorter mean sets in most cases and lower mean runtime than the evaluated weighted baselines, with some differences in achieved coverage.

</details>


### [1388] [An $Ω(T^{3/4})$ lower bound for projection-free online learning with linear minimization oracles](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37845v1)
*Julien Weibel,Pierre Gaillard,Wouter Koolen,Adrien Taylor*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明：任何每轮最多调用 m 次线性最小化预言机（LMO）的无投影在线学习算法，其最坏情况遗憾下界为 Ω(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})，从而回答了"是否所有 Online Frank–Wolfe（OFW）调参的遗憾都按 T^{3/4} 缩放"这一公开问题；并据此提出每轮多次线性优化的扩展 OFW，取得 O(max{T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, √T}) 的上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OFW 的遗憾上界此前仅在特定调参下已知为 T^{3/4}（Hazan–Kale 2012；Hazan 2016），但"所有 OFW 调参乃至所有无投影算法是否都同样按 T^{3/4} 缩放"仍是开放问题；作者希望给出统一的下界刻画，并厘清 LMO 调用次数与遗憾之间的权衡关系。

Method: 构造性下界证明：对任意每轮至多 m 次 LMO 调用的无投影算法，构造最坏情况实例，导出 Ω(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}) 的遗憾下界。基于该分析提出扩展 OFW——每轮执行多次线性最小化（即多步 LMO/多次线性优化组合），在给定 LMO 预算下改善步长/方向选择的信息利用率，并给出匹配的上界分析。

Result: (1) 通用下界：Ω(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})，独立于具体调参，回答了上述开放问题；(2) 扩展 OFW 上界：O(max{T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, √T})，在下界意义下于 m 相关项上紧（至常数），并在 m 足够大时退化为 √T 的最优统计速率。

Conclusion: T^{3/4} 型遗憾并非 OFW 调参的偶然产物，而是每轮单次 LMO 情形下的固有限制；增加每轮 LMO 调用次数 m 可按 m^{-1/4} 提升遗憾，且当 m 达到 ~T^{1/2} 量级时可恢复 √T 速率。这为无投影在线学习中的计算—统计权衡提供了统一刻画。

Abstract: This work considers projection-free online learning algorithms with linear minimization oracles for handling the decision set. For Online Frank--Wolfe (OFW), regret upper bounds were already known for specific OFW tunings [Hazan and Kale, 2012, Hazan, 2016] which scaled as $T^{3/4}$ (where $T$ is the horizon length). However, it remained an open question whether the regret of all OFW tunings scaled as $T^{3/4}$.
  We answer that question, proving a universal worst-case regret lower bound $Ω(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})$ for any projection-free algorithm that makes at most $m$ linear minimization oracle calls per round. The analysis suggests an extended OFW to resort to multiple linear optimizations per round, for which we prove a regret upper bound $O(\max \{ T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, \sqrt{T} \})$.

</details>


### [1389] [Investigating the Early Signatures of Feature Learning in Deep Linear Networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37834v1)
*Shaunak Bhandarkar,Boris Hanin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文对均值场参数化的深度线性网络，从初始化出发单步梯度训练，给出了高维数据（含低维尖峰信号）下特征学习的闭式刻画：一步更新将各层特征核改变为目标对齐的秩一尖峰，放大量约为学习率×深度；并用KRR分析表明该特征带来"反收缩"放大效应，其泛化优势在尖峰强度与有效信噪比足够大时出现，各向同性输入下则消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络的成功常被归因于学习到数据依赖的特征，但训练非线性非凸、数据多具各向异性，导致"何种特征涌现、何时改善泛化"难以显式刻画。作者希望在一个可解析的极简设定（单步训练、深度线性网络、尖峰数据）中精确回答这一问题，尤其是低维任务结构对第一步梯度收益的作用。

Method: 1) 设定：均值场参数化的深度线性网络，高维各向异性数据（低秩尖峰协方差 + 目标对齐）；从初始化出发仅做一步梯度下降。2) 在无限宽均值场极限下推导各层特征核的一步更新闭式解，得到秩一尖峰形式与放大因子（学习率、深度）。3) 在该学习到的特征核上做核岭回归（KRR），指出其等价于对初始化KRR估计量的标量膨胀（"反收缩"）。4) 在过参数化比例极限下，以尖峰强度、尖峰-目标对齐度、有效信噪比等宏观参量给出偏差、方差与泛化误差的闭式表达。

Result: 一步更新使每层特征核获得目标对齐的秩一尖峰，放大倍数随学习率与层深线性增长；KRR在学习特征核上表现为对初始估计量的标量膨胀，能重新放大被岭回归抑制的任务相关方向，但同时放大噪声；闭式偏差-方差分解显示：各向同性输入下一步泛化优势消失，仅当尖峰强度与有效信噪比均充分大时优势显现。

Conclusion: 成功的单步梯度既需要也从低维任务结构（尖峰信号）中获益：特征学习对泛化的增益并非普适，而依赖于数据中低维信号的存在及其与目标的对齐程度和有效信噪比。该工作提供了特征学习—泛化关系的可解析微观图像。

Abstract: Deep neural networks learn data-dependent features, a capacity widely credited for their empirical success. However, explicitly characterizing what features emerge -- and when they improve generalization -- is challenging, since training is nonlinear and non-convex and the data is often anisotropic. Here, we give a closed-form account of feature learning for a deep linear network in a mean-field parameterization, trained by one gradient step from initialization on high-dimensional data carrying a low-dimensional (spiked) signal. In the infinite-width mean-field limit, one step updates each layer's feature kernel by a target-aligned rank-one spike, amplified by both the learning rate and the layer depth. We next assess how these features impact prediction through kernel ridge regression (KRR), finding that KRR on the learned feature kernel yields scalar inflation of the KRR estimator at initialization -- an "anti-shrinkage" mechanism that reinflates task-relevant directions suppressed by ridge, while also amplifying noise. To study when this inflation improves generalization, in the overparameterized proportional limit we derive closed-form expressions for the bias, variance, and generalization errors of these estimators in terms of key macroscopic parameters -- notably the spike strength and spike-target alignment. Crucially, we find that a one-step generalization advantage vanishes for isotropic inputs and appears when both the spike strength and an effective signal-to-noise ratio are sufficiently large, demonstrating that a successful first gradient step both requires and benefits from low-dimensional task structure.

</details>


### [1390] [QD-PINN:A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach to Bayesian Quickest Detection in High-Dimensional Diffusions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37473v1)
*Hang Ye,Yi Liu,Haipeng Xing*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出基于PINN的框架求解高维带空间依赖的扩散过程快速检测问题中的最优停止边界，并给出自由边界PDE与无穷维随机优化问题等价的理论证明，同时用深度集成与MC dropout量化边界估计的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速检测问题（QDPs）应用广泛，但其变分不等式具有互补结构，传统数值方法在高维情形下面临巨大挑战，且易受维数灾难影响。

Method: 构建PINN框架估计QDPs在高维扩散过程与空间依赖下的最优停止边界；理论上证明自由边界PDE与无穷维随机优化问题之间的新等价性，从而严格论证用有限维神经网络逼近真实解的合理性；并采用深度集成与Monte Carlo dropout进行不确定性量化以评估鲁棒性。

Result: 在不同独立训练与随机前向传播下边界估计变异性低，表明估计稳定一致；与可获得的参考数值解对比，结果高度吻合。

Conclusion: 该PINN框架可有效克服维数灾难，为高维QDPs的最优停止边界提供理论上有依据、数值上可靠且具备不确定性量化能力的求解途径。

Abstract: Quickest detection problems (QDPs) arise in a wide range of applications. However, the complementarity structure of the associated variational inequalities poses substantial challenges for traditional numerical methods, particularly in high-dimensional settings. We propose a PINN-based framework for estimating the optimal stopping boundary in QDPs with high-dimensional diffusion processes and spatial dependence, while overcoming the curse of dimensionality. Theoretically, we establish a novel equivalence between the free-boundary PDE and an infinite-dimensional stochastic optimization problem, rigorously justifying the use of finite-dimensional neural networks to approximate the true solution. Furthermore, we assess the robustness of the proposed framework by quantifying uncertainty in the learned stopping boundaries using deep ensembles and Monte Carlo dropout. The results show low variability across independent training runs and stochastic forward passes, indicating stable and consistent boundary estimates. We also compare our PINN results with reference numerical solutions where available and find close agreement.

</details>


### [1391] [Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Expectile Aggregation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37450v1)
*Tianyi Zhu,Wei Lan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ExpectileGCN，用可学习的expectile水平替代均值聚合，在异配图上捕捉超出均值的邻域分布信息，并给出稳定性、泛化与分类风险的理论分析及实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN依赖邻域聚合，但传统均值聚合可能无法捕捉与类别相关的分布信息，在异配图上尤为明显。

Method: 引入可学习的expectile水平，使聚合算子能在最小型与最大型行为间连续调节（均值为特例）；采用基于sigmoid平滑的可微近似与不动点迭代实现端到端优化。

Result: 理论上建立稳定性性质与直推泛化保证；在同配邻域模型下分析分类风险，证明信息性邻域中expectile聚合可利用类别相关的尺度差异获得相对均值聚合的分类优势，并在每邻居标签信息量递减的局部渐近机制下该优势在极限分类风险意义下依然保持；实验中在同配与异配基准图上取得较强预测性能，并在特征损坏与结构扰动下更鲁棒。

Conclusion: expectile聚合是均值聚合的推广，能在异配场景下提供可证明且经验上有效的聚合改进。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) rely critically on neighborhood aggregation, yet conventional mean aggregation may fail to capture class-relevant distributional information, particularly in heterophilic graphs. We propose ExpectileGCN, an adaptive graph aggregation framework that introduces a learnable expectile level to capture neighborhood information beyond the mean. The proposed operator continuously adjusts aggregation between minimum- and maximum-type behaviors, with mean aggregation as a special case. A differentiable approximation based on sigmoid smoothing and fixed-point iterations enables end-to-end optimization. Theoretically, we establish stability properties and transductive generalization guarantees for ExpectileGCN. We further investigate its classification risk under heterophilic neighborhood models. For informative neighborhoods, we show that expectile aggregation can exploit class-dependent scale differences to achieve a classification advantage over mean aggregation. Under a local asymptotic regime with diminishing per-neighbor label informativeness, we establish that this advantage can persist in terms of limiting classification risk. Experiments on homophilic and heterophilic benchmark graphs demonstrate strong predictive performance and improved robustness under feature corruption and structural perturbations.

</details>


### [1392] [An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37398v1)
*Giada Badaracco,Sean Benevedes,Christina Reissel,Philip Harris,Gaia Grosso*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SIGMA框架，将高斯混合模型的密度估计与可处理的不确定性量化结合，并把拟合不确定性作为冗余参数纳入拟合优度检验（由点零假设推广为复合假设），使同一生成模型的可信测试集规模比标准检验大一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理科学（如粒子物理本底估计）中常用生成模型做密度估计，但现有机器学习方法缺乏可将不确定性传播到统计检验中的量化手段，导致生成模型验证只能依赖把模型视为精确的点零假设拟合优度检验。由于有限训练集拟合的模型永远不精确，测试集足够大时任何足够强的检验终将拒绝它，从而混淆“真实误建模”与“分辨率提高导致的估计误差暴露”。

Method: 提出端到端框架SIGMA：采用不确定性可解析处理的高斯混合模型（GMM）进行密度估计；构造新的拟合优度检验，将拟合的统计误差作为冗余参数进行剖面化（profiling），把传统点零假设检验提升为复合假设检验。

Result: 在受控二维玩具模型和建模QCD本底过程的对撞机物理基准上验证：在纳入不确定性后，同一模型可被信赖的测试集规模比标准检验允许的大约一个数量级；此时拒绝信号表明真实的误建模，而非测试集大到足以分辨拟合误差（前提是传播的不确定性忠实覆盖该误差）。

Conclusion: 该工作为物理科学中生成模型的稳健使用提供了有统计依据的基础，使拟合不确定性得以纳入检验流程并区分真实误建模与有限统计误差。

Abstract: Density estimation with generative models is a common task in the physical sciences, for example in background estimation in particle physics. Existing machine learning techniques, however, lack methods to quantify uncertainties that can be propagated into a statistical test. That limits the validation of generative models to standard goodness-of-fit tests, in which the generative model is treated as exact (point-null hypothesis). But a model fitted to a finite training set is never exact, so if its uncertainties are neglected, any sufficiently powerful goodness-of-fit test will eventually reject it once the test set is large enough to resolve this estimation error. We propose SIGMA, an end-to-end framework combining density estimation with principled uncertainty quantification. We use Gaussian mixture models, for which uncertainties are tractable, and further construct a new goodness-of-fit test in which these uncertainties are profiled as nuisance parameters to account for the statistical error of the fit, promoting the conventional point-null test to a composite one. A rejection then signals genuine mismodeling rather than a test set large enough to resolve the error of the fit, provided the propagated uncertainties faithfully cover that error. We demonstrate the framework on a controlled two-dimensional toy model and on a collider physics benchmark modeling the QCD background process. With uncertainties included, the same model can be trusted on test sets up to an order of magnitude larger than the standard test allows. Our work thus provides a statistically grounded basis for a robust use of generative models in the physical sciences.

</details>


### [1393] [Low-degree polynomials lower bounds for clustering in small dimension](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37272v1)
*Alexandra Carpentier,Nicolas Verzelen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文研究了当簇数 $K$ 远大于维度 $d$ 时，从 $K$ 个各向同性分布混合模型中聚类 $n$ 个样本的计算极限。作者构造了基于对偶 BCH 码的 $2K$ 个乘积 Bernoulli 分布混合（$K=(d+1)^m$），使其矩张量直到 $2m+1$ 阶与 $\{-1,1\}^d$ 上均匀分布一致，从而证明低次多项式在分离度 $\Delta^2\ll(K^2d^{3/2}/n)^{1/(2m+2)}$ 时无法聚类；即在多对数分离下需 $n\gtrsim K^2d^{3/2}$ 个样本，并通过高斯化归约推广到各向同性高斯混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 $K\gg d$ 的区间，基于张量的算法能以多对数级中心分离恢复划分，但需要 $dK$ 的难以显式表达的大多项式样本量，而现有低次下界仅要求 $n>dK^2$，二者之间存在显著空白，论文旨在给出更强的低次计算下界以刻画该区间的真实计算难度。

Method: 构造 $\{0,1\}^d$ 上 $2K$ 个乘积 Bernoulli 分布的混合，$K=(d+1)^m$，中心由对偶 BCH 码构造，使观测的矩张量直到 $2m+1$ 阶与 $\{-1,1\}^d$ 上均匀分布相同。采用低次多项式方法，使用一族由二分图索引、近似正交的多项式；其矩由 BCH 码诱导的 $\mathbb F_{d+1}$ 上多项式系统解的数目控制，核心分析在于将二分图的组合结构与解集结构相联系。随后通过高斯化论证以归约方式把硬度传递到各向同性高斯混合。

Result: 对任意固定 $m$，证明只要分离度满足 $\Delta^2\ll(K^2d^{3/2}/n)^{1/(2m+2)}\wedge\sqrt d$（忽略多对数因子），聚类即为低次困难；特别地，在多对数分离下低次多项式需要 $n\gtrsim K^2d^{3/2}$ 个样本（忽略多对数因子），且该硬度以归约意义传递到各向同性高斯混合。

Conclusion: 论文给出 $K\gg d$ 区间内更强的聚类低次下界，将所需样本量从 $dK^2$ 提升至 $K^2d^{3/2}$ 量级，揭示了张量算法与低次下界之间的差距，并说明基于 BCH 码的矩匹配构造是构造统计-计算鸿沟的有效工具。

Abstract: We study the computational limits of clustering $n$ observations drawn from a mixture of $K$ isotropic distributions in $\mathbb R^d$, in the regime where the number $K$ of groups is much larger than the dimension $d$. In this regime, tensor-based procedures recover the partition with a polylogarithmic separation between the centers, but they require a sample size that is a large and non-explicit polynomial of $dK$, whereas the existing low-degree lower bounds only show that $n$ must be larger than $dK^2$. We introduce a mixture of $2K$ product Bernoulli distributions on $\{0,1\}^d$, with $K=(d+1)^m$, whose centers are built from a dual BCH code. This construction ensures that the moment tensors of the observations coincide with those of the uniform distribution on $\{-1,1\}^d$ up to the order $2m+1$. For any fixed $m$, we establish a low-degree polynomial lower bound showing that clustering is hard as long as the separation $Δ$ satisfies $Δ^2\ll(K^2d^{3/2}/n)^{1/(2m+2)}\wedge\sqrt d$, up to polylogarithmic factors. In particular, with a polylogarithmic separation, low-degree polynomials require $n\gtrsim K^2d^{3/2}$ observations, up to polylogarithmic factors. Through a Gaussianization argument, this hardness carries over, in the sense of reductions, to isotropic Gaussian mixtures. Our proof relies on a family of polynomials of the observations, indexed by bipartite graphs, which is almost orthonormal. The moments of these polynomials are governed by the number of solutions of polynomial systems over the finite field $\mathbb F\_{d+1}$ that are induced by the BCH code, and the crux of our analysis is to connect the combinatorial structure of the bipartite graphs with the structure of the solution sets of these systems.

</details>


### [1394] [Doubly Robust Deep Kernel Tests for Structured Outcomes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37227v1)
*Robin Leman,Bariscan Bozkurt,Sofiane Tanji,Arthur Gretton,Houssam Zenati*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 DR-KTE-Deep：在图像、文本、图等结构化高维结果上检验两种干预是否诱导相同结果分布，通过对学习到的深度特征优化功效准则进行双重稳健均值嵌入差检验，实证功效显著优于固定核与带宽优化核基线且Type-I误差良好校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有干预效应检验多针对低维或非结构化结果，当结果为图像、文本、图等高维结构化对象时，直接比较分布困难；核方法受固定核/带宽选择限制，检验功效不足。

Method: 将干预分布表示为学习深度特征上的均值嵌入，处理效应取为均值嵌入差的双重稳健表示；DR-KTE-Deep 以该表示上的估计功效准则为目标优化深度特征（学习核）；理论上证明功效准则刻画固定备择下的渐近信噪比，给出其正则化估计的一致有限样本界，并在学习核固定时证明留出检验在原假设下渐近有效（需合适 nuisance 估计速率）。

Result: 理论上得到功效准则与渐近信噪比的对应关系、有限样本均匀界及渐近有效性保证；实证在图像、文本、图结果上，DR-KTE-Deep 功效大幅高于固定核与带宽优化核基线，同时Type-I误差保持良好校准。

Conclusion: 将深度特征学习与双重稳健均值嵌入检验结合，可有效提升高维结构化结果下干预分布相等性检验的功效，并具备理论有效性保障。

Abstract: We propose a test of whether two interventions induce the same outcome distribution when outcomes are structured and high-dimensional, such as images, text and graphs. We represent the interventional distributions as mean embeddings on learned deep features, such that the treatment effect is a doubly robust representation of the difference in mean embeddings. Our test, DR-KTE-Deep, optimises the learned features so as to maximise an estimated power criterion on this treatment effect representation. To motivate our learning objective, we show that the power criterion characterises the asymptotic signal-to-noise ratio of the test under fixed alternatives, and we derive a uniform finite-sample bound for its regularised estimate. We show that, with the learned kernel fixed, a held-out test is asymptotically valid under the null given suitable nuisance-estimation rates. Empirically, DR-KTE-Deep achieves substantially higher power than fixed and bandwidth-optimised kernel baselines across image, text and graph outcomes, while maintaining well-calibrated Type-I error.

</details>


### [1395] [Intrinsic Information-Theoretic Analysis of ReLU Nets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36864v1)
*Johan Mylius-Kroken,Elisabeth Wetzer,Ali Ramezani-Kebrya,Robert Jenssen,Kristoffer Knutsen Wickstrøm*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对高维下互信息(MI)估计依赖超参数、偏差主导信号的问题，本文利用连续分段线性(CPWL)网络(含ReLU)对输入空间的内在凸线性区域划分，将输入映射为离散区域标签Π与连续表示T，提出将I(Y;T)分解为可解释几何项，并给出可估的"路由信息"I(Y;Π)的plug-in估计器及函数等价商扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络中互信息是表示学习分析的基础工具，但高维MI估计器依赖超参数，其偏差常压过真实信号，导致分析不可靠。作者希望摆脱外部离散化与超参数依赖，转而利用网络自身的分段线性结构进行信息论分析。

Method: 1) 利用CPWL网络(含ReLU)将输入空间划分为凸线性区域，为每个输入赋予离散区域标签Π，与连续表示T、标签Y共同构成三元组；2) 提出I(Y;T)的几何分解，其中主导项为路由信息I(Y;Π)，并给出可估的plug-in估计器，证明在充分采样情形下它近似I(Y;Π,T)的总体下界；3) 当划分饱和时，引入函数等价商，将实现同一线性算子的区域合并为一个等价类以恢复信息量，该扩展仅含一个有界无量纲参数，并通过商的压缩比报告。

Result: 路由估计器在相同网络与数据上与三种既有MI基线高度一致；函数等价商在充分采样与欠采样之间的过渡区间内能恢复出有信息量的估计；整体框架不依赖外部离散化，仅基于网络固有的分段线性结构。

Conclusion: 本文为CPWL网络的内部信息几何提供了分析框架，以内在分段线性结构而非外部离散化为基础，用小规模、有界参数的路由估计器替代易受偏差干扰的高维MI估计，并为划分饱和情形提供函数等价商作为补救手段。

Abstract: Mutual information (MI) is fundamental to representation-learning analysis in deep networks, but in high dimensions MI estimators depend on hyperparameters whose bias often dominates the signal. We show that continuous piecewise-linear (CPWL) networks, including ReLU networks, admit an intrinsic information-theoretic analysis that avoids this pitfall: their inherent partition of the input space into convex linear regions assigns to every input a discrete region label $Π$ alongside the continuous representation $T$ and label $Y$. We introduce a decomposition of the mutual information $I(Y;T)$ into interpretable geometric terms. We show that the dominant term, the *routing information* $I(Y; Π)$, admits an estimable plug-in estimator, that in the well-sampled regime, approximates a population lower bound on the joint information $I(Y; Π, T)$. When the partition saturates, a functional-equivalence quotient collapses regions implementing the same linear operator and restores informativeness; this extension has a single bounded, dimensionless parameter, which is reported through the quotient's compression ratio. The routing estimator agrees strongly with three established MI baselines applied to the same networks and data. The functional quotient recovers informative estimates in the regime bordering the well-sampled and under-sampled regime. We provide a framework for analysing the internal information geometry of CPWL networks, grounded in their inherent piecewise-linear structure rather than in external discretisation.

</details>


### [1396] [Boundary Geometry Determines Optimal Shallow ReLU Approximation under Weighted Coefficient Constraints](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36854v1)
*Jia-Qi Yang,Lei Shi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究凸体 $K\\subset\\mathbb R^d$ 上边界几何对浅层 ReLU 网络 $L^q$ 逼近的影响，在加权变差空间单位球上给出任意凸体的上下界，并确定平面凸体及其与多胞体（如立方体、圆柱体）乘积的最优多项式逼近指数；对 $C^2$ 凸体在依赖维数的 $q$ 范围内确定最优指数，正主曲率情形推广到一切有限 $q\\ge2$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有逼近速率结果多针对立方体或欧氏球等特定区域，最优指数对区域几何的依赖尚不清楚。作者希望厘清边界几何（尤其边界小帽的几何增长）是否会在维数、误差范数与加权规则固定时改变最优逼近指数。

Method: 以加权变差空间单位球为目标类，将区域几何嵌入输出系数约束；对一般凸体推导 $L^q$ 逼近的上下界；引入与边界小帽相关的单一几何增长指数来刻画区域依赖性；对平面凸体、其与多胞体乘积、$C^2$ 凸体（分正主曲率与非正主曲率情形）分别给出最优指数；并分析权重视角下的阈值与网络压缩实现。

Result: 得到任意凸体的逼近上下界；确定所有平面凸体及其与多胞体乘积的最优多项式指数；对 $C^2$ 凸体在超出 $2$ 的依赖维数的 $q$ 范围内确定最优指数，正主曲率时对一切有限 $q\\ge2$ 成立；最优指数对区域的依赖由单一几何增长指数刻画；给出保持经典逼近指数的尖锐权重阈值，并改进欧氏球上的既有权重且保持经典 $L^2$ 速率；当目标本身为有限 ReLU 网络时，上界可由仅使用原有神经元的压缩网络实现且不增加加权系数和。

Conclusion: 边界几何在维数、误差范数与加权规则固定时也能改变最优逼近指数，因此逼近速率本质上依赖区域几何；该几何依赖性可归结为一个边界小帽增长指数，并可据此给出尖锐的权重条件与压缩网络实现。

Abstract: We study how boundary geometry affects $L^q$ approximation by shallow ReLU neural networks on convex bodies $K\subset\mathbb R^d$. The target classes are unit balls of weighted variation spaces that can enlarge classical spaces by incorporating domain geometry into constraints on output coefficients. We establish upper and lower bounds for arbitrary convex bodies and determine the optimal polynomial approximation exponents for all planar convex bodies and their products with polytopes, including cubes and circular cylinders. For $C^2$ convex bodies, we determine the optimal exponents in a dimension-dependent range of $q$ extending beyond $2$. When all principal curvatures are positive, the result extends to every finite $q\ge2$. For these classes, the dependence of the optimal exponent on the domain is captured by a single geometric growth exponent associated with small boundary caps. We also identify sharp weight thresholds for retaining the classical approximation exponent and improve previous weights on Euclidean balls while preserving the classical $L^2$ approximation rate. When the target is given as a finite ReLU network, the upper bounds can be realized by a compressed network using only the original neurons, without increasing the weighted coefficient sum. These results show that boundary geometry can change the optimal exponent even when dimension, error norm, and weighting rule are fixed.

</details>


### [1397] [Joint Distributional Copula Regression for Insurance Claim Frequency and Severity via Boosting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36835v2)
*Banghee So,Na Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模型提升（boosting）的估计方法，用于拟合双变量响应的结构化可加分布copula回归模型，重点应用于保险索赔频率与强度的联合建模，兼顾可解释性与预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保险精算实务（尤其受监管场景）要求模型透明、可审计、可解释（XAI），而黑箱方法难以满足；同时需要刻画索赔频率与强度之间的相依结构及其随投保人特征的变化，并对全条件联合分布（分位数、尾部、预测区间）进行推断。

Method: 以GAMLSS为基础，允许除条件均值外的多个分布参数依赖协变量；使用线性项与低自由度样条等回归型基学习器，通过boosting进行变量选择与效应估计；以copula刻画边缘分布间的相依性，并允许依赖性随协变量变化（分布copula回归）。

Result: 在模拟数据与真实数据上，该方法能够恢复协变量对边缘分布参数与相依结构的真实效应，实现信息变量选择，预测性能与标准基准模型相当；并给出了拟合模型的解释方式。

Conclusion: 结构化可加分布copula回归结合boosting，可在保持可解释性的同时提升预测精度，适用于需可审计性与全分布风险刻画（条件分位数、尾部行为、预测区间）的精算应用。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a model-based boosting approach for fitting structured additive distributional copula regression models for bivariate responses, with particular emphasis on jointly modeling insurance claim frequency and severity. The approach uses regression-type base learners, such as linear terms and splines with low degrees of freedom. It builds on generalized additive models for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS), which extend generalized additive models (GAMs) by allowing multiple distributional parameters, rather than only the conditional mean, to depend on covariates. The structured additive predictors make the model inherently interpretable, offering greater transparency and auditability than black-box approaches. These features are particularly relevant in regulated actuarial settings and applications requiring explainable artificial intelligence. By estimating the entire conditional joint distribution, the framework also enables insurance practitioners to examine conditional quantiles, tail behavior, and prediction intervals of risks. The copula component captures dependence between claim frequency and severity and allows practitioners to investigate how this dependence varies with policyholder characteristics, potentially improving predictive performance. Moreover, by incorporating modern machine-learning techniques, specifically boosting, the proposed model improves prediction accuracy while retaining interpretability. We assess the proposed framework using both simulated and real data. The results demonstrate its ability to recover the true covariate effects on the marginal distributional parameters and the dependence structure, select informative variables, and achieve predictive performance competitive with standard benchmark models. We also illustrate how to interpret the fitted model.

</details>


### [1398] [Algorithmics for Graphical Separation Criteria](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36502v1)
*Moisés Chavira-Flores,Sebastian Weichwald,Leonard Henckel*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文研究统计图模型中各类分离判据（separation criteria）的算法判定问题，证明所研究的全部判据都可用可达性（reachability）的模块化变体来检验，除 σ-分离外均可在与边数线性时间内完成，并通过 CIfly 框架提供 R/Python 实现及仿真评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计图模型通过图分离准则编码随机向量各分量间的依赖关系，社区已发展出多种图类与分离判据，但缺乏对这些分离陈述判定问题的统一、高效算法刻画，需要明确其计算复杂度边界并提供可用实现。

Method: 将各类分离判据归约为可达性的模块化变体，借助 CIfly 框架部署这些变体，给出 R 与 Python 实现，并通过仿真研究评估实际运行时间与扩展性。

Result: 所研究的全部分离判据均可通过可达性的模块化变体检验；除 σ-分离外均达到线性时间，且因载入图本身即为关于边数的线性操作，该复杂度在渐近意义下最优；σ-分离不在此线性界内。仿真实验给出运行时间与规模扩展的实证结果。

Conclusion: 分离陈述的判定问题可统一归结为可达性计算：对绝大多数判据而言线性时间即为最优可达成界，CIfly 框架为实际应用提供了通用且高效的实现路径。

Abstract: Statistical graphical models are representations of the dependences between the components of a random vector. They encode these dependences via graphical separation criteria. We consider the algorithmic problem of checking separation statements for the various graph classes and separation criteria that have been developed by the community. We establish that all criteria we study can be checked by modular variations of reachability. For all separation criteria but $σ$-separation, this yields a linear-time algorithm. This is effectively the optimal attainable time since loading the graph itself is linear-time in the number of edges in the graph. Using the CIfly framework for deploying modular variations of reachability, we also provide R and Python code implementing our algorithms. We evaluate empirical runtime and scaling behavior in a simulation study.

</details>


### [1399] [Second-order Sinkhorn Geometry and $\sqrt{n}$-Inference](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36488v1)
*Tristan Luca Saidi,Florian Gunsilius,Gonzalo Mena*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文为Sinkhorn散度所诱导的形式Riemann几何补齐了两块核心理论：证明Sinkhorn度量张量的Hadamard可微性并导出Levi-Civita协方差导数，从而得到测地线与平行移动方程（均为固定RKHS上的ODE）；并利用Banach空间ODE理论对解做线性化，给出指数映射、对数映射、平行移动及诱导Sinkhorn距离的插件估计量的√n渐近高斯性与自助法相合性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sinkhorn散度因计算与统计可处理性而被广泛使用，但它既非度量，也不天然具备形式Riemann结构；而插值、重心平均、平行移动等几何操作恰恰依赖这些性质。近期工作通过在概率测度空间上构造形式Riemann切空间与度量张量（二次逼近Sinkhorn散度）来弥补该缺陷，但尚缺乏可微性、协变导数、测地/平行移动方程及其估计量的统计推断理论。

Method: (1) 对一类适当有限光滑性的代价函数，证明Sinkhorn度量张量的Hadamard可微性，并推导该几何下的Levi-Civita协变导数；(2) 由协变导数得到测地线与平行移动方程，二者均为固定RKHS上系数光滑的ODE；(3) 借助Banach空间ODE理论的标准工具对上述方程的解进行线性化，在标准正则条件下建立插件估计量的极限分布与自助法一致性。

Result: 在线性化成立的前提下，指数映射、对数映射、平行移动以及诱导Sinkhorn距离的插件估计量均以总体值为中心满足√n极限高斯过程；非参数自助法对上述所有对象均相合。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是概率测度空间上基于传输的几何中典范几何操作的首批√n极限定理与自助法一致性结果，为在该几何框架下开展统计推断（置信集、假设检验）提供了理论基础。

Abstract: The Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased form of entropic optimal transport, has been widely used in various scientific disciplines due to its computational and statistical tractability. Unlike the Wasserstein distance, however, the Sinkhorn divergence is not a metric and it does not naturally admit a formal Riemannian structure. These properties are central to many applications of optimal transport methods that utilize interpolation, barycentric averaging, parallel transport or other geometric operations. Recent work addresses these shortcomings by constructing a formal Riemannian tangent space and a metric tensor on the space of probability measures that quadratically approximates the Sinkhorn divergence. In this work, we extend this framework with two major threads of contributions. For a suitable class of finite-smoothness cost functions, we prove Hadamard differentiability of the Sinkhorn metric tensor and we derive the Levi-Civita covariant derivative in this geometry; we then use the covariant derivative to obtain the geodesic and parallel transport equations, each of which amount to an ODE on a fixed Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) with smooth coefficients. Our second contribution is to linearize the solutions to the geodesic and parallel transport equations using standard tools from Banach space ODE theory. We show that under standard regularity conditions these linearizations imply $\sqrt{n}$-limiting Gaussian processes centered at population values for the plugin estimators of the exponential map, the logarithmic map, parallel transport and the induced Sinkhorn distance. Moreover, we show that the nonparametric bootstrap is consistent for all objects mentioned. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first $\sqrt{n}$--limit theorems and bootstrap consistency results for canonical geometric operations in a transport-based geometry on the space of probability measures.

</details>


### [1400] [Approximation Families and the Statistical Efficiency of Denoising Score Matching](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36205v1)
*Brian Miyatake*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究由前向扩散生成元特征函数的梯度所张成的有限维近似空间上的score matching，比较OU流下多项式近似与环面热流下三角多项式近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解score matching在有限维函数近似空间（基为正则化特征函数梯度）中的统计稳定性，判别不稳定现象是方法固有的还是近似空间的性质所致。

Method: 在OU流下用多项式基、在环面热流下用三角多项式基构造score匹配；提出operator-informed score matching（OISM），即用扩散半群对score matching损失做平均；并给出局部minimax下界分析。

Result: OU情形：对任何与标准高斯一致可比的非高斯初始分布，score估计方差的渐近值沿某多项式次数子列指数增长；OISM在固定次数降低方差，但在足够小时间下无法消除该指数不稳定性；minimax下界表明高次依赖源于估计score的多项式投影本身，而非OISM的伪影。环面热流情形：OISM在三角多项式上实现score误差的有限样本控制，并在期望KL损失下达到光滑密度的经典minimax速率。

Conclusion: 近似空间的谱结构与流的选择决定score matching的高阶稳定性：OU+多项式因特征值快速增长而出现指数不稳定，热流+三角多项式则保持稳定并具备最优速率。

Abstract: We study score matching over finite-dimensional approximation spaces generated by gradients of eigenfunctions of the infinitesimal generator of a forward diffusion. We compare polynomial approximation under one-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck flow with trigonometric-polynomial approximation under heat flow on the torus. In the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck setting, we show that for every non-Gaussian initial distribution uniformly comparable to the standard Gaussian, the asymptotic score-estimation variance grows exponentially along a subsequence of polynomial degrees. Averaging the score-matching loss under the diffusion semigroup, which we call operator-informed score matching (OISM), reduces the variance at each fixed degree but does not eliminate this exponential instability at sufficiently small times. A local minimax lower bound shows that the same high-degree dependence arises when estimating the polynomial projection of the score, rather than being an artifact of OISM. In contrast, under heat flow on the torus, OISM over trigonometric polynomials admits finite-sample control of the score error along the forward diffusion and yields the classical minimax rate for estimating sufficiently smooth densities under expected Kullback-Leibler loss.

</details>


### [1401] [Anytime Valid Confidence Bands for Distribution Functions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36149v1)
*Bror Hultberg,Dave Zachariah,Antônio H. Ribeiro*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为数据流的分布函数构造在所有时刻与所有点上同时有效的非参数置信带，即使观测可任意依赖历史；理论宽度由二分搜索树的深度决定，并推广为一般框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非参数推断常需刻画未知函数（如CDF）在整个定义域上的行为，而非仅某一点；现有方法多针对独立同分布或固定样本量，缺乏对数据流、任意依赖结构下"时间×空间"一致有效的置信带。

Method: 先推导时间平均条件CDF的置信带，证明其宽度由二分搜索树（binary search tree）的深度决定；进而抽象为一套统一框架：对任意索引族的时间平均分布函数，可在时间与任意索引集上一致地构造有效置信带；并以重要性加权CDF、右删失CDF及多元CDF为例进行说明。

Result: 得到时间平均条件CDF的一致置信带，其宽度量化依赖于二分搜索树深度；框架可统一覆盖重要性加权、右删失及多元CDF等情形，均给出时间与索引集上一致有效的置信带。

Conclusion: 该工作将CDF置信带从固定样本推广到任意依赖的数据流场景，提供了模块化、可扩展的统一构造框架。

Abstract: Nonparametric inference often requires characterizing an unknown function, such as a cumulative distribution function (CDF), across its entire domain rather than a specific point. We develop confidence bands for distribution functions of a data stream that are valid simultaneously over all times and all points, even when each observation may depend arbitrarily on the past. We begin by deriving such bands for the time-averaged conditional CDF and show how their widths are determined by the depth of a binary search tree. We then show that this result is an instance of a framework through which one can construct valid confidence bands uniformly over time and over an arbitrary index set for any indexed family of time-averaged distribution functions. We illustrate the framework on importance-weighted and right-censored CDFs, as well as multivariate CDFs.

</details>


### [1402] [Symmetry Breaking Is the Price of Finite Capacity](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36138v1)
*Maggie Chlon,Leon Chlon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文提出并精确刻画了一个"对称性代价"现象：当模型容量受限时，即便问题本身具有旋转对称性，最优模型也会可预测地破坏对称性；对高斯问题与秩受限注意力头，破缺量可精确计算并经验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直觉上，若问题在旋转下答案不变，最优模型应具备旋转不变性（对称性）。论文旨在检验这一直觉在容量受限时是否成立，并量化"强制对称"所付出的性能代价，尤其针对注意力头的低秩相似度结构。

Method: 将模型的各个方向按对称性分为"等强度方向的块（block）"；对称模型必须整块使用方向，而容量预算截断某个块时，任何最优模型都会破缺对称。对含 k 单元双线性预测器的高斯问题，推导对数损失下对称性代价的闭式表达 (U_k − I_k)/(2σ²)，即最佳 k 个方向的信号与最佳整块信号之差。进一步利用注意力头通过至多等于头维度的秩比较 token 这一事实，把结论迁移到以平方误差拟合对称相似度的注意力头，并给出区分容量驱动的对称破缺与其他成因的步骤。

Result: 对称性代价精确为 (U_k − I_k)/(2σ²)。在三维方向数据上训练的注意力头恰在预测的头维度处破缺对称，旋转敏感度与预测一致（RMSE 0.004）。softmax 注意力下，较平坦的注意力在测试处恢复了预测的对称头；而峰值注意力下，破缺头在 20 个头维度中的 16 个上优于所有整壳（whole-shell）对称头。

Conclusion: 容量受限是导致最优模型破缺问题对称性的充分且可预测的原因，其代价可解析计算并经验证实；该框架可诊断对称破缺是否源于容量，为模型设计与可解释性分析提供定量依据。

Abstract: If rotating a problem never changes its answer, one might expect its best model to be rotation-invariant; we show that this fails, predictably and by an exact amount, when capacity is limited. A symmetry groups a model's directions into blocks of equally strong directions, a symmetric model must use each block whole, and when the budget cuts a block every optimal model breaks the symmetry. For a Gaussian problem with a $k$-unit bilinear predictor, the log-loss price of symmetry is exactly $(U_k-I_k)/(2σ^2)$, the signal of the best $k$ directions minus that of the best whole blocks. Because an attention head compares tokens through a similarity of rank at most its head dimension, whatever computation precedes it, the same price governs heads fitted to a symmetric similarity by squared error, and heads trained this way on three-dimensional directions break symmetry at exactly the predicted head dimensions, with the predicted rotation sensitivity (RMSE 0.004). Under softmax attention, flatter attention restores the predicted symmetric head where tested, while with peaked attention broken heads beat every whole-shell symmetric head at 16 of 20 head dimensions. We give a procedure that separates capacity-driven breaking from other causes.

</details>


### [1403] [Learning on-the-fly quasi-stationarity diagnostics from low-dimensional surrogates](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36078v2)
*Noé Blassel*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出以非线性概率流的粗粒化与基于模拟的推断（RNN）替代MCMC式诊断，来估计加速动力学中的去相关时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行副本动力学等加速方法需要去相关时间估计（即过程进入准平稳分布QSD所需时间）。Binder–Lelièvre–Simpson方法用MCMC式诊断判断粒子近似与非线性条件化概率流是否耦合，但该诊断较保守、易失败，故需更优替代。

Method: 1) 建立针对条件于存活的被杀Markov跳过程的粗粒化框架，借助集体变量定义代理过程的非线性流，证明一致于时间、非渐近的误差估计，且不假设可逆性，并给出在绝热区制下显式缩放的界；2) 基于该结果，用粒子近似非线性有效流训练RNN，输出去相关后验概率作为诊断，再迁移到高维粒子近似的集体变量轨迹上。

Result: 在合成算例与一个分子体系的数值实验中，与Binder等的MCMC诊断比较，并在训练先验内、外测试：当前提假设成立时，RNN诊断在ROC分析中更优、更少保守、失败率更低，且判决阈值具有可解释性。

Conclusion: 粗粒化理论为基于学习的去相关诊断提供了依据；RNN诊断在假设成立时优于MCMC诊断，但其可靠性依赖先验假设，先验外情形仍需考察。

Abstract: Accelerated dynamics methods, such as parallel replica dynamics, require estimates of the decorrelation time, after which a process trapped in one of its metastable states is distributed according to the quasi-stationary distribution (QSD).
  In a method proposed by Binder, Lelièvre and Simpson, decorrelation times are defined by coupling a particle approximation of the non-linear conditioned probability flow of the process with MCMC-inspired diagnostics.
  We explore an alternative to MCMC diagnostics, based on coarse-graining of non-linear probability flows and simulation-based inference.
  We first develop a coarse-graining framework for killed Markov jump processes conditioned on survival, proving uniform-in-time, non-asymptotic estimates approximating the non-linear probability flow of
  the true process by the non-linear flow of a surrogate process, defined with a collective variable. The framework does not assume reversibility of the true process, and also gives bounds which scale explicitly in an adiabatic regime.
  Motivated by these results, we then construct a quasi-stationarity diagnostic using simulation-based inference: a recurrent neural network (RNN), trained on particle approximations of non-linear effective flows, estimates posterior probabilities of decorrelation. The learned diagnostic is then transferred to collective-variable traces of high-dimensional particle approximations.
  We investigate the behavior and robustness of this diagnostic on a set of numerical experiments, comparing it to the MCMC diagnostic of Binder et al.\ on both synthetic examples and a molecular system, in and out of its training prior distribution.
  When its prior assumptions hold, the RNN diagnostic outperforms the MCMC diagnostic in ROC analysis, is less conservative, fails less often, and has an interpretable decision threshold.

</details>


### [1404] [Anchored Stein Variational Gradient Descent Algorithm for Non-smooth Sampling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36018v1)
*Thanh Dang,Matthew X. Burns,Jiaming Liang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出锚定Stein变分框架（anchored SVGD），通过引入光滑参考势$U_0$与锚权重$a=e^{U-U_0}$，在目标势$U$非光滑时仍可从$p\propto e^{-U}$采样，且无需计算$U$的梯度，标准SVGD为其特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SVGD依赖目标势$U$的梯度，当$U$非光滑（如仅局部Lipschitz）时梯度不存在，算法无法直接应用；因此需要一个不显式计算$\nabla U$的变分采样框架。

Method: 引入更光滑的参考势$U_0$（连续可微）和锚权重$a=e^{U-U_0}$，构造锚定扰动；在低正则性假设（$U$局部Lipschitz、$U_0$连续可微等）下，推导锚定扰动的KL第一变分公式，在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中识别最速下降方向，并给出基于锚定核化Stein差异的非渐近收敛界；同时给出由$U$构造合适$U_0$的指导。

Result: 建立了KL第一变分公式与RKHS中最速下降方向；证明了锚定SVGD关于锚定核化Stein差异的非渐近收敛界；并将标准SVGD作为特例纳入框架。

Conclusion: 锚定SVGD将SVGD推广至非光滑势情形，避免了对$U$的梯度计算，理论上保证了收敛性，并提供了参考势选择的可操作建议。

Abstract: We introduce a Stein variational framework for sampling from a target density $p\propto e^{-U}$ when the target potential $U$ is possibly non-smooth. The key idea is to introduce a smoother reference potential $U_0$ and the anchor weight $a=e^{U-U_0}$. The resulting anchored Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) algorithm is able to target $p\propto e^{-U}$ without computing the gradient of $U$ and include standard SVGD as a special case.
  In particular, we allow the target potential $U$ to be locally Lipschitz while the reference potential $U_0$ is continuously differentiable, along with other suitable assumptions. Under this low regularity regime, we establish a Kullback-Leibler first variation formula for anchored perturbations, identify the corresponding steepest descent direction in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space and prove a nonasymptotic convergence bound for the anchored SVGD algorithm in terms of an anchored kernelized Stein discrepancy. Finally, we also provide guidance on constructing a suitable reference potential $U_0$ based on $U$.

</details>


### [1405] [Model Selection for Off-Policy Evaluation via Pairwise Bellman Validation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35748v1)
*Lars van der Laan,Vasilis Syrgkanis,Nathan Kallus*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出成对Bellman验证（PBV），一种无需调参的极小极大模型选择程序，用留出转移对有限类别的拟合Q函数和占用比估计器进行选择，并给出有限样本oracle不等式保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线策略评估（OPE）中模型选择与超参数调优是核心难题：拟合Q函数与占用比估计的误差无法直接用留出转移评估；现有Bellman残差与极小极大验证方法往往需要辅助回归或对独立critic类做优化，带来额外计算与调参成本。

Method: 提出成对Bellman验证（PBV）：利用候选两两差分构造critic，仅需有限次经验矩计算，无需辅助验证模型或单独critic优化。理论上指出Q函数误差与候选-真实占用比对数比构成oracle critic，其Bellman与伴随Bellman矩可控制估计误差，候选差分近似这些未知critic并用惩罚项处理比较器近似误差。具体给出：无加权PBV（在离线分布下评估成对Bellman矩，需成对强制性条件）；目标对齐PBV（TA-PBV，用边缘化重要性加权摆脱强制性条件）；伴随PBV（A-PBV，针对占用比选择，以对数比critic评估伴随Bellman矩）。

Result: 建立了相对于最优可用候选的有限样本oracle不等式，且在候选类误设下仍成立。在Hopper与Deep OPE基准上，无加权PBV表现具竞争力，目标占用加权在重叠受控情形下可进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: PBV以成对差分替代独立critic优化，实现了免调参、低计算成本的OPE模型选择，并具备误设下的理论保证；加权变体可在良好重叠条件下改善选择效果。

Abstract: Model selection and hyperparameter tuning pose a central challenge in off-policy evaluation (OPE) because errors of fitted Q-functions and occupancy-ratio estimates cannot be directly evaluated from held-out transitions. Bellman-residual and minimax validation methods often require auxiliary regressions or optimization over separate critic classes, adding computational and tuning costs. We introduce pairwise Bellman validation (PBV), a tuning-free minimax procedure for selecting among finite classes of fitted Q-functions and occupancy-ratio estimators using held-out transitions. PBV constructs critics from pairwise candidate differences, requiring only finitely many empirical moment calculations without auxiliary validation models or separate critic optimization. We establish finite-sample oracle inequalities relative to the best available candidate, even under candidate-class misspecification. Our key insight is that Q-function errors and log ratios between candidate and true occupancy ratios provide oracle critics whose Bellman and adjoint Bellman moments control estimation error. Pairwise candidate differences approximate these unknown critics, while penalties account for comparator approximation error. For Q-function selection, we first develop unweighted PBV, which evaluates pairwise Bellman moments under the offline distribution and admits oracle guarantees under a pairwise coercivity condition relating the offline distribution to the target-policy dynamics. We then develop target-aligned PBV (TA-PBV), which uses marginalized importance weighting to provide error control without pairwise coercivity. For occupancy-ratio selection, we develop adjoint PBV (A-PBV), which evaluates adjoint Bellman moments against log-ratio critics. On Hopper and Deep OPE, unweighted PBV performs competitively, while target-occupancy weighting can improve performance in settings with controlled overlap.

</details>


### [1406] [Provably Efficient Q-learning for Robust Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35656v1)
*Yuchen Jiao,Gen Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模型无关的异步 Q-learning 算法用于基于鲁棒 MDP（总变差不确定集）的鲁棒强化学习，在马尔可夫采样下给出近极小极大最优的样本复杂度界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 MDP 强化学习易受 sim-to-real 差距影响，分布鲁棒 RL（基于 RMDP）可保证不可预测环境下的可靠性，但现有文献缺乏高效的模型无关方法，尤其缺乏面向实际更相关的马尔可夫数据的算法。

Method: 考虑 γ-折扣无限时域 RMDP，状态空间 S、动作空间 A，不确定集由总变差距离刻画、不确定度为 σ。仅访问由行为策略诱导的单条马尔可夫样本轨迹及名义转移核，提出异步 Q-learning（模型无关）算法，并分析其收敛性与样本复杂度。

Result: 达到最优 Q 函数逐元素 ε-近似的样本复杂度（忽略对数因子）上界为 1/[μ_min ε² (1-γ)³ max{1-γ, σ}] + t_mix/[μ_min (1-γ)]，其中 t_mix 为混合时间、μ_min 为最小状态-动作占用概率。该结果近极小极大最优，仅多出 1/(1-γ) 因子，且显著优于已有界。

Conclusion: 该工作为鲁棒 RL 提供了首个高效的模型无关、面向马尔可夫数据的算法，样本复杂度近最优，推动了鲁棒 RL 在实际场景中的可用性。

Abstract: Standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms based on Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are vulnerable to sim-to-real gaps. To address this issue, distributionally robust RL algorithms based on robust MDPs (RMDPs) have been proposed, for ensuring that agents can perform reliably to unpredictable conditions in real-world environments. Despite of the rich literature, \revision{an efficient model-free method is still lacking} for robust RL, particularly for Markovian data, which is more relevant in practical applications. In this work, we take a step towards settling this problem by proposing a sample efficient (asynchronous Q-learning) algorithm for robust RL. In particular, consider a $γ$-discounted infinite-horizon RMDP with state space $\mathcal{S}$ and action space $\mathcal{A}$, where the uncertainty set is specified by the total variation (TV) distance with uncertainty level $σ$. Assuming access to a single trajectory of Markovian samples induced by a behavior policy and the nominal transition kernel, the sample complexity of the proposed Q-learning algorithm --- to achieve an entrywise $\varepsilon$-approximation of the optimal Q-function --- is bounded by $$ \frac{1}{μ_{\mathsf{min}}\varepsilon^2(1-γ)^3\max\{1-γ,σ\}} + \frac{t_{\mathsf{mix}}}{μ_{\mathsf{min}}(1-γ)} $$ up to logarithmic factors. Here, $t_{\mathsf{mix}}$ and $μ_{\mathsf{min}}$ denote the mixing time and the minimum state-action occupancy probability of the sample trajectory, respectively. This result is nearly minimax optimal, with an additional factor of $\frac{1}{1-γ}$. Moreover, it achieves a significant improvement over existing bounds.

</details>


### [1407] [Depth Improves Training-Time Scaling for Difficult Tasks in Deep Linear Networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35514v1)
*Taishi Watanabe,Ryo Karakida,Jun-nosuke Teramae*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 通过精化深线性网络分析，阐明任务谱决定网络深度何时改善训练时间缩放指数：困难任务中加深网络可提升渐近缩放指数，简单任务中指数与深度无关；并以预测器范数重参数化时间，得到指数与深度无关的统一缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放律中指数由数据分布与学习任务结构决定，但网络深度能否改善训练时间缩放律尚无定论，本文旨在解决这一未决问题。

Method: 对深线性网络进行更精细的理论分析，按任务谱（谱难度）划分任务类型并推导渐近训练时间缩放指数；提出由预测器范数控制的时间重参数化，统一刻画不同任务难度下的动力学；并在基于基准图像数据构造的任务及非线性网络上开展数值实验验证。

Result: 谱困难任务中，增加深度可改善渐近训练时间缩放指数；谱简单任务中指数与深度无关，深度仅在两类区域的边界处影响对数修正项。在预测器范数重参数化下，损失遵循同一缩放律且其指数与深度无关。数值实验（基准图像衍生任务与非线性网络）定性复现了深度对训练时间缩放的依赖任务结构效应。

Conclusion: 任务结构（任务谱）决定了深度对训练时间缩放的影响方式，深化了对架构—任务相互作用的理论理解，并为研究更广泛神经网络类别的缩放行为提供了基础。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws describe the predictable power-law dependence of model performance on training time, dataset size, and model scale, with the exponents quantifying how performance changes with resources. Recent theory has shown how scaling exponents are shaped by the data distribution and the structure of the learning task, but whether network depth can improve training-time scaling has remained unsettled. Through a refined analysis of deep linear networks, we clarify that the task spectrum determines when increasing network depth improves training-time scaling. For spectrally difficult tasks, increasing depth improves the asymptotic training-time scaling exponent, whereas for easy tasks, the exponent remains independent of depth, with depth affecting only a logarithmic correction at the boundary between these regimes. Remarkably, we find that a reparameterization of time governed by the predictor norm provides a unified description of the dynamics across task difficulties. Under this reparameterization, the loss follows a common scaling law whose exponent is independent of depth. Numerical experiments on a task derived from benchmark image data and with nonlinear networks exhibit qualitatively consistent task-dependent effects of depth on training-time scaling. Our findings advance the theoretical understanding of how task structure shapes the effects of network architecture on learning and offer a basis for studying scaling behavior across broader classes of neural networks.

</details>


### [1408] [A knowledge-driven nonconvex square-root regularization framework for joint group sparsity and structured smoothness](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35428v1)
*Wanling Xie,Hu Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出NS$^3$R方法，将无σ的平方根损失与联合非凸ℓ_{2,q}罚项统一，同时编码组稀疏与结构化平滑先验，并给出非渐近误差界与高效DS-IRLS-th算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化正则方法多基于平方损失与凸罚项，难以联合建模"预定义组结构"与"分段平滑"两类互补先验；平方损失导致最优调参对未知噪声水平σ敏感，凸罚项则带来估计偏差与大系数过收缩问题。

Method: 构建NS$^3$R：以平方根损失（σ-free）结合联合非凸ℓ_{2,q}罚（0<q<1）实现组稀疏与结构化平滑；在温和的(2,q)-group restricted compatibility条件下建立非渐近误差界；提出带阈值化的双筛选IRLS（DS-IRLS-th）算法，采用嵌套双筛选策略降低计算量、提升数值稳定性，并证明非凸优化的全局收敛性。

Result: 理论上获得NS$^3$R估计量的严格非渐近误差界；算法上具备可证的全局收敛性与更低的计算代价；合成数据与真实数据实验显示，在有限样本情形下NS$^3$R持续优于当前先进方法。

Conclusion: NS$^3$R将无σ的平方根损失与非凸ℓ_{2,q}罚有效结合，兼顾组稀疏与结构化平滑先验，在理论误差界、算法收敛性与有限样本实证表现上均有优势，为结构化稀疏学习提供了偏差更小、对噪声水平更稳健的统一框架。

Abstract: Structured sparse learning is a leading paradigm for high-dimensional data modeling, as it enables rigorous integration of domain-validated structural priors into the learning process. Among these priors, pre-defined grouped structure and piecewise smoothness are ubiquitous in real-world applications. However, most existing structured regularization methods are built on squared loss and convex penalties, rarely jointly model these two complementary structural priors, and suffer from two key limitations. Their optimal tuning parameters are sensitive to the unknown noise level $σ$ due to the squared loss. Meanwhile, convex penalties induce inherent estimation bias and severe over-shrinkage of large magnitudes. To address these issues, we propose a knowledge-driven Nonconvex Structured Smooth Adjustment for Square-Root Regularization (NS$^3$R), which unifies the $σ$-free square-root loss with a joint nonconvex $\ell_{2,q}$ penalty ($0 < q < 1$) to simultaneously encode group sparsity and structured smoothness priors. Theoretically, we establish rigorous non-asymptotic error bounds for the NS$^3$R estimator under a mild $(2,q)$-group restricted compatibility condition. Computationally, we develop an efficient double-screened IRLS with thresholding (DS-IRLS-th) algorithm, which adopts a nested double-screening strategy to reduce computational cost and improve numerical stability, with provable global convergence for the resulting nonconvex optimization problem. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that NS$^3$R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in finite-sample settings.

</details>


### [1409] [Beyond Wasserstein Proximity: Finding Better Transfer Sources](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35314v1)
*Gordei Verbii,Georgii Killinkarov,Vladimir Yafarov*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了一种"条件式"源选择准则：在选择预训练源时选取与目标域Wasserstein距离最远的源（而非最相似源），并在加密货币波动率预测任务上证明可显著提升迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统域适应与迁移学习普遍采用"相似性优先"的源选择策略（边际接近性），但边际接近并不必然对应最有用的预训练源。作者借助域适应理论与一个回归示例说明：更大的源变异虽增大Wasserstein距离，却能改善估计效果，因而需要一种条件性的源选择替代方案。

Method: 以十个Binance现货资产的五日加密货币波动率为任务，使用六类预测器族、三个随机种子及共享时间截断点。基于Gaussian-Wasserstein距离，对比"选取最近三源"与"选取最远三源"两种预训练源选择策略；并加入前瞻性试点（pilot）选择的排名机制，以及"最远优先几何筛选＋试点排名"的两阶段回顾性五候选筛选流程。评估指标为相对持续性基准的技能分数，并采用日期分块的配对区间、目标异质性、种子与时间块敏感性分析。

Result: 选择最远三个源而非最近三个源后，MLP的平均持续性相对技能提升12.52个百分点，Transformer提升20.90个百分点，且事后配对日期分块区间均为正。前瞻性试点选择在全部六个预测器族中均优于随机迁移。紧凑循环模型取得最低的绝对平均误差，表明"选择效用"与"预测质量"可相互分离。回顾性五候选筛选显示，在试点排名前加入最远优先几何筛选可为MLP与Transformer带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 研究区分了跨目标关联与目标内决策，说明边际最接近并非最优源选择准则，条件性（最远优先）选择可提升迁移技能。结论对固定历史面板属探索性，筛选分析并未测量运行时节省，需谨慎外推。

Abstract: Source selection often favors similar data, yet marginal proximity need not identify the most useful pretraining source. We motivate a conditional alternative through domain-adaptation theory and a regression example in which broader source variation improves estimation despite increasing Wasserstein distance. We examine five-day cryptocurrency volatility using ten Binance spot assets, six forecaster families, three seeds, and shared temporal cutoffs. Selecting the three farthest rather than nearest Gaussian-Wasserstein sources improves mean persistence-relative skill by 12.52 percentage points for MLP and 20.90 for Transformer, with positive post-hoc paired date-block intervals. Forward pilot selection improves mean skill over random transfer in all six families. Compact recurrent models achieve the lowest absolute mean errors, separating selection utility from forecasting quality. Retrospective five-candidate screening shows additional gains from farthest-first geometry before pilot ranking for MLP and Transformer. We distinguish across-target associations from within-target decisions and evaluate target heterogeneity, training seeds, and temporal-block sensitivity. Findings are exploratory for a fixed historical panel; the screening analysis measures no runtime saving.

</details>


### [1410] [Temporal-Difference Calibration of Black-Box Simulators](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35311v1)
*Min Zeng,Xin Wen,Xi Chen,Yichen Zhang,Wen-Xin Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出无导数时序差分（TD）框架用于黑盒模拟器校准，基于随机方向有限差分设计三种TD算法，建立收敛性、均方误差界与CLT，并揭示"规格依赖偏差"现象与在线自助法推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒模拟器校准中梯度不可得、仅能进行随机方向函数查询，且模拟器生成的价值估计带有噪声；需要在正确设定下恢复物理参数、在误设下仍近似最优。

Method: 以Bellman正交性定义校准参数；基于随机方向有限差分构建三种TD估计方程算法（查询成本与噪声复用方式不同）；分析涵盖四种查询噪声机制下的几乎必然收敛、末次迭代均方误差界、Polyak-Ruppert平均的CLT；并提出少重复在线自助法及一个两阶段TD递推。

Result: 正确设定下有限差分偏差在目标处消失（即使梯度代理有偏），允许固定扰动半径并使指数逼近1/2；误设下退化为经典Kiefer-Wolfowitz速率。在线自助法在可忽略噪声下给出Student-t校准区间，并识别出沿Markov轨迹导致传统乘子推断失效的协方差失配。

Conclusion: 该框架在无需导数的情况下实现黑盒模拟器校准与有效统计推断；第二阶段TD递推无需额外模拟查询即可修正残余价值差异。

Abstract: We develop a derivative-free temporal-difference (TD) framework for calibrating black-box simulators using one-step transitions from a target system and noisy simulator-generated continuation values. The calibration parameter is defined through Bellman orthogonality, recovering the physical parameter under correct simulator specification and yielding a near-optimal $L_2$ approximation of the policy value under misspecification. We propose three TD algorithms based on random-direction finite differences, distinguished by their query costs and reuse of noisy simulator evaluations. We establish almost-sure convergence, last-iterate mean-square error bounds, and central limit theorems for Polyak-Ruppert averages across four query-noise regimes. Our analysis reveals a specification-dependent bias phenomenon: for two algorithms, the finite-difference bias of the TD estimating equation vanishes at the calibration target under correct specification, even when the gradient surrogate remains biased. This permits a fixed perturbation radius and rate exponents approaching $1/2$ in the simulator rollout budget, whereas misspecification generally recovers the classical Kiefer-Wolfowitz rates. We also develop a few-replicate online bootstrap that yields Student-$t$ calibrated confidence intervals under negligible query noise, and identify a covariance mismatch that can invalidate conventional multiplier inference along Markov trajectories. Finally, a second-stage TD recursion corrects the remaining value discrepancy without additional simulator queries.

</details>


### [1411] [Identities, Not Pairs: Distribution-Free False-Accept Control for Embedding-Based Verification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35277v1)
*Salim Khazem*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出COVE：将试验对在增广后的全部 N=C(m+2,2) 对中排序进行验证判决，边缘FAR可控制在 floor(αN)/N，首次可能接受阈值为 O(1/m^2)，突破校准-only阈值在hub身份下的最坏情形下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于嵌入的验证通常用 m 个身份间全部冒名对来校准误接受阈值，但这些对彼此共享身份（非独立），且当存在与大量人群高分相似的“hub身份”时，校准-only阈值存在最坏情形限制：在边际FAR≤α的约束下，对无hub校准集很难在高分处接受。需要试验信息才能在该分数附近稳定接受。

Method: 理论上刻画最坏情形界限：若hub身份对比例ρ的人群给出高分，则任何在身份可交换律下边际FAR≤α的校准-only阈值，在无hub校准集上以至少 (m+2)α/(2ρ) 的概率达到hub分数。据此提出COVE：把校准单元与probe、reference增广，将试验对在全部 N=C(m+2,2) 对中排序，按秩裁定接受；在身份可交换性下边际FAR≤floor(αN)/N；并用独立cohort的固定对称cohort归一化分数保持该保证。实验用6个基准、8个冻结编码器验证。

Result: 6个基准8个冻结编码器上实测FAR与精确界一致。在两个有效的校准-only基线均无法接受任何样本的情形下，COVE在可靠比较中保留了采样oracle真实接受率的中位100%。对比：依赖对上的经验分位数FAR达2.87α；对配对使用二项上置信界的方法在多达55%的校准抽样中未达其名义95%条件FAR目标。对称CSLS在测试设置中将COVE的真实接受率最高提升4.3倍。

Conclusion: 校准-only阈值在hub结构下存在固有的最坏情形脆弱性，必须引入试验信息；COVE通过全局配对基数的秩检验给出精确可证的边际FAR保证，并在实践中兼顾高真实接受率，配合对称CSLS可进一步显著提升性能。

Abstract: Embedding-based verification often calibrates a false-accept threshold from all impostor pairs among $m$ identities, although these pairs share identities. We characterize a worst-case limit: when hub identities score highly against a fraction $ρ$ of the population, a calibration-only threshold with marginal false-accept rate (FAR) at most $α$ under every identity-exchangeable law reaches the hub score on hub-free calibration sets with probability at most $(m+2)α/(2ρ)$. Uniformly accepting near that score at levels well below $ρ/m$ therefore requires trial information. We propose COVE, which ranks the trial pair among all $N=\binom{m+2}{2}$ pairs formed by augmenting the calibration units with the probe and reference. Under identity exchangeability, its marginal FAR is at most $\lfloorαN\rfloor/N$, with first possible acceptance at $1/N=O(1/m^2)$. The rule also retains this guarantee with a fixed symmetric cohort-normalized score using an independent cohort. On 6 benchmarks and 8 frozen encoders, realised FAR was consistent with the exact bound. Where both valid calibration-only baselines accepted nothing, COVE retained a median $100\%$ of the sampled oracle's true-accept rate over reliable comparisons. In contrast, an empirical quantile over dependent pairs reached 2.87$\,α$ FAR, and a binomial upper confidence bound over pairs missed its nominal 95\% conditional-FAR target in up to 55\% of calibration draws. Symmetric CSLS raised COVE's true-accept rate by up to 4.3-fold in the tested settings. The code is available in https://github.com/salimkhazem/Cove.git

</details>


### [1412] [Sequential versus fully conditional specification for tree-based synthesis of health data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35163v1)
*R{é}my Chapelle,Mohammed Sedki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文比较两种基于条件分布树模型的合成数据生成范式（顺序指定与全条件指定），在医疗数据上评估其风险-效用权衡，发现二者无普遍优劣：顺序法对变量顺序敏感，全条件法超参数更多、计算成本更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗等领域推广合成数据以兼顾隐私与开放科学，需要快速、灵活的合成流程；基于决策树诱导的条件分布的模型是常用手段，但将这些模型组合为合成分布存在顺序指定与全条件指定两条路径，目前缺乏关于哪种指定能更好优化风险-效用权衡的指导意见。

Method: 使用两种指定方式（顺序指定与全条件指定），将基于树的条件分布模型组合起来合成医疗数据集，并用多项风险指标与效用指标评估所生成合成数据的质量。

Result: 结果显示两种指定方式之间不存在普遍的优势；顺序合成对变量排序较为敏感，而全条件指定涉及更多超参数并带来更高的计算开销。

Conclusion: 无法给出统一的指定方式推荐；顺序法的敏感性与全条件法的高超参数与高成本，可能限制其作为即插即用合成流程的适用性。

Abstract: Disseminating synthetic data in place of original ones is a promising way to enforce privacy while complying with open science principles, especially in the healthcare domain. To keep pace with the rate at which researchers collect such data, there is a need for fast and flexible synthesis procedures. A popular class of such procedures is based on models of conditional distributions induced by decision trees. Such models can be combined into a synthetic distribution following two main approaches: sequential specification and fully conditional specification. However, there is currently no recommendation on which specification to use to optimize the risk-utility tradeoffs. In this work, we use both specifications to synthesize medical datasets by combining tree-based models of conditional distributions. We compare the quality of the resulting synthetic data using several metrics of risk and utility. Our results indicate no general superiority of either specification over the other. Sequential synthesis seems sensitive to the ordering of the variables, while the fully conditional specification involves more hyperparameters and incurs higher computational costs, which may limit its suitability for off-the-shelf synthesis procedures.

</details>


### [1413] [Macro Mondrian Conformal Risk Control](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35035v1)
*Julien Combes,Jean-Francois Coeurjolly,Alexandre Dervill{é}*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Mondrian保形与宏平均思想的风险控制方法，在用户定义的分组上控制平均风险，仅需一个分类taxonomy并对每个点的风险按组概率重加权，使稀有样本贡献更大，从而缓解不平衡分布下CRC仅保证边际风险控制的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CRC（Conformal Risk Control）将保形预测扩展到一般单调损失函数的控制，具备无分布假设、模型无关的优点，适用于语义分割等高维输出任务。但CRC只提供边际（marginal）保证，即风险仅在数据分布上平均受控；在分布不平衡时，包含稀有物体的输入其风险可能仍不受控，即便边际保证成立。

Method: 借鉴Mondrian保形预测与宏覆盖率（macro-coverage）算法，引入一个taxonomy函数为每个数据点分配组标签，并按该点所属组的概率对单点风险进行系数重加权，使稀有组样本贡献更大；据此在用户定义的分组上实现平均风险控制。

Result: 在两个语义分割数据集上验证了该方法的有效性，说明其能在分组层面实现风险控制，弥补边际控制的不足。

Conclusion: 通过在用户定义分组上施加平均风险控制并对组概率重加权，可在不平衡分布下避免稀有类风险失控，是对CRC的有益补充；方法具有无分布、模型无关特性，适用于高维结构化预测任务。

Abstract: Conformal Risk Control (CRC) extends conformal prediction beyond the coverage setting to the control of general monotone loss functions, in a distribution-free and modelagnostic fashion. This makes it well-suited to problems with high-dimensional targets, such as the semantic segmentation task addressed in this work. However, CRC guarantees only marginal control, meaning that the risk is controlled on average over the data distribution. Under imbalanced distributions, the risk on inputs that contain rare objects may therefore remain uncontrolled, even when the marginal guarantee holds. We propose a new method that controls the risk on average over user-defined groups of the domain, drawing on Mondrian conformal prediction and macro-coverage algorithms. The method relies on a taxonomy, that is, a function that assigns a group to each data point, and reweights each point's risk by a coefficient that depends on its group probability, so that rare points contribute more than common ones. We illustrate the approach on two semantic segmentation datasets.

</details>


### [1414] [The Noise-Transmission Burden of Diffusion Network: Why Image Prediction Can Outperform Noise Prediction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34834v1)
*Gyeonghun Kang,Pengxi Liu,Bingshuo Qian,Xiang Cheng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文从去噪（denoising）视角解释扩散模型中"干净图像预测（x-prediction）"与"噪声预测（ε-prediction）"在有限网络中表现差异的根源，提出"噪声传输负担"概念，并给出输入瓶颈导致的去噪误差下界及预条件处理对该下界的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 干净图像预测与噪声预测在总体最优意义下等价，但在有限容量网络中表现截然不同，且实际生成质量存在差距。作者希望给出一个基于去噪误差的理论解释，统一说明预测目标、预条件选择与模型宽度这些因素如何影响生成质量。

Method: 1) 指出噪声预测器 $f_{\varepsilon,t}$ 诱导的干净图像估计为 $\widehat X_1=Y_t-\sigma_t f_{\varepsilon,t}(Y_t)$，从而揭示"噪声传输负担"：预测器必须保留用于抵消输入损坏的信息。2) 在高斯损坏的 $d$ 维数据下，分析秩为 $r<d$ 的线性输入瓶颈带来的去噪误差下界 $\sigma_t^2(d-r)$，并与图像预测的有界最优风险对比。3) 分析 EDM 预条件在高噪声时衰减该瓶颈贡献、精确预条件在各噪声水平下完全抵消该贡献。4) 在无输入瓶颈时，假设模型表示可精确仿射恢复含噪 patch，刻画超出线性去噪的修正项的协方差谱如何决定所需模型宽度。5) 在 ImageNet 上用 JiT 进行实验验证。

Result: 理论刻画显示：线性输入瓶颈下噪声预测存在下界 $\sigma_t^2(d-r)$，而图像预测最优风险有界；EDM 预条件可衰减该贡献，精确预条件可完全抵消。无瓶颈情形下给出由修正项协方差谱决定的所需宽度刻画。ImageNet 上 JiT 实验测得去噪损失与预测的瓶颈下界及其经预条件的衰减/抵消一致；进一步加宽模型在低噪声处带来更大的相对去噪增益，此时超出线性去噪的修正分散在更多方向上，与谱刻画一致。

Conclusion: 论文提供了一个基于去噪的、统一的解释框架，说明预测目标、预条件选择与模型宽度三方面如何在实践层面造成生成质量差距，为扩散模型目标函数与架构设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: Clean-image prediction ($x$-prediction) and noise prediction yield equivalent population-optimal denoisers, yet can perform very differently in finite diffusion networks. For noisy input $Y_t$ with noise standard deviation $σ_t$, a noise predictor $f_{\varepsilon,t}$ induces the clean-image estimate $\widehat X_1=Y_t-σ_t f_{\varepsilon,t}(Y_t)$. This reveals a noise-transmission burden: the predictor must preserve information needed to cancel the input corruption. Under Gaussian corruption of $d$-dimensional data, a linear input bottleneck of rank $r<d$ imposes a denoising-error floor $σ_t^2(d-r)$ even with unrestricted downstream computation, while the corresponding optimal risk for image prediction remains bounded. EDM attenuates this bottleneck contribution at high noise; exact preconditioning cancels it at every noise level. Without an input bottleneck, assuming exact affine recovery of the noisy patch from the model representation, we characterize how the covariance spectrum of corrections beyond linear denoising determines the width required above the patch dimension. ImageNet experiments with JiT show that measured denoising losses reflect the predicted bottleneck floor and its attenuation or cancellation through preconditioning. Further widening yields larger relative denoising gains at low noise, where corrections beyond linear denoising spread across more directions, consistent with our spectral characterization of the required model width. Together, these results provide a denoising-based account of practical generation-quality gaps across prediction targets, preconditioning choices, and model widths.

</details>


### [1415] [Intrinsic Information Rates of Summaries in Simulation-Based Inference](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34703v1)
*Vansh Bansal,Pradip Sharma Poudel,James G. Scott*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文将模拟推断中的摘要 S 建模为 Y→S 的有损信道，用互信息 I(Y;S) 显式刻画"信息预算"，证明该预算随后验收紧而无界增长，并证明有限预算下随机摘要在失真上严格优于任何确定性摘要（含其时间共享混合），进而在神经后验估计器中插入二元瓶颈、在等码率下比较，实验支持该结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模拟的推断通常把观测 Y 压缩为固定维摘要 S，后验仅条件于 S。精确保持后验往往需要无限信息，因此任何摘要都隐含一个有限的信息预算，但该预算很少被显式选择或度量，也缺乏对其规模与最优分配方式的理论认识。

Method: 1) 将摘要视为 Y 到 S 的有损信道，以互信息 I(Y;S) 作为信息预算的度量。2) 对参数模型证明：即使存在固定维充分统计量，随后验集中所需预算也无界增长；一般情形下所需预算由随机后验的分布决定，上界通过对后验量化得到，下界通过以后验状态概率加权的逆定理（converse）给出。3) 在模拟器满足共同支撑条件（覆盖典型连续观测空间）下，证明任何确定性摘要必然有损失，随机摘要在每个小于精确保持所需的正预算处，严格取得比所有确定性摘要及确定性摘要的时间共享混合更低的失真。4) 在神经后验估计器中加入二元瓶颈，测量各训练摘要的码率，并在匹配码率下比较不同编码器族。

Result: 理论结果：(a) 参数模型中所需预算 I(Y;S) 随后验收紧无界增长；(b) 给出基于后验量化的上界与后验概率加权的逆定理下界；(c) 有限预算下随机摘要失真严格优于确定性摘要及其时间共享混合。实验：在四个模拟器基准与多种编码器族上，随机瓶颈取得更优的码率—损失权衡；且不同信息预算下，编码器架构的排序会发生改变。

Conclusion: 摘要的信息预算应被显式建模与测量；预算规模由后验分布决定并随精度需求无界增长；有限预算应以随机方式分配。因此在神经后验估计中引入随机（二元）瓶颈、按码率对齐比较更为合理，且架构选择应随信息预算而变化。

Abstract: Simulation-based inference often encodes observations $Y$ into a fixed-dimensional summary $S$, with the posterior conditioning only on $S$. While exact preservation often requires infinite information, any such summary imposes a finite information budget on inference which is rarely an explicit choice or measurement. In this paper, we make the budget explicit by modeling the summary as a lossy channel from $Y$ to $S$, and ask two questions: how large must the budget be, and how best is it spent? First, we show for parametric models that this budget, measured by the mutual information $I(Y;S)$, grows unboundedly as the posterior concentrates, even when fixed-dimensional sufficient statistics exist. More generally, the required budget is set by the distribution of the random posterior, and we bound it from above by quantizing posteriors and from below by converses that weight each posterior state by its probability. Second, we show that a finite budget is best spent stochastically. Under a common-support condition on the simulator, covering the continuous observation spaces typical of simulators, a deterministic summary necessarily loses something: a stochastic summary achieves \emph{strictly} lower distortion than every deterministic summary and every time-shared mixture of deterministic summaries at every positive budget too small for exact preservation. Motivated by these results, we insert a binary bottleneck into neural posterior estimators, measure each trained summary's rate, and compare summaries at matched rate. Across four simulator benchmarks and several encoder families, stochastic bottlenecks achieve favorable rate--loss tradeoffs, and architecture rankings change at different information budgets.

</details>


### [1416] [How Much Graph Is Too Much? Graph Construction and Exposure in Spatio-Temporal Forecasting](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34611v1)
*Saj Maru,Qiyu Han,Krishna Mamidala*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了时空图神经网络中"图构建"与"图信息注入方式"两类设计选择对预测精度的影响，发现在统一的变点预测协议下，同一领域图在不同集成方式下可能改善或恶化误差，联合评估二者是必要的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空图神经网络的核心假设是图邻居能提供超越节点自身历史的信息，但预测精度同时取决于邻居选择（图构建）与图消息进入时序模型的方式（图暴露），现有工作往往将二者割裂评估，难以判断图的真实增益。

Method: 在美国州级失业率、交通速度和电力需求三个数据集上开展诊断式实验，采用两组对照：（1）固定领域图、改变暴露方式；（2）固定后期门控集成、改变图构建。以仅使用节点自身历史的GRU及随机化图作为控制基线，并在统一的变点预测协议下比较。

Result: 同一领域图在不同集成设计下相较GRU可使误差改善或恶化；仅采用后期集成不足，加入融合门后在三个任务上均取得更低的平均误差；在固定后期门控集成时，基于残差相关性的图在测试图中平均误差最低，但在失业率任务上随机化图表现相近。

Conclusion: 图构建与集成方式应联合评估，研究结论须与实际执行的对照实验相对应；融合门控是图信息有效利用的关键组件，而图结构的优势并非普遍稳健。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal graph neural networks combine a node's history with information from graph neighbors. The central question is whether graph neighbors provide predictive information beyond each node's own history. Forecast accuracy depends on both the choice of neighbors and the way graph messages enter the temporal model. We study these choices as graph construction and graph exposure on U.S. state unemployment, traffic speed, and electricity demand. Our diagnostic design uses two comparisons: varying exposure while holding the domain graph fixed, and varying construction while holding late gated integration fixed. A GRU using only each node's own history and randomized graph controls help assess what the graph contributes. Under a common change forecasting protocol, the same domain graph can improve or worsen error relative to the GRU across integration designs. Late integration alone is insufficient, while adding a fusion gate yields lower mean error in all three tasks. With late gated integration fixed, a graph based on residual correlations has the lowest mean error among the tested graphs, although randomized graphs perform similarly on unemployment. The findings support evaluating graph construction and integration together, with conclusions tied to the comparisons actually performed.

</details>


### [1417] [HIFI: A Highly Efficient Framework for Statistical Inference with Foundation Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34550v1)
*Po-Wei Chen,Shan Yu,Chunlin Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出两阶段微调框架 HIFI，将基础模型适配与重采样统计推断解耦，实现可扩展的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对缺乏可解析采样分布的神经估计器，重采样推断需数百次模型拟合，在基础模型规模下计算代价过高。

Method: Stage 1 在大样本上一次性适配基础模型以捕捉数据结构并控制偏差；Stage 2 在较小的独立样本上对残差并行拟合多个轻量 PEFT 估计器，执行重采样推断（集成子采样、非参数 bootstrap）。

Result: 在视觉与文本实验中覆盖数千万至百亿参数以上模型，点估计准确、置信区间校准良好，训练计算量较直接重采样最多降低 91.9%。

Conclusion: HIFI 为大规模基础模型提供可行的不确定性感知统计推断，并在基因表达推断中展示实际价值。

Abstract: Foundation models provide powerful representations for unstructured data, such as text and images, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) makes their adaptation to downstream tasks increasingly practical. For neural estimators that lack a tractable sampling distribution, resampling-based procedures offer a flexible route to statistical inference, but they often require hundreds of model fits, making them computationally prohibitive at foundation-model scale. We introduce HIFI, a two-stage fine-tuning framework for statistical inference on parameters such as conditional means. Stage 1 adapts a foundation model once on a larger sample, capturing the complex structure of the data and controlling estimation bias through a single fit. Stage 2 applies a resampling inference procedure to a smaller independent sample, concurrently fitting multiple lightweight PEFT estimators to the residual to quantify estimation variability without relearning the full task. HIFI accommodates a broad class of resampling procedures, including ensemble subsampling and the nonparametric bootstrap. Across vision and text experiments, HIFI scales to pretrained models ranging from tens of millions to more than ten billion parameters while providing accurate point estimates and well-calibrated confidence intervals across diverse architectures, and reduces training compute by up to 91.9% relative to direct resampling. An application to gene-expression inference illustrates the practical value of the framework for uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

</details>


### [1418] [Joint Independence Testing for Latent Position Random Graphs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34544v1)
*Xiaoyi Wen,Zoltan Szabo*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文提出图希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（GHSIC），用于度量 M≥2 个潜在位置随机图（LPRG）之间的独立性，并基于邻接矩阵谱分解给出收敛率为 Õ(n^{-1/3}) 的可估计算法，且无需选择核函数及其超参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核方法中 RKHS 能无损编码概率分布、刻画 M≥2 个随机变量的联合独立性，但现有度量依赖显式可观测的 Gram 矩阵并以 O(n^{-1/2}) 收敛。LPRG 中节点相似性由隐表示经核决定，Gram 矩阵只能隐式观测，估计困难；且现有方法仅限 M=2 且只保证一致性、无收敛率，因而亟需针对 M≥2 的 LPRG 独立性度量。

Method: 定义 GHSIC 作为 M≥2 个 LPRG 的独立性度量；利用邻接矩阵的谱分解构造隐式 Gram 矩阵的估计，从而给出 GHSIC 的估计量，且方法无需人工选择核函数与超参数。

Result: 理论上证明 GHSIC 估计量达到 Õ(n^{-1/3}) 的收敛率（n 为样本量）；数值实验在合成数据以及自然语言感知任务中脑功能连接子网络的分析上均验证了估计量的有效性。

Conclusion: GHSIC 将核独立性度量从显式 Gram 矩阵推广到隐式可观测的 LPRG 场景，覆盖 M≥2 的多元情形并给出显式收敛率，同时免去核与超参数调优，为 LPRG 独立性检验提供了可行且有效的工具。

Abstract: Kernel techniques are among the most powerful methods in data science and statistics.
