One of the key properties of kernels contributing to their numerous successful applications is that the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space is expressive enough to encode probability distributions without loss of information or to capture the joint independence of $M\ge 2$ random variables, under mild conditions. Computationally, these measures (i) rely on the so-called Gram matrix which contains the pairwise similarity of sample points, and (ii) converge at a rate $O \left(n^{-\frac{1}{2}}\right)$, where $n$ denotes the sample size. We focus on measuring the independence of latent position random graphs (LPRGs), a model widely-applied for instance in neuroscience, sociology, and epidemiology. In LPRGs a latent representation is associated to each node. The similarity of these representations (meant via a kernel) determines whether two nodes are connected, making the Gram matrices only implicitly observable and the estimation challenging. Despite the fundamental importance of quantifying the independence of $M$ LPRGs, very little is known about the solution of this problem; existing techniques are restricted to $M=2$ components and only guarantee consistency without rates. In this work, (i) we define an independence measure called graph Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion (GHSIC) for $M\ge 2$ LPRGs, (ii) we prove that it can be estimated at a rate $\tilde{O}\left(n^{-\frac{1}{3}}\right)$ relying on spectral decomposition of adjacency matrices, (iii) without the need to choose kernels and their hyperparameters. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GHSIC estimator both on synthetic examples and in the analysis of brain functional connectivity subnetworks in natural language perception.

</details>


### [1419] [Certifying Distributionally Robust Decisions from Projection Observations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34493v1)
*Pouya Ahadi,Kamran Paynabar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究有限高斯投影实验中不可辨识矩模型下的稳健决策问题，给出返回决策或"未决"结果的置信集证书，并证明其可靠性、不可辨识时的必要弃权以及固定检查点的认证保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量测量无法识别潜在协方差或每一项决策风险，但人们仍希望据此做出稳健决策；需要刻画观测律所定义的不可区分矩模型集合，并说明在何种条件下决策可被认证。

Method: 设定固定均值加标准差目标的有限高斯投影实验；以观测律定义不可区分矩模型集合；构造在集合内一致成立的决策并给出置信集证书（决策或未决）；用标量profile把非线性风险比较化为凸内层问题；用合成实例与显式期望样本信息下界及单独测量的停止时间作比较。

Result: 证明了证书的可靠性、对互不相容最优值的不可辨识模型必须弃权、以及固定检查点的认证保证；七个合成实例中联合校准的矩区域给出的充分预算为显式期望样本信息下界的21至52倍；单独测量的停止时间更低，1,900条模拟流中决策错误为零。

Conclusion: 在不可识别风险下可实现经认证的稳健决策，但代价是倍数偏高的样本预算与必要弃权；所给比较并非匹配下界，且保证依赖高斯重复假设，推广需谨慎。

Abstract: A scalar measurement can determine a robust decision without identifying the latent covariance or every decision risk. We study finite Gaussian projection experiments with a fixed mean-plus-standard-deviation target. The observation laws define a set of indistinguishable moment models. We exhibit decisions that agree throughout that set despite unidentified risk values, and give a confidence-set certificate that returns a decision or an unresolved outcome. We prove soundness, necessary abstention for indistinguishable models with incompatible optima, and a fixed-checkpoint certification guarantee. A scalar profile reduces nonlinear risk comparisons to convex inner problems. Across seven synthetic instances, jointly calibrated moment regions give sufficient budgets 21 to 52 times explicit expected-sample information lower bounds. Separately measured stopping times are lower, with zero decision errors in 1,900 simulated streams. These comparisons do not constitute matching bounds, and the guarantees require Gaussian replication.

</details>


### [1420] [Intrinsic Gradient Barriers in Pushforward Deep Generative Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34484v1)
*Edric Tam,Qingyang Liu,Barbara Engelhardt,Ray Bai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文从传输问题本身出发，证明从log-concave源分布到重尾或多峰目标分布的pushforward映射在梯度与Jacobian上存在定量下界，说明深度生成模型的困难源于内在几何而非网络架构或训练方法，并提出双射重参数化来缓解梯度负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成模型（DGMs）通常学习将简单源分布（如标准高斯）映射到复杂高维目标分布，但经验上难以准确刻画重尾分布与分离良好的多峰分布。作者希望说明这种困难并非源于特定神经网络架构或训练流程，而是传输问题本身的内在性质。

Method: 建立将log-concave源分布传输到目标分布的pushforward映射的梯度与Jacobian的定量下界：对重尾目标，所需梯度幅值随目标矩的增大而增长；对多峰目标，分离模态间的低概率区域同样强制传输映射产生大梯度。分析在较以往更弱的正则条件下成立，并对目标分布扰动保持稳定；同时讨论大导数与表达力—数值稳定性权衡的关系。进而提出简单的双射重参数化类别，以缓解几何结构难度、降低学习生成映射的梯度负担。

Result: 证明重尾与多峰目标的传输映射必然具有大梯度/Jacobian，且下界在更弱正则条件下成立、对目标分布扰动稳定；大导数对应表达力与数值稳定性的权衡。双射重参数化可减轻梯度负担，数值实验支持理论分析。

Conclusion: DGMs对重尾与多峰分布的建模困难是传输问题内在的几何障碍，而非架构或训练缺陷；当目标为近似给定密度而非生成建模时，可通过简单双射重参数化缓解该障碍。

Abstract: Broad classes of deep generative models (DGMs) operate by learning to map a simple source distribution, such as a standard Gaussian, to a complex high-dimensional target distribution. Despite their success, DGMs often empirically struggle to accurately represent distributions with heavy tails or well-separated modes. In this work, we show that these difficulties reflect intrinsic properties of the underlying transport problem rather than particular neural network architectures or training procedures. We establish quantitative lower bounds on the gradients and Jacobians of pushforward mappings that transport log-concave source distributions to such targets. For heavy-tailed target distributions, the required gradient magnitude grows as the target develops increasingly large moments. For multimodal target distributions, the low-probability regions between well-separated modes similarly force large gradients in the transport map. We discuss how such large derivatives relate to trade-offs between expressivity and numerical stability. Our results hold under substantially weaker regularity conditions than previous analyses and remain stable under perturbations of the target distribution. Finally, we show that these obstructions can be mitigated when the goal is approximation of a given density rather than generative modeling. Specifically, we propose simple classes of bijective reparametrizations that can alleviate the difficult geometric structure and reduce the gradient burden placed on the learned generative map. Numerical experiments support our theoretical analysis.

</details>


### [1421] [MetaARIMA: Configuration-Level Transfer Learning for ARIMA Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34171v1)
*Vitor Cerqueira,Ricardo Inácio,Carlos Soares*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 MetaARIMA：一种基于元学习预训练的 ARIMA 配置策略，将迁移学习引入经典统计预测的"配置层面"，从历史实验中学习哪些 ARIMA 配置能达到分位数前列表现，并在新序列上推荐候选配置，兼顾可解释性与局部估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型已证明在多样数据上预训练可有效迁移到新预测任务；而 ARIMA 等经典方法仍对每条序列独立配置与训练，无法积累以往实验知识。加之 ARIMA 配置选择困难，通常依赖基于样本内拟合优度的启发式规则，效率与效果都受限。

Method: MetaARIMA 学习一个配置策略，以历史实验为训练数据，识别出能达到 top-quantile 性能的 ARIMA 配置；推理阶段先用最大边际相关性（MMR）选出多样化的候选配置集合，再用连续减半（successive halving）高效确定最终配置，同时保留解释性与参数在本地估计的特点。

Result: 在迁移学习设定中（M4 训练，M1、M3、Tourism 评估），MetaARIMA 优于 AutoARIMA 及其他经典方法，且数据效率更高；与近期零样本基础模型对比时，MetaARIMA 与 Chronos2、Moirai2、TimesFM 保持竞争力。实验代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将元学习式的迁移引入经典统计模型的"配置层"是一条有效路径：可在保留 ARIMA 可解释性与局部估计优势的前提下显著提升配置选择效率与预测精度，并能与零样本基础模型相抗衡。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models have demonstrated that pretraining on diverse datasets enables effective transfer to new forecasting tasks. Classical methods like ARIMA, however, remain configured and trained independently for each series, discarding knowledge from previous experiments. Consequently, selecting and training an ARIMA configuration remains challenging and often relies on heuristic approaches based on in-sample goodnessof-fit measures. We propose MetaARIMA, a pretrained configuration policy based on metalearning that brings transfer learning to classical statistical forecasting at the configuration level rather than the model level. The policy learns from historical experiments which ARIMA configurations achieve top-quantile performance, and recommends promising candidates for new series while preserving interpretability and local estimation. At inference, it selects a diverse set of candidates via maximal marginal relevance and efficiently identifies the final configuration using successive halving. Experiments in a transfer learning setting, training on M4 and evaluating on M1, M3, and Tourism, show that MetaARIMA outperforms AutoARIMA and other classical methods while being more dataefficient. In a comparison with recent zero-shot foundation models, MetaARIMA remains competitive with Chronos2, Moirai2, and TimesFM. The experiments are publicly available at https://github.com/vcerqueira/experiments-metaarima.

</details>


### [1422] [Prior-Data Fitted Networks for In-Context Off-Policy Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34035v1)
*Shuguang Yu,Ting Li,Fan Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 InCOPE，一种基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的离线策略评估（OPE）方法，通过在合成的 OPE 任务先验上预训练共享的策略—价值预测规则，实现对新表格决策问题的免微调策略价值估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPE 在在线实验代价高或不安全时对部署前评估决策策略至关重要。但当行为策略数据有限、且目标策略偏向数据中极少观测到的状态与动作时，准确估计十分困难，现有方法难以应对。

Method: 构建覆盖马尔可夫决策过程与行为—目标策略对的 OPE 任务先验，采样生成行为策略数据集及精确的目标策略价值用于预训练；预训练 PFN 学习跨任务共享的策略—价值预测规则。面对新的表格决策问题，网络以行为策略数据集、目标策略及已知任务设置为上下文，无需任务特定参数更新即可直接预测策略期望回报。

Result: 在四个表格领域中开展实验，其中包括一个半合成临床场景，结果表明 InCOPE 在策略价值估计上具有有效性。

Conclusion: 将 OPE 建模为任务分布上的上下文内推断问题，借助 PFN 的跨任务先验知识，可在数据受限且存在分布偏移的条件下实现高效、无需在线交互的策略价值估计。

Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) is essential for assessing decision policies before deployment when online experimentation is costly or unsafe. Accurate estimation remains difficult when behavior-policy data are limited and the target policy favors states and actions rarely observed in those data. We propose InCOPE, a prior-data fitted network that learns a shared policy-value prediction rule across synthetic OPE tasks. We construct an OPE task prior over Markov decision processes and behavior-target policy pairs, generating behavior-policy datasets and exact target-policy values for pretraining. For a new tabular decision problem, the pretrained network uses the behavior-policy dataset, target policy, and known task settings as context to predict the policy's expected return without task-specific parameter updates. Experiments across four tabular domains, including a semi-synthetic clinical setting, demonstrate InCOPE's effectiveness for policy-value estimation.

</details>


### [1423] [Partial Modal Tensor Regression](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34008v1)
*Jintao Han,Li Zhang,Xuejun Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文提出部分众数张量回归（PMTR）：先构造部分众数张量协方差以引导张量降维，再在降维张量子空间上建立众数张量回归模型，并给出估计相合性与渐近性质及数据驱动的各模维度选择方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量数据广泛出现，需在保持张量内在结构的同时刻画张量预测子与响应关系。现有张量回归多聚焦条件均值或条件分位数；当响应分布非对称、重尾或受离群值污染时，条件众数提供稳健且可解释的替代刻画。

Method: 构造含条件众数信息的部分众数张量协方差，用于引导张量维数约简；随后在约简后的张量子空间中建立众数张量回归模型，避免直接向量化带来的维数负担并保留张量结构信息；采用数据驱动程序确定各张量模上的有效维数。

Result: 在适当正则条件下建立所提估计量的相合性与渐近性质；数据驱动的维数选择程序可确定各模的有效维数。

Conclusion: PMTR为张量预测提供了稳健的条件众数建模框架，兼顾降维效率与张量结构保持，并具备理论保证与可实现的维数选择方案。

Abstract: With the rapid development of modern scientific research, tensor data have become increasingly prevalent across a wide range of fields. How to effectively characterize the relationship between tensor predictors and a response while preserving the intrinsic structure of tensor data has therefore become an important problem in high-dimensional statistical analysis. Existing tensor regression methods mainly focus on conditional means or conditional quantiles. When the response distribution is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or contaminated by outlying observations, the conditional modal provides a robust and interpretable alternative characterization. In this paper, we propose a partial modal tensor regression (PMTR) method. The proposed method constructs the partial modal tensor covariance, which incorporates information on the conditional modal to guide tensor dimension reduction, and subsequently establishes a modal tensor regression model in the reduced tensor space. This strategy alleviates the dimensionality burden caused by direct vectorization while preserving the intrinsic structural information of tensor predictors. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish the consistency and asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators and employ a data-driven dimension-selection procedure to determine the effective dimension along each tensor mode.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [1424] [A Behavioral approach to Constrained Linear Quadratic Control: Feasibility and Optimality](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40542v1)
*Soutrik Bandyopadhyay,Debasattam Pal,Shubhendu Bhasin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该文在行为（behavioral）理论框架下建立受约束线性二次最优控制，用轨迹层面的核表示与行为不等式刻画系统与约束，借助二次微分形式与Gateaux微分导出行为版KKT条件，并给出全部最优约束轨迹的完整参数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典LQ最优控制依赖状态-输入表示，把约束当作输入/状态上的逐点不等式，难以在无限维轨迹空间中以统一、无坐标的方式处理；作者希望以轨迹为基本对象，构建更一般且可扩展（闭环、数据驱动）的受约束最优控制表述。

Method: 采用行为方法：系统动力学用核表示（kernel representation）建模，不等式约束用定义在无限维凸锥上的行为不等式刻画；用二次微分形式（QDF）编码性能指标，将受约束LQ问题转化为轨迹空间上的凸变分优化；通过Gateaux微分推导驻点条件与互补条件，并证明其可表示为增广行为系统，该系统唯一分解为自治子行为与可控子行为。

Result: 导出的驻点与互补条件构成KKT框架的行为对应物；增广行为系统的自治/可控唯一分解给出所有最优受约束轨迹的完整参数化；数值算例展示了不等式约束对最优行为的影响。

Conclusion: 该框架为受约束最优控制提供了通用的轨迹层面表示，能够无坐标地统一处理动力学与不等式约束，并为闭环控制与数据驱动扩展奠定基础。

Abstract: This paper develops a constrained linear-quadratic (LQ) optimal control framework within the behavioral approach. Unlike classical formulations that rely on state-input representations, our method treats both the system dynamics and the constraints as trajectory-level objects. The system is modeled through a kernel representation, while inequality constraints are captured using behavioral inequalities defined over infinite-dimensional convex cones. Using quadratic differential forms (QDFs) to encode performance indices, we formulate the constrained LQ problem as a convex variational optimization over trajectories. By employing Gateaux differentials, we derive the stationarity and complementarity conditions and show that they admit a representation as an augmented behavioral system whose unique decomposition into autonomous and controllable sub-behaviors yields a complete parameterization of all optimal constrained trajectories. The resulting conditions constitute a behavioral analogue of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) framework. A numerical example illustrates the effect of inequality constraints on the optimal behavior. The framework provides a general, trajectory-level representation for constrained optimal control and opens avenues for closed-loop and data-driven extensions.

</details>


### [1425] [Adaptive Federated Optimization Across Smooth and Nonsmooth Regimes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39716v1)
*Zimeng Wang,Ali Dadras,Alp Yurtsever*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: AdaFed 是一种联邦优化方法，可在单一参数设置下同时适应光滑阶数与常数，无需预先指定光滑阶数，并在光滑非凸、光滑凸与 Lipschitz 非光滑凸三类问题上均取得与集中式 AdaGrad 类方法相当的收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式优化中 AdaGrad 类方法能同时适应光滑性的阶数与常数，但现有扩展到联邦优化的方法在面对异构客户端目标与多次本地步骤时，要求事先指定光滑阶数，这限制了方法的通用性。

Method: 提出 AdaFed：一种联邦优化算法，通过单一参数选择即可在多种优化情形下自适应，采用 AdaGrad 式自适应步长机制，结合本地多步更新与异构目标处理，无需预设光滑阶数；理论上分别在确定性设定与轻尾随机梯度噪声假设下进行分析。

Result: 确定性设定下：光滑非凸与光滑凸目标均达到 O(1/T) 收敛率；Lipschitz 非光滑凸目标达到 O(1/√T)（至多相差对数因子）。在轻尾随机梯度噪声假设下，上述保证可扩展至随机设定，仅额外增加对数因子与依赖噪声的项。三类问题的实验进一步验证了理论结论。

Conclusion: AdaFed 消除了联邦优化中对光滑阶数预先指定的依赖，以统一的参数配置覆盖光滑非凸、光滑凸与非光滑凸三类问题及确定性/随机两种噪声设定，并由实验支持其理论保证。

Abstract: AdaGrad-style methods can simultaneously adapt to both the order and constants of smoothness in centralized optimization. However, existing extensions to federated optimization with heterogeneous client objectives and multiple local steps require the smoothness order to be specified in advance. We address this limitation with AdaFed, a federated method that adapts across several regimes under a single choice of parameters. In the deterministic setting, AdaFed achieves an $O(1/T)$ convergence rate for both smooth nonconvex and smooth convex objectives, and an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate for Lipschitz nonsmooth convex objectives up to logarithmic factors. Under a light-tailed stochastic-gradient noise assumption, these guarantees extend to the stochastic setting with additional logarithmic factors and noise-dependent terms. Experiments across the three problem classes further support our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [1426] [Carbon-Aware Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with Decision-Focused Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39645v1)
*Jaume Reixach,Wanru Chen,Jiaming Wu,Balázs Kulcsár*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究碳排放感知的电动汽车路径问题（EVRP），决策变量涵盖路径、充电与等待，使充电需求可向电网碳强度较低的时段转移；并提出决策聚焦学习（DFL），用近似SPO+方向训练电网碳强度预测的线性模型，底层求解器为限时大邻域搜索加精确后处理。基于德国实例：碳感知优化使实际排放平均降低28.76%（但非碳运营成本上升）；决策聚焦训练较预测聚焦学习使实际总成本平均降低2.30%，在75.5%测试实例上更优，尽管点预测精度明显更低；该优势在不同求解器配置与碳成本权重下保持为正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电动汽车虽无尾气排放，但充电排放取决于随时间变化的发电结构；传统路径优化对碳盲视，且碳排放决策依赖未来电网碳强度预测，而常规"预测聚焦"训练与下游优化目标不一致，导致预测精度高但决策效果不佳。

Method: 构建以碳感知为目标的EVRP，联合决定路径、充电与等待；采用决策聚焦学习，以近似SPO+方向训练线性碳强度预测器，使训练与求解器对齐；求解器为限时大邻域搜索（LNS）加精确后处理。

Result: 德国实际实例上：显式计入充电排放使实际排放平均下降28.76%，代价是非碳运营成本上升；决策聚焦训练使实际总成本平均降低2.30%，在75.5%测试实例上优于预测聚焦学习，虽然点预测精度显著更低；优势在多种求解器配置与碳成本权重下平均仍为正。

Conclusion: 将充电排放纳入路径优化可显著减排；以求解器感知的决策聚焦方式训练预测模型，能在点预测精度下降的情况下提升实际决策表现，且结论具有跨配置稳健性。

Abstract: Electric vehicles produce no tailpipe emissions, but charging them produces emissions that depend on the time-varying generation mix of the electricity consumed. We study an Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with a carbon-aware objective that accounts for charging-related emissions alongside conventional routing costs. The problem determines routing, charging, and waiting decisions, allowing charging demand to be shifted toward periods with lower grid carbon intensity. Because these decisions depend on forecasts of future carbon intensity, we propose a decision-focused learning approach so that the training of the model employed for predicting the carbon intensity of the grid over time is solver-aware. In particular, we train a linear predictor using approximate SPO+ directions and employ a time-limited Large Neighborhood Search followed by exact postprocessing as the underlying solver. Experiments on realistic Germany-based instances show that explicitly considering charging-related emissions reduces realized emissions by 28.76% on average relative to carbon-blind optimization, although at the expense of higher non-carbon operating cost. Moreover, decision-focused training reduces realized total cost by 2.30% on average relative to conventional prediction-focused learning and performs better on 75.5% of the test instances, despite substantially lower pointwise predictive accuracy. Finally, we show that its average advantage remains positive across varied solver configurations and carbon-cost weights.

</details>


### [1427] [Conic-Lifting for Learning-rate-free Convex Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39531v1)
*Julien Grand-Clément,Joon Kwon,Francesco Orabona*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个统一的在线凸优化（OCO）算法族：通过增加一个标量坐标将原凸域提升为锥，从而在无需调参学习率、且域可无界的情形下统一并推广了AdaGrad式学习率、Conic Blackwell算法与parameter-free算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免调参策略（AdaGrad式学习率、Conic Blackwell算法、parameter-free算法）分属不同类别，分析手段各异且往往较难，缺乏统一框架；同时希望处理无界凸域并免除人工设定学习率。

Method: 借鉴Blackwell (1954) 的思想，通过添加一个标量坐标把凸域提升为锥；提升后的次梯度与对应的提升决策正交，使比较器尺度在regret分析中可自由优化。在锥上分别应用FTRL与OMD，即得到CBA与CBA^+的推广，并拓展到具有强凸平方范数的有限维赋范空间；对任意非空闭凸域，利用已知梯度界获得parameter-free regret保证。

Result: 在Hilbert空间有界域上，该框架分别由FTRL与OMD恢复出CBA与CBA^+；在具有强凸平方范数的有限维赋范空间中给出其推广；对任意非空闭凸域，由已知梯度界得到parameter-free regret保证；在无约束Hilbert空间中，该构造精确恢复KT (Krichevsky–Trofimov) coin-betting算法；另给出一个无需梯度界的无约束域parameter-free算法。

Conclusion: 锥提升为免调参OCO提供了统一视角，将若干看似独立的方法纳入同一FTRL/OMD框架，并揭示了与KT coin-betting的深层联系，同时扩展了适用空间与域的范围。

Abstract: A central topic in online and stochastic optimization is to design algorithms that do not require tuning of hyperparameters. Successful strategies in online learning include AdaGrad-style learning rates, Conic Blackwell algorithms, and parameter-free algorithms. However, these classes require different, often difficult, analyses. We develop a unifying family of Online Convex Optimization (OCO) algorithms that require no user-tuned learning rate on convex domains that may be unbounded. The construction lifts the domain to a cone by adding one scalar coordinate, an idea going back to Blackwell (1954). The lifted subgradients are orthogonal to the corresponding lifted decisions, leaving the comparator scale free to optimize in the regret analysis. Applying Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) and Online Mirror Descent (OMD) on the cone recovers Conic Blackwell Algorithm (CBA) and Conic Blackwell Algorithm Plus (CBA$^+$) on bounded domains in Hilbert spaces and extends them to finite-dimensional normed spaces with a strongly convex squared norm. For arbitrary nonempty closed convex domains in these spaces, a known gradient bound yields parameter-free regret guarantees. Surprisingly, on an unconstrained Hilbert space, the construction recovers the Krichevsky--Trofimov (KT) coin-betting algorithm exactly. We also give a parameter-free algorithm for unconstrained domains that requires no gradient bound.

</details>


### [1428] [Optimization-based lane-changing trajectory planning in mixed traffic with embedded input convex neural networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38939v1)
*Yuanxiang Yang,Yu Liu,Fabricio Oliveira,Yu Han,Claudio Roncoli*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出数据驱动优化框架，将神经网络代理模型嵌入贝塞尔曲线轨迹规划器，用线性规划形式实现换道安全与横向舒适度代价建模，兼顾预测精度与求解效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合交通中联网自动驾驶车辆的换道策略受周围车辆行为不确定性影响，且将真实预测模型嵌入优化会带来巨大计算负担，难以兼顾交互建模与可解性。

Method: 以贝塞尔曲线为换道轨迹参数化基础；安全代价由三部分代理构成：输入凸循环神经网络(ICRNN)编码规划轨迹、全输入凸神经网络(FICNN)嵌入换道时长、部分输入凸神经网络(PICNN)解码器结合历史交通状态融合；另用FICNN代理逼近最优横向舒适代价（关于换道时长的函数）。两类代理均以线性规划(LP)形式嵌入，避免传统混合整数规划(MIP)嵌入NN所需的二元变量，并理论证明其最优性精确性，扩展到含附加解析目标项与多代理的问题。

Result: 在真实与仿真轨迹混合数据集上，代理精度与无约束基线相当，优化效率较传统MIP显著提升；闭环仿真显示加权规划代价明显降低，持续优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 输入凸神经网络代理+LP嵌入的方式可在保持预测精度的同时实现高效换道优化，为混合交通下的实时换道规划提供了可行且可扩展的方案。

Abstract: Lane-changing (LC) maneuvers are highly challenging vehicle interactions, with substantial implications for traffic safety and efficiency. Developing effective LC strategies for connected and automated vehicles in mixed traffic is complicated by the uncertainty associated with surrounding-vehicle behavior and the computational burden of embedding realistic prediction models within optimization schemes. To capture these complex interactions while retaining tractability, this study proposes a data-driven optimization framework that embeds neural network (NN) surrogates for safety and lateral comfort within a Bézier-curve-based trajectory planner. Specifically, the safety cost during the LC process is quantified via a surrogate composed of an input convex recurrent neural network (ICRNN) encoding the planned trajectory, a fully input convex neural network (FICNN) embedding the LC duration, and a partially input convex neural network (PICNN) decoder fusing them with historical traffic states; separately, another FICNN surrogate approximates the optimal lateral comfort cost as a function of the LC duration. Both surrogates are embedded via linear programming (LP) formulations, avoiding the binary variables required by conventional mixed-integer programming (MIP) approaches for NN-embedded optimization. We further theoretically establish their exactness at optimality and extend the framework to problems with additional analytical objective terms and multiple surrogates. Experiments on a hybrid dataset combining real-world and simulated trajectories demonstrate that the proposed method achieves surrogate accuracy competitive with unconstrained baselines while substantially improving optimization efficiency over conventional MIPs. Closed-loop simulations further show that the proposed planners markedly reduce the weighted planning cost and consistently outperform baseline methods.

</details>


### [1429] [Stable Dynamical Mass Transportation via port-Hamiltonian Structure](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38465v1)
*Dongjun Wu,Yankai Lin,Gang Feng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该文放弃精确最优性，提出以随机端口Hamilton系统为参考模型的密度反馈框架，使确定性非线性系统的闭环连续性方程匹配参考模型的FPK方程，从而实现分布式、可扩展的分布输运。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性系统上的动态最优质量输运受维数灾难与开环实现方式制约，难以在线求解全局有限时域输运问题，因此有必要以稳定性、鲁棒性和可扩展性为目标，寻求牺牲精确最优性的替代框架。

Method: 以随机端口Hamilton系统为参考模型，在适当结构假设下证明其密度渐近收敛到给定稳态分布；随后将确定性非线性系统整形为相容的端口Hamilton形式，并加入粒子层面的局部密度反馈项，使闭环连续性方程与参考模型的Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov方程一致。对线性系统与高斯目标，推导密度反馈可镇定的充要条件并给出显式控制器构造。

Result: 所设计的反馈可将一大类初始分布驱动至目标分布；由于密度项在粒子层面是局部的，控制器可分散实现，且无需在线求解全局有限时域输运问题。文中通过非线性算例与仿真验证了方法，并在线性高斯情形下给出了充要条件与显式控制器。

Conclusion: 以牺牲精确最优性换取稳定、鲁棒与可扩展的参考模型匹配思路，为非线性系统的分布输运提供了可行的分散化实现途径。

Abstract: Dynamical optimal mass transportation over nonlinear systems is often hindered by the curse of dimensionality and open-loop implementation. We propose an alternative framework that sacrifices exact optimality in favor of stability, robustness, and scalability. We use a stochastic port-Hamiltonian system as a reference model. Under suitable structural assumptions, we show that its density converges asymptotically to a prescribed steady-state distribution. We then shape a deterministic nonlinear system into a compatible port-Hamiltonian form and add a local density-feedback term so that its closed-loop continuity equation matches the Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov equation of the reference model. The resulting feedback drives a broad class of initial distributions to the target distribution. Because the density term is local at the particle level, the controller admits decentralized implementation and avoids solving a global finite-horizon transport problem online. Nonlinear examples and simulations illustrate the method. For linear systems with Gaussian targets, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for stabilizing density feedback and give explicit controller constructions.

</details>


### [1430] [Neural Compression of Long ADMM Trajectory for Multiparametric Quadratic Program](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38079v1)
*Liang Wu,Honghui Zheng,Bo Yang,Xu Yang,Yilin Mo,Ján Drgoňa*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出自监督神经压缩框架TQPNet，将长ADMM优化轨迹压缩为紧凑的神经热启动加少量精化迭代，用于实时求解大规模多参数二次规划（mpQP）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时求解大规模mpQP通常需要数千次迭代优化更新，是模型预测控制（MPC）与学习型系统中的主要计算瓶颈。

Method: 推导作用于原始-对偶变量 (x, β) 的低维ADMM格式，证明其迭代可等价表示为ReLU层（ADMM(ReLU)）；据此构建TQPNet：MLP(ReLU) 生成热启动，接少量展开的ADMM(ReLU)精化层；以最优性条件构成的残差损失离线自监督训练，无需求解器标签；残差框架同时支持在线解认证与自适应精化。

Result: 在大规模mpQP与实时MPC实验中，TQPNet精度高、泛化性强，推理速度显著快于传统基于优化的方法。

Conclusion: 将ADMM迭代等价为ReLU网络使神经热启动与可认证精化统一于同一残差框架，可在保证解质量的前提下大幅降低实时mpQP求解的计算开销。

Abstract: Solving large-scale multiparametric quadratic programs (mpQPs) in real time often requires thousands of iterative optimization updates, creating a major computational bottleneck in model predictive control and learning-enabled systems. This paper proposes TQPNet, a self-supervised neural compression framework that learns to compress long ADMM optimization trajectories into a compact neural warm start followed by a few refinement iterations. We derive a low-dimensional ADMM scheme operating on the primal-dual variables $(x,β)$ and show that its iteration admits an equivalent ReLU-layer representation, termed ADMM(ReLU). Building on this insight, TQPNet combines a multilayer perceptron with ReLU activations (MLP(ReLU)) and a small number of unrolled ADMM(ReLU) refinement layers. The network is trained offline using an optimality-condition-informed residual loss, eliminating the need for solver-generated labels. The proposed residual-based framework enables both self-supervised training and online solution certification through adaptive ADMM(ReLU) refinement. Experiments on large-scale mpQPs and real-time MPC applications demonstrate that TQPNet achieves high accuracy, strong generalization, and substantially faster inference than conventional optimization-based methods.

</details>


### [1431] [Conformal Predictive Distributions for Contextual Order Fulfillment Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38046v1)
*Tinghan Ye,Amira Hijazi,Pascal Van Hentenryck*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该文用共形预测分布（CPS回归、CVAP多分类）刻画配送时效不确定性，并嵌入上下文优化模型（C-SAA）做配送履约决策，理论给出基于预测误差的遗憾界，实证在500万+真实订单上显著提升准确率、迟延识别率与决策成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商家到门履约需在配送时间未知前选择履约仓与承运商，现有做法依赖静态时效估计，无法反映不确定性随订单与履约选项的变化，导致决策次优。

Method: 构造共形预测分布（CPD）：回归用Conformal Predictive Systems（CPS，含split CPS与Mondrian CPS），多分类用cross Venn-Abers predictor（CVAP）；将其用于上下文优化模型，以contextual sample-average approximation（C-SAA）求解；并推导遗憾界=预测误差项+情景评估误差+候选生成差距，其中预测项依赖校准残差或类概率对当前订单的代表性。

Result: 500万+自营订单：CVAP把精确到日准确率由规则法的49.5%提升至64.1%；配合更重视迟延的分位数加权规则，SCPS点估计使迟延检测率从3.8%升至79.4%；基于残差的CPD区间覆盖率达标或略超名义水平。JD.com仿真6个测试日：C-SAA+CVAP降总成本7.1%，C-SAA+MCPS降6.7%（相对非共形预测），迟延率均从5.7%降至4.0%以下。

Conclusion: 共形预测分布可有效量化订单级、选项级的时效不确定性，在理论上保证遗憾受预测误差控制，在实践中同时降低履约成本与迟延率，优于静态/规则估计。

Abstract: Ship-to-home fulfillment requires a retailer to select a fulfillment location and carrier before the delivery time is known. These decisions often rely on static transit-time estimates, which cannot represent how delivery-time uncertainty varies across orders and fulfillment options. This paper constructs conformal predictive distributions (CPDs) using Conformal Predictive Systems (CPS) for regression and the cross Venn-Abers predictor (CVAP) for multiclass classification, and uses them in a contextual optimization model for fulfillment decisions. The model is solved by contextual sample-average approximation (C-SAA). The regret of each fulfillment decision, its expected cost above that of the best decision, is bounded by forecast error, scenario-evaluation error, and the candidate-generation gap. The forecast term depends on how well calibration residuals or class probabilities represent the current order. On more than five million proprietary order records, CVAP raises exact-day accuracy from 49.5% for the rule-based estimate to 64.1%. Paired with a decision rule that selects a quantile weighting late errors more heavily, the split CPS (SCPS) gives a point estimate that raises late-delivery detection from 3.8% to 79.4%. Residual-based CPS distributions also meet or slightly exceed nominal interval-coverage targets. In decision experiments with a JD.com simulator over six test dates, C-SAA with CVAP lowers mean total cost by 7.1% and C-SAA with the Mondrian CPS (MCPS) lowers it by 6.7%, relative to C-SAA with the original nonconformal forecast. Both cut the late-delivery rate from 5.7% to below 4.0%.

</details>


### [1432] [Trajectory-Planning Attitude Control System for Satellites with Magnetic Attitude Control and One Reaction Wheel](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38029v1)
*Patrick McKeen,Alex Meredith,Kerri Cahoy*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究LEO航天器姿态执行机构选型问题，提出单反作用轮＋三磁力矩器的混合执行系统，并采用轨迹规划控制方法，在满足指向精度的同时减少反作用轮卸载需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反作用轮与磁力矩器在体积、重量、功耗与成本上存在明显权衡：反作用轮性能优但代价高，磁力矩器廉价轻便但性能受限。作者希望以更少硬件（仅一个反作用轮）获得接近反作用轮的性能，同时规避其动量饱和与静摩擦问题。

Method: 构建单反作用轮＋三轴磁力矩器的混合执行机构配置，采用轨迹规划（trajectory planning）控制方法，以指向目标满足为核心、以最小化反作用轮卸载需求为优化导向；规划框架可处理时变目标与随轨道变化的磁场。并与仅用磁力矩器的规划型控制系统进行对比。

Result: 初步结果显示轨迹指向精度可达角分级（fractional-degree accuracy），能够有效管理反作用轮动量并避免静摩擦（stiction）；与纯磁力矩器规划控制相比，收敛性更好、大角度机动（slew）更快。

Conclusion: 混合单轮＋三磁力矩器配合轨迹规划控制，是LEO姿态执行机构的一种高性价比方案，可在降低成本与硬件规模的同时保持较好指向性能与动量管理能力。

Abstract: Selecting attitude actuators for spacecraft in low earth orbit (LEO) often involves a trade between reaction wheels and magnetorquers. Reaction wheels generally have higher size, weight and power as well as cost, compared with magnetorquers, but have performance advantages. We consider a hybrid system relying on a single reaction wheel and three magnetorquers, using a trajectory planning control method that focuses on meeting pointing goals and minimizing the need to desaturate the reaction wheel. The use of planning allows for intelligent use of the reaction wheel and accommodates time-changing goals and orbit-varying magnetic fields. Preliminary results show trajectories with fractional-degree-accuracy, as well as management of reaction wheel momentum and avoidance of stiction. We also compare to a magnetorquer-only planning-based control system and show better convergence and faster slews.

</details>


### [1433] [Verifying Control Invariance of H-Polytopes is coNP-Complete](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36773v1)
*Mario Eduardo Villanueva,Boris Houska*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 证明验证H-多面体对离散时间线性系统（含多面体输入约束）是否为控制不变集是coNP-完全的，从而建立集合论控制的根本复杂度壁垒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合论控制（set-theoretic control）中，最大控制不变集的计算是核心工具，但其计算复杂度的理论基础尚不明确；作者希望确立其内在计算复杂度下界。

Method: 将"H-多面体是否为控制不变集"的判定问题归约为已知的coNP-完全问题，进行复杂度归约证明；并讨论输入约束集以H-表示或V-表示给出时的情形。

Result: 该验证问题为coNP-完全；作为直接推论，H-多面体的最大控制不变子集的精确计算是coNP-难的；结论对输入约束集的H-表示与V-表示均成立。

Conclusion: 控制不变性验证与最大控制不变集精确计算具有coNP级本质难度，说明一般情形下不存在多项式时间精确算法，需依赖近似方法或结构假设。

Abstract: We prove that verifying whether an H-polytope is control invariant for a discrete-time linear system with polytopic input constraints is \textsc{coNP}-complete. This establishes a fundamental computational complexity barrier for set-theoretic control. As an immediate consequence, the exact computation of maximal control invariant subsets of H-polytopes is \textsc{coNP}-hard. These hardness results hold regardless of whether the input constraint set is given in H- or V-representation.

</details>


### [1434] [Frequency-Uniform Log-Regret Reinforcement Learning for Diffusions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36758v1)
*Jose Blanchet,Lutong Hao,Renyuan Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究Euler离散受控扩散的episodic值函数强化学习，给出常数关于时间步δ一致的O(log K)（及高概率O(logK loglogK)）遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高频控制问题常通过时间离散化研究，但细化步长δ会使离散horizon H=T/δ增大，导致标准有限horizon遗憾保证在物理horizon T固定时反而变差；希望获得关于δ一致的遗憾界。

Method: 针对受控扩散的Euler离散，采用episodic value-based RL，以相对Euler模型最优策略的累计K回合遗憾为度量；在值函数梯度、Bellman残差导数与fitted critic的稳定性与正则性条件下证明O(log K)遗憾界且常数关于δ一致；对漂移关于未知参数线性、扩散协方差未知为常数的情形，构造约束的model-based controlled-diffusion fitted-Q算法(CD-FQ)，验证局部化条件。

Result: 一般条件下得到常数关于δ一致的O(log K)遗憾界；对CD-FQ在固定及有限T下得到高概率O(log K log log K)遗憾，常数同样关于δ一致。

Conclusion: 结果说明遗憾保证可对时间离散步长δ保持一致，避免了细化步长导致的退化，为高频控制问题的离散化RL提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: High-frequency control problems are often studied through time discretization, but refining the timestep $δ$ increases the discrete horizon $H=T/δ$ and can make standard finite-horizon regret guarantees deteriorate even when the physical horizon $T$ is fixed. We study episodic value-based reinforcement learning for Euler discretizations of controlled diffusions. The performance is measured as the cumulative regret over $K$ episodes relative to the optimal policy of the corresponding Euler model. Under stability and regularity conditions on value function gradients, Bellman residual derivatives, and fitted critics, we prove an $\mathcal{O}(\log K)$ regret bound with constants uniform in $δ$. For dynamics with drift linear in unknown parameters and unknown constant diffusion covariance, we verify localized versions of these conditions for a constrained, model-based controlled-diffusion fitted-$Q$ algorithm (CD-FQ) and obtain high-probability $\mathcal{O}(\log K\log\log K)$ regret for fixed and finite $T$, again with constants uniform in $δ$.

</details>


### [1435] [Balanced Active Subspaces for Optimal Control via Trajectory Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36342v1)
*Emmanuel S. Ameh,Samuel E. Otto*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出平衡主动子空间最优控制框架BASOC，用于高维非线性系统值函数的模型降维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 求解Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程面临维度灾难，难以实现高维非线性系统（如航空流场重层流化、失速恢复）的实时最优反馈控制。

Method: BASOC借助轨迹优化与Pontryagin极小值原理，沿局部最优轨迹获取状态与协态（值函数梯度）数据，构造状态协方差与梯度协方差矩阵；对两矩阵进行平衡化，得到用于逼近值函数的斜投影，并可据此构建降阶模型与代理反馈控制律。

Result: 证明在线性二次型最优控制问题中，BASOC等价于对最优闭环实现的初始条件平衡快照法；在POD与平衡截断表现较差的三维非线性系统上验证有效，并在非线性复Ginzburg-Landau方程上验证了大规模系统的可行性。

Conclusion: BASOC通过兼顾值函数敏感方向与最优轨迹状态分布方差的平衡子空间实现降维，兼具理论一致性（LQR下等价于平衡快照法）与非线性大尺度问题的实用性。

Abstract: The curse of dimensionality associated with solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for the value function remains a key obstacle for real-time optimal feedback control of high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems. This is especially severe in aerospace applications such as relaminarizing unsteady turbulent flows and recovering from aerodynamic stall where nonlinear dynamics play a significant role. We introduce Balanced Active Subspaces for Optimal Control (BASOC), a model reduction framework which seeks to find directions in state space along which the value function is most sensitive, and the distribution of states exhibits maximum variance along optimal trajectories. BASOC leverages trajectory optimization and the Pontryagin minimum principle to obtain state and co-state (value function gradient) data along locally optimal trajectories for constructing state and gradient covariance matrices. Balancing these matrices provides an oblique projection for approximating the value function, which can also be used to construct reduced-order models and surrogate feedback control laws. We show that for linear-quadratic optimal control problems, BASOC becomes equivalent to a snapshot method for initial condition balancing of the optimally controlled closed-loop realization. The framework is demonstrated on a nonlinear three-dimensional system where POD and balanced truncation are known to perform poorly, and on the nonlinear complex Ginzburg-Landau equation to demonstrate feasibility for larger-scale systems.

</details>


### [1436] [Efficient ADMM for Soft-Constrained Quadratic Programs via Generalized Slack Projections](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35631v1)
*Roland Schwan,Thomas Lew,Brian Plancher*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一种不增加问题规模的ADMM方案，通过对松弛投影函数做修改，支持一大类凸松弛罚函数（含所有ℓ_k范数），用于求解带软约束的二次规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中QP约束常通过松弛变量软化以保证可行性，但标准做法引入额外决策变量，导致优化问题规模膨胀、求解变慢。

Method: 设计适用于一大类凸松弛罚函数（包括所有ℓ_k范数）的ADMM迭代格式；唯一改动是将松弛投影替换为修改后的松弛投影函数，其余算法保持不变，从而避免引入额外变量。

Result: 数值算例显示出显著的加速效果，并在一个能源优化问题上验证了方法的灵活性。

Conclusion: 在不扩大问题规模的前提下可高效处理软约束QP，且方法通用、易集成于现有ADMM实现。

Abstract: Quadratic programs (QPs) are a core building block in many applications. In practice, constraints are often softened with slack variables to guarantee feasibility. The standard approach tackles this by introducing additional decision variables, growing the resulting optimization problem. In this paper, we propose an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) scheme for a broad class of convex slack penalty functions, including all $\ell_k$-norms, without increasing the problem size. The only change to the ADMM scheme is a modified slack projection function, while the remaining algorithm stays the same. We demonstrate our approach on numerical examples, showing significant speedups, and show its flexibility on an energy optimization problem.

</details>


### [1437] [ADACT: PDE-Constrained Thermal Hardware/Software Co-Design Adjoint-Driven Optimal Control via Finite Difference Discretization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35569v1)
*Don Li*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出硬件/软件协同设计的物理信息PDE约束热节流最优控制算法 ADACT，以Crank–Nicolson有限差分+反向伴随状态法+L-BFGS求解，在满足热约束的同时最大化吞吐、降低冷却能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模AI与HPC的算力需求使多核处理器面临严重功率密度限制与热节流，亟需有原理支撑的、物理信息驱动的预测性动态热管理（DTM）方法。

Method: 将温度场建模为二维非齐次抛物型反应-扩散方程，含空间局部化、时变功率源项与变对流冷却，边界为非齐次Dirichlet条件；用Crank–Nicolson格式与五点离散Laplacian在均匀网格上离散（无条件稳定，二阶时空精度）；采用连续时间反向伴随状态法求精确梯度，配L-BFGS优化；用MMS验证前向/伴随求解器的二阶收敛率，用方向导数Taylor测试验证梯度精度。

Result: MMS定量验证了前向状态与反向伴随求解器均具二阶收敛率，Taylor测试确认梯度正确；数值实验表明ADACT可动态调节软件功率负载与硬件冷却强度，在严格维持物理热阈值的同时保持运行吞吐。

Conclusion: ADACT为热风险、冷却能耗与执行吞吐之间的多目标权衡提供了可验证、物理一致的PDE约束最优控制框架，适用于芯片级DTM的软硬件协同节流。

Abstract: By virtue of the sheer compute demands of large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing (HPC), modern multi-core microprocessors suffer from severe power density limits and thermal throttling, entailing an urgent need for principled methods for predictive, physics-informed dynamical thermal management (DTM). Here, we introduce a hardware/software co-design physics-informed PDE-constrained DTM throttling optimal control algorithm, ADACT (Adjoint-Driven Adaptive Co-Design Thermal Control), that minimizes thermal risk and cooling energy overhead while maximizing core execution throughput. The underlying physical temperature field is governed by a two-dimensional nonhomogeneous parabolic reaction-diffusion equation with spatially localized, time-varying power source terms and variable convective cooling subject to nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. We employ a discretization of the continuous state PDE via a Crank-Nicolson finite difference scheme with a 5-point discrete Laplacian operator on a uniform spatial mesh, which preserves unconditional numerical stability and $O(Δx^2 + Δy^2 + Δt^2)$ second-order temporal and spatial accuracy. To efficiently compute exact gradients, we construct and implement a continuous backward-in-time adjoint state method with L-BFGS as our optimization algorithm of choice. The accuracy and second-order convergence rates of both forward state and backward adjoint solvers are quantitatively verified via the Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS), and gradient accuracy is validated using directional derivative Taylor tests. Numerical experiments demonstrate that ADACT dynamically throttles software power workloads and modulates hardware cooling efforts to strictly uphold physical thermal thresholds while maintaining operational throughput.

</details>


### [1438] [Constraint Learning by Optimizing over Trained Neural Networks: A Pragmatic Tutorial](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35505v1)
*Jiaxiao Fang,Thiago Serra*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于“约束学习”的教程性论文，介绍在优化模型中嵌入神经网络时的实践性考量，并通过案例验证更小、更稀疏的网络的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束学习是借助机器学习建模优化问题的新兴范式：可将训练好的模型嵌入优化模型，从数据中经验性地学习约束，或用更简单的近似替代非线性目标函数。但嵌入神经网络后，优化模型可能规模过大或求解过慢，亟需实用指导。

Method: 采用教程形式，系统梳理在优化模型中有效且高效地使用“神经网络约束学习”的实践性考量（如网络结构设计），并以案例研究加以验证。

Result: 案例研究表明，采用更小、更稀疏的神经网络有助于提升约束学习嵌入优化模型后的效率与可求解性。

Conclusion: 在约束学习中嵌入神经网络时，应重视模型规模与稀疏性等实践因素；更小、更稀疏的网络在实践中更具优势。

Abstract: Constraint learning is an emerging paradigm of modeling optimization problems with the help of machine learning. In this paradigm, trained machine learning models are embedded into the optimization model. For example, we can learn constraints empirically from available data, or we can avoid using a nonlinear objective function by learning a simpler approximation for it. Neural networks become a compelling option if the machine learning models must capture more elaborate and nuanced relationships. However, optimization models embedding neural networks may become too large or too slow to solve. In this tutorial, we present practical considerations for an effective and efficient use of constraint learning with neural networks and validate it with a case study highlighting the benefit of smaller and sparser networks.

</details>


### [1439] [Global $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ Convergence of Multilevel Gradient-Regularized Newton Methods](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35195v1)
*Nick Tsipinakis,Matthias Voigt*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析了一类多层梯度正则化牛顿法，用于求解Hessian为Lipschitz连续的无约束凸优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全空间梯度正则化牛顿法虽具有全局 O(k^{-2}) 的函数值收敛速率，但每次迭代需在完整高维空间计算牛顿修正，计算代价高；作者希望借助多层（子空间）思想降低计算成本，同时不损失原有收敛阶。

Method: 在低维子空间中计算牛顿修正以构造多层方法；为使多层格式获得 O(k^{-2}) 收敛速率，引入一类行嵌套（row-nested）限制算子，保证约化梯度范数沿层级单调不增，从而完成收敛性分析。

Result: 理论证明：在Hessian Lipschitz连续与行嵌套限制算子条件下，多层方法保持全空间方法 O(k^{-2}) 的全局函数值收敛速率。数值实验显示：采用行嵌套算子的方法与全空间梯度正则化牛顿法收敛行为相当，且在大规模问题上显著节省计算量。

Conclusion: 多层梯度正则化牛顿法在保持全局收敛阶的前提下有效降低单步计算开销，是一种适用于大规模凸优化问题的可行加速方案；行嵌套限制算子是支撑其理论保证的关键设计。

Abstract: We develop and analyze multilevel gradient-regularized Newton methods for unconstrained convex optimization with Lipschitz-continuous Hessians. By computing Newton corrections in lower-dimensional subspaces, the proposed methods aim to reduce computational costs while preserving the global $\mathcal{O}\left(k^{-2}\right)$ convergence rate in function values of the full-space method. To establish this rate for multilevel methods, we introduce a class of row-nested restriction operators that ensures monotonicity of the reduced-gradient norms across levels. Numerical experiments with row-nested operators demonstrate convergence behavior comparable to full-space gradient-regularized Newton, while offering substantial computational savings on large-scale instances.

</details>


### [1440] [Reinforcement learning for constrained stochastic linear--quadratic control in continuous time](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34995v1)
*Weiping Wu,Qitong Pan,Xun Li,Peng Wu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究标量状态、非负控制约束的连续时间随机线性二次控制，在二次运行代价下刻画随机化探索对最优均值反馈的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次运行代价下，随机化探索会改变最优均值反馈；需要理解熵正则/探索与硬约束（非负控制）交互下最优条件均值的结构，并为未知动力学提供无模型算法。

Method: 引入一个不含熵的辅助问题：条件策略均值非负、协方差按状态平方比例给定。通过矩约化（moment reduction）与状态分离，得到两个分区间的Riccati方程，刻画有限时域值函数与最优条件均值；给出使该均值与原约束问题最优反馈一致的"控制—代价相容性"充分条件。对时不变系数刻画无折扣无穷时域最优并证明均方渐近稳定性。对未知动力学，设计有限/无穷时域的无模型actor–critic方案。

Result: 得到有限时域值函数与最优条件均值的Riccati刻画；给出控制—代价相容性充分条件；刻画无穷时域无折扣最优并证明均方渐近稳定性；数值实验对比学习策略与解析目标，并考察探索对最优均值的影响。

Conclusion: 随机化探索在带非负控制约束的LQ问题中可通过协方差按状态平方比例设定的辅助问题精确刻画，并借助分区Riccati方程与相容性条件与原始约束问题对齐；该框架可推广到无穷时域并支持无模型actor–critic实现。

Abstract: We study continuous-time stochastic linear--quadratic control with a scalar state and nonnegative control constraints. With quadratic running costs, randomized exploration can change the optimal mean feedback. We introduce an auxiliary problem without entropy in which the conditional policy mean is nonnegative and the covariance is prescribed in proportion to the squared state. Moment reduction and state separation yield two regional Riccati equations and characterize the finite-horizon value function and optimal conditional mean. We give a sufficient control--cost compatibility condition under which this mean coincides with the optimal feedback of the original constrained problem. For time-invariant coefficients, we characterize the undiscounted infinite-horizon optimum and establish mean square asymptotic stability under the stated assumptions. For unknown dynamics, we develop model-free actor--critic schemes for finite and infinite horizons. Numerical experiments compare the learned policies with their analytical targets and examine the effect of exploration on the optimal mean.

</details>


### [1441] [Explicit Globally Asymptotically Stable Attitude Control with Reaction Wheel Angular Momentum and Torque Constraints](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34922v1)
*Javier Urrios,Rafael Vazquez,Guillermo Pacheco-Ramos*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一种基于MRP参数化的显式Lyapunov姿态控制器，通过类势垒的动量反馈与连续正标量统一缩放机制，在不求解在线优化的前提下逐时刻硬约束反作用轮角动量与输出力矩，并证明调节问题的全局渐近稳定性与约束满足性，进一步扩展到跟踪问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反作用轮驱动的刚体航天器在姿态控制中必须防止轮子饱和与力矩超限，而常规处理依赖于在线优化（如MPC/QP），计算负担大且难以保证逐时刻的硬约束。作者希望获得无需在线优化、可解析证明约束满足且保持Lyapunov收敛性的显式控制器。

Method: 采用修正罗德里格斯参数（MRP）描述姿态；设计类势垒函数的动量反馈项以抑制轮速饱和；当力矩限制将被突破时，用一个连续正标量对所有反馈项统一缩放，从而保持Lyapunov函数单调下降；对跟踪问题，将势垒项替换为误差状态对应形式；全程不求解在线优化。

Result: 调节问题：借助LaSalle不变性原理证明全局渐近稳定（GAS），并对任意对称正定惯量矩阵解析证明角动量与力矩约束的满足。跟踪问题：在对参考轨迹的显式可行性条件下获得渐近（非全局）稳定及同样的安全保证。仿真验证了收敛性与约束满足，并与其他控制器进行了性能对比。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了一种计算量低、可解析验证安全性、且保持Lyapunov稳定性的显式反应轮姿态控制方案，适用于须严格满足轮动量与力矩硬约束的航天器姿态调节与跟踪；跟踪情形以全局性换取更一般参考下的安全性。

Abstract: We present an explicit Lyapunov attitude controller for rigid spacecraft actuated by three orthogonally mounted reaction wheels, parameterized using Modified Rodrigues Parameters (MRPs), which enforces hard bounds on wheel angular momentum and applied torque at every instant without solving any online optimization. A barrier-inspired momentum feedback prevents wheel saturation; a continuous positive scalar uniformly scales the feedback whenever a torque limit would otherwise be breached, preserving Lyapunov convergence. For the regulation problem, global asymptotic stability (GAS) is established via LaSalle's invariance principle, and constraint satisfaction is proved analytically for arbitrary symmetric positive-definite inertia matrices. Replacing the barrier by an error-state counterpart extends the design to tracking, with asymptotic (though no longer global) stability and the same safety guarantees under explicit feasibility conditions on the reference. Simulations confirm convergence and constraint satisfaction, and compare performance against other controllers.

</details>


### [1442] [Uniform observability criteria for linear time-varying systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34581v1)
*Soulaimane Berkane*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对线性时变系统的均匀可观测性，提出了可直接从系数矩阵检验的充要条件，覆盖常值动态系统与级联系统两类，并应用于积分链测距定位等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证线性时变系统的均匀可观测性通常需要计算状态转移矩阵，计算量大且难以直接由系统系数判断。作者希望建立仅依赖系数矩阵（及输出矩阵、特征空间等）的充要条件，从而绕过状态转移矩阵的直接计算。

Method: 对两类系统分别给出判据：（1）实谱常值动态+可测且本质有界输出矩阵的系统，证明均匀可观测性等价于输出矩阵在每个特征空间上的持续激励，等价于Kalman可观测性堆叠的持续激励；（2）常值可观测测量子系统与隐藏状态耦合的级联系统，在一致正则性假设下用输出导数的线性组合消去被测状态，得到隐藏动态的等价可观测性检验，实谱时化归为在每个特征空间与直接测量核的交集上的激励条件。

Result: 得到两个可直接由系数矩阵检验的充要条件，并将级联判据应用于任意阶积分链对固定锚点测距的情形，给出了相应提升线性时变系统的精确激励条件；另一应用处理直接隐藏测量情形，并与已有充分性检验进行了比较。

Conclusion: 均匀可观测性可由特征空间上的持续激励性质刻画，无需显式状态转移矩阵；该框架可用于级联与测距类时变系统，且给出的条件是充要的，较现有仅充分的条件更紧。

Abstract: Verifying uniform observability of a linear time-varying system generally requires its state-transition matrix. This paper develops necessary and sufficient conditions that can be checked directly from the coefficient matrices for two classes of systems. For constant dynamics with real spectrum and a measurable, essentially bounded output matrix, uniform observability is equivalent to persistent excitation of the output matrix on each eigenspace. An equivalent condition requires persistent excitation of the Kalman observability stack. The second result concerns cascades with a constant observable measured subsystem coupled to a hidden state. Under uniform regularity assumptions, linear combinations of output derivatives eliminate the measured state and yield an equivalent observability test for the hidden dynamics. When those dynamics have real spectrum, the test reduces to excitation on each eigenspace intersected with the kernel of the direct measurements. An application to arbitrary-order integrator chains with measurements of ranges to fixed anchors gives an exact excitation condition for the associated lifted LTV system. A second application treats direct hidden measurements and compares the condition with existing sufficient tests.

</details>


### [1443] [Non-Ergodic Markovian Mirror Descent with Unbounded Noise](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34433v1)
*Yunus Alp Biyikoglu,R. Srikant*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 利用泊松方程分解马尔可夫噪声，在允许子梯度与泊松解无界的条件下，证明单样本路径随机镜像下降对加权平均迭代达到 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的期望次优间隙界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有马尔可夫噪声下的随机镜像下降分析通常依赖有界性、非周期性或边际分布收敛到平稳分布等假设，限制了对无界状态空间与周期链的适用性。

Method: 通过泊松方程分解马尔可夫噪声并控制其贡献；在正则性与矩条件下（允许随机子梯度与泊松解在状态空间上无界）进行分析；对不可约有限状态链验证泊松解条件并给出显式界以量化周期性影响；对不可约可数状态链在几何 Lyapunov 漂移条件与子梯度增长界下验证正则性与矩条件。

Result: 对合适步长，加权平均迭代的期望次优间隙达到 $O(T^{-1/2})$；分析不要求链非周期，也不要求边际分布收敛到平稳分布。

Conclusion: 该工作放宽了马尔可夫噪声下随机镜像下降的假设，给出统一且显式的收敛保证，并阐明周期性与无界状态空间的影响。

Abstract: We analyze stochastic mirror descent for minimizing a convex objective expressed as an expectation under the stationary distribution of a Markov chain, using noisy subgradient observations along a single sample path. Through Poisson's equation, we decompose the Markovian noise and control its contribution under regularity and moment conditions that allow the stochastic subgradients and the Poisson solution to be unbounded across the state space. We establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ bound on the expected suboptimality gap of the weighted-average iterate for an appropriately chosen step size. The analysis does not require aperiodicity or convergence of the chain's marginal distributions to stationarity. For irreducible finite-state chains, we verify the required conditions on the Poisson solution and derive explicit bounds that quantify the effect of periodicity. For irreducible countable-state chains, we verify the required regularity and moment conditions under a geometric Lyapunov drift condition and suitable growth bounds on the stochastic subgradients.

</details>


### [1444] [Controlled Block Proximal Linearized Method for Nonconvex and Nonsmooth Optimization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34390v1)
*Weifeng Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出受控块近端线性化（CBPL）方法，在无有界性/强制性假设下求解多块非凸非光滑优化，并应用于图正则NMF、CP分解与ℓ0稀疏NMTF，获得整序列收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多块非凸非光滑优化中，迭代点往往无界、原目标非强制，导致经典块坐标/近端类方法的收敛分析失效；同时图正则矩阵分解类模型存在尺度退化问题，需在保留原目标、变量与约束的前提下同时获得有界性与收敛性保证。

Method: 在块更新中引入一个"控制势"（control potential），同时保留原目标、变量与约束，形成CBPL算法；给出显式控制设计条件，并在KL性质下建立收敛理论。将CBPL实例化到三类模型：图正则非负矩阵分解（NMF）、CP张量分解、以及带ℓ0范数稀疏约束的独立核心NMTF（含independent Tucker core）。对每个块给出显式投影与可计算的安全步长参数。

Result: 在显式控制条件与KL性质下，得到迭代有界、有限长度（finite length）、原变量整序列收敛与目标值收敛；极限点处原目标的一个极限次梯度在所有有效比较方向上为零。对NMF/CP/NMTF，刻画了保重构的尺度退化：证明尺度临界性等价于图塌缩，且完全临界性迫使此类塌缩；显式控制给出紧的下水平集与图作用的一致正下界（含independent Tucker core情形），同时保留真正改变重构的方向。对普通NMF与CP模型，整序列收敛到完全临界点。实验（直接安全更新）显示收敛性、持续的图作用以及受控的因子与核心尺度。

Conclusion: CBPL以轻量的控制机制替代逐一证明有界性，统一处理无界迭代下的多块非凸非光滑问题，并在图正则分解类模型中把尺度退化机理形式化为"尺度临界⇔图塌缩"，为工程上可直接实施的安全步长更新提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: We consider multiblock nonconvex and nonsmooth optimization without assuming bounded iterates or coercivity of the original objective. We propose the Controlled Block Proximal Linearized (CBPL) method, which incorporates a control potential into block updates while retaining the original objective, variables, and constraints. Under explicit control design conditions and the KL property, the control yields boundedness, finite length, whole-sequence convergence of the original variables, and convergence of objective values. At the limit, one limiting subgradient of the original objective vanishes on all effective comparison directions. We apply CBPL to graph-regularized nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), CP decomposition, and independent-core matrix tri-factorization (NMTF) with $\ell_0$ norm sparsity constraints. We characterize their reconstruction-preserving scale degeneracies, proving that scale criticality is equivalent to graph collapse and that full criticality forces such collapse. Explicit controls provide compact sublevel sets and a uniform positive lower bound on graph action, including with an independent Tucker core, while retaining genuine reconstruction-changing directions. Each block admits an explicit projection and a computable safe step parameter. For ordinary NMF and CP models, whole-sequence convergence to a full critical point follows. Experiments with direct safe updates demonstrate convergence, sustained graph action, and controlled factor and core scales.

</details>


### [1445] [A Nonconvex Framework for Joint Sparse Sample Weighting and Parameter Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33957v1)
*Hassan Nojavan,Chul Moon,Miju Ahn*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出SWAPE框架，联合优化模型参数与样本权重，支持凸/弱凸/DC损失及弱凸稀疏正则，用交替最小化+MM求解并给出收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练数据中存在不利/异常样本会损害模型性能，需要同时学习参数并为每个样本分配个体权重以抑制不良数据影响，且需覆盖更广泛的非凸损失与稀疏权重约束。

Method: 构建关于模型参数与样本权重的双变量联合优化问题：参数侧允许凸、弱凸与difference-of-convex损失，权重侧采用弱凸稀疏函数控制复杂度；采用交替最小化，两个子问题分别用majorize-minimize（MM）近似求解，并给出各损失的多种近似方案，证明整体算法收敛性。

Result: 在多种学习任务与不同数据异常设置下的数值实验表明，该框架相较基准方法能更有效地降低不良数据点的影响。

Conclusion: SWAPE为鲁棒训练提供了统一、可收敛的联合加权与估计范式，理论覆盖较广的损失与稀疏函数类别，实验验证其抑制异常样本影响的有效性。

Abstract: We propose a joint sparse sample weighting and parameter estimation (SWAPE) framework that jointly optimizes model parameters and sample weights to train a model while simultaneously assigning an individual weight to each training data point. Our framework accommodates several widely used loss functions for the model parameters, including convex, weakly convex, and difference-of-convex loss, and weakly convex sparsity functions to control the complexity of the sample weights. To solve the resulting bivariate problem, we propose an alternating minimization method in which the subproblems for updating the model parameters and weights are each approximated using majorize-minimize techniques. We provide several approximation methods for the loss functions considered in this paper, and show the overall algorithm's convergence. Numerical experiments on various learning tasks and data anomaly settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in minimizing the impact of undesirable data points compared to benchmark methods.

</details>

### [1446] [The proton structure one mode at a time: a Neural Tangent Kernel analysis of a DIS fit](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36034v1)
*Amedeo Chiefa,Luigi Del Debbio,Richard Kenway*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 基于NTK分析前馈神经网络在DIS数据拟合PDF中的训练动力学，将单味梯度流解析解推广到多味情形，建立Shapley值与几何解释，并证明正则化等价于按特征值时间尺度逐步纳入NTK模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从实验数据确定PDF是一个病态反问题，训练中的正则化机制及其与数据、方法论的关系尚缺乏解析理解，需要现象学相关设定下的训练动力学分析。

Method: 在DIS数据拟合PDF的NN训练中分析NTK；将此前单味分析的梯度流精确积分推广到多味情形；在线性依赖于PDF的观测量上推导Shapley值并给出训练的几何解释；考察梯度优化算法与参数化的正则化作用及初始化影响。

Result: 正则化相当于逐步纳入NTK模式，每个模式按其对应特征值设定的时间尺度被学习；仅少数领头模式即可重构目标PDF，数据噪声由后期学习的次领头模式携带；复现了初始化导致的瞬态行为。

Conclusion: 框架可推广至固定函数形式等其他参数化、物理中的其他ML应用，以及不一致数据下的压力测试。

Abstract: We study the training dynamics of a feed-forward neural network (NN) through the analysis of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) in a phenomenologically relevant fit of parton distribution functions (PDFs) from deep inelastic scattering (DIS) data. The exact integration of the gradient flow derived in a previous single-flavour analysis is generalised to the multi-flavour case, yielding an analytical perspective on the relationship between data and methodology during training. The Shapley value recently used in the context of PDFs is derived within our statistical framework for observables that depend linearly on the PDFs, and we outline a geometric interpretation of training. We expose the role of gradient-based optimisation algorithms and of the parametrisation in the regularisation of the ill-posed inverse problem that affects the determination of PDFs from experimental data, demonstrating that the regularisation amounts to the incremental inclusion of NTK modes, each learned at the timescale set by the corresponding eigenvalue. We find that only a few leading modes of the NTK are necessary to reconstruct the target PDFs, while the noise of the data is carried by the sub-leading ones learned at later stages of training. Finally, we consider the impact of the initialisation on the training dynamics, and recover a transient behaviour observed in the previous analysis and in the machine learning (ML) literature. Beyond sharpening our understanding of the training dynamics, our framework can be applied to other parametrisations (such as fixed functional forms) and ML applications in physics, as well as to stress tests in the presence of inconsistent data.

</details>

### [1447] [Impossibility of No-Regret in Multi-Agent Bidding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36666v1)
*Zongjun Yang,Rachitesh Kumar,Christian Kroer*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文证明：在重复第二价格拍卖中，若所有投标人同时使用预算或ROI约束下的pacing算法，则无法同时实现无遗憾（no-regret）；高方差与高遗憾存在确定性联系，从低方差系统可提取pacing均衡，从而得到联合无遗憾的PPAD-hard性，且常用算法在简单市场上即可通过循环表现出高方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实互联网广告拍卖中买家普遍部署pacing算法或自动出价代理，学界常用"无遗憾"作为算法性能的理论保证；但多智能体同时学习时的联合无遗憾是否可实现尚不明确，尤其是带预算/ROI约束的约束型学习问题。

Method: 考虑T轮重复第二价格拍卖、n个pacing投标人、物品到达i.i.d.的模型；建立"在线出价系统高方差⇒高遗憾"的确定性关系；通过从低方差系统中提取pacing均衡，归约证明联合无遗憾的PPAD-hard性；对若干常用出价算法借助动力系统分析与数值仿真考察其循环行为。

Result: 证明所有投标人同时达到无遗憾（同时满足各自预算或ROI约束）在计算上不可行；联合无遗憾问题为PPAD-难；并给出证据表明若干广泛使用的pacing算法即便在简单市场实例上也会因循环而产生高方差行为。

Conclusion: 在买家同时部署pacing算法的互联网拍卖系统中，一般情形下不能期望联合无遗憾保证；多智能体约束型学习存在本质的计算与动力学障碍，需针对均衡选择、算法稳定性或协议设计另寻出路。

Abstract: We consider $T$ repeated second-price auctions across $n$ pacing bidders with i.i.d. item arrivals, and show that it is computationally impossible for all bidders to achieve no-regret simultaneously while satisfying their respective budget or return-on-investment constraints. Therefore, in the prominent internet auction systems where buyers simultaneously deploy pacing algorithms or automated bidding agents, we cannot hope to achieve joint no-regret guarantees in general.
  We establish a deterministic relationship that high variance in online bidding systems implies high regret. By showing that one can extract a pacing equilibrium from a low-variance system, we prove PPAD-hardness of attaining joint no-regret. For several widely used bidding algorithms, we also show evidence from dynamical systems and numerical simulations that they can indeed display high-variance behavior through cycling, even on simple market instances.

</details>


<div id='eess.AS'></div>

# eess.AS [[Back]](#toc)

### [1448] [Discovering Interpretable Acoustic Features in Autoregressive Voice-Cloning TTS Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40505v1)
*Anuj Diwan,David Harwath,Eunsol Choi*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于特征的语音克隆TTS模型可解释性框架，利用SAE、PCA和随机方向特征，通过稀疏探针、引导与定量自动可解释性，分析自回归语音克隆TTS模型所表征和使用的声学属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音克隆TTS能从简短语音提示合成未见说话人的声音，但这些模型究竟表征并使用了哪些声学属性仍不清楚，缺乏系统的可解释性分析。

Method: 构建基于特征的可解释性框架，提取稀疏自编码器（SAE）、PCA及随机方向特征，采用稀疏探针、特征引导（steering）和定量自动可解释性三类评测；以Qwen3-TTS为主要对象，并将探针与引导扩展到另外5个模型以检验跨架构泛化性。

Result: 这些模型编码了音高、能量、噪声、口音等概念，但稀疏预测与引导仅对部分概念有效；强探针性能并不总能转化为有效引导，反之亦然；SAE适合人工标注概念的稀疏探针与新概念发现，PCA在稠密探针与引导上具竞争力；自动可解释性在Qwen3-TTS中发现684个经自动验证的SAE特征，覆盖说话人聚类、说话风格与录音条件等已知概念之外的属性。

Conclusion: 本文对自回归语音克隆TTS模型进行了全面的可解释性研究，揭示了不同特征方法与评测范式之间的差异与互补性。

Abstract: Voice-cloning TTS models synthesize an unseen speaker's voice from brief speech prompts, but it remains unclear which acoustic properties they represent and use. We introduce a feature-based interpretability framework for autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models, analyzing features from sparse autoencoders (SAEs), PCA, and random directions via sparse probing, steering, and quantitative auto-interpretability. We focus on Qwen3-TTS and extend probing and steering to $5$ additional models to test generalization across architectures. These models encode concepts like pitch, energy, noise, and accent, but sparse prediction and steering are effective only for some concepts. Strong probing does not always translate to steering or vice-versa. SAEs are useful for sparse probing of human-labelled concepts and novel-concept discovery, while PCA is competitive for dense probing and steering. Auto-interpretability finds $684$ automatically validated SAE features in Qwen3-TTS covering speaker clusters, speaking style, and recording conditions beyond known concepts. Overall, we perform a comprehensive interpretability study of autoregressive voice-cloning TTS models.

</details>


### [1449] [Streaming Speech Recognition on a Microcontroller: a 65.7M-Parameter Transducer in 2 and 4 Bits on the ESP32-P4](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38739v1)
*Billal Boumedine*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 作者将65.7M参数的流式Zipformer2 transducer（Kroko）在无NPU的ESP32-P4（双400MHz RISC-V核、128-bit PIE SIMD、32MB PSRAM）上实现：编码器290个矩阵按敏感度分配2/4-bit并做Hadamard旋转分组量化，权重从71MB int8压缩至26.65MB；C引擎单核双核分配下单chunk（1.28s音频）耗时0.90s（含beam search），LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other WER为4.34%/10.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无神经网络加速器的MCU上部署流式端到端ASR，需要在极受限的算力（8亿次级别/秒的两核）与内存（32MB PSRAM）下同时保证实时性与识别精度，而现有量化/推理方案多面向GPU或带NPU的边缘设备，缺乏对纯RISC-V+SIMD微控制器的完整工程证据与误差归因。

Method: 1) 免训练后量化：编码器290个矩阵以2或4 bit/权重存储，按实测敏感度决定逐矩阵位宽；矩阵先做Hadamard旋转分组，再以GPTQ并配合分组scale（norm）搜索进行舍入，并先向原模型输出做校正。2) 激活：矩阵乘法前int8、乘积间int16。3) 手写PIE SIMD内核的C推理引擎，PC版本与芯片逐比特一致，便于在完整测试集上测精度。4) GPU模拟器拆分整型算术与权重量化各自的误差贡献；在全部test-clean上做消融验证GPTQ的作用。

Result: 权重文件由71MB int8降至26.65MB；每1.28s音频chunk耗0.90s（双核，含beam search）。WER：LibriSpeech test-clean 4.34%、test-other 10.26%（原模型3.94%/9.17%）；FLEURS与Common Voice差距扩大到2.3和1.1个百分点。GPU模拟器表明整型算术几乎无损失，全部精度差距来自权重量化；消融显示GPTQ贡献最大。工程方面给出从51.3s到0.62s（每chunk编码器时间）的优化历程、向16MB压缩的尝试（止于19.63MB）及失败方案；未测能耗。

Conclusion: 在无NPU的RISC-V MCU上可实现流式Zipformer2 transducer的准实时（0.90s/chunk）推理，2/4-bit混合精度加GPTQ在26.65MB内保持了可用的识别精度，误差主要源于权重量化而非整型运算；该工作提供了可复现的引擎、固件与权重，并诚实报告了未达成的压缩目标与失败尝试。

Abstract: We run Kroko, a 65.7M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer for English, on the ESP32-P4, a microcontroller with two 400 MHz RISC-V cores, a 128-bit SIMD extension (PIE) and 32 MB of PSRAM, but no neural accelerator. Without any training, the encoder's 290 matrices are stored with 2 or 4 bits per weight in Hadamard-rotated groups: the width of each matrix comes from its measured sensitivity, and each matrix is first corrected toward the original model's output, then rounded with GPTQ and a search over the group norms. The released 71 MB of int8 weights become a 26.65 MB file. Activations are int16 between the matrix products and int8 into them. A C engine with hand-written PIE kernels processes each 1.28 s chunk of audio in 0.90 s on both cores, beam search included, and its PC build computes the same bits as the chip, so accuracy is measured on whole test sets. LibriSpeech WER is 4.34% on test-clean and 10.26% on test-other, against 3.94% and 9.17% for the released model; on FLEURS and Common Voice the gap grows to 2.3 and 1.1 points. A GPU simulator shows that the integer arithmetic costs nothing and that the whole gap comes from the weights, and an ablation on all of test-clean shows that GPTQ does most of the work. We also report the port's speed history, from 51.3 s to 0.62 s of encoder time per chunk, each design step measured again in one build, an attempt to reach 16 MB that stopped at 19.63 MB, and what did not work. We did not measure energy. The inference engine, the firmware and the 2/4-bit weights are available at https://github.com/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr.

</details>


### [1450] [Realizing Low-Precision Storage and Sparse Execution in a Folded FPGA Speech Enhancer](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35144v1)
*Clément Laroche*

Main category: eess.AS

TL;DR: 针对折叠式流式语音增强FPGA加速器，用实测代价分别驱动混合精度权重与结构化通道稀疏训练；在Kria KV260上比特精确部署后，最佳稀疏模型消去47.3%卷积MAC，帧时降45%、动态能耗降60%，且语音质量更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件感知训练常以FPGA资源、时延或比特运算量为优化目标，但折叠（分时复用算术单元）改变了压缩真正能节省的对象：共享算术使精度、权重存储与调度工作量相互解耦，单一比特运算指标无法反映实际收益。

Method: 从折叠式流式语音增强加速器的实测代价出发推导训练目标：混合精度权重用于降低片上存储（按存储定价），结构化通道稀疏用于从引擎调度中整块移除运算（按可移除工作量定价）；在Kria KV260上做比特精确实现并同会话对比，方案包括 cycle-cost 加权 lasso 与普通 channel group-lasso。

Result: 最佳稀疏模型消去47.3%卷积MAC，相对同会话测得的存储定价模型帧时由1.86 ms降至1.03 ms（−45%）、动态能耗由83 μJ/帧降至33 μJ/帧（−60%），语音质量更高；相对另行测得的最优稠密实现，帧时降42%、能耗降48%。权重由8 bit降至6 bit使动态功率降27%，但帧时变化不足5%；普通 channel group-lasso 比 cycle-cost 加权 lasso 移除更多工作量。

Conclusion: 折叠加速器的硬件感知训练应将“存储代价”与“可移除工作量代价”分开定价，而非依赖单一比特运算指标。

Abstract: Hardware-aware training often optimizes FPGA resources, latency, or bit operations, but folding changes what compression saves: shared arithmetic decouples precision, weight storage, and scheduled work. We derive training objectives from the measured costs of a folded streaming speech-enhancement accelerator. Mixed-precision weights reduce on-chip storage; structured channel sparsity removes entire operations from the engine schedule. We deploy a bit-exact implementation on the Kria KV260. The best sparse model eliminates 47.3% of convolution MACs, cutting frame time by 45% (1.86 to 1.03 ms) and dynamic energy by 60% (83 to 33 $μ$J/frame) against a storage-priced model measured in the same session, with higher speech quality. Relative to the most efficient dense build measured separately, frame time falls by 42% and energy by 48%. Reducing weight width from 8 to 6 bits lowers dynamic power by 27% but changes frame time by less than 5%. Plain channel group-lasso removes more work than cycle-cost-weighted lasso. Thus, folded-accelerator training should price storage and removable work separately, rather than rely on a single bit-operation metric.

</details>
