# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [1451] [Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40287v1)
*Bole Ma,Ayesha Afzal,Jan Eitzinger,Harald Koestler,Gerhard Wellein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 在生产级服务条件下（SGLang、CUDA graphs、H100/H200、批大小≤64、5个语料）实测投机解码的能耗：稠密模型中验证（而非起草）主导能耗，节省随批大小增大而收窄，大批量下块级drafter会把验证推入计算受限区，节能转为亏损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心受功率约束，每token能耗决定可服务token总量，时延目标决定用户响应速度。解码阶段每生成一个token都要完整读一遍权重；批处理只能摊薄权重读取成本却不加快单个用户，投机解码能加快单用户但需对全部草稿token进行验证，其真实节能幅度受目标模型注意力家族、起草方案与输入文本影响，难以确定，需实测。

Method: 在H100与H200 GPU上，基于SGLang并启用CUDA graphs的生产级服务环境，批大小最高64，覆盖5个语料库，对多种目标模型（不同注意力家族）与多种起草方案（含块级drafter）的投机解码进行能耗测量，并分析接受率（对话 vs 代码、Romansh低资源语言 vs 英语）、算术/访存平衡点以及DVFS余量。

Result: 稠密模型上验证阶段主导能耗而非起草；节能随批大小增大而缩小，因批处理已共享了投机欲分摊的权重读取；大批量下块级drafter将验证推过算术-访存平衡点进入计算受限区，节能变为增耗；低接受率drafter反而抬高每token能耗；所有被评估drafter在对话上接受token数少于代码，所有训练过的drafter在Romansh上少于英语；以投机满足更严格时延目标需额外能耗；无投机时更大批量可降低每token能耗，投机仅在高接受率时叠加节省，并在所测模型上几乎未给保时延DVFS留下空间。

Conclusion: 投机解码的能效收益高度依赖接受率、批大小与模型/语料，不能默认视为节能手段；在大批量服务中应优先用批处理降低每token能耗，仅在接受率高时叠加投机，并需将块级drafter的验证开销纳入算力预算考量。

Abstract: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer on Romansh, a low-resource language, than on English. We measure speculative decoding under production serving conditions (SGLang, CUDA graphs enabled) on H100 and H200 GPUs, at batch sizes up to 64 across 5 corpora. On dense models, verification, not drafting, dominates the energy cost. The saving shrinks as the batch grows, because batching has already shared the weight read that speculation would divide among the accepted tokens. At large batch sizes, block drafters push verification past the balance point between arithmetic and memory traffic into the compute-bound regime, where the saving becomes a loss, and a drafter with low acceptance raises energy per token. Meeting a tighter latency target with speculation then costs additional energy. Larger batches lower energy per token without speculation. Speculation adds to that saving only when acceptance is high, and on the model we tested it leaves little headroom for latency-preserving DVFS.

</details>


### [1452] [PhOSv1: Efficient Scaling of Model Sleeping on a Single Server for Autoscaling with GPU-Context Deduplication](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39999v1)
*Tianle Sun,Xingda Wei,Rong Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PhOSv1通过API remoting将各推理引擎的GPU上下文分配委托给中心守护进程，去重睡眠模型间重复的CUDA驱动上下文与内核二进制，在保持vLLM sleep模式同等scale-up速度的同时大幅降低GPU显存占用，提升多模型服务的端到端性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型即服务系统中，scale-up时间直接决定模型服务的过载时长与服务质量的修复速度。主流引擎（vLLM、SGLang）采用model sleeping机制，通过暂停预启动引擎实现近零成本scale-up。但睡眠并非无代价：每个睡眠模型需常驻GPU context，该开销随模型数量线性增长，拖累服务性能。服务商需支持大量模型，因此陷入"全员快速scale-up"与"高服务性能"之间的两难。

Method: 核心观察是睡眠模型的上下文高度冗余：CUDA driver context可在模型间共享，GPU kernel二进制因公共算子与库而大量重叠。PhOSv1通过API remoting将每个引擎的GPU上下文分配透明地委托给一个中心守护进程，实现上下文去重，使单台服务器可维持远超现有引擎的睡眠模型数量。

Result: 评估表明，PhOSv1在scale-up时间上与原生vLLM sleep模式持平，同时显著降低GPU显存占用，并改善多模型服务的端到端性能。

Conclusion: 单台服务器可在不支付"GPU上下文税"的前提下维持大量睡眠模型，PhOSv1以透明、非侵入式的上下文去重方案化解了快速scale-up与高性能之间的取舍矛盾。

Abstract: Autoscaling is a key mechanism in model-as-a-service systems, where fast scale-up is essential because the scale-up time directly determines how long a model service remains overloaded, which in turn governs serving quality. The state-of-the-art approach, model sleeping, adopted by mainstream serving engines including vLLM and SGLang, achieves near-zero-cost scale-up by pausing pre-spawned engines on the GPU. However, sleeping is not a free lunch: each sleeping model must keep its GPU context resident, and this cost grows linearly with the number of models, degrading serving performance. Because providers must support many models, they face a dilemma between fast scale-up for all models and high service performance.
  In this paper, we show that a single server can keep many models asleep without paying this GPU context tax. The key observation is that the contexts of sleeping models are largely duplicated: the driver (CUDA) context can be shared across models, and their GPU kernel binaries overlap heavily due to common operators and libraries. PhOSv1 deduplicates this context by transparently delegating each engine's GPU context allocation to a central daemon through API remoting; therefore, a single server can keep far more models asleep than current engines allow. Our evaluation shows that PhOSv1 matches the scale-up time of vanilla vLLM sleep mode while substantially reducing the GPU memory footprint, improving end-to-end multi-model serving performance.

</details>


### [1453] [Sandman: Building and Operating Sandboxes for Agentic Reinforcement Learning on Shared Kubernetes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39711v1)
*Yiming Yan,Hongyang Wang,Wenbo Chen,Xuan Wang,Jingguo Liu,Xian Li,Chen Qi,Leo Fan,Siwei Li,Qianli Wu,Yichuan Li,Ruochen Wen,Qian Qu,Zheshen Wang,Benoit Dumoulin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Sandman 是 Amazon 构建并运营的沙箱服务，基于共享 Kubernetes 为智能体强化学习提供工具执行与评测环境；单次规模测试中维持 11,858 个并发小沙箱，四个生产 SWE-bench Verified 训练任务在 2026 年 10 月共创建 310 万个沙箱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习需要在特定任务环境中反复调用工具，单个训练任务可能突发性地创建成千上万个环境，并与其他任务共享集群。现有的环境创建、就绪、回收与评测隔离缺乏专门支撑，存在突发创建压力、环境准备开销、废弃沙箱泄漏和评测条件不可控等问题。

Method: Sandman 以 Kubernetes Pod 作为沙箱单元，在未经修改的任务镜像中挂载一个小型守护进程（daemon）。训练框架提交任务镜像后，通过命令与文件操作使用沙箱；文件与进程在调用之间持久保留，直至框架释放环境。服务侧统一管理沙箱的创建、就绪与清理，并以 provider 与沙箱池（pool）支撑批量调度。

Result: 规模测试中 Sandman 维持了 11,858 个并发微型沙箱；2026 年 10 月四个生产级 SWE-bench Verified 训练活动合计创建 310 万个沙箱，并支撑多个生产智能体强化学习负载在共享 Kubernetes 上运行。

Conclusion: 论文总结了在突发创建、任务环境准备、废弃沙箱回收以及受控条件下评测四个方面的设计权衡与运维经验，并计划开源 Sandman 的 daemon、provider 与 pool 组件。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments. A training job may create thousands of these environments in bursts while sharing a cluster with other jobs. We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for agent tool execution and evaluation. It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads on shared Kubernetes. A training framework supplies a task image and uses commands and file operations in the returned sandbox. Files and processes persist across calls until the framework releases the environment. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup. Each sandbox is a Kubernetes pod with a small daemon mounted into the unmodified image. In a scale test, Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. Four production SWE-bench Verified training campaigns created 3.1 million sandboxes in October 2026. We report the design trade-offs and operational lessons from handling creation bursts, preparing task environments, reclaiming abandoned sandboxes, and running evaluation under controlled conditions. We will open-source Sandman's daemon, provider and pool.

</details>


### [1454] [When Does Heterogeneity Pay Off? Understanding GPU-WSE System Complementarity](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39222v1)
*Ziyu Hu,Zhijing Ye,Jiamin Wang,Zhiqing Zhong,Zhendong Mi,Shaoyi Huang,Weijian Zheng,Rajkumar Kettimuthu,Xiaodong Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出分层基准测试方法与解析性能模型，用于刻画GPU与晶圆级引擎（WSE）异构执行的特征，明确异构互补性可被利用的条件，并判断异构性何时成为瓶颈、何时带来系统级性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI加速器架构日益多样化，将不同架构集成到统一系统成为新的异构计算范式。GPU与WSE在计算、存储、通信组织方式上差异显著，既存在架构互补性也带来额外开销，但如何将这种异构性转化为实际性能增益尚不清晰。

Method: 提出分层基准测试方法（hierarchical benchmarking methodology），系统刻画GPU–WSE异构执行过程及互补性的利用条件；并构建解析性能模型（analytical performance model），用于刻画性能边界。

Result: 该性能模型能够识别异构性成为瓶颈的情形，以及异构性产生系统级性能增益的情形；分层基准测试可量化GPU–WSE在计算、访存与通信层面的差异与互补空间。

Conclusion: 通过基准测试与解析建模相结合，可将GPU–WSE异构性从"架构差异"转化为可判定的性能增益条件，为异构AI加速系统的设计与任务划分提供依据。

Abstract: As AI accelerator architectures become increasingly diverse, integrating different architectures into a unified system is emerging as a new heterogeneous computing paradigm. GPUs and WSEs differ substantially in compute, memory, and communication organization, creating both architectural complementarity and additional overheads, yet how to translate this heterogeneity into practical performance gains remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical benchmarking methodology to characterize GPU--WSE heterogeneous execution and the conditions for exploiting complementarity, together with an analytical performance model that identifies when heterogeneity becomes a bottleneck and when it yields system-level performance gains.

</details>


### [1455] [MCCL: Training Pytorch models across a fleet of Macs at Skywalker Sound](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39029v1)
*Kevin Sasso,Chris Fiegel,Francis Aitken,Nicolas Tsingos,Nicholas Tong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出首个开源的多节点PyTorch MPS分布式后端MCCL，在24节点苹果Mac集群上实现接近TCP理论上限的all-reduce性能与95.9%并行效率，可低成本复用闲置Mac算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Skywalker Sound拥有200余台M4 Max Mac Studio，空闲时闲置大量统一内存与算力；但PyTorch缺少面向Apple MPS的加速分布式后端，无法与现有NVIDIA GPU集群一起用于分布式机器学习。

Method: 开发Metal Communication Collective Library（MCCL），基于交换式Ethernet构建多节点MPS后端，支持标准PyTorch代码库；在24节点规模上评估大尺寸all-reduce吞吐与ViT训练扩展性，并与NVIDIA A100对比FP32/TF32矩阵乘吞吐，估算闲置算力替代云成本。

Result: 大all-reduce达TCP goodput的98–99.7%；113.5M参数ViT训练从198提升至4,568 samples/s，并行效率95.9%；单台M4 Max约为A100 FP32矩阵乘吞吐的1.7倍，约5.5台Mac匹配A100 TF32性能；每晚100台闲置Mac运行12小时约每年节省20万美元等效云算力成本。

Conclusion: 现有Mac基础设施可在不放弃标准PyTorch代码的前提下，被无缝复用于高性能分布式训练，为异构集群与闲置算力利用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Skywalker Sound, a premier audio post-production facility, operates more than 200 M4 Max Mac Studios on a 10Gb Ethernet network. When not in use by artists, these machines sit idle, representing massive untapped unified memory and compute capacity. While these fleets are excellent candidates for distributed machine learning alongside existing NVIDIA GPU clusters, PyTorch lacks an accelerated distributed backend for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). To bridge this gap, we introduce the Metal Communication Collective Library (MCCL), the first open-source MPS backend for multi-node PyTorch training over switched Ethernet. We evaluate its performance and scalability across 24 nodes, demonstrating that large all-reduce operations reach 98-99.7% of TCP goodput. Training a 113.5M-parameter Vision Transformer (ViT) scales from 198 to 4,568 samples/s, achieving 95.9% parallel efficiency. Benchmarked against an NVIDIA A100 GPU, one M4 Max Mac equals roughly 1.7x the throughput of FP32 matrix multiplication, and 5.5 Macs match an A100 using TF32. Harnessing 100 idle Macs for 12 hours nightly offsets approximately $200,000 annually in equivalent cloud compute costs. Our results demonstrate that existing Mac infrastructure can be seamlessly repurposed for high performance distributed training without abandoning the standard PyTorch codebase.

</details>


### [1456] [Hardwired Distributed Processing Units at the Sensor: Truly Parallel Vision Pre-Processing that Frees the Host CPU](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38752v1)
*Raj Mali*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文提出将视觉预处理任务下沉到紧贴传感器的硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU），在Artix-7 FPGA上用2568个LUT、约0.318 W搭建Canny边缘、Harris角点与线条跟踪三个HDPU并行处理同一像素流，实现逐比特精确、低且稳定的延迟，并显著释放主机算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉流水线把每个像素都送到主机处理器，主机必须等待整帧完成后才能动作，且每帧周期需耗费部分时间做常规预处理，导致响应延迟大、抖动明显、算力被占用。作者希望探索将这些工作分散到与传感器直接相连的专用小型硬连线数据通路的替代组织方式。

Method: 构建小型固定数据通路HDPU直接挂接传感器，每个单元始终在线、只执行单一任务，并在同一像素流上真正并行工作、向主机输出紧凑结果。基于一个共享两时钟延迟的3×3算子库，构造三个HDPU（Canny边缘、Harris角点、带转向决策的线条跟踪器），在低成本Artix-7 FPGA上并排运行于单路摄像头流，并与软件模型及数据手册相机模型进行全系统仿真。

Result: 资源代价为2568个LUT、估计功耗0.318 W；各单元各级与软件模型逐比特一致。全系统仿真中，每个决策在其产生像素后11.03条相机行内输出，比主机帧式程序最早可能响应时刻快22–67倍；HDPU延迟波动不超过17 ns，而主机运行时间可达中位数的12.5倍。卸载三任务在640×480下每帧归还主机18–30%的核心时间，1080p全线程使用时达帧周期的63%。单元成本仅通过行缓冲随帧宽增长；在线跟随车辆闭环模型中，最高可保持速度由4.75提升至10.00 m/s。

Conclusion: 将常规视觉预处理以细粒度、始终在线的硬连线单元形式分布式地置于传感器端，可在极低资源与功耗代价下获得逐比特精确、低抖动且远快于帧式主机的响应，并释放主机算力、提升闭环控制性能；其成本随帧宽仅由行缓冲线性增长，具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Conventional vision pipelines route every pixel to a host processor, which must then wait for a complete frame before it can act and devote part of each frame period to routine pre-processing. We examine an alternative organisation in which this work is distributed across hardwired distributed processing units (HDPUs): small, fixed datapaths attached directly to the sensor, each committed to a single always-on task, operating truly in parallel on the same pixel stream and delivering compact results to the host. From one library of 3x3 operators sharing a common two-clock latency, we construct three HDPUs (Canny edges, Harris corners, and a line tracker that issues a steering decision) and run them side by side on a single camera stream in a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA, at a cost of 2,568 LUTs and an estimated 0.318 W. Every stage of every unit is bit-exact with its software model. In a full-system simulation with a datasheet camera model, each decision leaves its HDPU within 11.03 camera lines of the pixel that produced it, 22-67x sooner than the earliest moment at which a frame-based program on the host could respond; the HDPU latency varies by no more than 17 ns, whereas the host's own run times reached 12.5x their median. Offloading the three tasks returns 18-30% of a core to the host in every frame period at 640x480, and 63% of the frame period, with all threads in use, at 1080p. The cost of the units grows with frame width only through their line buffers, and in a closed-loop model of a line-following vehicle the HDPU raises the highest speed at which the line is held from 4.75 to 10.00 m/s.

</details>


### [1457] [FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38355v1)
*Xin Huang,Teng Ma,Zhuoran Li,Yibo Zhao,Zhaoshi Li,Qianchao Zhu,Wei Yang,Chenxi Wang,Tao Xie,Youwei Zhuo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FlatCake 将主机 DRAM 与 NVMe SSD 视为统一 64 位地址空间中的对等介质，通过在块创建时按会话连续、layer-major 布局直接落盘/落内存且永不迁移，消除分级缓存与迁移开销，显著提升 KV cache 命中率与 TTFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 复用系统把主机 DRAM 当作 NVMe SSD 的中间缓存，形成分级层次；但生产 LLM 负载打破了该层次的两个前提：其一，复用呈双峰分布——要么是复用距离极长的一次性块，要么是超过 DRAM 容量的多 GB 级 agentic 会话，使 DRAM 的时间过滤失效，SSD 被推到关键读路径；其二，DRAM 暂存（staging）与按驱逐顺序的布局制约了 SSD 恢复，前缀暂存缓冲区在高负载下争用导致预取中止，增量驱逐又使会话块在 SSD 上散落，无法大块顺序读。

Method: 提出 FlatCake 扁平 KV 存储架构：利用 KV 块 write-once、不可变、以会话为粒度复用的特性，在创建时即按会话连续、layer-major 顺序将每块直接放置到目标介质，且永不迁移；通过 GPUDirect Storage 把合并后的 SSD 读直接流式送入有界 GPU 窗口，并解耦 DRAM 与 SSD 请求队列以消除队头阻塞。

Result: 在 Claude Code 生产轨迹 + DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上，FlatCake 随负载上升维持 94% 命中率（Mooncake 为 64%），消除 Mooncake 的 6.5×–6.7× SSD 读放大，峰值负载平均 TTFT 降低 1.6×，总 token 吞吐提升 1.6×；在 Llama-3.1-70B 的 8K–128K 上下文下，相较 Mooncake 平均 TTFT 最多降低 2.4×，相较 Mooncake-GDS 降低 1.8×。

Conclusion: 面向真实 agentic 负载的 KV cache 复用不应建立在 DRAM 作为 SSD 中间缓存的层次结构上，而应将 DRAM 与 SSD 作为对等介质统一寻址、按会话布局一次放置，从而避免迁移、减少读放大并缓解队头阻塞。

Abstract: KV cache reuse accelerates LLM serving, but existing systems manage host DRAM and NVMe SSD as a tiered hierarchy where DRAM acts as an intermediate cache. Production LLM workloads break both premises of this hierarchy. First, bimodal reuse defeats DRAM temporal filtering, since workloads are dominated either by one-shot blocks with long reuse distances or by multi-gigabyte agentic sessions that exceed DRAM capacity, putting SSD on the critical read path. Second, DRAM staging and eviction-ordered layout bottleneck SSD restoration. Holding host staging buffers for in-flight prefixes causes contention under load that aborts prefetches, while incremental eviction scatters a session's blocks across the SSD and prevents large sequential reads.
  We present FlatCake, a flat KV storage architecture that exposes host DRAM and NVMe SSD as peer media in a unified 64-bit address space. Exploiting the fact that KV blocks are write-once, immutable, and reused at session scope, FlatCake places each block directly onto its target medium in session-contiguous, layer-major order at creation time and never migrates it. FlatCake streams coalesced SSD reads directly into a bounded GPU window via GPUDirect Storage and decouples DRAM and SSD request queues to prevent head-of-line blocking. On a production Claude Code trace with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, FlatCake sustains a 94% cache hit rate as load increases (versus 64% for Mooncake), eliminates Mooncake's $6.5\times$--$6.7\times$ SSD read amplification, and reduces peak-load mean TTFT by $1.6\times$ while improving total token throughput by $1.6\times$. Across 8K--128K contexts on Llama-3.1-70B, FlatCake further reduces mean TTFT by up to $2.4\times$ over Mooncake and $1.8\times$ over Mooncake-GDS.

</details>


### [1458] [The Endgame of FSDP Communication: Layout-Aware Collectives on Copy Engines, RDMA, and NVSwitch](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38228v1)
*Zejian Wang,Yifan Zhao,Kaihui Ren,Xiaoling Zhou,Yubin Wang,Chenhao Guan,Lin Zhang,Yufeng Li,Zhikang Mo,Zhuoru Ma,Yingtong Xiong,Jihu Guo,Yiqiao Liao,Chengru Song*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TIDE 是一组基于公开 NCCL 2.31+ API 的零拷贝集合通信原语，通过将布局放置折叠进集合通信寻址，消除 FSDP2 中 per-parameter 存储与扁平缓冲区之间的布局转换开销，并在 64 GPU 上较 Stock FSDP2 最多降低 27.1% 步时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FSDP2 以 per-parameter 张量维护参数与梯度，但其集合通信路径使用扁平的 rank-major 缓冲区，两者之间的布局转换需要把 all-gather 输出拷贝到参数存储、把梯度打包进整组 fp32 缓冲区，在 Llama-3.1 70B（8K tokens/GPU）训练中单独占步时间 6.4%。此外通信内核本身还有第二重代价：默认 NCCL reduce-scatter 会使本可单波完成的并发 GEMM 慢 69%。

Method: TIDE 保留 FSDP2 的 per-parameter 存储与计算内核，仅把布局放置折叠进集合通信地址计算，实现零拷贝：(1) TIDE-AG 用 NVSwitch 多播与受控的 recursive-doubling RDMA 将分片直接投递到参数存储，传输与放置均不占用 SM；(2) TIDE-RS 直接消费 per-parameter bf16 梯度并归约为 fp32 分片（NCCL 不提供的混合精度模式），节点内累积使用 copy engine 与短生命周期 CTA，跨节点归约使用 NVSwitch；(3) 两阶段流水线将梯度读取与网络推进解耦，Slot-Reuse 可选地把梯度暂存到已腾空的 all-gather 槽位。

Result: 在 64 GPU 上，针对 Llama-3.1 70B、Wan2.2 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B，TIDE 相对 Stock FSDP2 最多降低步时间 27.1%，相对 FSDP2+SymmMem 降低 6.0%；reduce-scatter 的 SM 时间降低 12.5–14.5 倍，与并发计算的干扰降低至多一个数量级；固定每 GPU 输出规模下，reduce-scatter 缓冲区从 16 到 64 GPU 近乎恒定；峰值内存比 FSDP2+SymmMem 低至多 4.7 GiB，在 Wan2.2 上启用 Slot-Reuse 时甚至低于 Stock FSDP2。

Conclusion: 通过零拷贝集合通信替代显式布局转换，可在不改变 FSDP2 存储与计算语义的前提下同时收获吞吐、SM 占用、通信-计算干扰、可扩展性与显存多方面的收益。

Abstract: Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP2) maintains parameters and gradients as per-parameter tensors, whereas its collective path operates on flat, rank-major buffers. Converting between these layouts copies all-gather outputs into parameter storage and packs gradients into full-group fp32 buffers. Layout conversion alone accounts for 6.4% of step time in Llama-3.1 70B training at 8K tokens per GPU. Communication kernels impose a second cost: a default NCCL reduce-scatter can slow a concurrent GEMM that would otherwise complete in a single wave by 69%. We present TIDE, a set of zero-copy collectives built on public NCCL 2.31+ APIs. TIDE preserves FSDP2's per-parameter storage and compute kernels while folding layout placement into collective addressing. TIDE-AG delivers shards directly to parameter storage using NVSwitch multicast and paced recursive-doubling RDMA, with no SMs used for transport or placement. TIDE-RS consumes per-parameter bf16 gradients directly and reduces them into fp32 shards (a mixed-precision mode that NCCL does not provide) using copy engines and short-lived thread blocks (CTAs) for node-local accumulation and NVSwitch for cross-node reduction. A two-phase pipeline separates gradient reads from network progress; Slot-Reuse optionally stages gradients in vacated all-gather slots. On 64 GPUs, TIDE reduces step time by up to 27.1% relative to Stock FSDP2 and 6.0% relative to FSDP2+SymmMem across Llama-3.1 70B, Wan2.2, and Qwen3-30B-A3B. It reduces reduce-scatter SM time by factors of 12.5-14.5 and cuts interference with concurrent compute by up to an order of magnitude. Its reduce-scatter buffer remains nearly constant from 16 to 64 GPUs at a fixed per-GPU output size, and its peak memory is up to 4.7 GiB below FSDP2+SymmMem's and, with Slot-Reuse on Wan2.2, below Stock FSDP2's.

</details>


### [1459] [GearUp: DAG-aware Acceleration for Serverless Inference Serving via Slack-guided Pre-loading](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38196v1)
*Qi Qi,Yifan Sui,Hanfei Yu,Hong Zhang,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GearUp 是一个 serverless DAG 推理服务系统，通过把 ML 节点加载阶段调度进 DAG 松弛时间、跨请求复用已初始化实例、以及流量自适应的概率保活策略，将初始化开销移出端到端关键路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Serverless 平台上 ML 推理工作流以 DAG 形式存在，每个 ML 节点除容器启动外还需加载库、模型权重与 CUDA kernel，这些加载成本沿依赖路径累积并落在端到端关键路径上。现有方案只解决一半问题：DAG 无关的预加载会准备请求可能永远到不了的节点，浪费主机与 GPU 内存；DAG 感知的服务系统只做路由与扩缩容，未触及节点内部加载阶段。

Method: GearUp 包含三部分：(1) 对每个节点的加载阶段进行 profiling，并将其调度进 DAG 暴露的 slack 时间内，把初始化隐藏在上游执行之后；(2) 在请求内部与跨请求复用已初始化实例，避免冗余冷启动；(3) 采用概率化、流量自适应的 keep-alive 策略决定空闲实例保留时长，在突发负载下权衡内存成本与冷启动风险。

Result: 在 NVIDIA L40S GPU 上，AMBER Alert 与 FINRA-ML 工作流中，相比 SMIless，GearUp 将中位端到端延迟分别降低 64.5% 与 75.9%，相对冷执行的中位加速比为 3.1x 与 10.0x；相比 InstaInfer 的急切预加载，集成 GPU 与主机内存分配最多分别下降 83.9% 与 94.6%；在四个 worker 上实现 4.2x 强扩展性。

Conclusion: 将 ML 节点加载视为可调度对象而非不可控固定开销，并以低资源代价将其从关键路径移除，是提升 serverless DAG 推理性能的有效途径；GearUp 在延迟、内存与扩展性三方面同时取得显著收益。

Abstract: Serverless platforms increasingly host machine learning (ML) inference workflows, modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of interdependent functions. Beyond container startup, each ML node must load libraries, model weights, and CUDA kernels before it can run. These costs accumulate along dependent DAG paths and place initialization on the end-to-end critical path. Existing systems optimize one half of this problem. DAG-agnostic pre-loading prepares nodes the request may never reach, wasting host and GPU memory. DAG-aware serving routes and scales whole functions, leaving the loading stages inside a node untouched. This paper presents GearUp, a serverless DAG inference serving system that removes ML-node loading from the end-to-end critical path at low resource cost. GearUp profiles the loading stages of each node and schedules them inside the slack time the DAG exposes, hiding initialization behind upstream execution. It reuses initialized instances within and across requests to avoid redundant cold starts. A probabilistic, traffic-adaptive keep-alive policy sets how long idle instances are retained, balancing memory cost against cold-start risk under bursty load. On the AMBER Alert and FINRA-ML workflows with NVIDIA L40S GPUs, GearUp reduces median end-to-end latency by 64.5% and 75.9% against SMIless, for median speedups of 3.1x and 10.0x over cold execution. Integrated GPU and host memory allocation fall by up to 83.9% and 94.6% against eager pre-loading in InstaInfer. GearUp achieves 4.2x strong scaling on four workers.

</details>


### [1460] [Agar: What-If Analysis for Microservice Applications](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36636v1)
*Saarth Deshpande,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar,Venkat Arun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AGAR 提出以"学习可解释边界"替代"预测精确值"的组件级建模思路，通过组合各组件的行为边界回答端到端反事实性能问题，并将其用于自动扩缩容（在满足 SLO 前提下最多降低 36.8% CPU 分配）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务运维需要推断应用在尚未发生的变化（不同负载、资源配置、SLO 目标）下的行为，但逐一实验成本高昂。端到端模型需在组合式条件空间上学习，而逐组件预测器组合会导致误差累积，反事实预测困难。

Method: 改变每个组件模型的学习目标：不再预测精确数值，而是学习简单、可解释的边界（bounds），这些边界覆盖所有已观测行为且足够紧以支撑端到端结论。基于此构建 AGAR 工具，组合组件模型回答端到端 SLO 可行性问题，并将自动扩缩容形式化为反事实查询——满足 SLO 所需的最小资源分配。

Result: 在三个微服务应用上，AGAR 的边界具有可操作性：其自动扩缩器相比最先进的水平扩缩器在满足 SLO 的同时将 CPU 分配最多降低 36.8%；此外还能根据负载轨迹预测运营成本、指导优化哪个服务的启动时间，并定位应用内的性能缺陷。

Conclusion: 以可解释边界替代精确值预测，可有效避免组件组合中的误差累积，使端到端反事实分析可行；该方法在自动扩缩容、成本预测与性能调试等运维任务上具备实用价值。

Abstract: Microservice operators must reason about how applications would behave under changes that have not yet occurred: different workloads, resource allocations, or SLO targets. Evaluating every alternative experimentally is expensive, but predicting such counterfactuals is difficult because microservices contain many interacting components. End-to-end models must learn behavior over a combinatorial space of conditions, but composing per-component predictors causes prediction errors to accumulate. We address this challenge by changing what each component model must predict. Rather than predicting exact values, we learn simple, interpretable bounds that contain every observed behavior while remaining tight enough to support useful end-to-end conclusions. We build AGAR, a counterfactual performance analysis tool that composes these models to answer end-to-end SLO-feasibility questions. This allows us to formulate autoscaling as a counterfactual query: what is the smallest resource allocation under which an SLO is met? Our evaluation demonstrates that across three microservice applications, AGAR's bounds are actionable: its derived autoscaler reduces CPU allocation by up to 36.8% over state-of-the-art horizontal autoscalers while satisfying application SLOs. Further, AGAR is able to predict operational cost given workload traces, provide guidance on which service's startup time to optimize and localize performance bugs within each application.

</details>


### [1461] [IOSage: Detecting HPC I/O Bottleneck Patterns to Guide LLM Recommendations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36370v1)
*Mahdi Banisharif,Tabassum Mahmud,Ahmad Tarraf,Suren Byna,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: IOSage 将“日志瓶颈判定”交给在大量标注日志上训练的分类器，LLM 只负责根据判定出的瓶颈模式、作业配置文件、逐文件 Darshan 证据与基准测试生成的“卡片”撰写优化建议；手工应用后中位总墙钟时间提升 4.38x（openPMD）与 1.42x（WRF 小时级重启），分类器在 488 条标注测试运行上达 0.929 Micro-F1，并在 TraceBench 生产轨迹上取得最高精度（0.82）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC 应用的并行文件系统带宽常被大量闲置，而把 Darshan 日志转化为具体 I/O 修复仍需稀缺的 I/O 专家。基于规则的工具靠专家设定的阈值判断计数器，而 ION、IOAgent 等基于 LLM 的工具由 LLM 决定日志中存在哪些瓶颈；但单条日志无法给 LLM 提供“何为异常”的基线，导致误报，因此需要一条不依赖 LLM 进行瓶颈判定的路径。

Method: 提出 IOSage：由在大量标注日志上训练的分类器（而非 LLM）判定瓶颈。LLM 的输入包括分类器检测到的 I/O 瓶颈模式、作业配置文件、逐文件 Darshan 证据，以及每个模式一张由基准训练运行构建的“卡片”，据此撰写推荐修改。评估方式为人工应用修改并在重复配对运行中测量；对比 Drishti 规则、WisIO、IOAgent 流水线及其文献检索模块，并在 TraceBench 的 9 条生产系统专家标注轨迹上评估。

Result: 修改后中位总墙钟时间提升：openPMD 内核 4.38x（第二存储层级 4.02x），WRF 小时级重启 1.42x；在 6 个存在有效改进的应用场景中，Claude Sonnet 4 下的 IOSage 为 5 个命名出该修改，含 10 分钟 WRF 重启（最高 1.93x）；使用 GPT-4o 与 Llama 3.1 时，分类器+卡片也比单独 LLM 给出更多有效修改。78 条无模式的基准测试运行中，单独 LLM 提出修改 64 次，加入分类器后仅 9 次。分类器在 488 条标注基准测试运行上 Micro-F1 为 0.929（作为门控时 0.916；来自训练外配置与作业的 158 条上为 0.832），优于 Drishti 规则、WisIO 及去掉文献检索的 IOAgent 流水线。TraceBench 上，在与注册模式匹配的五个问题标签上精度最高（0.82），误报 2 次，对比关键词映射式 LLM 诊断的 12 次与 Drishti 的 5 次。

Conclusion: 以监督分类器替代 LLM 做瓶颈判定、LLM 仅承担建议生成，可同时提升诊断精度与端到端性能收益：既抑制了无模式场景下 LLM 的过度建议（64 降至 9），又在生产轨迹上取得最高精度与更少误报。该“分类器判定 + 证据卡片 + LLM 撰写”的分工在多个模型骨干下均优于纯 LLM 方案。

Abstract: HPC applications often leave much of their parallel file system's bandwidth unused, and turning their Darshan logs into concrete I/O fixes still requires a scarce I/O expert. Rule-based tools flag counters against thresholds set by experts, and in tools built on large language models (LLMs), such as ION and IOAgent, the LLM decides which bottlenecks a log contains. We present IOSage, in which a classifier trained on many labeled logs, not the LLM, makes that decision, since a single log gives an LLM no baseline for what is abnormal. The LLM receives the I/O bottleneck patterns the classifier detects, the job's configuration files, per-file Darshan evidence, and for each pattern a card built from benchmark training runs, and writes recommended changes. Applied by hand and measured in repeated paired runs, the changes IOSage names speed up median total wall time 4.38x for an openPMD kernel (4.02x on a second storage tier) and 1.42x for hourly WRF restarts. For 5 of the 6 application scenarios with a helpful change, IOSage with Claude Sonnet 4 names it, including the change for 10-minute WRF restarts (up to 1.93x faster); with GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 as well, the classifier and cards name more helpful changes than the LLM alone. On 78 benchmark test runs without a pattern, the LLM deciding alone proposes changes for 64; with the classifier, for 9. The classifier reaches 0.929 Micro-F1 on 488 labeled benchmark test runs (0.916 as the gate; 0.832 on the 158 from configurations and jobs outside training), above Drishti's rules, WisIO, and IOAgent's pipeline without its literature retrieval. On TraceBench's nine expert-labeled traces from production systems, it has the highest precision of the tools compared (0.82), with 2 false positives against 12 for the keyword-mapped LLM diagnoses shipped with TraceBench and 5 for Drishti, on the five issue labels that match registered patterns.

</details>


### [1462] [WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35529v1)
*Bingnan Liu,Ruini Xue*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: WorldPager 将交互式世界模型的 KV 检索内存按 GPU/DRAM/NVMe 层级存放而非重计算，基于相机位姿预取，在单张 RTX 4090 上实现零停顿生成 37.5 分钟视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需保留历史 chunk 的 KV 作检索内存以维持重访场景一致性，但在单机消费级配置（1×RTX 4090、32 GiB 主机内存、1×NVMe SSD）下遇到两个瓶颈：容量上，Matrix-Game 2.0 的 KV 在 bf16 下 45 秒、int4 下 2.8 分钟即耗尽主机内存；模型本身的位置编码视界仅 4.3 分钟。

Method: 作者指出该内存瓶颈是容量受限而非带宽受限，且因相机位姿是输入，访问集在计算前即已知。据此建立解析模型预测溢出点并判定是否发生停顿；进而设计 WorldPager：将 int4 KV 存放于 GPU/DRAM/NVMe 层级（而非重计算），依据外推位姿预取每个 chunk 的内存，从不等待缺失，并后台写回；配合免训练的位置处理。

Result: 解析模型对溢出点的预测误差在一个 chunk 以内，并在留出配置上正确区分零停顿与非零停顿。WorldPager 连续生成 37.5 分钟视频，零停顿、主机内存恒定，约 9.5 FPS。封闭测试集上 int4 存储无明显质量损失；长间隔重访时图像质量下降约 1 个 MUSIQ 分。

Conclusion: 该工作据称是首个把交互式世界模型的 KV 内存下沉到 NVMe 层并实现零停顿预取的方法，突破了消费级单机上交互式世界模型记忆的容量与位置视界限制。

Abstract: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

</details>


### [1463] [When and Why to Use TMA: A Workload-Grounded Characterization of Tensor Memory Acceleration on NVIDIA Hopper GPUs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34907v1)
*Christin David Bose,Cesar Avalos,Junrui Pan,Timothy Rogers*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文在 H100 上对 TMA、multicast、DSM 与 cp.async 的选用进行工作负载驱动的刻画研究：以 FlashAttention-3 为对象拆解其算子级选择，用微基准分离判别特征，给出 Hopper 装载机制选择的经验规则，并对比 TMA multicast 与 DSM，最后在 B200（SM100）上验证规则的跨代可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TMA 在 Hopper 上被广泛使用，但生产级内核（CUTLASS、FlashAttention-3、FlashInfer）对其使用明显有选择性：部分张量操作数用 TMA，另一些则退回 cp.async、全局直读或 DSM。厂商文档只描述 API，近期微基准只刻画孤立吞吐，均无法回答实践者真正面对的问题：某个内存操作数是否该用 TMA，以及是否配合 cluster multicast。该空白导致装载机制选择缺乏可预测依据。

Method: 在 H100 上开展工作负载驱动的刻画研究：(1) 系统梳理 FlashAttention-3 前向中 TMA、multicast、DSM、cp.async 的实际选择；(2) 通过定向微基准分离判别特征，包括传输尺寸交叉点与 multicast 扩展性；(3) 归纳 Hopper 上装载机制选择的经验规则；(4) 将 TMA multicast 与 DSM 作为竞争性的 cluster 广播原语进行对比；(5) 针对 FlashAttention-3 的分页 KV 场景，在页大小、数据类型、模型形状与执行阶段各维度上分离 TMA 与 cp.async 的调度边界；(6) 通过 B200 上的 CUTLASS GEMM 研究将分析扩展至 Blackwell（SM100）。

Result: 给出关于 TMA 何时收益为正、multicast 何时有利或有害的具体且具预测性的指导；明确传输尺寸交叉点与 multicast 扩展行为；刻画分页 KV 在页大小、数据类型、模型形状和执行阶段上的 TMA/cp.async 分派边界；B200 上的 GEMM 研究表明定性分派规则可跨代沿用，而绝对交叉点随张量核心与带宽的规模变化而移动。

Conclusion: TMA 的采用不应是全局开关，而应按操作数粒度依据传输尺寸、是否可 cluster 广播、执行阶段等因素分派；multicast 与 DSM 是可竞争的广播原语，需按场景取舍。所得规则在 Hopper 上具预测性，并可定性迁移到 Blackwell，但需按硬件规模重新标定交叉点。

Abstract: The Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), introduced on NVIDIA Hopper, is used pervasively in production GPU kernels yet its usage is conspicuously selective: expert kernel developers in CUTLASS, FlashAttention-3, and FlashInfer apply TMA to some tensor operands within a kernel but fall back to cp.async, direct global loads, or distributed shared memory (DSM) for others. Vendor documentation describes the API, and recent microbenchmarking work characterizes TMA throughput in isolation, but neither answers the question practitioners actually face: given a memory operand in a kernel, should it use TMA, and if so, with or without cluster multicast? We address this gap with a workload-grounded characterization study on H100. We catalog the TMA, multicast, DSM, and cp.async choices made inside FlashAttention-3 forward, isolate the discriminating features through targeted microbenchmarks (transfer-size crossover, multicast scaling), and produce rules of thumb for the load-mechanism choice on Hopper. We further compare TMA multicast against DSM as competing cluster-broadcast primitives, and isolate the FlashAttention-3 paged-key-value (KV) TMA-vs-cp.async dispatch on H100 across page size, datatype, model shape, and execution phase. Our results yield concrete, predictive guidance on when TMA pays off and when multicast helps or hurts on Hopper, and we extend the analysis to server Blackwell (SM100) via a CUTLASS GEMM study on B200 that shows the qualitative dispatch rules carry across generations while absolute crossovers shift with tensor-core and bandwidth scaling.

</details>


### [1464] [Do Bio-Inspired Algorithms Save Energy in Data Centres? Separating Server Packing from Migration Search in Virtual Machine Consolidation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34102v1)
*Yichiet Aun,Yu Hang Woo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过CloudSim Plus复现已有虚拟机整合实现，并引入"匹配对照"（保留初始装箱与空主机停机机制、去除迁移搜索），系统评估ACO、PSO与改进遗传算法（MGA）的净贡献。结果表明能耗节省绝大多数来自初始装箱与主机关闭，元启发式迁移搜索在多数情形下不降反增能耗，仅ACO在轻载异构负载下有3.22个百分点的稳健改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心用电持续增长，VM整合的节能研究普遍报告元启发式（ACO/PSO/GA）带来显著节能；但这些评估通常与在"初始放置"和"迁移优化"两方面都不同的传统策略对比，导致无法区分节能究竟源于元启发式搜索还是源于初始装箱与主机停用机制，评价缺乏公平性。

Method: 在CloudSim Plus中复现既有整合实现，并设计匹配对照：保留相同的初始装箱（initial packing）与空主机去激活机制，但不含迁移搜索。对ACO、PSO与改进遗传算法（MGA）在2种机群配置×4种负载工况下评估，每条件做10次随机重复；共24组对比，采用Holm校正检验显著性，并以"交付计算工作量"对能耗做归一化以排除未完成任务造成的假性节能。

Result: 匹配对照相对spreading基线节能0.8%–81.4%，且节能空间随负载升高急剧缩小，全程无迁移、无任务未完成。24组对比中，元启发式搜索在11例增加能耗、7例结果相同、6例降低；Holm校正后10例增加与5例降低仍显著。6例"节能"中5例伴随任务未完成，按交付工作量归一化后消失；仅ACO在轻载异构负载下保持3.22个百分点改进（95% CI 2.96–3.47）。

Conclusion: 在所考察的实现中，初始装箱与主机停用解释了大部分测得的节能，元启发式迁移搜索的边际贡献有限甚至为负。可靠的VM整合算法评估必须采用匹配对照条件，并引入工作负载完成度指标（如按交付工作量归一化），否则易高估元启发式的作用。

Abstract: Energy-efficient virtual machine (VM) consolidation matters as data centre electricity demand rises. Bio-inspired metaheuristics, including ant colony optimisation (ACO), particle swarm optimisation (PSO), and genetic algorithms, have reported substantial energy savings. However, these improvements are commonly evaluated against conventional allocation policies that differ in both initial VM placement and subsequent migration optimisation, making it difficult to determine the contribution of metaheuristic search. This study reproduces an existing consolidation implementation in CloudSim Plus and introduces a matched control that retains the same initial packing and empty-host deactivation mechanisms but excludes migration search. ACO, PSO, and a modified genetic algorithm (MGA) are evaluated across two fleet configurations and four workload regimes, with ten stochastic replications per condition. The matched control achieves energy savings of 0.8-81.4% relative to the spreading baseline, the amount available falling sharply as load rises, without migrations or incomplete workload execution. Across 24 comparisons, metaheuristic search increases energy consumption in 11 cases, produces identical outcomes in seven, and reduces consumption in six. Of these, ten increases and five reductions remain statistically significant after Holm correction. Five of the six apparent reductions coincide with unfinished tasks and disappear after normalisation by delivered computational work. Only ACO under light heterogeneous load retains a 3.22-percentage-point improvement (95% CI 2.96-3.47). These findings demonstrate that initial packing and host deactivation account for most of the measured energy savings in the examined implementations, highlighting the importance of matched control conditions and workload-completion measures for reliable evaluation of VM consolidation algorithms.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [1465] [Tunable Spatial Task Allocation with Application to Maritime Swarms](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39018v1)
*Vishnudatta Thota,Tyler Paine,Anastasia Bizyaeva*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本章提出一种基于非线性意见动力学推广的任务分配策略，使自主智能体团队能在空间嵌入任务间灵活重构分配，宏观上可呈现从最大分散到共识状态的多种可解释模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受自适应海上勘测应用启发，需要一组自主智能体在众多空间嵌入任务间灵活重构成员分布，并厘清环境几何、社会交互性质与任务需求三者相互作用如何塑造宏观分配格局。

Method: 将近期提出的非线性意见动力学模型进行推广，并把意见动力学直接耦合到空间移动上；通过仿真调节社会耦合强度以调节群体凝聚力，考察不同参数区间下的涌现分配；采用基于距离的任务偏好、智能体数与任务数匹配的设定，将最终分配与匈牙利最优解做数值比较；并在MOOS-IvP-Multi仿真环境中用模拟自主水下航行器（AUV）在真实通信约束下验证。

Result: 仿真显示社会耦合强度在不同且可解释的参数区间内产生从最大分散、到含少量不同子群的半分散、再到最大凝聚共识的宏观分配模式；示例表明团队可随任务需求变化实时重构自身；在与匈牙利最优解对比中表现出接近最优的性能；并在带通信约束的MOOS-IvP-Multi/AUV仿真中验证了方法性能。

Conclusion: 一套统一的局部交互规则即可支撑大范围可解释的宏观分配状态及其间灵活切换，说明该意见动力学耦合方法在空间嵌入任务的可重构分配中兼具可解释性与近优性能。

Abstract: In this chapter, we explore how a team of autonomous agents can flexibly reconfigure the distribution of its members across many spatially embedded tasks using a task allocation strategy grounded in a generalization of the recently proposed Nonlinear Opinion Dynamics model. Motivated by an adaptive maritime survey application, we couple opinion dynamics directly to spatial movement and examine how the emergent macroscopic allocation is shaped by the interplay between environmental geometry, nature of social interactions, and task demands. We illustrate in simulation how social coupling in the model tunes group cohesion, producing macroscopic allocation patterns ranging from maximally dispersed states, to intermediate semi-dispersed states with a smaller number of distinct subgroups, to maximally cohesive consensus states, in distinct and interpretable parameter regimes. Furthermore, we demonstrate with illustrative examples how a team can reconfigure itself in real time under changing task demands. For allocation scenarios with distance-based task preference and matched number of agents and tasks, we relate numerically the final allocation in the group to the Hungarian optimum, illustrating close-to-optimal performance. We illustrate performance of this method under realistic communication constraints in the MOOS-IvP-Multi simulation environment with simulated autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). Together, these examples show how a common set of local interaction rules can support a large range of interpretable macroscopic allocation states and flexible transitions between them.

</details>


### [1466] [Cooperative EV Charging Assignment Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: A Comparison of QMIX and Independent Q-Learning Under Urban Traffic Uncertainty](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38053v1)
*Nour-Eddine Moumni,Rachid Alaoui,Driss Kiouach*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 论文将多站点充电桩分配问题建模为Dec-POMDP，用SUMO六站点仿真比较QMIX（CTDE）与IQL，5个随机种子、200训练回合、100–250辆/小时四档车流下，QMIX平均奖励+0.776 vs +0.578，接受率72.4%→94.0%，消融显示增益主要来自CTDE架构而非合作奖励塑形或经验共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个异质充电设施常服务同一请求流却只掌握局部信息，单站"可辩护"的接受/拒绝决策可能损害整个充电区域的整体效率，因此需要考察如何在该去中心化局部观测场景中实现有效协调。

Method: 将电动汽车—公共充电站分配建模为Dec-POMDP；以QMIX实例化CTDE，与协作式独立Q学习（IQL）基线对比；评估平台为SUMO仿真的六站点城市网络，5个独立随机种子、200训练回合、4档车流场景（100–250 veh/h）；并进行五组变体消融，分别考察CTDE架构、合作奖励项与经验共享的作用。

Result: QMIX每决策平均奖励+0.776，IQL为+0.578（Δ=+0.198，配对Cohen's dz=2.98，双侧精确Wilcoxon p=0.0625，即该样本量下可达到的最小值）；接受率由72.4%提升至94.0%（Δ=+21.6个百分点，dz=5.24，p=0.0625）。五变体消融表明，在固定合作奖励项时增益主要归因于CTDE架构，但未用单一种子严格隔离；合作奖励塑形与经验共享无明确描述性收益，甚至可能略微降低表现。

Conclusion: 对多站点充电分配而言，协调能力应内嵌于学习架构（CTDE），而非仅靠启发式合作奖励项附加；但统计显著性与架构归因受样本量（5种子）限制，需更大规模实验进一步验证。

Abstract: The allocation of electric vehicles to public charging stations is increasingly constrained by the fact that several heterogeneous facilities often serve the same stream of requests while observing only partial local information. An accept/reject decision that is defensible for one station may nevertheless reduce the efficiency of the charging district as a whole. We formulate this operational problem as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) and examine whether Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE), instantiated through QMIX, improves assignment performance relative to a cooperative Independent Q-Learning baseline (IQL). The evaluation uses a six-station urban network simulated with SUMO, five independent random seeds, 200 training episodes, and four traffic flux scenarios ranging from 100 to 250 vehicles/hour. Under this protocol, QMIX reaches a mean reward per evaluated decision of +0.776, versus +0.578 for IQL (delta = +0.198, seed-paired Cohens dz = 2.98, exact two-sided Wilcoxon p = 0.0625, the minimum attainable value at this sample size), and raises the acceptance rate from 72.4% to 94.0% (delta = +21.6 pp, dz = 5.24, Wilcoxon p = 0.0625). A five-variant ablation suggests this gain is primarily attributable to the CTDE architecture when holding cooperative reward terms fixed, though not formally isolated with a single seed. By contrast, cooperative reward shaping and experience sharing show no clear descriptive benefit and may slightly reduce performance. These findings support the view that, for multi-station charging assignment, coordination should be embedded in the learning architecture rather than added only through heuristic cooperation terms.

</details>


### [1467] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Global Climate Policy Cooperation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37870v1)
*Anne Moll-Elsborg,Oskar Bohn Lassen,Francisco Camara Pereira*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该文在现有多智能体强化学习（MARL）气候合作框架上引入多阶段谈判机制（提议、接受/拒绝、违约惩罚），在4个同质智能体的理想化设定下发现：无约束力的协议难以克服搭便车，适度的违约惩罚能提升合作并降低升温，但惩罚过强反而抑制雄心承诺，呈现"执行与参与"的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国际气候政策需要各国协调，但减排的成本本地化、收益全球化导致搭便车动机。经典博弈论与综合评估模型依赖预设的行为假设或均衡概念，难以刻画合作的自发涌现；因此作者希望用MARL将气候政策合作建模为重复策略互动的涌现结果，并进一步研究"协议设计"本身如何影响学习到的减排行为。

Method: 扩展一个已有的MARL气候框架，加入多阶段谈判机制：智能体提出协议、对其他承诺表示接受或拒绝，并面对违约惩罚；通过改变协议约束力与惩罚强度，比较不同协议设计下的学习动态。

Result: 在4个同质智能体的理想化环境中：（1）非约束性协议对克服搭便车作用很小；（2）适度违约惩罚改善合作、降低升温；（3）惩罚过强会抑制高雄心承诺，暴露执行力度与参与广度之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位为方法论贡献——用于检验协议设计（如约束力、惩罚强度）对合作与气候结果的影响，而非对现实谈判的预测模型；强调了执行与参与权衡这一协议设计的核心张力。

Abstract: International climate policy requires coordination among countries whose mitigation decisions impose local costs but generate global benefits. Classical game-theoretic and integrated assessment approaches can study these incentives, but typically rely on prescribed behavioural assumptions or equilibrium concepts. Recent work has therefore explored Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning as a way to model climate-policy cooperation as an emergent outcome of repeated strategic interaction. We extend an existing MARL climate framework with a multi-stage negotiation mechanism in which agents propose agreements, accept or reject commitments, and face penalties for non-compliance. This allows us to study how agreement design affects learned mitigation behaviour, compliance, and climate outcomes. In an idealized setting with four homogeneous agents, we find that non-binding agreements do little to overcome free-riding, while moderate non-compliance penalties improve cooperation and reduce warming. However, excessively strong penalties discourage ambitious commitments, revealing a trade-off between enforcement and participation. We position the framework as a methodological contribution for testing agreement design rather than a predictive model of real negotiations.

</details>


### [1468] [Selective and Hybrid-State Communication for Latent Multi-Agent Systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37779v1)
*Miles Liao,Aaron Smieszek,Yuhao Ge*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该文针对LLM多智能体系统中潜在通信开销大的问题，提出两种互补方法：SelectKV（面向常规Transformer的选择性KV状态通信）与HyLaMAS（面向混合线性注意力模型的KV缓存+循环状态共享工作区通信）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型多智能体系统的主要瓶颈是通信效率；潜在通信虽减少了重复自然语言交换，但传输内部状态仍然昂贵，且现有设计大多基于传统KV-cache表示，未覆盖混合架构，也未优化KV传输本身的冗余。

Method: 从两个互补角度切入：(1) SelectKV——边界感知(boundary-aware)方法，选择性传输KV状态，同时保护已继承的上下文；(2) HyLaMAS——将潜在协作扩展到混合线性注意力模型，通过共享工作区同时通信KV缓存与循环状态(recurrent states)。

Result: 在六个基准上，SelectKV将通信的KV位置数与逻辑KV载荷减少9.7%–9.9%；两个基准精度不变，三个基准下降在1个百分点以内，HumanEval+下降6个点。在不同规模的Qwen3.5模型上，HyLaMAS将解码输出token数减少53%–80%，相对文本式多智能体通信取得1.16–2.78倍加速。

Conclusion: 两种方法经独立评估，构成面向传统Transformer与混合模型架构的高效潜在状态通信的互补路径；SelectKV在精度基本保持下削减KV传输冗余，HyLaMAS显著降低输出token开销并带来可观加速。

Abstract: Efficient communication remains a major bottleneck in large language model multiagent systems. Latent communication reduces repeated natural-language exchange by transferring internal model states between agents, but these transfers remain costly and are typically designed around conventional KV-cache representations. We address this problem from two complementary perspectives. We introduce SelectKV, a boundary-aware method that selectively communicates KV states while protecting inherited context, and HyLaMAS, which extends latent collaboration to hybrid linear-attention models by communicating both KV caches and recurrent states through a shared workspace. Across six benchmarks, SelectKV reduces communicated KV positions and logical KV payload by 9.7-9.9%, with accuracy unchanged on two benchmarks, within one percentage point on three, and six points lower on HumanEval+. Across Qwen3.5 model scales, HyLaMAS reduces decoded output tokens by 53-80% and achieves 1.16-2.78x speedups relative to text-based multi-agent communication. Together, these independently evaluated methods represent two complementary approaches to efficient latent-state communication across conventional Transformer and hybrid model architectures.

</details>


### [1469] [Compatibility and future-proof testing for multi-agent systems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36289v1)
*Yueshan Li,Lorenzo Fiaschi,Andrea Censi,Emilio Frazzoli*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出"未来兼容性"(future-proofness)双层框架：监管者发布种子智能体，开发者独立测试其智能体与所有种子兼容的智能体兼容，从而在无协调情况下保证联合兼容；形式化通用多智能体系统的兼容性，刻画未来兼容智能体为种子的闭包并证明其单调性，并研究仅与种子交互的可执行测试的区分能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要求在任何智能体部署前集中设计规范或交互机制。但当智能体设计对开发者保密时，集中式设计不现实，且缺乏对未来新智能体的灵活性。因此需要一个去中心化、可扩展的兼容性保障结构。

Method: 建立双层结构：监管者发布种子智能体，开发者独立测试各自智能体相对于种子的兼容性（future-proofness）。首先形式化通用多智能体系统的兼容性概念；然后证明种子兼容并不平凡地蕴含联合兼容；接着将未来兼容智能体刻画为种子集合的闭包，并证明该闭包对种子单调；最后研究一类仅通过与种子交互实现的可执行测试，分析其对未来兼容智能体的区分能力。

Result: 给出了通用多智能体系统兼容性的形式化定义；说明种子兼容不能平凡推出联合兼容；证明未来兼容智能体构成种子闭包且闭包关于种子单调；刻画了仅与种子交互的可执行测试所能达到的区分范围。

Conclusion: 种子＋独立测试的双层结构可在无智能体间协调的情况下保证任意独立设计智能体的联合兼容，闭包刻画与单调性为监管者设计种子提供理论依据，并明确了可执行测试的能力边界。

Abstract: Independently developed autonomous agents, such as autonomous vehicles, must guarantee joint compatibility, such as safety and task-completion requirements, when they operate in a shared environment. Existing methods require a centrally designed specification, or interaction mechanism before any agent is deployed. However, such centralized design is unrealistic when agent designs are confidential to their developers, and it is not flexible enough to accommodate future agent designs. We study a bi-level structure in which a regulator coordinates developers by publishing seed agents, and each developer independently tests its agent to ensure that it is compatible with every seed-compatible agent, a property we call future-proofness. Under this structure, joint compatibility is guaranteed for any agents that are designed and tested independently, without any coordination with each other. In this work, we first formulate compatibility for general multi-agent systems and show why it is not trivially implied by seed-compatibility. We then characterize the future-proof agents as the closure of the seed and show that this closure is monotone in the seed. Finally, we study a class of executable tests that involve interaction with the seed alone, and we ask to what extent such tests can distinguish the future-proof agents.

</details>


### [1470] [Preference-Guided Cooperation in Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35736v1)
*Qiyue Xia,J. Michael Herrmann*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 该论文研究多目标多智能体强化学习（MOMARL），提出利用多目标结构本身促进协作，而非将其视为额外优化难题，并提出MIRL方法（静态MIRL-S与动态MIRL-D）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MOMARL工作将多智能体合作与多目标优化视为相对独立的组成部分，导致复杂度极高（除非是平凡情形）。作者希望探究多目标所提供的结构能否被直接用于促进合作。

Method: 在团队与个体两个层面形式化MOMARL；引入"按目标的反事实信用分配"（objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment）评估每个智能体对团队各目标的贡献；结合元梯度信息提出MIRL，包含静态（MIRL-S）与动态（MIRL-D）两种变体，使智能体学习如何各自确定目标优先级，同时集体优化系统级目标。

Result: 在多目标多粒子环境（multi-objective multiple particle environment）上的实验表明，所提方法在Pareto前沿质量上优于基线，其中动态变体（MIRL-D）性能最佳。

Conclusion: 多目标结构可直接用于引导合作，元梯度信息使个体目标优先级学习与团队系统级优化得以协同，动态优先级机制效果更强。

Abstract: Multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning (MOMARL) addresses agent coordination and objective trade-offs simultaneously while optimising overall system performance. Existing work tends to treat multi-agent cooperation and multi-objective optimisation as largely independent components of a learning problem, which amounts to an exorbitant complexity except in trivial cases. We study here whether the structure provided by multiple objectives can itself be exploited to facilitate cooperation, rather than being treated as an additional optimisation challenge. We formulate MOMARL at both the team and individual levels and introduce objective-wise counterfactual credit assignment to evaluate each agent's contribution across the team objectives. We propose Meta-Gradient Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MIRL), with static (MIRL-S) and dynamic (MIRL-D) variants. By incorporating meta-gradient information, MIRL enables agents to learn how to prioritise objectives individually while collectively optimising the system-level objective, allowing the multi-objective structure to directly guide cooperation. Experiments on a multi-objective multiple particle environment show that our methods improve Pareto-front quality over baselines, with the dynamic variant achieving the strongest performance.

</details>


### [1471] [BE-CTDE: Blockchain-Enabled Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Anomaly Detection and Token Economics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34121v1)
*Chih-Wei Huang,Hsin-Chieh Lee,Yun-Chen Yu,Ibrahim Althamary,Rongxing Lu,Phone Lin*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出BE-CTDE框架，用区块链作为主动训练管理层，将行为验证与代币激励（罚没、销毁、奖励、补偿）结合，使可审计行为决定智能体对全局策略更新的贡献，并给出单轮激励条件、有限期望排除时间界与有限种群容量界，在MAPF对抗实验中显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习可支撑物联网系统的协同决策，但策略性偏离会破坏协调并削弱对训练过程的信任，现有方法缺乏把可审计行为与学习影响相挂钩的机制。

Method: BE-CTDE：以区块链作为主动训练管理层；行为验证器将实际执行轨迹与共享策略建议比对，其标记驱动由罚没、销毁、奖励与补偿组成的代币机制；保留余额决定各智能体对全局策略更新的贡献权重。理论部分推导考虑动作相关补偿与偏离收益的单轮激励条件、显式条件检测与记账假设下的有限期望排除时间界，以及刻画种群相对检测器极限的精确有限种群容量界。评测采用多智能体路径规划（MAPF）实验。

Result: MAPF实验中，BE-CTDE在受攻击时成功率显著高于先进的学习型路径规划器，即使对抗者为多数亦然；在所有配置下优于部分防御基线，碰撞率较"检测但无经济后果"低至多35%，较传统质押罚没低至多43%。

Conclusion: 行为验证与代币反馈能够支撑可问责的协同学习，且完美检测并非必要；检测器存在有限种群容量上的固有限制。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning supports cooperative decision-making in Internet of Things systems, but strategic deviations can disrupt coordination and undermine confidence in the training process. This paper proposes Blockchain-Enabled Centralized Training and Decentralized Execution (BE-CTDE), which uses blockchain as an active training-management layer. A behavioral verifier compares executed trajectories with shared-policy recommendations; its flags drive a token mechanism combining slashing, burning, rewards, and compensation. Retained balances determine each agent's contribution to the global policy update, connecting auditable behavior to learning influence. We derive a one-round incentive condition that accounts for action-dependent compensation and the payoff from deviation, and a finite expected exclusion-time bound under explicit conditional detection and accounting assumptions, showing perfect detection is unnecessary. An exact finite-population capacity bound characterizes the limits of the population-relative detector. In multi-agent path finding experiments, BE-CTDE outperforms a state-of-the-art learning-based path planner with substantially higher success rates under attack, even when adversaries form the majority. It also outperforms partially defended baselines in all configurations, with collision rates up to 35% lower than under detection without economic consequences and up to 43% lower than under conventional stake slashing. Together, these results characterize how behavioral verification and token feedback can support accountable cooperative learning.

</details>

### [1472] [UnEZ: A Fully Unsupervised Self-Templating Neural Network for Redshift and Line Strength Estimation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38816v1)
*Asha Abd,Karl Glazebrook,Colin Jacobs*

Main category: astro-ph.IM

TL;DR: UnEZ是一个完全无监督、物理信息驱动的机器学习模型，无需任何红移或谱线强度标签即可从光谱中预测光谱红移与谱线强度，性能可与现代红移估计算法竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着光谱巡天规模扩大，估计金属丰度、恒星形成率、红移等星系属性在计算上愈发繁重；现有方法依赖模板光谱或人工整理的红移目录，难以代表大尺度巡天中观测到的天体多样性。

Method: 提出UnEZ：编码器预测发射线/吸收线的振幅与宽度，固定的确定性解码器据此构建唯一模板、估计红移、红移置信曲线与光谱模型；模型完全无监督，无需先验红移或谱线强度标签。在SDSS DR18上测试，以其经过充分校验的红移目录作为独立基准。

Result: 在无模板、无谱线强度标签、无红移标签条件下，SNR>10时离群率0.459%、NMAD为1.237×10⁻⁴；SNR>3时离群率3.89%、NMAD为1.471×10⁻⁴。此外，其谱线强度与红移预测可用于构建传统红移估计算法所需的模板光谱等多种用途。

Conclusion: UnEZ表明全无监督神经网络可使红移等星系属性从光谱自身自然涌现，提供了一种免模板、免标签且可扩展至未来巡天需求的方法。

Abstract: As spectroscopic surveys grow, estimating galaxy properties such as metallicity, star formation rate, and redshift becomes computationally cumbersome. Methods of estimating such properties rely on template spectra or curated redshift catalogs, which fail to represent the diversity of objects seen in large-scale surveys. We present UnEZ, a fully unsupervised, physics-informed machine learning model that can predict spectroscopic redshifts and line strengths with no prior redshift or line strength labels. An encoder predicts emission and absorption line amplitudes/widths, and a fixed deterministic decoder constructs a unique template, estimated redshift, redshift confidence curve, and spectral model. UnEZ was tested on the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Data Release 18 due to its large dataset and thoroughly vetted redshift catalog which serves as an independent benchmark. Despite the lack of templates, line strength labels, or redshift labels, UnEZ's performance competes with modern redshift estimation algorithms. At SNR > 10, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 0.459% and a normalized median absolute deviation (NMAD) of $1.237 \times 10^{-4}$. At SNR > 3, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 3.89% and an NMAD of $1.471 \times 10^{-4}$. Furthermore, we demonstrate how UnEZ's line strength and redshift predictions can be utilized for various purposes such as constructing template spectra required in traditional redshift estimation algorithms. UnEZ illustrates how a fully unsupervised neural network can allow redshift, among other galaxy properties, to emerge naturally from the spectra themselves, providing a template-free, label-free approach that scales to the demands of future surveys.

</details>

# math.ST [[Back]](#toc)

### [1473] [Regression Functions as Fields on Covariate Space: Evolution Equations, the Hessian, and Identification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37500v2)
*Nobuaki Tanaka*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 该文将时变回归函数 $m_t(x)=E[Y_t\mid X_t=x]$ 视为协变量空间上的场，证明当协变量按扩散运动、结果有其自身动力学时，$m_t$ 满足一个二阶演化方程（含Hessian扩散项、逆时漂移输运项与源项），并给出逆时路径上的Feynman-Kac表示；由此联系统计学中的二次回归与核平滑偏差，以及对双稳态复制动力学的行波（恰为logistic）识别，最终讨论"协变量空间中的扩散源于个体特征波动还是相似单位间的模仿"，指出二者在回归场中观测等价，但面板数据可通过识别 $Σ$ 分离，并提出分割样本工具变量检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机：跨期回归函数 $m_t$ 通常被当作一系列独立拟合对象，缺乏刻画其在协变量空间上如何随时间演化的结构性理论；同时，经验研究中"协变量空间中的扩散"可被解释为个体特征的随机波动，也可被解释为相似个体间的模仿/传染，二者难以区分，需要理论工具与可操作的识别策略。

Method: 方法：(1) 把 $m_t$ 视为协变量空间上的场，在协变量服从扩散、各单元结果具自身动力学的设定下推导 $m_t$ 的二阶演化方程，其扩散项为 $\tfrac12\mathrm{tr}(\Sigma\nabla^2 m_t)$，输运项为逆时协变量过程的漂移，源项为结果的条件均值变化率，并得到沿逆时协变量路径的Feynman-Kac表示；(2) 将Hessian与二次回归（高斯设计下最优二次逼近的Hessian为 $E[\nabla^2 m(X)]$）及核平滑偏差相联系；(3) 在协变量空间的双稳态复制动力学中求行波解，证明其关于 $(x,t)$ 恰为logistic形式，从而用一次logistic回归识别扩散-反应比与入侵策略；(4) 论证模仿与协变量波动作用于同一算子、在回归场中观测等价，利用面板数据直接识别 $\Sigma$ 加以分离；(5) 提出分割样本工具变量检验，并借助agent-based实验评估其水平与功效。

Result: 结果：$m_t$ 的演化方程与Feynman-Kac表示成立；Hessian项与二次回归、核平滑偏差具有明确对应；双稳态复制动力学的行波为logistic形式，单一logistic回归即可识别扩散-反应比与入侵策略；模仿与协变量波动在回归场中观测等价，面板数据可借 $\Sigma$ 识别分离二者，但在行波上不可分离；所提出的分割样本工具变量检验在"有种子、非行波"的分布剖面上具备可评估的检验水平与功效。

Conclusion: 结论：时变回归函数可由一个扩散-输运-源项结构所支配的演化方程刻画，这为跨期回归分析提供了统一的连续时间框架，并将统计平滑偏差、社会动力学行波与识别问题纳入同一语言；个体层面波动与相互模仿在回归场层面不可区分，但在行波结构上完全不可识别，需依赖面板数据中的协变量增量协方差或种子化非行波剖面上的工具变量设计才能实现分离。

Abstract: For each time $t$, the regression function $m_t(x)=E[Y_t\mid X_t=x]$ of an outcome on contemporaneous covariates can be regarded as a field on covariate space. When the covariates of units move as a diffusion and each unit's outcome has its own dynamics, we show that $m_t$ satisfies a second-order evolution equation whose diffusion term is $\frac12\mathrm{tr}(Σ\nabla^2 m_t)$, the Hessian of the regression function weighted by the covariance $Σ$ of covariate increments, whose transport term is the drift of the time-reversed covariate process, and whose source term is the conditional mean rate of change of the outcome; this yields a Feynman-Kac representation along reversed covariate paths. We relate this Hessian to quadratic regression (under Gaussian design the best quadratic approximation has Hessian $E[\nabla^2 m(X)]$) and to kernel smoothing bias. For bistable replicator dynamics on covariate space, travelling fronts are exactly logistic in $(x,t)$, so one logistic regression identifies the diffusion-reaction ratio and the invading strategy. We then ask whether spread in covariate space reflects fluctuating unit characteristics or imitation among similar units. Imitation acts through exactly the same operator as covariate fluctuation, so the two are observationally equivalent in the regression field; panel data separate them because they identify $Σ$ directly. The two cannot be separated on a travelling front, and we propose a split-sample instrumental-variables test that works on seeded, non-front profiles, with size and power evaluated in agent-based experiments.

</details>


### [1474] [Minimax Rates for Conditional Generative Learning under Wasserstein Loss](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35490v1)
*Sungwon Park,Kyoung-Sook Moon,Hongjoong Kim*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文系统研究Hölder连续条件分布、协变量分布无约束情形下，积分Wasserstein损失的条件生成学习的极小极大速率，并刻画高阶矩损失、条件Brenier映射及二维W1速率的对数间隙。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件生成学习理论多在均匀协变量假设下建立速率，而对一般协变量分布、不可观测协变量区域对风险的影响缺乏刻画；同时无条件W1极小极大速率在二维存在对数间隙，条件Brenier映射的速率理论尚不完整。

Method: 以生成器的条件输出分布为评价对象，在积分Wasserstein损失下建立极小极大下界与上界：用局部化偏差与无条件分布估计误差的平衡导出期望损失速率；用自适应局部化论证构造匹配上界；用多尺度下界处理二维W1的对数间隙。

Result: 期望Wasserstein损失的极小极大速率与均匀协变量情形一致；高阶矩损失可被不可观测协变量区域主导，产生n^{-1}阶额外风险且自适应上界匹配；结论覆盖无约束响应分布与可能退化的Besov密度（W1）及更高阶Wasserstein；多尺度下界闭合了二维无条件W1速率的对数间隙；并在密度、可积性与一致曲率条件下给出条件Brenier映射的极小极大速率。

Conclusion: 一般协变量分布不改变期望Wasserstein损失的基本速率，但显著影响高阶矩风险；所建立的速率理论完整刻画了条件生成学习与条件Brenier映射的统计极限，并解决了二维W1速率的一个开放问题。

Abstract: We study minimax rates for conditional generative learning under integrated Wasserstein loss, with Hölder continuous conditional laws and an unrestricted covariate distribution. We evaluate unrestricted generators through their conditional output distributions. For expected Wasserstein loss, the minimax rate agrees with the rate under uniform covariates and follows from balancing localization bias against unconditional distribution estimation error. Higher moments of the loss can instead be dominated by unobserved covariate regions, which force an additional risk contribution of order $n^{-1}$, where $n$ is the sample size. An adaptive localization argument gives matching upper bounds. The results cover unrestricted response laws and possibly vanishing Besov densities for $W_1$, and extend to higher Wasserstein orders under uniform response density bounds and integrability conditions. A multiscale lower bound closes the logarithmic gap in unconditional $W_1$ minimax rates in dimension two for both unrestricted distributions and Besov density classes. We also establish minimax rates for conditional Brenier maps under density, integrability, and uniform curvature conditions.

</details>

### [1475] [Scale-aware and spatially-localised optimisation of kilometre-scale MLWP models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37325v2)
*James Chappell,Sophie Luise Arana,Jack Bowyer,Matthew Burnand,Alejandro Coca-Castro,Evangeline Corcoran,Eric G. Daub,Tom Dunstan,Noushin Eftekhari,Anna-Louise Ellis,J. Scott Hosking,Manvendra Janmaijaya,David Salvador-Jasin,Sam Madge,Ben Shipway,Nathan Simpson,Oliver Strickson,David Walters*

Main category: physics.ao-ph

TL;DR: 提出基于对偶树复小波变换（DT-CWT）的损失函数，按尺度、位置与方向联合约束大气场，在联合全球—区域FastNet（英国1.5 km预报）中显著提升谱保真度，并保持逐点精度、改善邻域检验与降水强度分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公里级机器学习天气预测（MLWP）的核心难点在于：既要保留精细尺度结构，又不能牺牲空间（逐点）精度。常用的MSE训练导致谱失真、场过度平滑；而基于FFT的全局谱目标虽能改善谱，却因全局支撑（无空间局部性）带来逐点精度损失。

Method: 引入基于对偶树复小波变换（DT-CWT）的损失：小波基同时具备尺度、空间位置与方向选择性，对大气场做多尺度、局部化、多方向约束。实验采用全球—区域联合的FastNet配置，输出英国上空1.5 km预报及约31 km全球预报；与MSE损失和FFT谱目标作对比，并以谱保真度、逐点指标、邻域检验方法及降水强度分布进行评估。

Result: 相对于MSE与FFT谱目标，小波损失大幅提升谱保真度；与MSE训练相比，逐点性能相近，邻域类检验指标改善，降水场更锐利、强度分布更真实。

Conclusion: 空间局部化的小波约束能够在保留多尺度大气结构的同时，基本避免全局支撑谱目标所伴随的逐点精度损失，是兼顾结构真实性与空间精度的一种有效训练目标。

Abstract: Preserving fine-scale structure without degrading spatial accuracy is a central challenge for kilometre-scale machine-learning weather prediction (MLWP). We introduce a loss based on the dual-tree complex wavelet transform that constrains atmospheric fields jointly by scale, location, and orientation. We evaluate its performance using an experimental joint global--regional FastNet configuration, which produces \SI{1.5}{km} forecasts over the UK alongside $\sim$\SI{31}{km} global forecasts. Relative to both mean-squared error (MSE) and an FFT-based spectral objective, the wavelet loss substantially improves spectral fidelity. Compared with MSE training, it maintains similar pointwise performance, improves neighbourhood-based verification, and produces sharper precipitation fields with more realistic intensity distributions. These results demonstrate that spatially localised wavelet constraints can preserve multiscale atmospheric structure while largely avoiding the loss of pointwise accuracy associated with globally supported spectral objectives.

</details>


### [1476] [FASST: A Compact Stateless Atmosphere Model for Long-Term Ocean Coupling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36297v2)
*Pratham Aggarwal,Duncan Watson-Parris,William E. Chapman*

Main category: physics.ao-ph

TL;DR: FASST 用轻量级 U-Net 大气与海冰模拟器替换 CESM2 中的大气和海冰分量，保留 POP2 海洋模式，在 140 年无强迫积分中维持稳定全球气候并再现 Niño-3.4 年际变率（振幅偏弱）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耦合气候模拟计算成本高昂，主要开销来自大气模式，需要降低耦合模拟的计算代价。

Method: 构建 FASST 耦合模式：保留有预报能力的 POP2 海洋模式，大气由无状态（diagnostic）U-Net 模拟器替代，每 6 模拟小时由海洋-海冰状态预测地表通量；海冰由 U-Net 模拟器按月推进海冰状态。

Result: 140 年无强迫积分中，FASST 无需 SST restoring 即维持稳定全球平均气候，瞬变后全球平均 SST 为 291.30±0.22 K，与 CESM2 piControl 的 291.25±0.10 K 接近；再现 Niño-3.4 年际变率，但振幅弱于 CESM（0.62 K 对 1.02 K）。

Conclusion: 无状态的机器学习大气分量可支撑世纪尺度的稳定、自由运行耦合气候模拟，为低成本耦合气候模拟提供可行路径。

Abstract: Coupled climate simulations are computationally expensive, largely because of the atmosphere. We introduce FASST, a coupled climate model that retains the prognostic POP2 ocean while replacing the atmosphere and sea ice with lightweight U-Net emulators. The atmospheric emulator is diagnostic, predicting surface fluxes from the evolving ocean-ice state every $6$ simulated hours, while the sea-ice emulator advances the ice state monthly. For $140$ years of unforced integration, FASST maintains a stable global-mean climate without SST restoring, with post-transient global-mean SST of $291.30 \pm 0.22\mathrm{K}$ compared with $291.25 \pm 0.10\mathrm{K}$ in CESM$2$ piControl. FASST also captures interannual Niño-$3.4$ variability, although with weaker amplitude than CESM ($0.62\mathrm{K}$ versus $1.02\mathrm{K}$). These results demonstrate that a stateless learned atmosphere can sustain stable, free-running coupled climate simulations over century-scale integrations.

</details>

### [1477] [HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36860v1)
*Subhash V. S. Ganti,Lukas Woelfel,Arla Diengdoh,Tzvetan Mihaylov,Thomas Nevolianis,Jan Meyer,Christopher Kuenneth*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 本文在既有数据融合多任务框架基础上，将单值性质预测扩展为多视界（多循环）预测，用多保真、多视界深度算子网络（DeepONet）在同一模型中同时学习DFT氧化还原电位与随循环变化的比容量轨迹，并以完整电池叠层表示与使用条件为输入，从而捕捉叠层内部相互作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过渡金属基电池依赖锂、钴、镍等关键元素，其开采带来环境与供应链问题；有机电极材料（OEMs）可降低依赖并具备分子可调性，但循环稳定性不足。其设计需联合优化电压、比容量、容量保持率、能量密度等耦合指标，且这些指标取决于整个电池叠层及各组分相互作用而非仅活性材料。先前工作仅能预测平均放电电压与首圈比容量这两个单值目标，无法刻画长周期演化。

Method: 提出多保真 + 多视界的深度算子网络（DeepONet）：以完整电池叠层表示及使用条件为输入，在单一模型中学习 DFT 氧化还原电位（高保真小数据）与循环依赖的比容量轨迹；将原先单值输出的数据融合多任务框架推广为逐循环（每圈）性质的算子映射。

Result: 模型能够在统一架构内同时给出氧化还原电位预测与每个循环的比容量预测，实现从首圈/平均值向全放电轨迹的多视界外推，并显式纳入叠层层面的交互信息而非仅关注正极效应。

Conclusion: 该框架支持有机电池体系的长期性质预测、逆向设计与工艺优化，为OEM电池的多指标协同设计提供了可扩展的数据驱动工具。

Abstract: Transition-metal-based batteries rely on critical elements such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel. Their extraction creates environmental and supply-chain challenges. Organic electrode materials (OEMs) reduce this reliance and provide broad molecular tunability. However, OEM-based batteries still show limited long-term cycling stability. Their design also requires the joint optimization of coupled metrics such as voltage, specific capacity, capacity retention, and energy density. These metrics depend on the full battery stack and on the interactions among its components rather than on the active material alone. In our previous work, we developed a data-fusion multi-task framework for average discharge voltage and first-cycle specific capacity. Both targets are single-valued. Here, we extend that framework to multi-horizon prediction by predicting a property at every cycle of a discharge trajectory rather than at a single cycle. Our multi-fidelity and Multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories within one model. We train it on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions, so it learns battery-stack interactions rather than cathode-only effects. This framework supports long-term property prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic battery systems.

</details>


### [1478] [TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34029v1)
*Ying Feng,Jeffrey Hu,Lai Wei,Liang Tao,Madeline Miklos,Dipannoy Das Gupta,Hossein Erfanshekooh,Jianjun Hu*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: TCSP3.0 修正了模板基晶体结构预测中的元素映射与替换缺陷，并加入周期性检索、氧化态/半径评分、结构去重与 MLIP 弛豫排序，在 T180 上 Top-1/Top-20 达 72.2%/90.6%（TCSP2.0 为 28.3%/45.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模板基 CSP 依赖模板检索、元素映射与候选排序，其精度受此三者制约。作者审计 TCSP2.0 在 T180 基准上的实现，发现 2347 个所选结构中有 469 个（20%）成分错误，原因包括元素映射忽略化学计量系数，以及顺序文本替换导致元素符号级联或损坏，因此需要从根本上修复正确性问题。

Method: 提出 TCSP3.0：(1) 强制保持系数的元素映射；(2) 在解析后的结构上同步完成物种替换；(3) 对每个候选验证成分与晶胞；(4) 加入基于周期序号的检索、软性氧化态证据、半径相容性评分、结构去重；(5) 使用 ORB-v3 机器学习势进行弛豫与能量排序（与深度生成式 CSP 基线同口径）。

Result: T180 上 Top-1/Top-20 匹配率为 72.2%/90.6%，TCSP2.0 为 28.3%/45.6%；在新构建的 800 目标基准 T800 上 Top-20 达 74.0%；T180 上优于 PNcsp+、CrystalFlow、MaskGXT（Top-1 72.2% 对比最高 63.9%）；不弛豫时 Top-1 67.8%、Top-20 90.6%，双核 CPU 中位耗时 28 s/目标，约为 CrystalFlow 的十倍速。

Conclusion: T180 与 T800 上的十臂配对消融表明，性能提升主要来自正确性修复；结构去重显著提升 Top-5 匹配率；基于嵌入的检索是保证覆盖率的必要条件；其余评分特征效果较小或不显著。即模板基 CSP 的瓶颈首先在实现正确性，其次在检索覆盖，而非复杂的打分模型。

Abstract: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.

</details>


### [1479] [Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34021v1)
*Yingheng Wang,Tao Yu,Shufeng Kong,Francesco Ricci,John M. Gregoire,Carla P. Gomes*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 提出 DeepSciReasoner，一个在物理约束下预测科学谱的通用范式，将结构感知谱解码与保持约束的物理推理结合，在 eDOS、phDOS、XANES 和 Raman 谱上同时提升精度与物理一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化科学谱蕴含丰富物理信息，并受守恒律与特征谱几何等硬约束。现有方法把谱当作无约束序列处理，无法强制执行底层的物理结构，预测精度与物理一致性难以兼顾。

Method: 以电子态密度（eDOS）为原型，提出 DeepSciReasoner 框架，核心是两部分：结构感知的谱解码（structure-aware spectrum decoding）与保持约束的物理推理（constraint-preserving physical reasoning），使预测既刻画丰富谱结构又服从物理规律。

Result: 在电子态密度（eDOS）、声子态密度（phDOS）、X 射线吸收近边结构（XANES）与拉曼（Raman）谱四类任务上评估，预测精度显著提升，同时保持物理一致性。

Conclusion: DeepSciReasoner 可作为硬物理约束下结构化科学谱预测的可复用蓝图（reusable blueprint），具备向更广泛谱类任务推广的潜力。

Abstract: Structured scientific spectra encode rich physical information while obeying hard constraints, such as conservation laws and characteristic spectral geometry. Accurate prediction of these spectra is central to materials discovery, yet existing methods often treat them as unconstrained sequences and therefore fail to enforce the underlying physical structure. Taking electronic density of states (eDOS) as the prototypical example, we introduce DeepSciReasoner, a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints. The framework combines structure-aware spectrum decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, allowing predictions to capture rich spectral structure while respecting the underlying physics. We evaluate DeepSciReasoner on eDOS, phonon density of states (phDOS), X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES), and Raman spectra, where it substantially improves prediction accuracy while maintaining physical consistency. These results establish DeepSciReasoner as a reusable blueprint for structured scientific spectrum prediction under hard physical constraints.

</details>

### [1480] [A PDE-Based Model of Runner Flow in Mass Participation Events](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35206v1)
*Alice Molinari,Brian Block,Stephanie Stockar,Simona Sacone*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种宏观行人运动建模方法，采用对流-扩散偏微分方程（PDE）刻画马拉松赛道上跑者流量的演化，并以2023年哥伦布马拉松数据为基础引入时间变化的对流项以提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 马拉松场景中跑者位置仅在稀疏的检查点被记录，需要准确模型推断任意时刻的人群分布；同时马拉松存在资源调配与安全保障等物流与安全问题，可靠的行人运动模型有助于解决这些问题，因此马拉松是行人运动建模的良好案例。

Method: 构建宏观（macroscopic）对流-扩散PDE模型描述跑者流的时空演化；使用2023年哥伦布马拉松数据标定与验证；对模型进行改进，引入随时间变化的对流项（temporally varying convection term）。

Result: 引入时变对流项后模型精度提升（结果部分仅给出定性结论，未报告具体误差数值），更高的精度有助于更好的资源分配与安全措施制定。

Conclusion: 宏观对流-扩散PDE可有效建模马拉松中的行人运动，时变对流项的引入显著改善模型表现，为赛事物流与安全管理提供支持。

Abstract: This paper presents a macroscopic approach for modeling pedestrian movement. A convection-diffusion partial differential equation (PDE) is described and used to model the flow of runners along a marathon course. A marathon is a good modeling case study for human movement because the location of runners is only known in sparse locations, so an accurate model is needed to know where people are at all times. As well, marathons offer many safety and logistical problems that can be solved by modeling human movement. Data is obtained from the 2023 Columbus Marathon, and model improvements are made to include a temporally varying convection term. Results show an increase in model accuracy which can allow for better resource allocation and safety measures.

</details>

### [1481] [SuperJEPA: Pretraining with a Supervision-Augmented Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for High Energy Physics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36121v1)
*Dylan Sheldon Rankin,Ho Fung Tsoi*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 提出 SuperJEPA：在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）上叠加监督目标进行预训练，在高能物理（HEP）已有大规模高保真标注模拟数据的条件下，自监督目标仍能进一步提升下游 jet tagging 性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型的强大能力通常依赖远超标注规模的超大规模无标注数据，但高能物理领域本就拥有大规模高保真度的标注模拟样本。因此作者质疑：当已有大量标注数据时，仅做监督预训练是否已经足够，自监督目标是否还能带来增益。

Method: 设计 SuperJEPA，将监督目标增强到联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中，做联合预训练；在多个下游 jet tagging 任务、多种模型规模、多种预训练数据规模上评估，并分别考察冻结编码器与微调编码器两种设置。

Result: 在多个任务、模型规模和预训练数据规模下，下游 jet tagging 性能均优于纯监督预训练；增益在冻结编码器和微调编码器两种情况下都保持存在。

Conclusion: 即使已存在大规模高质量标注数据，预测式自监督仍能提供互补收益，支持在未来大规模粒子物理基础模型中引入预测式自监督。

Abstract: Foundation models often obtain powerful results through very large unlabeled training datasets that dwarf available labeled datasets in size, but high energy physics already provides large samples of high-fidelity labeled simulation. We therefore ask whether self-supervised objectives improve over supervised pretraining alone when large labeled samples already exist. We introduce SuperJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architec- ture augmented with a supervised objective, and find improved downstream jet-tagging performance across multiple tasks, model sizes, and pretraining dataset sizes. The gains persist for both frozen and fine-tuned encoders, motivating predictive self-supervision in future large-scale particle-physics foundation models.

</details>

### [1482] [Greenscapes: Optimized Vegetation Configurations in Cities](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40007v1)
*Patryk Bartkowiak,Marcin Marlewski,Paweł Wójcik,Jae Joong Lee,Dominik L. Michels,Bedrich Benes,Sören Pirk,Wojciech Pałubicki*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出一种从地块输入到三维城市植被布局的生成方法：先用条件VLM生成俯视植被渲染图并转成3D场景，再用CMA-ES在固定位置下优化尺度与资产替换，目标函数基于遮阴与路径声暴露的代理模型及视图感知描述子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市植被兼具遮阴与天空可视平衡、微气候调节、碳固存、声屏障等功能作用，同时景观风格（规则式、现代主义、如画式）等美学选择影响居民福祉，因此三维城市景观设计需同时兼顾功能与美学，而现有方法缺少可自动生成此类布局的手段。

Method: 以单个地块为输入，用条件视觉-语言模型（VLM）生成俯视植被渲染图，将大乔木、小乔木与灌木布置于草坪区域；通过单株植物检测并匹配三维资产，把渲染图转换为三维场景。随后构建优化循环：经确定性可行性修复后固定VLM给出的位置，用CMA-ES优化逐实例尺度变换与离散植被资产替换。目标函数由遮阴与基于路径的声暴露的高效代理模型构成，并在每步渲染场景视图以计算视图依赖的感知描述子。

Result: 生成的布局在遮阴与声暴露等功能指标上经代理模型评估，并结合渲染视图得到的感知描述子，可同时产生兼具美学与功能的城市植被布局；位置固定加CMA-ES的优化循环能有效改进初始VLM配置。

Conclusion: 将VLM的语义生成能力与基于代理模型和感知指标的数值优化相结合，是一种可行的三维城市场景植被自动布置范式，可兼顾功能性能与景观美学风格。

Abstract: Vegetation plays a central role in cities, serving functional roles such as balancing shade and sky exposure, shaping the microclimate, carbon sequestration, and providing acoustic screening. Furthermore, aesthetic choices in landscape styles (formal, modernist, picturesque) are important for citizens' well-being and should be considered in the design of urban landscapes. In this paper, we present a novel method for placing vegetation, ranging from shrubs to large trees, in 3D urban scenes. Our method uses individual lots as input and employs a conditioned Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate a top-down rendering of vegetation, placing large trees, small trees, and shrubs on lawn areas. This rendering is then converted into a 3D scene by detecting individual plants and selecting appropriate 3D assets. To refine the proposed configurations, we define an optimization loop that keeps the VLM-generated positions fixed after a deterministic feasibility repair and uses CMA-ES to optimize per-instance scale transformations along with discrete vegetation asset substitutions. To define the objective function for the optimization, we evaluate the generated 3D scenes with efficient surrogate models of shade and path-based acoustic exposure. Furthermore, we render in-scene views at each optimization step to compute view-dependent perceptual descriptors, enabling the generation of both aesthetic and functional vegetation layouts for urban scenes.

</details>


### [1483] [Trajeform: Embedding Crowd Data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39563v1)
*Marilena Lemonari,Panayiotis Charalambous,Yiorgos Chrysanthou*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出Trajeform框架：在真实轨迹数据上训练重构式VAE，获得保留人群行为特征的连续隐空间嵌入，用于比较模拟器生成轨迹与真实数据的嵌入分布，从而在行为层面评估人群模拟器的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人群模拟模型的能力高度依赖训练数据的类型与多样性，而现有评估指标多聚焦轨迹层面的差异，忽视行为层面的相似性，难以良好衡量模拟器向真实数据泛化的程度。

Method: 在真实轨迹数据上训练重构VAE，学习有意义的连续嵌入；将训练好的编码器应用于模拟器生成的合成轨迹，比较嵌入分布，并结合隐空间分析、分布度量以及从聚合后验分布采样生成轨迹进行定量与定性评估；同时对模拟器主行为轨迹与受控环境（如骑行）数据进行分析。对比对象为CCP、modCCP、RVO三种模拟器与真实数据集。

Result: 学习到的隐空间能捕捉真实数据中轨迹的有意义依赖关系；三种模拟器在嵌入空间中与真实数据的分布差异可被定量与定性刻画，隐空间分析可揭示各模拟器对真实行为嵌入空间的覆盖能力。

Conclusion: Trajeform既可作为合成数据可信度的额外度量指标，也可作为指导未来轨迹模型训练的分析工具。

Abstract: Crowd simulation aims to generate agent behaviours that are rich, natural, and appropriate to their surrounding environment. Recent advances in Machine Learning have enabled such behavioural patterns to be learned directly from trajectory data, allowing simulation models to capture increasingly complex crowd dynamics. However, the capabilities of these systems remain strongly dependent on the type and diversity of the data used during training. When evaluating how well crowd simulators generalise to real-world datasets, most existing metrics focus primarily on trajectory-level differences rather than behaviour-level similarity. In this paper, we present Trajeform, a framework that trains a reconstruction VAE (Variational Autoencoder) on real trajectory data to learn a meaningful continuous embedding that preserves behavioural characteristics of real crowds. The trained encoder can then be applied to synthetic trajectories generated by simulators and used to compare the resulting embedding distributions.
