Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Nemotron 3.5 Super与Nemotron 3.5 Lightning两个开源高效MoE混合Mamba-Transformer模型：Super为120B总参/12B激活的多模态模型，Lightning为30B总参/3B激活的文本模型，面向推理、长上下文与智能体负载，兼顾能力与部署效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向推理、长上下文理解与智能体（agentic）工作负载，需要同时具备强能力与高部署效率的开放模型；现有模型难以在激活参数受限条件下同时满足多模态、长上下文、投机解码与多语言（含印度语言）能力需求。

Method: 架构采用MoE + Hybrid Mamba-Transformer；训练层面结合大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练与原生投机解码（Super另加Indic继续预训练与agentic软件工程中期训练）。后训练管线覆盖SFT与强化学习（RLVR、RLHF），Super额外引入专家教师训练与多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD），将纯文本基座转化为可推理文本/图像/视频/交互工具环境的多模态智能体；推理侧探索并行智能体执行与自验证的测试时扩展，并配合post-training MTP boosting、NVFP4量化与推理优化。

Result: Indic继续预训练使印度语言基准最高提升9.82个百分点；agentic中期训练增强软件工程能力与跨agent harness鲁棒性。后训练Super在SWE-bench Pro达51.78%，以约4.6倍更少的激活参数超越Nemotron 3 Ultra。MTP boosting在概率化draft采样下将投机解码接受长度最高提升21.8%；NVFP4量化相对BF16实现99.62%中位精度恢复。GB200上最高4,856 output tokens/s/GPU，同时维持≥50 tokens/s/user。

Conclusion: 通过在训练与部署全流程联合优化能力与效率，Nemotron 3.5 Super/Lightning在低激活参数下实现了强推理、长上下文、多模态与agentic能力，并通过蒸馏、投机解码与量化等工程手段显著提升吞吐与部署经济性。

Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

</details>


### [1560] [FAD-KV: Adaptive Dictionary KV Caching for Efficient Reasoning Decoding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37921v1)
*Yuxuan Zhu,David H. Yang,Parisa Shiravani,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri,Tejaswini Pedapati,Subhajit Chaudhury,Keerthiram Murugesan,Pin-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FAD-KV框架，通过筛选式稀疏编码与固定容量字典自适应，在避免字典无界增长的同时实现高效KV缓存压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存在长输出推理中内存与计算随生成长度线性增长，字典式稀疏KV压缩可保留token级结构、不施加全局低秩约束，但现有方法存在两个解码期瓶颈：迭代稀疏编码（如OMP）带来解码开销；静态字典与测试时演化的KV分布不匹配，而朴素追加式自适应更新会导致字典膨胀。

Method: FAD-KV包含两个组件：(i) 筛选式稀疏编码——一次性Top-n选择确定小候选原子池，再进行轻量系数精化，替代迭代式稀疏求解；(ii) 固定容量字典自适应机制——复用不活跃原子而非扩展字典规模。

Result: 在推理与长上下文基准上，FAD-KV取得较强的质量-效率权衡，并在解码过程中避免了字典的无界增长。

Conclusion: 同时控制稀疏编码成本与字典增长，使FAD-KV成为内存有界、计算高效的KV压缩框架，适用于长推理负载。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a core mechanism in large language models, where intermediate key and value representations are stored to accelerate autoregressive decoding. As generation length increases, KV cache memory and computation grow linearly, making compression critical for efficient long-output reasoning. Dictionary-based sparse KV compression is appealing because it represents each token's KV states as a sparse combination of learned basis elements (atoms) in a dictionary, preserving token-level structure without enforcing a global low-rank constraint. However, existing dictionary-based methods face two practical limitations during decoding: iterative sparse coding methods such as Orthogonal Matching Pursuit add decoding-time overhead, and static dictionaries may mismatch evolving KV distributions under test-time generation. While adaptive dictionary updates can reduce this mismatch, naive append-only strategies lead to dictionary growth during generation. We propose FAD-KV, a \textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{D}ictionary KV caching framework for efficient reasoning decoding. FAD-KV integrates (i) a screening-based sparse coding scheme, where a one-shot Top-\(n\) selection identifies a small candidate pool followed by lightweight coefficient refinement, and (ii) a fixed-size dictionary adaptation mechanism that reuses inactive atoms instead of expanding the dictionary. By controlling both sparse coding cost and adaptive dictionary growth, FAD-KV provides a memory-bounded and computation-efficient KV compression framework for long reasoning workloads. Experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks show that FAD-KV achieves a strong quality-efficiency trade-off while avoiding unbounded dictionary growth during decoding.

</details>


### [1561] [DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36929v1)
*Saifullah Saifullah,David Dembinsky,Stefan Agne,Andreas Dengel,Sheraz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出 DocXEval，首个面向多模态文档理解（文本、版式、图像）的可解释性框架，将现有 XAI 方法与评测指标适配到该领域，并对语义实体识别等任务做高效的多目标适配。作者系统评测了 13 种 XAI 方法（3 个任务、8 个数据集、4 个模型、17 个指标），发现 Occlusion 整体上最忠实、最可解释，并通过元评估与诊断分析揭示模态贡献、空间归因模式及潜在数据偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 Transformer 在文档理解上性能突出，但其黑箱特性阻碍了在高风险场景中的安全部署；而视觉与语言任务的 XAI 研究虽已有进展，针对多模态文档理解的 XAI 研究却很少，缺乏统一的方法适配与评测基准。

Method: 构建统一可解释性框架 DocXEval，把已有 XAI 方法和评价指标迁移到文本—版式—图像三模态文档理解语境，并针对语义实体识别等领域任务提出高效的多目标适配版本；在该框架下开展大规模系统评测（13 种 XAI 方法 × 3 任务 × 8 数据集 × 4 模型 × 17 指标），并进行指标间一致性的元评估和数据集级诊断分析。

Result: 仅少数方法在所有评价标准下表现一致，Occlusion 总体上是忠实性与可解释性最好的方法；元评估显示多个忠实性指标与复杂度指标之间存在中等至强一致性，同时识别出若干产生不可靠结果的指标；诊断分析揭示了各任务与标签下各模态的贡献、目标实体周围的空间归因模式以及潜在的数据集偏置。

Conclusion: 该工作既为多模态文档理解的 XAI 研究提供了基准，也提供了实践指南，帮助研究者选择方法与指标并警惕不可靠指标；代码已开源以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.

</details>


### [1562] [DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36759v1)
*Jing Huang,Zhiya Tan,Changtao Miao,Shutao Gong,Yang Wang,Joey Tianyi Zhou,Jianshu Li,Ying Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DocSkill：面向多语言多跳文档问答的技能编排智能体框架，结合有界MCTS离线轨迹生成SFT与DPO监督，并发布MMHop-DocBench数据集（60K问答、10语言、8领域）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言多跳文档问答需跨复杂版面、多页面、多语言定位并整合证据；现有单次处理与自适应工具调用方法难以协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证三项能力。

Method: 提出DocSkill智能体框架，学习技能编排策略，依据不断演化的证据状态选择、回访或跳过技能；用有界蒙特卡洛树搜索离线探索替代技能轨迹，产出SFT演示与DPO偏好对；并构建MMHop-DocBench数据集，其HopGen流水线通过层次化页面—元素图推导可追溯的跨页证据路径，生成带页面级与元素级证据标注的问答对。

Result: DocSkill（Qwen3-VL-8B）在MMHop-DocBench上取得41.0准确率与49.2 F1，分别超出最强基线5.5与6.3分；在MMLongBench-Doc与DocBench上表现具竞争力。

Conclusion: 以“可学习技能编排+离线MCTS监督”的方式统一证据获取、跨页整合与验证，可有效提升多语言多跳文档问答性能，配套数据集提供了可追溯的细粒度证据标注。

Abstract: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.

</details>


### [1563] [Specialization, Diversity, and Scaling in Child-Scale Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36679v1)
*Steven Y. Feng,Michael C. Frank*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过在BabyView真实儿童家庭录音转写与TinyDialogues合成儿童导向对话上训练小型GPT-2，研究发现小数据语言学习的关键不仅在数据量，更在数据来源环境与"输入—预测目标"的匹配度：模型对训练所用单一儿童语言环境有显著专化，且多为词汇与分布统计层面；多儿童混合训练提升对汇总留出语言的预测，但语法基准无明显同等增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型训练语料远超儿童实际接触的语言量，而学界对"小规模、自然主义数据"下的学习规律了解甚少。作者希望考察数据量之外的因素——数据来源环境（哪个儿童）、数据多样性（单儿童 vs 多儿童）、自然 vs 合成——如何影响语言学习的成效与性质。

Method: 在密集家庭录音转写（BabyView）与合成儿童导向对话（TinyDialogues）上训练小型GPT-2，系统操纵训练数据的数量、来源与多样性；并用简单5-gram模型作为对照，检验跨儿童预测模式是否可由低阶分布统计复现；评估指标涵盖对不同儿童语言环境的预测表现与语法基准。

Result: 在某一儿童语言环境上训练的模型，对该环境的预测显著优于对其他儿童环境的预测；该专化大部分是词汇与分布性质的，5-gram模型即可复现跨儿童模式（r=.91）。多儿童数据训练相对单儿童训练明显改善对汇总留出语言的预测，但在语法基准上无同等明显提升。不同数据规模下，自然主义与合成输入产生不同的语法与词汇—语义模式，且各语法现象间差异显著。

Conclusion: 小数据语言学习不仅取决于模型看到多少语言，还取决于语言来自哪些环境，以及训练输入与所要求预测目标之间的匹配程度；"环境特异性"与"输入—目标匹配"应成为小数据语言学习研究的核心变量。

Abstract: Modern language models are trained on far more language than children experience, but we know much less about learning from small, naturalistic datasets. We train small GPT-2 models on transcripts of speech with children from dense home recordings (BabyView) and on synthetic child-directed dialogue (TinyDialogues), varying the amount, source, and diversity of training data. Models trained on one child's language environment predict that environment substantially better than other children's environments. Much of this specialization is lexical and distributional: a simple 5-gram model reproduces the cross-child pattern (r=.91). Training on data from multiple children clearly improves prediction of pooled held-out language relative to training on a single child's input without a similarly clear improvement on grammatical benchmarks. Across data sizes, naturalistic and synthetic training inputs also produce different grammatical and lexical-semantic patterns, with important differences between grammatical phenomena. Together, these results show that small-data language learning depends not only on how much language a model sees, but on which environments it comes from and how well that input matches what the model is asked to predict.

</details>


### [1564] [Causal Localization of Evidence Effects in Transformers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36524v1)
*Jipeng Li,Pramod Khargonekar,Yanning Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"受控证据聚合"(CEA)实验范式与"均衡效用因果筛选"(BUC)头归因方法，证明由受控符号输入筛选出的紧凑注意力头集合，其因果影响可从符号任务迁移到自然语言决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作多以自然语言语料做因果干预，难以控制混淆变量、难以界定"正确行为"；作者希望验证：受控符号输入能否揭示真正影响语言模型决策的注意力头，且这种因果作用能否迁移到自然语言证据聚合任务。

Method: 1) CEA：在其余提示固定的前提下，改变两个符号的计数与顺序，用两个答案token的logit差衡量模型偏好，提示不规定正确答案；2) BUC筛选：联合评估"消融头输出对计数效应的去除程度"与"在两个方向上进行均值输出替换时对效应的恢复程度"，得到紧凑头集合；3) 推导条件界，将头归因与干预效应相关联，并给出从有限样本中恢复归因候选集的充分条件；4) 在Pythia-410M上分别针对四种排序条件独立筛选1–12个头，并在未参与筛选的计数比较及自然语言"哪一州的报告更多"任务上检验迁移。

Result: 在Pythia-410M中，各排序条件下消融1–12个筛选出的头可消除65.5%–91.6%的计数效应，且对未用于筛选的计数比较仍保持影响；在自然语言任务上，仅基于符号yes/no提示筛选的8个头被消融后，平均准确率下降8.2个百分点，而按规模与层匹配的随机头集合仅下降0.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 受控符号探针能够识别出紧凑的注意力头集合，其因果作用可推广至自然语言决策，为机制可解释性提供了一种可控、可量化且具迁移性的实验与归因框架。

Abstract: Can controlled symbolic inputs reveal attention heads that influence a language model's decisions from natural language evidence? We introduce controlled evidence aggregation (CEA), which varies the counts and order of two symbols in otherwise fixed prompts and measures changes in a frozen Transformer's preference between two answer tokens. The preference is measured by their logit difference; the prompts prescribe no correct answer. Balanced utility causal selection (BUC) identifies compact head sets by jointly evaluating how much ablating their outputs removes the count effect and how closely patching mean outputs between count conditions recovers the effect in both directions. We derive conditional bounds linking head attribution to intervention effects and specifying when the attribution shortlist can be recovered from finite samples. In Pythia-410M, ablating sets of 1-12 heads selected separately for four ordering regimes removes 65.5-91.6% of the count effect. The sets retain their influence on count comparisons not used for selection. To test relevance beyond symbolic inputs, we evaluate a natural language task asking which state is supported by more reports. Ablating eight heads selected only on symbolic yes/no prompts lowers mean accuracy by 8.2 percentage points, versus 0.8 for random sets matched by size and layer. Our results demonstrate that controlled symbolic probes can identify compact attention head sets whose causal influence extends to natural language decisions.

</details>


### [1565] [LLM Hallucination Detection via Low-rank Multilinear Decomposition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36191v1)
*Devansh Sharma,Faizul Rakib Sayem,Shahana Ibrahim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 LOTUS，一种基于多线性低秩分解的幻觉检测框架：先用互补统计描述子压缩变长 token 表示，再通过低秩 Tucker 分解从 LLM 隐状态中提取紧凑表征，训练轻量级幻觉分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 常生成流畅但事实错误的回答；现有基于内部表示的幻觉检测器多依赖选定激活或池化压缩，可能忽略分布在 Transformer 各层、特征模态与 token 上的判别信息，且对标注数据依赖较强。

Method: LOTUS（Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning）：第一步用互补统计描述子汇总变长 token 表示，捕获峰值激活、激活分布和跨层变化；第二步采用低秩多线性（Tucker）分解提取能反映 LLM 隐状态内在结构的紧凑表示；最后基于该表示训练轻量级幻觉分类器，以降低对标注数据的依赖。

Result: 在多个 LLM 与问答基准上，幻觉检测性能优于近期 SOTA 基线。

Conclusion: 多线性低秩分解结合统计描述子的紧凑隐状态表征，是提升幻觉检测效果并减少标注依赖的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate fluent yet factually incorrect responses, raising concerns about their reliability. Recent hallucination detectors increasingly exploit internal representations, but extracting informative signals from high-dimensional hidden states remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on selected activations or pooling-based compression, potentially overlooking discriminative information distributed across Transformer layers, feature modes, and tokens. We propose LOTUS (Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning), a multilinear low-rank decomposition framework for hallucination detection that extracts compact representations from LLM hidden states while reducing dependence on labeled data. Our approach first summarizes variable-length token representations using complementary statistical descriptors that capture peak activations, activation distributions, and cross-layer changes. We then leverage low-rank multilinear decomposition to extract compact representations that capture the underlying structure of LLM hidden states, which are subsequently used to train a lightweight hallucination classifier. Experiments across multiple LLMs and question-answering benchmarks demonstrate improved hallucination detection performance over recent state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [1566] [FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36083v1)
*Giorgos Iacovides,Oliver Hannibal,Wuyang Zhou,Danilo Mandic*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FinLLM-KG 是一个模型无关的框架，将因果 LLM 与金融知识图谱结合，在推理阶段注入来自 SEC 10-K 的、具有时间性的公司层面知识，以提升金融情感分析的语境理解与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于后训练金融大模型的情感分析方法仅限于对单篇文章进行孤立预测，且为黑箱模型：既缺乏上下文理解，也难以用于高风险金融决策场景。

Method: 在推理时（不更新模型权重）从金融知识图谱中检索知识，以两种形式提供上下文——自然语言公司简介，或少量按相关性排序的事实三元组；再通过句子级与知识图谱事实级的归因，使每篇文章的情感得分可溯源。

Result: 在模拟实验中，FinLLM-KG 在投资组合表现上持续优于当前最优基线；且计算开销近乎为零，适用于任意因果 LLM。

Conclusion: 以检索式知识图谱上下文增强因果 LLM，可在几乎零成本下实现更贴合公司层面语境、且可解释、支持人工介入复核的金融情感分析。

Abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.

</details>


### [1567] [Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35804v1)
*Aidar Myrzakhan,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 dSpark，一种基于调度蒸馏的框架，学习"何时提交（unmask）token"，以实现更快的扩散语言模型生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM 可并行生成多 token，但常需多轮解码。高效生成不仅取决于哪些 token 易预测，还取决于提交它们是否有助于预测其余位置：高可预测 token 提供的上下文有限，而揭示较难预测的 token 可使其他位置更早变得可预测。

Method: 构造 unmasking 调度，优先揭示能让其他位置更易预测的 token，从而更早降低解码不确定性；再将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，支持更快的并行采样，并用 KL 散度正则项保持生成质量。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上广泛评估；GSM8K 上，在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-7B-Instruct 上分别相比各类基线取得 10.12× 与 5.12× 加速，同时保持更优的任务性能。

Conclusion: 以"信息增益"而非单纯"可预测性"为准则的调度蒸馏，可显著加速扩散语言模型解码且不损失质量。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

</details>


### [1568] [OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36013v1)
*Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team,Yuechen Luo,Chong He,Fang Li,Shaoqing Xu,Jingkai Wang,Menglun Su,Jiaxin Liu,Shengyin Jiang,Zhiyi Lai,Long Chen,Longlong Wang,Liang Hu,Haochen Liu,Yuncheng Jiang,Hongwei Xie,Jieming Cui,Hanbing Li,Junjie Huang,Zhixiang Duan,Hexin Zhang,Weixiang Liang,Ying Gong,Yuhan Wang,Yong Pan,Pengna Li,Kangyi Wu,Ken Deng,Kun Ma,Fuxi Wen,Zhi-xin Yang,Hangjun Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出轻量统一具身智能体 OmniBrain-0，用共享高层决策模型统一操作与导航，并配套渐进式训练与数据飞轮。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用具身智能需在长时序中协调多种技能、跟踪任务进度并从失败中恢复；专用策略难以保证任务级可靠性，而大型多模态智能体依赖昂贵的推理和外部经验，紧凑模型难以复现。

Method: 渐进式训练框架：具身预训练、领域专家智能体蒸馏、多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD），将强教师经验蒸馏进操作/导航专家后再整合为统一模型，统一性发生在决策模型内部而非仅工具接口；并提出 Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement（RSI）数据飞轮，由 Meta-Agent 将执行证据转化为精炼评分细则、步骤级提醒与经验证轨迹，用于领域专家更新并经 MOPD 重新整合。

Result: 在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0、R2R-CE Val-Unseen 及多项真实操作任务上评估，兼具强跨域任务性能，且推理与执行开销显著低于闭源教师模型。

Conclusion: 证明可将具身能力高效迁移并整合进紧凑统一智能体，以低开销实现长时序多技能协调与任务级可靠性。

Abstract: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

</details>


### [1569] [MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36006v1)
*Simon A. Lee,Jiahang Sha,Moonseong Jeong,Yunbei Pan,Jeffrey N. Chiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文评估可在笔记本本地运行的开放式System One模型MedJev，在十个医学基准（医学知识、诊断、基于MIMIC IV与MIMIC IV ED的患者级预测）上与零样本LLM基线、已发表GPT结果及监督模型对比，并提出一种轻量两参数重校准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One式模型（如Jev）通过单次前向传播直接回答结构化问题而无需生成文本，具有快速、低算力的临床决策支持潜力，但其医学能力与置信度可靠性缺乏系统评估，尤其是患者级预测任务上的校准问题亟待解决。

Method: 在十个医学基准上评估可在笔记本运行的开放模型MedJev，涵盖医学知识与诊断（MedQA、USMLE、NEJM）及基于MIMIC IV/ED的患者级预测任务；与零样本LLM基线、已发表GPT结果和监督模型比较；并用ECE衡量校准。另提出仅含两个参数、使用50–200个标注样本即可适配本地人群的轻量重校准方法。

Result: MedJev在MedQA达72.5%、USMLE 75.4%、NEJM 80.1%，接近已发表GPT-4表现，置信度校准良好（ECE 0.028–0.063）。患者级任务中，院内死亡AUROC为0.926，超过XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊入院等操作性结局上逊于监督模型（0.745 vs. 0.809）；患者级预测存在明显校准偏差（院内死亡ECE 0.286），经两参数重校准后可降至0.007。

Conclusion: 开放System One模型可作为医学AI有前景的零样本基线，兼具竞争力的预测性能、低算力成本与高效本地校准能力；作者公开代码与评测框架以支持后续研究。

Abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.

</details>


### [1570] [Making Reasoning Visible: Configuration-Aware Diagnostic Modeling for Adaptive Scaffolding in Structured Reasoning Tasks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35609v1)
*Trystan Geoffre,Zheng Yuan,Thierry Geoffre*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个诊断框架，通过在交互式学习游戏中分析学生的动作序列，将学习者隐性的多步推理过程显性化：计算五个可解释的策略维度、从任务结构与行为模式估计"协调需求"，并将推理归类为四种状态。基于234名学生、42道形态句法练习共36,234次交互的分析发现，推理策略主要随情境变化而非稳定特质（ICC=0.14），学生在低效状态中高度持续（高协调需求导致的失败中74.6%在无干预下再次失败），且仅用策略模式的预警模型即可较准确预测验证成功（AUC=0.826，加入序列上下文为0.902）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应辅导系统通常只依赖简单的对/错答案，无法理解学生"如何思考"，因而难以对学习者的隐性多步推理过程建模并进行早期、有针对性的支架干预。

Method: 以语法推理为实例，构建可解释的诊断框架：分析学生在交互式学习游戏中的动作序列，计算五个可解释的策略维度（如系统性纠错、随机猜测），从任务结构与行为模式估计协调需求（coordination demand），并将推理划分为四种状态；进而在234名学生、42道形态句法练习、36,234次交互的数据上做方差分解（ICC）、失败持续率分析与预警建模。

Result: 策略变异主要来自情境而非稳定个体特质（ICC=0.14）；学生在非生产性状态中持续性高，74.6%由高协调需求（而非单纯知识缺口）驱动的失败在无干预下紧接着再次失败；预警模型预测验证成功准确度较高，仅用策略模式AUC=0.826，加入序列上下文后达0.902，且避免了对当前错误计数的循环依赖。

Conclusion: 使隐性推理过程可见，可支持更早、更有针对性的支架，回应学生"怎么想"而非仅"是否成功"；该框架虽在语言学习中验证，但提供了可推广、可解释的架构，适用于任意领域中复杂结构化推理的诊断。

Abstract: Modeling the latent, multi-step reasoning processes of learners is a core challenge for adaptive tutoring systems, which often rely on simple right/wrong answers rather than understanding how students think. Instantiated here for grammatical reasoning, this study introduces a diagnostic framework that makes students' step-by-step problem-solving visible by analyzing their action sequences in an interactive learning game. The framework computes five interpretable strategy dimensions (e.g., systematic error correction, random guessing), estimates coordination demand from task structure and behavioral patterns, and classifies reasoning into four distinct states. Analyzing 36,234 interactions from 234 students working on 42 morphosyntactic exercises, we found that reasoning strategies vary primarily by context rather than stable traits (intraclass correlation = 0.14), and students show high persistence in unproductive states; specifically, 74.6% of failures driven by high coordination demand (rather than simple knowledge gaps) are followed by another failure without intervention. Our early warning model predicts validation success with strong accuracy (AUC = 0.826 using strategy patterns alone; 0.902 with additional sequential context) while avoiding circular reliance on current error counts. These findings demonstrate that making latent reasoning processes visible enables earlier, more targeted scaffolding that responds to how students are thinking rather than simply whether they succeed. While demonstrated in language learning, the framework provides a generalizable, interpretable architecture for diagnosing complex, structured reasoning in any domain.

</details>


### [1571] [Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35482v1)
*Dingming Li,Yiwen Qiu,Linjuan Wu,Hongxing Li,Zixuan Wang,Xinze Lyu,Ye Guo,Daoxin Zhang,Zhe Xu,Weiming Lu,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Culture-MMT 诊断基准，用于评估社交媒体翻译中的"分布式证据语用重构"，并通过控制证据条件的评测框架揭示视觉接地与文化语用适配是两个独立的模型瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体跨语言交流中，用户生成内容的语义分散于文本、图像与文化知识之中；既有评测通常将图像视为可选、默认文本信息充分，从而无法区分错误源于视觉证据缺失还是文化适配不足。

Method: 构建 Culture-MMT 基准：498 条经脱敏的精选 UGC 实例，覆盖 20 个领域，按所需证据类型分为 Symbol、Visual、Hybrid 三类；开发与人类判断对齐的领域专用评判器 Judger，并设计系统性改变译者可用证据的受控评测框架，测试 17 种模型配置。

Result: 真实图像带来显著提升：Visual 类 +0.280、Hybrid 类 +0.197，而 Symbol 类仅 +0.050；随机图像无类似增益。人工撰写的描述表明，即便视觉事实已明确，联合依赖型案例依然更难。

Conclusion: 文化有效的社交媒体翻译应被理解为"从分布式证据中进行意义重构"，视觉接地与文化语用适配构成两个相互独立的模型瓶颈。

Abstract: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

</details>


### [1572] [The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35411v1)
*Adam Hollowell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 对Gemma 2 家族六个模型（2B/9B/27B 的 base 与 instruct 变体）复现情感几何提取流程，发现核心情感几何普遍存在、线性映射可跨模型迁移、尺度增大使方差分散到更多方向但仍与效价强相关、27B 模型情感词在较深层才突现于输出词表，而指令微调的各项分析层指标变化均落在预设下限之内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有情感几何提取流程仅在 Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 Gemma 2 27B base 上各被建立或复现一次，缺乏跨模型规模与训练阶段的系统比较；作者希望检验情感几何是否是 Gemma 2 家族的普遍性质，以及模型尺度和指令微调如何影响该几何的结构（方差分布、与人类效价评分的关联、在词表输出中的可读出深度）。

Method: 采用 Sofroniew 等（2026）建立、Hollowell（2026）在 Gemma 2 27B base 上复现的情感向量提取流水线，对 Gemma 2 2B/9B/27B 的 base 与 instruction-tuned 共六个模型单元提取情感向量；用线性映射在两模型间拟合并以留出情感的目标模型向量排名评估迁移（15 对模型、30 个有序对，并用清洗后嵌入表向量重拟合）；分析主成分方差占比及其与人类效价评分的相关性随尺度的变化；将情感向量投影到 256,000 词表上，统计其自身情感词进入 top-10,000 的层深度；对微调引起的各分析层指标变化与预设下限（floor）比较，并做多重比较校正下的合并检验。

Result: （1）六个模型单元均呈现核心情感几何；单向拟合的 15 对中仅 1 次失败，每对中位排名均为 1，用清洗嵌入表向量重拟合后 30 个有序对全部在 rank 1 恢复留出情感。（2）尺度增大使方差分散到更多方向而不削弱与效价的关联：首位主成分方差占比在 base 中由 31.6%（2B）降至 29.8%（9B）、26.7%（27B），在 tuned 中由 31.9% 降至 29.2%、27.3%，但其与人类效价评分相关在六模型中均在 .71–.78。（3）2B/9B 中位情感词自第 0 层即进入 top-10,000；27B 中起始接近随机水平，约前一半网络不进入，并在第 23 层一步进入。（4）微调使所有已登记分析层指标变化均在 floor 内：效价相关上升、唤醒相关下降（后者与预测相反）但幅度均在 floor 内，PC2 方差占比下降且经校正后合并下降显著；中后层稳定性超过 floor，并溯源至 base 27B 的最后一层。

Conclusion: 情感几何是 Gemma 2 家族跨规模与训练阶段的稳健性质，可被线性映射跨模型对齐；尺度改变的是方差在方向上的分散程度而非其与效价的绑定；27B 中情感词在输出词表中的可读出性呈现明显的层间阈值式跃迁，提示更大的模型可能在更深层才将情感表征链接到词表输出；指令微调对这些已登记分析层测量的影响均不超过预设下限，说明情感几何主要继承自预训练而非由对齐微调塑造。

Abstract: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

</details>


### [1573] [SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34971v1)
*Debopam Sanyal,Hongjie Chen,Riya Elizabeth Kuriyan,Arth Tak,Divya Kothandaraman,Akshay Mehra,Joshua Kimball,Alexey Tumanov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 SVD-Attention，一种免微调的诊断方法：对每个注意力头的交互矩阵做 SVD，并用谱幅值与校准集上的激活方差联合为每个奇异模式打分，从而判断哪些头/层真正使用了满秩预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练 Transformer 的推理算力大量消耗在自注意力上，而每个头的 query-key 交互在结构上本是低秩的；但缺少对"实际数据上哪些头真正用满秩"的经验性诊断。

Method: 对每个头的交互矩阵 M_h 做奇异值分解，用谱幅值和 token 激活方差（小校准集上估计）联合给每个奇异模式打分，保留"头能放大且真实数据确实激活"的模式并精确因子化，丢弃其余模式，无需微调。

Result: 在 7 个预训练模型和 5 类任务上发现任务相关的冗余分布：情感/图像分类与生成任务冗余集中在中浅层，稠密预测与抽取式问答集中在深层。截断被标记层损失至多 1.75 F1，而截断同数量其他层最多损失 50 F1。单独使用降低 0.8–1.5% FLOPs，与权重剪枝组合降低 8–11%，任务质量变化 0–4%。

Conclusion: SVD-Attention 定位为分析工具而非压缩方法，其冗余诊断具有任务依赖性且对性能损失有良好预测性，可作为组合式效率优化的辅助手段。

Abstract: Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix $M_h$ and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. Across seven pretrained models and five task types, the diagnostic finds a task-dependent pattern: redundancy sits in the early to middle layers for sentiment and image classification and for generation, and in the late layers for dense prediction and extractive question answering. It is also predictive: truncating the layers it flags costs at most $1.75$ F1, while truncating the same number of layers elsewhere in the same model costs up to $50$ F1. SVD-Attention is an analysis tool rather than a compression method: acting on it reduces inference FLOPs by $0.8$-$1.5\%$ on its own and by $8$-$11\%$ when composed with weight pruning, with $0$-$4\%$ change in task quality.

</details>


### [1574] [HARP-LoRA: Hierarchy-Conditioned Rank Projection for Low-Rank Adaptation in Scientific Table Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34589v1)
*Hossein Sholehrasa,Mohammadhossein Amini,Doina Caragea,Remya Ampadi Ramachandran,Dan Wu,Zihang Shi,Zelin Li,Lindsey Hulbert,Eder Martinez,Xuan Xu,Majid Jaberi-Douraki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 HARP-LoRA，一种以表头层级为条件的低秩投影微调方法，用行列表头层级构造 token 级内在表示来调制 LoRA 下投影，在药代动力学科表与 WikiTQ 上以极少可训练参数超越 LoRA 与 TableLoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学表格存在多级表头、合并单元格、题注与脚注等复杂布局，信息抽取困难；在药代动力学（PK）中必须将数值正确关联到药物、物种、剂量、给药途径、单位与实验条件。现有参数高效方法（如 LoRA）虽降低适配成本，但未显式建模表格数值与其周边表头之间的关系。

Method: HARP-LoRA 扩展 projected LoRA：对每个数据 token，依据其所在行表头与列表头的层级结构构造 token 特定的内在表示，用这些表示对低秩下投影进行条件化（hierarchy-conditioned rank projection），从而在注入层级上下文的同时保持预训练模型与随机投影张量冻结。实验基于 950 张人工标注的 PK 表格（来自 587 篇文献）与 WikiTableQuestions，采用 Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma 3 27B。

Result: Llama 3.1 8B 下 PK F1 为 57.64%、WikiTQ 准确率 53.15%，较 LoRA 分别提升 1.42 与 6.56 个百分点；Gemma 3 27B 下取得最佳 PK F1 70.63%、WikiTQ 准确率 56.87%。可训练参数仅 172K、197K、547K，显著少于 LoRA 与 TableLoRA。

Conclusion: 将轻量适配器条件化于表头层级，可在保持参数高效的前提下同时改善科学表格抽取与扁平化通用域表格推理，说明层级结构信息是表格理解中有效且低成本的归纳偏置。

Abstract: Tabular data is widely used in scientific applications, where complex layouts, including multi-level headers, merged cells, captions, and footnotes, make information extraction difficult. This is particularly important in pharmacokinetics (PK), where values must be correctly associated with the drug, species, dose, administration route, unit, and experimental condition. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) reduce adaptation cost but do not explicitly incorporate relationships between table values and surrounding headers. We introduce HARP-LoRA, a hierarchy-conditioned rank projection method for low-rank adaptation in scientific table understanding. HARP-LoRA extends projected LoRA by constructing token-specific intrinsic representations from the row- and column-header hierarchies of each data token. These representations condition the low-rank down-projection, incorporating hierarchical context while keeping the pretrained model and random projection tensors frozen. We evaluate HARP-LoRA on 950 manually annotated PK tables from 587 scientific articles and on WikiTableQuestions (WikiTQ) using Llama~3.2 3B, Llama~3.1 8B, and Gemma~3 27B. With Llama~3.1 8B, HARP-LoRA achieves a PK F1-score of 57.64\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 53.15\%, improving over LoRA by 1.42 and 6.56 points, respectively. With Gemma~3 27B, it achieves the best PK F1-score of 70.63\% and WikiTQ accuracy of 56.87\%. These results use only 172K, 197K, and 547K trainable parameters, far fewer than LoRA and TableLoRA. Overall, conditioning lightweight adapters on table-header hierarchies improves extraction from scientific tables and reasoning over flatter general-domain tables while maintaining parameter efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/hosseinsholehrasa/HARP-LoRA

</details>


### [1575] [Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34585v1)
*Bahaeddin Türkoğlu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该综述性文章系统梳理了大语言模型（LLM）从Transformer架构、预训练、微调与RLHF，到检索增强生成、思维链提示、智能体工具调用，以及FlashAttention、QLoRA等效率技术的全流程，并给出方法对比表、生命周期图与评估检查清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用ChatGPT等生成式AI工具的工程师需要清晰理解"训练阶段改变了什么"与"提示词额外补充了什么"，缺乏对LLM关键概念、方法边界与评估陷阱的统一、可操作的说明。

Method: 以教程/综述方式进行概念性阐述：先介绍Transformer的上下文词间连接机制与预训练（下一词预测），再说明微调与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF，利用人类答案排序）；随后依次介绍RAG（提供外部文档）、思维链提示（引导中间推理步骤）与智能体工具使用；在效率方面介绍FlashAttention（减少注意力计算中的数据搬移）与QLoRA（量化低秩适配以降低微调显存）；并以生命周期图和对比表格归纳各方法的特性与局限。

Result: 提供了一张LLM生命周期图和多张方法对比表（含各方法局限）；给出用于评判LLM评估主张的简短检查清单，指出数据污染（测试材料混入训练）与LLM-as-a-judge（模型打分）两类风险；同时讨论了超长上下文与幻觉（虚假或无依据陈述）问题。

Conclusion: LLM能力来自"训练带来的改变"与"提示与外部增强带来的补充"两部分的叠加；评估时应区分事实准确性与"回答听起来是否有帮助"，并对数据污染、模型自评偏差等保持警惕。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. Readers get a life cycle figure and tables comparing methods and their limits. A short checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims flags test material in training (data contamination) and model-based grading (LLM-as-a-judge). It also covers very long inputs (long context) and hallucination, meaning false or unsupported claims. Check factual accuracy separately from whether an answer sounds helpful.

</details>


### [1576] [Efficient Proof Generation for Lean Statements with Multiple Candidate Answers](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34490v1)
*Pengzhen Lin,Ke Zhang,Maziar Raissi,Zhouxing Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出联合证明框架，将候选答案选择、答案补充与形式化证明生成整合为单一机制，在同等证明成功率下将token开销降至约六分之一，并利用双证明冲突检测形式化陈述的不忠实问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流程中上游求解器给出多个候选答案后，需对每个候选分别搜索证明，造成大量冗余计算开销；同时形式化陈述可能未忠实保留原题语义，且检测此问题通常依赖额外评判器。

Method: 训练一个证明器（prover），在单次调用中完成候选答案选择或提出新答案，并为至少一个答案生成证明，从而实现候选答案选择、答案补充与形式化证明生成的统一；进一步复用生成的证明，通过"同一形式陈述下两个不同答案均获得可验证证明"这一冲突来判定陈述不忠实，无需额外评判器。在Lean 4中实现。

Result: 在MATH-500、AMC 2023与AIME 2024/2025/2026上，达到与逐候选证明生成相同的形式化证明成功率，token开销约为其六分之一；并在无需额外评判器的情况下识别出至少6.1%的形式化陈述为不忠实。模型与代码已开源。

Conclusion: 联合证明是一种高效的形式化推理范式，既显著降低证明搜索的计算成本，又将证明复用为形式化忠实性的自检信号，为自动化数学推理中的效率与可靠性提供了统一解决路径。

Abstract: In formal systems such as Lean 4, efficiently finding answers to mathematical problems and generating verifiable proofs is an important task in automated mathematical reasoning. In the traditional way where an upstream solver provides multiple candidate answers, the common workflow requires searching for proofs for each candidate separately, incurring redundant computational cost. To this end, we propose a joint proof framework that integrates candidate answer selection, answer supplementation, and formal proof generation into a unified reasoning process. At its core is a trained prover that selects given or proposes new answers and generates a proof for at least one answer in a single call. Joint proof can also reuse generated proofs to check for faithfulness errors. For problems with a unique answer, if two distinct answers both obtain verifiable proofs under the same formal statement, this confirms the statement does not faithfully preserve the original problem semantics. On MATH-500, AMC 2023, and AIME 2024/2025/2026, our framework achieves the same formal proof success rate as per-candidate proof generation with about one sixth of the token cost, and identifies at least 6.1% of the formalized statements as unfaithful without requiring additional judges. Our model and code are available at https://github.com/Linppz/Gobble-Prover.

</details>


### [1577] [Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34281v1)
*Harsidak Singh Banwait,Chander Prabha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对LLMs进行系统分类综述，从BERT到GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok，梳理其数据集、算力、硬件、架构与参数，并讨论局限、计算挑战与开放问题，聚焦LLM的时间线演进。研究发现：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间取得最优比例的模型，具备更强的推理稳定性与对齐效果，且不按比例增加计算负载；规模化与可持续性的平衡是当前代际AI的核心特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs在上下文理解、少样本/零样本学习、代码生成、推理与问题求解方面能力突出且相关研究激增，但对其系统性的分类学（taxonomy）梳理工作仍然有限，缺少对模型演进脉络与关键技术要素的整体性归纳。

Method: 采用文献综述与分类学方法：以时间线为主线，系统对比从BERT等早期模型到GPT、Gemini、Claude、Grok等现代LLMs，在训练数据集、训练算力、硬件规格、架构与参数规模等维度上进行归纳与分类，并梳理局限性、计算挑战与开放问题。

Result: 发现清晰的规律：在架构复杂度与数据质量之间优化比例的模型，表现出更强的推理稳定性与更好的对齐效果，且计算负载并未按比例增加；这种规模化与可持续性之间的平衡构成当前一代AI的界定性特征。

Conclusion: LLMs的发展呈现从早期模型到当代模型的清晰演进脉络；未来方向并非单纯扩大规模，而应追求架构复杂度、数据质量与计算效率之间的协同平衡，以实现稳定推理与良好对齐的可持续发展。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. We would delve into topics like datasets used to train LLMs, computational power used during training, their hardware specifications, architecture and parameters. Further, we would also look at the limitations, computational challenges and open problems as well. This study would primarily focus on the timeline of LLMs, signifying their growth over the period. Findings reveal a clear pattern: models that optimize the ratio between architectural complexity and data quality exhibit stronger reasoning stability and better alignment, without proportionally increasing the computational load. This desired balance between scaling and sustainability is the defining characteristic of the current generation of AI.

</details>


### [1578] [$Δτ$-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34238v1)
*Shuofei Qiao,Xuanguang Pan,Yijun Chen,Wendi Feng,Bin Wu,Runnan Fang,Yuqi Zhu,Shumin Deng,Emine Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Δτ-Bench：一个模拟大型工具生态系统结构演化的可执行智能体基准，包含 42 个领域、1,588 个多轮任务与 6 个连续生态状态；最强模型/框架仅 42.3% 成功率，并据此提出 Steward，通过增量技能维护与动态供给在生态变化中保持更高成功率与更低维护开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法同时考察两类需求：在"移动的能力前沿"上主动发现高效工具使用路径，以及及时修正已积累的程序性知识。真实工具生态中服务独立演化——熟悉的工具消失或被替代、更优替代在功能重叠与文档噪声中出现——因此需要能刻画这种结构性演化的可执行基准。

Method: 构建 Δτ-Bench：42 个领域、1,588 个经校验的多轮任务，通过"保持能力等价"的变换生成 6 个相继的生态状态，使工具消失、替换、功能重叠与文档噪声受控出现。在此基础上评测各类模型与智能体框架的成功率、技能学习方法的适应性与技能维护开销；并提出 Steward——一个生态系统管理器，在任务执行过程中联合管理工具与程序性知识，采用增量式技能维护与动态供给。

Result: 即使最强的被测模型或智能体框架也仅达 42.3% 任务成功率；现有技能学习方法的初期增益无法随生态演化稳定转化为更强的适应能力。相比之下，Steward 在生态变化下维持更高的任务成功率与更低的技能维护开销，并改善受扰动工作流的恢复能力与更高效替代工具的采纳率。

Conclusion: 工具生态的结构性演化是现有基准与智能体能力的显著缺口；成功适应要求同时进行高效工具的主动探索与程序性知识的持续修订。联合管理工具与知识的生态管理器（Steward）在实践中优于仅依赖模型能力或既有技能学习方法的方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce $Δτ$-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In $Δτ$-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. $Δτ$-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.

</details>


### [1579] [Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34180v1)
*Chen Chen,Rui Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出因子化写入路由（FWR），将"是否写入"与"写多少槽位"解耦，实验发现写入策略存在密度依赖的反转：密集信息宜总是写入，稀疏事实宜学习选择性写入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列模型需保留早期信息。全注意力成本随长度增长，循环记忆模型以固定槽位压缩历史实现线性时间处理但容量有限，写入决策变得关键：干扰项会污染有用内容，被跳过的证据则无法召回。现有"多槽记忆"对所有token写入相同数量的槽位，把"是否存储"与"更新多少槽位"混为一谈。

Method: 提出因子化写入路由（FWR）：先对每个token决定保留或跳过，再选择固定或自适应于token的写入槽位数；读取时查询仍访问全部槽位。在两个需在长上下文后检索事实的合成任务（密集的 Feature Recall 与稀疏事实的 Passkey）上，各用十个随机种子评估，并对比"总是写入""学习到的门控选择写入"以及"自适应分配规则"；另设使用部署时不可得事实标签的诊断性oracle。

Result: 出现密度依赖的反转。每次写入4个槽位时，密集 Feature Recall 上"总是写入"优于选择性写入（长上下文准确率0.472 vs 0.337）；稀疏事实 Passkey 上学习到的选择性写入显著更优（0.222 vs 0.048）。在学习门控下，测试的自适应槽位规则在两个任务上均不如固定槽位分配。带事实标签的诊断oracle在 Passkey 上达到0.372，说明过滤干扰项仍有提升空间。

Conclusion: 写入策略应随信息密度而变：信息密集的上下文应避免漏写（倾向于总是写入），干扰项占主导时则应过滤干扰。FWR的因子化视角揭示了"存不存"与"存多少"分离的必要性，同时表明自适应的槽位数分配尚未带来收益，而干扰项过滤是主要的改进方向。

Abstract: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

</details>


### [1580] [T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34103v1)
*Shahriar Kabir Nahin,Xiao Ye,Muhao Chen,Ben Zhou,Anshuman Chhabra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出T2D框架，将草稿模型设计视为优化问题，用延迟感知的结构化剪枝加知识蒸馏从目标模型直接构造草稿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的效果取决于草稿与目标模型的分布对齐程度及草稿模型推理延迟，但现有方法用独立预训练小模型或手工选择结构剪枝目标模型，无法显式平衡二者权衡。

Method: 将草稿模型设计建模为优化问题，基于目标模型进行延迟感知的结构化剪枝，并结合知识蒸馏，联合优化实测推理延迟与目标模型响应上的交叉熵损失。

Result: 在多领域投机解码基准和多个不同规模目标模型族上，T2D可剪掉目标模型最多92%的参数仍获得高性能草稿模型，优于竞争基线；所得草稿模型还可被其他投机解码的token对齐与知识蒸馏方法即插即用地复用，带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 联合权衡草稿模型架构与对齐的前沿，是释放LLM投机解码潜力的关键。

Abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [1581] [Who Called? V33DA: A Physically Verified Multimodal Benchmark for Vocal Attribution in Zebra Finch Groups](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38109v1)
*Maris Basha,Yuhang Wang,Xiaoran Chen,Longbiao Cheng,Luca Yapura,Anja T. Zai,Mathieu Salzmann,Richard Hahnloser*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 论文提出 V33DA——一个面向斑胸草雀群体"空间发声归属"的多模态数据集基准，用加速度计验证的叫声标签，检验模型在已见/未见面个体上的发声者定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究社会性通讯需要判断"谁在叫"和"在哪里叫"，但现有资源要么只做声源定位而不识别个体，要么只从孤立叫声识别个体、不利用三维候选几何，且缺少经物理验证的真值标签。

Method: 构建 V33DA：33,625 个经验证事件，5 通道音频+3 路相机视角、每个可见候选个体的标定三维姿态、10 只个体与 3 组实验的无线电遥测；发声者身份由身上佩戴的加速度计振动信号验证，该通道对基准模型隐藏，仅用于"在体参考上限"。任务定义为：给定检测到的叫声与可见候选鸟，选出叫声发出者，设三种评测设定。

Result: 三种设定为：熟悉个体的跨场次测试、向新群体的跨实验迁移、留一个体交叉验证。参考方法显示域内准确率与未见个体迁移之间稳定存在差距：可利用熟悉发声身份的方法在已知发声者上表现好但迁移骤降；保留显式空间推理的候选感知方法迁移明显更好。在体参考在各设定下接近完美，验证标签内部一致性。

Conclusion: 公开 V33DA（固定协议与代码）及未经评测的 V33DA++（重叠叫声事件与±2 s 上下文窗口）。该工作揭示了身份先验依赖与空间推理泛化之间的权衡，为社交发声归属研究提供可验证基准。

Abstract: Deciding which member of an animal group produced a vocalization and where that vocalization was produced are central to studying social communication but are rarely evaluated with physically verified ground truth. Existing resources either localize sounds without identifying the caller, or recognize individuals from isolated vocalizations without reliance on the 3D candidate geometry. We close this gap with V33DA, a dataset-centered multimodal benchmark for spatial vocal attribution in social zebra finches: it comprises 33,625 verified events coupling 5-channel audio with three camera views, calibrated 3D pose for every visible candidate, and per-bird radio telemetry across 10 individuals and three experiments. Caller identity is verified from an on-body accelerometer-derived vibration signal; this channel is withheld from benchmark models and used only by an on-body reference ceiling. Given a detected vocalization and the visible candidate birds, the task is to select the caller. We evaluate it under three regimes: session-disjoint testing on familiar birds from held-out recording dates, held-out-experiment transfer to a new cohort, and leave-one-individual-out evaluation on a bird whose vocalizations are held out from training. Reference methods expose a consistent gap between in-domain accuracy and transfer to unseen individuals: methods that can exploit familiar vocal identity perform well on known callers but degrade sharply on unseen ones, whereas candidate-aware methods preserving explicit spatial reasoning transfer substantially better. The on-body reference stays near-perfect across regimes, confirming the internal consistency of the accelerometer-verified labels. We release V33DA with fixed protocols and code for the evaluated methods, and V33DA++, an unevaluated companion set of verified overlapping-call events and +/-2 s context windows.

</details>


### [1582] [SMEBENCH: Benchmarking Neural Music Editing with Synthetized MIDI Edits](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36715v1)
*Matthieu Cervera,Francesco Paissan,Micael Antunes,Mirco Ravanelli,Ricard Marxer,Cem Subakan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出SMEBench——一个基于符号MIDI编辑并渲染配对源/目标音频的大规模可控音乐编辑基准，含12类操作（配器、奏法、力度、音高）与3600例均衡测试集及少量真实多轨音频补充；借助配对目标可分别评测源保持、目标一致性与文本兼容性，并据此诊断常用音频编辑指标、基准六个代表性系统，发现排名结论会随指标而变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经音乐编辑要求系统"按要求修改同时保留不应变化的内容"，但现有评测普遍缺乏配对的目标编辑，导致"源保持"与"目标一致性"难以分开度量。

Method: 通过修改符号MIDI演奏构造可控编辑，并渲染得到匹配的源音频与目标音频；每个样本包含源音频、编辑指令、配对目标、编辑元数据与补充描述。基准覆盖十二种配器、奏法、力度与音高操作，构成均衡的3600例测试集，并附加一个由多轨录音得到的小规模真实音频补充集。

Result: 配对目标使源保持、目标一致性与文本兼容性可被独立评估；利用该参考对常见音频编辑指标进行诊断，并评测六个代表性编辑系统，结果显示用于排序系统的指标会实质性地改变最终结论。

Conclusion: 配对目标是音乐编辑评测的关键缺失环节，SMEBench为可分解、可诊断的评测提供了可行范式，同时提示现有指标存在可靠性问题，系统排名对指标选择敏感；数据集已公开。

Abstract: Neural music editing requires a system to perform a requested change while preserving the musical content that should remain unchanged. Existing evaluations often lack a paired target edit, making these requirements difficult to measure separately. We introduce SMEBench, a large-scale benchmark of controlled music edits constructed by modifying symbolic MIDI performances and rendering matched source and target audio. Each example contains a source, an instruction, a paired target, edit metadata, and complementary descriptions. The benchmark covers twelve instrumentation, articulation, dynamics, and pitch operations and includes a balanced 3,600-example test set together with a smaller real-audio complement derived from multitrack recordings. The paired targets allow source preservation, target agreement, and textual compatibility to be evaluated independently. We use these references to diagnose common audio-editing metrics and benchmark six representative editing systems, showing that the metric used to rank a system can materially change the conclusion. The dataset is available at our repository.

</details>


### [1583] [Geometric Consistency Based Label-Free Validation for Checkpoint Selection in Audio Active Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35329v1)
*Shiqi Zhang,Tuomas Virtanen*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出一种无需标签的"几何一致性"检查点选择准则，用于音频主动学习，在匹配标注预算下达到最佳AULC平均排名，性能与额外验证集相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流音频主动学习（AL）协议依赖一个假定存在的验证集来逐轮选择检查点，但验证集标签同样计入标注成本，从而削弱了本就有限的标注预算带来的优势。因此需要一种无标签的验证方法来替代验证集。

Method: 在冻结的预训练嵌入空间中，用已标注集构建最近类均值（NCM）与k近邻（kNN）两个分类器，对未标注数据预测伪标签以刻画其几何结构；以检查点与这些伪标签的一致性（几何一致性）以及其在已标注集上的交叉熵作为打分，据此选择检查点。方法适用于任意查询策略，仅有一个实际不敏感的超参数，每轮仅需对未标注数据增加一次批量前向传播。

Result: 在跨数据集、编码器与查询策略的匹配标签预算设置下，该方法在AULC（标注曲线下面积）上取得无额外标签方法中的最佳平均排名，并与超出预算的验证集方法持平。

Conclusion: 这是音频主动学习中针对检查点选择的无标签验证的首次系统性研究，表明无需标注验证集也能可靠选择检查点，保持主动学习的标注成本优势。

Abstract: Audio active learning (AL) trains a classifier at low annotation cost by labeling only an informative fraction of an unlabeled collection over successive rounds. Each round picks one of the checkpoints saved during training. Mainstream AL protocols do so with an assumed validation set, but in practice its labels also count toward the annotation cost, shrinking the advantage of an already small annotation budget. We propose geometric consistency, a label-free validation rule for checkpoint selection. Both classifiers, nearest-class-mean and k-nearest-neighbor, are built from the labeled set in a frozen pretrained embedding space. They then predict the unlabeled data to model its geometry. The rule scores each checkpoint by its agreement with these pseudo-labels and its cross-entropy on the labeled set. It works with any query strategy, has one hyperparameter, insensitive in practice, and adds only one batched forward pass over the unlabeled data per round. At matched label budgets across datasets, encoders, and query strategies, it attains the best mean rank in area under the labeling curve (AULC) among methods without extra labels and is on par with an out-of-budget validation set. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of label-free validation for checkpoint selection in audio AL.

</details>


### [1584] [A Hierarchical Method for Environmental Sounds Recognition in Complex Acoustic Scenes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34931v1)
*Zhouwen Li,Haijun Lin,Bowen Lv,Yupeng Chen*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出FTANet（频-时自适应网络）+两阶段层次分类的轻量级环境噪声识别模型：先粗分5大类，再路由到类别专属分类器细分为25类，在自建数据集、UrbanSound8K与天津在线声环境监测平台实测中均取得较好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境噪声识别对噪声控制至关重要，但传统单阶段分类器在不平衡多类条件下存在类别混淆问题。

Method: FTANet采用并行非对称一维卷积分别捕获时间动态与频带分布，并用自适应融合注意力（AFA）增强判别性声学特征；整体为两阶段层次分类：第一阶段分5个粗类（覆盖25个细类），第二阶段将样本路由至对应类别专属分类器做细粒度识别。

Result: 自建数据集粗分类准确率95.45%，仅0.2004M参数；UrbanSound8K十折平均准确率79.24%、平均F1 80.37%，优于对比卷积模型；天津在线声环境监测平台实测粗分类87.94%，正确路由到C2的自然声条件细分类准确率97.21%；完整层次模型总体准确率87.18%、加权平均F1 87.40%。

Conclusion: 层次化两阶段框架结合轻量FTANet可缓解不平衡多类下的类别混淆，参数量小、性能优于对比模型，在城市环境噪声监测中具有可行性。

Abstract: Environmental noise identification is essential for noise control, yet conventional single-stage classifiers suffer from class confusion under imbalanced multiclass conditions. This paper proposes a lightweight hierarchical model integrating a Frequency-Time Adaptive Network (FTANet) with a two-stage classification mechanism. FTANet employs parallel asymmetric one-dimensional convolutions to capture temporal dynamics and frequency-band distributions, while adaptive fusion attention (AFA) enhances discriminative acoustic features. In the first stage, FTANet classifies sounds into five coarse-grained categories covering 25 fine-grained classes. In the second stage, samples are routed to the corresponding category-specific classifiers for fine-grained recognition. On a self-constructed dataset, FTANet achieves 95.45% coarse-grained accuracy with only 0.2004M parameters. On UrbanSound8K, it achieves 79.24% mean accuracy and 80.37% mean F1-score in ten-fold evaluation, outperforming compared convolutional models. Field tests on the Tianjin Online Acoustic Environment Monitoring Platform yield 87.94% coarse-grained accuracy and 97.21% conditional fine-grained accuracy for natural sounds correctly routed to C2. The complete hierarchical model achieves 87.18% overall accuracy and 87.40% weighted-average F1-score, demonstrating its feasibility for urban environmental noise monitoring.

</details>


### [1585] [From Speech Tokens to Stolen Voices: Attacker-Chosen-Text Speaker Impersonation via Representation Inversion](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34688v1)
*Ye Lu,Shen Wang,Runze Liu,Zhitao Ou,Haonan Huang,Yihan Yan,Fanghui Sun,Zhaoyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出STIA（Speech Token Inversion Attack），利用单条短时泄漏的语音前端表示，在无原始音频与转写文本的情况下生成"受害者音色+攻击者指定文本"的语音，揭示语音表示中可复用的说话人身份信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端语音大模型使语音前端在用户设备上运行、仅将语音表示上传服务器；尽管原始音频留在本地，这些表示仍可能携带说话人身份信息，一旦被攻击者获取可用于模仿用户声音，威胁语音隐私。现有研究对该类泄漏风险缺乏量化评估。

Method: STIA将离散、连续或混合类型的语音表示统一转换为条件序列，并在公开语音数据集上使用"同一说话人不同话语"的配对数据训练条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）语音生成模型；推理时将泄漏表示中的说话人特征与攻击者指定文本结合，直接合成目标音色语音。

Result: 在仅泄漏3秒语音对应的Moshi表示条件下，STIA平均达到CAM++说话人余弦相似度0.78，目标文本词错误率3.80%，即音色相似度与可控性均较高。

Conclusion: 语音前端表示确实泄露可复用的说话人身份信息，构成实际隐私威胁；设计语音前端表示方法时须将此类风险纳入考量，并提示需研究表示层的隐私保护机制。

Abstract: Speech interaction systems have gradually evolved from traditional cascaded systems that use text as intermediate information to end-to-end speech language models that directly process speech representations. In some applications, the speech frontend runs on the user's device and sends speech representations to a remote server for inference, while the original audio remains local. However, these representations may still contain speaker identity information. If an attacker obtains them, it may use this information to imitate the user's voice, threatening their voice privacy. To investigate this risk, we propose \stia, a Speech Token Inversion Attack that generates speech with attacker-specified text in a victim's voice using a single short leaked representation, without access to the original audio or its transcript. Specifically, \stia converts discrete, continuous, or mixed speech representations into conditioning sequences and trains a conditional flow-matching speech generation model using pairs of different utterances from the same speaker in public speech datasets. The model combines speaker characteristics contained in the leaked representation with the specified text to generate speech in the victim's voice. Experiments show that, with a Moshi representation leak corresponding to 3 seconds of speech, \stia achieves an average CAM++ speaker cosine similarity of 0.78 and a target-text word error rate of 3.80\%. These results show that speech frontend representations reveal reusable speaker identity information and highlight the need to consider privacy risks when designing speech frontend representation methods.

</details>


### [1586] [Does Notation Matter? MusicXML Tokenisation for Symbolic Music Generation and Understanding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34247v1)
*Andrea Poltronieri,Matteo Spanio,Simone Chieppa,Xavier Serra,Martín Rocamora*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向 MusicXML 的通用分词框架，并通过训练 26 个自回归与掩码语言模型，系统比较 MusicXML、MIDI 与 ABC 三种符号音乐表示在深度学习中的效果，发现更丰富的记谱信息（MusicXML）在理解与生成任务上均带来可测量收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号音乐表示在完整性上差异很大（MIDI 偏演奏、MusicXML 偏完整记谱），但表示丰富度对深度学习模型的影响尚不清楚；MIDI 分词已被充分研究，而 MusicXML 作为乐谱交换的事实标准几乎未被探索。

Method: 构建首个 MusicXML 通用分词框架；训练 26 个自回归与掩码语言模型，将 MusicXML 分词与 MIDI、ABC 表示对比，考察 MusicXML 内部不同分词策略的影响，并检验音乐语法感知分词是否优于将乐谱当作纯文本处理；以线性探测评估作曲家分类、难度估计、伴奏建议等理解任务，以客观统计指标与人工成对偏好研究评估生成任务。

Result: 采用 MusicXML 分词的模型在理解任务与生成任务上均优于 MIDI 与基于文本的对等模型。

Conclusion: 记谱丰富度（notational richness）能为符号音乐深度学习带来可测量的优势，MusicXML 表示值得作为符号音乐建模的重要选择。

Abstract: Symbolic music representations encode musical content at varying levels of completeness, from performance-oriented formats such as MIDI to fully notated scores such as MusicXML. Yet the impact of this representational richness on deep learning models remains poorly understood. While tokenisation has been extensively studied for MIDI, score-based formats have received considerably less attention, and MusicXML in particular remains largely unexplored despite being the de-facto standard for score interchange. In this paper, we introduce the first general-purpose tokenisation framework for MusicXML, and conduct a systematic empirical study to determine whether notational richness confers a measurable advantage for deep learning on symbolic music. We train 26 autoregressive and masked language models, comparing MusicXML tokenisation against MIDI and ABC-based representations, probing the effect of different tokenisation strategies within MusicXML, and testing whether music-grammar-aware tokenisation outperforms treating scores as plain text. We evaluate music understanding tasks using linear probing across composer classification, difficulty estimation, and accompaniment suggestion, and generative tasks using objective statistical metrics and a human pairwise preference study. Our results show that MusicXML-tokenised models outperform MIDI and text-based counterparts on understanding and generative tasks.

</details>


### [1587] [AudioFM: Towards General Purpose Audio Representation Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34183v1)
*Yamin Li,Ruidong Zhang,Anran Wang,Eduardo Fonseca,Dan Ellis,Zechen Li,Simon A. Lee,Tao Pang,Jake Garrison,Maxwell A. Xu,Yicheng Wang,Jitian Zhang,Weizhi Zhang,Haichao Zhang,Catie Chang,Xin Liu,Anupam Pathak,Daniel McDuff,Shwetak Patel,Jake Sunshine,Yuzhe Yang,Xiaoran Fan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: AudioFM 是一个自监督音频表征学习框架，将录音级对比学习与 patch 级掩码隐表征判别相结合，在多种音频领域的线性探测、微调和零样本迁移中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有录音级对比目标只约束池化后的整体音频表征，未显式监督局部时频表征，难以同时兼顾全局声景与细粒度声学细节。

Method: 学生网络利用可见声学上下文预测被掩码 patch 的表征，并在来自其他录音的候选中识别其对应的全视图教师目标（patch 级掩码隐表征判别）；同时引入来自合格时序邻居的较弱监督以促进局部时间一致性；与录音级对比目标联合训练。

Result: 在线性探测、微调和零样本迁移上跨多音频领域达到 SOTA，事件检测表现更优、场景级理解更稳健，域泛化能力强。

Conclusion: 将录音级对比与 patch 级掩码隐表征判别互补结合，可有效统一全局声景与细粒度声学时刻的表征学习。

Abstract: Learning audio representations that effectively bridge holistic global soundscapes with fine-grained acoustic moments is a long-standing goal in self-supervised learning. Recording-level contrastive objectives encourage agreement between pooled audio representations, but do not explicitly supervise local time-frequency representations. We introduce AudioFM, a self-supervised framework that combines recording-level contrast with patch-wise masked latent discrimination. Using visible acoustic context, a student predicts representations of masked patches and identifies their corresponding full-view teacher targets among candidates from other recordings. We further incorporate weaker supervision from eligible temporal neighbors to encourage local temporal consistency. Extensive evaluations show that AudioFM achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse audio domains in linear probing, fine-tuning, and zero-shot transfer, demonstrating superior event detection, robust scene-level understanding, and strong domain generalizability.

</details>


### [1588] [EmoNet: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN for Speech Emotion Recognition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33977v1)
*Muhammad Moiz Khalid,Abdur Rehman Tariq,Muhammad Okasha Yamin*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出EmoNet——一个轻量级语音情感识别框架，基于四块深度可分离CNN编码器（含SE注意力与残差连接）、BiLSTM与多头注意力池化，使用134维声学特征及SpecAugment等增强，在TESS+RAVDESS+SAVEE合并数据集上以4.11M参数取得96.75%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音情感识别在心理健康评估、人机交互与自动客服中有重要应用，但说话人风格差异、声学条件变化使分类仍具挑战；现有主流方案多依赖大型Transformer架构，算力开销大，难以用于实时或资源受限场景，因此需要轻量化且高性能的模型。

Method: 模型由四块深度可分离卷积CNN编码器（引入squeeze-and-excitation注意力与残差连接）构成，后接BiLSTM进行时序特征建模，并采用多头注意力池化增强表征；输入使用134通道声学特征集，配合音频级扰动与SpecAugment等数据增强提升鲁棒性；在TESS、RAVDESS、SAVEE三数据集合并数据上评测，并与复现基线及更大规模SOTA模型对比。

Result: EmoNet在七类情感分类任务上取得96.75%的测试准确率，参数量仅4.11M；性能优于其复现基线，并与参数量显著更大的先进架构保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过深度可分离卷积、注意力机制与时序建模的组合，可在极低参数预算下实现高精度语音情感识别，为实时与资源受限部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is a fundamental task in affective computing that enables applications such as mental health assessment, human-computer interaction, and automated customer support systems. Accurate emotion classification from speech remains challenging due to variations in speaker style, acoustic conditions, and the high computational cost of modern deep learning approaches. Many existing systems depend on large transformer-based architectures that require substantial computational resources, making them less suitable for real-time or resource-constrained environments. This research proposes EmoNet, a lightweight deep learning framework for speech emotion classification across seven emotion categories. The model is built on a four-block depthwise separable CNN encoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and residual connections, combined with a Bidirectional LSTM for temporal feature learning and a multi-head attention pooling mechanism for improved representation. A comprehensive 134-channel acoustic feature set alongside data augmentation techniques including audio-level perturbations and SpecAugment is employed to improve robustness under diverse acoustic conditions. Evaluated on a combined dataset of TESS, RAVDESS, and SAVEE, EmoNet achieves a test accuracy of 96.75% with only 4.11 million parameters. The proposed model outperforms its reproduced baseline and remains competitive with significantly larger state-of-the-art architectures.

</details>

### [1589] [Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35816v1)
*Lennart Schiweck,Adrian Kempf,Michelle Retig,Moritz Feucht,Tim Mangliers,Benjamin Himpel*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出基于乐器活动、可见性与图像清晰度并结合节拍时间与概率相机选择的模块化多机位音乐会剪辑框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机位音乐会剪辑需在音乐相关性、视觉质量与切换时机之间做出协同决策，现有方法缺乏可解释且可扩展的整合框架。

Method: 构建模块化框架：从多轨音频提取乐器活动，结合可见乐器与图像清晰度特征，采用基于节拍的时间模型与概率化相机选择；用可解释打分模型在完整镜头区间上关联各分量与视角选择，并进行分量测试与四机位音乐会的探索性专家研究。

Result: 分量测试与专家研究对多种剪辑变体给出一致性不一的混合评价。

Conclusion: 局部视听相关性需扩展为上下文与序列级准则；该架构为检验此类扩展及研究各分量行为如何影响完整剪辑质量提供基础。

Abstract: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.

</details>
