# quant-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [1590] [Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40490v1)
*Hong-Ye Hu,Zhenlai Wang,Binzhao Luo,Tao Xiang,Chen Zhao*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 提出“神经分诊解码”（neural triage decoding）框架：利用伴随式一致性自适应分配神经计算量，使超高速率qLDPC码（数百逻辑比特，含lifted-product与Kasai码）在达到接近最优算法解码器精度的同时，解码延迟降低约1–2个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速率qLDPC码可将编码率提升至1/2以上、显著降低物理比特开销，但其实际部署依赖兼具高精度与低延迟的解码器。现有高精度解码器计算延迟大，而神经网络解码器此前尚未在高速率qLDPC码上得到验证。

Method: 1）基于伴随式一致性的自适应计算分配：局部神经消息传递网络快速给出纠错预测；2）附加迭代用于消减残余伴随式违规；3）极少触发的多样化（diversification）阶段为剩余样本搜索一致解。另对精确按位边缘解码器进行严格分析，揭示与码距无关的伴随式不一致误差下限，并考察解码器对误差先验失配的鲁棒性。

Result: Triage解码器可解码编码数百逻辑比特的超高速率qLDPC码（lifted-product码与Kasai码），精度与近最优算法解码器相当，达到当前最优水平；解码延迟降低约1–2个数量级。理论分析给出精确按位边缘解码器存在的、与码距无关的伴随式不一致误差下限；实验还表明神经网络解码器对失配的误差先验具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 自适应神经解码是实现快速、精确、可扩展量子纠错的可行路线，在近期具备实用前景。

Abstract: Quantum error correction is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computing. High-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes have emerged as a promising approach to reducing the substantial physical qubit overhead of quantum error correction, enabling encoding rates exceeding $1/2$ in blocks of approximately one thousand physical data qubits. However, their practical implementation requires decoders that combine high accuracy with low latency to keep pace with quantum hardware. Existing decoders of high-rate qLDPC codes can achieve high accuracy but often incur substantial computational latency, whereas neural network decoders have yet to be demonstrated for high-rate qLDPC codes. Here, we introduce \emph{neural triage decoding}, a framework that uses syndrome consistency to adaptively allocate neural computation. A local neural message-passing network rapidly predicts error corrections, additional iterations reduce residual syndrome violations, and a rarely invoked diversification stage searches for consistent corrections to the remaining shots. We demonstrate that the \texttt{Triage} decoder can decode ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes encoding a few hundred logical qubits, including lifted-product and Kasai codes, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy comparable to the near optimal algorithmic decoders while reducing decoding latency by approximately one to two orders of magnitude. Our framework is inspired by a rigorous analysis of the exact bitwise marginal decoder, revealing a distance-independent syndrome-inconsistent error floor. In addition, we show the robustness of neural network decoders to mismatched error priors. Our results establish adaptive neural decoding as a promising route towards fast, accurate, and scalable quantum error correction in the near term.

</details>


### [1591] [Barren Plateaus in Quantum Linear Combinations: Interference and Lie-Algebraic Control](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38193v1)
*Amir Koutahi,Pouya Kananian,Hans-Arno Jacobsen*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 论文研究量子线路相干叠加（干涉）对训练信号即梯度方差的影响，区分单次LCU与反复交替分支/辅助比特混合两类结构：前者给出梯度方差下界（分支方差乘系数模的四次方），并导出含干涉项与相对相位项的精确损失/梯度公式；后者在全特殊酉辅助控制下确定生成李代数，并由匹配门实例给出单次LCU方差多项式衰减、联合Haar采样下指数集中的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相干求和量子线路引入的干涉会改变训练信号，而现有对量子线路梯度方差（贫瘠高原）的分析多针对普通线路，缺乏对LCU式叠加结构中干涉如何影响梯度方差与可训练性的定量刻画，因此需要区分不同叠加结构并给出严格界与精确公式。

Method: 1）将相干求和区分为单次线性组合酉（LCU）与分支操作和辅助比特混合反复交替的线路；2）对单次LCU，用矩阵均值为零的独立分支证明梯度方差下界（≥分支方差×|系数|⁴），不依赖Haar随机性，适用于任意门位置；3）推导精确的损失与梯度表达式，分解出分支干涉的附加贡献，并识别依赖相对系数相位的项及其在分支集合对 i·I 乘法不变时消失的条件；4）用四比特匹配门实例验证相位项可非零；5）对反复交替情形，由分支的结合代数确定生成的李代数（含可用中心相位方向）；6）从系数选取规则出发，结合后选择、测量误差与近似矩给出界。

Result: 单次LCU的总梯度方差至少为分支方差乘其系数模的四次方，且该界与门位置无关、无需Haar随机假设；干涉带来的额外贡献被精确量化，其中相位相关项在分支集合关于 i·I 乘法不变时消失，而四比特匹配门例子表明该项可非零。反复交替且全特殊酉辅助控制下，生成李代数由分支结合代数确定；该控制性结果仅在附加采样假设下才能预测集中。匹配门实例显示单次LCU方差随规模多项式衰减，联合Haar采样下呈指数集中；同时给出系数选取规则及后选择、测量误差、近似矩的界。

Conclusion: 相干叠加线路的可训练性由结构决定：单次LCU无法通过零均值分支消除梯度方差，其下界由系数模四次方控制；干涉与相对相位引入可精确计算的额外项，其中部分项可通过对称性（i·I不变性）消除；反复交叠的可控性由分支结合代数的李代数决定，指数集中需额外采样假设。系数设计与后选择/测量误差分析构成实际应用中的约束条件。

Abstract: A coherent sum of quantum circuits introduces interference that can alter the training signal. We distinguish a single linear combination of unitaries (LCU) from a circuit that repeatedly alternates branch operations and ancilla mixing. For a single-pass LCU, independent branches with zero matrix means cannot erase the differentiated branch's gradient variance: the total variance is at least the branch variance times the fourth power of its coefficient magnitude. This bound holds at any gate position and does not require the circuit unitaries to be Haar-random. Beyond this lower bound, we derive exact loss and gradient formulas that quantify the additional contributions from interference between branches. One of these terms depends on relative coefficient phases and vanishes when the branch ensemble is invariant under multiplication by $i \mathbb{I}$; a four-qubit matchgate example shows that it can be nonzero. For repeated interleaving with full special-unitary ancilla control, we determine the generated Lie algebra from the associative algebra of the branches, including the available central phase directions. This control result predicts concentration only with additional assumptions on circuit sampling. Matchgate examples exhibit polynomial single-pass LCU variances and exponential concentration under joint Haar-random sampling. We also derive coefficient-selection rules and bounds for postselection, measurement error, and approximate moments.

</details>


### [1592] [Quantum Evolution Kernel for Node-Attributed Graphs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36984v1)
*Manuel Padovani,Alessandra Di Pierro,Claudia Daffara*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 提出将节点属性图嵌入中性原子量子计算机的新方法，基于三能级量子态做节点级特征编码，并用于数字识别任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展PASQAL的量子演化核（QEK），使其能处理带节点属性的图数据，从而在量子框架下利用属性信息完成分类任务。

Method: 在QEK基础上引入基于三能级（qutrit）量子态的节点级特征编码，给出可提取相关性信息用于分类的原型；整个量子过程用Pulser库模拟（受模拟规模限制）。

Result: 在数字识别任务上，采用Wasserstein距离后，本方法取得比常用的Jensen-Shannon距离方法更高的平均准确率。

Conclusion: 三能级节点属性编码结合Wasserstein距离可有效提升量子核方法在数字识别上的表现，但模拟规模仍受限于实验数据集大小。

Abstract: We present a novel approach to embed node-attributed graphs onto neutral-atom quantum computers, and propose an application to digit recognition. Our approach extends PASQAL's quantum evolution kernel (QEK) by introducing a node-level feature encoding based on three-level quantum states. To this purpose, we present a prototype showing how the resulting embedding can be leveraged to extract correlation-based information for classification tasks. The entire quantum process is simulated using Pasqal's Pulser library, which inevitably imposes constraints on the size of the experimental datasets. We compare our method with classical baselines to evaluate its potential. We show that, for the digit recognition task, our method achieves a higher mean accuracy than the more commonly used Jensen-Shannon distance-based methods by utilizing the Wasserstein distance.

</details>


### [1593] [Wave Is All You Need: A Quantum Language Model Based on Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34492v1)
*Jun Liu*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 提出基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（FC-QBM）的自注意力机制及语言模型FC-QBM-LM，通过语义量子态的酉演化隐式实现位置编码与自注意力，数学上等价于经典自注意力；8量子比特模型仅44参数，在唐诗语料上收敛良好且具强噪声鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典自注意力需将连续语义流离散为矩阵并显式做矩阵乘法，计算开销大且归一化需额外处理；作者希望借助量子态的酉演化天然归一化的特性，设计一种隐式完成位置编码与注意力计算的量子自注意力机制。

Method: 构建基于FC-QBM的自注意力机制：对语义量子态做酉演化，隐式实现位置编码与自注意力，测量结果天然满足归一化；严格推导其计算原理并证明与经典自注意力数学等价；推导FC-QBM-LM的训练与生成原理并给出两个算法；在唐诗语料上训练8量子比特模型，比较以Y轴/ X轴旋转门结尾的线路，并在8种噪声强度下做小样本实验。

Result: 8量子比特设置下量子层仅用44个参数即完成整个位置编码与自注意力流程；无噪声时收敛良好；以Y轴旋转门结尾的线路收敛优于X轴版本；小样本、8种噪声强度下保留超过99%的无噪声收敛性能；五言绝句生成实验初步展现联想发散、意象内容生成与符合人类习惯的词序排列三项能力。

Conclusion: FC-QBM自注意力可等价替代经典自注意力并以极少参数实现，兼具良好收敛性与噪声鲁棒性，为量子语言模型提供可行原型；后续需在更大规模、真实噪声硬件及生成质量定量评估上进一步验证。

Abstract: This work proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine (FC-QBM), and further constructs a fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine language model (FC-QBM-LM) using the mechanism as the core engine. By performing unitary evolution on semantic quantum states, the mechanism implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention computation, eliminating the need to decompose continuous semantic streams into discrete matrices for explicit matrix multiplication, with the measurement results naturally satisfying the normalization condition. Specifically, this work rigorously derives the computational principle of the self-attention mechanism based on FC-QBM, and demonstrates that this mechanism is mathematically equivalent to the classical self-attention mechanism. The mathematical principles governing the training and generation of FC-QBM-LM are thoroughly derived, and the two corresponding algorithms are subsequently developed. An 8-qubit FC-QBM-LM is finally constructed and trained on the corpus of Tang poetry. Under the 8-qubit setting, the quantum layer implements the entire positional encoding and self-attention computation pipeline with only 44 parameters. In the noiseless scenario, the model exhibits favorable convergence. Furthermore, the quantum circuit proposed in this work, which terminates with Y-axis rotation gates, achieves better convergence than the counterpart terminating with X-axis rotation gates. Under the small-sample regime and across eight distinct noise intensity levels, the model demonstrates strong noise robustness, retaining over 99% of its noiseless convergence performance. Experiments on five-character quatrain generation reveal that the model preliminarily exhibits three core capabilities: associative and divergent thinking, content generation across imagery and human-aligned word ordering.

</details>

### [1594] [Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review: Application to Online Cell-Type Labeling](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40252v1)
*Xuhe Zhang,Zhi Huang,Ying Jin*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出CARED框架，在分布偏移下通过随机专家抽检实现AI辅助细胞类型标注的长期累计误差控制，最多70%细胞可免于专家复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字病理中AI模型可加速细胞类型标注，但若要安全规模化应用，必须确定哪些模型生成标签可免专家复核且具备误差控制。由于不同组织区域与切片间细胞形态和类型组成会变化，一次性校准不可靠，亟需在分布偏移下仍有效的误差控制方法。

Method: 提出Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift（CARED），一种无分布假设框架：对每个到来批次均匀随机抽取子集交由专家复核，用所得标签校准后续决策；对未复核样本判定可安全跳过标注的子集，并为其余样本提供候选标签供下游裁定。理论证明在无平稳性与可交换性假设下，对完整流及抽检样本之外的细胞均实现累计误差长期控制；并引入类条件保证以覆盖重要但稀有的细胞类型，以及效用模块以提升自动处理率、缩小候选集并增强生物学一致性而不损害有效性。

Result: 在胰腺、肺、卵巢标注流及由真实专家标注构建的流上实验表明，CARED可控制累计误差，同时相当比例细胞（最高70%）绕过专家复核。

Conclusion: CARED为演化工作流中AI辅助细胞标注提供了无需分布假设、可长期误差控制的实用方案，并有针对稀有类型与实用性的扩展。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) models can accelerate cell-type annotation in digital pathology, but safely scaling their use requires determining, with error control, which model-generated labels can be accepted without expert review. This is challenging in evolving workflows because cell morphology and type composition may change across tissue regions and slides, making one-time calibration unreliable. We propose Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift (CARED), a distribution-free framework that leverages randomized expert audit to achieve long-run error control for AI-assisted annotation under distribution shift. For each incoming batch, CARED uniformly selects a subset of cases for expert review and uses the acquired labels to calibrate later decisions. Among unreviewed cases, CARED determines a subset of them to safely skip expert labeling, while suggesting candidate labels for the others for downstream resolution. We prove that this workflow provides long-run control of cumulative error over both the full stream and the cells outside of the audit sample, without stationarity or exchangeability assumptions. We further enhance the framework by introducing class-conditional guarantees to ensure error control within important but rare cell types, together with a utility module to target more automatic resolutions, smaller candidate sets, and greater biological coherence, without compromising validity. Experiments on pancreas, lung, and ovary annotation streams, together with a stream constructed from real expert annotations, show that CARED controls the cumulative errors while a substantial fraction of cells (up to 70%) bypass expert review.

</details>


### [1595] [Tabular foundation models are not a shortcut to calibrated clinical risk prediction: a pre-registered simulation against the true risk](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39065v1)
*Ebrahim Khaled Ebrahim*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文通过已知真实风险的预注册仿真（58个场景×1000次随机设计）与四个临床数据集，比较三种表格基础模型（TabPFN-3.5、TabICLv2、Mitra-v2）与Firth逻辑回归（截距校正，FLIC）的校准表现。结论：基础模型并非实现良好校准的捷径，其校准斜率仅在少数场景（n=200、3%事件率）优于FLIC；即使3000例样本也常不足以保证校准；真实数据中无模型能抵抗人群事件率漂移，需在本地500例上重新校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型可直接对表格数据预测风险而无需拟合，但其风险预测是否"正确"（即校准）此前仅在真实数据上评判，而真实数据中真实风险未知，无法客观衡量校准误差。作者因此希望在真实风险已知的仿真环境中，系统检验基础模型的校准能力是否优于经典回归方法。

Method: 预注册仿真研究：在58个场景、1000次随机设计下，比较TabPFN-3.5、TabICLv2、Mitra-v2与Firth逻辑回归（截距校正，FLIC）；以预注册边距为判据，评估平均风险、截距与斜率的校准；随后在四个临床数据集上验证，并检验人群事件率变化的影响及本地重新校准（500例）的修复效果。

Result: 在48个核心场景中，基础模型的校准斜率有36或37个落在FLIC的预注册边距内，仅在n=200、事件率3%时更优。即便n=3000，FLIC、TabPFN-3.5与Mitra-v2在事件率10%和30%时仅有63%–83%的样本在三项校准指标上接近真值，3%事件率时降至35%–50%；TabICLv2更差（8%–39%和1%–3%）。随机设计中，基础模型有25%–38%的情况真实校准误差显著低于FLIC，无一例显著更高（但预计n=3000时会出现小幅劣势）。真实数据上，无模型能抵抗人群间事件率变化，在500例本地患者上重新校准可大幅修复。

Conclusion: 表格基础模型并未提供通往良好校准的捷径：其校准性能总体与截距校正的Firth逻辑回归相当，仅在特定小样本、低事件率情形下略有优势，且高维/大样本下仍存在校准不足风险。临床应用时应关注事件率漂移并实施本地重新校准。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models are pretrained networks that predict risk from a table without fitting a model. Whether their risks are correct (calibrated) has been judged on real data, where true risk is unknown. In a pre-registered simulation with known true risks, we compared TabPFN-3.5, TabICLv2 and Mitra-v2 with Firth logistic regression with intercept correction (FLIC) in 58 scenarios and 1,000 random designs, then on four clinical data sets. Foundation models were not a shortcut to calibration. Their calibration slope matched FLIC's within the pre-registered margin in 36 or 37 of 48 core scenarios and was better only at n = 200 with a 3% event rate. Even 3,000 patients were often not enough: with FLIC, TabPFN-3.5 or Mitra-v2, 63%-83% of samples gave risks close to the truth in average, intercept and slope at event rates of 10% and 30%, and 35%-50% at 3%. TabICLv2 did worse (8%-39% and 1%-3%). Across the random designs, foundation models had a lower true calibration error than FLIC beyond the margin in 25%-38% and a higher one in none, though small losses were predicted at n = 3000. On real data, no model resisted a change in event rate between populations; recalibration on 500 local patients largely repaired it.

</details>


### [1596] [Pro-Active Inference](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34681v1)
*Skyler Wu,Yash Nair,Antoine Maechler,Emmanuel J. Candès*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 本文提出无放回形式的主动推断框架 PAI（Pro-Active Inference），在仅有全量协变量与 ML 预测、只能观测少量标签的设定下，主动选择标注对象并在线更新预测，构造统计有效的置信区间，并给出有限样本无偏性、渐近有效性与效率分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计总体均值在科学应用中很常见，但观测全部结果成本过高；通常全量协变量与 ML 预测可得，仅少数结果能被观测。目标是利用这些信息主动挑选待标注样本、随标签到来更新预测，并给出统计有效的置信区间。

Method: 提出 PAI 的无放回版本，扩展此前的有放回方法与 Active Statistical Inference；不采用固定顺序的"跳过标签"决策，而是从剩余协变量池中主动选择下一个标注样本，并兼容在线 ML 更新。建立有限样本无偏性与渐近有效性，提出改进的有限样本方差估计量，并将 PAI 扩展到超总体推断，无需 Bonferroni 校正或 α 分割。在准 oracle 设定下刻画 PAI 相对 Batch Active Inference 的潜在效率增益，强调预测残差不平衡的作用；并用可解释的、理论驱动的诊断与冻结 ML 消融实验分析效率得失机制。

Result: 在八个不同数据集上，使用相同的 ML 预测器与不确定性分数，PAI 在绝大多数测试设定下比 Sequential Active Inference 采样效率更高，统计覆盖率接近名义水平。但与 Prediction-Powered Inference、均匀采样等更简单基线以及密切相关的 Prediction-Powered Active Testing 相比，额外自适应性有时提升、有时损害统计效率。

Conclusion: PAI 提供了统一的、无需放回假设的主动推断框架，兼具理论保证与实证采样效率优势；但自适应性的收益并非普遍，取决于初始残差估计问题与后续在线学习动态，需通过诊断与消融加以判断。

Abstract: Estimating a population mean is fundamental across scientific applications, but observing every outcome can be prohibitively expensive. Often, covariates and machine learning (ML) predictions are available for the full population, even when only a small subset of outcomes can be observed. How can we leverage this information to proactively select observations to label, update ML predictions as labels arrive, and construct statistically valid confidence intervals? We develop a general, without-replacement formulation of Pro-Active Inference (PAI), extending our earlier with-replacement approach and building on Active Statistical Inference. Rather than making fixed-order label-skip decisions, PAI proactively selects which observation to label next from the remaining covariate pool while accommodating online ML updates. We establish PAI's finite-sample unbiasedness and asymptotic validity, develop an improved finite-sample variance estimator, and extend PAI to superpopulation inference without Bonferroni corrections or $α$-splitting. We characterize PAI's potential efficiency gains over Batch Active Inference in a quasi-oracle setting, highlighting the role of prediction-residual imbalance. Across eight diverse datasets, PAI achieves greater sampling efficiency than Sequential Active Inference in the vast majority of tested settings with near-nominal statistical coverage, using the same ML predictor and uncertainty score. However, comparisons with simpler baselines such as Prediction-Powered Inference and uniform sampling, as well as the closely related Prediction-Powered Active Testing, reveal when additional adaptivity helps or hurts statistical efficiency. Through interpretable, theory-motivated diagnostics and frozen-ML ablations, we investigate when and why PAI gains or loses efficiency, highlighting the initial residual-estimation problem and subsequent online learning dynamics.

</details>


### [1597] [Synthetic Data Augmentation for Functional Data: Wasserstein Risk Bounds and Diffusion-Based Conditional Generation](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34120v1)
*Yuhao Qi,Wenlin Dai,Xuehu Zhu*

Main category: stat.ME

TL;DR: 该文研究用类条件函数扩散生成器做合成数据增强，在Wasserstein-1距离下给出理论保证，包括合成曲线上训练的上下界风险、最优合成曲线数量、合成数据优于真实数据的条件，以及类别不平衡下的合成曲线分配界，并在温度、高光谱和步态曲线数据上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数型数据采集成本高，样本量常仅为数十到数百条曲线；现有合成数据增强理论面向有限维数据且依赖全变差，对函数无信息量，缺乏函数型数据增强的理论保障。

Method: 采用类条件函数扩散生成器生成合成曲线；在Wasserstein-1距离下刻画生成器，对稳定下游估计器给出在合成曲线上训练风险的上下界（等价于在同等数量真实曲线上训练的风险加生成惩罚项），推导最优合成曲线数量及合成数据优于真实数据的条件；对类别不平衡情形，在不做样本划分的情况下界定真实与合成曲线联合训练的超额风险，并据此分配合成曲线。

Result: 理论上得到风险的上下界、最优合成样本数、合成优于真实的条件以及不平衡下的超额风险界；实验表明增强提升了分类、函数到标量回归和函数到函数回归的性能，且在类别不平衡下将合成曲线导向少数类获得最大增益。

Conclusion: 函数型扩散生成器增强在Wasserstein-1框架下具备可证明的效用，其收益可分解为“等效真实样本+生成惩罚”，并可通过按类分配合成曲线在类别不平衡下获得最大提升。

Abstract: Functional data are costly to collect; samples of tens to hundreds of curves are common. Synthetic data augmentation can help, but its theory is developed for finite-dimensional data and relies on total variation, which is uninformative for functions. We study augmentation with a class-conditional functional diffusion generator and state guarantees in the Wasserstein-1 distance. For stable downstream estimators, we bound the risk of training on synthetic curves, from above and below, by the risk of training on as many real curves plus a generation penalty, and derive the best number of synthetic curves and a condition under which synthetic data outperform real data. For allocating synthetic curves under class imbalance, we bound the excess risk of training on real and synthetic curves together, without sample splitting. In applications to temperature, hyperspectral and gait curves, augmentation improved classification, function-to-scalar regression and function-to-function regression, and directing synthetic curves to the minority class gave the largest gain under class imbalance.

</details>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [1598] [Diagnosing Optimizer-Landscape Interaction via Representation in Subset Selection Multitasking: Evidence from Piano Fingering](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39779v1)
*Ananda Phan Iman,Tingyang Wei,Chang Wook Ahn*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文通过适应度景观分析，研究连续松弛编码对进化多任务优化（EMTO）中表示诱导适应度景观及知识迁移效果的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续松弛常被用作EMTO的统一搜索空间编码方案，但其会重塑诱导适应度景观，对优化行为与知识迁移的影响尚缺乏深入理解。

Method: 以钢琴指法估计（子集选择问题的代表性案例）为对象，引入多种编码变体，借助适应度景观分析考察表示诱导景观与优化器行为的交互，及对搜索动态和解质量的影响。

Result: 迁移有效性强烈关联于表示诱导景观特征的变化，而非仅由算法因素决定。

Conclusion: 表示设计是EMTO中有效知识迁移的关键因素，应作为核心设计考量。

Abstract: Continuous relaxations are commonly used as an encoding scheme for evolutionary multitasking optimization (EMTO), allowing heterogeneous tasks to be optimized within a unified search space. However, these continuous representations fundamentally reshape the induced fitness landscape, and their impact on optimization behavior and knowledge transfer remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge the gap by analyzing the interaction between the representation-induced fitness landscape and optimizer behavior through fitness landscape analysis. Using piano fingering estimation as a representative case of the subset selection problem, we introduce several encoding variants and investigate how their induced landscapes influence search dynamics and solution quality under EMTO. Our analysis indicates that transfer efficacy is strongly associated with changes in representation-induced landscape characteristics, rather than algorithmic factors alone, highlighting the representation design as the key factor of effective knowledge transfer in multitasking optimization.

</details>


### [1599] [GC-LIF: Spiking Group-Equivariant Neural Network With Group-Coupled Membrane Dynamics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39601v1)
*Nhan Trong Luu,Duong Trung Luu,Thang Cong Truong*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该文给出脉冲神经网络中LIF神经元保持G-等变性的充要条件（参数须沿联合轨道为常数），据此提出GC-LIF与SGE-Net，实现无需旋转数据增强的旋转不变脉冲视觉推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN具备事件驱动、低功耗优势，但其旋转不变性仅靠数据增强获得；群等变CNN将对称性内置于结构，而SNN缺乏忠实对应物——因为G-等变卷积后的LIF神经元会因膜电位递归破坏等变性，且SNN常用的逐神经元异质参数与之冲突。

Method: 给出该现象不发生（即每时间步保持等变）的充要条件：神经元参数(β, v_th)须在群作用于(群,空间)索引的联合轨道上为常数；该条件被闭式求解，适用于任意逐元素有状态神经元。满足条件的逐通道参数化方案称为Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF)，与p4、p4m等变卷积及脉冲率群最大池化组合成SGE-Net。

Result: 在MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100上，将各检查点分别在干净测试集及其全部群变换副本上评估：未用旋转训练的SGE-Net对C4、D4不变，并在10个数据集-群对中的9个上优于用旋转训练的普通SNN；非等变基线最坏情况损失达72个百分点。算子级测试在训练前后均验证理论，解析估计显示SGE-Net在8个时间步下算术能耗为普通CNN的1.7倍、比对应ANN低2.3倍。

Conclusion: LIF的参数异质性会破坏群等变性，沿联合轨道共享参数是充要解；GC-LIF+SGE-Net证明SNN可在不依赖旋转增强的情况下获得严格C4/D4不变性并保持竞争精度与低能耗。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise event-driven, low-power inference, but on vision tasks they still acquire rotation invariance only through data augmentation. Group-equivariant CNNs build such symmetries into the architecture, yet a faithful spiking analogue is missing: a leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron placed after a $G$-equivariant convolution can break equivariance through its membrane recurrence. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for this not to happen. The layer is equivariant at every time step if and only if the neuron parameters $(β, v_{\mathrm{th}})$ are constant along the joint orbits of the group action on the (group, space) index. We solve it in closed form, and it covers any elementwise stateful neuron. Its sufficiency half specialises a known result for equivariant recurrent networks; its necessity half rules out the heterogeneous per-neuron parameters common in SNNs. The per-channel parameterisation that satisfies it, Group-Coupled LIF (GC-LIF), is combined with $p4$ and $p4m$-equivariant convolutions and a spike-rate group max-pool into SGE-Net. On MNIST, KMNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, evaluating each checkpoint on the clean test set and all its group-transformed copies, SGE-Net trained without rotations is invariant under $C_4$ and $D_4$ and outperforms a plain SNN trained with rotations in nine of ten dataset-group pairs, whereas non-equivariant baselines lose up to $72$ percentage points in the worst case. Operator-level tests confirm the theory before and after training, and an analytical estimate places SGE-Net at $1.7\times$ the arithmetic energy of a standard CNN and $2.3\times$ below its ANN counterpart at eight time steps.

</details>


### [1600] [FPGAFly: A 166.7k-Neuron Fruit-Fly Connectome on One FPGA via Deferred Spike Expansion and Shared-Codeword States](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38118v1)
*YE Ziyang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: FPGAFly 在单块 FPGA（Gowin GW5AST-LV138）上实现了果蝇雄性中枢神经系统 16.67 万神经元、2560 万突触连接的完整连接组实时仿真，为单芯片全脑建模提供可行方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 突触分辨率的果蝇连接组使逐神经元仿真成为可能，但全脑模型依赖昂贵软件或多块神经形态芯片，单块 FPGA 仅能承载小规模或统计性网络。直接扩展面临两大瓶颈：逐突触脉冲展开使队列流量随扇出（最高 11.2k）放大；41 位神经元状态需 6.83 Mbit，超过目标器件 6.27 Mbit 的片上 BSRAM。

Method: 1）保持顺序的延迟展开队列：按源 ID 顺序为每个脉冲存储单个 64 位描述符，抑制扇出导致的流量膨胀；2）24 位状态编码：正常态、不应期态与量化越界态共享码字，压缩存储开销。

Result: 外部存储器流量降低 54.5%–57.9%，队列峰值数据量降低 95.6%–96.5%，且结果位级一致；BSRAM 占用由 438 降至 270，仅增加 1245 个 LUT，10,000 次 MNIST 预测输出零差异。在 80 MHz 下，每 100 ms 仿真窗口平均耗时 86.83 ms，2000 次测试中最坏 93.05 ms。

Conclusion: 通过算法-架构协同优化，首次在单块 FPGA 上完成完整果蝇中枢神经系统连接组的实时仿真，验证了单芯片全脑规模脉冲网络仿真的可行性。

Abstract: Synapse-resolution fruit-fly (Drosophila) connectomes enable neuron-by-neuron simulation of entire insect nervous systems, yet whole-brain models still require computationally demanding software or multiple neuromorphic chips, and single FPGAs support only small or statistical networks. Scaling to the full connectome, per-synapse spike expansion scales queue traffic with fan-out up to 11.2k, while 41-bit neuron states require 6.83 Mbit, exceeding the 6.27 Mbit on-chip block static RAM (BSRAM) of the target device. FPGAFly runs the 166.7k-neuron, 25.6M-connection leaky integrate-and-fire male central nervous system (CNS) connectome on one FPGA. Order-preserving deferred expansion queues one 64-bit descriptor per spike in source-ID order, cutting external memory traffic by 54.5%-57.9% and peak queue data by 95.6%-96.5% with bit-identical results. A 24-bit encoding shares codewords across normal, refractory, and quantized out-of-range states, reducing BSRAM usage from 438 to 270 with 1245 extra LUTs and zero changes across 10,000 MNIST predictions. At 80 MHz on a Gowin GW5AST-LV138, each 100 ms window finishes in 86.83 ms on average and within 93.05 ms across 2000 tests, realizing the first complete Drosophila CNS connectome simulation on one FPGA.

</details>


### [1601] [TRON: Transferring Naturally Evolved Network Architectures into Neuroevolution](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35647v1)
*Konstantinos Zacharopoulos,Alexandra Bekou,Jose M Serradell,Foteini Paraskevopoulou,Apostolos Fournaris,Ioannis Arapakis,Oscar Lao*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: TRON 提出以实验测得的蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络作为神经网络架构先验，替代随机拓扑初始化，并结合物种形成与"物种隔离"机制进行神经进化搜索；在 3 个分类与 3 个回归基准上取得最高预测性能与更低方差，但计算成本更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS 面临神经网络拓扑空间巨大且非线性的难题；进化方法虽可生成架构，但变异与重组过程中难以保持功能组织，效果受限。作者假设自然进化的生物网络蕴含支持适应性与可进化性的组织原则，可作为架构先验。

Method: 提出 TRON（TRansfer Of Natural networks）神经进化框架：不采用随机拓扑，而将实验表征的 PPI 网络复用为结构构建单元（架构先验）；将经典进化算子与神经进化机制（如物种形成/speciation）结合，并引入"物种隔离"（species quarantine）以保护新生架构的早期成熟阶段。在 CORA、CITESEER、PUBMED 三个分类基准与 DIABETES、FRIEDMAN、CALIFORNIA 三个回归基准上与既有进化及神经进化方法对比。

Result: TRON 在所有分类数据集及多数回归任务上取得最高预测性能；独立运行间方差显著更低，表明鲁棒性与收敛稳定性更强；代价是计算开销增加。

Conclusion: 结果支持 PPI 网络作为有效架构先验，表明生物来源的交互网络比随机拓扑更适合作为神经进化的基底；TRON 验证了将自然进化网络架构迁移到 AI 系统的可行性，为通过复用生物组织原则提升 NAS 可进化性提供了方向。

Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) is challenging because of the vast, non-linear space of artificial neural network (ANN) topologies. Evolutionary methods can generate architectures, but their effectiveness is limited by difficulties in preserving functional organization during mutation and recombination. Naturally evolved biological networks may provide organizational principles that support adaptation and evolvability. Here, we introduce TRON (TRansfer Of Natural networks), a neuroevolution framework that uses experimentally characterized protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks as architectural priors. Instead of starting from random topologies, TRON reuses biological interaction patterns as structural building blocks. It combines classical evolutionary operators with neuroevolution-inspired mechanisms, including speciation, and introduces species quarantine to protect newly generated architectures during early maturation. We evaluated TRON against established evolutionary and neuroevolutionary methods on three classification benchmarks (CORA, CITESEER, and PUBMED) and three regression benchmarks (DIABETES, FRIEDMAN, and CALIFORNIA). TRON achieved the highest predictive performance among the evaluated methods on all classification datasets and most regression tasks. It showed substantially lower variability across independent runs, indicating greater robustness and convergence stability, at increased computational cost. These findings support the use of PPI networks as effective architectural priors and suggest that biologically derived interaction networks provide more favorable substrates for neuroevolution than random topologies. More broadly, TRON demonstrates the feasibility of transferring naturally evolved network architectures into artificial intelligence systems, offering a direction for improving evolvability in NAS through the reuse of biological organizational principles.

</details>

# q-bio.BM [[Back]](#toc)

### [1602] [mdRNAcat: A Molecular Dynamics RNA Catalog of REST2 Conformational Ensembles](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35204v2)
*Anton E. Dorn,Emile de Bruyn,Fabrice von der Lehr,Philipp Knechtges,Stefan Kesselheim,Alexander Schug*

Main category: q-bio.BM

TL;DR: mdRNAcat：48个RNA系统的全原子MD数据集，采用REST2增强采样，提供坐标、瞬时力与参考哈密顿量下重评估的力，用于数据驱动的RNA模型开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习RNA分子模型需要能捕捉构象变异性并提供一致物理训练信号的模拟数据，而现有数据难以同时满足这两点。

Method: 选取48个序列多样性RNA系统，采用溶质缩放副本交换（REST2），每系统32个哈密顿态，每态200–300 ns生产模拟；输出原子坐标、瞬时力及未缩放参考哈密顿量下重评估的力，附结构注释与副本交换元数据；以HDF5标准化格式存储，参考态1 ps、全态100 ps间隔；并分析构象采样、交换行为、碱基配对与糖环构象分布。

Result: 构建了涵盖序列多样性的可用数据集，并表征了构象采样、副本交换效率、碱基配对及糖环褶皱分布特征。

Conclusion: mdRNAcat为开发和评估数据驱动RNA模型（含粗粒化力场）提供可复用的标准化资源。

Abstract: Learning molecular models of RNA requires simulation data that capture conformational variability and provide consistent physical training signals. Here, we introduce mdRNAcat, a curated dataset of all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of 48 RNA systems selected to promote sequence diversity. Each system is simulated using replica-exchange with solute scaling (REST2), with 32 Hamiltonian states and production lengths of 200-300 ns per state. The dataset provides atomic coordinates, instantaneous forces, and forces reevaluated under the unscaled reference Hamiltonian, together with structural annotations and replica-exchange metadata. Coordinates and forces are available at 1 ps intervals for the reference state and 100 ps intervals across all states in a standardized HDF5 format. We characterize conformational sampling, exchange behavior, base pairing, and sugar-pucker distributions to document the properties of the simulated ensembles. mdRNAcat provides a reusable resource for developing and evaluating data-driven RNA models, including coarse-grained force fields.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [1603] [Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40586v1)
*Yalin E. Sagduyu,Tugba Erpek,Sastry Kompella*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出一种带杂波抑制的多基地ISAC框架，通过残差与注意力增强的深度网络从杂波污染的观测中直接增强目标响应，实现高保真位置与速度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G及后5G机会信号ISAC可共享基础设施与频谱实现联合感知通信；多基地ISAC借助空间分布接收机扩大感知覆盖，但密集动态杂波会严重恶化双基地距离与多普勒估计，进而导致目标定位与速度估计误差。

Method: 构建多基地ISAC框架：以随机位置、不同多普勒扩展与雷达截面积的散射体建模分布式杂波，刻画密集动态杂波效应；评估多种传统信号处理杂波抑制基线；引入基于残差与注意力增强的深度神经网络杂波抑制方法，直接从含杂波观测中增强目标响应。

Result: 传统基线在强杂波条件下鲁棒性有限；所提深度学习方法在多种杂波条件下于目标位置与速度估计上显著优于传统方法。

Conclusion: 深度学习杂波抑制可有效提升多基地ISAC在密集动态杂波下的鲁棒性，实现高保真目标定位与测速。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources. While multistatic ISAC can increase sensing coverage with spatially distributed receivers, dense and dynamic clutter can significantly degrade bistatic range and Doppler estimation, leading to errors in target localization and velocity estimation. This paper presents a multistatic ISAC framework with clutter suppression for high-fidelity estimation of target position and velocity. Distributed clutter is modeled with randomly located scatterers with varying Doppler spreads and radar cross sections to capture dense and dynamic clutter effects. A broad range of conventional signal processing baselines are evaluated for clutter suppression, showing limited robustness under strong clutter conditions. To address this limitation, deep learning-based clutter suppression methods are introduced to improve robustness against dense and dynamic clutter by employing residual and attention-enhanced deep neural network architectures that directly enhance target responses from clutter-contaminated observations. These methods substantially outperform conventional approaches in target position and velocity estimation across diverse clutter conditions in multistatic ISAC.

</details>


### [1604] [Quantifying the Relay-Coverage Trade-off in Mobile Multihop Flooding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39561v1)
*Johannes F. Loevenich,Thies Möhlenhof,Roberto Rigolin F. Lopes*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 该文在157辆车的公开轨迹上，用OLSRv2与精确最小代价中继集，量化了"冗余中继"与"拓扑刷新"之间的可靠性与开销权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动多跳网络的全网泛洪依赖本地维护的拓扑信息来选择中继，但节点移动使信息过时。现有两种应对方式——增加冗余中继、或更频繁刷新拓扑并重选中继——其对可靠性与开销的权衡缺乏量化，且常被当作相互独立的鲁棒性机制。

Method: 基于157辆车的公开轨迹，采用OLSRv2并结合精确最小代价中继集计算，测量中继覆盖生存时间、二跳邻居覆盖约束，并对比瞬时链路状态下的中继选择，进而比较不同应用泛洪速率下的开销。

Result: 两倍覆盖仅将中继覆盖生存时间的中位数提升2.3倍，远低于独立风险模型预测的约一个数量级；43.6%的二跳邻居只有唯一可选中继，且新出现邻居会使既有覆盖失效；使用瞬时链路状态时，第二中继的投递增益从0.061降至0.016。开销交叉点约在每节点100 bit/s的应用泛洪速率。

Conclusion: 中继覆盖与拓扑刷新构成可度量的"冗余—新鲜度"权衡，而非相互独立的鲁棒机制。低于约100 bit/s时两倍覆盖开销更低，高于该值则刷新拓扑更优，故中继冗余应视为依赖负载的设计选择，而非固定的启发式鲁棒参数。

Abstract: Network-wide flooding in mobile multihop networks selects relays from locally maintained topology information. Mobility makes this information outdated, leaving two basic responses: add redundant relays or refresh the topology and re-select relays more frequently. How these mechanisms trade reliability for overhead, however, is not well quantified. We quantify this trade-off on a public trace of 157 vehicles using Optimized Link State Routing version 2 (OLSRv2) and exact minimum-cost relay sets. Twofold coverage increases median relay-cover lifetime by only 2.3x, rather than about an order of magnitude as predicted by an independent-hazard model. The limitation is structural: 43.6 % of two-hop neighbours have only one possible relay, and newly appearing neighbours invalidate existing covers. Moreover, the delivery gain of a second relay falls from 0.061 to 0.016 when relay selection uses instantaneous link state, showing that redundancy mainly compensates for outdated topology information. Relay coverage and topology refresh therefore form a measurable redundancy-freshness trade-off rather than independent robustness mechanisms. In our trace, twofold coverage has lower overhead below about 100 bit/s of application flooding per node, whereas fresher topology information has lower overhead above it. This makes relay redundancy a load-dependent design choice rather than a fixed heuristic robustness setting.

</details>


### [1605] [Keeping Inference in the Radio: Design and Measurement of a Spiking Accelerator for mmWave ISAC Activity Recognition](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37480v1)
*Anthony Sánchez,Rafael Ruiz,José A. Belloch,Jesús O. Lacruz,Joerg Widmer*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文研究能否用脉冲神经网络（SNN）作为"常开"的微多普勒人体活动识别分类器：用Spiker+框架在DISC数据集（60 GHz IEEE 802.11ay）上生成SNN硬件加速器，与脉冲编码器一起部署于ZCU208 RFSoC可编程逻辑中，实现从微多普勒帧到活动标签的全链路推理。132神经元的全连接SNN在新受试者上达94.7%准确率（macro-F1 90.7%），单次推理206微秒，逻辑资源仅为同拓扑常规网络的1/8，动态能耗显著更低；量化感知训练可将其权重压缩至3比特而精度损失小于0.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通感一体化（ISAC）使无线网络能够利用接收端本就计算的信道估计进行人体活动识别，但推理通常运行在基站、AP或手机的通处理器上，而通用处理器恰恰是设备为节能最先关闭的部件。因此常开感知需要一个足够小、可在系统其余部分休眠时持续供电运行的分类器。作者旨在验证SNN能否胜任这一角色。

Method: 使用开源Spiker+框架在公开DISC数据集（60 GHz IEEE 802.11ay微多普勒数据）上自动生成SNN加速器，并将其与脉冲编码器共同实现在ZCU208 RFSoC上，使从微多普勒帧到活动标签的完整链路均运行于可编程逻辑中；采用全连接SNN（132个神经元），并与同器件上同拓扑的常规网络（分别输入相同二值脉冲与16位频谱图）对比资源占用、动态能耗与精度，同时评估量化感知训练对权重位宽的压缩效果。

Result: 132神经元全连接SNN在未见受试者上取得94.7%准确率（90.7% macro-F1），单次推理耗时206微秒；相比同器件同拓扑常规网络，逻辑资源仅需约1/8；每决策动态能耗比输入相同二值脉冲的网络低3.4倍（准确率相当），比输入16位频谱图的网络低7.6倍（准确率仅低1.2个百分点）；量化感知训练将权重量化至3比特，精度与6比特网络相差不足半个百分点（在相同编码器阈值下）。

Conclusion: SNN可作为常开通感活动识别的低功耗分类器：其事件驱动特性与硬件友好的紧凑结构在RFSoC可编程逻辑中实现了极低逻辑开销与动态能耗，同时保持高精度；结合量化感知训练进一步压缩权重位宽，为系统休眠期间的持续感知提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication allows wireless networks to recognize human activity from the channel estimates that the receiver computes anyway. The inference, however, runs on the general-purpose processors of the base station, access point or handset, which are the first components a device switches off to save energy. Always-on sensing therefore requires a classifier that is small enough to remain powered while the rest of the system sleeps. We investigate whether Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can provide such a classifier. To this end, we generate SNN accelerators for micro-Doppler activity recognition on the public DISC dataset (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz) with the open-source Spiker+ framework, and implement them together with a spike encoder on a ZCU208 RFSoC, so that the complete chain from micro-Doppler frame to activity label runs in programmable logic. A fully connected SNN with 132 neurons achieves 94.7 % accuracy (90.7 % macro-F1) on unseen subjects and performs an inference in 206 microseconds. Compared to conventional networks of the same topology on the same device, it requires an eighth of the logic and 3.4X less dynamic energy per decision than a network fed the same binary spikes, at comparable accuracy, and 7.6X less than a network fed the 16-bit spectrogram, at 1.2 points lower accuracy. Quantization-aware training reduces its weights to 3 bits within half a percentage point of the 6-bit network at the same encoder threshold

</details>


### [1606] [From Ethernet to Wi-Fi: Flow Feature Selection and Construction for Traffic Classification](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37007v1)
*Francisco Rau,Petia Georgieva,Carlos Herranz,Iñaki Val,Joaquin Perez*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套五阶段特征选择与构造流程，使仅在以太网数据上训练的流级分类器可用于Wi-Fi流量分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于以太网数据训练的流级流量分类器迁移到Wi-Fi流量时准确率下降，需要解决跨链路层技术的特征不一致问题。

Method: 五阶段流程：移除传输协议标识符、检验速率依赖性、比较特征分布及各特征对应用类别的信息量、降低冗余、构造归一化包大小与时间特征；在ns-3中仿真以太网与Wi-Fi（Best Effort接入类别）流量，用六个开发场景的标注Wi-Fi数据做特征设计，另留一个场景作最终测试。

Result: 评估比较不同特征集、检验阈值敏感性，并分析不同流量条件下的分类错误。

Conclusion: 通过针对性特征选择与构造，可缓解以太网到Wi-Fi的域偏移，提升跨技术流分类的适用性。

Abstract: Flow-based traffic classifiers trained on Ethernet data may lose accuracy when applied to Wi-Fi traffic. This paper proposes a five-stage procedure for selecting and constructing features that enable Wi-Fi flow classification using models trained only on Ethernet data. The procedure removes the transport protocol identifier, examines rate dependence, compares feature distributions and the information each feature provides for the application classes, reduces redundancy, and constructs normalized packet-size and temporal features. Ethernet and Wi-Fi traffic are simulated in ns-3, with Wi-Fi using Best Effort access category. Labelled Wi-Fi data from six development scenarios are used for feature design, while a separate scenario is reserved for final testing. The evaluation compares feature sets, examines threshold sensitivity, and analyses classification errors under different traffic conditions.

</details>


### [1607] [Sample-and-Score: Surrogate-Guided Coordinated Spatial Reuse in IEEE 802.11 Networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36868v1)
*Maksymilian Wojnar*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出"采样-打分"式Co-SR配置优化方法：随机采样配置并用离线训练的代理模型打分选优，无需在线微调或序贯探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IEEE 802.11bn中协调空间复用（Co-SR）通过并发传输提升区域吞吐，但配置组合空间巨大，实时优化困难；现有MAB与启发式基线需多轮交互或大量测量。

Method: 采样-打分框架：随机抽取Co-SR配置，用代理模型逐一打分并取最优；代理模型离线训练，部署时不做在线微调、不做序贯探索。

Result: 在2–16个AP的未见拓扑上，达到完美代理模型吞吐的52–77%；完美采样-打分在8192个候选中可达吞吐上界的95%；性能接近需多步交互的MAB与启发式基线。

Conclusion: 离线代理模型配合随机采样可作为一种低交互开销、可实时部署的Co-SR配置选择方案，性能接近需在线交互的基线。

Abstract: Coordinated spatial reuse (Co-SR) in IEEE 802.11bn increases area throughput through simultaneous transmissions, yet the combinatorial configuration space makes real-time optimization challenging. We propose a sample-and-score approach: draw random Co-SR configurations, score each with a surrogate model, and select the best. The surrogate is trained offline and deployed without online fine-tuning or sequential exploration, yet performs close to multi-armed bandit and heuristic baselines that need multiple interaction steps or extensive measurements. On unseen topologies with 2-16 access points, it recovers 52-77% of a perfect surrogate's throughput. A perfect sample-and-score approach reaches 95% of the upper bound throughput with 8192 candidates.

</details>


### [1608] [Learning Graph Beliefs for Active Radio Mapping With Decision-Certified Multi-Step Sensing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37717v1)
*Wangqian Chen,Hao Wang,Yumeng Zhang,Chenghong Bian,Junting Chen,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: GraphBARC：图结构主动无线地图构建框架，结合学习式空间建模与解析贝叶斯推断，采用非短视多步路径规划选取测量点，并以残差界与置信排除实现高效评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集测量代价高昂，需主动采样优先选取信息量大的测点；现有主动采样依赖预设空间模型方差或逐点不确定度，难以充分刻画不同测量间的空间相关性。

Method: 构建图网络仅用已获取测量学习节点与边相关因子，诱导全图联合信念，无需重训练即可解析更新观测；采用非短视感知策略，在可行多步路径上评估全图贝叶斯风险降低，考虑信息冗余；复用候选响应并以残差界约束路径价值差，保留共享响应误差结构；用误差感知延续界筛除劣质前缀，再仅精化未决比较所需响应；并给出可计算决策间隙界，证明精化过程中已认证排除保持有效。

Result: 相较对比基线平均RMSE降低逾16%；相较固定精度、无剪枝实现，核心规划时间减少56%。

Conclusion: 将学习式图空间建模与解析贝叶斯主动采样结合，并配合非短视规划与界驱动的响应精化，可在保证决策正确性的同时显著提升无线地图构建精度与规划效率。

Abstract: Radio maps provide essential wireless propagation knowledge for network optimization and autonomous platforms. Acquiring dense measurements, however, is prohibitively costly, requiring active sampling to prioritize informative measurements. Existing active sampling methods typically rely on variances from prescribed spatial models or learned pointwise uncertainty, which may not fully capture the spatial correlation of different measurements. This paper proposes GraphBARC, a graph-structured active radio map construction framework that integrates learned spatial modeling with analytical Bayesian inference. A graph network learns correlated node and edge factors using only acquired measurements, inducing a joint full-map belief that supports analytical observation updates without retraining. Rather than immediate one-step acquisition, it adopts a nonmyopic sensing strategy that evaluates joint map-wide Bayes risk reduction over feasible multi-step routes, accounting for information redundancy among planned measurements. We reuse candidate responses and derive residual-based bounds directly on route-value differences, retaining shared response-error structure to avoid uniformly high-accuracy evaluation. An error-aware continuation bound screens unpromising prefixes, after which only responses needed for unresolved comparisons are refined. We further establish a computable decision-gap bound and show that certified exclusions remain valid during refinement. Experiments show that GraphBARC reduces mean root-mean-square error (RMSE) by over 16% relative to the evaluated baselines and core planning time by 56% compared with the fixed-accuracy, unpruned implementation.

</details>


### [1609] [Trim: Fee Level Matters More Than Skew in Lightning Routing](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35296v1)
*Huiping Sun,Peilu Guo,Yiming Zhu,Yueqi Wu,Zhong Chen*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Trim：将闪电网络路由通道建模为带昂贵补货的双边库存，证明最优费率可分解为"水位（level）+ 余额偏斜（skew）"，并实证表明水位是一阶效应、偏斜仅是二阶保险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闪电网络路由节点以挂牌费率出租通道余额，但运营工具只把费率随余额围绕一个人工设定水平移动，究竟费率中的哪一部分真正驱动收益并不清楚，缺少理论刻画与实证校准。

Method: 将通道视为带昂贵补货的双边库存问题，求解最优动态定价，得到费率=水平项（由需求与补货成本决定）+偏斜项（流动性的影子价格）；在精确求解的通道上与平坦费率及因子二偏差对比，并在 2026 年快照（合成支付）上与各类调参工具比对各通道收益–成功率前沿。

Result: 水平项主导：无任何费率规则能超过"需求上限与补货成本"所定的水平；精确求解通道上最优平坦费率在中位数处距最优仅 1.6%，而水平偏差两倍会损失数十个百分点。偏斜项最多只弥补持平费率因拒绝转发而损失的收益。在快照数据上，无调参工具能超出该前沿几个百分点，偏斜对毛收益的影响为几个百分点。

Conclusion: 应优先选择费率水平：Trim 规则刻画收益–成功率前沿，对所有通道发布同一水平，仅在补货频繁且昂贵处附加偏斜。

Abstract: Lightning routing nodes lend their channel balance for a posted fee. Operators' tools move that fee with the balance around a hand-set level, and which part of the fee drives revenue is unclear. We present Trim, which models a channel as a two-sided inventory with costly refills. Its optimal fee is a level, set by demand and replenishment, plus a balance skew, the shadow price of liquidity. The level is first order: no fee rule beats the ceiling demand and replenishment set, and on exactly solved channels the best flat fee comes within $1.6\%$ of the optimum at the median, whereas a level off by a factor of two loses tens of percent. The skew is second-order insurance: it adds at most what the flow-balancing flat fee loses to refused forwards. So the level should be chosen: Trim's rule traces the revenue--success frontier, posts one level on every channel, and adds a skew only where refills stay frequent and costly. On a 2026 snapshot with synthetic payments, no tuned tool beats that frontier by over a few percent, and a skew changes gross revenue by a few percent.

</details>

### [1610] [Pair-Dependent Judge Errors Change the Minimax Rate of Semantic Entropy](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39196v1)
*Jiamiao Liu,Dewen Qiao,Yu Zhang,Xuetao Chen*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 论文研究含噪成对判定下的语义熵估计的极小极大理论：模型化已知"有偏裁判"（等价判定概率为 q+ΔM_ab），刻画一致性阈值、收敛速率与相变，指出四顶点树统计量非单射时即使 N→∞ 也不存在一致估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义熵需由裁判对答案对"等价/不等价"的判定来估计，而自动裁判的误差依赖于被比较的答案对。既有极小极大理论只覆盖"假等价概率对所有答案对相同"的理想裁判，无法反映真实裁判的结构性偏差，因此需要建立能刻画偏差依赖答案内容的判定误差的极小极大估计理论。

Method: 将已知裁判建模为：含义为 a、b 的两答案被判等价的概率为 q+ΔM_ab，其中 M 为对称矩阵，q 与 0、1 有界间隔。用树上统计量（tree statistics）刻画似然结构：三个含义时速率由四答案上的树统计决定；在开集信道下，一致性阈值由五顶点树决定。以等分点（equitable point）处的三次退化推导速率 N^{-1/3}（N=n⁴Δ⁶），在多项式弱窗口上分析，并用计算机辅助证书验证两类信道的开集存在性。

Result: 对显式开类中的每个信道，在满足 n⁵Δ⁸ 超过 log n 倍数的多项式弱窗口上，极小极大平方风险为 N^{-1/3} 阶；若至多四顶点的树函数为单射，则在每个多项式弱窗口上风险为 min{1,N^{-1/3}}，指数来自等分点的三次退化。在开类中某个开集信道里，四顶点树函数在两不同熵的分布上取等值，此时每个多项式弱窗口的极小极大风险为 min{1,N^{-1/3}} 与一个在 n⁵Δ⁸ 中指数衰减项之和，故 n⁵Δ⁸ 有界时无一致估计量，即使 N→∞。取 Δ=n^{-β}、β>1/2 时，四顶点树函数单射的信道恰在 β<2/3 可一致估计，该开集信道的阈值恰为 β<5/8，风险指数在此由 1/12 降为 0。

Conclusion: 语义熵在答案依赖型噪声裁判下的可估计性由四顶点树函数是否单射决定：非单射导致信息瓶颈，使一致性需要 n⁵Δ⁸→∞ 这一更强条件，且仅在 β<5/8 时才可能一致。该结果刻画了语义熵估计的相变与风险指数，说明现有假设"所有答案对误差相同的裁判"所给出的理论过于乐观，并为裁判设计与样本预算提供可判据。

Abstract: Semantic entropy, the entropy of the meanings among a language model's sampled answers, is estimated from the verdicts of a judge that declares pairs of answers equivalent or not, and automatic judges err in ways that depend on the answers they compare. The existing minimax theory covers only judges whose false-equivalence probability is the same for all pairs. We model a known judge that declares two answers with meanings $a$ and $b$ equivalent with probability $q+ΔM_{ab}$, for a symmetric matrix $M$ and $q$ bounded away from $0$ and $1$, and show that for three meanings the rate is set by tree statistics on four answers, while on an open set of channels the consistency threshold is set by trees on five. For every channel in an explicit open class, the minimax squared risk is of order $N^{-1/3}$ with $N=n^4Δ^6$ on polynomial weak windows on which $n^5Δ^8$ exceeds a multiple of $\log n$, and of order $\min\{1,N^{-1/3}\}$ on every polynomial weak window when the tree functions on at most four vertices are injective. The exponent comes from a cubic degeneracy at the equitable point. On an open set of channels in the class, the four-vertex tree functions take equal values at two distributions with different entropies. For such a channel, on every polynomial weak window, the minimax risk is of the order of the sum of $\min\{1,N^{-1/3}\}$ and a term that decays exponentially in $n^5Δ^8$, so no estimator is consistent while $n^5Δ^8$ stays bounded, even as $N\to\infty$. For $Δ=n^{-β}$ with $β>1/2$, channels of the class with injective four-vertex tree functions allow consistent estimation exactly for $β<2/3$, and the channels of this open set exactly for $β<5/8$, at which the risk exponent drops from $1/12$ to $0$. Computer-assisted certificates show that both kinds of channels occur on open sets.

</details>


### [1611] [Beyond Reachability: When Edit Order Preserves Couplings in Graph Flow Matching](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38486v1)
*Zilin Li,Zixing Song*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 该文研究在固定配对、必要编辑与采样预算不变的前提下，通过重排「合法最短编辑」顺序能否保持源–目标对应关系，并给出端点耦合可恢复性的精确判据：当且仅当通往不同目标的路径不共享图状态时，源盲马尔可夫投影可达不可避免的时钟误差下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最短路径最优性并不能保证无记忆图生成器保留给定的源–目标对应关系；作者希望在操作成本（配对、必要编辑、采样预算）固定时，判定合法编辑次序能否保持该预设耦合，从而区分「边际误差相同」但「配对保真度不同」的编辑方案。

Method: 在统一泊松时钟下分析源盲马尔可夫投影，建立端点耦合可恢复性的充要判据（不同目标路径不得共享图状态，同一目标的路径可合并）；据此给出精确的有限状态路由形式化与保合法性的调度流程（附恢复证书）；并用无标记构造与容量受限族展示共享边结构对源区分度的影响，最后给出目标条件下的混叠上界，把结构路由设计与纯图生成器的终端保真度联系起来。

Result: 给出充要判据：源盲投影达到不可避时钟误差下界 ⇔ 通往不同目标的路由不共享图状态；无标记构造表明共享边结构仍可保留源区分；容量受限族显示在边际误差相同的编辑次序间，配对误差存在显著分离（sharp separation）；并导出连接结构路由设计与学习型纯图生成器终端保真度的混叠界。

Conclusion: 合法编辑次序在固定操作成本下能否保持预设耦合，可由路由状态共享结构精确判定；不同目标间共享状态是端点保真的唯一障碍，而同一目标内合并无害。该刻画为编辑调度、恢复证书与生成器设计提供了可操作的结构性指导。

Abstract: Shortest-path optimality does not guarantee that a memoryless graph generator preserves a prescribed source-target correspondence. We study whether reordering legal shortest edits can retain this correspondence without changing the pairing, mandatory edits, or sampling budget. Under a common Poisson clock, we establish an exact criterion for endpoint coupling recoverability: the source-blind Markov projection attains the unavoidable clock-error floor if and only if routes to distinct targets do not share graph states. Routes to the same target may merge without sacrificing endpoint fidelity. This characterization leads to an exact finite-state routing formulation and a legality-preserving scheduling procedure with recovery certificates. A marker-free construction demonstrates how shared edge structure can retain source distinctions, while a capacity-constrained family exhibits a sharp separation in paired error between edit orders with identical marginal error. Finally, a target-conditioned aliasing bound connects structural route design to the terminal fidelity of a learned graph-only generator. These results characterize when legal edit ordering can preserve a prescribed coupling under fixed operational costs.

</details>


### [1612] [Federated Learning for Semantic Communications over Multiple Access Channels](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37951v1)
*Yalin E. Sagduyu,Tugba Erpek,Yi Shi*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 该文提出面向多址信道（MAC）的联邦学习语义通信（FL-SemCom）框架，多个分布式发射机在同一时隙内并行传输语义信息，并联合优化语义特征提取、压缩、无线传输与语义推理，通过联邦语义聚合（共享+个性化编码器）在降低训练开销的同时提升数据不均衡下的语义推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语义通信系统对用户独立训练，训练开销大、信道占用多；且分布式发射机本地数据量不均（数据不均衡）会削弱语义表示质量。作者希望利用MAC上的并行语义传输实现多发射机并发训练，并通过联邦聚合使小数据量用户获益，从而支持可扩展、通信高效的边缘智能。

Method: 构建MAC上的端到端学习式SemCom系统，将语义特征提取、压缩、无线传输与语义推理联合优化；以FL方式协同训练多发射机，利用同时同频的并行语义传输实现同一传输区间内多发射机并发训练；引入联邦语义聚合机制，编码器分为共享组件与个性化组件，实现跨用户知识共享与本地自适应；在衰落信道上用CIFAR-10进行评估。

Result: 在共享无线接入条件下保持较高的语义推理精度；在严重数据不均衡场景下性能显著提升；并行语义传输在保持分布式发射机（异质本地数据集）鲁棒语义性能的同时显著降低训练开销与信道占用。

Conclusion: FL与SemCom的结合能够在共享多址接入下实现可扩展、通信高效的协同语义传输与训练，为未来无线网络中的边缘智能提供可行路径。

Abstract: This paper presents a federated learning (FL) framework for semantic communication (SemCom) over the multiple access channel (MAC), where multiple distributed transmitters simultaneously convey semantic information to a common receiver using end-to-end learned semantic representations. Semantic feature extraction, compression, wireless transmission, and semantic inference are jointly optimized through FL-based SemCom. Unlike conventional SemCom systems that train users independently, simultaneous semantic transmissions over the MAC enable concurrent training of multiple transmitters within the same transmission interval, thereby reducing training overhead and channel usage. Federated semantic aggregation is incorporated with shared and personalized encoder components, allowing transmitters with limited local training data to benefit from semantic representations learned from transmitters possessing larger datasets while preserving local adaptation. Evaluated using the CIFAR-10 dataset over fading channels, the proposed approach maintains high semantic inference accuracy under shared wireless access and significantly improves performance under severe data imbalance. In the meantime, simultaneous semantic transmissions can significantly reduce training overhead while preserving robust semantic performance across distributed transmitters with heterogeneous local datasets. These results highlight the potential of combining FL and SemCom to support scalable and communication-efficient edge intelligence in future wireless networks.

</details>


### [1613] [Privacy-Preserving Over-the-Air Federated Learning over Cell-Free Massive MIMO System with User-Centric Clustering](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37424v1)
*Manobendu Sarker,Soumaya Cherkaoui*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 该论文研究无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络下、基于OTA聚合的差分隐私联邦学习的跨层设计，利用信道硬化使热噪声充当隐私掩蔽资源，并通过联合优化AP-UE关联、发射功率与人工噪声方差最小化聚合方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OTA聚合中无线接收热噪声通常被视为性能损害，但本文指出其可作为隐私掩蔽资源，从而减少甚至免除人工噪声；现有工作缺乏对隐私约束下关联、功率与人工噪声的联合跨层优化分析。

Method: 构建基于遍历隐私记账框架的每用户零集中差分隐私（zCDP）约束，联合优化AP-UE关联、UE发射功率与人工噪声方差以最小化聚合方差；将混合整数非凸问题通过交替优化求解，其中功率分配采用DC（凸差）方法，聚类采用贪心坐标下降。

Result: 分析揭示制度依赖结构：严格隐私要求倾向低发射功率与稀疏AP关联以利用热噪声，宽松要求倾向更大簇以提升聚合质量。数值结果显示聚合方差较基线降低最多89%，MNIST达97%测试精度，CIFAR-10上有一致增益；严格隐私预算下对比方案接近随机水平，宽松预算下仍显著落后。

Conclusion: 热噪声可作为有效的隐私掩蔽资源，跨层联合设计（关联、功率、人工噪声）在隐私与效用间取得显著更优折衷，验证了所提交替优化方法的有效性。

Abstract: This paper investigates cross-layer design for differentially private federated learning over cell-free massive MIMO networks with over-the-air (OTA) aggregation. Distributed access points (APs) collaboratively serve user equipments (UEs) through user-centric clustering, where clipped local model updates are perturbed with Gaussian noise and simultaneously transmitted over a shared uplink for OTA averaging at a central processing unit. Exploiting channel hardening, we show that thermal noise inherent in wireless reception can act as a privacy-masking resource, reducing or even eliminating the need for artificial noise. Based on this observation, we formulate a joint optimization problem over AP-UE associations, UE transmit powers, and artificial noise variances to minimize aggregation variance subject to per-UE zero-concentrated differential privacy constraints derived from an ergodic privacy accounting framework. Analysis reveals a regime-dependent structure: stringent privacy requirements favor low transmit powers and sparse AP associations to exploit thermal noise for privacy, whereas relaxed requirements favor larger clusters to improve aggregation quality. The resulting mixed-integer nonconvex problem is solved via alternating optimization combining difference-of-convex power allocation and greedy coordinate-descent clustering. Numerical results show up to 89% lower aggregation variance than conventional baselines and enable 97% test accuracy on MNIST with consistent gains on CIFAR-10. Under strict privacy budgets, competing schemes remain near random-chance performance, while under relaxed budgets they continue to lag significantly behind the proposed design.

</details>


### [1614] [Variable-Length Feedback Coding With Universal Decoding and Bandit Channel Selection](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36818v1)
*Recep Can Yavas*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文研究噪声方差未知（仅知区间）的K个AWGN信道上的变长反馈编码，提出VLSF-Bandit与VLF-Bandit两种联合编码与信道选择方案，给出二阶可达界且均为一阶最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接收端每时刻只能选择一个信道并通过无噪反馈汇报选择，且双方均不知各信道噪声方差，需在解码过程中在线学习信道质量以避免过度使用次优信道。该"VLF-Bandit"问题融合了变长反馈编码、通用解码与bandit信道选择，此前方法难以兼顾。

Method: 方案一VLSF-Bandit为单阶段VLSF方案：高斯随机码本、基于似然混合比的score、并将渐近最优的kl-UCB++ bandit算法作用于接收功率。方案二VLF-Bandit将消息以Schalkwijk–Kailath传输分包发送，用其归一化输出作为噪声样本学习方差，并让探索包携带消息比特。

Result: 为两方案证明二阶可达界，且均为一阶最优。在码本大小对数中，log N系数幅度上：VLSF-Bandit为基线1加信道探索项；VLF-Bandit幅度更小，以通用解码项替代基线并且信道探索项更小。K=1时VLF-Bandit界优于Yavas与Tan(2025)的通用VLF界；K≥2时优于explore-then-commit策略的界。

Conclusion: 将通用解码与变长反馈编码结合，并把探索包用于消息传输，可在未知噪声方差的多信道AWGN场景下获得更优的二阶性能，验证了单阶段VLSF加bandit选择与两阶段VLF-Bandit设计的有效性。

Abstract: We study variable-length feedback (VLF) coding over $K$ additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channels whose noise variances are unknown to both terminals but lie in a known interval. The receiver selects one channel at each time, conveys the selection over noiseless feedback, and must learn the channel qualities while decoding, to avoid overusing suboptimal channels. This setting, which we call the VLF-Bandit problem, combines VLF coding, universal decoding, and bandit channel selection. We develop two joint coding and channel-selection schemes. The VLSF-Bandit scheme is a single-phase variable-length stop-feedback (VLSF) scheme based on a Gaussian random codebook, a score formed from a ratio of likelihood mixtures, and the asymptotically optimal $\text{kl-UCB}^{++}$ bandit algorithm applied to the received power. The VLF-Bandit scheme sends the message in packets by Schalkwijk--Kailath transmission, uses its normalized outputs as noise samples to learn the variances, and lets its exploration packets carry message bits. We prove second-order achievability bounds for both schemes, which are first-order optimal. In the logarithm of the achievable codebook size, the magnitude of the $\log N$ coefficient, with $N$ the average decoding time, is a baseline of one plus a channel-exploration term for VLSF-Bandit. For VLF-Bandit, this magnitude is smaller, with a universal-decoding term replacing the baseline and a smaller channel-exploration term. The VLF-Bandit bound improves on the universal VLF bound of Yavas and Tan (2025) for $K=1$ and on the bound of an explore-then-commit strategy whenever $K\geq2$.

</details>


### [1615] [Information-Theoretic Secure Aggregation With Heterogeneous Client Quantization](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35833v1)
*Shreya Meel,Sennur Ulukus,Itzhak Tamo*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文提出一种信息论安全的联邦学习聚合方案，在客户端采用异构量化位数、并容忍客户端掉线与至多T个半诚实客户端与服务器串谋的情况下，仍能保护个体模型更新的隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数安全聚合方案要求客户端将更新参数投影到共同的有限群/域上，难以直接适配带宽异构导致的客户端不同量化精度；现有异构量化安全聚合方法会泄露部分聚合值，在特定掉线与串谋模式下甚至泄露个体更新的片段，存在隐私风险。

Method: 利用(T+1, N)门限黑盒秘密共享构造；尽管各客户端更新因量化不同而属于不同代数群，其秘密份额仍由相同的线性整数系统生成，从而统一处理异构量化与掩码传输。

Result: 所提协议在客户端异质量化下可容忍客户端掉线，并抵御至多T个半诚实客户端的相互串谋及与服务器的串谋，达到信息论意义上的安全聚合，不泄露部分聚合或个体更新片段。

Conclusion: 通过基于统一线性整数系统的门限黑盒秘密共享，可在异构量化约束下实现无隐私泄露的安全聚合，弥补了现有方法在掉线与串谋场景下的隐私缺口。

Abstract: In federated learning (FL), secure aggregation enables a server to compute the sum of local model updates of $N$ clients, without revealing any information on the individual model updates to the server, beyond their sum. Different clients may be subject to heterogeneous bandwidth constraints, and consequently may choose different numbers of quantization levels to represent the information they send. Most secure aggregation works require the clients to project the values of their update parameters to a common finite group (or field), which does not directly accommodate heterogeneous precision constraints on their transmitted masked updates. Existing approaches of secure aggregation with heterogeneous quantization levels reveal partial aggregates of model-updates, and can reveal segments of individual model updates, under certain dropout and client-server collusion patterns. To prevent this privacy breach, we propose an information-theoretic secure aggregation scheme that tolerates client drop-outs, and up to $T$ semi-honest clients that collude with each other and with the server, under heterogeneous quantization at clients. Our protocol utilizes the $(T+1, N)$ threshold black-box secret sharing construction, where secret shares of the client updates, despite belonging to distinct algebraic groups owing to different quantization, are generated from identical linear integer systems.

</details>


### [1616] [World Model for Energy Efficiency Maximization in Dynamic Metasurface Antennas](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35813v1)
*Abdolrasoul Sakhaei Gharagezlou,Mehdi Monemi,Matti Latva-aho,Mehdi Rasti*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 提出基于世界模型（world model）的强化学习框架，联合优化动态超表面天线（DMA）系统中的数字波束成形与DMA阵元权重，在时变信道下最大化长期平均能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMA可支撑大规模、密集且高能效的天线架构，但数字波束成形与DMA阵元权重对接收信号与干扰功率存在耦合影响，在时变信道下联合优化困难；同时需满足发射功率、Lorentzian相位限制与最小速率等约束，且无模型强化学习样本效率低、难以做长期规划。

Method: 将问题建模为时变信道下最大化时间平均能效（EE）的优化问题，约束包括发射功率、Lorentzian相位限制与最小速率要求。构建世界模型框架，从与环境交互中学习潜在系统动力学，并通过想象轨迹联合优化数字波束成形与DMA阵元权重；同时引入保可行性动作映射与安全代价信号，以保证策略学习过程中的约束满足。

Result: 仿真表明，相比深度Q网络（DQN）基线，所提框架将时间平均能效提升约20%，同时具有更高的样本效率和更可靠的约束满足能力。

Conclusion: 基于世界模型的强化学习方法能够有效联合优化DMA系统中的数字波束成形与阵元权重，在时变信道下兼顾能效、样本效率与约束可行性，优于无模型DQN方案。

Abstract: Dynamic metasurface antennas (DMAs) have emerged as a promising technology for realizing large-scale antenna arrays in next-generation wireless networks owing to their ability to enable dense and energy-efficient antenna architectures. However, jointly optimizing digital beamforming and DMA element weights under time-varying channel conditions remains challenging due to their coupled effects on the received signal and interference powers. We formulate this problem to maximize time-averaged energy efficiency (EE) under time-varying channel conditions, subject to transmit power constraints, Lorentzian phase limitations, and minimum rate requirements. To enable long-term planning and improve sample efficiency compared with model-free reinforcement learning, we develop a world model framework that learns latent system dynamics from interactions with the environment and jointly optimizes digital beamforming and DMA element weights through imagined trajectories. Furthermore, we incorporate feasibility-preserving action mappings and safety cost signals to ensure constraint satisfaction during policy learning. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves the time-averaged EE by approximately 20% compared with the deep Q-network baseline, while achieving higher sample efficiency and more reliable constraint satisfaction.

</details>


### [1617] [Multi-view Semantic-aware Resource Allocation for Edge AI](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34532v1)
*Jiawei Luo,Hussein Saleh,Mohamad Assaad*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 提出面向多用户边缘AI的语义感知资源分配端到端框架：将OIB扩展为多视角高斯信息瓶颈(MGIB)，实现无需变分近似与网络重训练的视角融合；联合优化压缩级别、传输模式与PRB分配，建模为MILP并用拉格朗日松弛求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G网络中无线资源稀缺，语义通信被视为关键解决范式；多用户边缘AI场景下需要同时考虑语义压缩、多源视角融合与无线资源分配的联合优化。

Method: 将OIB扩展为多视角设定下的MGIB，融合互补源视角且无需变分近似或网络重训练；构建联合压缩级别选择、传输模式选择（每组激活源数量）与PRB分配的优化框架，建立为MILP，采用拉格朗日松弛(LR)算法高效求解，并与NP-hard最优解对比。

Result: 仿真表明LR方案达到近最优效用，且PRB效率相比平均分配提升一倍。

Conclusion: MGIB与LR相结合可为多用户边缘AI提供高效、近最优的语义感知资源分配方案，显著提升无线资源利用率。

Abstract: Semantic communication is emerging as a pivotal paradigm to overcome wireless resource scarcity in 6G networks. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end framework for semantics-aware resource allocation in multi-user Edge AI. We extend the Opportunistic Information Bottleneck (OIB) to a multi-view setting, termed the Multi-view Gaussian Information Bottleneck (MGIB), by fusing complementary source views without variational approximation or network retraining. A resource allocation framework is then formulated for joint compression-level selection, transmission mode selection (i.e., the number of active sources per group), and PRB assignment. The problem is formulated as a Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP), solved efficiently via a proposed Lagrangian Relaxation (LR) algorithm, and benchmarked against the NP-hard optimal solution. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed LR scheme achieves near-optimal utility, and doubles PRB efficiency versus average allocation.

</details>


### [1618] [Unifying Performance and Equity via Percentile Optimization and Cell-Free Massive MIMO](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33982v1)
*Ahmad Khan,Hussein A. Ammar,Raviraj Adve*

Main category: cs.IT

TL;DR: 本文将百分位优化（SLqP速率最大化）引入用户中心无蜂窝大规模MIMO网络，通过变量替换恢复块凹性，提出具闭式辅助更新与凹功率更新的下行功率控制算法，并证明其非降收敛至方向稳定点；仿真显示相较WMMSE将最低10%用户平均速率提升56–72%、Jain公平指数从<0.92升至>0.99，且在相同公平性下优于大规模MIMO与小基站。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升最弱用户吞吐是无线资源分配的核心目标，也是用户中心无蜂窝大规模MIMO（UC-mMIMO）架构的构建初衷。作者希望把"百分位优化"框架与UC-mMIMO结合：已有百分位优化序列方法依赖块凹性，但UC-mMIMO的相干联合传输在功率中引入交叉项，破坏块凹性，使原循环最大化方法无法沿用。故需解决这一非凸、非光滑、NP难问题的新求解方法。

Method: 以SLqP（sum-least-qth-percentile）速率为目标，对UC-mMIMO下行功率控制建模，该效用涵盖max-min-rate与sum-rate最大化作为特例。针对问题非凸、非光滑、NP难的特点，设计变量替换以消除相干联合传输带来的功率交叉项、恢复块凹性；据此得到含闭式辅助变量更新与凹功率更新的算法，并给出非降收敛到方向稳定点的自包含证明。

Result: 仿真得到两点结论：(1) 在无小区边缘的架构中百分位优化仍有价值——相较WMMSE基准，最低10百分位UE的平均速率提升56–72%，Jain公平指数由低于0.92升至高于0.99；(2) 在相同SLqP效用下与大规模MIMO、小基站直接比较，UC-mMIMO在所有测试的接入点密度下均给出最高的低百分位速率（分别最高提升62%与2.7倍），且保持相同公平性，优势随致密化而扩大。

Conclusion: 百分位优化与UC-mMIMO可有效结合；所提变量替换+块凹化算法可高效求解该NP难问题并具收敛保证。百分位优化即使在无边缘架构中依然重要，UC-mMIMO在提升低百分位用户性能方面优于大规模MIMO与小基站，且致密化收益更显著。

Abstract: Improving the throughput of the weakest users is a central objective of wireless resource allocation, and the objective around which the user-centric cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (UC-mMIMO) architecture is built. This paper brings the two together by formulating and solving percentile programs for UC-mMIMO networks. We maximize the sum-least-qth-percentile (SLqP) rate via downlink power control, a utility that targets the user equipments (UEs) in the lowest q percentile of the rate distribution and subsumes max-min-rate and sum-rate maximization as special cases. The problem is non-convex, non-smooth and NP-hard. The cyclic maximization approach of one of the previous percentile optimization series does not carry over: the coherent joint transmission technique introduces cross terms in the powers that destroy the block-concavity on which it relies. We develop a change of variables that restores block-concavity, yielding an algorithm with closed-form auxiliary updates and a concave power update, and we give a self-contained proof of non-decreasing convergence to a directional stationary point. Simulations establish two facts: first, percentile optimization retains its value in an architecture with no cell edges; relative to the weighted minimum mean-square error benchmark, it raises the average rate of the lowest-10th-percentile UEs by 56--72% and Jain's fairness index from below 0.92 to above 0.99. Second, compared directly with massive MIMO and small cells under the same SLqP utility, UC-mMIMO delivers the highest lower-percentile rates at every access point density tested, by up to 62% and 2.7$\times$ respectively, at the same fairness, and its advantage widens with densification.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [1619] [Deep Learning Based Behavioral Drift Modeling for Continuous Biometric Authentication](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40398v1)
*Suprava Saha Dibya,Minar,Abdulla Al Noman,Md. Zafir Abid Shresto,Ahmed Sayef*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出两级击键动力学认证系统：第一级用TCN+对比学习+PBT进行固定文本登录认证（EER 3.77%），第二级用4模型深度学习集成在自由文本会话中持续监测行为漂移，发现异常则回到第一级重认证，形成闭环防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一固定文本登录认证存在会话劫持与长期行为漂移风险，需要纵深防御的持续认证机制。

Method: 两级架构：Level 1 采用TCN结合对比学习与基于种群的训练（PBT）做固定文本认证，显式建模长期行为漂移；Level 2 用4模型深度学习集成对自由文本输入持续监测，检测到可疑漂移时触发回退重认证。特征包括保持时间、上下延迟、下下间隔与三元组模式；数据集为GREYC（固定文本）与Buffalo（自由文本）。

Result: 固定文本认证准确率96%+，EER 3.77%；自由文本持续认证在5% FAR下TAR达83.53%（EER 10.05%），对冒充攻击表现出较强抵抗能力。

Conclusion: 两级+反馈闭环设计兼顾高安全登录与持续行为监测，在两类数据集上均取得优于基线的性能。

Abstract: This research proposes a two-level keystroke dynamics authentication system that provides defense-in-depth security through continuous behavioral drift monitoring. Level 1 employs fixed-text password authentication using Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) with contrastive learning and population-based training (PBT), achieving 3.77% EER for high-security login verification. Upon successful authentication, Level 2 continuously monitors user typing during natural free-text sessions using a 4-Model Deep Learning Ensemble. If suspicious behavioral drift is detected during monitoring, the system re-authenticates the user by returning to Level 1, providing a feedback loop against session hijacking and behavioral anomalies. The system explicitly models long-term behavioral drift through the fixed-text component's PBT mechanism, which adapts to temporal variations in password typing patterns. This research leverages free-text (Buffalo dataset) and fixed-text (GREYC dataset) keystroke dynamics datasets, extracting temporal and spatial features including hold times, up-down latencies, down-down intervals, and trigram patterns. The final system achieves 96%+ accuracy for fixed-text authentication (3.77% EER) and 83.53% True Acceptance Rate (TAR) at 5% False Acceptance Rate (FAR) for free-text continuous authentication (10.05% EER), demonstrating superior performance and strong resistance to impostor attacks through continuous behavioral monitoring.

</details>


### [1620] [DYNAS: A Dynamic Network Penetration Testing Framework Using Deep Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40214v1)
*Md. Rakibul Hassan,Majedul Islam,Md. Ashraful Alam,Muhammad Iqbal Hossain,Swakkhar Shatabda*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出DYNAS仿真环境（含IDS响应、扫描误报/漏报噪声、服务临时不可用、时长型动作超时）与Pen-DHRL递归 manager-worker 策略，在4种场景变体上优于GNN、Invariant、Attention基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络规模与不确定性使自动化渗透测试复杂化，现有RL环境缺乏在防御性与非平稳条件下进行受控评估的能力。

Method: DYNAS：参数化大规模场景生成 + 有状态入侵检测响应 + 显式扫描假阳性/假阴性噪声 + 服务临时不可用 + 基于时长的动作超时；Pen-DHRL：以IDS条件化全局上下文选择持久子目标的递归manager-worker策略。与GNN、Invariant、Attention基线在4种场景变体和多种训练机制下对比。

Result: IDS关闭训练、IDS开启评估时，Pen-DHRL在Bridge与Dynamic上每步奖励分别约高64%和24%，在VarA与VarB上捕获主机数分别约多26%和30%；防御动态全程开启训练时，Pen-DHRL在4场景均获得正的平均回合回报，而flat基线在全部12个架构-场景组合均为负；分阶段课程训练在全部16个组合上获得正平均回报。

Conclusion: DYNAS提供了可控的非平稳防御性评估平台；递归子目标分解与IDS条件化上下文对防御感知渗透测试策略至关重要，课程式训练可显著提升训练稳定性。

Abstract: As network scale and uncertainty complicate automated penetration testing, reinforcement learning (RL) environments must support controlled evaluation under defensive and non-stationary conditions. We present DYNAS (Dynamic Network Attack Simulator), which combines parameterized large-scale scenario generation with stateful intrusion detection responses, explicit scan false-positive and false-negative noise, temporary service unavailability, and duration-based action timeouts. We further introduce Pen-DHRL, a recurrent manager--worker policy that selects persistent subgoals using IDS-conditioned global context. We compare Pen-DHRL with GNN, Invariant, and Attention baselines across four scenario variants and multiple training regimes. Under IDS-disabled training followed by IDS-enabled evaluation, Pen-DHRL obtains approximately 64\% and 24\% higher reward per step on Bridge and Dynamic, respectively, and approximately 26\% and 30\% more captured hosts on VarA and VarB than the next-best baseline. With all defensive dynamics active from the beginning of training, Pen-DHRL achieves positive mean episode returns in all four scenarios, whereas the flat baselines produce negative mean returns in all 12 architecture--scenario combinations; staged curriculum training produces positive mean returns across all 16 evaluated combinations.

</details>


### [1621] [Cybersecurity Practices in Industrial Automation and Control Systems: a Study of Croatian System Integrators](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39573v1)
*Filip Katulić,Damir Sumina,Stjepan Groš,Tena Velki*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 基于克罗地亚三个焦点小组，本文考察工业自动化与控制系统（IACS）系统集成商对NIS2网络安全要求的认知、实施挑战与现行做法，揭示业主安全意识不足、企业规模与内外资差异以及监管压力预期分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业网络安全事件频发，欧盟NIS2指令旨在强化关键与重要行业的网络安全要求与韧性，但在IACS环境中将合规要求转化为工程实践仍十分困难，且缺乏对系统集成商这一关键中介角色的实证了解。

Method: 采用定性研究，围绕能源、化工与制药、食品饮料三个行业客户的系统集成商开展三个焦点小组访谈，收集其对网络安全要求、实施障碍与当前实践的感知。

Result: 参与者反映IACS业主网络安全意识有限；小企业与大企业、本土企业与外资企业在实践上存在差异；对监管压力的预期分化——部分认为可提升安全水平，部分预期仅出现以降低成本为导向的最低限度合规。

Conclusion: 研究为制定更具可操作性的网络安全实践提供基础，并加深了对IACS系统集成商与业主在应对网络安全时面临的关键挑战的理解。

Abstract: Given the increasing frequency of industrial cybersecurity incidents, governments, industry, and the research community are all working to find ways to protect industrial automation and control systems (IACSs). A key regulatory effort in the European context is the EU's Network and Information Security Directive 2 (NIS2), which aims to strengthen cybersecurity requirements and improve resilience across critical and important sectors. Nevertheless, translating cybersecurity requirements into practical engineering remains challenging within IACS environments. This paper explores how Croatian IACS system integrators perceive cybersecurity requirements, implementation challenges, and current practices in the industrial environments in which they operate. The findings are based on three focus groups with system integrators working with clients in the energy, chemical and pharmaceutical, and food and beverage sectors. Participants reported limited cybersecurity awareness among IACS owners, as well as perceived differences in practices between smaller and larger companies and between domestic and foreign firms. Participants were divided in their expectations regarding regulatory pressure: while some believed it could improve cybersecurity, others expected only minimal compliance focused on cost reduction. The results of this study provide a basis for developing more practical cybersecurity practices and offer a deeper understanding of the key challenges faced by IACS system integrators and owners when dealing with cybersecurity.

</details>


### [1622] [RV2GC: Reconstructing the Garbling Boundary in a RISC-V Garbled Processor](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39572v1)
*Zixiao Feng,Xiaolin Li,Chenglu Jin,Wei Yan,Yong Zhang,Hongwei Liu,Yong Liu,Qinfen Hao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: RV2GC 将混淆电路的边界重构为围绕固定 RISC-V 指令电路库的指令级按需执行框架，通过公开调度、持久化标签编码状态与条件执行栈，在隐藏私有输入的前提下显著降低安全执行开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整混淆处理器虽能为多程序复用固定电路，但评估器在执行局部计算时仍需重复遍历处理器全局结构，造成大量冗余工作；因此需要权衡跨程序复用的收益与重复执行的成本，把混淆边界从"整机"下沉到"指令级"。

Method: 提出 RV2GC：围绕固定 RISC-V 指令电路库重构混淆边界；公开的调度与操作数路由置于电路拓扑之外；用持久化的标签编码状态连接独立调用的混淆指令电路与指令专属的免混淆路径，并通过统一接口交互；引入条件执行栈（Conditional-execution Stack）与受保护提交机制，在公开调度下支持秘密相关分支、有界循环与秘密索引访存，使指令序列与内存地址序列独立于私有输入。

Result: 在九个基准上，ARM2GC 与 RV2GC 的运行时间比值为 12.81 至 4,043；电路规模上，所列最大指令电路为 3,386 个门，分别相当于 256 字节与 4,096 字节 Amber 处理器的 2.044% 与 0.393%；另量化了调度存储、通信开销及秘密相关执行代价。

Conclusion: 将混淆粒度细化到指令级并按需调用，可在保持地址与指令序列不泄露私有输入的同时，大幅优于完整混淆处理器的执行效率；指令级电路规模远小于整机电路，为可编程安全执行提供了更优的开销—复用折中。

Abstract: Programmable garbled-circuit execution must balance the benefits of cross-program reuse against the cost of repeated work during secure execution. A complete garbled processor provides a fixed circuit for many programs, but its evaluator repeatedly visits processor-wide structures even when only a small part performs the current protected computation. We present RV2GC, which reconstructs the garbling boundary around a fixed library of RISC-V instruction circuits. Public scheduling and operand routing operate outside the circuit topologies; persistent label-encoded state connects independently invoked garbled instruction circuits and instruction-specific garbling-free paths through a common interface. A Conditional-execution Stack and protected commits support secret-dependent branches, bounded loops, and secret-indexed memory access under public scheduling, keeping instruction and memory-address sequences independent of private inputs. Across nine benchmarks, measured ARM2GC-to-RV2GC runtime ratios range from 12.81 to 4,043. In terms of circuit size, the largest listed instruction circuit has 3,386 gates, corresponding to 2.044% and 0.393% of the 256-byte and 4,096-byte Amber processors, respectively. Additional comparisons quantify schedule storage, communication, and the cost of secret-dependent execution.

</details>


### [1623] [REALM: Identifying Minimal Task Assets for LLM Agents](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39155v1)
*Zihou Ren,Byungchul Tak,Long Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: REALM 将任务所需资产建模为依赖图节点，并在执行中通过源作用域选择接纳新发现资产，实现发现与授权的分离，在 AgentDyn 上将攻击成功率从 16.6% 降至 0.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体通常获得超出任务所需的文件、账号与服务访问权限，提示注入可借此将执行重定向到无关资源。实施最小权限原则的难点在于需识别任务真正需要的资产，且部分资产身份仅在执行过程中才显现。

Method: REALM（Required Execution Assets Linked to a Mission）把所需资产表示为依赖图节点，解析前置依赖关系，并通过源作用域选择机制接纳新发现的资产；将"发现资产"与"授权使用"解耦，同时保留智能体的计算自由。组件上，REALM Builder 维护已选授权并投影出 Asset Files，Partial API Manager 在 Task Container 内向 Agent 暴露资源绑定的 Partial APIs。

Result: 在 AgentDyn 的 60 个干净任务与 560 个注入用例上，以 qwen3.5-flash 为基座模型，任务完成率为 40.0% 与 36.4%，ASR 从 16.6% 降至 0.2%。

Conclusion: 通过依赖图化资产识别与发现—授权分离的动态最小权限机制，REALM 能在保持智能体自主性的同时大幅抑制提示注入造成的越权资源访问。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often receive access to more files, accounts, and services than a task requires. Prompt injection turns this excess access into an opportunity to redirect execution toward unrelated resources. Applying least privilege therefore requires identifying the assets needed by a task, including assets whose identities emerge only during execution. We present REALM (Required Execution Assets Linked to a Mission), an approach to identifying and maintaining a task's required assets and their permitted uses. The approach represents required assets as Dependency Graph nodes, resolves prerequisite relationships, and admits newly discovered assets through source-scoped selection. It separates discovering an asset from authorizing its use, while preserving the agent's freedom to choose its computation. The REALM Builder maintains the selected grants and projects Asset Files; the Partial API Manager exposes resource-bound Partial APIs to the Agent inside a Task Container. Across 60 clean tasks and 560 injected cases in AgentDyn, it completes 40.0% and 36.4% of tasks and decreases ASR from 16.6% to 0.2% with qwen3.5-flash as the base model.

</details>


### [1624] [DICE: Decentralized Incentive-driven Federated Learning for Efficient & Scalable Customization of Pretrained Models in Web3](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39132v1)
*Hong Lin,Zhongle Xie,Lidan Shou,Ke Chen,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: DICE 是一种面向 Web3 场景的区块链联邦学习（BCFL）算法，通过"动态渐进式学习+模型切片验证"和"树状委员会共识+效率驱动激励机制"两组协同技术，解决大模型定制中的效率与可扩展性难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型（PM）下游定制依赖任务数据，Web3 应用提供了大量此类数据；区块链联邦学习（BCFL）能在自利且不可信的 Web3 参与者间实现隐私保护的安全定制。但现有 BCFL 算法在应用于大型 PM 时，因巨大的计算与内存需求及许多参与者硬件受限，面临严重的效率与可扩展性挑战。

Method: 提出 DICE 算法，包含两组协同技术：(i) 动态渐进式学习方案与模型切片验证方案，使更多诚实参与者（包括无法部署完整模型者）参与 PM 定制并保持模型效用；(ii) 树状委员会共识协议与效率驱动的激励机制，缓解阻碍现有 BCFL 算法扩展到更大规模数据持有者的主要瓶颈，同时维持安全性。并辅以理论分析与实验验证。

Result: 理论分析给出了算法性质保证；在视觉与语言预训练模型定制上的大量实验表明，DICE 在效率、有效性和安全性方面均表现良好。

Conclusion: DICE 通过渐进式学习、切片验证、树状委员会共识与效率驱动激励的协同设计，可在大规模、硬件异构的 Web3 参与者环境下高效、可扩展且安全地定制大型预训练模型。

Abstract: Customizing Pretrained Models (PMs) for downstream tasks demands task-specific data, which burgeoning Web3 applications provide abundantly. Blockchain-powered federated learning (BCFL) offers a secure and privacy-preserving paradigm to customize PMs among self-interested and untrusted Web3 participants. Yet, existing BCFL algorithms face severe efficiency and scalability challenges when applied to large PMs, due to their substantial computational and memory requirements and the hardware constraints of many participants.
