This paper introduces DICE, a novel BCFL algorithm that addresses the efficiency and scalability challenges of customizing large PMs in Web3 via two sets of synergistic techniques: (i) a dynamic progressive learning scheme and a model slice verification scheme to enable a wider range of honest participants, including those unable to deploy the full model, to engage in customizing PMs, while preserving model utility; (ii) a tree-structured committee consensus protocol and an efficiency-driven incentive scheme to address the dominant bottleneck that hinders existing BCFL algorithms from scaling to a larger number of data holders for customizing data-hungry large PMs, while maintaining security. Theoretical analysis and extensive experimental results on customizing vision and language PMs demonstrate DICE's efficiency, effectiveness, and security.

</details>


### [1625] [Trustworthy Distributed Machine Learning in Cloud-Edge-IoT Systems: A Heterogeneity-Aware Survey of Security, Privacy, and Robustness](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38793v1)
*Long Dang,Ali Alfatemi,Kaiqi Xiong,Mohammed Aledhari,Abdellah Chehri,Shawqi Al-Maliki,Mohamed Rahouti*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向可信分布式机器学习（DML）的安全导向、异构性感知综述，将联邦学习（FL）作为高风险典型案例，系统梳理其安全边界、异构性影响、攻防交互、分层防御及部署与评测指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DML/FL 虽能在云-边-物联网系统中实现不集中原始数据的协同建模，但数据、计算、更新与编排的分布式化扩大了攻击面，并在隐私、鲁棒性、可靠性、公平性与治理等维度引入相互耦合的挑战，现有研究缺乏统一的安全中心视角与异构性感知路线图。

Method: 采用综述性框架：首先刻画 DML/FL 的资产、对手模型、信任假设与协调模式，界定安全边界；其次分析统计异构（Non-IID）、系统异构（资源不对称、间歇参与）与信任异构（cross-silo/cross-device）对收敛、公平性、攻击可检测性与防御可靠性的影响；随后综合归纳投毒、后门、拜占庭操纵、隐私泄露、模型抽取、网络/编排攻击、Sybil 行为与策略性参与等攻防交互；并对比稳健聚合、漂移感知优化、差分隐私、安全聚合、同态加密、安全多方计算、可信执行环境、水印、溯源、认证通信与监控等分层防御。

Result: 形成以安全为中心、异构性感知的 DML 可信性路线图，建立攻防分类体系与防御层级映射，并提出强调可复现 Non-IID 划分、攻击感知基准、隐私预算、攻击成功率、客户端级差异、时延、通信、内存、能耗/碳开销与可审计全生命周期制品的评测规范。

Conclusion: 可信 DML/FL 需要将异构性视为安全分析的一等要素，在隐私、鲁棒性、公平性与效率之间进行显式权衡；未来工作应依托可复现基准、多维指标体系与可审计治理机制，推动部署、评测与开放研究方向的一体化发展。

Abstract: Distributed machine learning (DML), including conventional distributed training and federated learning (FL), enables collaborative model development across cloud-edge-IoT systems without fully centralizing raw data. However, distributing data, computation, updates, and orchestration increases the attack surface and introduces coupled challenges across privacy, robustness, reliability, fairness, and governance. This survey presents a security-centered, heterogeneity-aware roadmap for trustworthy DML, with FL treated as a prominent high-risk case. We first characterize the assets, adversaries, trust assumptions, and coordination patterns that define DML/FL security boundaries. We then analyze how statistical, system, and trust heterogeneity, including non-IID data, resource asymmetry, intermittent participation, and cross-silo/cross-device trust differences, affect convergence, fairness, attack detectability, and defense reliability. Next, we synthesize attack-defense interactions across poisoning, backdoors, Byzantine manipulation, privacy leakage, model extraction, network/orchestration attacks, Sybil behavior, and strategic participation. We further compare layered defenses, including robust aggregation, drift-aware optimization, differential privacy, secure aggregation, homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, trusted execution environments, watermarking, provenance, authenticated communication, and monitoring. Finally, we discuss deployment, evaluation, governance, and open research guidelines, emphasizing reproducible, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) partitions, attack-aware benchmarks, privacy budgets, attack success rate, client-level disparity, latency, communication, memory, energy/carbon overhead, and auditable lifecycle artifacts.

</details>


### [1626] [Recurrent Bipartite Graph Neural Networks for QC-MDPC Error Decoding in McEliece Cryptosystems](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38479v1)
*Parth Rajeshkumar Tandel,Elisabeth Fink*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出循环二部图神经网络R-BGNN，通过GRU与多拓扑课程训练打破短环导致的译码振荡，显著降低QC-MDPC码译码失败率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模量子计算威胁经典加密，QC-MDPC码是后量子密码的重要基础；但其图结构中的短环会使经典置信传播译码器陷入极限环振荡而失败，在密码场景中此类失败会泄露密钥信息，构成严重安全漏洞。

Method: 提出概念验证性的循环二部图神经网络（R-BGNN）：在消息传递框架中引入门控循环单元（GRU）以建模迭代译码的时间动态，并采用多拓扑课程训练策略，使模型主动学习打破极限环振荡。

Result: 在20个未见过的矩阵拓扑上评估，R-BGNN显著优于经典Bit-Flipping与Min-Sum基线，在中等噪声水平（t=10）下译码失败率（DFR）降低63.7%，且收敛所需迭代次数更少。

Conclusion: 将循环神经网络机制融入图消息传递并结合课程训练，可有效缓解QC-MDPC码的译码失败问题，为后量子密码中基于学习的译码器提供了可行性验证。

Abstract: As the advent of large-scale quantum computing threatens classical encryption, Quasi-Cyclic Moderate Density Parity-Check (QC-MDPC) codes have emerged as a foundational element of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). However, decoding these relatively dense codes using classical Belief Propagation algorithms often leads to failures caused by short graph cycles that stall the decoder. In cryptographic applications, these failures are severe security vulnerabilities that leak secret key information. To address this, this paper proposes a Recurrent Bipartite Graph Neural Network (R-BGNN) as proof of concept. By integrating Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) into the message-passing framework and employing a multi-topology curriculum training strategy, the R-BGNN actively learns to break limit-cycle oscillations. Evaluated across 20 unseen matrix topologies, the proposed architecture significantly outperforms classical Bit-Flipping and Min-Sum baselines, reducing the Decoding Failure Rate (DFR) by 63.7\% at moderate noise levels ($t=10$) while converging in fewer iterations.

</details>


### [1627] [Rosemary: Efficient and Adaptable In-Storage Acceleration for Fully Homomorphic Encryption](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38262v1)
*Xuan Wang,Tianqi Zhang,Gabrielle De Micheli,Yujin Nam,Keming Fan,Augusto Vega,Minxuan Zhou,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Rosemary 是一个面向全同态加密（FHE）的异构加速系统，通过在 NAND 闪存 SSD 内集成存储内计算（ISP）硬件引擎，并结合编译器与算法层优化，突破 FHE 应用中的存储 I/O 瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FHE 虽可支持密文计算以保护隐私，但其计算、内存与数据搬移开销巨大。现有加速工作多基于可全部装进主存的小规模基准，忽视了大规模 FHE 应用中数据体量巨大所导致的存储 I/O 瓶颈。作者实测发现，先进 FHE 系统有 71%–85% 的执行时间用于在存储与计算单元之间搬运数据，而非有效计算。

Method: 提出异构 FHE 加速系统 Rosemary，包含三项核心创新：1）在基于 NAND 闪存的 SSD 内部嵌入可适配、硬件感知的 FHE 计算引擎，实现高效且高性价比的存储内 FHE 处理；2）设计吞吐-数据感知的程序分配器（TDAP），将 FHE 负载切分并调度到异构程序上；3）设计编译器级密文感知优化器（CLCAO），利用对 ISP 友好的 FHE 内核实现低成本存储内执行。

Result: 在包括加密深度学习的推理与云数据库查询等多样化 FHE 负载上，Rosemary 相对最先进的 CPU/GPU 实现取得 185.7× 的几何平均加速，相对已有 FHE 加速器取得 3.7× 加速；能效最高提升 3.9×，EDAP（能耗-延迟-面积积）最高改善 16.5×。

Conclusion: 存储 I/O 是大规模 FHE 部署的关键瓶颈，将 FHE 计算下沉到存储设备并配合跨层（硬件-编译器-调度）协同优化，可显著提升性能、能效与面积效率，为隐私计算场景下的 FHE 实用化提供可行路径。

Abstract: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computation on encrypted data and is promising for privacy-preserving computing. However, FHE deployment remains constrained due to massive computational, memory, and data-movement overheads. Existing acceleration strategies often overlook the storage I/O bottleneck caused by the enormous size of FHE data in large-scale applications, as most prior works focus on small benchmarks that fit in main memory. Our studies show that state-of-the-art FHE systems spend 71\% to 85\% of their execution time moving data between storage and compute units rather than performing useful computation. To address the I/O bottleneck, we present Rosemary, a heterogeneous FHE acceleration system that incorporates a novel in-storage processing (ISP) architecture with compiler-level and algorithmic optimizations. Our key innovations include 1) an adaptable hardware-aware FHE engine inside a NAND flash-based solid-state drive (SSD) for efficient and cost-effective in-storage FHE processing, 2) a Throughput-Data-Aware Program Allocator (TDAP) that partitions FHE workloads into heterogeneous programs, and 3) a Compiler-Level Ciphertext-Aware Optimizer (CLCAO) that exploits ISP-friendly FHE kernels for low-cost ISP execution. Across a diverse set of FHE workloads, including encrypted deep learning inference and cloud database queries, Rosemary achieves geometric-mean speedups of $185.7\times$ over state-of-the-art CPU/GPU implementations and $3.7\times$ over prior FHE accelerators, while improving energy efficiency by up to $3.9\times$ and Energy-Delay-Area-Product (EDAP) by up to $16.5\times$.

</details>


### [1628] [SPARSEBLEED: Bypassing Attribute-Inference Defenses via Sparsity Optimizations](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38110v1)
*Darsh Asher,Farshad Dizani,Joshua Kalyanapu,Ro Cammarota,Aydin Aysu,Samira Mirbagher Ajorpaz*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: SparseBleed 是首个绕过现有隐私防御的硬件级属性窃取攻击：无需梯度、logits、权重、标签、功耗轨迹等任何通道，仅利用稀疏化执行路径产生的稳定时序签名作为模型置信度的替代信号，单次查询即可高保真地推断敏感输入属性与真实输出标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN 广泛部署于医疗、金融等安全与隐私敏感领域，模型在机密数据上训练；已有工作关注软件层面的隐私攻击与防御，但忽视了面向性能的加速器优化（如稀疏化执行）本身可能直接破坏数据机密性，且现有最先进隐私防御并不能阻挡硬件层面的泄露。

Method: 提出 SparseBleed 时序侧信道攻击：利用稀疏驱动的执行路径所编码的稳定时序签名，将其作为模型置信度的替身信号，从而在单次查询下完成属性推断。攻击不依赖梯度、logits、模型权重、真值标签、功耗轨迹、DVFS 操纵、共享缓存等通道。方法在异构后端与硬件引擎上通用，包括 Intel AVX2/AVX-512/AMX、带 2:4 稀疏的 NVIDIA Ampere Tensor Cores，以及 Intel oneDNN、oneMKL SparseBLAS、NVIDIA cuSPARSE 等九种稀疏/稠密库。并评估了两种缓解措施：禁用稀疏优化的常时执行，以及等化最坏情况响应时间的填充防御。

Result: 在 Texas-100X 数据集上，SparseBleed 推断敏感输入属性（如 Sex）准确率达 66.39%，恢复真实输出标签 Surgical Procedure 的准确率达 99.8%，并在多种后端与库上泛化。缓解评估：禁用稀疏优化的常时执行代价高昂（NVIDIA 稀疏 Tensor Core 延迟最高增加 2×，AMX 微基准功耗增加约 25%）；而填充防御在 Texas-100X/Adult 上跨九个库平均仅带来 7.24% 性能开销，额外能耗近乎为零，即可掩盖时序泄露。

Conclusion: 面向性能的稀疏加速器优化会直接削弱数据机密性，构成被现有隐私防御忽视的硬件级属性窃取风险；该攻击跨后端、跨库普遍存在。相比之下，常时执行代价过高，而时间填充防御以极低开销（平均 7.24% 性能损失、近乎零额外能耗）即可有效抑制时序泄露，是更实用的缓解方案。

Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely deployed in safety- and privacy-critical domains such as healthcare and finance, where models are trained on confidential data. This paper presents the first hardware-level attribute-stealing attack that bypasses state-of-the-art privacy defenses, revealing that accelerator optimizations intended for performance can directly undermine data confidentiality. SparseBleed requires no access to gradients, logits, model weights, ground-truth labels, power traces, DVFS manipulation, shared caches, or other channels. Instead, we show that sparsity-driven execution paths encode stable timing signatures that act as a surrogate for model confidence, enabling high-fidelity attribute inference from a single query. SparseBleed generalizes across heterogeneous backends and hardware engines, including Intel AVX2/AVX-512/AMX, NVIDIA Ampere Tensor Cores with 2:4 sparsity, and nine well-known sparse and dense libraries such as Intel oneDNN, oneMKL SparseBLAS, and NVIDIA cuSPARSE. We evaluate SparseBleed to infer sensitive input attributes and true output labels. On Texas-100X, SparseBleed infers sensitive input attributes such as Sex with 66.39% accuracy and recovers the true output label, Surgical Procedure, with 99.8% accuracy. Finally, we evaluate mitigations. Constant-time execution by disabling sparsity optimizations is expensive (e.g., up to $2\times$ higher latency on NVIDIA Sparse Tensor Cores and $\approx 25\%$ higher power in AMX microbenchmarks). By contrast, a padding defense that equalizes responses to the worst-case time masks timing leakage with only 7.24% average performance overhead across nine libraries on Texas-100X/Adult and near-zero extra energy.

</details>


### [1629] [Progressive-Observation Physical-Layer Fingerprinting for Efficient Open-Set Ethernet Authentication](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38074v1)
*Chenming Zhang,Jiaxiang Geng,Aiqun Hu,Azzedine Boukerche,Peng Sun*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种渐进式观测的物理层指纹（PLF）认证方法，按查询自适应调整波形长度，显著降低边缘设备的数据采集与计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PLF系统对每次认证查询都采集并处理固定长度的波形，给资源受限的边缘节点带来沉重负担；同时指纹会随天数漂移，需要额外应对。

Method: 渐进式观测流程：先用轻量级CNN基于短观测拒识明显未知设备；再用更长的观测进行频谱匹配以接受明显已注册设备；仅对模糊查询使用全长波形做同样的匹配。另设计自适应校准算法，利用少量当日注册设备参考样本重新对齐特征与判决阈值，避免CNN重训练。

Result: 在两类控制器（100BASE-TX以太网设备）的留出日测试中，与固定长度处理相比，两类控制器、两天的错误拒绝率与错误接受率均持平或更低；每次查询波形数据量平均减少75.1%，Raspberry Pi 5上CPU处理时间平均减少73.7%。相同监测带宽下边缘节点可服务约4倍的认证查询。

Conclusion: 按需分配观测长度的渐进式PLF可在保持或提升认证精度的同时大幅降低边缘侧开销，配合自适应校准可缓解跨天指纹漂移，适合资源受限的物联网边缘认证部署。

Abstract: Physical-layer fingerprinting (PLF) has emerged as a promising authentication approach for Internet of Things devices. However, most PLF systems acquire and process a fixed-length waveform for every authentication query, burdening resource-constrained edge nodes. To address this issue, we propose a progressive-observation PLF method that adapts the waveform length to each query. Specifically, a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) first rejects clearly unknown devices from a short observation. Spectral matching then accepts clearly registered devices from a slightly longer observation. Only ambiguous queries proceed to the same matching on the full-length waveform, reducing both data acquisition and computation. Because fingerprints drift across days, we also design an adaptive calibration algorithm to avoid retraining the CNN. The algorithm realigns the features and decision thresholds using a few current-day references from registered devices. We evaluate the method with 100BASE-TX Ethernet devices of two controller types on held-out days. Compared with fixed-length processing, it keeps the false rejection and false acceptance rates equal or lower for both controller types on both days. It also reduces the waveform data per query by 75.1% and the CPU processing time on a Raspberry Pi 5 by 73.7% on average. With the same monitoring bandwidth, an edge node can therefore serve about four times as many authentication queries.

</details>


### [1630] [Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37741v1)
*Xinyan Hu,Pingbang Hu,Chloe Loughridge,Xuanli He,Nicholas Carlini,Matthew Jagielski,Javier Rando,Yiming Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 首次证明预训练数据投毒可在智能体中植入远程代码执行后门，0.1% 投毒率下4B模型攻击成功率约92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型依赖从公开网络抓取的大规模未筛选语料预训练，攻击者可在预训练数据中植入污染内容，构成安全风险；但预训练投毒能否在智能体（agent）中植入可执行任意命令的后门，此前未被端到端验证。

Method: 从头预训练 Qwen3 模型（0.6B、1.7B、4B），再用干净流水线后训练为命令行智能体；仅对预训练语料注入0.1%的新式投毒样本，植入触发式后门，并在不同模型规模与投毒率下评估攻击成功率（ASR）及干净输入下的正常表现。

Result: 后门成功植入：触发存在时部署的智能体执行恶意命令，干净输入下行为正常；ASR随模型规模增大而上升，4B 模型在0.1%投毒率下ASR约92%，投毒率降至0.0005%时仍为正。

Conclusion: 预训练数据投毒构成对智能体部署的现实端到端威胁，且随模型规模扩大而加剧，极低投毒率下也难以消除；需重视预训练语料的安全治理与后门检测。

Abstract: Large language models are pretrained on vast, uncurated corpora scraped from the public web. This creates a security risk from attackers who plant poisoned content in the pretraining data. We show for the first time that such poisoning can plant a remote code execution backdoor in an agent, causing it to execute attacker-chosen commands on the user's machine. To measure the threat end to end, we pretrain Qwen3 models from scratch at sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, and then post-train each into a CLI agent using a clean pipeline. Poisoning only 0.1% of the pretraining corpus with our new poison design implants the backdoor: the deployed agent executes the malicious command when the trigger is present while behaving normally on clean inputs. The attack success rate (ASR) increases with model scale, with the 4B model reaching roughly 92% ASR at a 0.1% poison rate and staying positive even when the poisoning rate drops to 0.0005%. Our code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/agentic-backdoor.

</details>


### [1631] [Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37266v1)
*Hongyan Chang,Hady Elsahar,Tom Sander,Pierre Fernandez,Saeed Mahloujifar,Sylvestre-Alvise Rebuffi,Tomáš Souček,Tuan Tran,Valeriu Lacatusu,Surya Parimi,Rashel Moritz,Vanessa Stark,Alexandre Mourachko*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"水印盆地"（watermark basin）现象——水印教师模型的推理轨迹在被蒸馏时会于参数空间中嵌入一个与任务微调子空间正交、与密钥相关的持久几何信号，并据此设计黑盒检测器 WM-Basin，在0.1%误报率下显著优于token级基线，且能抵抗量化、剪枝与RL后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专有语言模型及其推理轨迹面临基于API的蒸馏风险（学生模型学习教师输出）。现有黑盒检测器依赖输出文本的token级统计特征寻找"放射性"信号，但当蒸馏轨迹以低温度采样时，token级信号往往不可检测，导致检测失效。因此需要一种更持久、更可靠的蒸馏取证信号。

Method: 作者提出水印盆地对齐（WM-Basin）黑盒检测器：通过API查询可疑模型，用一个固定的干净探针模型将生成文本映射为梯度表示，投影去除普通任务微调方向，再检验残差梯度是否与由水印密钥诱导的水印盆地对齐。全程无需访问可疑模型的权重或logits。

Result: 在严格0.1%假阳性率下，跨多种教师模型与学生架构（135M–8.2B参数）、数学推理蒸馏场景中，WM-Basin在n-gram=1时检出79%、n-gram=3时检出45%的蒸馏模型，显著优于token级SOTA基线（29%与1.3%）。此外，由于信号位于持久盆地中，检测可经受量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练等蒸馏后修改。

Conclusion: 水印信号并非仅存在于token级表层统计，而是在参数空间中具有稳定的几何结构，这为模型蒸馏取证提供了更鲁棒的检测范式；WM-Basin在黑盒、低误报条件下大幅超越现有方法，并对常见后处理具备鲁棒性。

Abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

</details>


### [1632] [Blindfold: Keeping the Audit Coin Secret from LLM Agents](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37055v1)
*Wei Zhu,Meiyun Zuo,Huiping Sun*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"提交前非干扰"(PNI)性质，证明审计式认证的有效性不仅依赖审计随机币，还依赖该币不得在动作提交前、于智能体自选时刻干扰其视野；以两种币值下智能体视野的总变差距离 D_A 度量违反程度，并给出必要充分性、最坏偏差 (1-ε)D_A、泄露跨步复合与实测验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计式认证通常被认为只依赖防御方的审计币即可保证有效性，但对抗性 LLM 智能体可能通过观察审计行为留下的侧信道（如工具时间戳延迟、可见审计提示）识别自己是否被审计，从而操纵违规率。作者意在揭示这一隐含的机密性前提，并量化其破坏后果。

Method: 形式化定义"提交前非干扰"(PNI)：审计币不得在动作提交前、于智能体选择的时刻进入其视野；用两种币值下智能体视野的总变差距离 D_A 度量违反。理论分析给出 PNI 对自适应智能体的必要充分性、最坏偏差界 (1-ε)D_A 与最小代价下界、跨步复合性、跨回合共享资源信道容量，以及提高审计率无效性。实证上构建监视器（静默审计仅引入可被工具时间戳暴露的延迟），并测试真实 LLM 智能体对提示注入（点名可见审计通知）的响应，以及实时运行中按预注册时间表的验证。

Result: 最坏偏差为 (1-ε)D_A，且任何仅观测审计标签的程序都无法以更低代价修正；泄露在步骤间复合，跨回合共享资源形成可计算大小的信道，且提高审计率不能恢复有效性。实测中静默审计输出不变但延迟可被工具时间戳暴露且智能体可放大；通用、工具与时间条款的注入无效，而点名可见审计通知的注入被真实智能体遵循，导致普通证书在实测标签与实时运行中失效；静默审计可恢复正常；每次被审计调用使用新币可封闭时间信道，填充仅能收窄信道。

Conclusion: 审计式认证的有效性存在被忽视的机密性前提 PNI；一旦审计币在提交前泄露给智能体，认证可被系统性偏置且提高审计率无济于事。逐次调用独立新币可从机制上封闭时间侧信道，而填充等缓解手段只能减弱泄露。实践上应在设计阶段保障 PNI。

Abstract: Audit-based certification bounds the violation rate of an LLM agent by auditing a random fraction $\varepsilon$ of actions and reweighting the audited labels; its validity is meant to rest only on the defender's audit coin. We show that it also rests on a confidentiality property: the coin must not interfere with the agent's view before the action commits, at a time the agent chooses. We call this pre-commit noninterference (PNI) and measure its violation by $D_{\mathrm{A}}$, the total-variation distance between the agent's views under the two coin values. PNI is necessary and sufficient for an unbiased certificate against adaptive agents, the worst-case bias is $(1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}}$, and no procedure that sees only audited labels can pay less. Leakage composes across steps, a resource shared across episodes opens a channel of computable size, and raising the audit rate cannot restore validity. On a monitor we built, a silent audit changes no output but adds latency that tool timestamps expose, and the agent can enlarge it. A real LLM agent follows an injection that names a visible audit notice (generic, tool, and timing clauses have no effect); over that channel the plain certificate fails on measured labels and, by a post-hoc analysis, in a live run on a pre-registered schedule, while a silent audit restores it. A fresh coin per audited call closes the timing channel; padding only narrows it.

</details>


### [1633] [Quantifying and Prioritizing Stealthy Source-Manipulation Threats Against Multi-Source Anomaly Detectors](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36693v1)
*Indraveni Chebolu,Seema Panghal,Arnab Mallick,Ch A S Murty*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出"任务条件可见性裕度"（task-conditioned visibility margin）这一威胁量化指标，用以衡量对抗者需向检测器暴露的最小证据量（每单位下游任务危害），并据此构造最小证据攻击、定位检测器盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨源异常检测器的评估仅依赖干净数据假阳性率和对随机扰动的检测率，无法刻画"控制部分数据源、针对特定下游决策"的对抗者；缺少可量化、可计算的威胁度量。

Method: 定义任务条件可见性裕度：操纵为造成单位下游危害所必须暴露的最小检测证据；给出闭式解（约85微秒/证书），可生成最小证据攻击，并识别检测器不可见的任务相关方向；在17通道工业遥测基准上对1–4通道子集进行审计，并与随机排序、基于告警排序及任务梯度基线对比。

Result: 能标记82.8%随机单通道损坏的检测器，在64.7%的任务/子集对上存在一阶盲区；任务条件操纵产生超过两倍的"虚假安心"错误，并在5个划分中的4个更易规避告警（主要在小预算下）；用于优先级审计时，每10次检查中位数发现4个经验证的失效，随机排序为0，告警排序为2，与任务梯度基线相当；同样可对GDN、TranAD检测器及五源作物产量面板的脆弱配置进行排序。

Conclusion: 裕度弥补了传统指标对定向对抗威胁的刻画缺失，兼具闭式可计算性与审计实用性，可作为检测器安全评估与脆弱配置排序的通用工具。

Abstract: Security pipelines often fuse several data sources and protect a downstream model with a cross-source anomaly detector. Such detectors are usually judged by their clean false-positive rate and by how well they catch random corruption. Neither metric captures an adversary who controls some sources and targets a specific downstream decision. We propose a threat-quantification score, the \emph{task-conditioned visibility margin}, defined as the least detector evidence a manipulation must reveal per unit of harm to the downstream task. The margin has a closed form, takes about $85\,μ$s per certificate, yields a minimum-evidence attack, and identifies task-relevant directions the detector cannot see. On a 17-channel industrial telemetry benchmark, a detector that flags 82.8\% of random single-channel corruptions is first-order blind on 64.7\% of task/subset pairs in an audit of one- to four-channel subsets. Task-conditioned manipulations cause more than twice as many falsely reassuring errors as generic stealthy ones, and more of them evade the alarm on four of five splits, mainly at small budgets. Used to prioritize audits on held-out subsets, the margin finds a median of four verified failures in ten checks, compared with none for random order and two for alarm-based ranking, and performs comparably to the task-gradient baseline. It also ranks vulnerable configurations of the learned GDN and TranAD detectors and of a five-source crop-yield panel.

</details>


### [1634] [Generation, Not Selection: LLM Proposals for Certified Access-Control Policy Mining](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37716v1)
*Gautam Kumar,Ravi Sundaram,Shamik Sural*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 将ABAC策略挖掘中的候选规则生成从纯语法方式替换为大语言模型的语义式提议，同时保留贪心集合覆盖选择器以维持近似保证；语义提议在十个对比中全面优于语法挖掘器，减少假授权四到七倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略挖掘被建模为最小集合覆盖并用贪心求解，其 s*(1+ln m) 保证隐含一个从未被文献表述的前提：交给贪心的候选池必须包含最优规则。真正的瓶颈在生成而非选择，而现有生成器是纯语法的——只有足够多日志记录见证某条规则时才浮现它，因此在填满重尾策略的稀有例外规则上失效。

Method: 用语言模型基于属性名进行语义化规则提议，取代语法生成器；保留组合选择器承载近似保证。所有提议都针对观测到的拒绝记录进行过滤，使可靠性独立于提议机制——不可靠的提议者只会浪费候选，不会授予访问。另设匿名化消融实验以隔离机制。

Result: 在两个企业域上各跑五个随机种子，语义提议在十次运行中十次占优（七次严格更优）；策略接近最优（9.2–9.6 条规则，s*=9，对比 11.2–14.6），假授权降低四到七倍。完全替代而非增强语法挖掘器仅在见证稀缺时占优。匿名化消融显示：不透明属性名使模型的规则恢复损失约三分之二，而语法基线可证明不受影响，且在见证充足时无损失。

Conclusion: 生成而非选择是绑定约束；语义知识与日志证据互为替代品，二者结合可同时获得可审计的近最优策略与更强的可靠性保证。

Abstract: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policy mining---recovering a compact, auditable policy from an access log---is posed as minimum set cover and solved greedily, which enjoys an $s^{*}(1+\ln m)$ guarantee. That guarantee is \emph{conditional} on a precondition the literature never states: the candidate pool handed to greedy must contain the optimal rules. Generation, not selection, is the binding constraint, and existing generators are purely \emph{syntactic}---they surface a rule only when enough log records witness it, so they fail on precisely the rare exception rules that fill a heavy-tailed policy. We replace the generator with a language model proposing rules \emph{semantically}, from attribute names, and keep the combinatorial selector to carry the guarantee: every proposal is filtered against the observed denials, so soundness is independent of the proposal mechanism and an unreliable proposer can only waste candidates, never grant access. Over five seeds on each of two enterprise domains, adding semantic proposal to a syntactic miner dominates it on \emph{ten of ten} runs---strictly better on seven---with near-optimal policies ($9.2$--$9.6$ rules against $s^{*}=9$, versus $11.2$--$14.6$) and false grants cut four- to sevenfold. Replacing the syntactic miner rather than augmenting it wins only where witnesses are scarce. An anonymization ablation isolates the mechanism: opaque attribute names cost two thirds of the model's rule recovery while leaving the syntactic baselines provably unmoved, and cost nothing where witnesses are plentiful. Semantic knowledge and log evidence are substitutes.

</details>


### [1635] [Silent Blindness: Fault Vulnerability of Hardware Malware Detectors](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36612v1)
*Alireza Abolhasani Zeraatkar,Parnian Shabani Kamran,Parsa Mirfasihi,Saleh Khalaj Monfared,Hussain Al-Asaad*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文通过结构故障注入评估硬件恶意软件检测器（HMD）的脆弱性，发现树模型（尤其是Bagging集成）对关键故障的敏感度显著低于函数模型，并给出基于极小极大选择的关键单元保护方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HMD依赖硬件性能计数器分类恶意执行，其决策逻辑或参数若发生故障可能削弱检测能力、使恶意软件被误判为良性；现有工作缺乏对结构级故障后果（规避、误报上升、指标静默）的系统刻画。

Method: 在18个分类器、4种计数器预算、AdaBoost与Bagging集成的设计空间上做结构故障注入仿真：注入453,174个决策卡滞与参数位翻转事件，实例集规模7,400；主比较基于128个完整配置，并与覆盖140个可枚举故障位点的仿真汇总区分；按安全后果（规避、误报增加、指标静默）分类故障，以召回下降≥5个百分点为关键故障判据；并用精确极小极大选择法在加性单位成本与理想修复假设下确定保护候选。

Result: 树模型的平均关键故障比例低于函数模型（5.3% vs 14.3%），仅用穷举分析仍保持该排序；72.3%的树模型故障为"指标静默"（召回与假阳率变化均<0.1个百分点，但不一定保持单个预测不变）；27组匹配比较中Bagging在26组降低关键性，AdaBoost在2组升高；对代表性J48检测器，保护115个结构单元中的16个可将预测最大召回损失从60.1个百分点降至3.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了HMD结构模型的故障敏感性与潜在保护收益；但故障RTL对应关系与物理加固开销尚未验证。

Abstract: Hardware malware detectors (HMDs) classify hardware performance-counter measurements to identify malicious execution. Faults in their decision logic or parameters can weaken detection and allow malware to be classified as benign. We investigate this vulnerability through structural fault injection across a design space comprising 18 classifiers, four counter budgets, and AdaBoost and Bagging ensembles. The simulation evaluates 453,174 decision stuck-at and selected parameter bit-flip events on a 7,400-instance. Primary comparisons use 128 completed configurations. These completed-subset results are distinguished from the simulation summaries covering 140 configurations with enumerable fault sites. Fault outcomes are classified by their security consequences, including evasion, false-alarm increases, and metric silence. A fault is critical when malware recall decreases by at least five percentage points. Tree-based models exhibit a lower mean critical-fault fraction than function-based models, 5.3% versus 14.3%; exhaustive-only analysis preserves this ordering. Moreover, 72.3% of evaluated tree faults are metric-silent, changing both recall and false-positive rate by less than 0.1 percentage points without necessarily preserving individual predictions. Among the 27 completed matched comparisons, Bagging reduces criticality in 26, whereas AdaBoost increases it in two. Finally, an exact minimax selection method identifies protection candidates under additive unit costs and ideal correction. For a representative J48 detector, protecting 16 of 115 structural units reduces predicted maximum recall loss from 60.1 to 3.3 percentage points. These results characterize structural-model sensitivity and potential protection benefits; faulted RTL correspondence and physical hardening overhead remain unvalidated.

</details>


### [1636] [A Simple Presentation of Robust Membership Inference Attacks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36458v1)
*Renaud Gaucher,Ephraim Linder,Adam Smith,Jonathan Ullman,Lydia Zakynthinou*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文给出均值估计场景下鲁棒成员推断攻击的简明表述，覆盖多元高斯分布与二元乘积分布，并综述鲁棒成员推断的研究历史、扩展及与其他领域的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成员推断攻击中，攻击者需据数据统计量或训练模型判断某个个体是否在数据集中。若攻击在统计量被高度加噪时仍能成功，则称为"鲁棒"。作者希望系统而简洁地刻画这一鲁棒性，并梳理该方向的研究脉络。

Method: 以均值估计为核心，对攻击问题进行简化建模与表述；分别针对多元高斯分布和二元乘积分布两类数据分布给出鲁棒成员推断攻击的构造形式；同时开展文献综述，归纳鲁棒成员推断的历史、扩展与跨领域联系。

Result: 给出了多变量高斯与二元乘积分布下均值估计的鲁棒成员推断攻击的简单表述，并对鲁棒成员推断的已有研究进行了归纳总结（含发展历史、方法扩展及与其他研究方向的关联）。

Conclusion: 鲁棒成员推断可在均值估计这一基础设定下以简洁形式呈现，涵盖高斯与二元乘积分布两类情形；该框架为理解噪声无关的攻击能力提供了统一视角，并连接至更广泛的隐私与统计研究。

Abstract: In a membership inference attack, an attacker is given the data of a particular individual, and tries to determine if that individual was included in a particular dataset, given some kind of statistics derived from the dataset or a model trained on the dataset. Roughly, a membership inference attack is robust if it succeeds even when the statistics are highly noisy, regardless of how that noise is introduced. We give a simple presentation of robust membership inference attacks for mean estimation, covering both multivariate Gaussian distributions and binary product distributions. We also give a summary of the literature on robust membership inference, covering history, extensions, and connections to other research areas.

</details>


### [1637] [BUSTA: Teaching Small Language Models to Reason About Binary Execution](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36288v1)
*Ritika Poddar,Aidan Fennelly,Deirdre Murphy,Eric Wolos,Corre L. Steele,Michael Doyle*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文探究通过"逆基本块执行"任务（给定x86-64基本块与目标输出寄存器状态，预测能产生该状态的输入寄存器值）能否将逆向工程技能迁移到开源小模型；使用GRPO微调Qwen3-1.7B与Nemotron-3-Nano，将可知寄存器预测准确率分别从73.2%提升至85.3%、从63.3%提升至95.2%，接近前沿模型（最高99.2%）且参数量大幅缩减，并开源模型与数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正被越来越多地用于逆向工程（RE）工作流，但RE与常见编码任务不同：它要求模型推理底层程序行为；同时RE工具通常部署在资源受限的沙箱环境中，难以使用前沿规模的大模型。因此需要验证针对性的训练方法能否将特定RE技能迁移到开放小模型上。

Method: 提出逆向基本块执行任务：输入一个x86-64基本块及期望的输出寄存器状态，让模型预测产生该状态的输入寄存器值。以该任务为训练目标，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）对Qwen3-1.7B和Nemotron-3-Nano进行微调。

Result: 微调后可知寄存器（knowable-register）预测准确率：Qwen3-1.7B由73.2%升至85.3%，Nemotron-3-Nano由63.3%升至95.2%。前沿模型仍最高（达99.2%），但微调后的Nemotron-3-Nano以极小参数量将差距缩小至4个百分点以内。

Conclusion: 针对性的任务训练可将RE核心技能有效迁移至开放小模型，使其在资源受限的沙箱化RE环境中具备接近前沿模型的实用能力；作者开源了微调模型与训练数据集。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. Frontier models still score highest (up to 99.2\%), but our fine-tuned \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} comes within four points at a fraction of the parameter count. We release both fine-tuned models and the training dataset.

</details>


### [1638] [Privately Clipping Heavy-Tailed Data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36281v1)
*Matthew Joseph,Alex Kulesza*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 针对差分隐私向量求和中的裁剪界选择问题，提出以"残差相干性"为优化目标、权衡超界向量方向对齐度与额外噪声方差来隐私地选择裁剪界，并从理论上刻画其与偏差的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私求和的常规做法是：先将向量裁剪到界 B，再求和并加入与 B 成比例的噪声。隐私文献对噪声机制已有大量成果，却很少提供"基于数据隐私地选择裁剪界"的工具。而裁剪界直接决定偏差（裁剪造成的截断误差）与方差（噪声规模）之间的取舍，现有方法缺乏原则性的选择依据。

Method: 1) 引入"残差相干性"（residual coherence）概念，即超出裁剪界的残差向量在方向上的对齐程度；2) 构造优化目标，将残差相干性（与偏差相关）同因增大裁剪界而引入的额外噪声方差代价进行权衡，据此刻画一个隐私的裁剪界选择规则；3) 对一类重尾数据分布，理论证明残差相干性与偏差之间存在紧密联系；4) 在多个数据集上与现有基线方法进行实证比较。

Result: 理论上，在一类一般性的重尾数据情形下，证明了残差相干性与裁剪偏差之间存在紧密的定量关系，从而为用相干性代理偏差提供了依据；实证上，在若干数据集上该方法优于现有裁剪界选择基线。

Conclusion: 通过优化残差相干性与额外噪声方差的权衡来隐私地选择裁剪界，是一种有理论支撑且实践中优于基线的方案，弥补了隐私求和中数据自适应裁剪界选择工具不足的缺口。

Abstract: Summing vectors is a basic task in differentially private data analysis. Standard private sum algorithms clip vectors to some bound, sum them, and add noise scaled to the bound. The differential privacy literature has developed a deep library of noise addition mechanisms, but it offers few tools for privately choosing a clipping bound based on the data. We introduce a method that privately chooses a clipping bound by optimizing residual coherence, the directional alignment of vectors exceeding the bound, against the variance cost of additional noise. We prove a close relationship between residual coherence and bias for a general class of heavy-tailed data regimes and show empirically that, across several datasets, our method outperforms existing baselines.

</details>


### [1639] [A Category-Selective Encryption Framework for Privacy Protection of UAV Images](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35729v1)
*Ting Yan,Minghui Shang,Haolang Sun,Xu Wang,Yamin Han,Mingze He*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出面向无人机监控的类别选择性加密框架，仅加密用户指定的敏感类别，兼顾隐私保护与场景可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机航拍常同时捕获行人和车辆等敏感目标与普通场景内容，引发隐私担忧；现有方法采用类别无关的显著性检测对全部显著区域一律模糊，造成不必要的信息损失并妨碍下游场景分析。

Method: 核心是语义级选择性：先用80类检测器识别场景内容，再仅对用户指定的敏感类别加密，保留非敏感物体与背景。框架提供两种互补加密方案：(1) 缩略图保持加密（TPE），采用带可学习混合参数的自适应像素化，并由联合训练的增强U-Net恢复内容；(2) XOR流密码加密，实现无参数、数学上精确可逆。文中还详细给出架构设计、复合损失构建与联合训练方法。

Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，仅说明两种加密方案分别具备可学习恢复能力与数学精确可逆性，并称框架设计、复合损失与联合训练方法已完整给出。

Conclusion: 该工作为实用型隐私保护无人机监控奠定基础，在保护强度与场景效用之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems increasingly raises privacy concerns, as UAV aerial surveillance routinely captures sensitive objects such as pedestrians and vehicles alongside ordinary scene content. Existing privacy-preserving approaches typically employ class-agnostic saliency detection to indiscriminately obfuscate all visually salient regions, leading to unnecessary information loss and hindering downstream scene analysis. This paper proposes a category-selective encryption framework for privacy-preserving UAV surveillance. The core advance over prior class-agnostic approaches is semantic-level selectivity: the system first recognizes what is present in the scene via an 80-class detector, then encrypts only user-specified sensitive categories while leaving non-sensitive objects and background intact for downstream analytics. The framework supports two complementary encryption schemes: Thumbnail-Preserving Encryption (TPE), which applies adaptive pixelation with a learnable blend parameter and recovers content through a jointly trained Enhanced U-Net, and XOR stream cipher encryption, which offers parameter-free, mathematically exact reversibility. The architectural design, composite loss formulation, and joint training methodology are presented in detail, establishing a foundation for practical privacy-preserving UAV surveillance that balances protection strength and scene utility.

</details>


### [1640] [Adversary Brains: Hypothesis-Based Logical Signatures for Threat Actor Detection with LLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35624v1)
*Gadi Evron*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出"对手大脑"(adversary brain)概念：把威胁行为体行为建模为可随数据持续检验的演进式逻辑签名，借助语言模型将报告自动转化为签名、判定匹配并驱动更新循环，实现从战役/行为体活动模式层面的检测与情报发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检测以单点观测(IoC、YARA匹配文件、Sigma匹配日志行)为粒度，缺乏对战役或行为体整体活动模式的刻画；人工情报分析(Analysis of Competing Hypotheses, ACH)受限于同时只能比较少量假设，难以持续、规模化地验证与更新。

Method: 将ACH扩展至数千假设规模并操作化用于持续检测：以结构化逻辑签名形式表达敌手行为假设，使数据可自动、连续地对其进行检验，无需人工每次重新解读；由语言模型把文字报告转换为"大脑"、对匹配结果进行判断，并驱动保持"大脑"时效性的闭环流程。

Result: 概念与规模化路径被证明可行：语言模型使"大脑"的构建与维护具备可实践性；签名中的部分模式可匹配新出现的值(如新的C2域名)，从而辅助新指标发现，把未知的未知转化为已知的未知，并有望进一步转化为已知。

Conclusion: 检测与情报的机制单位应由单点观测上移至结构化、可演进的行为假设；LLM使该机制在规模与持续性上可落地，在检测粒度与未知威胁发现两方面提供增益。

Abstract: An adversary brain is an LLM-based model of a threat actor's behavior, held as an evolving logical signature: a hypothesis with enough structure that data can test it continuously, without a person re-interpreting it each time. Rather than any single observation, such as an IoC (Indicator of Compromise), it is the arrangement that becomes a detection, or intelligence, mechanism. Where YARA matches a file and Sigma matches a log line, an adversary brain matches the activity pattern of a campaign or threat actor. This is based on an intelligence analysis technique called Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH), which the design lifts from the limitation of a few hypotheses at a time, to thousands, and then also operationalizes it for continuous detection purposes. Language models make the concept, and scale, practical: they turn prose reports into brains, judge matches, and drive the loop that keeps brains current. A partial pattern in a brain can also match a new value, such as a fresh C2 (command and control) domain name, assisting with the discovery of new indicators, and turning unknown unknowns into known unknowns, and potentially into knowns.
  The author would like to thank Ryan Moon for the collaboration, and Sounil Yu, Chris Inglis, Thomas Roccia, Marius Benthin, Israel Grimberg, Michal Kamensky, Justin Borland, Brandon Levene, John Hultquist, and John Bambenek for their feedback and assistance.

</details>


### [1641] [Intellectual Property Protection of Hyperdimensional Computing Classifiers: Black-Box Ownership Verification via Model Watermarking](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34942v1)
*Hamed Poursiami,Farshad Soleiman,Ahmad Tahmasivand,Guojing Cong,Thomas Potok,Khaled N. Khasawneh,Kai Zeng,Maryam Parsa*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究超维计算（HDC）模型水印，将基于后门的水印嵌入适配到三种原型学习机制不同的HDC分类器，考察水印可学习性、精度代价、抗模型修改/复制/覆写能力，并在FPGA上进行欠压与超频压力测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HDC在资源受限系统上高效，但其模型的所有权验证（水印）问题尚未被探索，需要验证后门式水印是否可迁移到HDC并保持鲁棒性。

Method: 将后门式水印嵌入AdaptHD、OnlineHD与单遍Vanilla HDC三种分类器；在四个基准数据集上以常规神经网络为参照，评估精度损失、持续训练、抽取（extraction）与覆写（overwriting）攻击；并将带水印AdaptHD部署于FPGA，通过欠压与超频注入计算错误。

Result: 误差驱动型分类器（AdaptHD、OnlineHD）在1%名义触发暴露下可完成验证，平均精度损失不超过0.58个百分点；单遍Vanilla HDC需更高暴露且精度代价大。误差驱动模型在原生持续训练下保持验证，但抽取得到的替代模型能复现任务行为却无法验证水印。水印覆写可较易植入攻击者水印，且对原水印的侵蚀强于神经网络参照，但最强侵蚀伴随大幅精度下降。FPGA上验证可承受相当程度计算错误，更严重压力则导致验证失败伴随精度崩溃或推理超时。

Conclusion: HDC水印可行，但在抽取下的水印保留性与抗覆写方面存在局限。

Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) offers efficient learning and inference for resource-constrained systems, yet ownership verification of its models remains underexplored. We present the first systematic investigation of model watermarking in HDC by adapting backdoor-based embedding to three classifiers with different prototype-learning mechanisms. Across four benchmarks, with conventional neural networks as references, we examine whether watermarks can be learned without compromising task accuracy and whether they survive subsequent model modification and replication. The error-driven classifiers, AdaptHD and OnlineHD, support verification at a nominal trigger exposure of 1% with at most 0.58 percentage points of mean accuracy loss, whereas single-pass Vanilla HDC requires greater exposure and can incur substantial accuracy costs. The error-driven models retain verification under native continued training, but extraction produces surrogates that reproduce much of the task behavior without verifiable watermarks. Watermark overwriting readily embeds attacker watermarks into HDC prototypes and erodes the owner's watermark more strongly than in the neural network references, although the strongest erosion coincides with large accuracy losses. We further deploy watermarked AdaptHD on an FPGA and stress its execution through undervolting and overclocking. Verification survives substantial computation errors, whereas more severe stress either causes verification failure together with accuracy collapse or results in inference timeouts. These findings establish the feasibility of watermarking in HDC while identifying limitations in retention under extraction and sensitivity to overwriting.

</details>


### [1642] [Attack logics, not outputs: Concept-based Property Attacks for Shortcut Elimination in Neural Networks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34923v2)
*Raik Dankworth,Felix Mächtle,Thomas Eisenbarth,Gesina Schwalbe*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出以"概念级逻辑一致性"为目标的对抗攻击形式化框架：用概念可解释AI（C-XAI）在已训练网络上实现概念属性（如 red ∧ octagonal ⟹ stop_sign），并证明其搜索空间小于类别翻转攻击，实验中作为对抗训练数据可兼顾鲁棒性增益与语义偏置消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击与鲁棒性分析只针对最终输出的类别翻转（stop_sign → ¬stop_sign），属黑箱式的行为伪造，忽视概念层面的推理逻辑，因而难以揭示并纠正模型的语义偏置；作者主张鲁棒性分析应转向概念级逻辑不一致。

Method: 1) 形式化"概念属性"：定义为人类可解释概念上的约束（如 red ∧ octogonal ⟹ stop_sign），把此类属性的伪造作为原则化的对抗攻击；2) 借助概念可解释AI技术，在已训练好的网络上实现概念属性；3) 理论证明概念属性攻击的搜索空间相比简单类别伪造更小；4) 用所生成的概念级攻击样本进行对抗训练。

Result: 理论证明概念级攻击搜索空间缩减；在多个模型与数据集（视觉任务及安全相关的代码处理任务）上实证表明：基于概念级攻击的再训练在保持与经典对抗再训练相当的鲁棒性增益的同时，更好地消除语义偏置。

Conclusion: 概念级伪造可视为经典对抗攻击的推广：它更贴合直观的鲁棒性目标、搜索更高效，可作为逻辑约束驱动的对抗训练手段，在视觉与代码处理任务中同时提升鲁棒性与语义合理性。

Abstract: Deep neural networks (NNs) for computer vision are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, such that minuscule malicious changes to inputs may induce unintuitive outputs. One key approach to verify and mitigate such robustness issues is to falsify expected output behavior, which enables local robustness guarantees and adversarial training. Due to the black-box nature of NNs, current attacks only falsify a class of the final output, such as flipping from $\text{stop_sign}$ to $\neg \text{stop_sign}$. In this work we argue that robustness analysis should focus more generally on logical inconsistencies in concept-level reasoning rather than solely on output misclassification. We formalize this perspective through concept-based properties, i.e., constraints over human-interpretable concepts such as $\text{red} \land \text{octogonal} \implies \text{stop_sign}$ and study the falsification of such properties as a principled form of adversarial attack. Furthermore, an implementation of concept-based properties on already trained NNs is proposed using techniques from concept-based explainable artificial intelligence (C-XAI). For that we formally prove that attacks on concept-based properties are expected to have a reduced search space compared to simple class falsification, whilst arguably be more aligned with intuitive robustness targets. The practical effectiveness of our approach for logically informed adversarial training is shown in an empirical study across multiple models and datasets, including both vision and a security-relevant code processing task. Our results demonstrate that concept-level falsification generalizes classical adversarial attacks: Retraining on our novel attacks maintains robustness gains as compared to classical adversarial retraining whilst better eliminating semantic biases.

</details>


### [1643] [Compound Environmental Operating Stress and Cyber-Induced Pump Disruption in Water Distribution Networks: Matched Hydraulic Impacts, Service Continuity, and Sustained Recovery](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34670v1)
*Halil Dursunoglu,Fatma Dursunoglu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究利用WNTR在EPANET Net1与Net3两个基准网络上模拟网络攻击引发的泵停机，在假设性环境压力条件下评估供水系统的水力恢复情况，指出"服务恢复≠水力恢复"，且网络依赖性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字控制供水系统在受扰期间需维持服务，但供水服务恢复并不必然意味着水力（压力）恢复。既有研究多关注服务可用性，缺乏对攻击引发停机后"压力恢复"与"服务恢复"区分的量化评估，也未考虑环境运行压力与缓解策略的交互影响。

Method: 采用Water Network Tool for Resilience (WNTR)对两个EPANET基准网络（Net1、Net3）进行仿真。实验设计含288条仿真记录（240个独立配置），其中192个经验证的攻击场景；变量包括4小时与12小时停机时长、6种水力配置、4种缓解策略。所有攻击场景均满足泵停机验证与攻击前水力等效性校验。

Result: 12小时停机在Net1中平均造成404.96 m³未满足需求；Net3虽出现压力偏差但在建模条件下仍满足全部需求。192个场景中仅103个实现持续性压力恢复，其中65个随后出现压力回退；但全部场景均满足停机后供水服务恢复判据。组合缓解策略在Net1评估场景中消除了未满足需求；缩短停机时长获得的持续性压力恢复场景数最多。

Conclusion: 结果表明韧性具有网络依赖性，且需明确区分"服务恢复"与"水力恢复"两类判据；缓解策略对未满足需求与压力恢复的效用并不一致。环境压力场景属于敏感性假设而非经实测标定的气候影响，相关结论外推需谨慎。

Abstract: Digitally controlled water distribution systems must maintain service during disruptions, yet restoring water delivery does not necessarily ensure hydraulic recovery. This study evaluates cyber-induced pump outages under hypothetical environmental operating stress using two EPANET benchmark networks (Net1 and Net3) simulated with the Water Network Tool for Resilience. The experimental design comprises 288 simulation records (240 distinct configurations), including 192 verified attack scenarios, with four- and twelve-hour outages, six hydraulic configurations, and four mitigation strategies. All attack scenarios satisfied pump-shutdown verification and pre-attack hydraulic-equivalence criteria. Twelve-hour outages produced an average of 404.96 m$^3$ of unmet demand in Net1, while Net3 maintained full modeled demand delivery despite pressure deviations. Sustained pressure recovery occurred in 103 of 192 scenarios, with 65 exhibiting subsequent relapse, whereas all scenarios satisfied the post-outage water-service recovery criterion. Combined mitigation eliminated unmet demand in evaluated Net1 scenarios, while outage shortening achieved the highest sustained-pressure-recovery count. These findings highlight network-dependent resilience and the distinction between service restoration and hydraulic recovery. Environmental stress scenarios represent sensitivity assumptions rather than empirically calibrated climate impacts.

</details>

### [1644] [Learning Kolmogorov Backward Operators for Spectral Analysis and Forecasting: A Data-Driven Variational Galerkin Framework](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39580v1)
*Yuanchao Xu,Claire Valva,Ben Gao,Isao Ishikawa*

Main category: math.DS

TL;DR: 提出两阶段方法：先用FNO等直接从数据逼近固定滞后解算子，再做Galerkin投影到有限维可观测空间，并给出学习误差、采样误差与不变子空间逼近的完整误差分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kolmogorov后向方程的固定滞后解算子对可观测量是线性确定性演化，即使动力系统本身是随机的；希望在不了解控制方程的情况下从数据直接学习该算子，并获得谱与预测误差的理论保证。

Method: 两阶段：①无方程先验地从数据逼近解算子（如Fourier Neural Operator）；②Galerkin投影到预先给定或变分选取的有限维可观测空间。误差分析将估计器的学习误差、Galerkin内积的采样误差、可观测空间的不变性与重构性质追踪到计算谱与预测误差。

Result: 采样误差仅以乘性因子进入；孤立谱簇附近，子空间的不变缺陷控制其到目标不变子空间的距离；预测误差由约化模型单步误差与可观测投影误差控制，且当测度不变、约化模型保持常数且在零均值可观测量上稳定时误差界对预测时域一致。确定性情形下由FNO学习率给出学习误差的显式界。数值实验展示谱逼近与预测，包括长时间rollout稳定性，以及与EDMD在转移对少于基函数时的比较。

Conclusion: 该两阶段框架在数据驱动下实现解算子的谱逼近与稳定长期预测，并提供了可量化的误差界，优于转移样本不足情形下的EDMD。

Abstract: For a time-homogeneous Markov process, the fixed-lag solution operator \( (T_τf)(x)=\mathbb E[f(X_{t+τ})\mid X_t=x] \) of the Kolmogorov backward equation evolves observables linearly and deterministically, even when the dynamics are stochastic. We approximate this operator using a two-stage method where we first approximate this operator directly from data, without knowledge of the governing equation (e.g., Fourier Neural Operator), and then compress the Galerkin projection onto a finite-dimensional observable space that is fixed in advance or selected variationally. The error analysis traces the learning error of the estimator, the sampling error of the Galerkin inner products, and the invariance and reconstruction properties of the observable space to the computed spectra and forecasts. The sampling error enters only through a multiplicative factor. Near an isolated spectral cluster, the invariance defect of a subspace controls its distance from the target invariant subspace. The forecast error is controlled by the one-step error of the reduced model and the projection error of the observable; when the measure is invariant and the reduced model preserves constants and is stable on mean-zero observables, the bound is uniform in the horizon. For deterministic dynamics, a learning rate for Fourier neural operators (FNOs) gives one explicit bound for the learning error. Numerical experiments illustrate spectral approximation and forecasting, including long-rollout stability and a comparison with extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) when fewer transition pairs than basis functions are observed.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [1645] [TrussTutor-Bench: Benchmarking large language models on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection in statics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38917v1)
*Evangelos Apostolakis,Erfan Hamdi,Sara Jahedazad,Emma Lejeune*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出 TrussTutor-Bench 基准（200 道经核验的二维桁架题+自动生成的"学生解答"），评测 13 个大模型在解答正确性、谄媚（sycophancy）与错误检测三方面的能力，发现错误检测在该干净条件下无区分度，而谄媚率差异巨大（1.6%–50.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 已成为工程力学（如静力学）学生的学习助手，但有效辅导不仅需要给出正确答案，还需在学生质疑正确解答时坚持正确结论、并识别学生错误。现有基准几乎只测最终答案准确率，无法判断能解题的模型是否具备辅导所需的其它技术能力。

Method: 构建 TrussTutor-Bench：包含 200 道经过验证的二维桁架问题，并配对自动生成的学生解答（含合成错误注入）。以该基准评测 13 个 LLM，从三个维度考察：解答准确率、谄媚（学生坚持正确解答有误时模型是否改口）、以及对学生缺陷解答的错误检测率。

Result: 基线准确率为 64.5%–97.0%；所有模型对注入错误的检出率为 90.4%–100%，在该干净条件下缺乏区分度；谄媚率区分明显——当学生坚持自己已正确求解的问题答案有误时，模型放弃正确答案的比例为 1.6%–50.0%。

Conclusion: 模型间性能差异显著：领先模型能近乎完美地解题、核验并坚持学生解答的正确性，而部分模型可靠性明显不足，尤其在学生质疑正确解答时。TrussTutor-Bench 为判断哪些模型技术可靠到足以面向学生提供了可扩展的验证标准；后续研究应转向教学效果本身，结合学习科学考察 LLM 辅助是促进学生真正理解还是仅帮助得到答案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become a default source of help for students in science and engineering courses. In foundational engineering mechanics courses such as statics, students routinely use these tools to check answers, work through partial solutions, and ask for explanations. Effective tutoring in this setting requires more than a correct final answer. A model must also confirm correct work when a student doubts it, and identify errors in flawed work. Existing benchmarks evaluate LLMs primarily on final-answer accuracy, so it is unclear whether models that can solve mechanics problems also have the other technical capabilities that tutoring depends on. Here we introduce TrussTutor-Bench, a benchmark of 200 verified two-dimensional truss problems paired with automatically generated student solutions, and use it to evaluate thirteen LLMs on solution accuracy, sycophancy, and error detection. Baseline accuracy ranged from 64.5% to 97.0%. Every model detected nearly all injected errors in synthetic flawed student work (90.4% to 100%), so error detection did not distinguish models under these clean conditions. Sycophancy did. When a student insisted that correct work was wrong, models rejected correct solutions to problems they had themselves solved in 1.6% to 50.0% of cases. These results show that performance varies widely across models: the leading models solve, check, and defend student work nearly perfectly, while others are far less reliable, particularly when a student doubts correct work. TrussTutor-Bench provides a verified, extensible standard for determining which models are technically reliable enough to put in front of students. Follow-up work must now focus on teaching rather than technical capability, drawing on learning science to determine whether LLM help leads students to understand the material or simply to reach the right answer.

</details>


<div id='astro-ph.CO'></div>

# astro-ph.CO [[Back]](#toc)

### [1646] [OCCAMS: A Multi-Task Learning-Based Investigation of the CMB Power Spectra](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40415v1)
*Ankit Mandal,Rahul Shah,Md. Wali Hossain,Somasri Sen,Anjan A Sen,Supratik Pal*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 该文用变分自编码器（无宇宙学模型先验）拟合CMB温度与偏振功率谱，发现约需6个潜变量即可拟合，且与标准宇宙学自由参数数目相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在完全不引入宇宙学模型的前提下，需要多少潜变量才能拟合CMB功率谱（TT、TE、EE），以及这些潜变量在多大程度上对应标准宇宙学参数，从而检验能否得到紧凑的数据驱动参数化。

Method: 采用多任务学习与变分自编码器，在CLASS生成的2≤ℓ≤2500谱上训练；潜变量数L取5、6、7；用χ̂²、AIC、BIC及贝叶斯证据与Planck 2018数据比较拟合；训练后用归一化互信息衡量潜变量与宇宙学参数的对应关系；损失权重由不确定性加权在一次训练中确定，解耦项权重分别取固定（半自动SA）与可学习（完全自动CA）；重建损失按多极矩区间分三种配置切分，以区分温度与偏振、低ℓ与高ℓ的作用。

Result: 在六种配置—策略组合中的四种，拟合从L=5到L=6改善而不再继续提升；L=6在六种情况中有五种为最佳或接近最佳。SA解耦更清晰，CA无需先验设定解耦权重且在L=5、6时证据更高，二者构成可解释性与数据拟合之间的权衡。τ与A_s对应潜变量在任何模型中几乎不共享信息，与标准分析中大尺度偏振可分离二者的结论一致。

Conclusion: 所需潜变量数约为6，与标准模型依赖方法的自由参数数目相当；深度学习可给出CMB谱的紧凑、数据驱动参数化，且SA与CA策略各有优劣。

Abstract: How many latent variables are needed to fit the cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature and polarisation power spectra when a neural network is given no cosmological model, and to what extent do they map onto the standard cosmological parameters? We use multi-task learning with variational autoencoders trained on CLASS-generated spectra (TT, TE, EE) over $2\le\ell\le2500$. No cosmological model is built into the network, and the number of latent variables, $L$, is varied over $L=5$, $6$ and $7$. Their fits are compared to the Planck 2018 data using $\hatχ^2$, AIC, BIC and Bayesian evidence. Their correspondence with cosmological parameters is measured with normalised mutual information post-training. The loss weights are set within a single training run by uncertainty weighting, with the weight of the disentanglement term either fixed (semi-automated, SA) or learned (completely automated, CA). The reconstruction loss is split over multipole ranges in three configurations that separate the roles of temperature and polarisation and of the low- and high-$\ell$ ranges. In four of the six combinations of configuration and strategy, the fit improves from $L=5$ to $L=6$ and not beyond, and $L=6$ is the best, or close to the best, in five of the six cases. So, six latent variables are needed, as many as the free parameters of the standard, model-dependent approach. SA gives clearer disentanglement, while CA needs no a priori choice of the disentanglement weight and has the higher evidence at $L=5$ and $6$: the two strategies are points on a trade-off between interpretability and fit to the data. Notably, the latent variables for $τ$ and $A_s$ share almost no information in any model, consistent with large-scale polarisation separating the two, as in standard analyses. A deep-learning approach can thus give a compact, data-driven parametrisation of the CMB spectra.

</details>


<div id='cond-mat.stat-mech'></div>

# cond-mat.stat-mech [[Back]](#toc)

### [1647] [Diffusion models for the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39568v1)
*Daniel Schubring*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该工作将基于分数的扩散模型应用于二维经典Heisenberg模型（O(3)非线性sigma模型的格点表示），通过三个不同粗粒化层次训练神经网络实现多尺度采样，并引入Stein（Schwinger-Dyson）诊断评估学习到的分数函数质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在最细格点上直接采样存在精度与计算成本问题；同时需要一种不依赖逆向扩散采样的分数函数质量评估手段，并解决在S²流形上实现扩散模型的技术难题。

Method: 在二维经典Heisenberg模型的三种粗粒化训练集上分别训练基于分数的扩散模型，构建多尺度采样方案；引入两点关联函数的Stein（Schwinger-Dyson）诊断，并将其作为额外损失项融入训练；探讨将网络输入提升至S³（类似CP¹表示）以及构造球面热核的边界层近似以扩展其在大扩散时间下的适用性。

Result: 多尺度采样方案相较在最细格点上的直接采样，在精度和计算成本上均有适度改进；Stein诊断可在不依赖逆向扩散采样的前提下评估学习分数的质量，作为训练损失时亦有助益。

Conclusion: 扩散模型可有效用于格点场论中O(3)/Heisenberg模型的采样，多尺度策略与基于Schwinger-Dyson恒等式的诊断是提升精度与效率的可行途径，相关S²实现技术（S³提升、边界层近似）值得进一步研究。

Abstract: A score-based diffusion model is trained on the two-dimensional classical Heisenberg model, the lattice representation of the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model. Neural networks are trained on three different coarse-grainings of the same training set to implement a multiscale sampling scheme that modestly improves both the accuracy and computational cost of direct sampling on the finest lattice. Stein (or Schwinger-Dyson) diagnostics for the two-point correlation function are introduced to assess the quality of the learned score without relying on reverse diffusion sampling. These diagnostics are also incorporated into an additional training loss. We discuss several technical considerations relevant to implementing diffusion models on $S^2$. These include a consideration of lifting the network input to $S^3$, as in the $CP^1$ representation, and developing a boundary-layer approximation to the short-time spherical heat kernel that extends its usefulness to larger diffusion times.

</details>


### [1648] [Finite-step statistical mechanics of scale-invariant learning: spectral equations of state and curvature transport](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38012v1)
*Alexander Itin*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该文研究带记忆的离散随机梯度动力学中，哪些"热力学式"关系源于尺度对称性而非平衡态，并提出量化非理想涨落的诊断量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理想气体式描述仅在严格噪声假设下成立，而神经网络梯度噪声偏离这些假设；需要区分由尺度对称性导出的关系与真正的平衡态假设。

Method: 轨迹的精确重标度分析；局部谐振近似下的谱状态方程与维里系数；提出精确的曲率-输运恒等式与有限步损失平衡，将谐振涨落关系修正分解为曲率变化、有限步余项、梯度-记忆关联与有限窗漂移项；位移加权曲率变化作为时间箭头诊断；并计算高斯输入下整流师生网络的激活边界曲率贡献。

Result: 熵标度关系可由重标度精确解释而无需平衡假设；自调整权重范数给出以曲率谱矩为维里系数的谱状态方程；耦合参数组可维持稳态概率流；位移加权曲率变化的均值与二阶矩给出前向/反向状态对相对熵的下界。

Conclusion: 在球模型、师生网络及CIFAR-10/100卷积网络上验证了输运描述，并明确了谐振与三次余项近似的适用边界；结果将对称性关系与平衡假设分离，为学习动力学中的非理想涨落提供定量诊断。

Abstract: Stationary learning admits an ideal-gas description under restrictive noise assumptions. In neural networks whose gradient noise departs from these assumptions, however, an entropy-scaling relation resembling a Maxwell relation remains approximately valid. We ask which thermodynamic-looking relations follow from scale symmetry rather than equilibrium, and how departures from the ideal-gas description can be quantified, for discrete stochastic gradient dynamics with memory. An exact rescaling of trajectories explains the entropy relation without assuming thermal equilibrium. Within a local harmonic approximation, self-adjusting weight norms yield a spectral equation of state whose virial coefficients are set by moments of the curvature spectrum, and coupled parameter groups can sustain stationary probability currents. Our central result beyond this approximation is an exact curvature-transport identity. Together with a finite-step loss balance, it decomposes corrections to the harmonic fluctuation relation into measurable curvature changes, finite-step remainders, gradient-memory correlations and finite-window drift terms. A related displacement-weighted curvature change provides a diagnostic of the arrow of time; its mean and second moment give a lower bound on the relative entropy between forward and reversed state pairs. We also calculate the activation-boundary contribution to curvature for rectified teacher-student networks with Gaussian inputs. Tests in sphere models, teacher-student networks and convolutional networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 support the transport description and identify limits of the harmonic and cubic-remainder approximations. These results separate symmetry-based relations from equilibrium assumptions and provide quantitative diagnostics of nonideal fluctuations in learning dynamics.

</details>
