### [1649] [Neuronal Identity as an Organizational Basis for Analyzing Neural Population Dynamics](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36745v1)
*Seungjae Han,Joshua Yedam You,Soi Kim,Minho Eom,Jinho Park,Seunghee Park,Byeongwook Lee,Young-Gyu Yoon*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 论文提出以神经元的多模态生物学特征（分子、形态、电生理）为依据，将神经元路由到潜在分组，并以组级表示分析群体动力学，从而实现跨个体、跨会话的免重训迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元的分子、形态与电生理特性多样，决定了其在回路中的不同角色；这些特征在个体间高度共享，但在群体动力学分析中长期未被充分利用。作者认为这些共享的生物学画像可作为跨被试、跨记录会话关联神经动力学的共同参照。

Method: 构建一个框架：依据神经元的生物学画像将其分配到潜在群组，并把个体神经元映射为组级表示，在此表示上分析群体动力学。由于分组锚定于跨个体一致的生物学属性，学到的组织方式无需重新训练、也无需逐神经元对应即可迁移到未见动物。在斑马鱼幼体全脑钙成像与小鼠视觉皮层大规模电生理数据上评估，涵盖解码任务与流形分析。

Result: 在两个物种与两种记录模态上均取得最优表现：对行为与刺激标签的解码更优，同时在未见数据上更好地保持潜在轨迹的时间一致性与局部几何结构。消融显示，仅将生物特征作为辅助输入即可提升基线，而用其显式结构化群体组织的效果更强。

Conclusion: 以多模态生物学特征组织神经群体，是跨个体、跨记录会话泛化群体动力学的一种有前景的框架。

Abstract: Individual neurons exhibit diverse molecular, morphological, and electrophysiological properties that shape their distinct roles in neural circuits. While these multimodal features are largely shared across individuals, they remain an underutilized source of information in analyzing neural population dynamics. We posit that these shared biological profiles provide a common reference for relating neural dynamics across subjects and recording sessions. Our framework leverages this structure by routing neurons into latent groups based on their biological profiles and analyzing population dynamics through group-level representations. Because these assignments are anchored in biological properties that are consistent across subjects, the learned organization supports transfer to unseen animals without retraining or neuron-wise correspondence. We evaluate our framework on whole-brain calcium imaging in larval zebrafish and large-scale electrophysiology in the mouse visual cortex. Across both species and recording modalities, the framework delivers state-of-the-art performance in both neural decoding and manifold analysis: it achieves superior decoding of behavior and stimulus labels while better preserving the temporal consistency and local geometric structure of latent trajectories on unseen data. Our experiments demonstrate that not only does providing biological features improve baseline performance, but our proposed framework achieves even stronger results by using these properties to explicitly structure the population rather than treating them as auxiliary inputs. Together, these results suggest that organizing neural populations by their multimodal biological features offers a promising framework for generalizing population dynamics across subjects and recording sessions.

</details>


### [1650] [On the stability of learning](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35856v1)
*John J. Vastola*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 当梯度信息含噪且仅间歇可用时，即使平均学习动态收敛到正确的最优点，学习也可能不稳定，且学习方差可能渐近无穷；本文给出学习稳定性的显式条件，强调无偏信用分配不足以保障可靠学习，还需要足够频繁且信息充分的反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往学习算法分析通常假设信息充分的梯度连续可用，但生物神经网络中的学习信号往往稀疏、局部且仅间歇地在突触处可用，因此需要研究梯度间歇可用且含噪条件下的学习稳定性问题。

Method: 在若干可解析处理的设定中分析该问题，包括单层与多层线性网络，推导学习稳定的显式条件，并与随机梯度下降稳定性相关的既有条件进行概念上的区分与比较。

Result: 发现即使平均学习动态收敛到正确最优点，学习方差也可能渐近无穷，即学习不稳定；并给出在单层与多层线性网络中学习稳定的显式解析条件，指出这些条件与SGD稳定性条件互补但在概念上不同。

Conclusion: 无偏的信用分配不足以实现可靠学习，还需足够频繁且信息充分的反馈，这为生物可行学习模型增加了额外约束。

Abstract: Learning algorithms are usually analyzed under the assumption that informative gradients are continuously available. But this is not always true---learning signals in biological neural networks, for example, may be sparse, local, and only intermittently available at any given synapse. In this work, we show that if gradient information is noisy and only intermittently available, learning may be unstable. In particular, even if average learning dynamics converge to the correct optimum, variance in learning may be asymptotically infinite. We explore this point in a number of analytically tractable settings, including single-layer and multi-layer linear networks, and derive explicit conditions under which learning is stable. These conditions complement, but are conceptually distinct from, existing conditions related to the stability of stochastic gradient descent. Our work demonstrates that unbiased credit assignment is not enough for reliable learning; sufficiently frequent and informative feedback is also required, which yields an additional constraint on models of biologically plausible learning.

</details>


### [1651] [Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34638v1)
*Declan Kutscher,Reece Keller,Alyn Kirsch,Felix Pei,Aran Nayebi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究将果蝇全脑记录与神经力学数字孪生结合，测试20种内在动机算法能否复现果蝇自主探索行为及其对未来决策的神经表征；发现分层胜任力算法DIAYN在行为与神经预测编码两方面最接近果蝇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物能在无外部感觉线索和外源性目标的情况下，依靠内在动机实现高度自主行为，但其计算机制尚不清楚。作者希望检验"优化内在目标"能否产生在行为统计量与内部表征上定量匹配真实动物的具身智能体，从而为逆向解析动物自主性提供框架。

Method: （1）果蝇全脑记录，揭示自发探索决策的神经表征可提前10秒以上预测；（2）构建神经力学数字孪生，在模拟果蝇实验的虚拟系留球范式（virtual tethered-ball assay）中训练智能体；（3）采用分层策略，从离散的低级运动基元库中选择动作，契合"行为音节"的习性学理论；（4）不使用外部奖励，比较20种内在动机算法，涵盖好奇心、熵与胜任力三类方法；（5）评估指标包括自发运动统计量、内部表征，并像果蝇一样从运动学与神经活动中解码未来转向方向（相同时间尺度）。

Result: DIAYN——一种最大化行为熵与诱导感觉观测可分性的分层胜任力算法——在行为与神经前瞻编码的联合表现上最接近果蝇；其学习到的策略能捕捉个体间探索策略差异，提示个体多样性在群体层面服务于状态空间覆盖最大化；DIAYN的潜在活动还很好地复现了生物果蝇中运动学的半球间"和-差"编码规则。

Conclusion: 分层、内在动机驱动的智能体可作为逆向工程动物自主性的有力框架，说明内在目标优化足以生成与真实果蝇行为和神经表征定量一致的具身智能体（尤其是基于行为熵与观测可分性的胜任力目标）。

Abstract: Animals have a remarkable capacity for autonomy---driven by intrinsic motivation---without external sensory cues or extrinsic objectives, yet the computational mechanisms behind this ability largely remain a mystery. We combine whole-brain recordings in the fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster), which reveal neural representations of spontaneous exploratory decisions more than 10 seconds in advance, with a neuromechanical digital twin to test whether optimizing intrinsic goals yields realistically embodied artificial agents that quantitatively match fly behavior and internal representations of future volitional action during exploration. Our hierarchical policy selects from a discrete library of low-level motor primitives, consistent with ethological theories of behavioral syllables. We train agents without external reward using 20 intrinsic motivation algorithms spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency methods. The agents are evaluated in a virtual tethered-ball assay modeled on the fly experiment, comparing spontaneous locomotor statistics and internal representations and decoding future turn direction from kinematics and neural activity on the same timescales observed in flies. DIAYN, a hierarchical competency algorithm learning discrete policies that maximize behavioral entropy and the separability of induced sensory observations, achieves the strongest joint behavioral and neural prospective coding performance relative to flies. Its learned policies closely capture individual variability in fly exploration strategies, suggesting that this diversity serves to maximize state-space coverage at the population level. DIAYN's latent activity also closely captures the sum-difference rule for interhemispheric encoding of kinematics in biological flies. These results establish hierarchical, intrinsically motivated agents as a powerful framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [1652] [Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38977v1)
*Prashank Kadam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对628篇原始研究的系统综述与一次受控重评估表明，多数"提升代码质量"的技术只在自己针对的维度上有证据，且在等算力预算下难以胜过best-of-n采样基线；结论是收益必须对照预算匹配的采样基线、并在与技术自身信号无关的指标上报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在功能正确性基准上表现优异，但通过测试并不能说明代码可读、高效或安全。大量技术声称能改善这些质量属性，然而证据分散、通常只覆盖单一质量维度，且很少在等算力预算下进行比较，因此需要系统梳理并做受控重评估。

Method: (1) 系统文献综述：覆盖2021年7月至2026年10月的628篇原始研究，按阶段、信号来源与质量目标对技术分类，并公开声明由作者审核的LLM辅助。(2) 受控重评估：在匹配算力预算下，对4个模型运行10种技术，评测正确性、可维护性、效率与安全性四类基准；扩展至13个当前模型及仓库级任务；并在Gemma 4 31B上对66种重点技术做正面对比。

Result: 综述发现：多数研究只测自身目标维度，收益常伴随正确性不变或未报告，单一自动化质量信号易被"刷分"，算力、方差与数据污染鲜有报告。重评估发现：单次调用下质量提示会提高分析器问题计数，而复杂度与评判分数几乎不变；等预算下，带分析器加权排序器的best-of-n在排序器未优化的指标上追平或超过提示、规划、自精炼、审稿agent与检索；分析器反馈循环与微调仅在分析器问题计数上占优。HumanEval+（可能受污染且接近饱和的基准）上出现的大幅正确性下降，未在模型训练截止后举办的竞赛题上重现。正面对比中，66种技术仅有1种在其主要目标上以超出95%区间的方式胜过best-of-n，该比例与随机一致。

Conclusion: 现有"提升代码质量"技术的证据普遍薄弱且易被单一信号刷分。作者建议：任何收益都应报告于预算匹配的采样基线之上，并在与该技术自身信号无关的指标上验证，才能构成可信的质量提升证据。

Abstract: Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.

</details>


### [1653] [The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38628v1)
*Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi,Oliver Weissl,Johannes Betz,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对自动驾驶系统（ADS）仿真测试中"现实差距"（reality gap）研究进行了系统性映射：从4,195篇文献中筛选出235篇原始研究，刻画其目标、对象、方法、实验设置与评估证据，并区分"用于构建方法的真实世界信息"与"用于评估其主张的证据"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真对ADS测试至关重要，但仿真与现实的差异可能削弱测试结论的可信度。文献中究竟讨论了哪些差异、以及有何证据支持"仿真与现实相符"的主张，尚不清晰，缺乏系统性梳理。

Method: 采用系统性映射（systematic mapping）方法，从4,195篇文献中筛选235篇测量或缓解reality gap的原始研究；按目标、对象、方法、实验设置、评估证据进行分类；在六个ADS测试组件上区分仿真执行与真实世界执行，并对每种方法及其评估参照分别处理，从而把"构建方法所用的真实信息"与"评估其主张所用的证据"区分开来。

Result: 76%的研究聚焦于差距缓解，主要针对场景与交通参与者真实性和感知；94%报告了验证或测量流程。仅61项研究报告了覆盖多个指标族（传感器/感知一致性、ADS行为、车辆动力学、安全结果）的度量，且这种覆盖不足以建立差异与测试判定之间的因果联系。

Conclusion: 真实世界内容与物理执行须结合所评估的具体主张来解读；研究呼吁开展面向具体主张（claim-specific）的评估与组件级报告，以厘清哪些差异会影响测试结论，以及仿真证据何时能支持关于真实世界ADS行为的结论。

Abstract: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.

</details>


### [1654] [Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38214v1)
*Aditya Golatkar,Alessandro Achille,Renos Zabounidis,Vlad Sobal,Yangruibo Ding,Baishakhi Ray,Jonathan Buck,Guy Van den Broeck,Maryam Fazel,Pietro Perona,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 Skeleton Coding：让开发者以类代码的高层格式显式指定程序结构（数据类型、模块、函数的分解），与行为规格（测试、输入-输出示例）共同约束编码智能体，从而以指数级更少的测试将智能体引导至开发者意图的程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体通常只接收端到端行为规格（测试、输入-输出示例），但"需要多少、哪些规格"无法先验确定：规格的充分性取决于实现结构，而结构由智能体自行决定。同一组测试对某种结构充分，对另一种结构可能严重欠定，需要不同边界用例甚至指数级更多样例；且开发者难以从成千上万行生成代码中反推结构以判断规格是否完备。

Method: 提出 Skeleton Coding：开发者用高层、类代码的格式同时指定结构（骨架）与行为规格。理论层面将 AI 辅助编码建模为控制问题，分析骨架对所需测试数量的影响；实证层面在 4 个模型、3 个基准上，将最佳骨架规格与最佳端到端行为规格对比，并与"智能体可查询完整参考实现"的设置对照，同时度量大小模型差距、实现成本与代码侵蚀。

Result: 理论表明骨架可使开发者需提供的测试数量呈指数级减少。实证中，最佳骨架规格相较最佳端到端行为规格将平均测试错误降低 48.4%；即便智能体可查询完整参考实现，加入骨架仍使平均测试错误相对降低至多 27.0%。骨架还将大小模型间平均差距缩小约 52.4%，实现成本降低 15–26 倍，平均减少代码侵蚀 24.7%。

Conclusion: 结构规格是行为规格之外不可或缺的约束维度：显式指定骨架能显著提升规格的效率与完备性，缩小模型能力差距、降低实现成本并抑制代码侵蚀，因而开发者应联合指定结构与行为，而非仅提供端到端测试。

Abstract: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

</details>


### [1655] [Benchmarking Coding Agents under Evolving Requirements](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35488v2)
*Jia Feng,Alyssa Wu,Cuiyun Gao,Yunlong Wang,Songyuanyi Lu,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 FeatureLoop 基准，包含来自 34 个仓库、5 种主要编程语言、7 类软件形态的 61 个人工审核任务，通过"演化反馈"与"完成反馈"双重机制，在持久化工作区内追踪单一开发目标；累积可执行检查度量新行为、修复与旧功能保持。评估 12 个前沿模型，最强模型在两类反馈下完成 72.1% 任务，但失败阶段中仅 15.4% 能在两轮纠错修订内恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体评测以最终正确性为唯一指标，无法刻画"用户试用后反复提出请求、补充或澄清需求"这一真实开发过程中所需的持续引导能力，因而掩盖了可靠、低人工干预开发的真实障碍。

Method: 构建 FeatureLoop 基准：61 个任务、34 个仓库、5 种编程语言、7 类软件形态，均经人工审核；每个任务在持久化工作区中围绕单一开发目标推进，注入演化反馈（新增或澄清需求）与完成反馈（报告已声明需求的失败）；采用累积可执行检查分别追踪新行为实现、缺陷修复与既有功能保持；对 12 个前沿模型进行评测，并分析反馈利用方式与 token 效率。

Result: 最强模型在同时具备两类反馈时完成 72.1% 的任务；跨模型统计，观测到的失败阶段中仅 15.4% 能在两轮纠错修订内恢复；进一步分析暴露不完整修复、功能回归以及模型间在反馈使用模式和 token 效率上的显著差异。

Conclusion: 以最终正确性为唯一度量的评测高估了编码智能体的实际能力；当前模型在多轮反馈驱动的迭代开发中恢复能力薄弱，存在修复不彻底与回归问题，距离可靠、低人工干预的软件开发仍有明显差距，FeatureLoop 为度量这一差距提供了细粒度基准。

Abstract: Software development with coding agents often begins with a rough request that users refine after trying the implementation. Final correctness alone does not capture the repeated guidance this process requires. We introduce FeatureLoop, a benchmark of 61 human-reviewed tasks from 34 repositories across five primary programming languages and seven software forms. Each task follows one development goal in a persistent workspace through evolution feedback, which adds or clarifies requirements, and completion feedback, which reports failures of stated requirements. Cumulative executable checks track new behavior, repair, and preservation of earlier functionality. We evaluate 12 frontier models and find that the strongest completes 72.1% of tasks with both feedback types. Across models, however, only 15.4% of observed failed stages recover within two corrective revisions. Further analysis reveals incomplete repairs, regressions, and model-specific differences in feedback use and token efficiency, identifying obstacles to reliable, low-intervention development.

</details>


### [1656] [PROBE: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35987v1)
*Marco Paina,Mark Niklas Müller,Niels Mündler-Sasahara,Martin Vechev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出PROBE基准：覆盖20个GitHub仓库18个月内修复的全部2,457个bug，并给出候选发现与参考集的匹配方法；评测显示前沿编码代理召回率<21%、精确率<9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动发现bug是重要软件工程问题，编码代理已广泛部署但能力缺乏研究；尤其是"在整个仓库中找出人工维护者会修复的全部bug"这一挑战性任务尚未被研究，缺乏评测基准。

Method: 构建PROBE基准：收集20个多样化GitHub仓库18个月内修复的全部2,457个bug作为（部分）参考集，并设计将候选发现与参考集匹配的方法；在多个前沿模型上评测编码代理，并辅以LLM与人工评估者判定发现的有效性，同时比较代理发现bug与维护者修复bug的分布差异。

Result: 所有代理对参考集的召回率低于21%、精确率低于9%；更强模型将召回率从8%提升到17%，但不提升精确率；尽管精确率低，LLM与人工评估者仍判定85%的发现是有效的；代理发现的bug分布在代理之间相似，但与维护者修复的bug分布差异显著。

Conclusion: bug发现的实用价值高而前沿模型召回率低，PROBE可作为模型使用者与开发者的宝贵资源；同时提示精确率指标与人工有效性判断存在错位，代理的发现偏好与维护者关注点不一致。

Abstract: Proactive bug discovery is an important software-engineering problem. Even though coding agents are already widely deployed in this domain, their capabilities remain understudied. In particular, the challenging task of finding all bugs that human maintainers would repair across an entire repository has not been studied yet. To close this gap, we introduce PROBE, a benchmark consisting of all 2,457 bugs fixed over the course of 18 months across 20 diverse GitHub repositories, together with a method for matching candidate findings to this partial reference set. We evaluate coding agents across frontier models and find they all achieve a recall of below $21\%$ and a precision of less than $9\%$ with respect to the reference set. While stronger models increase recall substantially from $8\%$ to $17\%$, they do not improve precision. Surprisingly, despite the low precision, LLM and human evaluators still judge $85\%$ of findings valid. Crucially, we find that found bug distributions are similar across agents but differ substantially from those of bugs fixed by maintainers. The practical relevance of bug discovery and the low recall of frontier models make this benchmark a valuable resource for both model users and developers.

</details>


### [1657] [UnityBench-Mini3D: Evaluating LLM Agents for 3D Game Development in Unity](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35980v1)
*Yijun Zhou,Minghao Shao,Ke Zhang,Renkai Yuan,Hongbo Yuan,Bin Hu,Bozhao Qian,Hongxia Shen,Yanhong Liu,Yuting Chen,Yuntao Shi,Zhongxuan Xu,Shuo Mao,Haijia Zhou,Zhendong Li,Tao Zhang,Chenggang Li,Yuxuan Wang,Zinan Zheng,Calvin Zhang,Jia Li,Heng Chang,Jie Feng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 UnityBench-Mini3D：77 个项目级 Unity 任务基准，按 7 类专家定义技能划分、3 个难度层级，配 1,178 条人工编写的隐藏里程碑测试，通过引擎内确定性评测提供部分得分与失败定位，无需 LLM 裁判；21 个模型 × 9 个编码框架上平均通过率仅 57.7%（易 80.9%、难 35.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏开发对编码智能体提出了通用软件工程之外的压力：正确性依赖引擎 API、序列化场景状态与运行时行为的交互，而非仅源码。现有基准多面向 Godot 等平台，且严重依赖 LLM 裁判或粗粒度任务级结果，缺乏可定位、可复现的细粒度诊断能力。

Method: 以技能维度（而非教程或游戏类型）组织 7 类专家定义技能，设 3 个难度层级；每个任务由完整 Unity 项目 + 自然语言需求构成；评测采用 1,178 条留出的人工撰写里程碑测试，覆盖场景结构、组件配置与运行时行为，在引擎内部执行，实现确定性、细粒度的部分给分与失败定位，避免主观裁判。

Result: 在 21 个模型与 9 个编码框架组合上，易任务平均通过率 80.9%，难任务降至 35.2%，整体仅 57.7%，显示基准能有效区分不同系统能力与难度层级。

Conclusion: UnityBench-Mini3D 提供了一个可复现、可诊断的测试床，能在不同难度层级上区分系统表现，弥补了游戏引擎场景下细粒度确定性评测的空白。

Abstract: Game development stresses coding agents in ways general software engineering does not: correctness depends on how engine APIs, serialized scene state, and runtime behavior interact, not on source code alone. Existing benchmarks mainly target platforms such as Godot and heavily rely on LLM judges or coarse task-level outcomes. We present UnityBench-Mini3D, a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks organized around seven expert-defined skill categories rather than tutorials or genres, with three difficulty tiers. Each task pairs a complete Unity project with natural-language requirements and is evaluated using 1,178 held-out, human-authored milestone tests covering scene structure, component configuration, and runtime behavior. This in-engine evaluation provides deterministic partial credit, localizes failures, and distinguishes partial implementations from complete solutions without relying on subjective judges. Across 21 models and 9 coding harnesses, the average pass rate reaches 80.9% on easy tasks but falls to 35.2% on hard tasks, with just 57.7% overall. UnityBench-Mini3D provides a reproducible, diagnostic testbed distinguishing systems across difficulty levels.

</details>


### [1658] [AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34890v1)
*Zhanwei Wu,Jianhao Su,Brian Zhang,ShengTing Huang,Weidong Feng,Gang Liu,Zhiguo Li,Wei Huang,Li Tan,Wanjun Li,Zejiong Teng,Changgeng Zhong,Guanping Wu,Han-Hsing Tu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出AIPC——一种面向PyTorch推理项目端侧NPU部署的Agent方法，将结构化Skills与工具链、运行时、profiling证据结合，覆盖模型适配、产物构建、目标机执行、精度修复与性能优化全流程，在Qualcomm QAIRT上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在专用加速器（尤其端侧NPU）上部署和优化PyTorch推理项目，远不止调用框架device API那么简单：项目需转换为硬件运行时产物并适配目标工具链与应用接口。模型格式、量化流程、算子支持与工具链接口的差异，会造成横跨PyTorch/ONNX模型、工具链、运行时与设备执行的多层问题。LLM Agent虽可调用工具解决此类问题，但易因领域知识不足、配置与修复空间巨大、路径选择不佳而"漂移"。

Method: AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion）：将结构化Skills与工具链、运行时及profiling证据相结合，驱动跨层诊断与修复；把模型适配、产物构建、目标机执行、精度修复、性能优化组织为统一的部署流程。实验在Qualcomm QAIRT的端侧NPU路径上进行，覆盖视觉、语音、LLM与扩散模型；并考察Qwen3.8-27B作为本地可部署模型驱动Agent工作流的可行性。

Result: 两个优化案例中，Whisper-Small的Skill组6/7次运行满足预设精度与时延标准，对照组为0/6；YOLO-Worldv2端到端加速比达2.791x，对照组为1.599x。在预先固定部署契约、Skill、工具权限与检查条件的设定下，部分运行实现零人工干预（0-HITL）。

Conclusion: 结构化Skills结合工具链/运行时/profiling证据能有效缓解Agent在跨层部署中的漂移问题，显著提升端侧NPU部署的成功率与优化收益，并具备在固定契约下实现全自动（0-HITL）部署的潜力。

Abstract: Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection.
  We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT across vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, 6/7 Skill-arm Whisper-Small runs meet predefined accuracy and latency criteria versus 0/6 control runs, while YOLO-Worldv2 achieves a 2.791x end-to-end speedup versus 1.599x for the control. Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieve zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also examine Qwen3.8-27B as a locally deployable model for driving an Agent workflow.

</details>


### [1659] [From GPU to TPU with Coding Agents: What Works, What Fails, and What It Costs?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34422v1)
*Hui Sun,Anderson Uchôa,Wesley K. G. Assunção*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文构建148个PyTorch研究项目数据集，用Claude Code将其中10个从NVIDIA GPU迁移到Google Cloud TPU，并独立评估迁移的可信性与成本。结果显示8个项目满足目标，但执行尝试失败率达76%，近半数失败无报错，成本与性能表现差异巨大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算力成本上升、加速器容量有限以及供应商依赖，推动组织寻找GPU之外的替代方案。核心问题在于：编码智能体生成的TPU迁移是否可信、代价如何——因为智能体可能报告迁移成功，却悄然改变了模型的训练行为。

Method: 构建包含148个PyTorch机器学习研究项目的数据集，选取其中10个项目，使用Claude Code将其从NVIDIA GPU迁移至Google Cloud TPU。随后独立评估每个迁移是否可运行、是否保持数值行为、是否在目标硬件上执行、是否维持项目目标、性能是否可接受；同时分析失败案例、人工投入与成本。

Result: 8个项目达到项目目标判据，平均需2.4次人工介入。70次执行尝试中53次失败（76%），其中26次（49%）未抛出任何错误。最常见原因是重复编译及其他执行低效；与第三方库的交互会静默改变计算——某四芯片迁移中智能体报告成功，但梯度裁剪被改变，准确率从86.53%降至84.89%。成本差异显著：某工作负载中TorchTPU比GPU训练快1.86倍，单次运行成本低25%。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，编码智能体的自动化迁移存在显著的静默失效风险。建议实践者采用独立参考运行、在目标硬件配置下进行验证，并制定兼顾计算成本与人力成本的工作负载特定验收与停止准则。

Abstract: A coding agent can migrate a machine learning workload, report success, and still change how the model trains. Rising compute costs, limited accelerator capacity, and vendor dependence are pushing organizations toward alternatives to graphics processing units (GPUs); a key question is whether agent-generated migrations to tensor processing units (TPUs) can be trusted and at what cost. We build a dataset of 148 PyTorch ML research projects and use Claude Code to migrate ten of them from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs. We independently assess whether each migration runs, preserves numerical behavior, executes on the intended hardware, maintains the project's goal, and delivers acceptable performance. We also examine failures, human effort, and costs. Eight projects meet our project-goal criterion, and migrations require 2.4 human interventions on average. Of 70 execution attempts, 53 fail (76%), and 26 of these failures (49%) raise no error. The most frequent cause is repeated compilation and other execution inefficiencies, while interactions with third-party libraries can silently change the computation: in one four-chip migration, the agent reports success despite a change in gradient clipping that reduces accuracy from 86.53% to 84.89%. Execution costs vary widely: in one workload, TorchTPU, a PyTorch execution backend for TPUs, trains 1.86 times faster and 25% cheaper per run than the GPU. For practitioners, these findings motivate independent reference runs, verification under the intended hardware configuration, and workload-specific acceptance and stopping criteria that account for both computational and human costs.

</details>


### [1660] [EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34358v1)
*Yuhao Tian,Tao Li,Ling Zhou,Dave Towey,Zhaoxin Fan,Wenjun Wu,Rubing Huang,Tsong Yueh Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 EAST（Embodied AI Safety Testing），一个数字孪生框架，将文献支持的安全证据转化为覆盖感知、指令、环境、动作与时间的故障注入测试，以弥补"任务成功"无法衡量具身智能安全性的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务成功不能充分衡量具身AI的安全性，机器人可能在违反安全要求的情况下完成目标；现有评测偏重性能与鲁棒性，缺乏从已记录的安全危害到可执行、可验证测试的系统化路径。

Method: EAST 构建了专家审核的安全故障分类法与八个可执行算子，并附带适用性与有效性约束；采用三阶段工作流：生成测试规范、在仿真执行中验证故障是否真实发生、基于仿真器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规、任务结果与行为特征；同时保留执行轨迹与可回放记录以支持归因与可复现性。在六个 RoboTwin 操作任务与 ACT、RDT 两种策略架构上，与替代测试策略在同等预算下对比。

Result: 五组对比实验中，EAST 覆盖全部 74 个可允许的任务-策略-算子组合，其中 63 个获得有效证据；安全挑战暴露率接近 Random-Legal 与 Rule-Based；此外 82 次有效 EAST 执行在发生安全违规的同时仍完成任务，揭示了以成功为导向的评测所掩盖的风险。

Conclusion: 研究支持超越任务完成指标，开展系统化、有效性感知且可复现的具身AI安全测试。

Abstract: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. The framework preserves execution traces and replayable records, supporting attribution and reproducibility across experiments. We evaluate EAST on six RoboTwin manipulation tasks and two policy architectures, ACT and RDT, against alternative testing strategies under matched budgets. Across five comparative campaigns, EAST targets all 74 admissible task-policy-operator combinations and obtains valid evidence for 63, while achieving safety-challenge exposure rates close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based. Moreover, 82 valid EAST executions complete their tasks despite safety violations, revealing risks concealed by success-oriented evaluation. These findings support systematic, validity-aware, reproducible safety testing beyond task-completion metrics.

</details>


### [1661] [Bug Severity Classification with Fine-Tuned Open LLMs: A Paired Comparison with TF-IDF and CodeBERT Baselines on Eclipse Reports](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.34127v1)
*Asset Kanatov,Talgar Bayan,Askar Boranbayev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在Eclipse缺陷严重程度预测任务上，小型开源LLM（Llama 3 8B、Qwen 2.5 7B）经QLoRA微调后macro-F1约为0.49–0.53，与TF-IDF基线和微调CodeBERT无显著差异，且模型间差异主要体现在各类别的召回结构上，而非总体指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可本地运行的开放小型LLM被视为自动缺陷严重程度预测的候选方案，但缺少与廉价分类器在严格同等条件下的定量对比，尤其不清楚LLM相较TF-IDF与CodeBERT究竟带来多少增益。

Method: 从361,006条唯一Eclipse报告公开转储中抽取类别均衡的20,000条样本，统一在2,000条留出报告上评测11种配置：6个TF-IDF分类器、1个微调CodeBERT编码器、Llama 3 8B与Qwen 2.5 7B各做零样本与QLoRA微调；采用bootstrap置信区间与McNemar检验进行统计比较，并分析测试集与训练集重复数据的影响。

Result: 零样本LLM macro-F1为0.305/0.321，低于所有TF-IDF模型（0.430–0.489）；微调后分别达0.526与0.485，但因checkpoint、推理运行时与解码设置不同，该提升不能单独归因于微调。微调Llama 3与CodeBERT（0.518）无显著差异（差+0.007，95% CI −0.017~+0.032），微调Qwen 2.5低于CodeBERT。类别层面差异明显：微调Llama 3对Critical召回36%，Qwen 2.5对Critical召回69%但对Minor仅21%。去除8%与训练集重复的测试样本后，TF-IDF分数最多下降0.031，LLM几乎不变。

Conclusion: 在单任务设置下，小型微调LLM未能在总体macro-F1上超越更廉价的TF-IDF与CodeBERT基线，其价值更多体现在按类别的召回权衡上；作者公开切分标识、逐报告预测、分析脚本及本地部署工具CyberTriage以支持复现。

Abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) small enough to run on a laptop are an obvious candidate for automatic bug severity prediction. We measure what they add over cheaper classifiers on one task: assigning one of four Bugzilla severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Trivial) to Eclipse bug reports. From a public dump of 361,006 unique Eclipse reports we draw a class-balanced sample of 20,000 rows and compare eleven configurations of nine model types: six TF-IDF classifiers, a fine-tuned CodeBERT encoder, and Llama 3 8B and Qwen 2.5 7B, each run zero-shot and after QLoRA fine-tuning. All eleven are scored on the same 2,000 held-out reports, with bootstrap intervals and McNemar tests. The zero-shot runs reach macro-F1 0.305 and 0.321, below every TF-IDF model (0.430-0.489). The fine-tuned runs reach 0.526 and 0.485, but the zero-shot and fine-tuned setups also differ in checkpoint, serving runtime and decoding, so this gap cannot be credited to fine-tuning alone. Fine-tuned Llama 3 shows no detectable difference from CodeBERT (0.518; difference +0.007, 95% CI -0.017 to +0.032), and fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 is below it on macro-F1. The models differ more by class than in aggregate: fine-tuned Llama 3 finds 36% of Critical reports, Qwen 2.5 finds 69% but only 21% of Minor ones. The dump repeats 60,000 rows, and 8% of the test reports duplicate a training report; removing them lowers TF-IDF scores by up to 0.031 and leaves the LLMs almost unchanged. We release split identifiers, per-report predictions and the analysis script at https://github.com/tbayan/bug_finetuning_llm_artifacts, together with CyberTriage, a tool that serves the fine-tuned classifier locally.

</details>


### [1662] [How Do Small Coding Agents Use Code Graphs and Embeddings?](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33958v1)
*Saurav Bellam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，用小规模开放权重模型系统检验"代码智能体需要工具来补充仓库结构知识"这一前提，发现结构化工具（嵌入检索+代码图）相对纯 grep 的增益随模型规模呈倒 U 型（1.7–4B 峰值 17–21 点，32B 仅 4–5 点），且每多一跳正确定位几率乘 0.50–0.67，无任何工具组合能抹平该梯度；线性探针显示模型权重中仅存一跳、且偏词法的仓库图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有编码智能体普遍配备嵌入检索与代码图工具，其隐含假设是"模型缺乏仓库结构信息、工具负责供给"。但该前提缺乏在受控变量下的实证；同时不清楚工具收益是否随模型规模、任务图距离（hop depth）及检查点变化，也不清楚模型内部是否真的编码了仓库图结构。

Method: 1) 工具消融：在深度平衡的 160 任务子集与全部 500 任务上，对定位智能体做四档工具配置（仅 grep / +嵌入检索 / +图工具 / 全部），覆盖 10 个模型（Qwen3 0.6B–32B 六档×五种解码、一个 FP8 对照、Gemma 4 三档），共 79k episodes，并按已定义的确定性 hop depth 分层。2) 下游验证：用固定修复模型检验定位结果可解性。3) 机制分析：线性探针在"锚内、按度数分层"协议下检测直接调用边与二跳边，并与词法基线比较；结合 trace 分析工具使用形态。

Result: 结构化工具使 Qwen3-8B 与 Gemma 4 E4B 相对 grep-only 的准确率翻倍；增益在 1.7–4B 达峰（17–21 点），32B 降至 4–5 点（每参数翻倍优势比 0.77–0.82）。8B 以上约一半增益来自提交形式而非找到目标；14B→32B 的下降源于工具采用率下降而 grep-only 准确率持平；同一 4B 规模因检查点不同可获益也可不获益。每增加一跳，正确定位几率乘 0.50–0.67，任何工具集均未能平坦化该梯度；trace 显示图工具收益主要来自 hop 0 的名称查找与 hop 1 的一次扩展，智能体仅在 12–14% episodes 中链式扩展。固定修复模型从这些定位中解决 160 任务中的 6–13 个（oracle 26）。探针：直接调用边可解码（AUC 0.74；对话内 0.61–0.66），但低于词法基线（0.99），二跳边仅 0.57。

Conclusion: 小型智能体对仓库的"图景"本质上是一跳的、偏词法的，既体现在权重中也体现在工具使用中；工具的价值主要是补偿名称查找与单步扩展，而非提供多跳结构推理。因此，仓库结构工具的设计与评估应按 hop depth 与模型规模分层，且不能假定工具能替代模型的结构能力。作者公开了智能体、探针、日志与 trace。

Abstract: Coding agents are given embedding search and code-graph tools on the premise that a repository's structure is something the model lacks and the tool supplies. We test that premise on SWE-bench Verified with small open-weight models, stratifying tasks by a deterministic hop depth (the shortest code-graph path from code the issue mentions to code the gold patch changes) that a companion paper defines and validates. First, we ablate a localization agent's tool set (grep only; +embedding search; +graph tools; all) on a depth-balanced 160-task split and on all 500 tasks for ten models (six Qwen3 sizes from 0.6B to 32B with five decodings each, an FP8 control, three Gemma 4 sizes; 79k episodes). Structured tools double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B; their gain peaks at 17-21 points at 1.7-4B and falls to 4-5 points at 32B (odds ratio 0.77-0.82 per doubling of parameters). From 8B up, about half of that gain is the form of the submission rather than finding the target; the fall from 14B to 32B is a fall in tool uptake at equal grep-only accuracy; and the same 4B size gains or does not gain from a tool depending on the checkpoint. Each extra hop multiplies the odds of correct localization by 0.50-0.67 at every size, and no tool set flattens that gradient: traces show the graph tools' gain is name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1, and agents chain expansions in only 12-14% of episodes. A fixed repair model resolves 6-13 of 160 tasks from these localizations (oracle 26). Second, linear probes find direct call edges decodable under a within-anchor, degree-stratified protocol (AUC 0.74; 0.61-0.66 inside agent conversations), but below a lexical baseline (0.99), with two-hop edges at 0.57. Small agents carry a one-hop, largely lexical picture of their repository, in weights and in use. We release the agent, probes, logs and traces.

</details>


### [1663] [Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33949v1)
*Amit Verma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 schema 一致性失败的细粒度分类体系与确定性分类器，应用于 3,997 次生成尝试，揭示相同有效率可掩盖不同失败模式，并给出验证器、schema、重试与评测设计的工程实践建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流水线常用单一"有效率"概括结构化输出可靠性，掩盖了失败的具体原因以及哪些干预手段有效，因此需要细粒度的失败分类来诊断问题。

Method: 构建 schema 一致性失败的细粒度分类体系，并设计确定性分类器，依据模型响应与 Pydantic 校验错误自动分配失败类别；在 HotpotQA 与 FinanceBench 问题上，对 9 种 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型/API 配置的 3,997 次生成尝试进行分析，并做探索性 prompt 消融实验。

Result: 相似的有效率可能对应不同失败模式，主导失败类别随 schema 约束与任务而变。Markdown 围栏 JSON 是最常见失败：681 个围栏失败中仅 48.0% 去除围栏后通过校验，其余隐藏了额外违规（主要为字段长度违规）。抑制围栏的 prompt 变体看似把失败转向长度违规，但该变化与"原本已存在的违规被暴露"一致。

Conclusion: 单一有效率指标会掩盖失败构成的变化；论文据此提出四条工程实践（分别针对验证器、schema、重试与评测设计），其中三条有数据支持，关于重试反馈的一条仅为提议未验证，并公开分类器、生成结果与标注。

Abstract: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.

</details>

### [1664] [HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36361v1)
*Ahmad Abdel-Azim,Xihong Lin*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: HELICS是一个免定相的潜在流匹配框架，将染色体经卷积自编码器压缩为4096个连续潜变量token，在UK Biobank 41.7万基因组上训练transformer条件流匹配模型，实现全基因组SNP级条件合成基因型生成，保真度优于现有单倍型模拟器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体级基因型数据对遗传发现、疾病风险建模和药物研发至关重要，但许多关键场景数据受限：祖先人群代表性不足、罕见或不平衡疾病队列、受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成可支撑隐私保护的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但难点在于需学习数十万至上千万相关SNP上的超高维离散分布。

Method: HELICS（High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis）：免定相（phasing-free）的潜在流匹配框架。用卷积自编码器对染色体做token化，将>60万SNP压缩为4096个连续潜变量token；在拼接的多染色体潜表示上训练以条件流匹配参数化的transformer；以祖先信息和遗传易感性摘要为条件进行定向生成。

Result: 在UK Biobank逾41.7万基因组上训练，无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列；外部评估中与真实基因型的保真度强于现有基于单倍型的模拟器，等位基因频率一致性高，局部与长程SNP相关结构保持更优。扰动分析中提高条件疾病性状易感性，所诱导的SNP剂量变化与已发表关联权重高度相关。

Conclusion: HELICS为SNP级基因组数据提供了可扩展的生成建模框架，并为数据受限的遗传研究提供了构建条件合成队列的路径。

Abstract: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

</details>


### [1665] [Enhancing Clinical Classifier Robustness with Deep Representation Learning Based OOD Detection on DNA Methylation Data](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36344v1)
*Md Zahangir Alom,Quynh T. Tran,Breuer Alexandar,Brent A. Orr*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 提出端到端深度表示学习驱动的DNA甲基化阵列分布外（OOD）检测框架，用瓶颈层特征与谱差异判别IND/OOD样本，1D-SSA表现最佳，独立临床测试AUROC达0.976。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于DNA甲基化（DNAM）阵列的肿瘤分类是临床诊断工具，但基于固定参考队列训练的模型，对训练分布外的肿瘤类型会产生错误预测，需要质量控制机制识别OOD样本。

Method: 在公共肉瘤（SARC, GSE140686）与脑肿瘤（BT, GSE90496）队列上训练DNN分类器，从瓶颈层提取200维与500维嵌入特征；比较五种OOD方法（1D子空间分析1D-SSA、KNN、岭回归、马氏距离MD、距离平方和SSD），以谱差异区分IND与OOD样本；通过交叉验证、留出样本及独立临床数据集评估。

Result: 1D-SSA最有效。SARC-IND/BT-OOD下AUROC 0.975、TNR@95TPR 0.930；BT-IND/SARC-OOD下AUROC 0.9569、TNR@95TPR 0.8660；独立临床测试集平均AUROC 0.976、DE 0.032、FPR@95TPR 0.065、TNR@95TPR 0.935。

Conclusion: 深度表示学习型OOD检测可作为临床级甲基化肿瘤分类系统的实用质量控制层。

Abstract: DNA methylation (DNAM) array-based tumor classification is a powerful clinical diagnostic tool, but models trained on fixed reference cohorts can produce faulty predictions for tumor types not represented in the training distribution. We propose an end-to-end deep representation learning-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework for DNAm array data. Deep neural network (DNN) classifiers were trained on public sarcoma (SARC) (GSE140686) and brain tumor (BT) (GSE90496) cohorts, and feature vectors were extracted from bottleneck layers. Five OOD methods, including 1dimension (1D)-Subspace Analysis (1D-SSA), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Ridge Regression, Mahalanobis Distance (MD), and Sum of Squared Distances (SSD), were explored with 200 and 500-dimensional embeddings. Spectral discrepancy was used to discriminate in-distribution (IND) from OOD samples. Performance was measured via cross-validation, holdout samples, and an independent clinical dataset. 1D-SSA was the most effective approach. In the sarcoma-IND/brain tumor-OOD setting, the framework achieved an AUROC of 0.975 and True Negative Rate (TNR)@95TPR of 0.930, and an AUROC of 0.9569 and TNR@95TPR of 0.8660 for the brain tumor-IND/sarcoma-OOD setting. On the independent clinical test set, the method yielded a mean AUROC of 0.976, a DE of 0.032, an FPR@95TPR of 0.065, and a TNR@95TPR of 0.935. These results show deep representation-based OOD detection as a practical quality-control layer for clinical-grade methylation-based tumor classification systems.

</details>

# physics.flu-dyn [[Back]](#toc)

### [1666] [Generative AI in Turbulence: Foundations, Applications, Validations and Benchmarks](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35123v1)
*Luca Biferale,Michele Buzzicotti*

Main category: physics.flu-dyn

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场/综述性论文，主张生成式AI（扩散模型、score-based方法与概率输运框架）可处理观测不完整或自由度未解析的湍流问题，但湍流不同于常规图像生成，可视化真实度、逐点误差与低阶谱一致性均不足以衡量物理保真度，需以能级串、结构函数、异常标度、pdf尾部、相干结构、守恒律、时间一致性、集合多样性与泛化性等湍流本征性质作为验证标准，并呼吁建立开放数据、标准化挑战、隐藏测试、物理感知指标与失败案例记录相结合的基准生态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 湍流存在多尺度动力学、间歇性、极端事件、粗糙速度场与内禀随机输运，不完整观测或未解析自由度允许多个物理上合理的解，传统确定性方法难以刻画其不确定性；同时生成式AI在此类问题上有潜力，但社区间缺乏共同语言，且现有图像式评价指标无法判断物理真实性，因此需要架起AI与湍流两个社区的桥梁并重构验证范式。

Method: 综述与观点性梳理：聚焦扩散模型、score-based生成方法与相关概率输运（如流匹配/最优传输类）公式化描述，系统讨论其在无条件生成、概率重建、降阶建模、时间演化与无网格表示中的应用；同时从湍流物理出发，提出面向能量传输、结构函数与异常标度、pdf尾部、相干结构、守恒律、时间一致性、集合多样性与泛化的物理感知验证框架，并分析验证、基线、数据可得性与可复现性方面的局限。

Result: 论文并未给出新的数值实验或定量结果，而是给出分类性结论：生成式AI适用于随机闭合、超分辨、数据同化、不确定性量化及欧拉/拉格朗日流动集合生成等任务；并明确指出以视觉真实度、逐点误差和低阶谱一致性作为评价标准的不足，提出应以湍流本征统计与守恒性质作为评价核心，同时指出当前缺少统一的开放数据、标准化挑战、隐藏测试、物理感知指标与失败案例文档体系。

Conclusion: 生成式AI为湍流中的不确定性建模与多解采样提供了新的能力，但其价值必须在湍流物理意义上被验证，而非依赖图像生成式指标；未来需构建融合开放数据、标准化挑战与隐藏测试、物理感知度量及失败案例记录的基准生态，以推动AI与湍流社区的交叉协作与可复现研究。

Abstract: Generative AI offers new approaches to turbulence problems in which incomplete observations or unresolved d.o.f. admit multiple physically plausible solutions. Potential applications include stochastic closures, super-resolution, data assimilation, uncertainty quantification, and the generation of Eulerian and Lagrangian flow ensembles. However, turbulence is not a conventional image-generation problem. Its multiscale dynamics, intermittency, extreme events, rough velocity fields and intrinsically stochastic transport make visual realism, pointwise error, and low-order spectral agreement insufficient measures of physical fidelity. We examine where generative AI provide novel capabilities with emphasis on diffusion models, score-based methods, and related probability-transport formulations. We discuss their use in unconditional generation, probabilistic reconstruction, reduced-order modeling, temporal evolution, and mesh-free representations. We argue that validation must address turbulence properties: energy transfer, structure functions, anomalous scaling, pdf tails, coherent structures, conservation laws, temporal consistency, ensemble diversity and generalization. Finally, we discuss potential limitations in validation, baseline, data availability and reproducibility, and the need for a benchmark ecosystem combining open data, standardized challenges, hidden tests, physics-aware metrics, and documented failures. This paper serves as a bridge between two communities. For AI practitioners, we provide a fair and accessible introduction to turbulence, essential for appreciating the challenges posed by the field and for assessing the physical relevance of generative models. For turbulent practitioners, we provide an introduction to the key technological aspects of Generative AI, clarifying what these tools actually do, and where their potential and current limitations lie.

</details>


### [1667] [Neural Eigenfluid Bases: Spectral Objectives, Gauge, and Topology](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33925v1)
*Baiming Zhang,Shiying Xiong,Zhecheng Wang*

Main category: physics.flu-dyn

TL;DR: 提出神经特征流体基(NEB)：用可空间任意求值的神经网络表示基函数，通过微分提升与势边界条件直接保证不可压与不可穿透边界，结合几何局部正交化与Rayleigh最小化学习有序基，实现高精度、约千倍降维的连续流场重构与快速降阶模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统降阶模型依赖数值Laplacian特征基，离散定义、仅在网格点可用，且难以在同一框架内同时严格满足不可压性与障碍物不可穿透边界；同时势空间与速度空间学习目标之间的关系缺乏理论解释，需要一种可在任意空间位置求值、物理约束内生的基表示。

Method: 在Laplacian Eigenfluids基础上，以神经网络参数化基函数使其可在任意空间点求值；通过differential lifts与势边界条件（potential boundary conditions）直接施加不可压性和不可穿透边界；采用几何局部正交化（geometry-local orthogonalization）与Rayleigh最小化获得有序基；建立势空间与速度空间学习的联系并推导谱-方差关系（spectral-variance relation）；用gauge fixing减少势学习所需空间导数阶数；以Dirichlet能量损失学习障碍物周围独立环流场；预计算Galerkin算子以复用基。

Result: 1024模态下，两种目标在周期涡合并算例中速度误差均低于1%；障碍物绕流随机流场中，势基学习比同规模数值Laplacian基捕获更多初始能量且最终误差更低；降阶状态比全参考模型小约三个数量级（约千倍）；三维测试区分了空间重构误差与系数演化误差；同一基复用时，预计算Galerkin算子支持毫秒级更新。

Conclusion: NEB为连续流场重构与高效降阶模拟提供了物理约束内生的基表示，兼具精度、紧凑性与计算效率，可作为传统数值特征基的替代方案。

Abstract: Reduced-order models simplify fluid simulation by representing complex flows with a small number of spatial modes. Building on Laplacian Eigenfluids, we introduce Neural Eigenfluid Bases (NEB), a neural representation whose basis functions can be evaluated anywhere in space. We enforce incompressibility and impermeable boundaries directly through differential lifts and potential boundary conditions. Geometry-local orthogonalization and Rayleigh minimization then learn an ordered basis. We connect learning in potential and velocity spaces, and derive a spectral-variance relation explaining why these objectives weight approximate modes differently, even though their exact positive spectra agree. Gauge fixing reduces the number of spatial derivatives needed for potential learning, while a Dirichlet energy loss learns independent circulation fields around obstacles. With 1024 modes, both objectives keep velocity errors below 1% in periodic vortex merger. For random flows around obstacles, potential-based learning captures more initial energy and gives lower final errors than numerical Laplacian bases of the same size. The reduced state is about a thousand times smaller than the full reference model. Three-dimensional tests separate spatial reconstruction errors from errors in coefficient evolution. Precomputed Galerkin operators allow millisecond-scale updates when the same basis is reused across simulations. This provides a physically constrained basis for continuous flow reconstruction and efficient reduced-order simulation.

</details>
