# cs.LO [[Back]](#toc)

### [1702] [Learning Erasing Equal-Length Relational Pattern Languages in the Limit from Positive Data over Binary Alphabets](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39156v1)
*S. Mahmoud Mousawi,Sandra Zilles*

Main category: cs.LO

TL;DR: 在二进制字母表下，等长关系（equal-length）的擦除模式语言不可从正数据极限学习，从而解决了此前的公开问题；其不可学习性已在仅含三个极大变量子串的模式子类中出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系模式语言将Angluin模式语言中重复变量必须替换为相同串的要求放宽为满足给定关系。等长关系下，字母表规模≥3时该类已知可从正数据极限学习，而二进制情形是否为公开问题，本文旨在给出否定答案并厘清可学习性的边界。

Method: 采用形式语言学习的极限学习（identification in the limit from positive data）框架，通过构造性证明分析等长关系擦除模式语言的不可学习性；同时用极大变量子串（maximal substrings of variables）的数量对模式类进行细分，并给出相应的学习算法构造（含迭代学习器）。

Result: (1) 二进制字母表下，等长关系擦除模式语言不可从正数据极限学习；(2) 不可学习性在仅含三个极大变量子串的模式子类中即已成立；(3) 变量极大子串数不超过两个的模式在任意|Σ|≥2时可从正数据极限学习；(4) 若目标模式的极大变量子串至多一个，可用迭代学习器实现，仅依赖当前样例与前一假设更新。

Conclusion: 字母表大小与变量极大子串的结构复杂度共同决定等长关系擦除模式语言的可学习性，二者间存在明确分界；结果为该方向此前遗留的公开问题提供了完整刻画。

Abstract: Relational pattern languages generalize Angluin's pattern languages by requiring the strings substituted for repeated occurrences of a variable to stand in a given relation, rather than to be identical. We study erasing pattern languages under the equal-length relation, where all occurrences of a variable must be replaced by strings of the same length. Over alphabets with at least three letters, this class is known to be learnable in the limit from positive data. We show that over a binary alphabet it is not, which resolves an open question from earlier work. Our proof reveals that non-learnability already holds for the restricted subclass of languages generated by patterns that have exactly three maximal substrings of variables. We then show that patterns with at most two maximal substrings of variables are learnable in the limit from positive data for every alphabet of size at least two. If the target pattern is known to have at most one maximal substring of variables, this can even be achieved by an iterative learner, which updates its hypothesis using only the current example and its previous hypothesis.

</details>


### [1703] [Computing GR(1) Assume-Guarantee Contracts](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37534v1)
*Yigit Narter,Emily Zhao,Inigo Incer*

Main category: cs.LO

TL;DR: 该论文在GR(1) modulo theory框架下发展理论与算法，实现在组件接口上显式计算assume-guarantee契约的代数运算（如组合与商），核心是求解两个时序公式的量词消去问题，并在Pacti中实现、于紧急制动案例与合成族上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: assume-guarantee契约的代数运算可支撑复杂工程系统的组合式设计与分析，但此前仅在缺乏时间概念的逻辑上支持在组件接口处显式计算这些运算；本文旨在将这一能力扩展到含时序语义的GR(1) modulo theory。

Method: 核心难点是时序公式的两个量词消去问题。作者提出面向GR(1)-modulo公式的上下文辅助变量消去（context-aided variable elimination）过程，证明其可靠性（soundness），并在一个可容许公式类内刻画子问题意义下的最优解；进而用这些过程计算契约运算，包括组合与商。整体框架实现于Pacti工具中，以自动化组合推理GR(1)契约。

Result: 在自动紧急制动案例中计算了系统级契约，并揭示了组件规格交互所产生的兼容性条件；合成族实验表明，计算代价由被消去变量数与liveness合取项数主导，且与基于自动机的精确消去方法相比呈现互补的规模扩展特性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次为GR(1) modulo theory契约提供了可在接口层显式计算的代数运算及其可靠算法与实现，配以最优性刻画与复杂度经验规律，为含时序语义的组合式契约推理提供了可行且可与自动机方法互补的技术路线。

Abstract: Assume-guarantee contracts provide a set of algebraic operations that enable the efficient compositional design and analysis of complex engineering systems. The explicit computation of these operations at component interfaces is currently supported only for some logics lacking a notion of time. This paper develops theory and algorithms to compute these operations when the contracts are expressed in the GR(1) modulo theory. The key challenge is the computation of two quantifier elimination problems for temporal formulas. We develop context-aided variable elimination procedures on GR(1)-modulo formulas, establish their soundness, characterize subproblem-wise optimal solutions within an admissible class of formulas, and use the procedures to compute contract operations, including composition and quotient. We implement the resulting framework in Pacti, automating compositional reasoning over GR(1) contracts. Finally, we demonstrate the framework on an automated emergency-braking case study, where we compute system-level contracts and expose compatibility conditions arising from the interaction of component specifications. Experiments on synthetic families show that the cost is governed by the number of eliminated variables and liveness conjuncts, and a comparison with exact automata-based elimination shows complementary scaling.

</details>

### [1704] [On Worst-Case Guarantees for Graph-Based Nearest-Neighbor Search](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38133v1)
*Majid Daliri,Mohammadreza Daneshvaramoli,Purna Dutta,Edo Liberty,Cameron Musco,Christopher Musco,Torsten Suel*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 论文证明：任何基于贪婪搜索的标准图方法（平坦或分层图）在欧氏空间的近似最近邻搜索中无法达到亚线性查询时间，即使近似因子任意大；但若允许搜索图中加入 Steiner 点，则可获得与 LSH 相当的界，例如 c-ANN 查询时间为 Õ(n^{1/(c-1)})，并给出将 Steiner 点引入实用图方法的初步实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图方法（HNSW、DiskANN、NSG）经验性能优异但缺乏最坏情况理论保证，而 LSH 等有较成熟的理论；作者希望解释这一理论空白，并探寻可从理论上突破的方向。

Method: 理论下界：对"标准图方法"（在平坦或分层图上运行贪婪搜索的变体）给出强下界，证明其在欧氏空间 c-ANN 中无法实现亚线性查询时间，且对任意大的近似因子 c 均成立。上界：构造性证明在允许搜索图中加入 Steiner 点时可实现亚线性查询，得到 Õ(n^{1/(c-1)}) 的查询时间。并辅以初步实验，探索将 Steiner 点融入实际图方法的方式。

Result: 标准贪婪式图搜索在欧氏空间无法获得亚线性查询时间（任意近似因子下）；引入 Steiner 点后可获得与 LSH 可比的查询时间 Õ(n^{1/(c-1)})；初步实验展示了 Steiner 点在实用图结构中的可行接入方式。

Conclusion: 标准图方法缺乏亚线性理论保证源于其内在结构性限制，而非仅仅是分析技术未成熟；Steiner 点提供了从理论到实践弥合该差距的可行途径。

Abstract: Graph-based nearest neighbor search algorithms like HNSW, DiskANN, NSG, and others have surged in popularity in recent years due to their excellent empirical performance in comparison to space-partitioning methods like IVF data structures and Locality Sensitive Hashing (LSH). However, in contrast to LSH and related methods, obtaining strong worst-case theoretical guarantees for graph-based search has proven challenging. In this paper, we prove a strong lower bound that helps explain the lack of progress towards such guarantees. We show that no standard graph-based method (any that runs a variant of greedy search on a flat or hierarchical graph) can achieve sublinear query time for approximate nearest neighbor search in Euclidean space, even for an arbitrarily large approximation factor. On the other hand, we prove that sublinear query time is possible if we allow for Steiner points in the search graph. We obtain bounds comparable to LSH, showing e.g., that graph-based search with Steiner points can solve $c$-approximate nearest neighbor search in Euclidean space with query time $\tilde{O}(n^{1/(c-1)})$. We complement this result with initial experiments exploring how Steiner points can be incorporated into practical graph-based methods.

</details>


### [1705] [Online Interval Selection with Binary Predictions: Optimal Consistency and a Continuous Robustness Tradeoff](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37361v1)
*Zhong Han*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究带二分类预测的在线区间选择问题（可撤销接受、不可恢复拒绝），刻画了一致性与鲁棒性之间的最优权衡：确定性算法以一致性 d=(3+√5)/2 达到精确鲁棒性 φ^5≈11.090，并证明鲁棒性预算低于 4φ+3≈9.472 时一致性必须严格高于 d；进一步给出基于"账本"机制的可调替换代价连续族，并分析了随机化的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线算法通常追求鲁棒性，而学习增强（algorithms with predictions）希望利用预测获得更好一致性。区间选择中"可撤销、不可恢复"的在线决策特性使得预测利用更微妙。作者希望刻画：在几乎必然（含随机算法）成立的强保证下，一致性与鲁棒性之间的精确最优权衡，并给出达到最优的确定性算法及随机化的作用。

Method: 1) 模型：给定关于最终最优解归属的二分类预测，请求任意顺序到达，接受可撤销、拒绝或撤销不可恢复，收益与区间长度成正比。2) 下界：构造连续下界，证明任意鲁棒性预算低于 4φ+3 时一致性必须严格高于 d=(3+√5)/2。3) 算法：确定性算法达到一致性 d，并具有精确鲁棒性 φ^5；核心机制是给每个保留区间维护一个"账本"，记录因不可撤销决策而损失的正向预测质量。4) 推广：引入可调替换代价，得到连续的一致性—鲁棒性参数族，在两个参数区间上取得精确鲁棒性，包括 (C,R)=(25/9,10) 与 (4,7)。5) 随机化分析：区分期望鲁棒性与几乎必然鲁棒性。

Result: 在所有固定输入上几乎必然成立的保证下，最佳一致性为 d=(3+√5)/2；当鲁棒性预算低于 4φ+3≈9.472 时，一致性被严格下界推高至 d 之上；确定性算法以精确鲁棒性 φ^5≈11.090 达成 d。可调替换代价族在整个参数范围内给出精确一致性，并在两个区间上给出精确鲁棒性，如 (C,R)=(25/9,10) 与 (4,7)。随机化可使期望一致性趋近于 1，同时保持有限期望鲁棒性；但若要求几乎必然鲁棒性，则任何有限预算下期望一致性必须严格大于 2。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了带二分类预测的在线区间选择中一致性—鲁棒性权衡的近乎完整刻画：确定性情形下 d 与 φ^5 构成紧的最优点，并以连续下界说明其最优性；基于"预测质量账本"与可调替换代价的设计形成可调参数族并取得多组精确最优值；同时揭示随机化中期望鲁棒性与几乎必然鲁棒性之间的本质分离，为学习增强在线区间选择提供了理论基准。

Abstract: We study online interval selection with binary predictions of membership in a final optimal solution. Requests arrive in arbitrary order; accepted requests may be revoked, but rejected or revoked requests cannot be recovered. With rewards proportional to interval length, the best consistency under finite strict robustness is $d=(3+\sqrt5)/2$ when both guarantees hold almost surely on each fixed input, including for randomized algorithms. A continuous lower bound forces consistency strictly above $d$ at every robustness budget below $4\varphi+3\approx9.472$, whereas our deterministic algorithm attains $d$ with exact robustness $\varphi^5\approx11.090$, where $\varphi=(1+\sqrt5)/2$. Each held interval inherits a ledger recording positive prediction mass lost through irrevocable decisions. A tunable replacement cost gives a continuous family with exact consistency throughout and exact robustness on two parameter intervals, including $(C,R)=(25/9,10)$ and $(4,7)$. Randomization permits expected consistency approaching one with finite expected robustness, whereas almost-sure robustness forces expected consistency strictly above two at every finite budget.

</details>


### [1706] [Query Complexity of Learning Axis-Aligned Partitions](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35495v1)
*Hadley Black,Arya Mazumdar,Barna Saha,Geelon So*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文确定了在精确查询学习框架下学习高维盒（boxes）的查询复杂度。一般情形下CAL算法极小极大最优，复杂度为Θ(kd log(n/kd))；不相交盒在常数k时优化版Halving可改进log(d)因子；决策树叶子情形复杂度紧致为Θ(d + log n)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维盒是一类重要的几何概念类，但其在精确查询学习（exact query learning）下的查询复杂度此前缺乏系统刻画。作者希望针对不同结构强度（可重叠、不相交、决策树叶子）的盒集合，给出查询复杂度的紧致上下界，并厘清经典算法（CAL、Halving）是否最优。

Method: 将问题形式化为：给定点集X⊂R^d（n个点）由k个盒标注，每个点的标签由唯一包含它的盒决定，学习者通过标签预言机恢复所有点标签。分三种结构层次分析：(1) 一般可重叠盒，分析CAL算法的复杂度并证明其极小极大最优；(2) 不相交盒，分大k与常数k两情形，后者设计Halving的优化变体；(3) 盒为常数规模决策树的叶子，给出加性的紧致界。

Result: 一般情形：CAL为极小极大最优，查询复杂度Θ(kd log(n/kd))。不相交盒大k情形CAL仍最优；常数k情形，优化版Halving（Hegedüs 1995）较CAL改进log(d)因子。决策树叶子情形：紧致复杂度Θ(d + log n)，对d与log n呈加性，推广了Black-Larsen-Mazumdar-Saha-So 2026关于决策树桩（decision stumps）的结果。

Conclusion: 查询复杂度随盒的结构化程度而显著下降：从一般情形约kd log(n/kd)，到不相交常数k时去除log d因子，再到决策树叶子时的加性Θ(d+log n)。CAL在多数情形下已最优，而结构更强的假设需借助Halving类算法或专门分析才能达到更优界。

Abstract: This work establishes the query complexity of learning high-dimensional boxes in the exact query learning setting. Let $X \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ be a set of $n$ points, labeled by a collection of $k$ boxes: the label of each point in $X$ is determined by the unique box containing it. A learner aims to exactly recover the labels for every point in $X$ given access to a label oracle. We consider three increasingly-structured settings. In the most general setting, there are no conditions on the boxes, and they may overlap. We show that CAL (Cohn-Atlas-Ladner 1994), a classical active learning algorithm, is minimax-optimal with query complexity $Θ(kd \log (n/kd))$. When the boxes are disjoint, we examine two regimes. In the large-$k$ regime, CAL remains minimax-optimal. For the constant-$k$ regime, an optimized variant of the Halving algorithm (Hegedüs 1995) can beat CAL by a $\log(d)$ factor. Finally, in the most-structured settings, the boxes correspond to the leaves of a constant-sized decision tree. We prove a tight query complexity of $Θ(d + \log n)$ that is additive in $d$ and $\log n$, generalizing a recent result (Black-Larsen-Mazumdar-Saha-So 2026) that establishes the query complexity of learning decision stumps.

</details>

### [1707] [Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40447v1)
*Gokul Gowri,Nic Fishman,William N. Colgan,Minming Wang,Yusuke Kijima,Sachin A. Kumar,Aleksandr Zimin,Luke W. Koblan,Marinka Zitnik,Zachary D. Smith,Stephen Bates,Philippe Rigollet,Jonathan S. Weissman*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出"谱系修复"（lineage inpainting）：用树结构 Transformer 与随机插值（stochastic interpolants）构建生成模型，以谱系上下文建模谱系树上的细胞状态动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物学核心目标之一是预测多细胞系统动态；谱系上下文（姐妹、表亲等细胞状态）可能提供信息，但如何有效利用尚不清楚。

Method: 线ages inpainting 生成建模方法：树结构 Transformer + 随机插值，在谱系树上建模细胞状态动态；应用于小鼠胚胎发生的谱系示踪转录图谱；通过在未扰动发育上训练来模拟反事实以生成扰动响应假设。

Result: 恢复仅靠基因表达无法解析的动态，包括多个不同谱系被吸引到共同状态的转录趋同事件；模拟的反事实与已观察发育表型在多数情况一致，包括 Tbx5 敲除响应的单细胞测量。

Conclusion: 谱系信息为学习多细胞动态提供了丰富的上下文来源。

Abstract: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear. Here we introduce lineage inpainting, a generative modeling approach that uses lineage context with tree-structured transformers and stochastic interpolants to model cell state dynamics across lineage trees. Applied to a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, it recovers dynamics not resolved by gene expression alone, including multiple transcriptional convergence events where distinct lineages are drawn to a common state. Despite being fit on unperturbed development, lineage inpainting can generate hypotheses about perturbation responses by simulating counterfactuals. These simulations agree in many cases with observed developmental phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response. Our results show that lineage information provides a rich source of context for learning multicellular dynamics.

</details>


### [1708] [Structure, Not Sequence: Tracking and Validating Folding Mechanisms in ESMFold's Trunk with Sparse Autoencoders](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36226v1)
*Bohan Liu,Xiaohan Fan,Wenqian Ye,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 该文用稀疏自编码器（SAE）拆解ESMFold折叠主干，定位单/对表示的分工，并用推理型语言模型在规模上解释特征概念、追踪跨块概念组合并回溯到折叠输出，从而构建稀疏可解释且可验证的折叠电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构预测模型从氨基酸序列到3D结构的驱动机制理解不足，生物意义被困在稠密网络中；SAE已在序列模型中间表示上展现可解释概念提取能力，但面向"从序列语义回归物理形状"的折叠模型尚无对应解释。

Method: 三步法：①试点分析模块与recycle间的表示分布，定位主干中特定的空间计算；②训练SAE字典，揭示单表示承载继承语义、对表示计算成对几何的分工；③借助推理语言模型在规模上解读字典，用梯度归因追踪概念跨block的组合，并将解释代码追踪至折叠输出，与已知生物化学比对。

Result: 字典显露出主干内语义与几何的分工；概念激活可预测模型自身的折叠质量；解释代码在部分环节与已知生物化学一致、在另一些环节偏离。

Conclusion: 所训练的稀疏字典捕获了主干在序列模型之外计算的关系几何，将黑箱折叠主干转化为稀疏、可解释、可科学验证的电路。

Abstract: Structure predictors like ESMFold fold proteins using neural network computation and have transformed structural biology. However, the driving mechanism from amino-acid (AA) sequence to 3D structure is insufficiently understood, and biological meaning remains locked in the dense network. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promising results in obtaining interpretable concept features over an overcomplete basis of intermediate protein sequence-model representations. Yet folding models, which predict physical shape from AA sequence semantics, have no such account. We hypothesize that the features carrying the folding computation evolve in the 3D structural regression process. In this paper, we interpret the folding trunk in three steps. First, a pilot analysis on the representation distribution across modules and recycles locates distinct spatial computation in the trunk. Second, the dictionaries expose a division of labor: the single representation carries inherited semantics, and the pair representation computes the pairwise geometry. Third, we interpret the dictionary at scale with a reasoning language model, trace how the concepts compose across blocks by gradient-based attribution, and follow the interpreted code to the model's folding output, verifying where the computation aligns with, or departs from, known biochemistry. Together, the sparse dictionaries we train capture the relational geometry the trunk computes beyond the sequence model, and their concept activations forecast the model's own fold quality, turning the black-box folding trunk into a sparse, interpretable, and scientifically verifiable circuit.

</details>

### [1709] [Retrospective macromolecular pool fraction mapping from conventional clinical MRI: a physics-guided self-supervised deep learning framework](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37213v1)
*Jelmer van Lune,Miha Fuderer,Oscar van der Heide,Matteo Maspero,Martin B. Schilder,Jan Willem Dankbaar,Stefano Mandija,Alessandro Sbrizzi*

Main category: physics.med-ph

TL;DR: 提出一种物理引导的自监督深度学习框架，无需配对的定量参考扫描，即可从常规临床脑MRI（T1w、T2w、FLAIR）回顾性估计大分子池分数（MPF），并在大规模多中心数据上验证了其稳定性与病理敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPF是对髓鞘完整性及组织大分子含量敏感的定量影像生物标志物，但现有方法依赖专用采集序列与重建流程，限制了其在大规模研究中的应用。

Method: 构建嵌入解析双池磁化转移信号模型（关联序列平均射频发射功率与表观纵向弛豫）的物理引导自监督学习框架；通过自适应实例归一化（AdaIN）使网络中间特征以采集参数为条件，以适应异构临床协议。在7,705次3T MRI会话的多中心、多厂商、多协议数据集上训练与评估。

Result: 1,237次测试会话中，白质平均MPF为0.182±0.007，灰质为0.144±0.009；厂商×协议组间变异系数分别为2.65%与5.63%。70例脱髓鞘疾病标注会话中，病灶区MPF较正常表现白质降低35.6%。同一健康志愿者两种临床协议间MPF图的平均体素绝对百分比差异为7.7%，一致性相关系数0.888。

Conclusion: 磁化转移信息引导的自监督学习可从常规临床MRI稳定生成MPF图，为在既有影像档案和前瞻性常规扫描中研究脱髓鞘病理提供了无需专用qMT采集的可扩展途径。

Abstract: Macromolecular pool fraction (MPF) is a quantitative imaging biomarker sensitive to myelin integrity and other changes in tissue macromolecular content, but specialized acquisitions and reconstruction methods limit its use in large-scale studies. We present a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF directly from conventional clinical brain MRI ($T_1$-weighted, $T_2$-weighted, and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR]) without paired quantitative reference scans. The framework embeds an analytical two-pool magnetization transfer signal model that related sequence-averaged radiofrequency transmit power to apparent longitudinal relaxation. To accommodate heterogeneous clinical protocols, the network conditions intermediate features on acquisition parameters via adaptive instance normalization. It was trained and evaluated on a multisite, multivendor, multiprotocol dataset of 7,705 MRI sessions (3 T). Across 1,237 test sessions, mean MPF was $0.182 \pm 0.007$ in white matter and $0.144 \pm 0.009$ in gray matter, with limited variation across vendor-by-protocol groups (between-group coefficient of variation: 2.65% and 5.63%, respectively). In 70 sessions with demyelinating-disease labels, MPF was 35.6% lower in segmented lesions than in normal-appearing white matter. MPF maps from two different clinical protocols acquired in a healthy volunteer showed a mean voxel-wise absolute percentage difference of 7.7% and a concordance correlation coefficient of $0.888$, indicating good cross-protocol consistency. These results suggest that magnetization transfer-informed self-supervised learning enables stable MPF mapping from conventional clinical MRI, providing a scalable approach to investigate demyelinating pathology in both existing imaging archives and prospectively acquired conventional clinical scans without dedicated qMT acquisitions.

</details>
